Maybe every Mika has a little golden heart. You just have to let it shine a bit. Night night.
Grandpa Guh's most favorite story of all: how a cold, bare valley turned into soft pink Snuggledale, straight out of a guh's dream.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.0: This is my very favorite story. It's about this place, right here. Snuggledale.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.1: A long, long time ago this was a cold, bare valley. Nothing grew here, nobody lived here.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.2: Then an old guh came by, very tired from searching for cheese nibbles. He lay down and fell asleep.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.3: He dreamed of a place that was always soft and pink, where everyone cuddled each other, and nobody was ever alone.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.4: And because guh dreams sometimes come true, the next morning soft pink grass grew everywhere. And fluffy trees. And guhs.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.5: They built a little town, with a square and a fountain, and every year they celebrate the Great Cozyfest.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.6: Who that old guh was? Hmm... maybe it was my grandpa. Or maybe... it was me. Night night, little ones. *snore*
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.knuffelbad_: Find the Snuggle Pool by the Guh Sea
Wash your own guh in a guh washtub: soap, lather, rinse, blow-dry
Go down one of the Snuggle Pool's slides
Go down all three slides: the Pink Funnel, the Glow Tunnel and the Big Splash
Find all twelve special rubber duckies on the slides
item.guhs.guhshampoo.lore: On your tame guh at a guh washtub: step 1 of the bath ritual
item.guhs.guh_fohn.lore: Hold right-click on a rinsed guh: dry, fluffy and shiny!
item.guhs.knuffelbad_badeendje.lore: Put it on the water: it bobs and squeaks when you pet it
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.badmeesterguh: Rarity: Rare (Snuggle Pool, by the Guh Sea)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.badmeesterguh: The lifeguard of the Snuggle Pool. He keeps an eye on the three slides, teaches you how to wash a guh until it shines, and blows his whistle when you run. Tweeet! His little shop: swim caps, bathrobes and bubble foam for Ducky Coins.
structure.guhs.knuffelbad.tooltip: The swimming pool by the Guh Sea: a guh head full of bubble bath, washtubs and three big slides
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.bezet: Nyeg, %s is still sliding! Just a moment...
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.start.roze_trechter: The Pink Funnel! Two funnels with a guh face gulp you down, and then you flomp into the foam. There are %s duckies floating on the slide.
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.start.glimtunnel: The Glow Tunnel! Pitch dark, round and round the Star Guh's tower, with glowing little stars everywhere. There are %s duckies floating on the slide.
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.start.grote_plons: The Big Splash! Down the Giant Guh's tongue, and then... SPLASH! There are %s duckies floating on the slide.
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.besturing: Steer: left and right (A/D). Look around with your mouse. Stop: hold sneak.
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.speciaal: A special rubber ducky: %s! It's in your Guhdex now (Cozy).
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.uitslag: %s: %s points, %s of %s duckies, longest combo %s. You get %s Ducky Coins!
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.alle_eendjes: Grabbed ALL the duckies! What a champ, super wahoog!
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.eerste_record: Your first record on this slide: %s points!
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.uitgestapt: You got off the slide. Nyeg, next time go all the way down!
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.niet_bouwen: Nyeg! The Snuggle Pool belongs to Lifeguard Bubbles: we don't break or build anything here.
gui.guhs.scorebord.knuffelbad: Slide Champions of the Snuggle Pool
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.scherm.intro: Three slides, twelve special rubber duckies and foam up to your ears!
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.scherm.besturing: Click the little gate at the top of a slide. Steer with A and D!
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.scherm.winkel.toolti: Swim cap, bathrobe, shampoo, a hair dryer, tiles and foam, for Ducky Coins
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.scherm.wassen.toolti: How do you wash a guh until he shines? (The first time you get shampoo and a hair dryer!)
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.niet_van_jou: Nyeg, you can only wash your own tame guh.
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.geen_tobbe: Find a guh washtub first (no more than 6 blocks away)!
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.ingezeept: %s is in the bath and all soaped up! Now scrub: click your guh with an empty hand.
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.geschuimd: So much foam! Now rinse: click the washtub (the shower).
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.gespoeld: Rinsed clean! Now blow-dry: point the guh hair dryer at your guh.
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.klaar: %s is shining! So fluffy and clean. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.klaar.chat: %s is washed and will shine for a whole day. Lifeguard Bubbles gives you Ducky Coins!
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.iemand_anders: Nyeg, someone else is already washing this guh.
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.hint.inzepen: Soap up first: guh shampoo on your guh at a washtub.
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.hint.schuimen: Scrub first until there's enough foam (click your guh with an empty hand)!
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.hint.spoelen: Rinse first: click the washtub for the shower!
gui.guhs.knuffelbad.was.hint.fohnen: Now blow-dry: hold the guh hair dryer on your guh!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.hallo_n: Tooot! Welcome to the Snuggle Pool! I'm Lifeguard Bubbles. Here we wash guhs until they shine, and we have the three biggest slides in the whole Guhmension. Click a slide gate up top, hop in your swim ring and steer toward the rubber duckies. No running, but WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.hallo: Tooot! There you are again! Fancy a splash, or does a guh need a bath?
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.niet_re: TOOOOT! No running by the pool! We only slide on the slide, nyeg. Walk nice and chonky, like a real guh.
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.winkel: Have a look around. Everything costs Ducky Coins: you earn those on the slides and by washing.
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.wassen: Washing guhs goes like this: 1. guh shampoo on your tame guh at a washtub (then it hops in), 2. scrub with your hands until it's covered in suds, 3. rinse (click the tub), 4. blow-dry until it's dry. Then it shines for a whole day. So fluffy! Nyeg, not too chonky? Nope: never too chonky, just wahoog.
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.cadeaut: Here, a bottle of guh shampoo and a hair dryer from me. For your first wash. Tooot!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip0: Steer left and right (A and D) toward the duckies. Grab a few in a row and you get a combo. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip1: In the funnels you get pushed outward against the wall. Steer inward for the duckies at the bottom!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip2: The Glow Tunnel is pitch dark, but the little stars glow. Keep a close eye out for the glow duckies and star duckies, nyeg.
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip3: At the Big Splash you fly through the air at the end. The faster you go, the bigger the splash!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip4: A washed guh shines for a whole day. So clean and fluffy! You can never be too chonky, just not wahoog enough yet. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip5: The Mikas sometimes snatch cheese nibbles from the pool bags. Nyeg! Keep your stuff with you, and your guh will be wahoog enough.
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip6: There's a golden ducky. I've only seen it once myself. It was beautiful. *sniff*
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip7: Hold sneak if you really want to get off the slide. But then you won't get any Ducky Coins, okay.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.vadseendje.info: An extra-round ducky with a chonky little tummy. You can never be too chonky, just not wahoog enough yet. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.kaaseendje.info: Yellow with little holes, just like a piece of cheese. Smells a bit like cheese nibbles. Nyeg, don't eat it!
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.guheendje.info: A ducky with little guh ears and pink blushies. It doesn't say quack, it says guh.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.badmeestereendj: With a red cap and a whistle, just like Lifeguard Bubbles. Tweeeet, no running!
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.pluiseendje.inf: Super soft and pink, with a fluffy little quiff. Only floats in the Pink Funnel.
Has a spiral on its tummy and is a little dizzy. Only found in the Pink Funnel.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.sterreneendje.i: Dark blue with glowing little stars. You'll only find it in the Glow Tunnel.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.glimeendje.info: It glows all over in the dark! Only in the Glow Tunnel. Glow glow, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.maaneendje.info: A sleepy ducky with a nightcap and a little moon. Only in the Glow Tunnel. Zzz... quack.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.duikeendje.info: With a snorkel and goggles, ready for the Big Splash. Only found there.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.plonseendje.inf: Sky blue with a little water crown: the little king of the Big Splash.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.gouden_eendje.i: The rarest ducky in the whole Snuggle Pool! It shines like a golden cheese nibble. Whoever grabs it is super wahoog.
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.wereldleven: Eat a cheese ice cream from Jingles the Ice Cream Guh, or give one to a guh
Play a song on the guh xylophone (or your whistle) and let guhs sing along
Play all six songs on the guh xylophone
Grab a plushie from the claw machine
Collect all 22 guh plushies, the glitter plushie too
item.guhs.guh_fluitje.tooltip: Whistle your latest song: all guhs nearby sing along (and the gardens grow from it).
item.guhs.wereldleven_liedjesboekje.tool: Six guh songs, with the bars of the guh xylophone. Practicing is always allowed!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.seizoensijsje: Seasonal ice cream: only in %s from Jingles the Ice Cream Guh
gui.guhs.wereldleven.ijsje_tip: Right-click a guh with it: he gets the ice cream!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.ijscoguh: Rarity: Drops by (Guhmension, also on the Snuggledale square)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.ijscoguh: Jingles the Ice Cream Guh cycles through the Guhmension with his ice cream cart. Ding-a-ling! He sells cheese ice creams for cheese nibbles, with an extra flavor every season. The guhs chase after him. After a day he cycles on.
quest.guhs.ijscoguh.hallo.0: Ding-a-ling! Cheese ice creams! So cold they make you wahoog!
quest.guhs.ijscoguh.hallo.1: Nyeg, what a warm day! Fancy a cheese ice cream? One for your guh too?
quest.guhs.ijscoguh.hallo.2: The Mikas always want to snatch my ice creams. But I pedal faster! Ding-a-ling!
quest.guhs.ijscoguh.hallo.3: Give an ice cream to your guh: then it gets an ice cream hat. So cute, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ijscoguh.alsjeblieft: Here you go! Don't lick too fast, or you'll get cold ears.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.ijscoguh_komt: Ding-a-ling! Ding-a-ling! Jingles the Ice Cream Guh is coming!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.ijscoguh_geen_plek: Jingles the Ice Cream Guh has nowhere to stand here, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.marshmallow: %s toasts the marshmallow nibble over the campfire and gobbles it up. Mmmm, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.oefenen: Practice! On a real guh xylophone, guhs sing along.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.koortje_leeg: ♪ %s ♪ - play it near guhs and they'll sing along!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.nieuw_liedje: New in your songbook: %s! You get %s cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.liedjesboek_vol: All six songs! You're now the choir conductor of the Guhmension: here's your choir bow. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.fluit_leeg: You whistle %s. There's no guh nearby to sing along, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.grijp_kaartje: You need a ticket: a Fair Ticket or a coin from a minigame. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.grijp_glipt: Nyeg! It slips out of the claw... So close!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.grijp_mis: The claw grabs thin air. Nothing underneath, nyeg!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.grijp_gepakt: Grabbed: %s! Plus a Fair Ticket. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.grijp_glitter: WOW! The GLITTER PLUSHIE: %s! Plus a Fair Ticket. SUPER WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.grijp_gestopt: The claw machine has stopped. Your ticket is used up, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.grijp_stuur: WASD or arrows: steer. Space: grab!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.grijp_gewonnen: Grabbed! It's in your pocket (or at your feet). WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.normal.info: The very first plushie: a regular, soft, chonky guh. Squeeze it and it squeaks.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.mint.info: Fresh as a mint and just as soft.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.choco.info: Smells a little like chocolate. Don't eat it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.snow.info: White as fresh snow, warm as a blankie.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.brontosaurus.i: With a long neck, so it can peek over the other plushies.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.golden.info: A shiny golden guh. The fair guhs are jealous of it.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.rainbow.info: All the colors at once. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.starry.info: Purple with little stars: perfect for falling asleep with.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.ghost.info: A little see-through. Boo! (It's very sweet.)
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.teckel.info: Extra long, so extra much to cuddle.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.brococolief.in: In its pink onesie. What the note said, it won't tell.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.ender.info: With tiny little wings. It doesn't fly, but it does cuddle.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.koning.info: With a little crown and a white mane. His Chonkiness.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.wolk.info: A little cloud on its head and as light as a bit of fluff.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.zeemeerguh.inf: With a fish tail. Fits just right in your bathtub.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.mager.info: A little gray and thin... quick, give it a cheese nibble!
Gold and pink, with little wings: the wahoogest plushie of the Guh End.
Green-and-yellow spotted, and it smells ever so softly of cheese sauce.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.asguh.info: Gray with glowing little cheeks, but it's not hot at all.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.pluisguh.info: Super fluffy, with a little quiff. From Snuggledale!
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.pinguh.info: Black and white with an orange snoot. It doesn't waddle, but it does cuddle. From the Guh Polder!
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.glitter.info: Very rare: a plushie full of glitter that glows a little in the dark. It slips out of the claw easily!
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.roze.info: Strawberry cheese. It gives you blushies.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.ijsje_guh.roze: Blushies! %s looks super shy and happy. WAHOOG!
item.guhs.kaasijsje_mint.tooltip: Fresh mint with cheese flakes. Makes you run a bit faster.
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.mint.info: Fresh mint with cheese flakes. Makes you run a bit faster for a while.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.ijsje_guh.mint: %s is wearing an ice cream hat now. So fresh, nyeg!
item.guhs.kaasijsje_choco.tooltip: Chocolate cheese: you suddenly feel light as a little puff.
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.choco.info: Chocolate cheese: suddenly you feel as light as a bit of fluff.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.ijsje_guh.choco: %s floats a little, wearing a choco ice cream hat!
item.guhs.kaasijsje_bloesem.tooltip: Spring only: pink blossom with cheese. Blushies and a warm feeling.
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.bloesem.info: Spring only: pink blossom with cheese. Blushies and a warm feeling.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.ijsje_guh.bloesem: %s gets blushies and a blossom ice cream hat. Spring guh!
item.guhs.kaasijsje_zonnetje.tooltip: Summer only: lemon cheese with a little sun on top. Floaty and fast!
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.zonnetje.info: Summer only: lemon cheese with a little sun on top. Floaty and fast!
gui.guhs.wereldleven.ijsje_guh.zonnetje: %s floats in the sun wearing a yellow ice cream hat. WAHOOG!
item.guhs.kaasijsje_appeltaart.tooltip: Fall only: apple pie with cheese and crumbs. Warm inside.
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.appeltaart.info: Fall only: apple pie with cheese and crumbs. Warm on the inside.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.ijsje_guh.appeltaar: %s gobbles it up and gets blushies. Fall cozies!
item.guhs.kaasijsje_sneeuw.tooltip: Winter only: snow-white vanilla cheese. Brr... and still yummy.
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.sneeuw.info: Winter only: snow-white vanilla cheese. Brr... and still yummy.
gui.guhs.wereldleven.ijsje_guh.sneeuw: %s floats like a little snowflake, with blushies and a white ice cream hat!
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.toonladder.inf: Do re mi fa so la ti do: from the lowest bar to the highest. Every guh's first song.
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.vader_guh.info: Are you sleeping, are you sleeping, Brother Guh? Nibble bells are ringing... (Nobody sings along during nap time.)
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.altijd_vads.in: Twinkle, twinkle, little guh, chonky in your nibble bag. No, not too chonky: just not wahoog enough yet!
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.alle_guhtjes: All the Guhlings Swim in Cheese Sauce
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.alle_guhtjes.i: All the guhlings swim in cheese sauce, tra-la-la-la-lee, tra-la-la-la-lauce!
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.maneschijn: By the Light of the Nibble Moon
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.maneschijn.inf: By the light of the nibble moon, under the pink moon of the Guhmension.
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.ode_aan_de_kna: The most solemn guh song of all: about the very first cheese nibble. It makes Grandpa Guh teary.
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.wereldleven_ijsco: Met Jingles the Ice Cream Guh
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.wereldleven_ijsje: Seven cheese ice creams eaten or given
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.wereldleven_gezwa: Waved at by a guh ten times
item.guhs.pieppiepmuisje_item.tooltip: Right-click a block: the mousie hops off. Right-click in the air: onto your shoulder! Squeak.
item.guhs.poepschilly_item.tooltip: A picked-up Poopshelly (name and all). Right-click a block: it waddles off again. Blub!
item.guhs.schilly_item.tooltip: A picked-up Shelly (name and all). Right-click a block: there's Shelly again. Tiny head!
block.guhs.roze_guh_koek.tooltip: Eat it: Puppy Eyes! Place it: a tray with room for six. Empty hand: gobble one up, sneak: take one.
item.guhs.roze_guh_koek.tooltip: Eat it: Puppy Eyes! Place it: a tray with room for six. Empty hand: gobble one up, sneak: take one.
item.guhs.roze_guh_koek_recept.tooltip: Right-click to learn the secret recipe. Then bake it in the Nibble Oven: sweet dough, disc, icing. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.piep.muisje_getamed: Squeak squeak! The mousie is yours now. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.piep.verstoppertje: %s wants to play hide-and-seek... squeak! Find the mousie!
gui.guhs.piep.gevonden: Found it! Squeak squeak squeak! (a happy little mousie dance)
gui.guhs.piep.niet_gevonden: The mousie comes out all by itself... squeak. (A tiny bit proud.)
gui.guhs.piep.opgepakt: You pick up the mousie. It fits right in your hand. Squeak!
gui.guhs.piep.op_schouder: The mousie climbs onto your shoulder. Squeak! (Sneak + right-click a block: hop off.)
gui.guhs.piep.schouder_vol: There's already a mousie on your shoulder, nyeg.
gui.guhs.piep.poepschilly_klaar: Poopshelly is raring to go! Now right-click (empty hand) one of your tame guhs...
gui.guhs.piep.poepschilly_rust: Poopshelly is resting after all that polishing (%s:%s left).
gui.guhs.piep.poepschilly_getamed: Poopshelly is your buddy now! Time for a polish?
gui.guhs.piep.schilly_klaar: Shelly wants a bestie moment! Now right-click (empty hand) one of your tame guhs...
gui.guhs.piep.schilly_rust: Shelly has had enough cuddles for now (%s:%s left).
gui.guhs.piep.schilly_getamed: Shelly is your buddy now! (A tiny head, but a sweet one.)
gui.guhs.piep.schilly_alleen_tam: Poopshelly only crawls into guhs that are yours.
gui.guhs.piep.schilly_waggelt: Poopshelly waddles over to %s's tushie... polish polish!
gui.guhs.piep.schilly_kruipt: Plop! Poopshelly crawls into %s's tushie... it tickles! Guh guh guhhh!
gui.guhs.piep.fris: %s's tushie is sparkling clean again, WAHOOG! (fresh inside)
gui.guhs.piep.schilly_afgebroken: Plop! Poopshelly is already back out. The polish will have to wait, nyeg.
gui.guhs.piep.niet_jouw_maatje: This isn't your buddy, nyeg. Only the owner can do that.
gui.guhs.piep.even_bezig: %s is busy for a bit. Later!
gui.guhs.piep.opgepakt.pieppiepmuisje: You pick up %s. It fits right in your hand. Squeak!
gui.guhs.piep.opgepakt.poepschilly: You pick up %s. He pulls his little legs in: blub!
gui.guhs.piep.opgepakt.schilly: You pick up %s. Shelly looks a bit offended (tiny head), but secretly loves it.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.sub.pieppiepmuisje: Squeaksqueak Mouse: small, fluffy, super sweet
gui.guhs.piep.menu.sub.poepschilly: Poopshelly: the butt-cleaner of the Guh Sea
gui.guhs.piep.menu.sub.schilly: Shelly: tiny head, but a real bestie
gui.guhs.piep.menu.naam.tooltip: Type a new name and press OK (or Enter). Empty = no name. No name tag needed!
gui.guhs.piep.menu.rondvadsen.tooltip: On: happily pottering about. Off: stays right here until you say otherwise.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.rondvadsen.uit: %s stays put right here. Good critter!
gui.guhs.piep.menu.volgen.tooltip: On: walks (or swims) after you. Off: stays near its own little spot.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.volgen.aan: %s follows you everywhere again. Waddle waddle!
gui.guhs.piep.menu.piepjes.tooltip: The mousie squeaks every now and then. Off: a quiet mousie (it still squeaks in hide-and-seek, or you'd never find it).
gui.guhs.piep.menu.verstoppen.tooltip: On: the mousie sometimes hides in a flower pot or basket and squeaks until you find it.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.verstoppen.uit: %s is taking a break from hiding.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.zwemmen.tooltip: On: happily swims laps when there's water. Off: would rather stay on dry land.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.zwemmen.aan: %s is going swimming again. Blub blub!
gui.guhs.piep.menu.besties.tooltip: On: Shelly waddles over to guhs for a bestie moment (or a little beef...). Off: Shelly keeps it chill.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.besties.aan: %s is looking for besties again (and the odd bit of beef).
gui.guhs.piep.menu.besties.uit: %s is keeping it chill. No beef today.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.speciaal.pieppiepmuis: The mousie climbs onto your shoulder. Sneak + right-click a block (empty hand): hop off.
Then right-click (empty hand) one of your tame guhs: Poopshelly crawls into the tushie and polishes it sparkling clean!
gui.guhs.piep.menu.speciaal.schilly.tool: Then right-click (empty hand) one of your guhs: true besties!
gui.guhs.piep.menu.oppakken.tooltip: Into your pocket, name and all. Right-click a block to put it down again. (Sneak + right-click works too.)
gui.guhs.piep.lief_kijken: You suddenly look super sweet... the guhs melt! (Puppy Eyes)
gui.guhs.piep.nest_start: The angry cheese nibbles are waking up! Nyeg nyeg nyeg!
gui.guhs.piep.nest_golf: Wave %s of %s: here they come out of the holes!
gui.guhs.piep.nest_golf_klaar: That wave is beaten (they were a bit sadsie). More are coming...
gui.guhs.piep.nest_baas: The Angry Overnibble is coming! He's very angry. Or... just sadsie?
gui.guhs.piep.nest_beschermd: The Cheese Nibble Nest belongs to the nibbles: no breaking it, nyeg!
gui.guhs.piep.recept_onbekend: You don't know that recipe yet... (it's somewhere in a Cheese Nibble Nest)
gui.guhs.piep.recept_al: You already know this recipe. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.piep.recept_geleerd: You now know the recipe for the Pink Guh Cookie! Bake it in the Nibble Oven: sweet dough + disc + pink icing.
structure.guhs.kaasknabbel_nest.tooltip: A cheese rind hill full of holes... and angry cheese nibbles. Step onto the golden core if you dare!
gui.guhs.knus.piepboek.pieppiepmuisje.in: A teeny-tiny plush mousie: dark purple, with a fluffy cream band around its tummy and a shiny pink nose. It lives in the sweet guh houses of the Guhmension (about one per ten guhs) and adores cheese nibbles. Tame it with a nibble, carry it on your shoulder and play hide-and-seek: it squeaks until you find it!
gui.guhs.knus.piepboek.poepschilly.info: A brown plush sea turtle (with a cream tummy), from the coast of the guh sea. Poopshelly has a very special job: he waddles up to a guh's little bottom, crawls inside and scrubs everything sparkling clean from the inside out. It tickles terribly (the guh wiggles, giggles and blows soap bubbles), and then: plop, there he is again! After that the guh is Fresh Inside: faster and sparkly. Very tidy! (Right-click your Poopshelly for his little menu: Polish a Tushie!) (Note: Poopshelly is the bottom scrubber. His lookalike Shelly looks a lot like him, but doesn't scrub anything.)
gui.guhs.knus.piepboek.schilly.info: Shelly looks a whole lot like Poopshelly, but it really is a different turtle (look closely!). Shelly doesn't scrub guhs: Shelly is a tiny-head. That's why guh and Shelly sometimes have beef and turn their backs on each other in a huff... but they're also true besties, so they always make up again. Right-click your tame Shelly (little menu: Bestie Moment!) and then a guh.
gui.guhs.knus.piepboek.roze_guh_koek.inf: A pink iced cookie with big shiny blue eyes and a little snoot. They come six to a tray. Whoever eats one looks so sweet that the guhs get hearts from it (and are easier to tame). The recipe is in the treasure of the Cheese Nibble Nest.
A cheese nibble with angry eyebrows. Not a guh (a snack!), so it's allowed to be angry. It hops at you and pushes a little. Once defeated it turns out to be mostly... sadsie. It leaves regular cheese nibbles behind.
The biggest, angriest cheese nibble of the nest, with a little crown. It stomps so hard you go flying (jump in time!) and calls for help when things go badly. But really... it was just sadsie.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.beauty.waar: In the Guh Fields, Guh Meadows, Pink Puffs, Nibble Crumbs or Cheese Flats of the Guhmension: the Guh Beauty Theater, with the Show Guh. Chonk on the catwalk!
gui.guhs.spelgroep.race.waar: In the Guh Fields, Guh Meadows, Pink Puffs, Nibble Crumbs or Cheese Flats of the Guhmension: the Guh Racetrack, with the Race Guh in the pit lane.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.meppen.waar: In the Guh Fields, Guh Meadows, Pink Puffs, Nibble Crumbs or Cheese Flats of the Guhmension: the Whack-a-Mika Hall, with the Whack Guh. Whack those nibble thieves!
gui.guhs.spelgroep.disco.waar: In the Guh Fields, Guh Meadows, Pink Puffs, Nibble Crumbs or Cheese Flats of the Guhmension: the Guh Disco with the light-up floor, with the DJ Guh.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.golf.waar: In the Guh Fields, Guh Meadows, Pink Puffs, Nibble Crumbs or Cheese Flats of the Guhmension: the Guh Mini Golf, with the Golf Guh.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.smul.waar: In the Guh Fields, Guh Meadows, Pink Puffs, Nibble Crumbs or Cheese Flats of the Guhmension: the Chonky Food Fest, with the Munch Guh. Get nice and wahoog!
gui.guhs.spelgroep.vissen.waar: In the Guh Fields, Guh Meadows, Pink Puffs, Nibble Crumbs or Cheese Flats of the Guhmension: the Guhfish Pond, with the Fishing Guh on the jetty.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.verstop.waar: In the Guh Fields, Guh Meadows, Pink Puffs, Nibble Crumbs or Cheese Flats of the Guhmension: the Hide-and-Guh House, with Hidey Guh on the roof.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.kermis.waar: In the Guh Fields, Guh Meadows, Pink Puffs, Nibble Crumbs or Cheese Flats of the Guhmension: the Guh Fair, with the Fair Guh.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.bakkerij.waar: In the town of Snuggledale (Snuggledale biome): the Nibble Bakery, with Baker Crusty behind the counter.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.creche.waar: In the town of Snuggledale (Snuggledale biome): the Snuggle Daycare, with Miss Snuggles.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.kapper.waar: In the town of Snuggledale (Snuggledale biome): the Snip & Chonk hair salon, with Curly the Barber.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.knuffelbad.waar: In the Guh Sea: the Snuggle Pool with the big slides, with Lifeguard Bubbles.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.grijpmachine.waar: In the town of Snuggledale (Snuggledale biome): the claw machine on the square. Grab a plushie!
gui.guhs.spelgroep.sjoelen.waar: In the Guh Meadows: the Shuffle House with the giant shuffleboard, with Granny Nyegshuffle.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.doolhof.waar: In the Guh Fields: the big hedge maze, with Mr. Chonkwiggle at the entrance.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.katapult.waar: On the Chonk Cliffs: the guh castle with the catapult, with Captain Floopguh.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.knabbelspelen.waar: In the Guh Meadows and the Pink Puffs: the big circus tent, with Coach Wahoogaroo.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.elftocht.waar: In the ice-cold Guh Polder: start and finish in Guhwarden, with Skate Master Guhglide.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.circuit.waar: In the Guh Fields and the Cheese Flats: the Guh Circuit, with Coach Wahoog-Vroom in the pit lane.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.sledesprint.waar: In the white Snowguh Tundra: Nomguh, at the starting line with Steele Mika. Who's the fastest sled guh?
gui.guhs.spelgroep.guhwaii_spellen.waar: On the beach of an island of Guhwai'i: the surf beach, with Lilo-guh. Aloha, nyeg!

gui.guhs.kleding.nee.rugzak_niet_leeg: Empty the backpack first, nyeg! There's still all sorts of stuff in it.

gui.guhs.kleding.hooibaal.strohoed: Farmer Haybale: "What a hard worker! Here, my old straw hat. I bet it looks adorable on your guh!"
gui.guhs.kleding.hooibaal.overall: Farmer Haybale: "You're a real farm guh! Here you go: overalls, for your chonkiest guh."

gui.guhs.gids.minigames.zelf: just play on your own, no game host
gui.guhs.gids.minigames.geen_scores: We don't keep scores here: just have fun playing, wahoog!

advancements.guhs.grote_guhspelen.gids_w: Visit EVERY minigame building in the Guhmension and Snuggledale. Check the Guhdex (Minigames) to see which ones you're still missing!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.golf.geen_strafslag: No penalty stroke on easy: your ball goes back
gui.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.ontsnapt: Nyeg! The %s of %s wriggles off your hook and swims away giggling...
quest.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.ontsnapt_t: Escaped: %s fish. They're swimming around the pond all chonky now.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.beauty.makkelijk: A whole minute to dress your model, and a sweet jury: every judge gives one extra point. Nice and relaxed, chonk!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.beauty.medium: The Chonk Pageant as always: 45 seconds to dress up, a fair jury.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.beauty.lastig: Only 30 seconds to dress up! And a strict jury: Miss Chonksley takes off two points for every piece of clothing that doesn't fit the theme, Mr. Glitterguh wants a matching set and Granny Nibbles is picky. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.meppen.makkelijk: The Mikas pop up more calmly and stay up longer. Fewer guhs in between (don't whack them!) and more golden Mikas.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.meppen.medium: Whack-a-Mika as always: faster and faster, more and more heads.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.meppen.lastig: Super fast Mikas that are gone in a flash, lots more guhs in between (don't whack them, nyeg!) and golden Mikas are rare.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.golf.makkelijk: 10 strokes per hole and no penalty strokes: if your ball lands in the cheese sauce or goes off the course, it simply goes back. You tee off from the green mats, close to the hole.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.golf.medium: Guh Golf as always: 8 strokes per hole, cheese sauce or off the course is a penalty stroke.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.golf.lastig: Only 6 strokes per hole plus penalty strokes, from the red tee mats all the way at the back. The Golf Guh puts out extra pink slime bumpers and her guh windmill spins twice as fast. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.smul.makkelijk: The food falls more slowly and there's much less Mika's Grease. Munching without stress!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.smul.medium: The Chonky Food Fest as always.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.smul.lastig: The food falls much faster and the Mikas throw down buckets of Mika's Grease. Only for true munch champions!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.makkelijk: A bite? You have plenty of time to reel it in (2 to 3.5 seconds). No fish gets away!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.medium: The Guhfish Contest as always: on a bite, 1 to 2 seconds to reel it in.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.lastig: On a bite you only have half a second! And fish can wriggle off your hook: the heavier the fish, the bigger the chance. (The Mika Catfish always stays on, nyeg!)
quest.guhs.klassiekers.meppen.makkelijk: Take it easy today: the Mikas are still sleepy from their nap. Whack 'em!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.meppen.lastig: Careful, these are the fastest Mikas in the whole Guhmension! And there are sneakily lots of guhs among them: DON'T whack those, okay!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.smul.makkelijk: The Mikas are nice and lazy today: hardly any Mika's Grease is falling. Enjoy your meal!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.smul.lastig: Uh-oh, the Mikas are up top with buckets full of Mika's Grease, and the food falls like a rocket! Will your guh still get wahoog?
quest.guhs.klassiekers.golf.makkelijk: No penalty strokes today, and you get %s strokes per hole. Aim nice and easy!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.golf.lastig: Only %s strokes per hole, from the red mats at the back, with extra slime bumpers and a turbo guh windmill! Wahoog aiming, nyeg!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.beauty.makkelijk: Take your time: %s seconds per round, and the jury is extra sweet today.
quest.guhs.klassiekers.beauty.lastig: Only %s seconds per round, and the jury has her strictest glasses on. Show what you've got!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.makkelijk: The fish are biting very calmly today: you have plenty of time to reel them in.
quest.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.lastig: The fish are as fast as a Mika with a cheese nibble today! Reel them in quick, and hold on tight.
advancements.guhs.grote_guhspelen.klassi: Play a classic on easy: the beauty show, whacking, golf, munching or fishing
Play a classic on medium, just the way you're used to
Walk a whole show on hard: 30 seconds to dress up and a strict jury
Play Whack-a-Mika on hard and whack at least one Mika
Play all 9 holes of guh golf on hard: 6 strokes per hole, the farthest tees and extra slime bumpers!
Score points at the Chonky Food Fest on hard, dodging all that Mika's Grease
Fish a whole Guhfish Contest on hard, where the fish wriggle off your hook
Play all five classics on hard. You're the most wahoog guh in the Guhmension!
advancements.guhs.grote_guhspelen.sjoele: Find the Shuffle House in the Guh Meadows: the little house with a giant shuffleboard for a roof
Shuffle a whole turn of twenty pucks with Granny Nyegshuffle
Score 60 points or more in one turn
Score the full 100 points: five pucks in every gate
Collect the whole shuffleboard outfit: the shuffle cap, the shuffle vest and the shuffle brooch
item.guhs.sjoelen_schijven.lore: Stand at the head of the shuffleboard, hold right-click (the power bar goes up and down), look where it needs to go and let go. Shuffle away!
item.guhs.sjoelen_schijven.loan: Borrowed from Granny Nyegshuffle: after your turn they go back in her little box.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.sjoelguh: Rarity: Unique (in the Shuffle House in the Guh Meadows)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.sjoelguh: Granny Nyegshuffle has played shuffleboard since she was a little guh. She knits her own cardigans, pours tea for everyone who comes to watch and knows exactly how hard to push a puck: "Not too soft, not too hard, just wahoog, sweetie!" She never gets cross, not even when you slide every puck into gate 1. Nyeg!
structure.guhs.sjoelhuisje.tooltip: Minigame: guh shuffleboard with Granny Nyegshuffle, shuffle pucks and a knitted shuffleboard outfit (Guh Meadows)
quest.guhs.sjoelen.hello1: Well hello, dearie! Come to play shuffleboard? Twenty pucks, four gates, and a cup of tea afterwards. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.hello2: Nyeg nyeg, there's a new little guh! Do you know how it works? One puck in each gate: that's a set, twenty points!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.hello3: I waxed the board again this morning. Smooth as a cheese nibble in butter! Give it a try.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.hello4: Back in the day I played shuffleboard with my grandpa until late at night. He slid everything into gate 1... but I loved him anyway. Fancy a game?
quest.guhs.sjoelen.playing: You're playing shuffleboard, dearie! Go stand at the head of the board. Want to stop? That's fine too.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.busy: Just a moment, dearie: %s is playing right now. Watch from the bench!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.elsewhere: You're already playing shuffleboard somewhere else!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.broken: Nyeg... where did my shuffleboard go? I can't find the head anymore.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.full: Your pockets are stuffed full! Free up one slot for the pucks, then I'll lend them to you.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.start: Here are your twenty pucks. Go stand at the head of the board... ready? 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.sjoelen.how: Hold right-click with the pucks: the power bar goes up and down. Between Granny's two lines is just right. Look where it needs to go and let go. Walk sideways to slide from the left or right. Gates: 2-3-4-1. Every set (one in each gate) = 20 points!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.stopped: You stop playing. The pucks go back in Granny's little box. See you soon, dearie!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.walked_away: You walked away from the shuffleboard. Granny Nyegshuffle packs up her pucks.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.idle: Nyeg, did you fall asleep? Granny is tidying up the pucks.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.total: %s sets (%s points) + the rest (%s points) = %s points
quest.guhs.sjoelen.first_record: Your first turn: %s points. That's your record right away!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.no_record: Your record stays at %s points. Another game?
quest.guhs.sjoelen.munten: +%s shuffle pucks (1 for your turn, 1 per set, 1 for a new record)
quest.guhs.sjoelen.first: Your very first turn! A present from Granny: cheese nibbles and a little stack of shuffle pucks for at home. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.huis_record: HOUSE RECORD! Your name now floats at the top of the Shuffle House. Granny's knitting a scarf for it!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.opoe_100: A HUNDRED! Five in every gate! In a hundred years I've never seen anything so wahoog. Come here, you get a cuddle!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.opoe_goed: Well done, dearie! You can really play. Granny is proud of you.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.opoe_aardig: That was pretty good already! Try to give every gate the same amount, then you get more sets.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.opoe_oefenen: Nyeg, never mind! Practice makes perfect. Slide gently, between the two lines.
gui.guhs.sjoelen.countdown_sub: Stand at the head of the shuffleboard
gui.guhs.sjoelen.look: Look at the little gates at the end of the board!
gui.guhs.sjoelen.stand: Stand at the head of the shuffleboard to shuffle
gui.guhs.sjoelen.all_gone: All pucks shuffled! Granny will count them in a sec.
gui.guhs.sjoelen.wait_puck: Wait until your last puck is gone!
gui.guhs.sjoelen.good: Lovely! Right between Granny's little lines.
gui.guhs.sjoelen.no_build: Nyeg! The Shuffle House belongs to Granny: no breaking or building here.
gui.guhs.sjoelen.question: Fancy a turn at shuffleboard? Twenty pucks across the big board, into the gates 2-3-4-1. The more sets, the more Shuffle Pucks!
gui.guhs.sjoelen.mine: You're shuffling (%s pucks left). You can stop any time.
gui.guhs.sjoelen.busy: %s is shuffling. Watch from the bench or wait a little!
gui.guhs.sjoelen.play.tooltip: You get twenty pucks and stand at the head of the board
gui.guhs.sjoelen.stop.tooltip: Your turn stops; what's already in the gates no longer counts
gui.guhs.sjoelen.shop.tooltip: Granny's knitted shuffle outfit for your guh, for Shuffle Pucks
gui.guhs.sjoelen.rules: Every set (one in 2, 3, 4 and 1) is 20 points. Leftovers count per gate: 2, 3, 4 or 1. 100 at most!
advancements.guhs.grote_guhspelen.doolho: Find The Guh Maze in the Guh Fields (and say hello to Mr. Chonkwiggle)
Find all the stolen cheese nibbles in the maze and run to the exit
Beat the hard maze: sixteen nibbles, three fast Mikas and fake nibbles
Beat a medium or hard maze without a Mika snatching even one nibble
Buy the whole explorer outfit from Mr. Chonkwiggle: little hat, compass and little backpack
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.doolhofguh: Rarity: Unique (The Guh Maze, Guh Fields)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.doolhofguh: Mr. Chonkwiggle has trimmed hedges his whole life, and his mustache curls just as nicely as his maze. The Mikas keep hiding stolen cheese nibbles in it, and then the guhs aren't WAHOOG enough anymore. For every game he grows a brand-new maze, and he makes the nibbles float and sparkle above the hedges so you can spot them from afar. Getting lost is allowed, chonk!
item.guhs.gestolen_knabbel.lore: Found again in the maze! Bring it to the exit (Mr. Chonkwiggle makes sure it gets back to the guhs).
structure.guhs.guhdoolhof.tooltip: A gigantic hedge maze with a lookout guh in the middle (Guh Fields)
gui.guhs.doolhof.rules: The Mikas stole cheese nibbles and hid them in my maze! Pick a level: I'll grow a brand-new maze. Find all the nibbles, then run to the exit in the north. Hedge Mikas snatch a nibble back if they tag you (ouch? nope, they just giggle). The real nibbles float sparkling above the hedges: you can see them from far away, but you'll have to find the way there yourself. The faster, the more wahoog!
gui.guhs.doolhof.niveau.makkelijk: A little maze with one slow Mika, and at the bottom you can see how many nibbles are still hidden. Nice and relaxed, chonk.
gui.guhs.doolhof.niveau.medium: A proper maze with two Mikas.
gui.guhs.doolhof.niveau.lastig: The whole hedge field, three fast Mikas and fake nibbles in the dead ends. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.doolhof.shop.tooltip: The explorer outfit and hedge goodies, for maze nibbles
gui.guhs.doolhof.busy: %s is in the maze right now (%s, %s/%s nibbles, %s). Watch from the lookout guh on the bridge!
gui.guhs.doolhof.kapot: Nyeg... my hedge field is gone. I can't grow a maze here.
gui.guhs.doolhof.first: Your first time? Start with easy, so you get to know the Mikas.
gui.guhs.doolhof.free: The maze is free. Which level are you brave enough for?
gui.guhs.doolhof.niet_meppen: Hee hee, no whacking! A Hedge Mika is far too quick.
gui.guhs.doolhof.no_build: This is Mr. Chonkwiggle's maze: only he does the trimming here, nyeg!
quest.guhs.doolhof.hello: Good afternoon! I'm Mr. Chonkwiggle, hedge trimmer. The Mikas have hidden cheese nibbles in my maze again, and now the guhs aren't WAHOOG enough... Will you help me find them?
quest.guhs.doolhof.hello_again: There you are again! Up for a new maze? I'll trim you one right away.
quest.guhs.doolhof.busy: Shhh, %s is in the maze! Watch from the lookout guh.
quest.guhs.doolhof.busy_you: You're in the maze! Find those nibbles, chonk!
quest.guhs.doolhof.broken: Nyeg... I can't find my hedge field.
quest.guhs.doolhof.shop: My little shop! With the explorer outfit you get lost in style.
quest.guhs.doolhof.go.makkelijk: A little maze! %s cheese nibbles and %s slow Mika. I'll let it grow... shh, listen!
quest.guhs.doolhof.go.medium: A big maze! %s cheese nibbles and %s Mikas. I'll let it grow...
quest.guhs.doolhof.go.lastig: The WHOLE hedge field! %s cheese nibbles, %s fast Mikas, and watch out for fake nibbles. Here we go...
quest.guhs.doolhof.opzij: Step aside, the hedges are growing! Mr. Chonkwiggle puts you on the square.
quest.guhs.doolhof.klaar_staan: The maze is ready! Find %s cheese nibbles (they float sparkling above the hedges) and run to the exit in the north.
quest.guhs.doolhof.bar_makkelijk: Time %s · %s/%s cheese nibbles · %s still hidden, nyeg!
quest.guhs.doolhof.alles: All the nibbles! Now to the exit, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.doolhof.nep: Fake! A plastic Mika decoy... +%s seconds, nyeg!
quest.guhs.doolhof.gepikt: Hee hee! A Hedge Mika snatched a nibble and hid it somewhere else! (%s/%s)
quest.guhs.doolhof.tong: The Hedge Mika sticks its tongue out: you didn't have any yet, hee hee!
quest.guhs.doolhof.nog_niet: Hold on! You're still missing %s cheese nibbles. Back into the maze, chonk!
quest.guhs.doolhof.niet_klimmen: No climbing on the hedges, nyeg! Back down you go.

advancements.guhs.grote_guhspelen.katapu: Find the Nibble Catapult on the Chonk Cliffs: a guh castle facing a wonky Mika Fort
Flatten all twelve Mika Forts of one round with Captain Floopguh
Get three stars on a fort: all Mikas gone, all chests open and a fluffball to spare
Play a whole round on hard: three fluffballs per fort, and it's windy!
Get all 36 stars in one round. The Mikas are completely flustered!
Collect the whole catapult outfit: the little catapult helmet, the catapult belt and the fluffball earrings
item.guhs.katapult_pluisballen.lore: Stand at the catapult, look where it needs to go, hold right-click to pull back the band and let go: FLOOP!
item.guhs.katapult_pluisballen.loan: Borrowed from Captain Floopguh: soft as a guh, and they go back after your round.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.katapultguh: Rarity: Unique (on the wall of the Nibble Catapult, Chonk Cliffs)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.katapultguh: Captain Floopguh guards the Nibble Catapult. Across the gorge the Mikas have built their forts, full of stolen cheese nibbles. He never fires anything hard at them: only fluffballs, as soft as a guh. "FLOOP! And there goes the fort. Nobody gets hurt, the Mikas run off giggling and the nibbles are free again. WAHOOG!" His eyepatch is actually a heart. Nyeg.
structure.guhs.knabbelkatapult.tooltip: Minigame: fluffballs at twelve Mika Forts with Captain Floopguh, catapult stars and a catapult outfit (Chonk Cliffs)
quest.guhs.katapult.hello1: Ahoy, little guh! See that wonky fort across the way? Full of stolen cheese nibbles! Time for a fluffball. FLOOP!
quest.guhs.katapult.hello2: Welcome to the Nibble Catapult! Twelve Mika forts, and you get the fluffballs. They don't hurt anyone, you know: they're just like guhs.
quest.guhs.katapult.hello3: Nyeg! The Mikas built ANOTHER fort. They giggle at me all day long. Let's floop them away!
quest.guhs.katapult.hello4: My eye patch? That's a little heart, just for looks. I can aim just fine! Up for a round?

quest.guhs.katapult.busy: Hang on, %s is flooping. Watch from the wall!

quest.guhs.katapult.how.lastig: Look where the fluffball needs to go and hold right-click: the longer, the harder (up to 100%%). Let go: FLOOP! Hard: 3 fluffballs per fort, and it's windy: watch the arrows!

quest.guhs.katapult.mika2: (from across the way) Nyeh nyeh, you'll never hit us!

quest.guhs.katapult.mika5: (from across the way) Bring it on, little guh! Hee hee hee hee!
quest.guhs.katapult.stopped: You stop flooping. The fluffballs go back in the basket. See you next time, sailor!
quest.guhs.katapult.walked_away: You walked away from the catapult. Captain Floopguh packs up his fluffballs.
quest.guhs.katapult.idle: Nyeg, did you fall asleep? The Captain is tidying up the fluffballs.
quest.guhs.katapult.fort_klaar: Fort %s (%s): %s  %s points | Mikas %s/%s | chests %s/%s | +%s for your fluffballs
quest.guhs.katapult.record: New record on this level: %s points! (was %s)

gui.guhs.katapult.look: Look at the Mika Fort on the other side!

advancements.guhs.grote_guhspelen.knabbe: Find The Nibble Games: the big circus tent with the guh ears (Guh Meadows, Pink Puffs)
Take part in an event of The Nibble Games
Play The Nibble Games with at least one friend at the same time
Pin the tail blindfolded in (almost) exactly the right spot: 950 points or more
Play all six events in a row in the Great Hexathlon
Win the Great Hexathlon against at least one friend
Score 5000 points or more in the Great Hexathlon
Buy the whole sports outfit from Coach Wahoogaroo: sweatband, whistle and sports shirt
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.spelleiderguh: Rarity: Unique (The Nibble Games, Guh Meadows and Pink Puffs)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.spelleiderguh: Coach Wahoogaroo referees The Great Hexathlon. She always has her clipboard with her and knows exactly who hops the fastest, throws the farthest and pins the prettiest. The Mikas have snatched the cheese nibbles, so: six games, a thousand points per game, and who will be the wahoogest guh?
item.guhs.guh_zak.lore: For the sack race: jump to hop!
item.guhs.knabbelei_lepel.lore: Walk slowly, or it'll fall! Coach Wahoogaroo wants her spoon back.
item.guhs.knabbelspijker.lore: It dangles from your guh belt. Plop it into the cheese milk bottle!
structure.guhs.knabbelspelen.tooltip: A big circus tent with six playing fields around it: the Great Hexathlon (Guh Meadows, Pink Puffs)
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.zeskamp.tooltip: All six events in a row! 0 to 1000 points per event, 6000 at most. Your record: %s
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.rules: Ladies and guhtlemen! Six games around my tent: pick one, or do the Great Hexathlon. Friends can join in (up to four at once, each in their own lane): whoever opens the game waits a moment for them. Every event gives 0 to 1000 hexathlon points.
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.nu.tooltip: No more waiting for friends: let's go!
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.tabel.uitleg:
This is how the hexathlon points work (0 - 1000 per event):
- Nibble Bobbing: 30 points = 1000 (a golden nibble counts 3).
- Sack Race: finish in 7 seconds or faster = 1000; twice as long = 500.
- Mika Can Toss: 120 points = 1000 (10 per can, 20 extra for knocking them all down).
- Egg-and-Spoon Race: finish in 11 seconds or faster = 1000; twice as long = 500.
- Nail Plopping: three bottles in 20 seconds or faster = 1000; twice as long = 500.
- Pin the Tail on the Guh: your pin score itself (1000 right on the spot, 0 from 2.5 blocks away).
Didn't make it = 0. The Great Hexathlon: everything added up, 6000 at most!
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.shop.tooltip: The sports outfit and game goodies, for Games Ribbons
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.kapot: Nyeg... my playing fields are gone. I can't hold any games here.

gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.free: The fields are free. What'll it be?
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.blinddoek: Blindfold on! Find the guh board and pin it (right-click)...
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.no_build: These are Coach Wahoogaroo's fields: no remodeling, be a good sport!
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.hello: Hello, sporty one! I'm Coach Wahoogaroo. The Mikas snatched the cheese nibbles, and now the guhs aren't WAHOOG enough... A round of the hexathlon will cheer them up again. Are you in?

quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.wacht: You're in for %s! Waiting for the others... or press Start Now!

quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.bezig: Shhh, a game is on (%s)! You're up soon.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.shop: My little shop! With the sports outfit you're ready for any hexathlon.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.broken: Nyeg... I can't find my playing fields.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.open: %s! Who's joining? I'll blow the whistle in %s seconds!

quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.end.good: %s points, well done! Your guh is nice and WAHOOG.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.end.ok: %s points! Taking part matters more than winning, chonk. Again?
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.end.super1: Super job at %s! That earns you extra ribbons.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.end.ok1: Nice workout at %s! Try the Great Hexathlon too.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.hap.mat: Stay on your mat! The nibbles come to you.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.hap.te_ver: Too far away... wait for it to swing back!
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.ei.gemist: You missed flag %s! Go back, or the finish won't count.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.ei.valt: Oopsie, your nibble egg fell! Back to the last flag, with a new egg.

quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.prik.naast: Pinned! %s blocks from its little bum: %s points.
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.uitleg.knabbelhap: Cheese nibbles swing toward you on strings. Stay on your mat and chomp (click) them when they're close: a normal one is 1 point, a golden one 3. 45 seconds of munching: your guh gets nice and WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.uitleg.zaklopen: You're standing in a guh sack: walking barely works! Jump (space) to hop, and look where you want to go. Over the fluffy bumps to the finish. The faster, the better.
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.uitleg.blikgooien: On the table stand six cans with little Mika faces (3-2-1). Throw your 8 fluffballs (right-click): every can that falls is 10 points, all down is 20 extra and a new stack!
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.uitleg.eierlopen: A nibble egg on a spoon, past the four little flags to the finish. Walk calmly! Running, sharp turns and jumping make the egg wobble. If it falls, back to the last flag.
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.uitleg.spijkerpoe: A nibble nail dangles on a string behind your guh belt and swings around when you move. Stand with your bottom over a cheese milk bottle, keep still and crouch (sneak) to lower it in. Plonk! Three bottles.
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.onderdeel.guhguht: Pin the Tail on the Guh
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.uitleg.guhguhtje_: Blindfold on, spin around three times... and then search! Walk to the guh board and pin the little tail (right-click) where it belongs: on its little bum, by the pink spot. The closer, the more points (max 1000).

Tame a Pinguh: a guh in a penguin suit!
Grind nibble grain into nibble flour in a guh windmill
Pick a guh ice flower in the Guh Polder
block.guhs.rijpsprietjes.lore: Crackly little sprouts full of frost. Snip them with shears!
item.guhs.rijpsprietjes.lore: Crackly little sprouts full of frost. Snip them with shears!

gui.guhs.guhpolder.molentje.maalt: The little windmill is still grinding %s Nibble Grain... (faster when it snows!)
gui.guhs.guhpolder.meel_dubbel: Baked with Nibble Flour: twice as much, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.pinguh: Rarity: Uncommon (only in the Guh Polder)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pinguh: A guh in a penguin suit! A third of the wild guhs in the ice-cold Guh Polder are Pinguhs. There are classic Pinguhs (black with a white tummy and a little orange beak), fancy Emperor Pinguhs (a bit bigger, with golden cheeks) and, very rarely, a gray fluffy Pinguh chick: all babies look like that! Waddles around all chonky and slides over the ice on his belly. Tame him with cheese nibbles and he'll happily glide along with you on the Eleven Guhtowns Tour. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.schaatsmeesterguh: Rarity: Unique (in Guhwarden, at the start of the Eleven Guhtowns Tour)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.schaatsmeesterguh: Skate Master Guhglide has an orange bobble hat, a whistle on a cord and two little skates around his neck. He lends you guh skates, gives you a Stamp Card and blows the starting whistle: eleven towns, eleven stamps, it giet oan! He sells warm winter sweaters for Town Stamps. He always says: 'The chonkier you are, the smoother you glide! You just have to be wahoog enough, and hot chocochonk helps with that.'
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.stempelguh: Rarity: Eleven of them (one in every town of the Eleven Guhtowns Tour, each with its own little hat)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.stempelguh: In every town along the Eleven Guhtowns Tour stands a Stamp Guh with a stamp in his paw. Arriving in the right order? FLOMP! Another stamp on your card. Every Stamp Guh wears the hat and scarf of his own town.
structure.guhs.elfguhjestocht.tooltip: A frozen canal winding through the Guh Polder, past eleven towns, ditches with pollard willows and snowy hills: skating, stamps and hot chocochonk!
item.guhs.guh_schaatsen.lore: Borrowed from Skate Master Guhglide. Hold them and glide over the ice!
item.guhs.guh_schaatsen.how: On ice you skate super wahoog; off it you just walk, nyeg.
item.guhs.stempelkaart.lore: %s of the 11 stamps. Right-click: the whole card.
item.guhs.warme_chocovet.lore: Thick hot cocoa with whipped cream. Warm inside = extra wahoog for a bit!
item.guhs.snert_kommetje.lore: Pea soup so thick the spoon stands up in it. Then you skate faster all by yourself!

gui.guhs.elftocht.warm: Warm inside! You glide extra wahoog for a bit!
quest.guhs.elftocht.hallo: Hi, skater! Up for the Eleven Guhtowns Tour? Eleven little towns, eleven stamps, and the ice is slippery as glass. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.elftocht.hallo_bezig: You're already skating, wahoog! Want to stop? You can do that here.
quest.guhs.elftocht.start: Skates on, card in your pocket... First to %s! On my whistle: 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.elftocht.vrij: Free skating! No clock, no stamps, just nice gliding. Will you bring the skates back?
quest.guhs.elftocht.al_bezig: You already have skates, nyeg! Finish or stop this ride first.
quest.guhs.elftocht.gestopt: Skates are back. Thank you! Come gliding again soon?
quest.guhs.elftocht.finish: FINISH! %s! Here are %s town stamps (+%s for your speed). You're so wahoog!

quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.geen_tocht_s: Hi! I give the last stamp, in %s: the finish! Start with Skate Master Guhglide, close by here.
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.vrij: Free skating has no stamps, nyeg! But a cuddle from %s is always allowed.
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.wacht: Wait for the starting shot, you chonky impatient little guh!
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.al: You already have the stamp from %s! On to %s, wahoog!
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.volgorde: Nyeg! That's not the right order. First to %s!

gui.guhs.elftocht.bijna_weg: Hey, not so far from the polder, nyeg! Skate back, or your skates go back to Guhglide.
gui.guhs.elftocht.te_lang: That long?! The Stamp Guhs are going to bed. The tour is over, try again!
gui.guhs.elftocht.kruisje: Your first Eleven Guhtowns Tour! You get the Eleven Guhtowns Cross and %s extra Town Stamps. Put it somewhere nice!
gui.guhs.elftocht.server_record: The fastest skating guh in the whole world! You're at the top of the board!
gui.guhs.elftocht.no_build: Hands off the ice! The Eleven Guhtowns Tour has to stay pretty for everyone.
gui.guhs.elftocht.regels: Skate around the frozen canal and get a stamp from every Stamp Guh, in the right order: from Snuh to Dokguh, and the last one in Guhwarden (the finish). Your time goes on the board. Along the way: Hot Chocochonk and pea soup for a boost, and a cheering crowd. Every tour: 12 Town Stamps, up to 8 extra if you're quick, and 5 more the first time. The faster, the more Town Stamps!
gui.guhs.elftocht.knop.start.tooltip: Borrow skates and a stamp card, off to the starting line, and on the whistle: WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.elftocht.knop.vrij.tooltip: Borrow skates and glide around without a clock (no Town Stamps).
gui.guhs.elftocht.knop.stop.tooltip: Give the skates back (your run doesn't count).
gui.guhs.elftocht.knop.winkel.tooltip: Winter sweaters, scarves, hats and warm drinks, for Town Stamps.

gui.guhs.elftocht.geen_record: No record yet. Will you be the first?
