structure.guhs.guh_circuit.tooltip: Minigame: three race tracks (Rainbow Road, Chonk Track, Cheese Mountain Track) with Coach Wahoog-Vroom - easy, medium or hard
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.circuitguh: Rarity: Unique (in the Pit Palace of the Guh Circuit)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.circuitguh: Coach Wahoog-Vroom knows every bend of her three tracks by heart. With her headphones on and her golden stopwatch around her neck, she shouts "WAHOOG! One more lap!" all day long. She lends you a racing guh on Rainbow Road, the Chonk Track or the Cheese Mountain Track. Watch out for the Mika Snatchers: they snatch your WAHOOG speed, hee hee hee!
quest.guhs.circuit.hello_new: WAHOOG! Welcome to the Guh Circuit, chonk! I'm Coach Wahoog-Vroom. Three tracks, three levels: Rainbow Road floats through the sky, the Chonk Track has a LOOP and the Cheese Mountain Track goes up the mountain. Take your pick, I'll lend you a racing guh!
quest.guhs.circuit.hello: There's my favorite racer again! Which track will it be today? Your racing guh has already had a cheese nibble. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.circuit.hello_busy: Shh, there's a race on! Take a seat in the stands and cheer real loud: WAHOOG! You're up soon.
quest.guhs.circuit.go_go: Why are you standing here chatting with me? RACE! Your racing guh is waiting! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.circuit.go.regenboog: Rainbow Road! Hold on tight: we're going up in the sky. Drive through the rainbow rings for a WAHOOG boost and jump over the gaps!
quest.guhs.circuit.go.vads: The Chonk Track! Slippery cheese sauce in the hairpin bends, bouncy mushrooms and... THE CHONK LOOP! Just keep running, your racing guh does the rest!
quest.guhs.circuit.go.kaasberg: The Cheese Mountain Track! Up the Nibble Slope: watch out, the Mikas are rolling cheese nibbles down! At the top it's slippery with ice.
quest.guhs.circuit.shop: The circuit outfit! A little helmet, a wahoog racing suit and a checkered flag cape. Only here, only for circuit cups. Then your guh is a real racer!
quest.guhs.circuit.result: Over the line in %s (laps: %s). %s! You get %s circuit cup(s).
quest.guhs.circuit.record: NEW PERSONAL RECORD: %s (was %s)! From now on your ghost rides this race. +2 circuit cups
quest.guhs.circuit.first: Your very first race on this track! A welcome bag: 4 extra circuit cups and a handful of cheese nibbles. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.circuit.track_record: TRACK RECORD! %s raced the %s (%s) in %s: first place on the scoreboard! That race now rides along as the golden ghost!
quest.guhs.circuit.gepikt: Hee hee hee! A Mika Snatcher snatched your WAHOOG speed!
quest.guhs.circuit.rolknabbel: BOOM! A rolling cheese nibble! Up on the mountain the Mikas are giggling...
quest.guhs.circuit.gouden_geest: You were faster than the golden ghost! The track record is yours!
quest.guhs.circuit.pikker.hallo: Hee hee hee! I only snatch speed, you know. Nibbles are for later, nyeg!
quest.guhs.circuit.duwer.hallo: Hee hee, this cheese nibble is about to roll down! Push!
gui.guhs.circuit.baan.regenboog: A floating rainbow road through the sky: two jumps over nothing at all, a winding chicane and rainbow rings that give you a WAHOOG boost. A rainbow trail behind your racing guh!
gui.guhs.circuit.baan.vads: Through Chonkland: slippery cheese sauce in the hairpin bends, bouncy mushrooms on the straight and the famous CHONK LOOP. Hold on tight!
gui.guhs.circuit.baan.kaasberg: Up Cheese Mountain! Mikas roll cheese nibbles down the Nibble Slope: dodge them! At the top the ice is slippery, then you zoom back down again.
gui.guhs.circuit.baan.vads.kort: Cheese sauce, bouncy mushrooms, the Chonk Loop
gui.guhs.circuit.baan.kaasberg.kort: Uphill, rolling cheese nibbles, ice at the top
gui.guhs.circuit.niveau.makkelijk: A calm racing guh, few Mika Snatchers, and if you fall off the track I'll put you back just a little bit
gui.guhs.circuit.niveau.medium: A normal racing guh and a few Mika Snatchers
gui.guhs.circuit.niveau.lastig: A super fast but stubborn racing guh, lots of Mika Snatchers and Rolling Nibbles, and the silver WAHOOG pads don't work. +50 % Circuit Cups!
gui.guhs.circuit.start.tooltip: You get a rental racing guh; after the race it goes back to the pit stop
gui.guhs.circuit.shop.tooltip: The circuit outfit for your guh, for Circuit Cups
gui.guhs.circuit.busy: %s is racing on %s right now (lap %s). Wait a bit, or cheer along from the stands!
gui.guhs.circuit.munten: Gold %s Circuit Cups ... finished %s (+2 for a record)
gui.guhs.circuit.no_build: Nyeg! No building or digging on the Guh Circuit: the racing guhs will trip.
advancements.guhs.grote_guhspelen.circui: Drive your first race on the Guh Circuit
Finish all three tracks of the Guh Circuit
Drive a race on hard at the Guh Circuit
Get gold on hard on a track of the Guh Circuit
Beat the golden ghost or race a gold-medal time on a track of the Guh Circuit
Collect the whole circuit outfit: little helmet, racing suit and flag cape
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.brandweerguh: Rarity: Unique (the fire station on Career Street in Snuggledale town)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.brandweerguh: Fire Chief Splashguh has the red helmet with the golden star and the finest soot mustache in the whole dale. He puts out every marshmallow campfire that flares up too chonky, and gets little guhs down from trees (they love climbing up, but getting down... nyeg). Help him out once and you get your own fire helmet and jacket. Nee-naw nee-naw, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.politieguh: Rarity: Unique (the little police station on Career Street in Snuggledale town)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.politieguh: Inspector Wahoogsby solves every case with his big magnifying glass and a bag of cheese nibbles (for thinking). His biggest case: The Case of the Nibble Thief! A Mika snatched the town's nibble supply and left chonky paw prints behind. With him, Mikas are never punished, only hugged really tight in the cuddle cell.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.apothekerguh: Rarity: Unique (the little pharmacy on Career Street in Snuggledale town)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.apothekerguh: Doctor Sniffleguh has a white coat, a stethoscope, a little mirror on his head and a red nose that's always a bit runny (that's where his name comes from, achoo). With sniffle herbs from his herb garden and cheese milk he makes the yummiest cheese milk potion in the Guhmension: it makes every sniffly little guh WAHOOG again.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.bouwvakkerguh: Rarity: Unique (by the half-built house in some guh villages)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.bouwvakkerguh: Bob the Guhbuilder is building the prettiest house in the village, with a pencil behind his ear and a hammer on his belt. Only the roof isn't finished yet: he needs planks, and lunch (a builder without cheese nibbles never gets wahoog). Can we fix it? YES, WE CAN!
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.start: NEE-NAW NEE-NAW! Help, help! On the training ground next to the station, %s marshmallow campfires have flared up way too chonky! Here, take my guh fire hose: hold right-click and spray them all out. Quick, before the marshmallows burn!
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.nog: %s fires left! Keep spraying (hold right-click), and they'll get smaller on their own. Pssst!
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.allemaal_u: All out! Well done, colleague! But... DO YOU HEAR THAT? Squeak squeak! There's a little guh high up in the big tree on the training ground, and it's too scared to come down! Climb up the ladder and help it down.
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.boom: The little guh is still in the tree! Climb the ladder and right-click the little guh, then it'll jump right into your arms.
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.gered: Hup, into your arms and safe on the ground again! What a hero you are. Here, your very own fire helmet and fire coat: you're now a real firefighter guh! I'll take my hose back, it needs to dry in the hose tower.
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.bezet: Just a moment, there's already a firefighter guh putting out fires! Come back in a bit. Nee-naw!
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.niks: Huh? I don't see any training ground here... Nyeg. Come find me at the fire station in Snuggledale.
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.bedankt0: There's my best firefighter guh! Does the helmet suit you? Of course, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.bedankt1: Not a single marshmallow fire too chonky today. Thanks to you, all the little guhs know how it's done!
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.bedankt2: The little guh from the tree keeps asking about you. Now it only climbs very low bushes, hee hee.
gui.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.verlopen: Splashguh blew out the little fires himself. Talk to him again to help out once more.
gui.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.guhtje_wacht: The little guh is waiting for the fire brigade... Talk to Fire Chief Splashguh first!
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.start: Alarm, alarm! The town's nibble vault is EMPTY! Someone snatched the whole nibble supply... And look: pink, chonky paw prints. That's a Mika, I'm sure of it. Follow the trail from the vault and find the nibbles! (Don't be scared: a Mika only giggles.)
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.volg: Follow the pink paw prints from the nibble vault! They sparkle a little, so they're easier to see.
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.opgelost: You got the nibbles back! Case closed! The Nibble Thief ran off giggling, but oh well, he was just hungry. Here, your very own police cap and uniform: you're now a real police guh. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.bezet: A detective is already on this case! Two sniffer noses on one trail just makes a mess. Come back in a bit.
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.niks: Hmm, no vault and no trail to be seen here... Come find me at the little police station in Snuggledale.
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.bedankt0: Ha, my best detective! Not a single nibble snatched since you came along.
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.bedankt1: The Nibble Thief came to say sorry this morning. He got a cuddle in the cuddle cell and a cheese nibble. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.bedankt2: That cap really suits you! You look like a real inspector. Wahoogsby is proud of you.
gui.guhs.beroepen.politie.verlopen: The Nibble Thief's trail has gone cold... Talk to Inspector Wahoogsby again for a new lead.
gui.guhs.beroepen.politie.gevonden: Found it: the town's nibble stash! Go tell Inspector Wahoogsby the good news.
gui.guhs.beroepen.politie.niet_van_jou: A sack full of cheese nibbles... That belongs to the town! Inspector Wahoogsby is looking for it.
gui.guhs.beroepen.knabbeldief.betrapt: Hee hee hee! Caught! The Nibble Thief runs off giggling... nyeg!
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.start: Achoo... oh no, that wasn't me, that was Sniffles! He's in the sick corner and he's sooo sniffly. I know a recipe: pick %s sniffle herbs in my herb garden behind the pharmacy, and mix them with cheese milk in the mixing cauldron by the window. Then give the remedy to Sniffles!
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.kaasmelk: Here, a bottle of cheese milk from my little fridge. Don't drink it yourself, okay!
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.kruidjes: You have %s of %s sniffle herbs. The rest grow in the herb garden and in the little greenhouse behind the pharmacy: right-click a big plant.
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.ketel: Enough sniffle herbs and cheese milk! Now right-click the mixing cauldron by the window. Blub blub...
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.geef: That smells so good! Give the remedy to Sniffles: right-click him with the remedy in your hand.
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.klaar: Sniffles is all better, can you hear him? No more achoo, just WAHOOG! Here, your very own doctor's coat and stethoscope. You're now a real pharmacist guh!
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.bedankt0: Sniffles asks if you'll come play again. He hasn't sneezed in three days!
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.bedankt1: Achoo... Oopsie, now I'm a bit sniffly myself. No worries, I know just the remedy!
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.bedankt2: Listen with your stethoscope: that's the sound of a very wahoog little guh heart.
gui.guhs.beroepen.snotje.snif: Sniffles: *sniff sniff*... ACHOO! (He needs a cheese milk potion.)
gui.guhs.beroepen.snotje.blij: Sniffles waves at you. No more runny nose!
gui.guhs.beroepen.snotje.al_beter: Sniffles is already better! Save the potion for another runny nose.
gui.guhs.beroepen.snotje.beter: Glug glug... ACHOO... WAHOOG! Sniffles is better again! Go tell Doctor Sniffleguh.
gui.guhs.beroepen.snotje.vahoeg: Glug glug... WAHOOG! Sniffles feels totally fine again.
gui.guhs.beroepen.mengketel.nodig: For a cheese milk potion: sniffle herbs %s/%s and cheese milk %s/1.
gui.guhs.beroepen.mengketel.klaar: Blub blub... A cheese milk potion! It smells like cheese and springtime.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.start: Can we fix it? YES, WE CAN! ... Well, almost. My little house is nearly done, just the roof left. Bring me %s planks (any wood) for the roof beams and %s cheese nibbles for my lunch. Without lunch a builder never gets wahoog!
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.nodig: I still need: planks %s/%s and cheese nibbles %s/%s. Come back when you have everything!
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.materiaal: Lovely planks! And cheese nibbles, nom! Here are the roof tiles: %s of them. Climb the ladder onto the roof, walk up the little steps and right-click each see-through roof spot with a roof tile.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.nog: %s roof tiles to go! Right-click a see-through spot on top of the roof with a roof tile.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.af: TOPPING OUT! The roof is done! Can we fix it? YES, WE FIXED IT! Here, your very own hard hat and safety vest. You're now a real builder guh. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.gepikt: Oopsie... last night some Mikas climbed onto my roof and borrowed all the roof tiles, giggling. Nyeg! Back to square one.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.niks: Huh, where did my little house go? I only build in guh villages, you know.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.bedankt0: Look how pretty my little house is! Thanks to the best builder guh in the Guhmension.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.bedankt1: I'm already thinking about my next little house. With a slide off the roof, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.bedankt2: That hard hat really suits you! Now just a pencil behind your ear and you'll be just like me.
gui.guhs.beroepen.bouw.past_niet: That roof tile only fits on a see-through roof spot on Bob's roof.
item.guhs.guh_brandslang.lore: Hold right-click to spray. Too-chonky little fires go out by themselves
item.guhs.kaasmelkdrankje.lore: Sniffle herbs and cheese milk, mixed in the mixing cauldron. Good for every runny nose
item.guhs.kaasmelkdrankje.gedronken: Your nose is all clear again. WAHOOG!
item.guhs.snotkruidje.lore: For the mixing cauldron. Don't sniff it, or... achoo!
item.guhs.beroepen_dakpan.lore: Only fits on a roof spot of Bob the Guhbuilder's roof
block.guhs.beroepen_dakplek: Roof Spot (a roof tile still goes here)
block.guhs.beroepen_marshmallowvuur.lore: Snug with marshmallows. Is it blazing up too chonky? Call the fire brigade!
item.guhs.beroepen_marshmallowvuur.lore: Snug with marshmallows. Is it blazing up too chonky? Call the fire brigade!
block.guhs.beroepen_mengketel.lore: 3 sniffle herbs and a cheese milk in: blub blub, a cheese milk potion
item.guhs.beroepen_mengketel.lore: 3 sniffle herbs and a cheese milk in: blub blub, a cheese milk potion
block.guhs.beroepen_knabbelbuit.lore: With a pink Mika pawprint on it. Whose could that be?
item.guhs.beroepen_knabbelbuit.lore: With a pink Mika pawprint on it. Whose could that be?
advancements.guhs.grote_guhspelen.beroep: Put out the marshmallow fires and get the little guh down from the tree for Fire Chief Splashguh
The Case of the Nibble Thief
Follow the paw prints and recover the town's nibble stash for Inspector Wahoogsby
Make Sniffles better again with a cheese milk potion from Doctor Sniffleguh
Put the roof on Bob the Guhbuilder's little house: topping out!
Learn all four careers: firefighter, police, pharmacy and builder
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.root.des: Tame a guh: your heart meter starts filling up. Hearts never go down!
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.band_lie: Become sweet chonkies together with a guh (100 hearts)
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.band_meg: Become mega sweet chonkies together with a guh (600 hearts)
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.band_zie: Become soulguh bff 5evr <3 with a guh (2000 hearts). WAHOOG!
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.band_dag: Open your guh's diary (hold right-click on your guh, Diary button)
gui.guhs.band.knuffel_rust: %s is still all warm from the last cuddle. Again in a bit, nyeg!
gui.guhs.band.knuffel_nu_niet: %s can't cuddle right now (they're very busy).
gui.guhs.menu.knuffelen.tooltip: Give your guh a big chonky cuddle. That gives hearts! (Afterwards he needs a moment to recover.)
gui.guhs.menu.dagboekje.tooltip: Open your guh's diary in the Guhdex: hearts, faves, buddies, where he is and everything he's been through.
gui.guhs.anderevadsjes.leeg: You don't have any other tame critters yet, nyeg! Tame a squeaksqueak mouse, a Shelly or another little animal and you'll see here where it is.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.leeg: You don't have any tame guhs yet, nyeg! Tame one with cheese nibbles and his diary will show up here.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.tip: Call %s over to you, wherever it is: in another dimension, in its Guh House or the Guh Room, as a picked-up guh in a chest, in a Guh Wheel, on holiday... You first see what will happen.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.opgepakt: %s is picked up in a chest, backpack or pockets - go get him yourself!
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.guhwiel: %s is running laps in a Guh Wheel - go get him yourself!
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.dood: %s is up in the clouds... Calling won't help, but the Snuggleheart will.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.kwijt: Nyeg, %s can't be found anywhere. Go look where he was last seen!
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.favorietjes_hint: No faves discovered yet. Try all sorts of things: snacks, spots, plushies, songs, toys, tricks, clothes and other guhs. Does he look curious? Then you're getting warm!
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.geen_vriendjes: No guh buddies yet. Let him play with your other guhs!
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.geen_huisje: Doesn't live in a Guh House (yet).
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.nog_niks: Nothing yet... but it's sure to come, nyeg!
gui.guhs.band.niveau.geen: on the way to sweet chonkies...
gui.guhs.band.plek.slaapt_in_huisje: Snoring away in Guh House %1$s (%2$s, %3$s %4$s %5$s). Zzz...
gui.guhs.band.plek.rijdt_op: %1$s is riding on top (%2$s, %3$s %4$s %5$s). Go go!
gui.guhs.band.plek.item_grond: Lying on the ground like a little parcel (%2$s, %3$s %4$s %5$s). Nyeg, pick them up!
gui.guhs.band.plek.guhwiel: Running laps in a Guh Wheel (%2$s, %3$s %4$s %5$s). WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.band.plek.guhkamer: Having a sleepover in the Guh Room in your Guhbelly
gui.guhs.band.plek.onbekend: No idea, nyeg... Come by sometime, then your Guhdex will remember!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.getemd.tekst: Today I got an owner. They gave me a cheese nibble and that was it, I was sold. Nyeg, that's how easy I am.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_aai.tekst: A hand went over my fur. I'm still a little shy about it. One more time?
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_knuffel.t: My owner cuddled me so hard my chonk wobbled. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_rit.tekst: Someone sat on my back. Apparently I'm a horse now. A very chonky horse.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_guhmensio: Everything is pink here! The grass, the clouds, me. I feel right at home.
It's dark here and a little scary, nyeg. Good thing my owner is here too.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_huisje.te: I have a little house that looks like my own head. My ears are the roof. Makes total sense.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_lief.teks: We are now officially sweet chonkies together. I wrote it in my diary, so it's real.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_mega.teks: Mega sweet chonkies together! My little heart is so big it barely fits in my chonk anymore.
Soulguh bff 5evr <3. Forever. This is never going away. Never. Nyeg nyeg nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_klusje.te: I worked! Really worked! Now I do need a little rest, a tiny nap or three.
Toys! I didn't know those existed. My life is now complete.
I'm having a sleepover in my owner's belly. Sounds weird, but it's super snug in here.
We played a game together. I cheered so hard my little ears flapped.
I made a buddy. We're chonkies together now. Not as chonky as with my owner, though.
My owner knows a little secret about me now. Shh, don't tell anyone, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.getemd: Today I picked %s as my human. Good choice, if I do say so myself, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.geboren: Today I was born! I'm still very small, but my chonk grows every day.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.eerste_knuffel: Did you know a cuddle is worth exactly three cheese nibbles? I just did the math.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.eerste_guhmensio: Did you know the air in the Guhmension smells like cotton candy? I checked.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.eerste_guheinde: Today I was in the Guh End. I wasn't scared. Just a teeny bit. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.eerste_huisje: My house is called %s. I think it's the prettiest name in the whole world.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.niveau_lief: Today I got sooo WAHOOG: %s and I are sweet chonkies together, nyeg!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.niveau_mega: %s and I are now MEGA sweet chonkies together. I've never been this wahoog before.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.niveau_zielsguh: %s is my soulguh bff 5evr <3. I pressed a little heart into my fur, forever.
gui.guhs.klus.opgraven.tip: Digs up cheese nibbles in grass, dirt or sand in the chore area. Sometimes finds something rare, nyeg! Put a chest next to the house for the loot. (Guhs and mousies)
gui.guhs.klus.farmen.tip: Harvests ripe crops and replants them right away: wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, cheese nibble plants, peppers and guh gardens. Also pumpkins, melons, sugar cane, cocoa, nether wart and peanut and mustard sprouts. Waters thirsty gardens. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.klus.opruimen.tip: Picks up stuff lying around and brings it to the chest. Is there a Bank Guh in the chore area? Then everything gets sorted, including what's in the chest. Needs: a chest or Bank Guh. (Guhs and mousies)
gui.guhs.klus.dieren.tip: Pets and feeds guh lambs, nibble chicks and guh cows, picks up wool and eggs and collects eggs from the chicken nests. Harvests full nibble hives and beehives (honeycomb, or honey when there are empty bottles in the chest). Put nibble feed and empty bottles (for cheese milk) in the chest! (Guhs)
gui.guhs.klus.bakken.tip: Brings nibble grain from the chest to a guh windmill and the flour back, and bakes treats in a nibble oven when the chest has everything for a recipe. Nibble flour = twice as much! (Guhs)
gui.guhs.klus.vissen.tip: Catches guhfish and seashells when there's a little pond (3+ water blocks) in the chore area. Very rarely a Golden Guhfish! (Guhs, Shelly and Poopshelly)
gui.guhs.klus.waken.tip: Squeaks and runs to you when a Mika or monster comes near the house, and pushes Mikas away ever so gently. Never fighting, always sweet! (Guhs; mousies only squeak)
gui.guhs.klus.plukken.tip: Picks nibbleberries and sweet berries, and a little flower at any flower (which stays put): every kind of flower, most often a pink guh flower. (Guhs and mousies)
gui.guhs.klus.lampjes.tip: Turns on the guh lamps and candles in the chore area in the evening, and off again in the morning, with a big yawn. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.klus.oppas.tip: Cuddles and feeds squeaksqueak mice, Shelly and Poopshelly nearby. A hurt guh gets a snack from the chest (cupcake, cookie, cheese nibbles...). (Guhs)
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.huisje_g: Build a Guh House: a little house shaped like a guh head
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.huisje_v: Fill a Guh House all the way up with guhs and buddies
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.huisje_g: Build the biggest Guh House: room for eight chonky residents
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.huisje_b: Click Go inside in the screen of a Guh House: every little resident has its own bed there, and there is a guest bed for you
block.guhs.guhhuisje.lore: Room for %s residents: guhs, mousies, Shelly and Poopshelly
block.guhs.guhhuisje_klein.lore: A cozy guh head: the ears are the roof, the eyes the windows, the snoot the door.
item.guhs.guhhuisje_klein.lore: A cozy guh head: the ears are the roof, the eyes the windows, the snoot the door.
block.guhs.guhhuisje_medium.lore: With flower boxes under the eyes. Extra snug!
item.guhs.guhhuisje_medium.lore: With flower boxes under the eyes. Extra snug!
block.guhs.guhhuisje_groot.lore: With a little chimney and a bow on the ear. Villa Wahoog!
item.guhs.guhhuisje_groot.lore: With a little chimney and a bow on the ear. Villa Wahoog!
gui.guhs.huisje.gebouwd: Your Guh House is called %s! Right-click it to choose residents and chores.
gui.guhs.huisje.trekt_in: %s now lives in Guh House %s. Welcome home, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.vol: Guh House %s is full! Build another one, or a bigger one.
gui.guhs.huisje.niet_jouw_guh: Only your own tame guhs and buddies can live there, nyeg.
gui.guhs.huisje.niet_van_jou: Guh House %s belongs to someone else. No peeking inside!
gui.guhs.huisje.naam_bezet: That name is empty, too long or already taken by another house. Think of something else, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.opslag.bank: Chore loot goes to the Bank Guh (sorted!)
gui.guhs.huisje.opslag.kist: Chore loot goes in the chest next to the house
gui.guhs.huisje.opslag.deur: Put a chest next to the house! Right now the loot ends up on the doorstep.
gui.guhs.huisje.leeg: Nobody lives here yet. Click New Resident, or right-click the house with a picked-up guh or a buddy.
gui.guhs.huisje.nieuwe_bewoner.tooltip: Your own tame guhs and buddies that are close by (16 blocks) can come live here.
gui.guhs.huisje.koepel.tooltip: Show the chore area: a blue dome over the area where the residents wander, do chores and play.
gui.guhs.huisje.geen_klusjes: No chores known yet, nyeg! Your residents live here snugly, sleep here and play nearby.
gui.guhs.huisje.kies_bewoner: Pick a resident on the left to turn their chores on or off. These are all the chores (and what they need):
gui.guhs.huisje.baby: Babies don't do chores yet: they're still too little, they just get to play.
gui.guhs.huisje.alles_aan.tooltip: Everybody to work! Turns every chore of every resident on at once.
gui.guhs.huisje.alles_uit.tooltip: A day off for everyone! Turns every chore of every resident off at once.
gui.guhs.huisje.geen_kandidaten: There are no tame guhs or buddies of yours nearby that don't live here yet.
gui.guhs.huisje.verhuis: Lives in %s now. Click: move house!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.knop.tooltip: What's possible here? See which chores your residents can do around this house and what they can play with.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.uitleg.klusjes: Can the chore be done in the chore area right now? Point at a chore to see what it needs.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.uitleg.dingen: No chore to do for a moment? Then your residents sometimes go and play. This is what's in the chore area:
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ververs.toolti: Take a fresh look around the chore area. Also happens by itself every few seconds.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.bewoners.ja: Residents of this house who can do it: %s (turned on for %s).
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.bewoners.nee: Nobody who can do this lives in this house yet.
grass, dirt, sand or moss in the chore area with two blocks of air above it. Not right up against the house.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.farmen.gr: Nothing ripe right now. Still growing: %s
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.farmen.ge: No crops, guh gardens, pumpkins, sugar cane or sprouts
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.farmen.no: a little field of crops (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, cheese nibble plants, peppers...) or a planted guh garden in the chore area. Ripe ones get harvested and replanted, a thirsty garden gets water. Also: pumpkins and melons on their stem (the stem stays), sugar cane (the bottom piece stays), ripe cocoa they can reach, nether wart, and from every peanut or mustard sprout plant one sprout per 5 minutes (the plant stays put).
No chest, Bank Guh or Nom Hatch to put the stuff in
Nothing on the ground, but the chest can be sorted into the Bank Guh
All tidy: nothing lying around right now
a chest next to the house, a Bank Guh in the chore area or a working Nom Hatch in the chore area. Then they pick up whatever lies on the ground in the chore area.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.dieren.te: Nothing to do right now: the animals are happy and there's nothing to collect
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.dieren.ge: No farm animals, chicken nests or nibble hives
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.dieren.no: guh lambs, nibble chicks or guh cows in the chore area, a chicken nest with eggs or a full nibble hive. Put nibble feed and empty bottles in the chest!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bakken.ba: Ready to bake: the chest has everything for a recipe
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bakken.me: Nibble flour to pick up at the windmill: %s
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bakken.ma: There's nibble grain in the chest for the windmill
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bakken.ge: The guh windmill has nothing to do right now: no flour to pick up and no nibble grain to bring
There's a nibble oven, but the chest doesn't have everything for a recipe
Nothing to bake or grind: the chest doesn't have everything for a recipe and there's no grain or flour to carry
No nibble oven or guh windmill
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bakken.no: a nibble oven or a guh windmill in the chore area. And in the chest: nibble grain for the windmill, or everything for a recipe from the recipe book for the oven.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.vissen.te: Not enough water: %s of the 3 blocks
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.vissen.ge: There's water (%s blocks), but no spot at the edge to sit on
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.vissen.no: a little pond of at least 3 water source blocks in the chore area, with air above them (flowing water doesn't count). And next to it a free spot on solid ground to sit on.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.waken.rus: Always on guard. All quiet right now.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.waken.gev: There's a Mika or monster near the house right now!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.waken.nod: nothing! When a Mika or monster comes near the house, they squeak and run to you. Guhs gently push Mikas away, mousies only squeak.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.plukken.b: Flowers to pick a little flower at: %s
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.plukken.l: Nothing to pick right now: the berries are still growing or the flowers are resting
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.plukken.n: nibbleberry bushes, sweet berry bushes or flowers in the chore area: every small flower, plus the sunflower, lilac, rose bush and peony (no wither rose). The bush and the flower stay put. A flower rests for 5 minutes afterwards.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.lampjes.t: Lights: %s. They go on in the evening and off in the morning, not right now.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.lampjes.n: guh lamps or candles in the chore area (the tag guhs:klusjes/lampjes). On in the evening, off again in the morning.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.oppas.ver: All the buddies were just cuddled and no guh is hurt
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.oppas.gee: No buddies nearby and no hurt guh
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.oppas.nod: buddies of yours in the chore area (squeaksqueak mice, Shelly, Poopshelly...) or a hurt guh of yours. Each buddy gets a cuddle every 2 minutes. Put snacks and cheese nibbles in the chest!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.polijsten: Cobblestones in the chest to polish: %s
cobblestones in the chest next to the house or in the Bank Guh. Mossy cobblestone and cobbled deepslate work too.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.knabbelba: Guhs chase it and nudge it with their snoot until the cheese nibble pops out. Munch!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.guh_glijb: Guhs climb up the frame and slide down. Wheee!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.pluizige_: Guhs and squeaksqueak mice run through it: in one hole, out the other. Pieces that are joined together count as one tunnel.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.guh_wip: A guh sits on it and seesaws, best of all together with a friend.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.guh_schom: A guh sits on it and swings happily back and forth.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.jukebox: Is a record playing? Then the guhs within 8 blocks happily dance along.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.kampvuur: Late in the evening, guhs within 7 blocks of the fire put on their pajamas and nightcap, right before they go inside.
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.knop.tooltip: Walk through the snoot door into the house. You are a little big for it, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.weiger.afstappen: Get off first, nyeg! You won't fit through the little door like that.
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.weiger.spel: You are still in the middle of a game. Finish that first, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.weiger.storing: The little door is stuck for a moment. Try again in a bit, nyeg.
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.welkom: Welcome to %s. Wipe your feet, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.welkom_gast: Welcome to %s, the house of %s. Wipe your feet, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.buiten: You are outside again. Bye, little house, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.huisje_weg: The house is not there any more! You are outside again, nyeg.
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.op_de_mat: Hup, back on the doormat, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.niet_hier: You only get in here through the snoot door of a Guh House, nyeg.
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.van_wie: This is the house of %s, nyeg. Looking is fine, touching is not!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.instoppen: You tuck %s in. Sleep tight, nyeg! ♥
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.aaien: You pet %s very softly. It just snores on, nyeg.
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.leeg_bed: This little bed is still free. Who will come and live here, nyeg?
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.maatje: %s is tucked up under the blanket. Shh, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.briefje.vakantie: On holiday: %s. Postcard to follow, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.briefje.kantoor: At the Guh Office. Working hard at being chonky, nyeg.
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.briefje.guhkamer: Having a sleepover in the Guh Room, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.briefje.zit: Sitting somewhere, waiting like a good guh, nyeg.
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.briefje.weg: Out for a moment. Back soon, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.prikbord.kop: Notice board of %s: who does which chore?
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.prikbord.leeg: Nobody lives here yet. The notice board is still empty, nyeg.
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.slaap.dag: The guhs only sleep when it is dark. So do you, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.slaap.welterusten: Sleep tight among the guhs, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.slaap.ochtend: Good morning! Did you sleep well among the guhs, nyeg?
gui.guhs.huisje.binnen.slaap.bezet: Somebody is in the guest bed already, nyeg.
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.klusjes_: Digger Guh
Let a resident of your Guh House dig up cheese nibbles
Old McGuh Had a Farm
Let a resident harvest ripe crops and plant them again
Neat and Tidy
Let a resident tidy up stuff lying around
Sweet Pet Sitter
Let a resident pet and feed the farm animals, or harvest a nibble hive
Guh the Baker
Let a resident grind in a guh windmill or bake in a nibble oven
Gone Fishing
Let a resident catch guhfish and seashells in the pond by the house
Watchguh
A resident squeaks to warn you about a Mika or a monster (and gently pushes Mikas away)
Berry Picker
Let a resident pick berries or little flowers
Lights On
A resident turns the lights on in the evening (and off again in the morning, with a big yawn)
Babysitter Guh
A resident looks after a mousie, a little turtle or a hurt guh
A Place for Everything
Let the stuff from chores get sorted into a Bank Guh
Look What I Found!
A resident finds something rare while digging or fishing
Chore Champion
Let your residents do all ten chores
A Hundred Helping Paws
Your residents did a hundred chores together. WAHOOG!
block.guhs.klusjes_guhlampje.lore: A lamp with ears and a sweet little face. Right-click: on or off. Residents of a Guh House turn it on in the evening and off in the morning!
item.guhs.klusjes_guhlampje.lore: A lamp with ears and a sweet little face. Right-click: on or off. Residents of a Guh House turn it on in the evening and off in the morning!
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.lore: Fished up by a house guh. Hold it to your ear (right-click) and listen to the Guh Sea.
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.0: Shhhh... you hear the Guh Sea. And very softly: nyeg.
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.1: Shhhh... somewhere far away a little wave of cheese sauce sloshes.
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.2: Shhhh... a little fish whispers: "that guh is a pretty good fisher, you know".
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.3: Shhhh... you hear a guh snoring. Oh wait, that's your own guh.
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.4: Shhhh... WAHOOG! (the sea is happy you're listening)
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.5: Shhhh... the seashell smells like salt and a tiny bit like cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.klusjes.waken.hier: Squeak squeak! %1$s comes to warn you: watch out, %2$s at %3$s!
gui.guhs.klusjes.waken.ver: Squeak squeak! %1$s sends a warning from %3$s: there's %2$s sneaking around the house, nyeg!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_opgraven: I dug a hole and there was a cheese nibble in it! The ground is really just one big nibble tin, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_farmen.t: I picked wheat and planted it again right away. That's called farming. I'm a farmer now. With a chonk.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_opruimen: I tidied up everything that was on the ground. A pebble too. The pebble is in the chest now. You're welcome.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_dieren.t: I petted a guh lamb. The lamb petted me back. I think. Anyway, it was very soft.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_bakken.t: I baked! Something yummy came out of the oven and I did NOT eat it. Well, almost.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_vissen.t: I caught a fish with my pawsies. The fish was just as surprised as I was, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_waken.te: A Mika came to our house. I squeaked really loudly. I'm very brave. A little. From a distance.
I picked berries. A few of them ended up in the chest. The rest are in my chonk. Oopsie.
I turned on the lights, so nobody has to sit in the dark. In the morning I turn them off again. With a yawn.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_oppas.te: I looked after a mousie. The mousie looked after me. Now we're both very well looked after.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.opgraven: Did you know there are cheese nibbles in the ground at %s? I found out myself. With my very own pawsies!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.farmen: Today I harvested at %s. I planted a seed back too, or the ground gets sad.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.opruimen: Did you know %s is now the tidiest house in the whole world? That's thanks to me. And a little bit to the chest.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.dieren: Did you know a guh cow says moo when you pet her? Then I say nyeg back. That's how we chat at %s.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.bakken: It smells like freshly baked cookies at %s. I don't know who did that. (Me.)
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.vissen: Did you know fish don't like cheese nibbles? I do. That's why I fish at %s, and eat the nibbles myself.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.waken: I'm guarding %s. If a Mika comes, I squeak as loud as I can. Then I push him away very gently. Sweet, but strict.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.plukken: Did you know a flower doesn't get mad if you pick one? I asked at %s. It didn't say anything, so it's fine.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.lampjes: At %s the lights go on when it gets dark. That's me. I'm kind of like the sun, only smaller.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.oppas: Today I looked after someone at %s. It felt warm in my chonk. That's what being sweet feels like, I think.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.zeldzaam: Today I found %s at %s. WAHOOG! I sniffed it three times before I put it in the chest.
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.speelgoe: Let a guh play with a toy: a nibble ball, a little slide, a tunnel, a seesaw or a swing
Your guhs have played with all four kinds of toys
Kick a nibble ball (left-click). Who'll fetch it? Nyeg!
Give a guh on the swing or the seesaw a little push
Knock on a fluffy tunnel with a guh hiding inside
Go down the guh slide yourself, or swing or seesaw along (sneak + right-click)
block.guhs.guh_glijbaantje.lore: A climbing frame with guh ears, a platform on a guh snoot and a shiny slide. Wheee!
item.guhs.guh_glijbaantje.lore: A climbing frame with guh ears, a platform on a guh snoot and a shiny slide. Wheee!
block.guhs.guh_glijbaantje.uitleg: Guhs climb up and slide down. Right-click to slide yourself.
block.guhs.guh_wip.lore: A seesaw on a little guh head, with cushions and guh-ear handles.
item.guhs.guh_wip.lore: A seesaw on a little guh head, with cushions and guh-ear handles.
block.guhs.guh_wip.uitleg: Two guhs seesaw up and down together. Right-click: a little push. Sneak + right-click: seesaw yourself.
block.guhs.guh_schommel.lore: A pink swing with a guh head on the beam and a soft cushion.
item.guhs.guh_schommel.lore: A pink swing with a guh head on the beam and a soft cushion.
block.guhs.guh_schommel.uitleg: A guh swings on it by themselves. Right-click: push, higher! Sneak + right-click: swing yourself.
block.guhs.pluizige_tunnel.lore: Soft pink fur tunnel. Join the pieces together for a twisty tunnel!
item.guhs.pluizige_tunnel.lore: Soft pink fur tunnel. Join the pieces together for a twisty tunnel!
block.guhs.pluizige_tunnel.uitleg: Guhs run through it and hide inside. Knock on it (right-click) to find them.
item.guhs.knabbelbal.leeg: Empty: put a cheese nibble in it (right-click)
item.guhs.knabbelbal.uitleg: Put it down: guhs push it around until the nibble rolls out. Left-click to kick!
gui.guhs.speelgoed.glijbaan.bezet: Someone's already sliding, nyeg! Wait your turn.
gui.guhs.speelgoed.tunnel.leeg: Knock knock... nobody's in there. Not yet, nyeg.
gui.guhs.speelgoed.tunnel.gevonden: Found you! %s giggles and comes out of the tunnel.
gui.guhs.speelgoed.tunnel.muisje: %s found %s in the tunnel! Squeak squeak!
gui.guhs.speelgoed.bal.gevuld: There's a cheese nibble in the nibble ball again. Who's going to push it out?
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.eerste_knab: Today for the first time I pushed a nibble ball around until the nibble rolled out. Nom! I'm a ball champion, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.eerste_glij: Today I went down the slide for the first time. Wheee! My ears flapped all over the place.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.eerste_tunn: Today I hid in the fluffy tunnel for the first time. Nobody saw me. Well, almost nobody.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.eerste_wip_: Today I went on the swing for the first time. So high! I was so WAHOOG, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.knabbelbal_: I pushed the nibble ball with my snoot at least ten times. It rolls so nicely!
There was a cheese nibble in the ball. Now it's in my tummy. Chonky!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.glijbaantje: I went down the slide three times in a row. Again? Again!
The climbing frame has little ears, just like me. That's why I love it so much.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.tunnel_1: It's soft and dark in the tunnel. The perfect hiding spot, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.tunnel_2: I had to giggle so hard when I got found. That's what gave me away!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.wip_schomme: On the seesaw I went up and down, up and down. It made my tummy all tickly.
Someone gave me a push on the swing. I almost flew up to the clouds!
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.guhkamer: Send a guh to the Guh Room in your Guhbelly with the Guh Bell
Step through the door in your Guhbelly into your very own Guh Room
Your Guh Room has grown, thanks to a soulguh bff 5evr <3
Visit someone else's Guh Room (their belly has to be public)
item.guhs.guhbel.lore: Ding-a-ling! A golden little bell with guh ears.
item.guhs.guhbel.uitleg: Right-click: send your guhs to the Guh Room in your Guhbelly, or call them back to you.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.gegroeid: Your Guh Room has grown! Now %s x %s blocks, room for %s sleepover guhs. Thank you, soulguh!
gui.guhs.guhkamer.groeit_straks: A new soulguh! Your Guh Room grows as soon as you step inside again.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.even_geduld: %s is still fast asleep in the Guh Room... try again in a moment, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.gestuurd: %s is off for a cozy sleepover in your Guh Room. Bye-bye!
gui.guhs.guhkamer.vol: Your Guh Room is full! It grows with every soulguh bff 5evr <3.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.geen_maag: You don't have a Guhbelly yet, nyeg! Do the belly quest first.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.niet_jouw: Only your own tame guhs can have a sleepover in your Guh Room.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.prive: %s's belly isn't public: the Guh Room stays closed.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.welkom_thuis: Welcome to your Guh Room! %s guhs are sleeping over here.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.welkom_bezoek: Welcome to %s's Guh Room! Looking is fine, no petting.
gui.guhs.menu.guhkamer.logeren.tooltip: Off you go for a sleepover! Your guh goes to the Guh Room in your Guhbelly, just like with the Guh Bell. Is the room full? Then he snugly stays with you.
gui.guhs.menu.guhkamer.uit.tooltip: Sleepover's over! Your guh comes to you and goes with you again, just like calling with the Guh Bell. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhkamer.bel.groei: Your Guh Room grows with every guh that's soulguh bff 5evr <3 (now %s). Then there's more room!
gui.guhs.guhkamer.bel.stuur: Click: %s goes for a sleepover in the Guh Room
gui.guhs.guhkamer.bel.niemand_bij: None of your guhs nearby. They need to be within 24 blocks.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.bel.niemand_logeert: Nobody is sleeping over in your Guh Room yet. Send a guh there!
gui.guhs.guhkamer.bel.geen_maag: You don't have a Guhbelly yet. The Guh Room is in your belly: do the belly quest first!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.guhkamer.eerste: Today I got to have a sleepover in the Guh Room for the first time. In a belly! It's warm and pink in there and there's a little rug. Very snug, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.guhkamer.logeren_1: I'm on a sleepover in the Guh Room again. I miss my human a little. A teeny tiny bit. Okay, quite a lot.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.guhkamer.logeren_2: In the Guh Room I took a nap on the pink rug. Wahoog soft!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.guhkamer.logeren_3: Sometimes I hear the belly rumble when I'm lying in the Guh Room. That's just a lullaby, right?
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.samen_ju: Your guh cheers you on during a minigame: a good throw, a catch, a fast time
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.samen_ge: Play a minigame with your guh along. Playing together = hearts!
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.samen_re: Set a new record while your guh watches: it does the snuggle dance
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.samen_ka: Your guh hops on the back of your race kart and rides along the whole race
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.samen_sc: Your guh skates along with you on the Eleven Guhtowns Tour
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.samen_zw: Swim in the Snuggle Pool: your guh jumps in and swims along with you
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.samen_we: Come back to your guh after a long time: it does a welcome-back dance
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.samen_vr: Two of your guhs become buddies (let them spend lots of time together)
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.samen_be: Two of your guhs become best buddies: a real bff duo!
Sweet chonkies together: the Heart Pin and the Hearts emote are yours
Mega sweet chonkies together: the Snuggle Sweater and the Snuggle Dance are yours
Soulguh bff 5evr <3: the Soulguh Crown and the BFF Hug are yours
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.samen_ha: The prettiest collar of all: only for a soulguh. WAHOOG!
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.samen_bf: Do the BFF Hug with your soulguh: a big squishy hug with a giant heart above you
gui.guhs.samen.samen_gespeeld: ♥ %s played %s with you! Playing together = hearts.
gui.guhs.samen.kart: ♥ %s hops on the back! Racing together, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.samen.zwemmen: ♥ %s swims along with you. Splish splash, nyeg!
gui.guhs.samen.troost: ♥ %s was already waiting for you and gives you a comfort cuddle. Nyeg, so glad you're back!
gui.guhs.samen.welkom: ♥ %s is SO happy you're back! Welcome home, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.samen.onweer: Brr, thunderstorm! %s snuggles up close to you. Cuddle!
gui.guhs.samen.welterusten: %s waves you good night. Sleep chonky-tight, nyeg!
gui.guhs.samen.welterusten_meer: %s and %s more guhs wave you good night. Sleep chonky-tight, nyeg!
gui.guhs.samen.bff: ♥ You and %s give each other a big BFF hug! Soulguh bff 5evr <3
gui.guhs.samen.vriendjes: ♥ %s and %s are buddies now! Nyeg, how sweet.
gui.guhs.samen.besties: ♥ %s and %s are BEST buddies now! A real bff duo. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.samen.emote_ontgrendeld: ♥ Unlocked by your hearts: the %s emote! Pick it in your guh's Emotes menu.
gui.guhs.samen.emote_op_slot: %s is still locked: first become %s with a guh.
gui.guhs.samen.halsbandje: ♥ The Golden Heart Collar is yours! The prettiest thing a guh can wear, and you can only get it with a soulguh. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.samen.bff_uitleg: Tip: pick the BFF Hug in the Emotes menu while standing right next to your guh: then you really hug each other.
gui.guhs.emotes.op_slot: Locked, nyeg! First become %s with a guh.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.beauty: My human walked the catwalk and I clapped my pawsies so hard they turned red. Ten points from me!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.race: We raced today! I had to hold on to my ears, we went so fast. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.meppen: Whacking Mikas with a soft little hammer. They didn't even mind, they just giggled. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.disco: We danced on the light-up floor! Now I know all the colors by heart. Almost.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.golf: My human hit a little ball into a little hole. I almost ate the little ball. Almost!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.smul: Snacks fell from the sky! It was the best day of my life, and I only snatched three.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.vissen: We fished for guhfish. Now I smell like fish, but I'm very proud of it.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.verstop: We played hide-and-seek. I hid behind my own chonk. Nobody found me, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.bakkerij: We baked cookies! I got flour on my snoot and a cookie in my cheek pouch. Shhh, secret.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.creche: We looked after baby guhs. They're so tiny! I felt like a really big chonky guh.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.theehuis: A tea party! I stuck out my pinky. I don't have a pinky, but it went pretty well.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.kapper: A hairdo with curls went by. I want curls too. Or a quiff. Or both!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.sterrenwac: We looked at the stars. There was one shaped like a cheese nibble, I'm sure of it.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.ballon: We flew in a hot-air balloon! I looked down and saw the whole Guhmension. My tummy tickled.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.knuffelbad: We went down the slide: wheee! Now I'm a wet little chonk, but a happy wet little chonk.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.grijpmachi: A claw machine! I wanted to crawl inside to rescue the plushies. Wasn't allowed, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.sjoelen: We played shuffleboard with Granny Nyegshuffle. I cheered for every puck, even the ones in the wrong slot.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.doolhof: We walked through the maze. I knew the way! I just didn't say, or it wouldn't be exciting.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.katapult: Shooting fluffballs at a Mika fort! BOOM! The Mikas laughed, so that counts as sweet.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.knabbelspe: Sports! My human ran and I ran along in my head. Now I'm very tired.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.elftocht: We skated past all the towns. My pawsies are cold, but my heart is warm.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.circuit: Racing laps on the circuit! I sat on the back and shouted WAHOOG at every bend. Every. Single. Bend.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.beroepen: We did real work, just like big guhs. I was the very best helper, I told myself.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_bestie.tek: Now I have a BEST buddy. That's a buddy, but with extra cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_op_reis.te: We walked and walked and walked. I don't know where we were going, but it was together, so it was good.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_kart: On the back of the kart
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_kart.tekst: I rode on the back of a race kart! My cheeks were flapping. Again, NOW.
I can skate! Well, slide on my tummy. But very gracefully.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_zwemmen.te: I swam next to my owner in the Snuggle Pool. Guhs float really well, thanks to the chonk.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_troost.tek: My owner was gone for a while and came back very tired. I gave a cuddle. Cuddles make everything better.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_welkom.tek: My owner was gone sooo long. When they came back I did a little dance. A really big little dance.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_onweer.tek: The sky was rumbling. I wasn't scared, okay, I just wanted to sit really close to my owner.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_welteruste: My owner went to sleep and I waved. Another chonky day tomorrow, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_bff_knuffe: The biggest hug ever, with a heart above it. The heart was real, I saw it.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.eerste_minigame: Today %s and I played a game together. I cheered the loudest of everyone, nyeg!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.record: %s set a record and I did my very best dance. My chonk is still wiggling.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.op_reis: Did you know %s and I have walked a long, long way together? My pawsies still remember.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.kart: I rode on the back of %s's race kart! I shouted WAHOOG at every bend. Now I'm a bit hoarse.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.schaatsen: Today I skated across the ice next to %s. I only fell twice, and then I just slid on along on my belly.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.zwemmen: I went swimming with %s in the Snuggle Pool. Did you know a guh can't sink? Too chonky!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.troost: %s came back really tired. I was already waiting and gave the biggest comfort cuddle ever.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.welkom: %s was gone for so long! I did a welcome-back dance. With spinning and hopping and everything.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.onweer: There was a thunderstorm, so I snuggled up to %s. Did you know a human works better than a blanket?
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.welterusten: I waved nighty-night to %s. Sleep chonky-tight, I said. Or thought. Both.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.bff_knuffel: %s and I did the BFF Hug. A big pink heart floated above us. Soulguh bff 5evr <3!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.vriendje: I've got a buddy: %s! We walk together, we cuddle together, we snore together. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.bestie: %s is now my BEST buddy. I wrote it in my diary, with a little heart next to it.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.samen_slapen: Last night I slept in our house next to %s. Who snored the loudest? Not me, nyeg. (Me.)
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.favoriet: Discover one of a guh's faves. It shows it with an explosion of hearts!
Discover a guh's favorite snack (feed it all kinds of snackies)
Discover a guh's favorite spot (take it along on your travels)
Discover a guh's favorite plushie (put plushies down near it)
Discover a guh's favorite song (xylophone or disco)
Discover a guh's favorite color (dress it up in clothes)
Discover who a guh's very best guh buddy is
Discover all eight faves of one guh. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.alle: ★ You now know ALL of %s's faves! You two really are sweet chonkies together. WAHOOG! ★
gui.guhs.favorietjes.neuriet: ♪ %1$s is humming their favorite song (%2$s): they're in the mood! A happy guh cheers louder! ♪
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.eten.0: %s looks curiously at the snack... almost! Something like this is their very favorite, nyeg!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.eten.1: %s perks up their ears: mmm, this tastes ALMOST like their favorite snack. Warm, warm!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.eten.2: %s licks their snoot and looks at you hopefully. Something like that, but juuust a bit different... nyeg?
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.eten.0: %s sniffs... smacks... nyeg? Yummy, sure, but not their very favorite snack.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.eten.1: %s chews politely. It's sweetly meant, but their favorite snack is something totally different. Cold!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.eten.2: %s sniffs it and goes a little cross-eyed. Nyeg? Try something totally different!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.plek.0: %s looks around curiously... it almost smells like their favorite spot here!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.plek.1: %s pitter-patters in excited circles. This looks like their favorite spot, but it's juuust not it. Warm!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.plek.2: %s sniffs the air: their favorite spot is a lot like this spot, nyeg!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.plek.0: %s sniffs the ground... nyeg? Nice here, but their favorite spot is somewhere else entirely.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.plek.1: %s gives a yawn. Nice view, but nothing to wiggle about. Cold, cold!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.plek.2: %s looks around and shrugs their little shoulders. Keep looking, nyeg!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.knuffel.0: %s hugs the plushie and looks up curiously... that kind of plushie is almost their favorite plushie!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.knuffel.1: %s presses their snoot into the plushie: warm! Their very favorite plushie looks a bit like this one.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.knuffel.2: %s giggles softly. Almost, almost! Their favorite plushie is a little cousin of this one, nyeg.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.knuffel.0: %s sniffs the plushie... nyeg? Soft, but not their very favorite.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.knuffel.1: %s gives the plushie a polite pat. Cold! Their favorite plushie is totally different.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.knuffel.2: %s looks at the plushie, the plushie looks back. No spark. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.liedje.0: %s wiggles along curiously... that kind of song is almost their favorite song!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.liedje.1: %s hums a few notes along and then stops. Warm! Their song sounds a bit like this.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.liedje.2: %s waves their ears to the beat: almost! Try another song of the same kind.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.liedje.0: %s listens politely... nyeg? Nice tune, but not their favorite song.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.liedje.1: %s taps along with one pawsie and then almost falls asleep. Cold!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.liedje.2: %s sniffs the music (turns out you can). Nyeg? Maybe a totally different kind of song!
%s plays curiously... this kind of playing is almost their favorite toy, nyeg!
%s runs excited little laps. Warm! You play with their very favorite toy in just the same way.
%s squeaks happily: almost! Try a toy you play with in the same way.
%s sniffs the toy... nyeg? Fun, but not their favorite toy.
%s plays along for a bit and then sits down comfily. Cold!
%s looks at you as if to say: another toy please, nyeg.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.emote.0: %s looks up curiously after their trick... that kind of trick is almost their favorite trick!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.emote.1: %s beams a little. Warm! Their very favorite trick has exactly the same mood.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.emote.2: %s is still wiggling: almost, nyeg! Try a trick that feels the same.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.emote.0: %s gives a sniff... nyeg? Nice trick, but not their very favorite.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.emote.1: %s does it nicely, but their ears stay flat. Cold!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.emote.2: %s takes a deep breath and sighs. Nyeg. Maybe a totally different trick?
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.kleur.0: %s looks at themselves curiously... this color is right next to their favorite color!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.kleur.1: %s twirls in front of a puddle. Warm! Just a shade different.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.kleur.2: %s strokes their new outfit: almost, nyeg! Their favorite color is a neighbor color.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.kleur.0: %s sniffs their outfit... nyeg? Pretty, but not their favorite color.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.kleur.1: %s looks at their outfit and then at you. Cold! A totally different color, please.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.kleur.2: %s makes a pouty snoot. It suits them fine, but it's not their color, nyeg.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.vriend.0: %s happily sniffs this guh... warm! Their very best guh buddy is a buddy of this one.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.vriend.1: %s gives a pawsie. Warm! This guh knows their very best buddy really well, nyeg.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.vriend.2: %s plays along for a bit and then looks around: where's their very best buddy? Almost!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.vriend.0: %s sniffs the other guh... nyeg? Nice, but not their very favorite buddy.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.vriend.1: %s nods politely at the other guh. Cold! Their best buddy is a different guh.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.vriend.2: %s looks at the other guh and says: nyeg. That means: nice, but not my bff.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.eten: ♥ Nyeg!! %1$s munches and smacks and beams: %2$s is their FAVORITE SNACK! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.plek: ♥ WAHOOG! %1$s rolls through the grass with joy: %2$s is their favorite spot!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.knuffel: ♥ Ooooh! %1$s hugs and hugs and won't let go: %2$s is their favorite plushie!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.liedje: ♥ Nyeg nyeg nyeg! %1$s sings along at the top of their lungs: %2$s is their favorite song!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.speeltje: ♥ Wheee! %1$s can't stop anymore: %2$s is their favorite toy!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.emote: ♥ %1$s does it again, and again: %2$s is their favorite trick! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.kleur: ♥ %1$s shows off their outfit to everyone: %2$s is their favorite color! So chonky, so pretty!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.vriend: ♥ %1$s and %2$s are the very best buddies! Together they're twice as wahoog!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.weer.plek: ♥ %1$s hops around: back at their favorite spot, %2$s!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.weer.knuffel: ♥ %1$s hugs %2$s again, their very favorite plushie!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.weer.liedje: ♥ %1$s sings along with %2$s, their favorite song!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.weer.kleur: ♥ %1$s is wearing %2$s again, their favorite color!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.weer.vriend: ♥ %1$s is back together with %2$s, their very best buddy!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_fav_: My owner now knows what I love most of ALL. Now I'll surely get it every day. Right? Nyeg?
We were at my favorite spot! I rolled around in the grass for a bit. Three times. Four times.
I found my very favorite plushie. I'm never letting go of it. Unless a cheese nibble comes along.
My owner played MY song! I sang along so loud my little ears were trembling.
This toy is mine. Well, ours. But mostly mine, nyeg.
My owner likes my favorite trick too! I'm going to do it really often now. Really, really often.
I'm wearing my favorite color! I'm now officially the prettiest guh in the world. Says me.
My owner gets who my very best buddy is now. We do everything together. Even snoring.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_alle: My owner knows all my little secrets. All eight! Except where I hid that one cheese nibble. Shh.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_ijsj: Brrr! Cold on my snoot! One more bite. Brrr! One more bite. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_taar: I ate a pastry. Now there are crumbs in my fur and they're never coming out.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_suik: Candy! It sticks to my whiskers. This is the best day of my life.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_frui: Fruit is healthy, says my owner. It's yummy too, says me. But cheese nibbles are yummier.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_frit: Crispy! Golden brown! Chonk! I think I'm even a little chonkier now. Good, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_visj: I ate a fishy. It looked at me a little surprised. So did I.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_hapj: I've eaten a hundred snacks from my owner's hand already. My chonk grows and grows. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_stra: Sand between my toes! I built a sandcastle. Well, a sand bump.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_snee: Everything is white and cold and crunchy. My pawsies are ice cubes. But it's so pretty, nyeg!
So much water! Where does it all come from? I looked at it for a really long time.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_woes: Hot! Sandy! Not a cheese nibble in sight. Moving on quickly, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_bloe: I sniffed all the little flowers. One of them tickled. I had to sneeze. Achoo-guh!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_padd: There were cows walking around with mushrooms on their backs. I didn't say anything. Polite, huh.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_jung: Tall trees, funny noises and a parrot that shouted 'guh'. Or was that me?
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_moer: It's soggy here and a little stinky. My pawsies went 'squish squish'. Fun sound!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_grot: It's dark and something is dripping. I was very brave. I only squeaked once.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_berg: We climbed all the way to the top. I could almost see my house! I think. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_knuf: A whole dale full of plushies and sweet guhs. I want to live here. Or at least have a sleepover.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_guhp: Windmills, ditches and ice! I didn't slip. Okay, once. Okay, three times.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_vads: The Chonkwood Forest smells of nibbleberries and adventure. I felt very tough. And a little small.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_neth: It's very hot here and very red. I almost felt like a fried cheese nibble. Quick, let's go!
The End is very quiet and there are long black things walking around. I didn't look at them. Safer.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_guhm: I've been inside my owner's belly. On the inside! It's snugger than you'd think.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_barb: It smells like barbecue here and I'm hungry. I'm always hungry, but now extra.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_knuf: I cuddled a plushie. It didn't cuddle back, but I know it wanted to.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_koor: Someone played a song on the xylophone and I sang along. I'm a singing guh now. Almost famous.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_disc: Lights! Music! I danced until my chonk shook. Disco is my thing, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_kled: I'm wearing clothes! I'm a very fancy guh now. No more rolling in the mud. Okay, a little.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_dans: I danced while my owner was watching! My owner clapped. I think I'm a star.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_vaho: WAHOOG! I jumped so high I could smell the clouds for a moment. They smell like cotton candy.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_zing: I sang a song for my owner. It had no words, just 'nyeg'. But with lots of feeling.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_roll: I did a somersault! After that I didn't know which way was up for a bit. Again!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_reis: We've walked 1000 blocks together already! My pawsies are tired, but my little heart is happy.
Ten thousand blocks! I didn't count them all. Most of them, though. Up to twelve. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_mara: 42,195 blocks together: a real marathon! I deserve a medal. A cheese one, please.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_knuf: Ten big cuddles already! I keep a list. The list got cuddled too.
A hundred cuddles! I'm the most cuddled guh in the whole world. Definitely.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_reco: My owner set a record and I was cheering! So really it's my record too, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_klus: A hundred chores done! I'm the hardest-working guh in the whole house. Nap time.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_spee: Played fifty times! Playing is very hard work too, you know. Especially for my little ears.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_nach: My first night in my very own house. I snored all night long. So they say. Not me.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_week: We've been together a whole week! Seven days. That's like seven times as many cuddles.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_maan: A whole month together! I know all your little secrets now. And you know mine. Well, most of them.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_hond: A hundred days! I baked a little cake. In my head. It was very yummy.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_rege: Drops on my little ears! I'm a wet guh now. Wet guhs smell like... guh.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_onwe: BOOM! I snuggled up to my owner for just a second. But I wasn't scared. Really, I wasn't. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_snee: Snowflakes fell on my snoot. I ate one. Tastes like nothing. Still yummy.
