structure.guhs.mika_woonblokken.tooltip: The apartment blocks of the Nether Mikas: walkways, clotheslines and Granny Mika with her soup (Guhbarbecuether)
structure.guhs.mika_stal.tooltip: The stable of the Sausage Piglets, with the Stable Hand Guh in front of the big door (Guhbarbecuether)
structure.guhs.mika_brugpaleis.tooltip: A toll bridge through the mouth of a gigantic Mika. The Toll Keeper wants to hear three riddles from you (Guhbarbecuether)
item.guhs.paleizen_omasoep.lore: From Granny Mika, for the grumps of the apartment block. Don't eat it yourself, nyeg!
item.guhs.paleizen_breiwerkje.lore: Half a little cap on two needles. Bring it back to Granny.
item.guhs.paleizen_zwijnenvoer.lore: For the feeding trough in the Mika Stable. (Tastes like cardboard.)
item.guhs.paleizen_gevangen_zwijntje.lor: The runaway Sausage Piglet. Bring him to the Stable Hand Guh.
Put the basket down (right-click the ground): out hops a Sausage Piglet that wants to live with you.
Petting, brushing and nibble feed: a happy Sausage Piglet sniffs out something tasty every day.
item.guhs.paleizen_losse_plank.lore: Right-click close to the gap in the toll bridge: you lay a whole row of planks.
item.guhs.paleizen_recept_brug.lore: With this blueprint in your crafting table you can make Mika Bridge Planks and Rope Railing.
item.guhs.paleizen_recept_brug.lore2: It simply stays in your crafting table. (The bridge is drawn crooked.)
gui.guhs.boerderij.blij.worstzwijntje: Your Sausage Piglet is happy as can be! It's off to sniff out something tasty for you.
gui.guhs.paleizen.snuffel: Sniff sniff... your Sausage Piglet has sniffed something out!
gui.guhs.paleizen.mandje.los: Oink! Your Sausage Piglet hops out of the basket.
gui.guhs.paleizen.mandje.geen_plek: There's no room for the basket here. Find a bit of open ground.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.hallo: Oh, a visitor! Come in, child... or no, better stay outside, there's yarn everywhere in here. I'm Granny Mika. Those young Mikas swipe nibbles all day long. Not me, mind you. I knit. And I cook sausage soup. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.vraag: Would you do something for me? My neighbors grumble all day long, and only one thing helps: a little bowl of my sausage soup. But my little paws won't take all those stairs anymore.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.uitleg: Grumble Mika lives downstairs in the west block and grumbles about the noise. Whiny Mika lives in the east block, two floors up, and whines about the smell. And Snore Mika, two floors below me, snores so loudly that he wakes himself up. And then he grumbles. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.soep: Thank you, child! Here are three little bowls: one for Grumble Mika, one for Whiny Mika and one for Snore Mika. Don't eat them yourself, now! ...Oh well. I've got a whole pot left.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.soep_nog: Has the soup gone around yet? %s grumps to go. Grumble Mika lives downstairs in the west block, Whiny Mika two floors up in the east block and Snore Mika two floors below me.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.soep_kwijt: Is the soup gone? Or... did you eat it yourself? Never mind, child. Here, a fresh little bowl.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.breiwerk: They've all eaten and nobody is grumbling? Such peace and quiet! Then I can finally get on with my knit... MY KNITTING! It was lying on the edge of the walkway. It blew away: I just saw it land on the roof of the low block. Would you fetch it for me?
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.breiwerk_nog: My knitting must still be on the roof garden of the low block, over there on the other side. Take the stairs in the east tower and walk along the walkway, child.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.klaar: My knitting! And not a single stitch dropped. You know what? This little cap was nearly done anyway... click click click... there! A Knitted Mika Cap for your guh. With little horns! And I'll tell the young Mikas to give you a discount when you barter. Or else no more soup for them. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.dank0: Will you drop by again? There's always soup on.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.dank1: That cap must look adorable on your guh. With little horns you look like a real Mika right away. But a sweet one.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.dank2: A Nether Mika won't give you a discount? Then just say: 'Granny will hear about this!' Nyeg.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.hint.soep: bring the soup to Grumble Mika (west block, ground floor), Whiny Mika (east block, two floors up) and Snore Mika (tall block, two floors up)
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.hint.breiwerk: find the knitting basket on the roof garden of the low east block (the stairs in the east tower)
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.hint.terug: bring the knitting to Granny Mika on the top walkway
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.0.mopper: Grumble! Always such a racket around here. Stomping paws on the walkway, bells ringing, piglets oinking. GRUMBLE!
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.0.soep: Grumble... is that Granny Mika's soup? ...Slurp. Hm. Well. It is pretty tasty. But don't tell anyone. Grumble.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.0.tevreden: Grumble. Quiet now, I'm still enjoying the soup.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.1.mopper: It STINKS in here! Of burnt nibbles, of wet Mika, of everything. And nobody does a thing about it!
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.1.soep: What's that I smell... sausage soup? From Granny? Give it here! ...Mmm. Okay. THIS is allowed to smell.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.1.tevreden: I'm not whining for a moment. My snout is still full of soup smell. Lovely.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.2.mopper: ZZZ... snore... HUH?! Who's waking me up? I was just asleep! Well, I woke up from my own snoring. But STILL.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.2.soep: Soup in bed? From Granny? ...Slurp slurp. It makes you so nice and sleepy. Nighty-night. ZZZ...
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.3.a: Nice weather for the laundry, eh? Well. It's always smoky here. But the laundry is up.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.3.b: Do you know Granny Mika from the top walkway? She knits socks for the whole block. They do itch, though.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.4.a: Barbecuing takes patience. And swiped nibbles. But you didn't hear that last bit from me.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.4.b: Sausage? Nah, just kidding. Those are mine.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.5.a: Shh. I'm sunbathing. Yes, I know there's no sun here. You just have to believe in it.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.5.b: This is the nicest roof in the whole Barbecuether. Especially when nobody talks to me.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.geen_soep: No soup, no knocking on my door. Grump grump.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.vreemde: Soup? From whom? I don't take anything from strangers. Go talk to Granny Mika first. Grump.
gui.guhs.paleizen.soep.klaar: All three grumps have their soup. Suddenly it's very quiet in the block... Go tell Granny Mika!
gui.guhs.paleizen.breiwerk.niet_nu: A little basket with knitting. Whose could it be?
gui.guhs.paleizen.breiwerk.gevonden: You found Granny Mika's knitting! Quick, bring it back.
gui.guhs.paleizen.breiwerk.al: You already have the knitting. Granny Mika is waiting on the top walkway.
gui.guhs.paleizen.breiwerk.klaar: Granny left a spare bit of knitting here. 'For when it's windy again', she says.
gui.guhs.paleizen.korting: Granny Mika's discount! The Mika tosses your ingot back. 'Granny will hear about this!'
gui.guhs.paleizen.beloning.korting: Discount with the Nether Mikas: every third barter is free
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.hallo: Psst! You there! I'm the Stable Hand Guh. Yes, a guh, working for the Mikas. Somebody has to look after the Sausage Piglets, right? The Mikas make them sniff out nibbles all day and do nothing but shout. It makes them so restless, nyeg.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.vraag: Just look: they're bouncing around in their pens. Will you help me calm them down? All you have to do is pet them. Mikas can't do that, they don't have the patience.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.uitleg: A Sausage Piglet is a little sausage on legs: a snout, two little tusks, a stripe of mustard down its back and a curly tail with a knot in it. They can smell a nibble from a hundred blocks away. And they adore being petted. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.aai: Wahoog! Pet three of them until they oink calmly: three pets per piglet, and the bouncing settles all by itself. Empty hand, gentle paws.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.aai_nog: %s more Sausage Piglets to calm down. Take it easy: three pets per piglet, with an empty hand.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.voer: Hear that? Happy oinking! Now they're peckish. Here, a sack of piglet feed. Empty it into the feeding trough, all the way at the back of the aisle.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.voer_nog: The feeding trough is at the end of the aisle. Right-click it with the sack of piglet feed.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.voer_kwijt: Lost the sack? Here, I've got another one. Don't eat it yourself: it tastes like cardboard. Don't ask how I know.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.ontsnapt: Munch away! One, two, three, four, five... wait. Where's Oinky? His pen is open! OINKY HAS ESCAPED! He must be somewhere near the paddock. Sneak up to him, or he'll get spooked and run off. And then pick him up, nyeg!
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.zoek_nog: Oinky likes to hide behind the hay bales in the paddock, by the cart or up in the hayloft. Sneak, remember! Stomping paws spook him.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.klaar: OINKY! Come to your stable hand. You're a hero, nyeg! You know what? The Mikas never count their piglets anyway. Here: two little ones, each in a basket. Take good care of them: petting, brushing and nibble feed. Then every day they'll sniff out something tasty for you.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.dank0: How are your Sausage Piglets doing? Are they getting enough pets?
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.dank1: A happy Sausage Piglet sniffs something out every day. Sometimes a nibble, sometimes something from the Barbecuether. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.dank2: Don't tell the Mikas I give the piglets extra feed. Or soon I'll be the stable hand of... nothing.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.hint.aai: pet three Sausage Piglets in the stable (empty hand, three pets per piglet)
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.hint.voer: right-click the feeding trough at the back of the aisle with the sack of piglet feed
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.hint.zoek: look for Oinky near the paddock, sneak up to him and pick him up
gui.guhs.paleizen.aai.1: Oink? The Sausage Piglet is already bouncing a little less.
gui.guhs.paleizen.aai.2: Oinkkk... Almost calm. Just one more pet!
gui.guhs.paleizen.aai.3: Oinkkk! This Sausage Piglet is completely calm. (%s of 3)
gui.guhs.paleizen.aai.al: You already calmed this Sausage Piglet. It's oinking happily.
gui.guhs.paleizen.aai.klaar: Three calm Sausage Piglets! Go back to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.paleizen.voerbak: Munch munch munch! The Sausage Piglets dive into the feed. Go back to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.paleizen.schrik: Your stomping spooks Oinky and he runs off! Sneak up to him next time.
gui.guhs.paleizen.moe: Oinky is tired from all the running. Now you can just pick him up.
gui.guhs.paleizen.gevangen: You've got Oinky! He's oinking softly in your arms. Bring him to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.paleizen.niet_van_jou: This is the runaway piglet of %s. Yours is somewhere else.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.hallo: HALT! This is the toll bridge of the Mika Bridge Palace and I am the Toll Keeper. Nobody gets through my mouth... er, through THE mouth, without paying toll. And the toll is: three riddles. I'd rather have had nibbles, but the boss says riddles. Nyeg nyeg nyeg.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel_fout: WRONG! Nyeg nyeg nyeg! Have another good think. I've got plenty more.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsels_klaar: Three right?! Who told you the answers... Oh well. A deal is a deal. You may pass.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.brug: But er... there's one tiny thing. The bridge is broken. Again. The planks keep falling out, can you believe it? Here: five new planks. Could you pop them in? I'm far too busy toll keeping.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.brug_nog: The planks go in the gap, past my toll house. %s rows to go. Did you fall in? There's a scaffold hanging under the gap, with a ladder back up.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.brug_kwijt: Lost the planks? Dropped them in the sauce, I bet. Here, I've got more. I ALWAYS have more.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.brug_wacht: Somebody else just fixed the bridge. Just wait a bit: it'll collapse again any moment. Mika Quality!
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.bel_nog: The bridge is whole? Then ring the toll bell in the bell tower on the other side. Then everybody knows the bridge is open again. And that there are riddles to guess again!
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.klaar: DONG! I heard it all the way over here. Nice work. All right then: you never have to guess a riddle on my bridge again. And here, the blueprint of the bridge, with some planks and rope railing. You can build your own bridge at home. Without a toll. A shame, but oh well.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.dank0: Free passage for you. But don't tell the others, or soon everybody will want it.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.dank1: The bridge collapsed again? Yes. It does that. That's what makes it a Mika bridge.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.dank2: Want another riddle? What's yellow and costs eight nibbles? ...Nothing. I just want eight nibbles.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.tekening_kwijt: Lost the blueprint? Here's a new one. I draw them myself. That's why the bridge is drawn crooked.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.hint.brug: lay the five planks in the gap in the bridge (right-click with a plank, close to the gap)
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.hint.bel: walk across the bridge to the bell tower and ring the toll bell
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.hint.terug: go back to the Toll Keeper Mika for your reward
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.halt: Whoa whoa! First guess three riddles, nyeg!
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.plank: Tap tap tap! %s rows of planks to go.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.plank.op: You're out of planks, but %s rows are still missing. Get new planks from the Toll Keeper Mika.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.plank.ver: Walk to the gap in the toll bridge to lay this plank.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.plank.heel: The bridge is already whole. Wait until it collapses again (Mika Quality).
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.plank.niet_nu: These planks are for the toll bridge. Talk to the Toll Keeper Mika first.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.brug_heel: The bridge is whole! Hurry to the bell tower and ring the toll bell, before it collapses again.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.bel: DONG! The toll bell echoes across the whole bridge. Go back to the Toll Keeper Mika.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.bel.niet_nu: Dong. Nice sound. But the Toll Keeper has no idea what's going on: talk to him first.
gui.guhs.paleizen.beloning.doorgang: Free passage across the toll bridge, forever
gui.guhs.paleizen.beloning.zwijntjes: Two Sausage Piglets in a basket (to take home)
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.0: It's yellow, it crunches and it's always gone too soon. What is it?
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.1: I have a curly tail with a knot in it, four little legs, and really I'm a sausage. Who am I?
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.2: What gets wetter the more it dries?
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.3: What has a mouth but doesn't bite, and you walk right through it?
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.4: What can you break without touching it?
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.5: What does a guh say when it totally agrees with you?
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.uitleg: Granny Mika doesn't join in the nibble swiping: she knits and cooks sausage soup for the whole block. But her neighbors grumble and her knitting has blown away. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.0: Climb to the top walkway of the tall block and talk to Granny Mika.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.waar.0: The Mika Apartments in the Guhbarbecuether (Super Compass: Barbecue)
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.1: Bring a little bowl of sausage soup to Grumble Mika, Whiny Mika and Snore Mika (right-click them with the soup in your hand).
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.waar.1: Grumble Mika: west block, ground floor. Whiny Mika: east block, two floors up. Snore Mika: tall block, two floors up
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.2: Granny Mika's knitting has blown off the walkway. Find the knitting basket and take the knitting (right-click).
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.waar.2: The roof garden of the low east block (take the stairs in the east tower)
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.3: Bring the knitting to Granny Mika.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.waar.3: The top walkway of the tall block
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.klaar: Granny Mika is knitting again and the whole block smells of soup. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.1_klaar: All three grumps have their soup and suddenly it's very quiet in the block. Go tell Granny Mika!
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.waar.1_klaar: The top walkway of the tall block
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.kort.0: Talk to Granny Mika on the top walkway
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.kort.1: Bring soup to the three grumps
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.kort.1_klaar: Tell Granny Mika the soup has gone around
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.kort.2: Find the knitting on the roof garden
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.kort.3: Bring the knitting to Granny Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.uitleg: The Mikas make their Sausage Piglets sniff out nibbles all day and are far too rough. The Stable Hand Guh secretly takes good care of them, but now they're bouncing around in their pens and one has escaped.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.stap.0: Talk to the Stable Hand Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.0: Talk to the Stable Hand Guh in front of the big stable door.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.0: The Mika Stable in the Guhbarbecuether (Super Compass: Barbecue)
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.1: Pet three restless Sausage Piglets until they oink calmly: right-click with an empty hand, three pets per piglet.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.1: In the pens of the stable and in the paddock
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.2: Empty the Stable Hand Guh's sack of piglet feed into the feeding trough (right-click the trough with the sack).
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.2: At the end of the aisle in the stable
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.3: Oinky has escaped! Look for him near the stable, sneak up to him (or he gets spooked) and pick him up (right-click).
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.3: Behind the hay bales in the paddock, in the hayloft or by the cart
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.klaar: All the Sausage Piglets are oinking happily, and you have two of your own. Oink, nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.1_klaar: Three calm Sausage Piglets! Go back to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.1_klaa: In front of the big stable door
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.2_klaar: The Sausage Piglets are munching happily. Go back to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.2_klaa: In front of the big stable door
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.3_gevang: You have Oinky in your arms! Bring him to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.3_geva: In front of the big stable door
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.kort.0: Talk to the Stable Hand Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.kort.1_klaa: Go back to the Stable Hand Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.kort.2: Fill the feeding trough in the stable
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.kort.2_klaa: Go back to the Stable Hand Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.kort.3_geva: Bring Oinky to the Stable Hand Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.naam: The Toll Bridge of the Mika Bridge Palace
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.uitleg: Nobody crosses the bridge without guessing three of the Toll Keeper's riddles. And the bridge itself? Broken again. Mika Quality, nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.stap.0: Talk to the Toll Keeper Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.0: Walk to the gigantic Mika mouth and talk to the Toll Keeper Mika.
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.waar.0: The Mika Bridge Palace in the Guhbarbecuether (Super Compass: Barbecue)
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.1: Get three of the Toll Keeper Mika's riddles right. Guessed wrong? Then you simply get another riddle.
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.waar.1: With the Toll Keeper Mika in the gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.2: Lay the Toll Keeper's five bridge planks in the gap (right-click with a plank, close to the gap).
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.waar.2: On the bridge, past the toll house
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.3: Walk across the repaired bridge to the bell tower and ring the toll bell (right-click the bell).
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.waar.3: In the bell tower on the other side
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.4: Go back to the Toll Keeper Mika for your reward.
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.waar.4: With the Toll Keeper Mika in the gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.klaar: The bridge is whole (for now), the bell is ringing and you may always cross for free. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.kort.0: Talk to the Toll Keeper Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.kort.1: Guess three of the Toll Keeper's riddles
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.kort.2: Lay the five planks in the gap

Calm the Sausage Piglets, fill the feeding trough and catch Oinky
Guess the riddles, repair the bridge and ring the toll bell
block.guhs.bestaand_zielig_lantaarntje.l: It always looks a little sad. Pet it (right-click) and it cheers right up. Nyeg!
item.guhs.bestaand_zielig_lantaarntje.lo: It always looks a little sad. Pet it (right-click) and it cheers right up. Nyeg!
block.guhs.bestaand_knuffelguh.lore: Sewn with love by the Plushie Maker Guh. Go on, give it a squeeze (right-click)!
item.guhs.bestaand_knuffelguh.lore: Sewn with love by the Plushie Maker Guh. Go on, give it a squeeze (right-click)!
block.guhs.bestaand_knuffelmika.lore: Looks grumpy, feels soft. Guaranteed not to swipe any nibbles.
item.guhs.bestaand_knuffelmika.lore: Looks grumpy, feels soft. Guaranteed not to swipe any nibbles.
block.guhs.bestaand_knuffelrookguh.lore: A sad little puff of smoke to fall asleep against. No feeding needed.
item.guhs.bestaand_knuffelrookguh.lore: A sad little puff of smoke to fall asleep against. No feeding needed.
item.guhs.bestaand_aansteekspies.lore: Borrowed. Right-click a cold bridge brazier with it: fwoosh!
item.guhs.bestaand_recept_lantaarn.lore: Lets you make Sad Little Lanterns. The recipe simply stays in your crafting table.
item.guhs.bestaand_recept_knuffel.lore: The Plushie Maker Guh's pattern: wool, string and a little bit of love. Stays in your crafting table.
gui.guhs.bestaand.vuur.aan: FWOOSH! The bridge fire on the %s bridge is burning again (%s/%s).
gui.guhs.bestaand.vuur.al_aan: This bridge fire is already burning. Nice and toasty, nyeg!
gui.guhs.bestaand.vuur.spies: No little flame, no fire: right-click the brazier with the Guard Guh's lighting skewer.
gui.guhs.bestaand.vuur.uit: A cold brazier. The Guard Guh in the hall of the Skewer Keep surely knows more about it.
gui.guhs.bestaand.vuur.alle: All four bridge fires are burning! Go tell the Guard Guh.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kruid.weg: Rrrip! Mika Weed out (%s/%s). It gave one last grumpy hiss.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kruid.alle: The little garden is tidy again! The peanut sprouts breathe a sigh of relief. Go back to the Guard Guh.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.onbekend: Stolen plushies... The captured Plushie Maker Guh on this floor surely knows more about it.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.slot: The cage is locked. Slip a wahoog chonk through the bars, or sneak (crouch) and fiddle the lock open while no Mika is looking.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.betaald: The Mikas snatch your chonk and very obviously look the other way. The plushie wriggles out between the bars! (%s/%s)
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.open: Click! The lock pops open and the plushie wriggles out between the bars! (%s/%s)
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.betrapt: HEY! PAWS OFF, NYEG! A Nether Mika spotted you and gives you a shove.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.al_vrij: This cage is empty: your plushie is already back with the Plushie Maker Guh.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.alle: All three plushies are free! Go to the Plushie Maker Guh.
gui.guhs.bestaand.lantaarntje.blij: The little lantern cheers right up from your pet. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.bestaand.lantaarntje.zielig: The little lantern looks a bit sad again. Just the way it should.
gui.guhs.bestaand.beloning.knuffels: Three plushies: guh, Mika and Smoke Guh
gui.guhs.bestaand.commando.stand: Guard: step %s (fires %s, weed %s). Plushie Maker: step %s (cages %s).
gui.guhs.bestaand.commando.gewist: The questlines of the Guard Guh and the Plushie Maker Guh have been cleared for %s.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.hallo: HALT! Who goes there?! ... Oh, a visitor. Sorry, nyeg: force of habit. I'm the Guard Guh and I've been guarding this statue since back when this place was only lukewarm. But just look at that: the four bridge fires are out! Without fire, no guh can see where the bridge ends and the frying sauce begins.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.wat: The Spark Mikas! They blow them out, just for fun. 'Then WE burn the brightest,' they say. Show-offs. And I can't leave my post: who else would look after the statue? Well? Exactly.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.start: Wahoog! Here, my lighting skewer. On every bridge there's a brazier on a pedestal: four bridges, four fires. Right-click them with the skewer. And don't fall in the sauce, nyeg!
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.hint.vuren: light the four bridge fires: there is a brazier on every bridge of the Skewer Keep (right-click with the lighting skewer)
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.vuren_nog: Still %s of the %s bridge fires to go. I can see it from here: it's as dark as a burnt nibble over there.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.spies_kwijt: Lost my lighting skewer? Nyeg... luckily I have a whole rack of them. Here.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.brug_dicht: On one bridge the brazier has gone missing (bricked in? eaten?). I'll count that one as done, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.vuren_klaar: They're burning! All four! I can see the bridges again, and the bridges can see me. Wahoog! But now that I've got somebody who IS allowed to leave their post... the little peanut sauce garden upstairs is full of Mika Weed. The Mikas sow it, out of pure nyeg. Will you pull it out?
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.tuin_start: The little garden is one staircase up, in the middle of the keep. You'll know Mika Weed right away: purple, prickly and it gives you a grumpy look. I count %s clumps. Just pull them out: click on them!
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.hint.tuin: weed the clumps of Mika Weed in the little peanut sauce garden (one staircase up, in the middle of the Skewer Keep): click on them
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.tuin_nog: Still %s clumps of Mika Weed in the little garden. The peanut sprouts don't dare grow past them anymore.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.klaar: Four fires lit, garden tidy: THAT's how a keep should be! From now on you're an honorary guard, nyeg. Here: my spare helmet (the one with the satay plume), a guard's cloak and the recipe for my little lantern. It always looks a little sad, but if you pet it, it cheers right up. Just like me.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.bedankt0: The fires are still burning, you know. I check every five minutes. Well, I'm always checking. I'm a guard.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.bedankt1: Do you know what I guard here? The statue. And do you know what the statue does? Nothing. Best colleague I ever had, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.bedankt2: If the Spark Mikas come blowing again, I'll blow right back. Wahoog hard.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.recept_kwijt: Lost the recipe? A guard keeps two of everything. Here, nyeg!
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.hallo: Psst! Hey, you there! Not so loud... I'm the Plushie Maker Guh. The Mikas took me along, AND all my plushies. Now I have to darn Mika socks all day long. SOCKS! And my plushies are stuck in those cages, all alone. Will you help them out?
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.waarom: Walk away? The door is open, yes. But I'm not leaving without my plushies, nyeg! And honestly... Big Nether Mika is never here. He lives in his own castle, somewhere in the sauce sea. Here there's only a little sign minding his throne.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.start: Three cages, three plushies. The ransom is one wahoog chonk per plushie: right-click the cage with a wahoog chonk (or a chonk ingot) in your hand. No chonk? Then sneak (crouch) up to a cage and fiddle the lock open while no Mika is looking. Caught? Then you get a shove. That's all, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.hint.ko: free the three plushies from the cages on this floor: pay one wahoog chonk per cage, or sneak (crouch) and fiddle the lock open while no Mika is looking
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.kooien_: Still %s of the %s plushies are locked up. I can hear them squeaking, nyeg. Well, plushies don't squeak. But I can HEAR it.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.kooi_we: One cage is already broken (who does such a thing?). That plushie must have escaped: I'll count that one as done.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.draad: All three of them are here! Come here, my fluffy little chonks... Oh no. The Mikas have been tugging at them: every little seam has come loose. Bring me %s string and I'll sew them back up. Nether Mikas sometimes trade it for a chonk ingot, the thieves.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.hint.dr: bring string to the Plushie Maker Guh (Nether Mikas trade string for a wahoog chonk ingot)
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.draad_t: I see %s of the %s string. No thread, no plushie, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.klaar: Stitch, stitch, done! As good as new. You know what? You take three with you, I've got plenty more in my head. And here is my plushie pattern: with it you can sew them yourself, as many as you like. I'll stay a little longer. The Mikas need something to cuddle TOO. Them most of all.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.bedankt: Ever since you came by, I've been secretly sewing little ears onto all the Mika socks. They haven't noticed a thing, nyeg.
A plushie is only finished when it looks a little lopsided. That's not a mistake, that's personality.
Big Nether Mika? Never seen him. His throne just sits here, doing nothing. They say he has a castle of his own, in the sauce sea.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.patroon: Lost my pattern? I'll draw a new one in a jiffy. Here, nyeg!
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.optie.w: Why don't you just walk away?
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.naam: The Watch at the Skewer Keep
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.uitleg: The Guard Guh guards the statue in the Skewer Keep, but the bridge fires are out and his little garden is full of Mika Weed.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.stap.3: Weed the little peanut sauce garden
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.0: Talk to the Guard Guh. He stands in his sentry box next to the statue, in the hall of a Skewer Keep.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.0: A Skewer Keep in the Guhbarbecuether (Super Compass: Barbecue)
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.1: On every bridge of the Skewer Keep there's a cold brazier on a pedestal. Right-click all four with the lighting skewer.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.1: The four bridges of the Skewer Keep
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.2: The fires are burning! Go back to the Guard Guh in the hall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.2: The hall of the Skewer Keep (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.3: Pull the clumps of Mika Weed out of the little peanut sauce garden: click on them. The garden is one staircase up, in the middle of the keep.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.3: The little peanut sauce garden of the Skewer Keep
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.4: Everything is tidy again. Go back to the Guard Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.4: The hall of the Skewer Keep (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.klaar: The fires are burning and the garden is tidy. You're an honorary guard, nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.klaar: The hall of the Skewer Keep (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.uitleg: The Mikas of the grill palace took the Plushie Maker Guh along, AND all his plushies.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.nu.0: Talk to the captured Plushie Maker Guh. He sits in his sewing corner, one floor up in a Mika Grill Palace.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.waar.0: A Mika Grill Palace in the Guhbarbecuether (Super Compass: Barbecue)
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.nu.1: Open the three cages: pay one wahoog chonk per cage, or sneak (crouch) and fiddle the lock open while no Mika is looking.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.waar.1: One floor up in the Mika Grill Palace (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.nu.2: The plushies have been tugged apart. Bring string to the Plushie Maker Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.waar.2: The sewing corner in the Mika Grill Palace
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.nu.klaar: The plushies are free and whole again. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.waar.klaa: One floor up in the Mika Grill Palace (Guhbarbecuether)
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.bestaand_: Relight all four bridge fires of a Skewer Keep
Help the Guard Guh of the Skewer Keep: four fires lit, garden tidy
Fiddle a plushie cage open without a Nether Mika seeing it
Free the stolen plushies for the Plushie Maker Guh in the Mika Grill Palace
structure.guhs.fossiel_opgraving.tooltip: A dig with the skeleton of a giant guh, and the Archaeologist Guh (Guhbarbecuether)
structure.guhs.zoutkristalmijn.tooltip: A mountain of salt with a mine inside: this is where the crystal vein is, and the Mineworker Guh (Guhbarbecuether)
item.guhs.zoutkristal.lore: Pink, grainy and nice and savory. You use it to make the clever machines of Guh Technology.
block.guhs.fossielmijn_fossielbeeldje.lo: Tyrannoguhrus Nyex, the king of the nibblers. Millions of years old and still peckish.
item.guhs.fossielmijn_fossielbeeldje.lor: Tyrannoguhrus Nyex, the king of the nibblers. Millions of years old and still peckish.
item.guhs.fossielmijn_bot_schedel.lore: Belongs on the rack at the Fossil Dig
item.guhs.fossielmijn_bot_ruggengraat.lo: Belongs on the rack at the Fossil Dig
item.guhs.fossielmijn_bot_ribben.lore: Belongs on the rack at the Fossil Dig
item.guhs.fossielmijn_bot_pootjes.lore: Belongs on the rack at the Fossil Dig
item.guhs.fossielmijn_bot_staart.lore: Belongs on the rack at the Fossil Dig
item.guhs.fossielmijn_kwastje.lore: Hold right-click on bone sand. Every day there's something new in the sand again, nyeg!
item.guhs.fossielmijn_zoutkristalhouweel: Chips twice as much salt out of the crystal vein
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.eerst_praten: First ask the Archaeologist Guh what you're allowed to do here, nyeg
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.alle_botten: That's all five of them! Put them on the rack under the little roof
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.gekwast: You've already dusted here. Look for another patch of bone sand, nyeg
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.dag_leeg: This patch is empty for today. Tomorrow there'll be something again, nyeg
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.rek.leeg: An empty rack. The Archaeologist Guh surely knows more about it
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.rek.geen: This is where the Tyrannoguhrus Nyex goes. You're not carrying a bone right now that still needs to go on
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.rek.af: It's standing! Tell the Archaeologist Guh. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.rek.klaar: Your Tyrannoguhrus Nyex. Just look at those little ears!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.hallo1: Nyeg! Careful where you step! Here lies the find of the century: a real Tyrannoguhrus Nyex!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.hallo2: The big one stays where it is, but there's a little one left in the bone sand. Here, a Guh Dusting Brush: dust five bones loose for me!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.kwast_: Lost your brush? Nyeg nyeg. Here's a new one. Don't eat it!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.zoek: You have %s of the 5 bones. Look for the bone sand in the pit: there's a little tip of bone sticking out of the ash.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.bouw: Wahoog, all five! Now put them on the rack under the little roof. There are %s of the 5 on it.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.bot_we: Did you lose a bone? Luckily I had a plaster cast of it. Here!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.klaar1: WAHOOG! It's standing! Just look at that: those little ears, those little teeth... Tyrannoguhrus Nyex, the king of the nibblers!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.klaar2: This statuette is for you. And go ahead and keep the brush: every day there's something new in the bone sand again.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.tip0: With its stubby little legs the Tyrannoguhrus couldn't reach its own nibbles. That's why it went extinct. I think. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.tip1: Every day the ash pushes up something new. Feel free to come dusting!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.tip2: I'm still looking for a Guhceratops. See a bone with three little horns? Give me a shout!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.tip3: No nibbling on the finds. That goes for me too. Especially for me.
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.puin_klaar: The track is clear! Follow it to the cave with the crystal vein
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.ader.eerst: The Mineworker Guh wants the track cleared first, nyeg
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.ader.houweel: You need a pickaxe for that
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.ader.gevonden: The crystal vein! Wahoog! Bring the Mineworker Guh three salt crystals
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.ader.hak: +%s salt crystal (%s left in the vein for you)
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.ader.op: The vein has run out for you for now. Salt grows back by itself: come back later, nyeg
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.beloning.ader: The crystal vein: your very own supply of salt, which always grows back
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.hallo1: Nyeg, what a rubbly mess! The roof came down and now my whole cart track is covered in rubble.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.hallo2: My back has called it quits. Will you chip five chunks of rubble off the track? Then I'll tell you where the salt is!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.puin: Still %s chunks of rubble. They're on the track, in the tunnels of the mountain. Get chipping! Did somebody else just clear the track? Wait a minute, nyeg: the roof keeps crumbling.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.ader: Wahoog, the track is clear! Follow it all the way into the cave at the end: that's where the crystal vein is. Go on, give it a whack!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.breng: You found the vein! Bring me three salt crystals for my sandwich. You have %s right now.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.klaar1: Mmm, salt! Without salt a nibble tastes like nothing at all. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.klaar2: This Salt Crystal Pickaxe is for you: it chips out twice as much. And the vein? It always grows back. Chip away!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.voorra: The vein has %s crystals ready for you right now. Salt grows back by itself, nyeg.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.tip0: No salt, no flavor. No flavor, no guh. It's that simple.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.tip1: With salt crystal you make clever things: tubes, sensors, a Nom Hatch... Just ask the Inventor Guh.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.tip2: Salt crystal ore also just sits in the rocks around here. But only where nobody has ever been before, nyeg.
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.commando.stand: Fossil mine of %s: bones found %s, on the rack %s, rubble %s, salt in the vein %s
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.uitleg: The Archaeologist Guh has made the find of the century. But the little skeleton is still lying in pieces in the bone sand.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.stap.3: Show it to the Archaeologist Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.nu.0: Find the Fossil Dig and talk to the Archaeologist Guh by his tent.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.waar.0: The Fossil Dig in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.nu.1: With the Guh Dusting Brush, hold right-click on the bone sand in the pit until you have five bones.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.waar.1: The pit of the Fossil Dig
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.nu.2: Click the rack under the little roof with the bones.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.waar.2: The rack at the Fossil Dig
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.nu.3: Tell the Archaeologist Guh that the Tyrannoguhrus is standing.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.nu.klaar: The Tyrannoguhrus Nyex is standing! Every day there's something new in the bone sand to dust loose.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.waar.klaar: The Fossil Dig in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.kort.1: Dust five bones loose from the bone sand
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.kort.2: Put the bones on the rack
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.uitleg: The cart track of the Salt Crystal Mine is covered in rubble, and the Mineworker Guh hasn't had salt on his sandwich for days.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.nu.0: Find the Salt Crystal Mine and talk to the Mineworker Guh by his little shed.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.waar.0: The Salt Crystal Mine in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.nu.1: Chip five chunks of rubble off the track in the tunnels of the mine.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.waar.1: The tunnels of the Salt Crystal Mine
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.nu.2: Follow the track all the way into the cave and use a pickaxe on the pink crystal vein.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.waar.2: The cave at the end of the track
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.nu.3: Bring three salt crystals to the Mineworker Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.waar.3: The little shed by the mine
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.nu.klaar: The crystal vein is yours: it always grows back. With salt crystal you make the clever machines of Guh Technology.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.waar.klaar: The Salt Crystal Mine in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.kort.1: Chip five chunks of rubble off the track
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.kort.2: Mine the crystal vein in the cave
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.kort.3: Bring three salt crystals to the Mineworker Guh
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.fossiel_m: Dust the bones loose and put the skeleton together at the Archaeologist Guh's
Clear the cart track and find the Mineworker Guh's crystal vein
Find salt crystal: in the crystal vein of the Salt Crystal Mine or in salt crystal ore
structure.guhs.sausloper_stal.tooltip: The stable of the Sauce Striders, with the Caretaker Guh and a test ride through the sauce basin (Guhbarbecuether)
item.guhs.blubroom.lore: A warm dollop from a happy Sauce Blubby. For the Guh Brewing Cauldron, and for saucy inventions
item.guhs.sausblubje_potje.lore: It blubs happily against the glass. Nyeg
item.guhs.sausblubje_potje.tooltip: Right-click a block to set it free again
item.guhs.sausdieren_pindasaus_stok.lore: A Sauce Strider trots after it, all wahoog. Right-click while riding for a little sprint
item.guhs.guhdrankje.blubroom.lore: Cheese broth with blub cream. You don't fall anymore, you bounce. Boing, nyeg!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.blijft: %s waits here like a good boy
gui.guhs.sausdieren.leen_ander: This Sauce Strider is waiting for somebody else. Ask the Caretaker Guh for a test ride of your own
gui.guhs.sausdieren.stok_nodig: Hold Peanut Sauce on a Stick: he walks wherever you look
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_bewoner: %s sniffs your hand. Got any peanut sprouts on you?
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_leen: %s is ready for your test ride. Hop on!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_tam: %s wags his curly little tail. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_zadel: %s is yours. Put a saddle on him and you can ride
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_wild: %s gives you a shy look. He wouldn't say no to peanut sprouts
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_onbekend: %s doesn't know you yet. The Caretaker Guh at the Sauce Strider Stable will teach you how it's done
gui.guhs.sausdieren.eerst_stal: %s sniffs, but doesn't dare. First learn how to make friends from the Caretaker Guh at the Sauce Strider Stable
gui.guhs.sausdieren.getemd: %s is now your very own Sauce Strider! Put a saddle on him
gui.guhs.sausdieren.niet_slaan: Nyeg! You don't bonk a Sauce Strider, you pet him
gui.guhs.sausdieren.njam: Nom! The Sauce Strider munches happily
gui.guhs.sausdieren.te_groot_voor_potje: %s doesn't fit in your bottle. Only a small blubby fits
gui.guhs.sausdieren.gegroeid: %s grew a size from all those nibbles. Blub!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.nog_voer: Blub! %s more nibble(s) and it grows a size
gui.guhs.sausdieren.knuffel_klein: %s blubs with joy. It doesn't get any smaller than this
gui.guhs.sausdieren.gesplitst: Blub blub! %s splits with joy and leaves blub cream behind
gui.guhs.sausdieren.niet_slaan_blubje: Nyeg! You don't bonk a Sauce Blubby, you cuddle it
gui.guhs.sausdieren.poortje: Gate %s of %s: follow the little stars
gui.guhs.sausdieren.stap_op: Hop on your Sauce Strider (right-click) for gate %s of %s
gui.guhs.sausdieren.te_ver: Whoa whoa, he can't go that far from the stable. Back to the start!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.rondje_klaar: Your test lap is done in %s seconds. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.rondje_record: A lap in %s seconds: your fastest so far. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.optie.uitleg: How do I tame one myself?
gui.guhs.sausdieren.optie.blubje: Do you have a Sauce Blubby for me?
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.hallo: Nyeg! Welcome to the Sauce Strider Stable. My striders step through the frying sauce all day long, because on dry land they get cold little feet. Want to learn how to make friends with them? Then later you can tame one yourself.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.lok: Here, Peanut Sauce on a Stick. They trot after it, all wahoog. Go on, lure one out of the sauce basin over to me!
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.stok_kwi: Lost your stick? Licked it clean, I bet. Here's a new one, nyeg.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.gelokt: Look at him step! And see him shiver? That's the cold. Come on, let's warm him up from the inside.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.voer: Friendship goes through the tummy. Here are three peanut sprouts: feed them to a Sauce Strider from the stable.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.voer_nog: %s more peanut sprout(s) and he trusts you. Feed them to a Sauce Strider here in the stable, nyeg.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.voer_kwi: Out of sprouts? Gobbled them up yourself, I bet, nyeg. Here are %s more. But these really are for the Sauce Strider!
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.proefrit: He trusts you! Time for a test lap through the sauce basin: through the four gates, ending at the checkered finish. Hold on tight to your stick, he walks wherever you look.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.start: Fweet-fwee! There's your Sauce Strider, by the dock. Hop on and follow the little stars. No rush, he can't tip over.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.start_op: Fweet-fwee! There he is again. I'll time your lap, nyeg.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.klaar: What a ride! You're a real Sauce Strider Friend now. Here's a saddle, and some peanut sprouts for the road. The wild striders on the sauce sea will dare to come up to you now, too.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.na: Nyeg, there's my best student! Fancy a lap through the sauce basin? I'll time you.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.uitleg: Find a wild Sauce Strider on the frying sauce sea and feed him peanut sprouts until he gives hearts. Saddle on, stick in your hand and off you ride. Sneak and click to make him wait. And don't leave him standing on dry land too long!
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.blubje: A blubby? They bounce between my little legs all day long here. Here, one in a jar. Set it free at home, give it three cheese nibbles and it grows. Then one cuddle and you have two, with a dollop of blub cream on the side. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.blubje_h: You've still got one sitting in a jar, nyeg. Set that one free first.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.blubje_m: You already got one from me today. Tomorrow a new blubby is sure to bounce into the stable.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.lok: lure a Sauce Strider to the Caretaker Guh with the Peanut Sauce on a Stick
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.gelokt: ask the Caretaker Guh what a Sauce Strider likes to eat
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.voer: feed a Sauce Strider from the stable three peanut sprouts
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.nog_voer: one more peanut sprout for the Sauce Strider
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.vertrouwt: ask the Caretaker Guh for your test ride
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.proefrit: hop on at the dock, hold the stick and ride through the four gates
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.terug: pick up your saddle from the Caretaker Guh
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.klaar: tame a wild Sauce Strider on the frying sauce sea with peanut sprouts
subtitles.guhs.sausdieren.sausloper.stap: Sauce Strider steps through the sauce
subtitles.guhs.sausdieren.potje: Sauce Blubby hops into or out of a jar

Tame a wild Sauce Strider on the frying sauce sea
Ride the lap through the sauce basin in thirty seconds or less
Cuddle or feed a Sauce Blubby until it splits and leaves blub cream behind
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.uitleg: The Caretaker Guh teaches you luring, feeding and riding. After that you can tame a wild Sauce Strider yourself.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.nu.0: Talk to the Caretaker Guh. He'll teach you all about Sauce Striders.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.waar.0: The Sauce Strider Stable in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.nu.1: Hold the Peanut Sauce on a Stick and lure a Sauce Strider to the Caretaker Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.waar.1: The sauce basin of the Sauce Strider Stable
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.nu.2: Feed a Sauce Strider from the stable three peanut sprouts.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.waar.2: The sauce basin of the Sauce Strider Stable
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.nu.3: Ask the Caretaker Guh for your test ride, hop on at the dock and ride through the four gates.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.waar.3: The sauce basin of the Sauce Strider Stable
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.nu.4: Go back to the Caretaker Guh. He has a saddle for you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.waar.4: The Sauce Strider Stable in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.nu.klaar: You're a Sauce Strider Friend. Tame a wild Sauce Strider on the frying sauce sea, or ride another timed lap.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sausloper.waar.klaar: The frying sauce sea of the Guhbarbecuether

structure.guhs.grillcamping.tooltip: A tent village of guhs around a big campfire, with the Camp Boss Guh and the Lumberjack Guh (Guhbarbecuether)
structure.guhs.mika_ruilmarkt.tooltip: The market of the Nether Mikas: stalls around the Weigh House, with the Market Master Mika (Guhbarbecuether)
block.guhs.campingmarkt_kampvuur.lore: Light it with a flint and steel, put it out with a shovel. Marshmallows go with it, nyeg!
item.guhs.campingmarkt_kampvuur.lore: Light it with a flint and steel, put it out with a shovel. Marshmallows go with it, nyeg!
block.guhs.campingmarkt_weegschaal.lore: Click it: it weighs what you hold in your two hands. The fullest hand is the heaviest.
item.guhs.campingmarkt_weegschaal.lore: Click it: it weighs what you hold in your two hands. The fullest hand is the heaviest.
item.guhs.campingmarkt_tentzak.lore: Click a green VRIJ (vacant) sign at the Grill Campground with it: flomp, a tent!
item.guhs.campingmarkt_brandhout.lore: Chopped it yourself. Belongs on the big campfire of the Grill Campground
item.guhs.campingmarkt_roosterstok.lore: Hold right-click on a burning campfire and let go when the marshmallow is golden brown
item.guhs.campingmarkt_roosterstok.lore2: Too early is cold, too late is black. You need marshmallow nibbles. Nyeg!
item.guhs.campingmarkt_recept_plantageba: From the Camp Boss Guh: this is how you grow your own firewood in a box
Simply stays in your crafting table when you make a Plantation Box. Nyeg!
item.guhs.campingmarkt_keurstempel.lore: Click the stack of chonk you think is fake with it. Weigh first!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.eerst_praten: This spot is vacant. Ask the Camp Boss Guh at the reception for a tent bag, nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.geen_zak: You don't have a tent bag on you. The Camp Boss Guh has another one
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.bezet: A tent just went up here. Find another green VRIJ sign (or wait a moment)
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.haringen: Your tent is already up! Hammer in the stakes: click the iron pegs
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.tent: What a cozy little tent, nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.klaar: Everyone pitches their own tent here. Yours was here already. Nyeg, what a beauty it was!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.geen_ruimte: Something is in the way on this spot
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.staat: Flomp! Your tent is up. Now hammer in the four stakes (click them)
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.haring.eerst_tent: Pitch your own tent first: click a green VRIJ sign with the tent bag
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.haring.klaar: Four stakes in: your tent stands solid as a rock. Wahoog! Now off to the Lumberjack Guh
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.hak.eerst_praten: First ask the Lumberjack Guh if you may chop, nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.hak.klaar: Six logs! You get a bundle of firewood: toss it on the big campfire
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.hout_later: This wood is for the campfire party. Not just yet, nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.feest: WHOOSH! The campfire is burning and the party begins. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.opgepookt: You poke up the fire: it's burning nicely again
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.hout_in_hand: Hold the Lumberjack Guh's firewood in your hand and click the fire
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.uit: The campfire is out. No wood, no party, nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.warm: Nice and warm by the fire. Nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.geen_vuur: Hold the stick over a burning campfire (hold right-click)
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.geen_marshmal: There's no marshmallow on your stick. You need marshmallow nibbles
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.vuur_weg: You're too far from the fire
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.koud: Still cold. Hold it over the fire a bit longer
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.bijna: Almost! Not quite golden brown yet. A little longer
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.verkoold: Nyeg, burnt to a crisp! You wipe the stick clean: just try again
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.goud: Mmm, golden brown and sticky. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.goud_klaar: Three golden brown marshmallows! Go tell the Camp Boss Guh
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.nodig.hout: Logs chopped on the chopping block
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.beloning.pakje: The camping outfit: hat, scout neckerchief and backpack
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.beloning.extraatje: A little extra with every trade with a Nether Mika
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.weegschaal.leeg: Put something in your hands: your main hand is the left pan, your other hand the right one
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.weegschaal.midden: Exactly the same weight: %s against %s. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.eerst_afdin: Paws off! First ask the Market Master Mika what's going on here
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.klaar: Real chonk. All of it. The Market Master is keeping a close eye on them now
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.eerst_wegen: Weigh first, stamp after! Click two stacks (without the seal)
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.echt: Stack %s is real chonk! The trickster quickly shuffles the stacks: weigh again
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.ontmaskerd: FAKE! Stack %s is a cheese nibble in purple paper. Go tell the Market Master!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.links: Stack %s is on the left pan. Click another stack for the right pan
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.terug: Stack %s comes off the scale again
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.weeg.links: The scale tips to the left: stack %s is heavier than stack %s
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.weeg.rechts: The scale tips to the right: stack %s is lighter than stack %s
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.weeg.midden: The scale stays level: stack %s and stack %s weigh the same
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.schaal.uitleg: Click two stacks of chonk on the counter to weigh them. Then stamp the fake one
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.ruil.extraatje: The Market Master knows you: you get a little extra!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.ruil.kraam: Sold! Here comes your surprise. Meow!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.commando.stand: Camping-market of %s: campground step %s (stakes %s, wood %s, roasted %s), barter market step %s (fake %s, weighings %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.hallo1: Nyeg! Welcome to Grill Campground The Glowing Guh! Nice and warm, huh? Underfloor heating from the whole Barbecuether.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.hallo2: Whoever wants to stay here pitches their own tent. Here's a tent bag: find a green VRIJ sign (that means vacant) on the yellow grass by the gate and click it!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tentzak: Lost your tent bag? Nyeg nyeg. I had one more under the desk. Here!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tent: Find a green VRIJ sign (the yellow grass by the gate) and click it with the tent bag. All taken? Wait a moment: tents pack themselves back into the bag.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.haringe: Your tent is up! Now hammer in %s more stakes: click the iron pegs at the corners of your tent.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.hout: Lovely tent! Now for a campfire party. But no wood, no fire: ask the Lumberjack Guh at the woodshed for firewood.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.vuur: Got the firewood? Toss it on the big campfire in the middle. Then the party begins, wahoog!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.stok: What a party! Now for the yummiest part: marshmallows. Here's my Roasting Stick and a little bag of marshmallows. Roast %s of them golden brown!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.stok_ui: Hold right-click on the burning campfire and let go when it's GOLDEN BROWN. Too early is cold, too late is black. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.marshma: Out of marshmallows? Here are four more. %s more golden brown ones to go!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.rooster: %s more golden brown marshmallows! Has the fire gone out? Click it and you'll poke it right back up.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.klaar1: Three golden brown ones! You're a real camper guh. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.klaar2: This is for you: the camping outfit for your guh, and my recipe card for the Plantation Box. That's where I grow my own firewood!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.recept_: Lost your recipe card? Good thing I traced a copy. Here, nyeg!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tip0: With the Roasting Stick you can roast marshmallows anywhere: over any burning campfire, even during the day.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tip1: With tent canvas you can build your own tent at home. The sloped pieces are the roof, nyeg.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tip2: A Plantation Box needs chonk power. Just ask the Inventor Guh in the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant how that works.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tip3: Rule one of the campground: last one awake makes the coffee. Rule two: I'm never the last one awake.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.te_vr: Chop! Chop! ...Oh, hello. I'm busy chopping. Go see the Camp Boss Guh first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.hallo: Firewood for the campfire? I've got that! ...in whole logs. And my pawsies are tired from chopping.
Will you chop six logs on my chopping block? Just click it: chop! Then I'll tie them into a nice bundle.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.nog: %s more logs! Chop chop. Mind your own tail.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.hout_: Lost your bundle of wood? How do you even lose a bundle of wood... Here, a new one.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.naar_: There's your bundle of firewood! Go go, off to the big campfire with it.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.tip0: Satay wood burns the best. Sausage wood smells the best. Spruce wood is just wood.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.tip1: I've been chopping my whole life. Bonked my thumb exactly once. Been wearing a cap ever since. Doesn't help a bit, but it looks good.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.tip2: Want a chopping block at home too? An axe on a log, done. Chop!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.tip3: The Camp Boss Guh grows his wood in a box. A BOX! That's no forest in my book, nyeg.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.tent: Click a green VRIJ (vacant) sign by the campground gate with the tent bag
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.hak: Click a chopping block at the woodshed six times
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.marshmallow: Get the Roasting Stick from the Camp Boss Guh
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.rooster: Roast three marshmallows golden brown over the big campfire
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.kampbaas: Tell the Camp Boss Guh at the reception
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.afdingen: Talk to the Market Master Mika and haggle: a compliment when he brags, a low offer when he sighs, walk away when he growls
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.wegen: Weigh the five stacks of chonk in the Weigh House (click two stacks) and stamp the lightest one
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.0: Nyeg! Camping is the best thing there is. Especially the food.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.1: My air mattress has a leak. Luckily I'm pretty soft myself.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.2: Are you in the mood for marshmallows too? I'm ALWAYS in the mood for marshmallows.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.3: The Camp Boss Guh whistles every morning at six o'clock. Nobody knows why.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.4: Last night I heard rustling by my tent. It was my own tummy.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.5: When the campfire is burning, we all start dancing. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.hal: Meow! Welcome to the Nether Mika Barter Market. I am the Market Master. No touching the chonk ingots!
Somebody here is paying with FAKE CHONK. Will you help me look? Then first you need to know how to haggle, or the whole market will laugh at you. Talk to me again!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.gel: That's how it's done! When a Mika brags: give a compliment. When he sighs: offer low. When he growls: walk away. Remember that, meow.
Here is my Seal of Approval. In the Weigh House there are five stacks of chonk: one is fake, and fake chonk is LIGHTER. Weigh them and stamp the fake one!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.wee: In the Weigh House, click two stacks: the scale shows which one is lighter. Are you sure? Then click the fake stack with the Seal of Approval.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.ste: Lost your seal? Meow meow. Here's a new one. Don't stamp your forehead!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.kla: FAKE! A cheese nibble in purple paper! That's the work of my little nephew Smikkel... he ate the real ingot. I'll deal with it.
You get this scale. And I'll spread the word: from now on every Nether Mika gives you a little extra when you trade. Meow!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.koo: Meow, there's my best haggler! I've got a deal of the day. Win the haggling and it's yours. Or are you here for my little shop?
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.opt: Haggle for the deal of the day!
Go on, show me your little shop
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.koo: Sold! The deal of the day is yours. Tomorrow I'll have a new one, meow.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.tip: On my market the stall Mikas trade right away: a wahoog chonk ingot in, a surprise out. No sniffing it over first.
Real chonk is heavy. As heavy as a chonky guh after breakfast. Fake chonk weighs nothing, meow.
Every day I have one deal for whoever haggles well. You've already had today's. Come back tomorrow!
My little nephew Smikkel now has to sweep the market for a whole week. With his tail.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.begin.0: Just look at it, what a market! Built it with my own paws, the prettiest in the whole Barbecuether. A market permit costs %s nibbles. (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.begin.1: Sigh... so quiet today. Nobody's buying anything. A market permit costs %s nibbles. Or... oh well. (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.begin.2: Grrr! %s nibbles for a market permit. That's my final offer! Really! My very, very last! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.goed.0: Hmph, well played. %s nibbles then. And do you see my hat? The tallest hat on the market, picked it out myself! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.goed.1: Meow, clever. %s nibbles then. Sigh... and I still have seven little Mikas to feed. Seven! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.goed.2: Fine, %s nibbles. But I am NOT going any lower! Never! This really is my final offer! Grrr! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.fout.0: No no, that's not how it works! It stays %s. I'm the boss of the prettiest market there is, you know! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.fout.1: Wrong guess. It stays %s. Sigh... what a day. And my pawsies are so sore too. (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.fout.2: Miss! It stays %s nibbles. Grrr, my final offer, and I'm sticking to it! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.gewonne: %s nibbles?! Meow... sold. You know what: for such a good haggler it's free. You've got the knack!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.weggest: SHOO! I'm out of patience! ...Come back in a bit and we'll just start over. Meow.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.0.0: Meow! Fresh satay, picked just this morning! For one wahoog chonk ingot you get a surprise.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.0.1: No tasting. Sniffing is fine. Sniffing is free. For now.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.0.2: Got wahoog chonk on you? Just hold it up and we'll do business!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.1.0: Chonk! Real chonk! Heavy chonk! No fakes at my stall, just ask the Market Master.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.1.1: A chonk ingot in, a surprise out. That's how trading works, meow.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.1.2: Don't blow out the candles. They're for the mood.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.2.0: Glowing embers! Grill coal! Everything nice and warm. Don't put it in your pocket.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.2.1: For one wahoog chonk ingot you may dig around in my surprise bag.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.2.2: My stall is the warmest on the whole market. That's not an ad, that's a warning.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.uitleg: At the Grill Campground, guhs live in little tents around a big campfire. Whoever wants to stay pitches their own tent.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.stap.0: Talk to the Camp Boss Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.0: Find the Grill Campground and talk to the Camp Boss Guh at the reception.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.0: The Grill Campground in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.1: Click a green VRIJ (vacant) sign with the tent bag and hammer in the four stakes of your tent (click the iron pegs).
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.1: The campsites by the gate of the Grill Campground
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.2: Ask the Lumberjack Guh for firewood and chop six logs on his chopping block.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.2: The woodshed of the Grill Campground
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.3: Toss the bundle of firewood on the big campfire.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.3: The big campfire, in the middle of the Grill Campground
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.4: Get the Roasting Stick from the Camp Boss Guh, roast three marshmallows golden brown over the campfire and tell him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.4: The big campfire of the Grill Campground
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.klaar: You're a real camper guh! With the Roasting Stick you can roast marshmallows anywhere, and with the recipe card you can make a Plantation Box.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.klaar: The Grill Campground in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.kort.0: Talk to the Camp Boss Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.kort.1: Pitch your tent and hammer in the four stakes
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.kort.2: Chop six logs at the Lumberjack Guh's
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.kort.3: Toss the firewood on the big campfire
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.naam: The Fake Chonk of the Barter Market
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.uitleg: At the Nether Mika Barter Market somebody is paying with fake chonk. The Market Master Mika is looking for a clever haggler to help him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.stap.0: Talk to the Market Master Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.nu.0: Find the Nether Mika Barter Market and talk to the Market Master Mika in front of the Weigh House.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.waar.0: The Nether Mika Barter Market in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.nu.1: Talk to the Market Master and haggle his price down from 30 to 10 nibbles: a compliment when he brags, a low offer when he sighs, walk away when he growls.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.waar.1: The Market Master Mika, in front of the Weigh House
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.nu.2: Weigh the five stacks of chonk in the Weigh House (click two stacks) and click the stack that is lighter with the Seal of Approval.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.waar.2: The Weigh House, in the middle of the barter market
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.nu.3: Tell the Market Master Mika which stack was fake.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.waar.3: The Market Master Mika, in front of the Weigh House
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.nu.klaar: The fake chonk is unmasked! From now on every Nether Mika gives you a little extra when you trade, and every day you can haggle for the deal of the day.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.waar.klaar: The Nether Mika Barter Market in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.kort.0: Talk to the Market Master Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.kort.1: Haggle with the Market Master Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.kort.2: Weigh the stacks of chonk and stamp the fake one
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.camping_m: Pitch your tent, celebrate the campfire party and roast marshmallows at the Grill Campground
Learn to haggle and unmask the fake chonk at the Nether Mika Barter Market
structure.guhs.rookguh_vuurtoren.tooltip: The lighthouse that shows the Smoke Guhs the way home, with the Lighthouse Keeper Guh (Guhbarbecuether)
structure.guhs.pepertuin.tooltip: A greenhouse full of peppers, with the Pepper Grower Guh and his Guh Brewing Cauldron (Guhbarbecuether)
item.guhs.torenpeper_peperzaadjes.lore: One little plant, three peppers: the soil decides which
Peanut Sauce Nylium: pink Candy Pepper
item.guhs.torenpeper_peperzaadjes.glas: Under glass it grows three times as fast
item.guhs.torenpeper_njegpeper.lore: Green and mild. Well, mild... nyeg
item.guhs.torenpeper_vahoegpeper.lore: Red and hot! Eat it raw at your own risk. For the Pepperfire Potion
item.guhs.torenpeper_snoeppeper.lore: Pink and sweet as a cuddle. For the Peppersweet Potion
item.guhs.guhdrankje.pepervuur.lore: Cheese broth with Wahoog Pepper. You chop and dig like wildfire, with little flames coming out of your snoot. Nyeg!
item.guhs.guhdrankje.peperzoet.lore: Cheese broth with Candy Pepper. Warm and sweet inside: two extra hearts
item.guhs.torenpeper_seinlantaarn.lore: Lost Smoke Guhs follow whoever holds it. Red and white, just like the tower
item.guhs.torenpeper_lampkooltje.lore: Pressed glowcoal dust for the Lighthouse Lamp. Still warm
gui.guhs.torenpeper.lamp.uit: The lamp is out. Ask the Lighthouse Keeper Guh what he needs
gui.guhs.torenpeper.lamp.geen_kooltje: You need a Lamp Ember. The Lighthouse Keeper Guh is sure to have another one
gui.guhs.torenpeper.lamp.aan: Fwoop! The lamp is lit. TOOOOT, there goes the foghorn
gui.guhs.torenpeper.lamp.brandt_zoek: The lamp is lit. Smoke Guhs home: %s of %s
gui.guhs.torenpeper.lamp.brandt: The lamp stays lit as long as you're nearby. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.torenpeper.rookguh.thuis: WAHOOG! Smoke Guh %s of %s is home
gui.guhs.torenpeper.rookguh.van_ander: %s is looking for somebody else's light
gui.guhs.torenpeper.rookguh.volgt: %s follows your Signal Lantern. Just walk to the lighthouse
gui.guhs.torenpeper.rookguh.pak_lantaarn: %s can't see you in the smoke. Hold the Signal Lantern
gui.guhs.torenpeper.heet: HOT! HOT! HOOOOT! Nyeg nyeg nyeg!
gui.guhs.torenpeper.kweek.eerst_praten: This is one of the Pepper Grower Guh's Grow Boxes. Ask him for Pepper Seeds first
gui.guhs.torenpeper.kweek.leeg: An empty Grow Box. Plant a pepper seed in it (hold it in your hand)
gui.guhs.torenpeper.kweek.geplant: Planted! Under glass it's ripe in %s seconds
gui.guhs.torenpeper.kweek.groeit: Your little plant is growing. %s more seconds
gui.guhs.torenpeper.kweek.geplukt: Picked: %s! You get your seed back
gui.guhs.torenpeper.optie.rookguhs: How are the Smoke Guhs doing?
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.hallo: Ahoy, nyeg! I'm the Lighthouse Keeper Guh. See that lamp up there? Out. For weeks. And without light the Smoke Guhs can't find their way home through all that smoke. They just wander around, thin with hunger. Will you help me get the lamp lit again?
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.gruis: Wahoog! The lamp burns on glowcoal. Bring me %s Glowcoal Dust and I'll press it into a Lamp Ember. Glowcoal hangs glowing from the ceiling all over the place here.
You have %s Glowcoal Dust, I need %s for one Lamp Ember. Smash a chunk of glowcoal to bits, nyeg.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.koolt: Look at that, a Lamp Ember! Still warm. Climb into the tower, all the way to the top, and put it in the lamp. And take my Signal Lantern with you: you'll need it later.
Lost your Lamp Ember? Those things do roll off everywhere. Here, I still had one in my sou'wester.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.lamp: The stairs are inside, round and round and round. At the top you put the Lamp Ember in the lamp. I'll stay here, my little legs are too short for all those steps.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.lanta: Lost your Signal Lantern? Without a lantern no Smoke Guh will follow you. Here's my spare, nyeg.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.zoek: It's lit! But the lost Smoke Guhs don't dare come alone. %s are still roaming around the tower. Walk up to them with the Signal Lantern in your paw, and they'll float along behind you until they see the light.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.klaar: All three home, and they've eaten the whole Nibble Trough empty. WAHOOG! Here: a Delivery Guhling Whistle. Those little scooter guhlings listen to it. And this Lighthouse Keeper's Coat is for your guh, so he's a bit of a lighthouse keeper too.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.na: Ahoy, Lamplighter! As long as you're nearby, the lamp stays lit. The Smoke Guhs wave every evening. Well, it's always evening here.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.rookg: Chubby and pink, just as they should be! If you meet another skinny one out in the smoke, give him six cheese nibbles and he'll float straight home.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.fluit: Your whistle is right there in your pocket, nyeg. Have a look.
I already gave you a new whistle today. Tomorrow I'll have carved another one.
Blew away? Whistles do that. Here's a new one, take good care of it!
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.gruis: bring the Lighthouse Keeper Guh four Glowcoal Dust
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.lamp: climb into the lighthouse and put the Lamp Ember in the lamp
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.rookguhs: find the three Lost Smoke Guhs around the tower and bring them to the light with the Signal Lantern
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.allemaal_thui: all the Smoke Guhs are home: go back to the Lighthouse Keeper Guh
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.klaar_toren: put down a Scooter Station and whistle for your Delivery Guhling
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.hallo: Nyeg! Welcome to the Pepper Garden. This is where I grow the only plant that actually likes all that smoke: the pepper. One little plant, three peppers. Which one you get depends on the soil. Want to try it yourself? I have three Grow Boxes waiting for you in the greenhouse.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.kweek: Here are three Pepper Seeds. In the greenhouse there are three Grow Boxes: Ash Dirt, Glowcoal and Peanut Sauce Nylium. Plant a seed in each box. Under glass they're ripe in no time, and your plants really are yours: nobody picks them from under your snoot.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.kweek_n: %s more kind(s) to pick. Ripe peppers hang there bright red, green or pink. Just click the box, nyeg.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.zaadjes: Out of seeds? Ate them, I bet. They don't even taste good! Here, new ones. These go in the Grow Box.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.brouw: Three kinds, right the first time! Now for the real work: pepper potion. Here's a pinch of Grill Skewer Powder, a Bucket of Cheese Sauce and three bottles. My Guh Brewing Cauldron is at the back of the greenhouse. Fire it up, pour in the sauce, stir in a Wahoog Pepper or a Candy Pepper and tap a bottle. Green Nyeg Peppers are for nibbling, not for brewing.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.brouw_n: The cauldron is at the back of the greenhouse. Powder in, cheese sauce in, stir in a red or pink pepper, let it bubble a bit and then fill a bottle. I want a taste, nyeg!
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.brouw_w: Out of powder and no sauce left? Well, my cauldron belongs to everyone: whoever stirs first, brews. Here, a fresh pinch of Grill Skewer Powder and a new Bucket of Cheese Sauce. As soon as YOUR pepper goes in, it counts for you, nyeg.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.peper_o: No red or pink pepper left? Here's a seed. Plant it in the box with Glowcoal or Peanut Sauce Nylium: your Grow Boxes stay yours.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.klaar: Let me have a sniff... Ooh. OOH. That's a good one! You're a real Pepper Brewer. Here: a bag of seeds for home, a bottle of the other potion and a Pepper Garland for your guh. On Ash Dirt they grow anywhere, but under glass it goes three times as fast.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.na: There's my best student! Your Grow Boxes are always ready for you. And feel free to pick a pepper from the display beds, that's what they're there for.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.uitleg: Ash Dirt: the green Nyeg Pepper, nice and mild. Glowcoal: the red Wahoog Pepper, hot! That one goes in the Pepperfire Potion. Peanut Sauce Nylium: the pink Candy Pepper, sweet. That one goes in the Peppersweet Potion. Put glass above them and they grow three times as fast. Ripe? Right-click to pick, and the plant just keeps on growing.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.zaadjes: You still have seeds in your pocket, nyeg. Those will do just fine.
You already got seeds from me today. Tomorrow I'll have dried some new ones.
All out of seeds? Here are two. Tip: if you dig up a ripe plant instead of picking it, you get extra seeds.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.kweek: plant a pepper seed in each of the three Grow Boxes in the greenhouse and pick the ripe peppers
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.nog_plukken: another pepper picked: now the other Grow Boxes
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.geplukt: you've grown all three peppers: go back to the Pepper Grower Guh
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.brouw: brew a pepper potion in the Guh Brewing Cauldron at the back of the greenhouse
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.gebrouwen: your first pepper potion! Let the Pepper Grower Guh have a taste
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.borrelt: your pepper is bubbling in the cauldron: fill a bottle in a moment and go back to the Pepper Grower Guh
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.klaar_tuin: plant your Pepper Seeds at home on Ash Dirt, Glowcoal or Peanut Sauce Nylium, preferably under glass
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.toren_pep: Light the lamp of the Smoke Guh Lighthouse and bring three Lost Smoke Guhs home
Grow the three peppers in the greenhouse of the Pepper Garden and brew your first pepper potion
Eat a raw Wahoog Pepper. Nobody said it was smart
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.uitleg: The lighthouse lamp is out, and the Smoke Guhs can't find their way home anymore. Light it and bring three Lost Smoke Guhs to the light.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.stap.0: Talk to the Lighthouse Keeper Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.stap.4: Back to the Lighthouse Keeper Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.nu.0: Talk to the Lighthouse Keeper Guh. His lamp is out.
