gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.waar.0: The Smoke Guh Lighthouse in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.nu.1: Bring the Lighthouse Keeper Guh four Glowcoal Dust. He'll press it into a Lamp Ember.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.waar.1: Glowcoal hangs from the ceilings of the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.nu.2: Climb the spiral staircase and put the Lamp Ember in the lamp.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.waar.2: At the top of the Smoke Guh Lighthouse
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.nu.3: Find the Lost Smoke Guhs around the tower. With the Signal Lantern in your paw they'll follow you to the light.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.nu.4: All the Smoke Guhs are home. The Lighthouse Keeper Guh has something for you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.waar.4: The Smoke Guh Lighthouse in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.nu.klaar: The lamp stays lit as long as you're nearby, and the Smoke Guhs are home. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.kort.0: Talk to the Lighthouse Keeper Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.kort.3: Bring three Lost Smoke Guhs to the light
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtoren.kort.4: Go back to the Lighthouse Keeper Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.uitleg: The Pepper Grower Guh teaches you to grow peppers: one little plant, three peppers. And what to brew with them.
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.stap.0: Talk to the Pepper Grower Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.stap.3: Let the Pepper Grower Guh have a taste
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.nu.0: Talk to the Pepper Grower Guh. He has seeds for you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.waar.0: The Pepper Garden in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.nu.1: Plant a seed in each of the three Grow Boxes in the greenhouse and pick the ripe peppers.
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.waar.1: The greenhouse of the Pepper Garden
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.nu.2: Stir a Wahoog Pepper or a Candy Pepper into the cheese broth in a Guh Brewing Cauldron and tap a bottle.
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.waar.2: The brewing corner at the back of the greenhouse
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.nu.3: Bring your pepper potion to the Pepper Grower Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.waar.3: The Pepper Garden in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.nu.klaar: You're a Pepper Brewer. Keep growing at home: under glass it goes fastest.
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.waar.klaar: At home, or in the Grow Boxes of the Pepper Garden
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.kort.0: Talk to the Pepper Grower Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.kort.1: Grow the three peppers in the greenhouse
gui.guhs.verhalen.pepertuin.kort.3: Let the Pepper Grower Guh have a taste
item.guhs.knabbelring.lore: One nibble to share them all. It smells delicious. Too delicious, nyeg.
item.guhs.knabbelring.lore2: Right-click: put it on or take it off. On: Mikas can't see you.
item.guhs.knabbelring.lore3: But the Eye DOES see you, and in the Guhbarbecuether the Nine will come.
quest.guhs.ring.om: You put on the Nibble Ring. Nobody can see you... except the Eye.
quest.guhs.ring.af: You take off the Nibble Ring. Phew.
quest.guhs.ring.om.spel: Not during a game, nyeg: here the ring stays in your pocket.
quest.guhs.ring.portaal_dicht: Guhdalf has switched off this teleportation magic. Maybe you could help him by taking a ring along, since you're going on a journey anyway?
quest.guhs.ring.portaal_open: Guhdalf has switched the teleportation magic of the grill portal back on. For you, nyeg. The journey can begin!
quest.guhs.ring.wegwijs: Your story has begun! In the top left you can always see what to do. Your Journey Map is in the Guhdex (Tales tab), the Super Compass points to 'My Story' and Sam-guh always knows the way. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.ring.beloning: The Nibble Ring has been fried and shared. You are now a Ring-Bearer! Sam-guh wants to come home with you (click him) and Smikagol will go fishing for you. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.ring.trek.0: The ring whispers: eat me... just one little bite... nobody's looking...
quest.guhs.ring.trek.1: The ring suddenly smells like melted cheese. It's doing that on purpose.
quest.guhs.ring.trek.2: Your tummy rumbles. The ring rumbles back.
quest.guhs.ring.trek.3: The ring whispers: I'm crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, nyeg...
quest.guhs.ring.trek.4: Was that a crumb? No. The ring doesn't crumble. It's only teasing.
quest.guhs.ring.trek.5: The ring whispers: Guhdalf doesn't need to know...
quest.guhs.ring.trek.6: You accidentally lick your pawsie. It tastes like ring. Wahoog, that's yummy.
quest.guhs.ring.trek.7: The ring gets a little warm in your pocket. It knows you're thinking about it.
quest.guhs.ring.terug.negen: The Nine have caught you! They shove you back to your last rest stop. Don't put that ring on, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.terug.oog: The Eye has spotted you! With a single look you're back at your last rest stop.
quest.guhs.ring.terug.gevallen: Oops. Sam-guh picks you up and puts you back at your last rest stop.
quest.guhs.ring.negen.waarschuwing: It's getting cold... The Eye has spotted you. Take off the ring, quick!
quest.guhs.ring.negen.komen: The Nine are coming! Run, take off the ring or dazzle them with the Light Phial!
quest.guhs.ring.negen.kwijt: The Nine have lost you. They sniff around a bit more and slink off. Phew, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ring.negen.betrapt: A Skelly Mika Rider has spotted you!
quest.guhs.ring.doel.klaar: The journey is done and the ring has been shared. Now it's party time, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ring.doel.niet_begonnen: There's adventure in the air. Find Guhdalf at the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension.
quest.guhs.ring.doel.portaal: For that we have to go through the grill portal first. Your Super Compass points the way.
quest.guhs.ring.doel.hier: We're here: %s. Have a good look around.
quest.guhs.ring.doel.richting: To %1$s: that way, to the %2$s. About %3$s blocks to go.
item.guhs.lichtflesje.lore: The light of Guhladriel's favorite star, in a little phial. Right-click: a flash that blows smoke away and dazzles the Nine.
item.guhs.lichtflesje.lore2: In your hand it's a little lamp that walks along with you.
quest.guhs.ring.lichtflesje.verblind: Flash! The Skelly Mikas can't see a thing for a moment.
item.guhs.elfenmanteltje.lore: A little cloak from the tree guhs. Whoever carries it, sneaks and stands still looks like a rock.
item.guhs.elfenmanteltje.lore2: The Eye and the riders look right past a rock. After the story you also get it as clothes for your guh.
quest.guhs.ring.manteltje.hoe: Sneak and stand very still: then you look like a rock.
quest.guhs.ring.manteltje.rots: You look like a rock. Don't move, nyeg!
item.guhs.elfentouw.lore: Light as a feather and strong as a guh hug. Look at an Elven Rope Hook and right-click: the rope pulls you to it.
item.guhs.elfentouw.lore2: Reaches 24 blocks. Sneak to let go.
quest.guhs.ring.touw.geen_haak: The rope can't find a hook. Look at an Elven Rope Hook (no more than 24 blocks away).
quest.guhs.ring.touw.te_ver: That hook is too far away for the rope.
block.guhs.elfentouw_haak.lore: A little hook for the Elven Rope. Hang it on a wall or a ceiling, or put it on the ground.
item.guhs.elfentouw_haak.lore: A little hook for the Elven Rope. Hang it on a wall or a ceiling, or put it on the ground.
block.guhs.ring_rustvuur.lore: A little cooking fire where travelers rest. It never burns your pawsies.
item.guhs.ring_rustvuur.lore: A little cooking fire where travelers rest. It never burns your pawsies.
quest.guhs.ring.rustpunt.nieuw: Rest stop reached! If you get spotted or caught, you come back here. Sam-guh puts the pan on the fire.
quest.guhs.ring.rustpunt.gezellig: A cozy little cooking fire. This is where travelers rest, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.rustpunt.herinnering: This is where Sam-guh's stew tasted the very best.
quest.guhs.ring.rustpunt.al: The stew still needs to simmer. There'll be more tomorrow.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.praat.0: I'm not going without you, boss. And not without my pans either, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.praat.1: When we get home I'll plant nibble bushes everywhere. All the way to the fence.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.praat.2: Did we bring the salty snacks? Without salt I'm not climbing any mountain.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.praat.3: One paw in front of the other, boss. And a little snack in between.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.praat.4: I don't trust that ring. It's eyeing my sausages.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.eten.0: Garden stew, boss! With extra nibble. Go on, eat up.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.eten.1: It's not much, but it's warm. And there's cheese in it, wahoog.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.eten.2: Po-ta-toes! Boil 'em, mash 'em, stick 'em in a stew. Here, for you.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.pruttelt: The pot still needs to simmer, boss. There'll be another stew tomorrow.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.zwaar: Boss, you're walking all hunched over. Is the ring that heavy? Just click me: I can't carry the ring, but I can carry you, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ring.sam.draag: I can't carry the ring, but I can carry you, nyeg! Hold on to my ears.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.aangekomen: There. From here you're on your own, boss. My pawsies are all wobbly.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.ring_terug: Boss! You dropped the ring. Here. Don't eat it, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.niet_omdoen: Don't put it on, boss! The Eye will see you. Here in the Guhmension you can just about get away with it.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.andere_baas: I belong to another boss, nyeg. I can't leave them all alone.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.getemd: I'm coming home with you, boss. Forever. Do you have a garden there? Wahoog!
item.guhs.ring_vissenbotje.lore: Nibbled clean, right down to the bone. Right-click: your very own Smikagol comes scurrying over.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.niet_van_jou: We don't know you! We belong to another chonkie. Shhhh!
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.gids.0: This way, chonkie! Smikagol knows the way. Nearly always.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.gids.1: Walk softly, chonkie. The Eye has very big ears. No, eyes. One eye.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.gids.2: We look after the chonkie. Very well. May Smikagol see it for a moment? No? Pity.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.gids.3: Don't cross the swamp with your mouth open, chonkie. It tastes like old sauce.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.kom.1: This way, chonkie! Smikagol is waiting. Smikagol doesn't like waiting.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.kom.2: Shhhh! Over here! Before the riders come!
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.blijft: Smikagol stays here. By the water, if we may. Tasty fishesss.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.volgt: Smikagol walks along, chonkie. Behind you. Very close behind you.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.vis: Tasty fishesss! Caught %s. For you, chonkie. Smikagol already sneaked one for himself.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.bijt_nog_niet: They're not biting yet, chonkie. Little fishies are never in a hurry. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.maatje.0: Take Smikagol to water, chonkie. Then we catch fishesss for you.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.maatje.1: We are golden brown and sweet now. Mostly sweet.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.maatje.2: Sneak and click: then Smikagol stays put right where he is. Or walks along again.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.maatje.3: My chonkie... no, OUR chonkie. Sharing is tasty too, we have learned.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.geroepen: Smikagol is already here, chonkie! Did you call? Is there fishesss?
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.geen_maatje: Nobody comes. Smikagol only becomes your buddy after the story of the Nibble Ring.
quest.guhs.ring.feest.nog_niet: The party is waiting for you, once the ring has been shared. Until then we're saving you a piece of cake. A small piece.
quest.guhs.ring.feest.morgen: You've already had today's treat, nyeg. There's another party tomorrow!
quest.guhs.ring.feest.traktatie.0: Party in the Shire! Here, a Party Nibble. One a day, or you'll roll right down the hill.
quest.guhs.ring.feest.traktatie.1: Hip hip, nyeg! A Party Nibble for the Ring-Bearer.
quest.guhs.ring.feest.traktatie.2: There's always something to celebrate. Today: that it's today. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.titels.hint.ringdrager: Bring the Nibble Ring to Mount Fry and share it with everyone
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.voor.0: A wizard is never late, nyeg. Nor is he early. He arrives precisely when there are nibbles.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.voor.1: I'm looking for someone with sturdy pawsies and an empty tummy. No, wait. Definitely NOT an empty tummy. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.reis.0: Fly, you foolish guhs! Well, alright. Just walk calmly. But in the right direction.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.reis.1: Don't eat that ring. Not even a tiny corner. I see everything, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.na.0: Fried and shared. That's how it should be with a nibble, nyeg. I'm proud of you.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.na.1: My fireworks have run out, but my appetite hasn't. Shall we throw another party?
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.voor.0: We wants it... the chonkie... Don't tell the chubby guhs, shhhh!
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.voor.1: Tasty fishesss. Raw and wriggly. Want one? No? Lucky us, wahoog.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.reis.0: This way, chonkie! Smikagol knows a secret little path. Very secret. Very slippery.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.reis.1: It's ours... ours! Well, alright. Yours. For now. Shhhh.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.na.0: Smikagol is golden brown now. And crispy on the outside. It suits us, chonkie!
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.na.1: We got a piece. A WHOLE piece! Nobody took it away, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.voor.0: They call me Guhstrider. I sneak. You can't hear me. I can hear you, though: you smack your lips.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.voor.1: A king? Me? Oh no. I'm just a guh in a hood. Stop staring at my crown crumbs.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.reis.0: Sneaking is simple: tummy in, ears flat, and don't say 'nyeg'. That last one is the hardest.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.reis.1: If by my life or death I can protect the ring, I will. Preferably by my life, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.na.0: The nibble crown sits nicely. It just crumbles into my ears a little.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.na.1: A king shares his nibbles. It's the law. I wrote it myself, wahoog.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.voor.0: My elf eyes see very far. There, behind that hill: a nibble. It's mine.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.voor.1: I've already found seventeen nibbles today. Don't tell Gimguh. Or actually, do.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.reis.0: They're taking the nibbles to Mount Fry! What do my elf eyes see? That it's a long walk, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.reis.1: Forty-one nibbles! Gimguh says forty-two, but that last one was already lying on the ground.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.na.0: In the end it was a tie. I don't like saying that. So I say it quietly.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.na.1: I live in the tree city now. The view is good. From here I can see what's in your backpack.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.voor.0: Nobody tosses a dwarf guh! Well, maybe across a teeny tiny ditch. When nobody's looking.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.voor.1: And my axe? That's for the cheese, nyeg. Thick slices.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.reis.0: Forty-two nibbles! That elf counts the crumbs as whole ones. Two can play at that game.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.reis.1: There's a secret little tunnel under this mountain. I'm not saying where. It's behind that rock over there.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.na.0: A tie with an elf. I lost three nights of sleep over it. Didn't lose a single meal, though.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.na.1: My beard still smells like the fryer. I'm never washing it again, wahoog.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.voor.0: I'm a Mika, yes. But I don't steal. Almost never. I'm practicing really hard.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.voor.1: One does not simply carry a single nibble to Mount Fry. You need buns to go with it, at the very least.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.reis.0: Let me hold the ring for a moment. Only hold it! No? No. You're right. Sorry. I'm ashamed, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.reis.1: I blow my horn when there's danger. Or when it's dinnertime. Mostly the second one.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.na.0: I was given a piece. Just given it! Without stealing. That was new for me.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.na.1: I guard the king's cookie jar now. Nothing has gone missing yet. Almost nothing.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.voor.0: We're looking for second breakfast. The first one was gone before we woke up.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.voor.1: Pippguh didn't do anything. Whatever it was. And I was standing right there and didn't see it either.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.reis.0: Is there anything tasty left in your backpack? We're only looking. With our pawsies.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.reis.1: That was Pippguh, with the bucket. All I did was tell him to do it, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.na.0: We've grown, can you tell? From the tree guhs' nibbles. At least one crumb taller.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.na.1: Third breakfast is a thing now too. We invented it, wahoog.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.voor.0: What about second breakfast? And elevenses? And the in-between nibble?
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.voor.1: I never touch anything. Except everything. But always by accident.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.reis.0: A bucket? What bucket? Oh, THAT bucket. It fell. All by itself. Down that well.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.reis.1: Fool of a Pippguh, Guhdalf says then. But he says it sweetly, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.na.0: I sang at the party. Everybody cried. From laughing, they said.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.na.1: I never saw that well again. I think it saw me, though.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.voor.0: Welcome, traveler. This house is three thousand years old. So is the cheese sauce. Better not taste it.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.voor.1: I was there, back then. Three thousand years ago. When somebody ate the last nibble and said nothing.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.reis.0: The council has spoken. Well, shouted. You carry the ring. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.reis.1: Nine companions. So be it. Are there enough plates?
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.na.0: The ring has been shared. After three thousand years. I'd have liked a taste myself, to be honest.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.na.1: Do drop by. The waterfalls run with fresh cheese sauce now. THAT you may taste.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.voor.0: I know what you seek. It's in the fridge. In my house we always know everything.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.voor.1: Even the smallest guh can change the course of dinner.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.reis.0: Look into the mirror, if you dare. You'll see what was, what is, and what you're having for dinner tonight.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.reis.1: Three gifts I give you. Don't lose them. And wash the little cloak on a cold cycle, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.na.0: The shadow is gone and the fryer is on. These are good times.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.na.1: The phial still glows, I see. Handy in the pantry, wahoog.
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_guhda: Talk to Guhdalf at the big Barbecue Pit
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_gekre: One Nibble to Share Them All
Receive the Nibble Ring. Don't eat it, nyeg
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_sam.d: Sam-guh walks along with you, with all his pans
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_rustp: Reach a rest stop: this is where you come back to if you get caught
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_stoof: Have Sam-guh cook you a stew at a rest fire
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_kwijl: Walk past wild guhs with the ring: they trail after you, drooling
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_omged: Put the Nibble Ring on anyway. Mikas can't see you anymore. The Eye can
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_negen: Escape the nine Skelly Mika Riders
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_gaven: Receive the Light Phial, the Little Elven Cloak and the Elven Rope
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_verbl: Dazzle a Skelly Mika Rider with the Light Phial
Sneak and stand still with the Little Elven Cloak: you look like a rock
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_elfen: Let the Elven Rope pull you to a hook
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_gedra: Let Sam-guh carry you when the ring gets too heavy
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_klaar: Bring the Nibble Ring to Mount Fry, have it fried and share it with everyone
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_smika: Smikagol is your buddy: put him by the water and he catches fish for you
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_feest: Pick up your daily treat at the party in the Nibble Shire
structure.guhs.ring_rustpunt.tooltip: A little camp with a rest fire: Sam-guh cooks here and this is where you come back to if the Nine catch you (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhaal.reiskaart.knabbelring: The Journey of the Nibble Ring
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.grillguh: Hm. The Grill Guh's barbecue is still cold. Help him first, then come back. A journey begins with a burning portal, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.geen_kamp: There's no spot for my cart here, nyeg. Find me at another big Barbecue Pit: everything is ready there.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.hallo: Aha, there you are. Right on time. Sit down, you have to see this...
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.klusjes: The party won't set itself! Still to do: %s.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.klus.vuurwerk: launch a rocket (the crate on my cart)
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.klaar_voor_fee: Everything ready? Then let's party. Watch my hat.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.na_feest: You have the ring. Don't eat it, don't put it on. Talk to Sam-guh: he's coming along, whether you like it or not.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.proviand: Sam-guh is coming along, good. Pack the provisions first: the crates are by my cart.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.portaal: All packed? Then walk to the grill portal with Sam-guh. I'll switch it on as soon as you're there. Fly... no wait, that's for later.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.ring_kwijt: Lost it? The ONE nibble? Here, I'd already found it again. In your other pocket. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.vuurwerk.klus: FWOOSH! The first rocket is up in the sky. Guhdalf nods, pleased.
quest.guhs.ringh1.vuurwerk.wacht: The next rocket needs to cool down a bit first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.vuurwerk.dak: A rocket can't go up here: there's something above the crate.
quest.guhs.ringh1.tafel.klus: You put the cake and the nibbles on the table. It looks very festive. There's a bite missing already...
quest.guhs.ringh1.tafel.kijk: The party table of the Nibble Shire. There is always cake. There is always a bite missing.
quest.guhs.ringh1.tafel.straks: No snacking yet! The party has to start first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.klusjes_klaar: Everything is ready for the party. Talk to Guhdalf!
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.onbekend: Good day to you! I'm Sam-guh, the gardener. If you're looking for Guhdalf: he's grumbling away by his cart, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.uitnodiging: A party? With cake? I'm coming, nyeg! I'll bring my own spoon.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.komt_al: I'm on my way! Just watering the potatoes.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.eerst_feest: Party first, the rest later. That's how we do things here.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.mee1: A journey with a ring that smells like nibbles? Without a cook? Not happening, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.mee2: I'm coming too! I've already strapped my pans on. But provisions first: without sausage I'm not walking past the garden gate.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.proviand.0: Sausage! That'll get you over the first hill, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.proviand.1: Cheese. A whole wheel. For when the sausage runs out. So for in a minute.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.proviand.2: Nibbles! Boil 'em, mash 'em, stick 'em in a stew.
quest.guhs.ringh1.proviand.kijk: A crate of provisions for the road. It smells delicious.
quest.guhs.ringh1.proviand.zonder_sam: You'll never carry this without Sam-guh. Ask him along first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.proviand.sam_ver: Sam-guh is too far away to take it. Wait a moment until he's with you.
quest.guhs.ringh1.proviand.klaar: The backpack is full. Time to go: off to the grill portal!
quest.guhs.ringh1.portaal.sam1: This is it. If I take one more little step, I'll be farther from home than I've ever been, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.portaal.sam2: ...Oh, all right then. But if there's no second breakfast over there, I'm complaining to Guhdalf.
quest.guhs.ringh1.portaal.sam_ver: Wait for Sam-guh! You're not going through that portal without him.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.0: Good morning! Or do you mean that it is a good morning, whether I want it or not? Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.1: Adventures? Nasty, bothersome things. They make you late for dinner.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.2: Have you had second breakfast yet? And elevenses? Lunch? Afternoon tea? Nyeg, what a life.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.3: That Guhdalf. Always fireworks, always a fuss. But his cake is good.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.4: Sam-guh's potatoes are the best in the whole Shire. Don't tell him I said so.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.5: I heard that on the other side of the portal, sauce comes out of the ground. Could it be true?
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.6: My door is round. My window is round. I am round. It all fits together here, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.7: If you find a ring that smells tasty: don't eat it. My granny always said that. No idea why.
gui.guhs.ringh1.doel.guhdalf: Guhdalf at the big Barbecue Pit
block.guhs.ringh1_feesttafel: Party Table of the Nibble Shire
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.uitleg: Chapter 1 of the Nibble Ring. Guhdalf has switched off the grill portal until you help him. But in the Nibble Shire nobody goes on a journey without a farewell party, nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.0: Find Guhdalf. He's standing with his cart full of fireworks at the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension. Talk to him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.0: At the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension (the Super Compass points to 'My Story')
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.1: Help Guhdalf with the farewell party: launch a rocket from the crate on his cart, set the party table and invite Sam-guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.1: At Guhdalf's cart, next to the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.2: Everything is ready. Talk to Guhdalf: the party can begin, wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.2: At Guhdalf's cart, next to the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.3: You have the Nibble Ring. Don't eat it! Talk to Sam-guh: without him (and his pans) you won't get anywhere.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.3: Sam-guh is in his vegetable patch, or at Guhdalf's tent
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.4: Pack the provisions together with Sam-guh: the sausage, the cheese and the nibbles from the crates by Guhdalf's cart.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.4: At Guhdalf's cart, next to the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.5: Walk with Sam-guh to the grill portal of the Barbecue Pit. That's where the journey really begins.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.5: The Grill Coal frame of the big Barbecue Pit (or another grill portal)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.klaar: The grill portal works again and Sam-guh walks with you. Off to the Guhbarbecuether: Guhvendell awaits, nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.klaar: At Guhdalf's cart, next to the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.0: Talk to Guhdalf at the big Barbecue Pit
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.1: Help with the party: rocket, party table, Sam-guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.2: Talk to Guhdalf: the party begins
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.3: Ask Sam-guh along on the journey
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.4: Pack the provisions: sausage, cheese, nibbles
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.5: Walk with Sam-guh to the grill portal
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h1.regel.0: In a hole in the ground there lived a guh. Not a nasty, wet hole: it was a hill hole, and that means nibbles.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h1.regel.1: Nothing ever happens in the Nibble Shire. They eat six times a day and think adventures are a bother: they make you late for dinner.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h1.regel.2: But today a cart full of fireworks comes rattling down the path. Guhdalf the Grey is here. And he has something in his pocket that smells VERY tasty.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h1.regel.3: And so the story of the Nibble Ring begins. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.verteller: The Nibble Shire. Nothing ever happens here. And they like it that way.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.sam_laat: Mr. Guhdalf! You're late. Second breakfast is all gone, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.nooit_te_laat: A wizard is never late, Sam-guh. He arrives precisely when the nibbles are ready.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.portaal: And you wanted to go through the grill portal, didn't you? I've switched that off for a bit.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.ring: I found a ring. A nibble in the shape of a ring. Everyone who smells it wants to eat it.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.berg: It has to go to Mount Fry, in the Guhbarbecuether. And you were heading that way anyway.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.feest: But first, a farewell party. In the Nibble Shire nobody goes on a journey with an empty tummy. Will you lend a paw?
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.verteller: That evening the party is on. The whole Nibble Shire is there, because there is cake.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.sam_taart: This is the third cake, Mr. Guhdalf. The first two were for tasting, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.speech1: Dear guhs! I don't know half of you half as well as I should like.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.speech2: And the other half eats twice as much as I can bake.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.apart: Come over here. This is it: the Nibble Ring. One nibble to share them all.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.geheim: Keep it secret. Keep it whole. And whatever you do: do NOT eat it.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.omdoen: And don't put it on. Then the Eye of Sauceron will see you. He's been peckish for a very long time.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.sam_mee: A journey? Without a cook? I don't think so, nyeg. Just ask me later, I'll say yes.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.vuurwerk: And now: fireworks! Everybody duck, this one's new.
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h1_vu: Launch a rocket from Guhdalf's crate
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h1_fe: Celebrate the farewell party in the Nibble Shire
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h1_kl: Walk with Sam-guh to the grill portal: chapter 1 is done
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h1_be: Talk to four residents of the Nibble Shire
structure.guhs.knabbelgouw.tooltip: The Grill Guh's big Barbecue Pit with the hill holes of the Nibble Shire around it. This is where the story of the Nibble Ring begins (Guhmension)
quest.guhs.ringh2.aankomst: Guhvendell! The Last Cozy House. You're safe here: no Mika, no Eye, just lots and lots of cheese sauce.
quest.guhs.ringh2.sam.aankomst: Would you look at those waterfalls! Made of REAL cheese sauce. I'll go put a little pan on by the Rest Fire, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.kennis.klaar: You know everyone now. Ring the bell in the council ring, across the bridge!
quest.guhs.ringh2.bel.te_vroeg: The council only starts once you know everyone. You still need to meet: %s.
quest.guhs.ringh2.bel.eerst_guhrond: Not so fast with that bell! Talk to Guhrond first, on the doorstep of the hall.
quest.guhs.ringh2.bel.galm: The bell echoes over the waterfalls. Lovely sound, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.raad.na: Tell Guhrond that you'll carry the ring. He's on his high seat in the council ring.
quest.guhs.ringh2.genootschap.na: Guhrond gives you provisions for the road: cheese nibbles and two of the house stews. Don't eat it all at once!
quest.guhs.ringh2.genootschap.hint: Talk to Guhdalf when you're ready to set off.
quest.guhs.ringh2.klaar: Chapter 2 is done! The Fellowship is on its way to the Mines of Nibblemoria. Your Journey Map is in the Guhdex.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.welkom.0: Welcome to Guhvendell, ring-bearer. I am Guhrond. This house is three thousand years old. So is the cheese sauce. Better not taste it.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.welkom.1: Tonight there's a council about that nibble in your pocket. Go meet the others first. They're wandering around all over the place, eating my supplies.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.welkom.hint: Meet Araguh, Leguhlas, Gimguh, Boromika, Merry and Pippguh.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.nog: You haven't met everyone yet. You still need to meet: %s. Look by the gate, in the garden, in the hall and in the kitchen.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.bel: Everyone is here. Ring the bell in the council ring, across the bridge. Then they'll come by themselves. Usually.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.wie: They've been bickering for hours. Someone has to take the ring to Mount Fry. Someone with little paws and a big heart. Who, oh who?
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.nog_niet: Take your time. They'll keep bickering for a while. They can keep that up for three thousand years, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.vertrek: Nine companions. Go with Guhdalf when you're ready. And bring your plate back, or I'll never see it again.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.voor.0: Ha, there you are. Still got the ring? Didn't eat it? Not even a corner? Good, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.voor.1: Guhrond and I have known each other for ages. He still has a frying pan of mine.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.raad: They won't listen to an old wizard. You go say something to Guhrond. You know what.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.vertrek: Our road leads across the Charcoal Flats to the Mines of Nibblemoria. It's dark there, and something very, very peckish lives inside. Are you ready to set off?
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.nog_niet: Feel free to look around a bit more. A wizard never leaves early. He leaves precisely when the cookies are gone.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.op_weg: Then off we go! The Fellowship walks with you, even when you can't see them. Follow your Super Compass, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.les: I am Araguh. They call me Guhstrider. Whoever travels with me must know how to sneak. Show me: crouch (sneak) and then click me again.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.niet_gebukt: You're still standing up straight. The Eye can see you from three mountains away like that. Crouch, and then click me.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.kennis: Now THAT is sneaking. Tummy in, ears flat and no saying 'nyeg'. That'll come in handy at the Black Grill Gate.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.praat: I'm keeping an eye on the gate. And on the cookie tin. Mostly the cookie tin.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.bel: The bell? I'm on my way. Sneaking. You won't hear me coming.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.raad: All I'm saying is: whoever carries the ring must know how to sneak. And only one of us here can. Two, counting me.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.klaar: You have my sword. And my packed lunch, if you ask nicely.
quest.guhs.ringh2.leguhlas.kennis: I am Leguhlas, of the tree guhs. My elf eyes have already found seventeen nibbles today. That dwarf guh over there says seventeen and a half. Halves don't count.
quest.guhs.ringh2.leguhlas.praat: See that pile? Seventeen of them are mine. The rest were already there.
quest.guhs.ringh2.leguhlas.bel: I heard the bell before it even rang. Elf ears, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.leguhlas.raad: My elf eyes saw it first. So it's mine. That's how it works.
quest.guhs.ringh2.leguhlas.klaar: You have my bow. I only shoot cheese with it. Slices.
quest.guhs.ringh2.gimguh.kennis: Gimguh, son of Gluhin! Seventeen and a half, I've got. The half was under the bench and it DOES count. Just ask nobody.
quest.guhs.ringh2.gimguh.praat: Nobody tosses a dwarf guh. But you may toss me a nibble.
quest.guhs.ringh2.gimguh.bel: A council! Good. There's always food at those.
quest.guhs.ringh2.gimguh.raad: My tooth still hurts. But if I chop it to pieces, everyone gets a taste. Me first.
quest.guhs.ringh2.gimguh.klaar: You have my axe. It's for the cheese. Thick slices, wahoog!
quest.guhs.ringh2.boromika.kennis: I am Boromika. Yes, a Mika. But I don't steal! Is that it, in your pocket? Can I just hold it for a sec... No. No, you're right. Sorry, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.boromika.praat: The shards of Nibsil. Somebody has been nibbling on them. It wasn't me. Not this time.
quest.guhs.ringh2.boromika.bel: I'll be right there. I'm just looking at these shards a teeny bit longer. Looking is allowed.
quest.guhs.ringh2.boromika.raad: I only want to keep it safe. In my mouth. Just for a moment. For safety!
quest.guhs.ringh2.boromika.klaar: I'll carry the buns. There are almost as many in there as this morning.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.kennis: I'm Merry, that's Pippguh. We're here for second breakfast. And third. We don't know what a council is, but there's bound to be food.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.snoep: Oops. There was a cheese nibble in your bag. WAS. It rolled right out, straight into my mouth.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.lege_tas: Your bag is empty! What are we supposed to do about second breakfast now?
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.praat: The buffet is Guhrond's. We're guarding it. From very close up.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.bel: Was that the dinner bell? No? Shame.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.raad: Shhh! We're not here. We're a bush.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.klaar: We're coming too! Someone has to guard the provisions. From very close up.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.kennis: Pippguh! Pleased to meet you. Have you seen that bell yet, in the council ring? Guhrond says I'm not allowed to touch it. I don't know why.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.snoep: That was Merry. I only ate the wrapper. Oh. It didn't have a wrapper.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.lege_tas: There's nothing in your bag. I checked three times. With my little paws.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.praat: I'm not touching anything. That teapot fell all by itself. Almost.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.bel: YOU get to touch the bell? That's not fair, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.raad: I'm a bush too. A peckish bush.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.klaar: Where are we going, anyway? Doesn't matter. Is there a second breakfast on the way?
gui.guhs.ringh2.optie.nog_niet: Uh... let me think about it a bit
gui.guhs.ringh2.optie.rondkijken: I'll look around a bit more
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.beloning.provi: Guhrond's provisions: 6 cheese nibbles and 2 stews
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.beloning.genoo: The Fellowship of the Nibble Ring: eight companions for the road
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.uitleg: In Guhvendell, the house of Guhrond, a council gathers about the Nibble Ring. Everyone wants to eat it. Someone has to take it to Mount Fry. Nyeg, now who could that be?
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.0: Walk with Sam-guh through the Guhbarbecuether to Guhvendell, the house of Guhrond. Your Super Compass (My Story) shows the way. If you come across a Rest Fire, walk past it for a moment. Or let yourself be flown: a Travel Smoke Guh now waits at Guhdalf's camp in the Shire.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.0: Guhvendell, in the Sausage Woods of the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.1: You made it! Talk to Guhrond. He's standing on the doorstep of the big white house with the green roof.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.1: Guhvendell: the doorstep of the hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.2: Meet Araguh, Leguhlas, Gimguh, Boromika, Merry and Pippguh. They're all over Guhvendell: by the gate, in the garden, in the hall and in the kitchen. Guhrond knows who you still need to meet.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.2: Guhvendell: by the gate, in the garden, in the hall and in the kitchen
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.3: Everyone is here. Cross the bridge to the council ring (the round ring of pillars) and ring the bell. Then the Council of Guhrond begins.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.3: Guhvendell: the bell in the council ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.4: The council is bickering over who gets to eat the ring. Tell Guhrond, on his high seat in the council ring, that you'll take it to Mount Fry.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.4: Guhvendell: Guhrond in the council ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.5: You have provisions and eight companions. Feel free to look around a bit more. Talk to Guhdalf in the council ring when you're ready to set off.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.5: Guhvendell: Guhdalf in the council ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.klaar: The Fellowship of the Nibble Ring is on its way! Guhrond stays home and waves. Do drop by again sometime.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.0: Walk to Guhvendell (your Super Compass shows the way)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.1: Talk to Guhrond on the doorstep of the hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.2: Meet the whole company (six guhs, all over Guhvendell)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.3: Ring the bell in the council ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.4: Tell Guhrond that you'll carry the ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.5: Talk to Guhdalf: ready to set off
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h2.regel.0: Beyond the grill portal lies the Guhbarbecuether: smoke, embers and the smell of something tasty everywhere.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h2.regel.1: Deep in the Sausage Woods, where the cheese sauce tumbles off the rocks in waterfalls, stands Guhvendell: the Last Cozy House.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h2.regel.2: That is where Guhrond lives. For three thousand years he has known what must be done with the Nibble Ring. He's just still looking for someone to do it.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h2.regel.3: Walk there with Sam-guh. Your Super Compass shows the way. And no licking the ring, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.begin: The bell echoes through Guhvendell. The Council of Guhrond gathers.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.welkom: Strangers from distant lands, friends of old. You are here because of one nibble. One VERY tasty one.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.leg: Lay the ring on the stone, little one.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.ring: There it lies. It smells of melted cheese. Everybody gulps.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.geef: So it is true. The Nibble Ring! Give it to me. I'll eat it. For safety, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.frituur: The ring cannot simply be eaten. It must be fried in Mount Fry, where it was baked. And then shared fairly.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.wachten: Then what are we waiting for?
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.tand: OW! My tooth! That ring is rock hard, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.nul: That makes nibble number zero for you, Gimguh. I'm still on seventeen.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.half: Seventeen and a half! The half DOES count!
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.wandel: One does not simply walk to Mount Fry. There is an Eye there that never blinks. Well. Almost never.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.ik: I'll carry it. I am almost king, after all.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.ogen: My elf eyes saw it first!
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.stukken: I'll chop it to pieces. Fair and square! The biggest piece is mine.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.dwazen: Fools! There will be NO snacking before dinner!
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.eind: They bickered and bickered. The ring just lay there. Someone had to say something...
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.ik: I will take the ring! Though I do not know the way.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.stil: It went very quiet. Even the cheese sauce stopped splashing for a moment.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.last: I will help you bear this burden, as long as it is yours to bear. And I'll carry the cookies.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.zwaard: If I can protect you with all that I am, I will. You have my sword.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.bijl: And my axe! And my one good tooth.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.broodjes: You carry the fate of us all, little one. If this is the will of the council, then I will carry the buns.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.hee: Hey! The boss isn't going anywhere without me, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.scheiden: No, indeed, it is hardly possible to separate you two. Not even when he is invited to a secret council and you are not.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.ook: We're coming too! You'd have to stuff us in a sack to stop us.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.verstand: Anyway, you need someone with brains on this sort of... trip. Quest. Thing.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.afvallen: Well, that rules you out, Pip.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.negen: Nine companions. So be it. You shall be the Fellowship of the Nibble Ring!
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h2_ra: Ring the council bell in Guhvendell and hear just how many of them want to eat the ring
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h2_ge: Take up the ring and leave Guhvendell with eight companions
structure.guhs.guhvendel.tooltip: The Last Cozy House: Guhrond's elven house beneath three cheese sauce waterfalls, in the Sausage Woods (Guhbarbecuether)
block.guhs.ringh3_rune.lore: Carved out of the wall by Gimguh. Knock on it for a different sign. The nyeg rune glows.
item.guhs.ringh3_rune.lore: Carved out of the wall by Gimguh. Knock on it for a different sign. The nyeg rune glows.
block.guhs.ringh3_brokkelsteen.lore: Holds out exactly long enough. Usually. Keep walking, nyeg!
item.guhs.ringh3_brokkelsteen.lore: Holds out exactly long enough. Usually. Keep walking, nyeg!
block.guhs.ringh3_hendel.lore: Springs back all by itself. Dwarf guhs trust nobody with a lever.
item.guhs.ringh3_hendel.lore: Springs back all by itself. Dwarf guhs trust nobody with a lever.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.beloning.rune: Four runestones, carved out by Gimguh
gui.guhs.ringh3.poort.schrift: In glowing runes it says: 'The Gate of Durguh, Lord of Nibblemoria. Say nyeg and enter.' What do you say?
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.lees: Runes glow above the gate: 'Say nyeg and enter.' Other than that, nothing happens. Not yet.
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.al_open: The gate still remembers you. It's sliding open already, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.fout.1: The gate pretends it can't hear you. It really does say what you have to say...
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.fout.2: Still shut. Read the spell again, VERY literally: 'Say nyeg and enter.'
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.fout.3: Sam-guh whispers: 'I think you just have to say nyeg, boss. Nyeg.'
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.open: Nyeg! The runes light up and the gate of Nibblemoria grinds open.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.0: The Gate of Durguh. I got it open once. I just can't remember how, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.1: Chonkus opendus! ...Nothing. Nibblum portalis! ...Nothing either. Hm.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.2: I know every spell in the tongues of guhs, Mikas and hamsters. This gate listens to none of them.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.3: 'Say nyeg and enter.' What could that mean? It must be a very deep riddle. Let me think.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.4: ...Wait a moment. It just says so, right there. You have a keyboard, don't you? Then SAY it, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.open: Ha! I knew it all along. I only wanted to see if you knew it too.
quest.guhs.ringh3.hefboom.fout: CLONK. Wrong! Everything springs back, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.hefboom.open: CLICK-CLACK-CLONK. The portcullis rattles up. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.ringh3.hefboom.niet_van_jou: The lever is stuck. This riddle isn't yours yet, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.hefboom.al_gedaan: You already did this one. The portcullis opens for you.
quest.guhs.ringh3.hefboom.sam: There's a little rhyme on that stone in the middle, boss: first the sausage, then the cheese, sauce on top and the nibble last.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.hal.0: I have no memory of this place. I do remember that little rhyme. It was about food, like everything here.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.hal.1: Read the stone in the middle. And don't just go pulling things. Pippguh does that already, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.pippguh.put.0: I'm not touching anything anymore. Really. ...Is that a little lever?
quest.guhs.ringh3.pippguh.put.1: It was only a tiny bucket. It just made a very big noise.
quest.guhs.ringh3.pippguh.put.2: Guhdalf said 'fool'. But he said it with a capital letter. I heard it, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.put: Drums. They know we're here. Help Gimguh with his door, and be quick about it!
quest.guhs.ringh3.gimguh.wacht: A dwarf guh belongs underground. Nice and dark. Nice and close to the cheese.
quest.guhs.ringh3.gimguh.deur.0: There's a dwarf door here, I'd bet my beard on it. You knock three times on the rune of what Durguh liked best. Only... what was that again?
quest.guhs.ringh3.gimguh.deur.1: Bone? Sausage? Flame? I can't remember! Look at the tomb of Durguh, over there on the other side. It says so on it.
quest.guhs.ringh3.gimguh.deur.2: Knock three times on the same rune, with no other one in between. A dwarf door is precise, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.gimguh.open: See! A dwarf guh never forgets a door. For a moment at most.
quest.guhs.ringh3.rune.fout: Knock. %s? Nothing happens with that one. Again, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.rune.open: KNOCK. KNOCK. KNOCK. A piece of wall slides aside: Gimguh's secret passage. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.ringh3.rune.sam: That tomb says what Durguh loved most, boss. It's yellow and it has holes in it.
quest.guhs.ringh3.rog.trommels: Doom... doom... Drums in the deep. Something is coming.
quest.guhs.ringh3.rog.vlucht: THE BARBECUEROG! RUN! Across the Crumble Path, to the bridge!
quest.guhs.ring.terug.barbecuerog: SWISH! The Barbecuerog's bratwurst whip got you. He put you neatly back at your rest fire. You do smell like barbecue now, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.brug.weg: The bridge is gone. So is Guhdalf. You can't get through here for now, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.brug.heel: The dwarf guhs of old built to last forever: the Bridge of Nibble-dûm is back in place already.
quest.guhs.ringh3.na_brug: Guhdalf has fallen. Sam-guh sniffles. Come: up the long stairs, and outside.
quest.guhs.ringh3.araguh.einde: We made it through. Not all of us... But the ring is safe, and Guhdalf would want us to keep walking. Gimguh carved a few more runestones out of the wall for you. As a keepsake.
quest.guhs.ringh3.araguh.na: Satay Grove isn't far now. That's where Guhladriel has her home. She'll know what to do, and she has nibbles.
quest.guhs.ringh3.klaar: Chapter 3 is done: you made it through the Mines of Nibblemoria. On to Satay Grove!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.uitleg: Chapter 3 of the Nibble Ring. Under the Charcoal Flats lies the old mine of the dwarf guhs: a gate with a riddle, levers, a well you'd better not drop anything into, and very deep down something that has been smoldering for ages.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.stap.3: The guard room with the well
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.0: Walk with Sam-guh to the Mines of Nibblemoria, under the Charcoal Flats. The Super Compass (My Story) shows the way. Or let yourself be flown: a Travel Smoke Guh waits at the gate of Guhvendell.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.0: The Guhbarbecuether, quite a walk from Guhvendell
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.1: The gate is shut tight. A spell glows above the door: 'Say nyeg and enter.' Type the word in chat, or click the glowing runes and pick the right answer.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.2: Four levers, one right order. Read the little rhyme on the stone in the middle of the hall and pull them in that order. Wrong? Then you simply start over.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.2: The Hall of Levers, down the stairs from the gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.3: The portcullis is open. Walk on to the guard room with the well. And don't let Pippguh touch anything.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.3: Through the portcullis, to the west
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.4: The corridor has caved in and the drums are coming closer. Gimguh knows a dwarf door: knock three times on the rune of what Durguh liked best of all. His tomb is in the same room.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.4: The west wall of the guard room
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.5: Through the Hall of Pillars, across the Crumble Path and the Bridge of Nibble-dûm. Keep walking: the Crumble Path drops away under your pawsies and the Barbecuerog is coming after you. He won't do a thing to you, he only sends you back to the Rest Fire.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.5: The Hall of Pillars, deep in the mine
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.6: Guhdalf has fallen into the deep. Climb the long stairs to the East Gate and talk to Araguh outside.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.klaar: You made it through the Mines of Nibblemoria. Without Guhdalf, but with the ring. Sam-guh knows the way to Satay Grove.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.klaar: Satay Grove: the Mirror of Guhladriel
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.0: Walk to the Mines of Nibblemoria
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.1: Solve the riddle of the gate: what do you have to say?
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.2: Pull the four levers in the order of the rhyme
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.3: Walk into the guard room with the well
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.4: Knock three times on the right rune (look at the tomb of Durguh)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.5: Run! Across the Crumble Path and the bridge to the other side
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.6: Climb the long stairs and talk to Araguh outside
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h3.regel.0: From Guhvendell the company crossed the black Charcoal Flats: nine travelers, one Nibble Ring and far too few provisions.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h3.regel.1: Over the mountain was no good. Around it took too long. So only one way was left: underneath.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h3.regel.2: Under the flats lie the Mines of Nibblemoria, where the dwarf guhs once dug for cheese gold. Until they dug too deep and woke something up.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h3.regel.3: Nobody remembers what. 'Probably nothing,' said Pippguh. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh3_emmer.begin: An old guard room. A well. And on the edge... a little bucket.
scene.guhs.ringh3_emmer.emmertje: Ooh. Do you think there's still some nibble in there?
scene.guhs.ringh3_emmer.dwaas: Fool of a Pippguh! Throw yourself in next time, and rid us of your snacking!
scene.guhs.ringh3_emmer.weg: Drums in the deep. They are coming! There's a dwarf door here, only... which rune was it again?
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.ogen: And in the dark of the Deep Gate, two eyes opened.
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.barbecuerog: A Barbecuerog. A demon of charcoal and fire from the ancient world.
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.vijand: This foe is beyond any of you. To the bridge! Run!
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.brug: Across the Crumble Path! Keep walking, it's dropping away under your pawsies!
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.omkijken: Don't look back, don't look back... I'M LOOKING BACK! NYEG!
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.gooien: Nobody tosses a dwarf guh! ...Oh, all right, just this once.
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.dienaar: I am a servant of the Secret Fire, keeper of the flame of the Big Nibble!
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.schaduw: Go back to the Shadow, flame of the Barbecue!
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.weg: And he was gone. Pointy hat and all.
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.verder: Come. He would want us to keep walking. Up the long stairs, and outside!
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h3_po: Solve the riddle of the Gate of Nibblemoria
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h3_em: Be there when a little bucket falls into the well
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h3_ge: A Quick Trip into the Deep
Fall into the Chasm of Nibblemoria. Sam-guh will fish you back out
Get caught by the Barbecuerog's bratwurst whip
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h3_br: Stand with Guhdalf on the Bridge of Nibble-dûm
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h3_kl: Make it through the Mines of Nibblemoria
structure.guhs.knabbelmoria.tooltip: The old mine of the dwarf guhs under the Charcoal Flats. Only for those who get the gate open (Guhbarbecuether)
block.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.lore: A silver bowl of very still water. Shows what was, what is, and what you're having for dinner tonight.
item.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.lore: A silver bowl of very still water. Shows what was, what is, and what you're having for dinner tonight.
gui.guhs.ringh4.doel.steiger: The dock with the elven boats
quest.guhs.ringh4.aankomst: You are in Guhlórien. At the gate stands a familiar elf with very good eyes. And very many opinions.
quest.guhs.ringh4.rust.0: You snuggle up by the fire. Sam-guh is snoring before his pans even hit the ground.
quest.guhs.ringh4.rust.1: You sleep like a log. A round, chonk log. Until, in the middle of the night, you hear soft little paws...
quest.guhs.ringh4.rust.2: Guhladriel walks to the green dell. That is where her Mirror stands.
quest.guhs.ringh4.klaar: Chapter 4 is done! Ash Vale lies before you. Somewhere out there stands the Black Grill Gate.
quest.guhs.ringh4.zegen: Guhladriel's blessing: in her city you fall as softly as a little leaf. A chonk leaf.
quest.guhs.ringh4.gaven_gekregen: You have the three gifts of Guhladriel: the Light Phial, the Little Elven Cloak and the Elven Rope.
quest.guhs.ringh4.hint.zaal: climb the great spiral staircase around the Great Skewer, up to Guhladriel
quest.guhs.ringh4.hint.rust: rest on the guest platform (the tree by the gate, at the Rest Fire)
quest.guhs.ringh4.hint.spiegel: look into the Mirror in the green dell (right-click)
quest.guhs.ringh4.hint.gaven: talk to Guhladriel at the mirror
quest.guhs.ringh4.hint.boot: step into Leguhlas's elven boat at the dock
quest.guhs.ringh4.leguhlas.poort.wacht: One moment. My elf eyes see that you're still watching something.
Welcome to Caras Guhladhon! I saw you coming. Three days ago. You were still walking the other way back then.
Lady Guhladriel is waiting up in the Great Skewer. Up the spiral staircase, until you can't go any higher. Don't look down. Or actually do, it's pretty.
quest.guhs.ringh4.leguhlas.poort.later: This is the golden wood. No touching anything with greasy pawsies, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.welkom.0: Welcome, ring-bearer. I knew you would come. I also knew you got lost twice on the way.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.welkom.1: You mourn for Guhdalf. Do not be afraid: a wizard never simply falls. He falls precisely when he means to.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.welkom.2: But now you are tired. On the guest platform a little fire is burning, and there is a sleeping bag that smells of flowers. Go. Sleep.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.rust: You are about to fall over from sleepiness. Rest first, on the guest platform. Then we shall talk, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.spiegel: The Mirror stands in the dell, among the little white flowers. Look into it. If you dare.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.gaven.0: Your journey goes on, and I let nobody leave with empty pawsies. Three gifts.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.gaven.licht: The Light Phial. The light of our dearest star, in a little jar. Blows smoke away and dazzles the Nine. Do not drink it.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.gaven.elfen: The Little Elven Cloak. Crouch, stand very still, and the Eye will think you are a rock. A chonky rock, but still.
And the Elven Rope. It pulls you to any hook you can see. It doesn't itch, says Sam-guh.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.gaven.1: Leguhlas is waiting at the dock with the boats. Farewell, ring-bearer. May your nibbles never run out.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.opnieuw: You lost a gift. I knew it before you did. Here, a new one. And now keep an eye on your things, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.vaarwel: The river is waiting. So is Leguhlas, and he does not like waiting.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.na.0: You are back. I knew that. The tea is already getting cold.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.na.1: The Mirror is calm these days. Mostly it shows what we are having for dinner tonight.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.na.2: I have stayed small. It suits me well. Small guhs fit better in a hammock.
quest.guhs.ringh4.spiegel.donker: The bowl is empty and dark. Guhladriel has to fill it first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.spiegel.eigen_snoet: All you see is your own snoot. Very pretty.
quest.guhs.ringh4.spiegel.kalm: The mirror is calm again: it has shown you everything. Want another look? Guhdex > Tales > Watch Again, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.leguhlas.steiger.later: These boats are made of elven wood. They never sink. Unless Gimguh stands in one.
quest.guhs.ringh4.leguhlas.steiger.wacht: First go to Lady Guhladriel, up in the Great Skewer. The boats won't walk off. They might sail off, but not without me.
First go to Lady Guhladriel, up in the Great Skewer. The boats won't walk off. They might sail off, but not without me.
Lady Guhladriel is waiting for you, up there. I can see her sitting from here. She's looking at her little clock.
You've got bags under your eyes down to your knees. Sleep first, on the guest platform. Then we sail.
Have you looked into the Mirror yet? Down in the dell. I don't dare anymore: last time I saw Gimguh in the bath.
Guhladriel still has something for you, at the mirror. Nobody sails away from here without presents.
quest.guhs.ringh4.leguhlas.steiger.bootj: The boat has gone down the river for a bit. It'll be right back. Elven boats know the way.
quest.guhs.ringh4.gimguh.steiger.0: A dwarf guh does not belong on the water. A dwarf guh belongs UNDER the ground. With a sandwich.
quest.guhs.ringh4.gimguh.steiger.1: That elf says he has forty-three nibbles. I have forty-four. One of them is in my beard.
quest.guhs.ringh4.gimguh.steiger.2: I asked Lady Guhladriel for a single little hair. She gave me three! And a nibble. I am never leaving.
quest.guhs.ringh4.gimguh.steiger.3: If that boat wobbles, I'm lying down on the bottom. That's not fear. That's ballast.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.nog_niet: Not yet, nyeg. First rest, the Mirror and the gifts of Guhladriel. Then we sail.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.instappen: Hop on in. Sit down, keep your tail inside the boat. We're leaving in a moment!
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.erbij: You squeeze into the boat with the others. Snug.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.deco: This boat belongs to Guhladriel herself. Paws off, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.terug_nee: This boat sails back to the tree city. You have to go the other way, ring-bearer.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.terug: The elven boat sails you back to the tree city. It knows the way.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.nog_eens: Another round? Anytime. The statues stay big.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.blijf_zitten: Stay seated, nyeg! No getting out while we're sailing.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.af: Off we go. The Guhduin: the longest sauce river in the whole Guhbarbecuether. No stirring with your pawsies.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.water: It's wobbling. Tell that elf it's wobbling. I'm not telling him, I don't talk to him.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.rivier: Easy now, Gimguh. It's cheese sauce. If you fall in, you just eat your way to the shore.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.kijk: Look! There, around the bend! The Arguhnath, the Pillars of the Guh Kings!
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.groot: ...Nyeg. Those are BIG. Even their ears are bigger than my whole house.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.koningen: The Guh Kings of old, the ancestors of Araguh. They hold up a paw: this far, and not a crumb further.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.sam: I can't swim, boss. But if it's sauce, I'm willing to give it a try, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.tel: Forty-four nibbles. I just looked under the bench. I'm in the lead.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.tel_terug: That one was mine. I put it there. For later. So that's forty-three each.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.aanleg: There is the landing. Nobody can sail any further: around the bend the Guhduin tumbles down, the Sauce Falls of Rauguhs.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.afscheid.0: This is where you go ashore, ring-bearer. Ash Vale begins on the far side, and there stands the Black Grill Gate. My elf eyes can see it already. It does not look cozy.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.afscheid.1: Take care of yourself. And if you find nibbles on the way: those count for me, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.gezwommen: That works too, boss. Straight through the sauce. Now I'll smell like cheese for three days. Wahoog.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.uitleg: After the mine, everyone is tired and sad. In the golden wood of Guhlórien, Lady Guhladriel lives high up in the trees. Rest, look into her mirror if you dare, and then sail down the Guhduin in the elven boats. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.0: Walk to Guhladriel's tree city. The Super Compass and Sam-guh show the way. Or let yourself be flown: a Travel Smoke Guh waits at the exit of Nibblemoria.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.0: The golden wood of Guhlórien, quite a long walk
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.1: Talk to Leguhlas at the gate of the tree city.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.1: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.2: Climb the great spiral staircase around the Great Skewer and talk to Lady Guhladriel in her hall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.2: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.3: Go to the guest platform (the tree by the gate, up the stairs) and snuggle up by the Rest Fire.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.3: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.4: Walk to the green dell in the tree city and look into the Mirror of Guhladriel (right-click).
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.4: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.5: Talk to Guhladriel at the mirror. She has something for you. Three somethings.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.5: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.6: Walk to the dock and step into Leguhlas's elven boat. Stay seated until the far side.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.6: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.klaar: You sailed down the Guhduin, past the Arguhnath. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.kort.1: Talk to Leguhlas at the gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.kort.2: Climb to Guhladriel in the Great Skewer
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.kort.4: Look into the Mirror of Guhladriel
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.kort.5: Talk to Guhladriel at the mirror
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.kort.6: Step into the elven boat at the dock
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h4.regel.0: Guhdalf has fallen into the deep. Nobody is hungry. Not even Pippguh, and that's saying something.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h4.regel.1: The company stumbles out of the mine and into a wood where the satay trees turn gold: Guhlórien.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h4.regel.2: High in the branches lives Lady Guhladriel. She knows everything. Even what you sneakily ate yesterday.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h4.regel.3: Rest, ring-bearer. Tomorrow the river awaits. And tonight... a mirror. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.nacht: The middle of the night. Soft little paws on the moss. Guhladriel walks to the dell...
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.kijk: Will you look into the Mirror, ring-bearer?
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.snoet: All I see is my own snoot, boss. There's still stew on it, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.dingen: The Mirror shows things that were, things that are... and things that have yet to be baked.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.gouw: You see the Nibble Shire. The party tent. The long tables...
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.kruimels: ...and Mikas everywhere. They are eating ALL the nibbles. Even the crumbs. Even the ones under the bench.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.oog: Then the water turns red. An EYE. An enormous Mika eye, and it is looking straight at you!
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.trek: The Eye of Sauceron: "I see you... Do you have my nibble? I'm only a TINY bit hungry!"
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.weet: I know what it is you saw. For it is also in my mind. And it is also rumbling in my tummy.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.aanbod: Do you want the ring, then? Here. Then I'm nicely rid of it, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.koningin: In place of a Dark Lord you would have a QUEEN! Not dark, but ROUND and CHONK as the dawn!
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.houden: All shall love me... and bring me NIBBLES! Buckets full!
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.test: ...No. I pass the test. I will stay small, I will remain Guhladriel, and I'll just eat my own nibbles.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.bed: Can I go back to bed now, boss? Nyeg.
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h4_sp: What Has Yet to Be Baked
Look into the Mirror of Guhladriel
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h4_ge: This Far, and Not a Crumb Further
Sail down the Guhduin, between the two Guh Kings of the Arguhnath
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h4_kl: Finish chapter 4: The Mirror of Guhladriel
structure.guhs.guhladriel_boomstad.toolt: The tree city of Lady Guhladriel in the golden wood of Guhlórien, on the river Guhduin (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.ringh5.beeldje.0: The Eye blinks. He's just hungry, nyeg.
gui.guhs.ringh5.beeldje.1: He's looking at your pocket. There was a nibble in there once.
gui.guhs.ringh5.beeldje.2: Sauceron is purring. He really is. Softly.
gui.guhs.ringh5.beeldje.3: One little piece of ring and he was happy. He could have just said so.
gui.guhs.ringh5.beeldje.4: The Eye sees everything. Except rocks. And the dishes.
quest.guhs.ringh5.oog.gezien: The Eye is looking at you! Out of the light, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringh5.oog.ring: The Eye can feel the ring... Take it off, quick!
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.gezien: Hey! You there! Stay right where you are, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ring.terug.poortwachter: A Grill Guard spotted you and shoved you back to your rest stop. "No guhs allowed, it says so right there, doesn't it?"
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.snuif.0: *sniff sniff* Do you smell nibble too? I smell nibble. I don't see any nibble.
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.snuif.1: Who said "nyeg" just now? ... Nobody. I'm getting old.
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.snuif.2: There's a draft in here. A draft with a ring on. Oh well, never mind.
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.weg: Off you go! This fence is staff only. And for anyone we can't see.
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.na.0: Walk right on through, Ring-Bearer. Thanks for the snack, wahoog!
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.na.1: The boss is finally asleep. We're on break all day long. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.hallo: Ah, the ring-bearer. Come sit by the fire. I'll keep watch. And keep an eye on the ring.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.spijt.0: Don't look at me like that. I'm already ashamed enough for three Mikas.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.spijt.1: I'll stay here on watch. Far away from that ring. It's better this way, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.spijt.2: Don't trust that skinny one too much. He looks at the ring the way I looked at the ring.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.na.0: Fried and shared! And I got a piece too. I didn't deserve that. It was tasty, though.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.na.1: I'm still keeping watch. There's nothing left to guard, but I've gotten good at it.
quest.guhs.ringh5.geritsel: Something is rustling by the provisions. Somebody's into the nibbles!
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.betrapt: No whacking! No whacking! We don't steal, we... only taste. It smelled like our chonkie, nyeg. Sweet guh carries the chonkie, yes? We know a way past the Eye. A sneak path. We shows it!
gui.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.ja: All right. Show us the way.
gui.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.nee: Keep your paws off the provisions!
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.zweer: We swears it! On the chonkie! Smikagol shows the way. Round the back, through the Little Grill Door. Follow us, chonkie... er, master.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.toe_nou: Oh please, oh please. Without Smikagol the Eye looks you right back home. Just click on us if you change your mind, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.sam.vertrouw_niet: I don't trust him one nibble. But a way is a way. I'm keeping my frying pan within paw's reach.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.3: Up the stairs, over the ridge. At the top master sees where we must go. Don't be scared.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.4: The Ash Field. See the light on the ground? That's where he looks. Run from little wall to little wall once it has passed. We waits at every wall.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.5: Bare, bare, everything bare. No more little walls. But master has the little cloak! Crouch and stand still when the light comes. Still as a stone.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.6: Shadow Lane. The Eye doesn't look here. First the smoke: let the phial flash and it blows away. Then the riders: flash them blind, or be a rock until they have passed.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.7: Grill Guards. Mikas! They can't see a ring... shh. At the skull post, chonkie on, through the fence, and right off again. Not on sooner, or the riders smell it. Not on longer, or the Eye has you.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.8: There, there! The Little Grill Door. Walk on, master. We picks the lock open. We are good with little locks.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.9: Open! Open! Run, master, down the tunnel, before the white one is done with his fireworks!
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.klaar: Past the Eye, past the Nine, past the guards. Well done, master. Now only the mountain is left. We knows a stair... a very, very long stair. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.verder.0: And now straight on, master, out of the vale at the back. Follow your little nose: it smells like the fryer there. Nice and greasy. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.verder.1: Not straight on, master, the vale is shut tight with rock there. The little tunnel close by, through the rock wall at the little lantern. That's where it smells like the fryer!
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.verder.2: Not straight on, master, there is rock there. Under the tower of the Eye, shh, on tippy-toesss... and on the other side the little tunnel through the rock wall. That's where it smells like the fryer!
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.verder.dicht: Shh, master... at the back the vale is shut tight with rock, everywhere. Dig, then: straight through the back wall, outside the vale that is allowed. Or simply go back through the vale and around the outside: the guards and the Eye don't look at us anymore, we are past them already. Follow your little nose to the fryer. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.sam.klaar: Two stews for the climb. And I'm walking behind that creep, so I can see what he's up to.
quest.guhs.ringh5.rook.dicht: You can't see your own paw in this smoke. Didn't you have something that gives light?
quest.guhs.ringh5.rook.weg: The Light Phial flashes and the smoke blows away. Wahoog, the lane is clear!
quest.guhs.ringh5.poortje.dicht: The Little Grill Door is locked. Knocking won't help, nyeg.
gui.guhs.ringh5.doel.0: The camp before the Black Grill Gate
gui.guhs.ringh5.doel.7: The fire by the Little Grill Door
gui.guhs.ringh5.doel.ingang: The entrance to the vale of the Black Grill Gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.uitleg: The gate to the land of Sauceron is shut tight, and from his tower the Eye is watching. Smikagol knows a sneak path. So he says. If you get spotted, you're right back at the last rest fire: you never lose anything.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.0: Walk to the camp at the edge of Ash Vale. Your Super Compass and Sam-guh show the way. Or let yourself be flown: a Travel Smoke Guh waits at the landing of the tree city.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.0: The camp before the Black Grill Gate, in the Ash Vale of the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.1: Talk to Boromika by the campfire. He does look at your ring for an awfully long time.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.1: The camp before the Black Grill Gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.2: Something is rustling by the sacks of provisions. Go have a look and click on the thief.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.2: Behind the rock by the camp
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.3: Follow Smikagol up the stairs, over the ridge. At the top you'll see where to go.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.3: The stairs over the ridge behind the camp
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.4: Sneak across the Ash Field. Stay out of the light of the Eye: hide behind a little wall or under a little roof until it has passed.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.4: The Ash Field: diagonally to the left, to the Slag Hut by the rock wall
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.5: There's nothing to hide behind here. Is the light coming? Crouch and stand still with the Little Elven Cloak on you: then you're a rock.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.5: The Bare Plain: to the right, to the Hollow in the rock wall
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.6: Blow the smoke away with the Light Phial and slip past the two riders of the Nine. A flash blinds them, and a rock they can't see.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.6: The lane below the wall, up to the skull post
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.7: Three Grill Guards. Put the Nibble Ring on at the skull post, walk through the fence and take it right off again. No dawdling: the Eye can feel the ring!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.7: The Guard Fence: to the fire by the Little Grill Door
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.8: Walk to the little door in the wall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.8: The Little Grill Door, on the left in the wall
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.9: The little door is open! Run down the tunnel to the fire behind the wall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.klaar: You sneaked past the Eye. Wahoog! Now only Mount Fry is left.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.0: To the camp by the Black Grill Gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.1: Talk to Boromika by the fire
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.2: See who's rustling in the provisions
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.4: Cross the Ash Field: stay out of the light
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.5: Cross the Bare Plain: crouch and be a rock
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.6: Blow the smoke away, past the riders
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.7: Ring on, through the Guard Fence, ring off
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.9: Down the tunnel to the fire
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h5.regel.0: The elven boats carried you to where the sauce river vanishes into the ash: Ash Vale.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h5.regel.1: At the end of the vale stands a black wall with one gate. That gate is a grill, and it is shut.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h5.regel.2: Above it, on his tower, stares the Eye of Sauceron. He's looking for his nibble. He has been hungry for a very, very long time.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h5.regel.3: Whoever he sees, he looks right back to the last fire. So: don't get seen, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.begin: At the edge of Ash Vale a little fire is burning. Boromika is keeping watch. Mostly over your pocket.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.tonen: Show me that ring once more, little guh. It's so... round. And so crunchy.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.hapje: Just one little bite. Who would even notice? Give it to me, I'll keep it. Safe. In my tummy.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.foei: Down! Shame on you! Paws to yourself! Nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.wat_deed_ik: What... what did I just do? My paw moved all by itself.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.vergeef: Forgive me. That was the ring, not me. Well. A tiny bit me.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.wacht: I'll make it right. I'll stay here and keep watch, far away from that ring. Go, before I get hungry again.
scene.guhs.ringh5_oog.daar: There, master. At the end of the vale. The Black Grill Gate.
scene.guhs.ringh5_oog.dicht: Shutter than shut. A grill as tall as a house. And above it...
scene.guhs.ringh5_oog.oog: The Eye of Sauceron. He has lost his nibble. He is hungry. He has been hungry for a very, very long time.
scene.guhs.ringh5_oog.licht: Does master see the light on the ground? That's where he looks. Stay out of the light. Behind little walls, under little roofs. Then he sees nothing.
scene.guhs.ringh5_oog.sluipweg: Smikagol knows a sneak path. Round the back, through the Little Grill Door. Follow us. Softly, softly...
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.titel: The Return of Guhdalf the White
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.op_slot: Locked! No, no, no... Wait, master. We picks it. We picks it very hard.
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.hoeven: Clattering hooves in the lane. The Nine have smelled the ring.
