scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.schiet_op: They're coming! Hurry up, you creep!
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.achteruit: Back, you skellies! I am Guhdalf the White. And I have only just eaten.
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.verblind: The light of his staff is brighter than a hundred Light Phials. The Nine can't see a paw in front of their snoots anymore.
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.vuurwerk: Hey, Sauceron! Over here! I brought fireworks!
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.ren: Run, little ring-bearer! The Eye is looking at me now. Through the little door. Nyeg!
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h5_gi: We Swears It on the Chonkie
Let Smikagol show you the way past the Black Grill Gate
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h5_ro: Blow the smoke of Shadow Lane away with the Light Phial
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h5_la: Walk past a Grill Guard with the ring on
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h5_kl: Sneak past the Eye of Sauceron, the Nine and the Grill Guards
structure.guhs.zwarte_roosterpoort.toolt: The gate to the land of Sauceron, with the tower of the Eye behind it. Shut. Very, very shut (Guhbarbecuether)
block.guhs.ringh6_kooislot.lore: Keeps a Smoke Guhling locked up. Click it to pry it open.
item.guhs.ringh6_kooislot.lore: Keeps a Smoke Guhling locked up. Click it to pry it open.
item.guhs.ringh6_stukje_knabbelring: Piece of the Fried Nibble Ring
item.guhs.ringh6_stukje_knabbelring.lore: Golden brown, crispy and a little bit everyone's. One nibble to share them all.
quest.guhs.ringh6.kamp.sam: There it stands, boss. Mount Fry. First a bite by the fire, then up we go. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh6.kamp.smikagol: Up, up, the tasty path! Smikagol shows the way. Smikagol could carry the ring for a bit too? No? Pity.
quest.guhs.ringh6.kamp.hint: Follow the Winding Path behind the gate. Falling embers only shove you: watch out and keep walking!
quest.guhs.ringh6.kool.raak.0: Boink! An ember. It only shoves, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh6.kool.raak.1: Smack! Hot, but you're fine. Look up!
quest.guhs.ringh6.kool.raak.2: Ow! Oh wait, not ow. Just a shove.
quest.guhs.ringh6.kool.sam: Watch out, boss! The mountain is throwing embers!
quest.guhs.ringh6.slot.al_open: You've already freed this Smoke Guhling. It's probably waving somewhere above you, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh6.slot.eerst: This lock is stuck tight. First free the Smoke Guhling lower down the mountain.
quest.guhs.ringh6.slot.niet_van_jou: This isn't your adventure: this lock is waiting for a ring-bearer who is at this point in the story.
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.vrij.1: Wahoog! Free! The Mikas used me as a range hood! If you need us, we'll come and get you!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.vrij.2: Free, free, free! My little sister is still higher up. I'll go fetch Mom and Dad, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.vrij.3: At last! We're all together! Just call when the mountain starts to bubble, we'll come flying!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.zielig: The Smoke Guhling looks at you through the bars. The lock is on the front.
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.sam: Poor thing. Well done, boss. Onward and upward!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.dank.1: Wahoog, ring-bearer! We just live here now. Without a cage. It smells like fries, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.dank.2: Remember that flight home? Dad's muscles are still sore from it. Thank you!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.dank.3: The Mikas have bought a real range hood now. It doesn't work. We're laughing our tummies round!
quest.guhs.ringh6.touw.hint: The path ends here. Look up at the little blue lamp and right-click with the Elven Rope.
quest.guhs.ringh6.touw.sam: I can't climb with all these pans, boss. You go, I'll get there! (Don't ask how.)
quest.guhs.ringh6.touw.geen: You need the Elven Rope. Sam-guh still had one in his backpack: here!
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.loer.0: The chonkie is getting so heavy... Smikagol will carry it for a bit. Hand it over. Give!
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.loer.1: What's that shining in your pocket? Let Smikagol have a look... up close...
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.loer.2: So tired, the little ring-bearer. Smikagol helps! Smikagol just takes the chonkie for a moment...
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.mis: Almost! The chonkie slips away. Sssorry. That was a pet, not a pinch.
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.duw: Smikagol grabs for the ring and shoves you aside!
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.verblind: Ow! The light! It stings our little eyesss! Smikagol has stopped already!
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.sam: Paws off, you sneak! Boss, flash him with the Light Phial if he starts again.
quest.guhs.ringh6.zwaar.half: The Nibble Ring tugs at your pocket. It gets heavier with every step.
quest.guhs.ringh6.zwaar.vol: The Nibble Ring now weighs as much as a whole cheese shop. You can barely move forward.
quest.guhs.ringh6.sam.draag: I can't carry the ring... but I can carry you, nyeg! Climb on my back, boss.
quest.guhs.ringh6.sam.nog_niet: The Smoke Guhlings first, boss. Then I'll carry you, promise.
quest.guhs.ringh6.sam.boven: There's the crack. From here it's up to you, boss. It's your nibble. I'm right behind you.
quest.guhs.ringh6.sam.hint: Click Sam-guh: he'll carry you up the last stretch.
quest.guhs.ring.terug.ringh6_frituur: Nearly fried! The Smoke Guhlings fished you out and put you at your rest stop. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh6.rand.hint: Walk to the rim of the Frying Edge, above the fryer.
quest.guhs.ringh6.rand.geen_ring: You don't have the Nibble Ring with you. Click Sam-guh: he kept it safe for you.
quest.guhs.ringh6.stukje: You get your very own piece of the fried Nibble Ring. You may keep it. Or eat it.
quest.guhs.ringh6.thuis: The Smoke Guhs gently set you down in the Guhmension. They're already singing there: walk to the party!
quest.guhs.ringh6.thuis.ver: The party is waiting for you in the Nibble Shire: Guhdalf's camp by the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension, where your story began. Go there (the Super Compass shows the way: My Story). As soon as you stand on the ground there, the party starts.
quest.guhs.ringh6.feest.klaar: What a party. And from now on there's one every day, in the Nibble Shire.
gui.guhs.ringh6.doel.thuis: The party in the Nibble Shire
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.uitleg: The Nibble Ring has to go into the fryer. On top of Mount Fry, in the Smoke Delta. Sam-guh is coming along, and so is Smikagol. Sadly.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.0: Walk with Sam-guh to the foot of Mount Fry and find the base camp with the Rest Fire. Or let yourself be flown: a Travel Smoke Guh waits behind the Black Grill Gate.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.waar.0: Mount Fry in the Smoke Delta (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.1: Climb the Winding Path up to the First Ledge. Dodge the falling embers (they only shove) and click the lock on the cage to free the Smoke Guhling.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.waar.1: The Winding Path, around the mountain
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.2: The path has collapsed. Look up at the little blue lamp and use the Elven Rope on the hook, twice. Free the second Smoke Guhling. Smikagol grabs for the ring: flash him away with the Light Phial.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.waar.2: The west face of Mount Fry
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.3: Follow the narrow path to the east side, take the last hook up and free the third Smoke Guhling on the Third Ledge.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.4: The ring has grown too heavy. Click Sam-guh: he'll carry you the last stretch to the Crack of Fry.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.5: Walk through the crack to the Frying Edge above the fryer. It is time.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.6: The Smoke Guhs have brought you home. Walk to your friends in the Nibble Shire: someone is being crowned and there is a whole lot of food.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.waar.6: The Nibble Shire, by the big Barbecue Pit (Guhmension)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.klaar: The Nibble Ring has been fried and shared. The Eye is taking a nap. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.0: Go to the base camp at Mount Fry
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.1: Climb the Winding Path and free the Smoke Guhling
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.2: Elven Rope on the hooks; free the second Smoke Guhling
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.3: Last hook; free the third Smoke Guhling
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.5: Walk to the Frying Edge above the fryer
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.6: Go to the party in the Nibble Shire
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.aankomst: The Crack of Fry. This is where the Nibble Ring was baked. Well, almost: it was never fried.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.gooi: There's the fryer, boss. Toss it in! ...It does smell good, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.twijfel: The ring is heavy. And warm. And it smells like fresh cheese nibble. Surely one little bite is fine?
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.niet_eten: Don't eat it! Fry it! That was the deal, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.gegrepen: Smikagol snatches the Nibble Ring right out of your paws!
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.dans: Oursss! The chonkie is oursss! Wahoog, wahoog, wah...
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.stil: Splash. It bubbles. It sizzles. It smells... pretty good, actually.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.ach: Aw, poor sneak. ...Do you smell that too? It smells like the fair, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.krokant: PLOP! There he is again. Golden brown. Crispy. And glowing.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.lekker: Look at that! The chonkie is crispy! And so are we! Smikagol has never been so nice and warm!
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.delen: It's far too big for Smikagol alone. Would... would you all like a piece too?
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.delen_sam: Sharing! That's it! One nibble to share them all, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.iedereen: Everyone gets a piece. It crackles. The greed melts away like cheese in the fryer.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.oog: High above the crater, the Eye of Sauceron peeks inside. All this time he was only... hungry.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.voor_oog: Here, big eye. For you. No more grumpy looks now.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.oog_eet: Nom. The Eye blinks happily. Once. Twice...
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.dutje: ...and takes a nap. Zzz. The Guhbarbecuether is safe. And smells like fries.
scene.guhs.ringh6_vlucht.borrelt: Uh... boss? The fryer is boiling over! The whole mountain is going to bubble, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh6_vlucht.komen: Wahoog! We're coming to get you! With Mom and Dad!
scene.guhs.ringh6_vlucht.rookguhs: There they are: the Smoke Guhlings you freed. With their big, really, really big family.
scene.guhs.ringh6_vlucht.ook_mee: Wait for usss! Smikagol is a snack now, staying here is dangerous!
scene.guhs.ringh6_vlucht.naar_huis: Up, through the smoke, over the Smoke Delta. Back to the Nibble Shire.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.thuis: The Nibble Shire. It smells of grass, of fireworks and of a whole lot of food.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.welkom: There's our Ring-Bearer! Too late for breakfast, precisely on time for the party. Just as it should be.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.tweede: Is there a second party too? And a second dessert?
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.stil: Shh, Pipp. First the crown. Then the dessert.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.kroon: Araguh, wanderer of the Sausage Woods: no nibbling on your crown before the end of the day. Long live the king!
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.koning: My friends... you bow to no one. Except to the buffet, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.tel: Forty-three nibbles I found along the way! Forty-three!
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.tel_meer: Forty-four. I just took one off your plate.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.sorry: Sorry about that one time with the ring. I baked a cake. It's a little burnt.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.vis: Smikagol brought fishesss! Fried. Everything is tastier fried.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.naar_huis: Well, boss. We're back. ...Can I come live with you? I can cook, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.einde: And they nibbled happily ever after. One nibble to share them all.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h6.regel.0: Beyond the Black Grill Gate lies the Smoke Delta. And there, in the middle of the haze, it stands: Mount Fry.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h6.regel.1: This is where the Nibble Ring was once baked. Well, almost. It was never fried, and that is why everyone wants to eat it.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h6.regel.2: The plan is simple: climb to the top, ring in the fryer, done. Sam-guh brought pans for it.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h6.regel.3: Smikagol is coming along too. He says he's helping. He's drooling a little. Nyeg.
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h6_be: Reach the base camp at the foot of Mount Fry
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h6_ro: Free the three Smoke Guhlings of Mount Fry
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h6_fl: Flash Smikagol away with the Light Phial when he grabs for the ring
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h6_ge: One Nibble to Share Them All
Watch the Nibble Ring get fried after all. And shared.
structure.guhs.frituurberg.tooltip: The volcano where the Nibble Ring must be fried (Guhbarbecuether, Smoke Delta)
structure.guhs.sausuman_toren.tooltip: The black tower of Sauceruman, the wizard Mika who wants a bite too (Guhbarbecuether)
item.guhs.ringsausuman_ringdeeg.lore: A floppy ring of dough. Not tasty yet. For the Ring Baker
item.guhs.ringsausuman_frituursaus.lore: Sizzling hot. No licking. For the Ring Baker
item.guhs.ringsausuman_ui.lore: The only thing left in there. Round is round, nyeg. For the Ring Baker
item.guhs.ringsausuman_uienring.lore: One ring to eat them all. Not a Nibble Ring, but crispy
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.eerst_pra: This belongs to Sauceruman. Ask him first what he wants with it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.pak.deeg: The Dough Kneader spits out a floppy ring of dough. Plop. That one is for the Ring Baker.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.pak.saus: You tap a jug of sizzling hot frying sauce. No licking. (Tasty though.)
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.pak.kaas: The Cheese Cupboard is empty. Completely empty. There's only an onion left. Oh well: round is round, nyeg.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.heb_je.de: You already have ring dough. One ring at a time, says the Dough Kneader.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.heb_je.ka: There was only one onion. You already have it.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.klaar.dee: The Dough Kneader kneads on without much enthusiasm. You don't need anything else here.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.klaar.sau: Drip. Drip. The Sauce Tap is still leaking. You don't need anything else here.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.klaar.kaa: Now the Cheese Cupboard really is completely empty. There's a note on it: 'BUY CHEESE!!'
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.nog: %s more to go for the Ring Baker
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.bakker.afblijven: HANDS OFF! shouts Sauceruman. Talk to him first before you touch his Ring Baker.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.bakker.mist: The Ring Baker rattles, empty. You have %s of the %s things with you: dough, hot sauce and cheese are upstairs in the tower.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.bakker.koelt_af: The Ring Baker ticks and cools down. In the corner, somebody is sulking very hard.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.bakker.morgen: The Ring Baker has to cool down. Tomorrow it will bake you another onion ring.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.bakker.dagelijks: DING! One fresh onion ring. Sauceruman looks the other way on purpose.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.mikarad.por: The Uruk-Mika looks at you. He doesn't trudge one step faster.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.mikarad.regel: An Uruk-Mika trudges in here. A Mika doesn't run, a Mika gets a ride.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.0: A big eye. It blinks. It's feeling peckish.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.1: Nine riders. They're lost and too shy to ask the way.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.2: A guh running flat out in a wheel. He loves it. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.3: Yourself, from above. You have a crumb on your snoot.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.4: A mountain with the smell of frying coming out of it. It makes you hungry.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.5: Guhdalf. He waves. So he can see you too.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.6: Just sauce. It is only a pan, after all.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.7: Sauceruman, secretly sniffing an onion ring. He sees you looking and quickly goes back to sulking.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.optie.hapje: Want a bite of onion ring?
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.optie.weg: I'll let you sulk for a bit
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.optie.nog_een: May I have another onion ring?
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.beloning.dagelijks: One onion ring from the Ring Baker every day
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.te_vroe: Who are you? No ring? Then you're no use to me. Come back when you've got something round and tasty with you. And wipe your paws!
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.hallo: Well, well. The ring-bearer. I can smell it. Cheese. Crispy. ROUND. I am Sauceruman of Many Sauces: I have a sauce for everything, except something tasty to put it on. Give me a bite of that Nibble Ring. One bite! I'm asking nicely. More or less.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.hallo_o: WHAT? It's GONE? Fried, shared, and I got NOTHING? Even that Eye got a piece! I am Sauceruman of Many Sauces, I was sitting here ready with EIGHT kinds of sauce! Do you really not have one little crumb left for me?
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.zelf_ne: No? NO? To ME? Fine. Perfect. Then I'll bake one MYSELF.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.zelf_de: Later? LATER? I've been waiting for weeks! You know what? Never mind. I'll bake one MYSELF.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.opdrach: My Ring Baker is finished. Almost. It's just still empty. It needs dough from the Dough Kneader, hot sauce from the Sauce Tap and CHEESE from the Cheese Cupboard. It's all upstairs. Would you fetch it? I have to stay here and be important.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.ingredi: %s more things! Dough one floor up, hot sauce two floors up, cheese three floors up. Up the stairs, nyeg. And keep your paws off my Pannantír!
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.hendel: Everything in? Then pull the lever of the Ring Baker! No wait, I want to... no. You do it. If it blows up, it was you.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.mok: ... I'm not saying anything. I'm sulking. I wanted a Nibble Ring, with CHEESE. This is an ONION RING. That's a VEGETABLE. Go away.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.hapje: ... Give it here. *nibble* ... *nibble nibble* ... Nyeg. Pretty tasty. BUT I'M STILL SULKING. Here, take that pan with you, all I ever see in it is that Eye anyway. And those onion rings too. I don't want them. (Leave one behind.)
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.opgeget: You ate it YOURSELF? With me sitting RIGHT HERE? Now I'm sulking DOUBLE. Here, take that pan with you, I never want to see anything round again. And those onion rings too. Yes, I secretly baked a few more. Don't say a word.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.weg: Fine. Off you go. I'm perfectly happy here. In my corner. Alone. With my beard.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.na: What. I'm sulking. Can't you see? ... Was there anything else?
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.te_zwaa: Too heavy, too heavy... That Inventor Guh from the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant dropped by. 'Sauceruman,' he said, 'five machines on one wheel of %s chonk power, that's too heavy. Then everything stands still. And a GUH belongs in a wheel, not a Mika.' What does HE know? ... He was right. Don't tell him that.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.nog_een: The lever. One a day. I'm not looking. I NEVER look.
You've already had one today. The Ring Baker has to cool down. So do I.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.hint.ingrediente: fetch dough, hot sauce and cheese on the three floors of the tower
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.hint.hendel: pull the lever of the Ring Baker, downstairs in the hall
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.hint.mok: Sauceruman is sulking. Offer him a bite of your onion ring
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.hint.klaar: the Ring Baker bakes you one onion ring every day
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.wenk: Do you smell that? Somebody is baking something. It's coming from that black tower, that's where Sauceruman lives. You don't need it for the journey, but your Super Compass knows the way (Barbecue tab), nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.wenk_alleen: Not far from the tree city a black tower stands smoking: the Tower of Sauceruman. You don't need it for the journey, but your Super Compass knows the way (Barbecue tab).
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_sausu: One Onion Ring to Eat Them All
Help Sauceruman bake his own ring. It turns out to be an onion ring. He sulks
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.uitleg: Sauceruman of Many Sauces wants a bite of the Nibble Ring too. He doesn't get one, so he bakes his own. What could go wrong? (You don't need this for the journey.)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.nu.0: Go to the black tower and talk to Sauceruman. He wants something from you. Or let yourself be flown: a Travel Smoke Guh waits at the landing of the tree city.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.waar.0: The Tower of Sauceruman, a short walk from Guhladriel's tree city
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.nu.1: Fetch ring dough (one floor up), hot frying sauce (two floors up) and cheese (three floors up) from the tower.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.waar.1: Upstairs in the Tower of Sauceruman
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.nu.2: Pull the lever of the Ring Baker.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.waar.2: The hall of the Tower of Sauceruman
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.nu.3: Sauceruman is sulking in his Sulking Corner. Offer him a bite of your onion ring.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.waar.3: The hall of the Tower of Sauceruman
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.nu.klaar: Sauceruman is still sulking, but the Ring Baker bakes you an onion ring every day. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.kort.0: Talk to Sauceruman in his tower
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.kort.1: Fetch dough, hot sauce and cheese upstairs in the tower
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.kort.2: Pull the lever of the Ring Baker
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.kort.3: Offer Sauceruman a bite of onion ring
scene.guhs.ringsausuman_bakken.start: Stand back! Sauceruman of Many Sauces is going to bake a RING!
scene.guhs.ringsausuman_bakken.spreuk: One ring to eat them all! One ring to... to... oh well, ONE RING!
scene.guhs.ringsausuman_bakken.pling: DING. Something rolls out. It's round. It's crispy. It smells of... onion.
scene.guhs.ringsausuman_bakken.ui: That's not a Nibble Ring. That's an ONION RING. Who put ONION in there?!
scene.guhs.ringsausuman_bakken.mok: I wanted CHEESE. This is a VEGETABLE. Go away. I'm sulking.
gui.guhs.guhrio.vlag: Flag reached! This is where you pop back if things go wrong, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhrio.klaar: Level %s cleared in %s with %s coins. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhrio.klaar.record: Level %s cleared in %s with %s coins. That's your fastest time, wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhrio.geen_level: This start flag doesn't know which level it is (%s), nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhrio.pijp.kanaal: Channel %s (two pipes or two doors with the same channel belong together)
gui.guhs.guhrio.eerst: This gate is still shut. Clear level %s first, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhrio.stoppen: Press Q once more to step out of the level. Nyeg?
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunt: Big Chonk Coin! That's %s of the 3 in this level. Chonk!
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunten_alle: All eighteen big chonk coins of the castle are yours. Super wahoog chonk!
gui.guhs.guhrio.ei: Something is moving inside that egg... It's Guhshi's! He'll be waiting for you in the keep, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhrio.geen_ei: Guhshi gives you a puzzled look. He only comes along with whoever found his egg (in the cellars), nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhrio.verdwaald: Hey, how did you get here? This place is for playing only. Toad-guh will pop you back at the gate, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhrio.kasteel: The whole castle in one go: %s. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhrio.kasteel.record: The whole castle in one go: %s. That's your fastest run ever, super wahoog!

gui.guhs.spelgroep.guhrio_beloning.waar: In the frying sauce sea of the Guhbarbecuether: Big Nether Mika's Castle, with Toad-guh on the forecourt. Nyeg!

gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.stap.7: The duel with Big Nether Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.0: Find Big Nether Mika's Castle in the frying sauce sea and walk through the gate of level 1-1.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.1: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 1-1 (the courtyard) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!

gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.2: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 1-2 (the courtyard) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.2: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.3: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 2-1 (the cellars) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.3: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.4: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 2-2 (the cellars) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.4: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.5: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 3-1 (the keep) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.5: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.6: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 3-2 (the keep) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.6: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.7: The big gate at the end of the red carpet is open. Behind it waits Big Nether Mika himself. He only shoves, nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.7: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.klaar: The castle is completed. Thank you! But feel free to play again: there are bound to be more chonk coins lying around. Wahoog!
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_levels.d: Clear all six levels of Big Nether Mika's Castle
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_vadsmunt: Find all eighteen big chonk coins of the castle
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_duel.des: Win the duel with Big Nether Mika
structure.guhs.guhrio_kasteel.tooltip: Super Guhrio: six side-scrolling levels, a duel and a kidnapped princess (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.guhriow1.geheim.1_1: Secret found: the Mole Hole under the courtyard. The mole is saving up coins, but finders keepers. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow1.geheim.1_2: Secret found: the gardener's Coin Greenhouse. So THAT'S where they grow. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhriow1.vads: All three big chonk coins of level %s are yours. Chonk, chonk, chonk!
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.bedankt: Thank you! But the princess is in another part of the castle, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.verder: Big Nether Mika took her along 'for a piece of cake'. Why not try the cellars: the gate of level 2-1 is open now. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.alweer.0: You again? How cozy! She's still not here, you know. All I've got is a garden. And no cake.
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.alweer.1: Wahoog, you sure are fast. The princess? Oh no. Another part of the castle. Really truly, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.alweer.2: I stand here waving every single time, and every single time I have to say it. Sorry, nyeg. Would you like a flower?
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.praat: Nyeg? How did you get here, right beside the course? The princess is in another part of the castle. I tell everyone that.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.0: A and D walk, space bar jumps. Hold the space bar for a high jump, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.1: Jump up against the Question Block from below. What could be inside?
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.2: A Guhmba! Jump on top of it: flat. From the side it shoves you back to your flag.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.3: Don't step into the cheese pond! Whoever falls in simply pops back at their flag.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.4: Stand on top of the green pipe and dive in with S.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.5: Some blocks hold a Super Nibble. It makes you big, and when you're big you break bricks!
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.6: Stand in front of the door and press W.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.7: A Shell Mika! Jump on it, then kick its shell away: that tidies things up nicely.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.8: What a wide pond! Hold sprint: with a run-up you jump farther.
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_w1_binne: In Another Part of the Castle
Clear levels 1-1 and 1-2 of the courtyard, and hear from Toad-guh where the princess is NOT
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_w1_tuing: Find the Mole Hole, the Coin Greenhouse and all six big chonk coins of the courtyard
gui.guhs.guhriow2.slot.dicht: The Egg Lock squeaks: no egg, no entry, nyeg! Find Guhshi's Egg (the door under the painted egg).
gui.guhs.guhriow2.slot.open: The Egg Lock sniffs Guhshi's Egg and clicks open. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhriow2.uit: Guhshi has hatched from his egg! Hop onto the nest and he'll carry you. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow2.warp: Warp! The pipe spits you out in level %s, and that level's gate in the hall stays open for you from now on. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhriow2.warp.hal: The warp pipe has opened the gate of level %s for you. Go ahead and walk through, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriow2.warp.dicht: This warp pipe is clogged. Nyeg?
gui.guhs.guhriow2.vads: All six big chonk coins of the cellars are yours. Cellar chonk!
scene.guhs.guhriow2_uit.leg: You lay the egg in the warm nest.
scene.guhs.guhriow2_uit.rug: Guhshi thinks you're his mama. Go on, hop on his back, nyeg!
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_w2_uitge: Find Guhshi's Egg in the cellars and lay it in the warm nest
Find the warp room and let a warp pipe spit you out in another level
gui.guhs.guhriow3.ronde1: Round 1: run underneath him when he jumps and pull the lever, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow3.hendel: CLICK! Half the bridge flomps into the sauce. "MY BRIDGE!"
gui.guhs.guhriow3.pijp: The green pipe takes you back to the bridge, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriow3.ronde2: Round 2: he rolls up in his shell. Jump over it, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow3.ronde3: Round 3: the ?-block is full again. Grab the Fire Pepper and nibble his shell right back!
gui.guhs.guhriow3.treffer: Bullseye! %s more and he rolls into the sauce, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow3.plons: SPLASH! (Don't worry: he can swim. He's just very, very offended.)
gui.guhs.guhriow3.gewonnen: You beat Big Nether Mika in %s. He's not mad anymore: he has cake. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhriow3.parkeer: Guhshi will wait here for you: fire peppers make him sneeze, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriow3.peper_guhshi: You don't throw nibbles while riding Guhshi (he gobbles them up himself). Leave him at a hitching post first, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriow3.padguh: Toad-guh: Psst! Behind that really big gate with the horns it smells like cake. THAT'S where you need to be, I think. Wahoog lots of luck, nyeg!
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.mok: Hmph. Wet. Sticky. And still no cake. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.herrie: Yoo-hoo! Who's making such a racket on my bridge?
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.redden: Did you come to rescue me? How sweet! But I wasn't kidnapped at all, nyeg. I was here baking a cake.
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.stukje: I only wanted a piece. But nobody ever invites a Big Nether Mika over for cake...
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.vragen: Then why not just ask, you big chonker? Here. The biggest piece is for you.
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.voor_mij: FOR ME?! ...Wahoog. But next time I win. After the cake.
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.torenkamer: Come along to the tower room: there's plenty for everyone. Chonk for all guhs!
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.guhriow3_duel.tit: The Duel with Big Nether Mika
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.guhriow3_duel.reg: Behind the big gate he waits: Big Nether Mika, with horns, a red mane and a shell full of spikes.
He only shoves. Whoever gets bumped or falls into the sauce is right back at their flag.
Three rounds: run underneath him to the lever, jump over his rolling shell, and nibble that shell right back with a Fire Pepper.
And don't forget what it was all about: a piece of cake. Nyeg!
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_w3_taart: See how it all turns out for Big Nether Mika, Princess Peachguh and the cake
block.guhs.guhriobeloning_vraagblok.lore: Bonk it with your head (or click): one cheese nibble per player every day. Nom-nyeg!
item.guhs.guhriobeloning_vraagblok.lore: Bonk it with your head (or click): one cheese nibble per player every day. Nom-nyeg!
block.guhs.guhriobeloning_vlaggenmast.lo: Stack them into a pole: the base goes at the bottom, the little flag on top. Click for a party.
item.guhs.guhriobeloning_vlaggenmast.lor: Stack them into a pole: the base goes at the bottom, the little flag on top. Click for a party.
block.guhs.guhriobeloning_pijp.lore: Stand on it and sneak: you pop out at the nearest pipe of the same color, up to 50 blocks away. Use dye to make a different pair.
item.guhs.guhriobeloning_pijp.lore: Stand on it and sneak: you pop out at the nearest pipe of the same color, up to 50 blocks away. Use dye to make a different pair.
block.guhs.guhriobeloning_scorebord.lore: Shows the fastest times of Super Guhrio. Click for your own times.
item.guhs.guhriobeloning_scorebord.lore: Shows the fastest times of Super Guhrio. Click for your own times.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.prijs.kroon: from Princess Peachguh, after the duel
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.intro.1: Nyeg! A hero! I'm Toad-guh. Big Nether Mika has carried off Princess Peachguh. 'For a piece of cake', he said. A PIECE? It was the whole cake, chonk!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.intro.2: Through the gate you reach the level hall: six levels, seen from the side. Nobody hurts you, Mikas only shove. Whoever falls is right back at their flag.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.intro.3: The coins from the levels you spend with me: outfits and building blocks. And look for the three big chonk coins in every level. For all eighteen I've got something very shiny, wahoog!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.hallo: Nyeg, there you are again! You have %s coins in your pouch. What do you fancy?
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.gag: Thank you! But the princess is in another part of the castle, nyeg. (Nicely done though: %s cleared from start to finish. Wahoog!)
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.na_duel: You found the princess! And, was she just sitting there eating cake? Thought so, nyeg. Thanks for everything, hero. The stall stays open!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.gouden_: EIGHTEEN big chonk coins! Super wahoog! Here it is then: the Golden Chonk Cap. Only for the very greatest collectors, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.outfits: Outfits! Fresh from the mushroom. You have %s coins. What will it be?
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.blokken: Building blocks, for at home. Straight from the castle! You have %s coins. What will it be?
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.gekocht: Here you go: %s! Have fun with it, nyeg. You have %s coins left.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.tekort: Nyeg... you're %s coins short (you have %s). Go grab some more in the levels: you get a tip at every flagpole too!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.vadsmun: Your big chonk coins. 1-1: %s  1-2: %s  2-1: %s  2-2: %s  3-1: %s  3-2: %s. That makes %s of the 18, chonk!
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.waar.schild: Shell for on the back (40 coins)
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.fooi: Toad-guh slips you a tip of %s coins. You now have %s in your pouch, nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.wacht: Shh! Don't tell anyone: I haven't been kidnapped at all. The cake here is just really yummy, nyeg. But Big Nether Mika does so love playing knight... Clear all the levels first!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.bijna: All levels cleared, well done! Now just the duel. He only shoves, you know. After that I have something pretty for you, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dank.1: My hero! You won the duel. Big Nether Mika is sulking in the sauce now. It'll pass: he's simply getting cake in a minute.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dank.2: Here, my little crown. For your guh, as a thank-you. And take a cake with you. He was just peckish, you see? Nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dank.3: And look who wants to come with you! Guhshi has been wagging his tail this whole time. Go on, click him: he's yours. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dank.3_: And you already have Guhshi with you, I see. Take good care of him: he'll snap up nibbles from very far away. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.kroon_k: Lost your little crown? Nyeg, heroes... Here's a new one. Put it on right away this time!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dag: Hello hero! Guhshi is still waiting for you over there. Go on, click him, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dag_guh: Hello hero! How is Guhshi doing? Toss him a nibble from me: that's his favorite thing, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.vraag: Guhshi looks at you and wags his tail. Nyeg? May he come with you?
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.wacht: Guhshi gives you a sniff. He only goes along with whoever has won the duel with Big Nether Mika, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.wacht_e: Guhshi remembers you from his egg! Win the duel with Big Nether Mika and he'll come with you. Nyeg nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.al_gete: Nom-nyeg! This Guhshi stays with the princess. You already have yours.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.vrij: Guhshi wants to come with you! He's waiting with Princess Peachguh in the tower room: click him.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.gelukt: Guhshi is yours! He's already wearing his saddle: hop on, jump, and hold space to flutter. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.tong.aan: %s is snapping up nibbles off the ground again, nom!
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.vraagblok.knabbe: Ploink! A cheese nibble from the question block. Another one tomorrow, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.vraagblok.morgen: Tonk. Empty for today: there'll be a nibble in it again tomorrow, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.pijp.hint: Stand on the pipe and sneak (Shift): you pop out at the nearest pipe of the same color.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.pijp.geen_partne: This pipe doesn't come out anywhere. Place another pipe of the same color within %s blocks, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.pijp.afstappen: Hop off first: your guh doesn't fit in the pipe, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.pijp.bezig: Not right now: you're in the middle of something, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.pijp.geverfd: The whole pipe has a fresh new color. Pipes of the same color belong together.

Golden Chonk Cap (from Toad-guh, for all 18 Big Chonk Coins)

gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio_beloning.uitleg: What Super Guhrio leaves you with: Guhshi, outfits, building blocks and eighteen big chonk coins. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio_beloning.nu.0: Talk to Toad-guh. He sits on the counter of his mushroom stall, on the left of the castle forecourt.

gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio_beloning.kort.1: Win the duel and click Guhshi

scene.guhs.ringknipoog_baltoguh.afslag: Hmmm. I think I chonked down a wrong turn... There's no medicine chest here...
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_kistje.zocht: Somebody was looking for that, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_spiegel.titel: One More Thing in the Mirror
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_spiegel.visioen: The mirror shows one more thing: Guhtwo, tucking into a double helping.
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_stitch.titel: Who Keeps Letting That Thing In?
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_stitch.wie: WHO keeps letting that thing in?!
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_boris.berg: A normal guh can't climb this mountain... but maybe, just maybe...
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_sjokkel.ver: And there... comes one more. Very. Slowly.
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_sjokkel.sjokkel: It's Shuckly! He's been on his way since the bridge in Nibblemoria.
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_sjokkel.toetje: Just in time for dessert, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_kloon.twee: Two rings is twice as tasty!
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_sjekel.sjekel: Wow, that ring weighs almost half a shekel, I reckon. Can I have it? Maybe I can buy Liekguh with it... Oh no wait, never mind, that one already has a nose ring.
quest.guhs.ringknipoog.sjokkel.brug: Look at that: there goes Shuckly, shuffling onto the bridge. Very. Slowly.
quest.guhs.ringknipoog.sjokkel.klik: Shuckly is on his way to a party. Better not disturb him, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhpad.uitleg: The big stories open the worlds: first the Guhmension, then the Guhbarbecuether, then the Guh End. Point at a stop and you'll see what you're still missing for it.
gui.guhs.guhpad.slot.open: Open: you may go in here. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhpad.slot.echt: Locked for everyone. For now, nyeg...
gui.guhs.guhpad.leeg: There are no stories here yet.
gui.guhs.guhpad.hier: This is where you are on the Guh Path
gui.guhs.guhpad.klik_halte: Click to jump to these stories
gui.guhs.guhpad.vouw_dicht: Click to fold the stories away
gui.guhs.guhpad.groot: ★ Big story: counts for the Guh Path
gui.guhs.guhpad.eis.knabbelfeest: Guhdalf's nibble party (chapter 1 of the Nibble Ring)
gui.guhs.guhpad.echt.bekend: The only thing anyone knows: you only get there by following all the stories of the Guhmension, the Guhbarbecuether and the Guh End. In the Guh End there are two: The Legend of Guh and Spongeguh Cheesepants.
gui.guhs.guhpad.echt.laag6.tekst: Only opens in the real Guh End.
gui.guhs.guhpad.kompas.uitleg: Points to the nearest big story you haven't done yet. If you're following a story (Guhdex, Tales tab), it points to that story's next step. If that's in another world, it points to the portal.
gui.guhs.guhpad.kompas.dichtstbij: Now: the nearest story you haven't done yet
gui.guhs.guhpad.kompas.geheim.uitleg: A place from %s your story hasn't been to yet. Follow the story and it will show up here by itself. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhpad.kompas.vouw_dicht: Click to fold the places away
quest.guhs.guhpad.guhdalf.nee: Hohoho, nyeg! You don't just go wearing a ring. First show me you're a brave guh and follow these stories in the Guhmension: %s. Come back after that and I'll light the fireworks for you!
quest.guhs.guhpad.grillportaal: The grill portal only sputters a little, nyeg. Guhdalf won't let you through until you've followed these stories in the Guhmension: %s. Your Guhdex (Tales tab) shows the way!
quest.guhs.guhpad.guheindeportaal: The portal to the Guh End stays dark, nyeg. You still need to do this first: %s. Your Guhdex (Tales tab) shows the way!
gui.guhs.guhpad.verhaal.knabbelring: The Lord of the Nibble Ring
gui.guhs.guhpad.wereld.guhmensie.uitleg: Where every guh adventure starts. Everyone may go here right away.
gui.guhs.guhpad.wereld.barbecuether.uitl: Behind the grill portal. Guhdalf won't let you through until you've followed the big stories of the Guhmension.
gui.guhs.guhpad.wereld.guheinde.uitleg: Behind the portal in the Nibble Cellar. First the Nibble Ring, Super Guhrio and the Burnt Mika.
gui.guhs.guhpad.wereld.echt.uitleg: Nobody knows what lies here. Nyeg...
gui.guhs.guhpad.echt.raadsel.1: Beyond the end lies another end.
gui.guhs.guhpad.echt.raadsel.2: Whoever follows every story will hear one more whispering.
gui.guhs.guhpad.echt.raadsel.3: The last little nibble is never the last. Nyeg?
scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.storm: The storm grows thicker and thicker. Past three blocks, all you can see is white.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.kwijt: Sniff... sniff... nothing but snow. I can't find the way, nyeg.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.wolf: And then there she stands, on Wolf Rock. A white wolf guh. She glows softly, like a little star.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.boris: A regular guh would never make it. But a Baltoguh...
scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.half: Half guh, half wolf... and that's just right. Howl along!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.klaart: The storm settles down. And look: there are the posts again!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.titel: Day 45: The Night of the Bang
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.dag45: Day 45. Thunder rumbled over Clone Island. And in the clone tank... something bubbled.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.krak: CRACK! A split shot right across the glass.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.ogen: And in the pink nibble juice, two purple eyes opened.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.wie: Who am I... and where are my nibbles?
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.begon: And then... then it all came back to me. Nyeg!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_ohana.nacht: When everyone's asleep, 626-guh sits all by himself at the campfire. With the picture book.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_ohana.erbij: Scoot over, little chonk. I'll sit with you.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_ohana.citaat: Ohana means family. Family means nobody gets left behind... or forgotten. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_ohana.sterren: And above Guhwai'i, a thousand stars watched along. Nobody forgotten. Nobody.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.drie: A crystal, a golden nibble and a feather. That was all the Snuggleheart needed.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.wolken: High above the little chapel, the clouds slid open...
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.straal: ...and through the heart window fell a beam of light, right onto the heart.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.bonk: Thump... thump. The Snuggleheart beats again!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.vahoeg: WAHOOG, it's beating! For you, and for all your guhs waiting for you up in the clouds.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.nooit: From now on, nobody ever has to truly say goodbye again.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_grill.blokje: One Fire Starter Cube in the grill coal frame. Tsss...
scene.guhs.oudescenes_grill.loopt: ...and off runs the little flame, all around the frame!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_grill.ruik: Smell that? Cheese frying sauce, all the way from the other side! Nyeg nyeg nyeg.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_grill.verte: And far away, on top of a charred guh statue, someone in a pointy hat stood watching.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_grill.begonnen: Hm. The fire is burning again. Then it has begun, nyeg.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.tok: Tap, tap, TAP! The very last roof fluff is on.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.vlag: And there it flutters: the topping-out flag!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.dak: WAHOOG! With a roof on, it's finally a real little house.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.wie: Now it just needs someone to live in it... Nyeg?
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.trippel: And who comes pitter-pattering along, with a teeny-tiny suitcase full of nibbles?
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.knus: The first little resident. Little house, little guh. Cozy!
gui.guhs.snuffel.maatje.a.tekst: A little ball of seed fluff with a seed underneath and a leaf for a sail. Drifts along on the wind and steers with the leaf; light and airy, easy to spot against grass.
gui.guhs.snuffel.maatje.b.tekst: A little acorn with its cap pulled low over its eyes, a tuft of moss and two twig arms. Can point and wave with the twigs; the cap bobs along when it's up to something.
gui.guhs.snuffel.maatje.c.tekst: A glowing little dandelion head with petals all around and a curly tail. Gives off light (handy in the dark) and leaves a trail of fluffy sparks.
block.guhs.guhstation.lore: A gray-black game console with a guh snoot on it. It smells a little of sea air and wet dog
item.guhs.guhstation.lore: A gray-black game console with a guh snoot on it. It smells a little of sea air and wet dog
block.guhs.guhstation.tooltip: Put it down and click it: that's how you go back to Sniff Island
item.guhs.guhstation.tooltip: Put it down and click it: that's how you go back to Sniff Island
item.guhs.music_disc_snuffeleiland.lore: The little tune of the island. Captain Saltsnout played it on his boat every day
item.guhs.snuffel_geheugenkaart.lore: Everything your nose has learned is on here. A dog never misplaces it
item.guhs.snuffel_geheugenkaart.tooltip: Use it to save and go home
item.guhs.snuffel_bloesemtakje: Blossom Twig from Your Little Tree
item.guhs.snuffel_bloesemtakje.lore: Your buddy's little tree gave it to you to take along. It smells of Sniff Island, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.post_wacht: %s more things from the island are waiting for a free spot in your pockets
gui.guhs.snuffel.post_mee: %s x %s comes home with you. A dog has no pockets, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.aangespoeld: The waves wash you back ashore on the island. Nyeg, what a splash
gui.guhs.snuffel.stroming: The current is too strong here. Better swim back to the island
gui.guhs.snuffel.regels.poten: You can't build or break with pawsies. But you can sniff and dig, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.reis.geen_eiland: Sniff Island can't be reached right now
gui.guhs.snuffel.reis.spel_bezig: Finish your game first, then you can go to the island
gui.guhs.snuffel.reis.even_wachten: Just a teeny bit longer, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.reis.thuis: Home again, right where you were. All your things are still here. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.snuffel.meter.dichtbij: Very close! Keep sniffing a bit... (%s)
gui.guhs.snuffel.graaf_niets: Nothing here. Just sand between your toes, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.geur_geleerd: New scent in your sniff book: %s (%s). You now know %s scents. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.snuffel.rang.omhoog: Your nose has grown! You are now a %s. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.snuffel.boom.groeit.1: A little sprout is coming up by the ring of stones!
gui.guhs.snuffel.boom.groeit.2: The little sprout has become a shoot!
gui.guhs.snuffel.boom.groeit.3: The shoot has become a little bush!
gui.guhs.snuffel.boom.groeit.4: The little bush has become a young tree. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.snuffel.examen.start: %s begins: sniff out the %s scents. Take your time, there's no such thing as failing, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.guhstation.onbekend: The little screen stays black. This little box belongs to Sniff Island: first find a dock cottage by the water, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.guhstation.nee: No, I'd rather not sniff right now, nyeg
gui.guhs.snuffel.toets.kaart: Memory card: save and go home
gui.guhs.snuffel.keuze.kop_maatje: Which buddy is coming with you?
gui.guhs.snuffel.keuze.alleen_jij: Your buddy is a forest sprite that only you can see.
gui.guhs.snuffel.boekje.later: Ranks 2 through 5 come in a later story
gui.guhs.snuffel.boekje.leeg: Nothing yet. Hold down the sniff key and follow your nose, nyeg
quest.guhs.snuffel.bewoner.hallo: Woof! Er, I mean: nyeg! Lovely weather for sniffing, isn't it?
quest.guhs.snuffel.kapitein.vraag: Ahoy, landlubber! My little boat is all ready. Shall I sail you back home? You'll land right where you came from, with all your things. And the island isn't going anywhere, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffel.kapitein.geen_hond: Ahoy! You don't look like a dog. How did you wash up here, nyeg?
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.uitleg: Your little brother or sister is sick and only the healing flower can help. On Sniff Island you're a dog and you learn to sniff, nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.stap.1: Choose your dog and set sail
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.0: Look for a dock cottage by the water. Your Super Compass (My Story) shows the way.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.0: A dock cottage on a Deep Guh Sea in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.1: Little Wobble is sick and Papa has been gone for weeks. Go to the sickbed in the cottage. Then choose your dog and your buddy with Captain Saltsnout, and sail out onto the water with him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.1: The dock cottage: the sickbed in the cottage, the captain at the end of the dock
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.2: You're a dog! Wendy Wagtail found you on the beach and has run on ahead. Follow the path to Sniffville and talk to her at the beach gate.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.3: Tell Doctor Plasterpaw what's going on at home. His office is the white house with the red cross, by the square.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.4: Master Trufflenose will teach you to sniff. Go through the gate on the north side of the square to the meadow and talk to him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.5: All sorts of things are toppling over in the square, but nobody sees who's doing it. Go have a look by the well.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.6: The villagers have mislaid all sorts of things. Talk to the baker, the fisher, the teacher, Granny, the gardener or Little Droolball. With every good deed your buddy's little tree grows.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.7: The little tree is a young tree now: your nose is ready. Talk to Master Trufflenose in the meadow.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.8: You've got your diploma: you're a Sniff Pup! Your buddy wants to show you something by the little tree, on the little hill in the meadow.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.klaar: You're a real Sniff Pup and you have a trace of Papa. With the Guhstation you can go back to the island whenever you like. To be continued, nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.thuis: The story continues on Sniff Island. Go to a dock cottage by the water and ask the captain to take you across.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.thu: A dock cottage on a Deep Guh Sea in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.4_bot: Lesson 1: hold the sniff key and walk to where the orange meter swings the hardest. Swinging all the way? Then just hold down your left mouse button: as a dog you do not break the block, you dig.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.4_b: The meadow, right by Master Trufflenose
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.4_flu: Lesson 2: the master's whistle lies farther off in the meadow, by the hedge on the west side. Blue is a thing. Dig it up.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.4_bij: Lesson 3: not everything lies under the ground. Stand right by the bee oak on the west side of the meadow and keep sniffing.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.4_b: The big oak on the west side of the meadow
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.4_ter: Found it! Go back to Master Trufflenose.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.6_zoe: Sniff out what the villagers have mislaid (your buddy points the way) and dig it up. Can't remember where? Just ask them again.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.6_z: Sniffville, the meadow and the beach
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.6_bre: You've found something! Bring it back to whoever was missing it.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.7_bez: The exam is on: sniff out the four hidden scents, one of each color. There's no such thing as failing.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.7_dip: Found all four! Get your diploma from Master Trufflenose.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.8_snu: Between the stones by the little tree you smell something strange. Sniff and dig!
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.0: Look for a dock cottage by the water
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.1: Go to the sickbed, choose your dog and set sail
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.2: Walk to the village and talk to Wendy Wagtail
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.3: Talk to Doctor Plasterpaw (the house with the red cross)
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.4: Talk to Master Trufflenose in the meadow
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.4_b: Lesson 1: sniff out the chew bone. To dig: hold down your left mouse button
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.4_f: Lesson 2: sniff out the whistle (blue, farther off)
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.4_b: Lesson 3: sniff by the bee oak (green, no digging)
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.5: Have a look by the well in the square
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.6: Ask the villagers what they've mislaid
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.6_z: Sniff out what the villagers have mislaid
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.7: Talk to Master Trufflenose about your exam
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.7_b: Exam: sniff out the four scents
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.7_d: Get your diploma from Master Trufflenose
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.8: Go to your buddy's little tree
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.8_s: Sniff and dig by the little tree
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.thu: Go back to Sniff Island (dock cottage)
structure.guhs.steigerhuisje.tooltip: A cottage with a dock on the Deep Guh Sea. This is where the story of Sniff Island begins
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.feest_zo: Shh, the Lantern Feast is about to begin. Come and watch, nyeg!
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.hint.ziekbed: Little Wobble is in bed in the cottage. Hurry and have a look
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.hint.kapitein: Talk to Captain Saltsnout at the end of the dock
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.1: There you are. Now don't be alarmed: Wobble is as hot as a little stove and won't even touch a nibble. And a pup that turns its nose up at a nibble... that's the sniffle fever, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.2: Only one thing helps against that: the healing flower. It only grows on Sniff Island, far away across the Deep Guh Sea.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.3: Your papa went looking for it weeks ago. Weeks! And since then: not a letter, not a woof, nothing. I'm worried about old Wanderpaw.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.4: Whimper... I want Papa... and a nibble... but Papa first...
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.5: Listen closely. Here in the Guhmension you look the way you always do. But on Sniff Island you're simply who you are: a dog, just like Wobble and your papa. And only a dog with a good nose will find that flower.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.6: I'll watch over Wobble, day and night. But somebody has to go and fetch the flower. And look for Papa.
gui.guhs.snuffelsteiger.optie.nadenken: I need to think it over for a bit
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.buur.dapper: Brave, nyeg! Captain Saltsnout is moored at the dock with The Wet Nose. He's the only one who knows the way to the island.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.buur.ga: Off you go to the captain, at the end of the dock. I'll stay with Wobble.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.buur.terug: %s! Wobble is sleeping restlessly, but I'm right here. Do you have the flower yet? Not yet? Then quickly back to the island, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.buur.spoor: A trace of Papa? Really truly, %s? Then it's sure to turn out fine. Wobble is dreaming of it already, just look.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.pup.ga: Whimper... are you going to fetch Papa? And the flower? And... a nibble for the road?
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.pup.spoor: Yip! %s, did you smell Papa? Really really? Then I'll get better soon. Nyeg...
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.kapitein.eerst: Ahoy. What a fright, eh, with the little one. Go and look in at the sickbed first, in the cottage. I'm not going anywhere, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.kapitein.wie: To Sniff Island? That's a wild crossing, landlubber. And only dogs walk around there: the moment you set paw ashore, you're one yourself again. So tell me: which dog are you, under that coat? And which buddy is coming along with you?
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.kapitein.gekoz: A %s called %s, with %s as a buddy. Well, well, nyeg! Just say the word when you're ready to set sail.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.kapitein.klaar: Everything on board, %s? There's rough weather coming, I can feel it in my whiskers. Shall we set sail?
gui.guhs.snuffelsteiger.optie.andere_hon: I'd like a different dog or a different buddy after all
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.kapitein.weer: Ahoy, %s! The Wet Nose is ready. Back to Sniff Island? This time you stay in the boat, deal?
gui.guhs.snuffelsteiger.optie.blijven: I'll stay here a little longer
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.avond: It's the evening of the Lantern Feast. The whole little village is out on the dock.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.ahoi: Ahoy! Lanterns lit, bones on the table. Let's feast, nyeg!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.bed: Little Wobble should have been in bed ages ago. But a feast is a feast...
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.mandje: Wobble! You belong in your basket!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.gloeit: Oh no! Wobble is burning up!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.binnen: Quick, inside. Into bed with you!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.los: All paws on deck? Then we cast off. On to Sniff Island, nyeg!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.uit: And so you set sail, out onto the pink Guh Sea. For Wobble. And for Papa.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.luch: See that dark sky over there? I don't like it. Not one bit, nyeg.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.golv: Hold on tight! Waves as tall as a Guh House!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.teru: This is getting too wild! I'm turning back. We'll try again tomorrow.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.nee: Tomorrow is too late for Wobble! Then I'll swim!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.land: Landlubber! Come back! ... Nyeg. That's a brave one. Or plain bonkers.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.zwar: The waves grow taller and taller... and then everything goes black.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_vaart.weer: Cast off those lines! And mind: no jumping overboard this time, nyeg.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_thuiskomst.daa: There they are! Welcome home, nyeg!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_thuiskomst.thu: Safe at the dock, landlubber. The island isn't going anywhere.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.redder.welkom.0: There you are, %s! Welcome to Sniffville. Everybody here lives on four paws, nyeg. I'm Wendy Wagtail: I comb the beach and find all sorts of things. Today I found you!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.redder.welkom.1: You came rolling out of the sea like a wet sock. Don't worry: being a dog now is just part of the island. At home you're simply yourself again, and all your things are safe there, waiting for you.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.redder.welkom.2: But first, off to Doctor Plasterpaw. His office is the white house with the red cross, right by the square. Just tell him everything. Go on, tail up!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.redder.dag.0: Found anything nice yet? Today I found three shells, a boot and a dog. The dog was you, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.redder.klaar.0: A trace of your father, I heard already! If I find anything of his on the beach, I'll keep it for you. Beachcomber's honor.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.verhaal.0: Well well, a washed-up pup. Let's see... nose wet, tail in one piece, four paws. Fit as a fiddle! But you look so worried, %s. Go on, tell the doctor.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.verhaal.1: Your little brother or sister is sick... and your father has been gone for weeks, looking for the healing flower? Hm. Yes. That flower is real. It grows here, deep on Sniff Island.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.verhaal.2: But you can't SEE it, only SMELL it. Only a real sniff nose can find it. And your nose... well. That's still a human nose in a dog's snout, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.verhaal.3: Go to Master Trufflenose, in the meadow behind the little gate on the north side of the square. He turns every pup into a sniffer. Just say Plasterpaw sent you. And wipe your paws!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.dag.0: Nose wet, tail up: then everything turns out fine. Doctor's orders! And sniff something new every day.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.klaar.0: A scarf of your father's, by the little tree! Then he really was here. Rest up well, little sniff pup. The trail isn't going anywhere.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.eerst_dok: Hmm... you smell of seawater and questions. Go see Doctor Plasterpaw in the village first. After that, we talk.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les1.0: Aha, %s. Plasterpaw sent you. I am Master Trufflenose, and I smelled you coming when you were still lying on the beach. You will learn that too.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les1.1: Lesson one: HOLD THE SNIFF KEY. Your nose goes to the ground and the scent meter appears on your screen. The closer you are to the scent, the harder it swings.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les1.2: The color tells you what you smell. Orange is something tasty. I have buried a chew bone close by. Swinging all the way? Then you are standing on it, and then you DIG.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les1.3: Digging is simple: just hold down your left mouse button. You are a dog now, so you do not break the block: you dig! Keep holding until the chew bone comes up. Seek!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les1_hint: Nose down, tail up! Hold the sniff key and walk to where the orange meter swings hardest. The chew bone is close by, in the grass. Standing on it? Then just hold down your left mouse button: as a dog you do not break the block, you dig!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les2.0: A chew bone, and not even eaten. Well done! That was orange: something tasty. Lesson two: BLUE. Blue is a thing.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les2.1: My whistle is missing. It is somewhere farther off in the meadow, toward the hedge. The farther away, the fainter the scent: simply walk the way the meter grows. Seek!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les2_hint: My whistle is farther off, on the west side of the meadow, by the hedge. Walk with your nose to the ground until the blue meter grows. Swinging all the way: dig!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les3.0: My whistle! Fweet... hm, there is sand in it. Thank you. Lesson three: GREEN. Green is an animal. And not everything lies under the ground: some scents hang somewhere.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les3.1: Bees live in the big oak on the west side of the meadow. Stand close to it and keep sniffing until you have caught the scent. No digging, no nipping. Bees nip back, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les3_hint: The bees live in the big oak on the west side of the meadow. Stand close to it and hold the sniff key until your nose knows. No need to dig.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.lessen_kl: Tasty things, things, animals: three colors in your sniff book, %s. The fourth color is purple: something strange. That one I cannot teach you. You will smell it by yourself, one day.
Do you hear that? Rattling and barking, on the square! Things have been falling over there all week and nobody sees who is doing it. You go and have a look, with that fresh nose of yours.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.kabaal.0: That racket is coming from the square. Go have a look by the well, pup. I am staying here: my ears are too long for running.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.daden.0: Real sniffers help the village. You have done %s of the %s good deeds. Is your buddy's little tree a young tree? Then you come back for your exam.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.examen.0: The little tree is pretty as a picture, %s. Time for the SNIFFING EXAM! There's no such thing as failing: your nose may take as long as it likes.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.examen.1: I have hidden four scents in the meadow and the village. One of each color: something tasty, a thing, an animal and... something strange. Two are buried, two hang somewhere.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.examen.2: On your screen you can see how many you have. Got all four? Then come back for your diploma. Nose down, tail up. Seek!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.examen_hi: You have %s of the %s. Something tasty lies in the meadow, my spare cap by the meadow gate, the animal lives in Gardener Turnip's vegetable patch and the strange thing stands right by the roadblock. Seek!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.diploma.0: All four! And not a single one eaten! Sit. No, stay standing, you are wagging too hard. Ahem.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.diploma.1: I, Master Trufflenose, hereby declare that %1$s has passed the sniffing exam. From now on you are officially: %2$s. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.diploma.2: There are five ranks. Sniff Nose, the second, you become at twenty scents: then you may pass the roadblock. But that is for later. Hey... your buddy is fluttering so. I believe it wants to show you something by the little tree.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.boom.0: Your buddy wants to show you something by the little tree, on the little hill. Go have a look. And bring your nose.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.klaar.0: A trace of your father, beyond the roadblock... You may only pass there as a Sniff Nose, rank two of five. Keep sniffing, pup. Every new scent counts, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.hallo.0: Fresh bread! Well, almost. Without a rolling pin it's more of a ball. Come back later, pup, I'm busy grumbling.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.vraag.0: My rolling pin is gone! Yesterday it was still on the windowsill, this morning: poof. Without a rolling pin all I can bake is rolls. The whole village has been eating rolls for three days!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.vraag.1: You've had sniffing lessons, haven't you? It smells of dough: something tasty, so orange. Find it for me and I'll bake flat loaves again. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.hint.0: My rolling pin smells of fresh dough. Last night I heard something rolling, past the little school, toward the fisherman's hut. Somewhere in the grass there, I think. Nose down!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.terug.0: My rolling pin! And there's still dough on it! Flat bread again at last. Always a crust for you, pup. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.dank.0: Flat bread, flat cookies, flat everything. Thanks to you! Want a crust? Oh no, wait. Eaten. Sorry.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.hallo.0: Shh. The fish are sleeping. Or I am. One of the two. Come back later, pup.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.vraag.0: My favorite bobber is gone. Red and white. Without a bobber I can't tell if I've got a bite. I've been sitting here since Tuesday. It is still Tuesday, isn't it?
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.vraag.1: It smells of fish. Everything of mine smells of fish. That's green on your meter: an animal. Will you look for it? Then I'll catch a fish for you. If I get a bite.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.hint.0: My bobber drifted off with the tide, to the little beach south of the harbor. Just follow the coast with your nose. It smells of fish, same as me.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.terug.0: My bobber! Red, white and still wet. Now I can tell again when I've got a bite. Hey... I've got a bite! Oh no. Seaweed.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.dank.0: Bobber bobs, fisher fishes. As it should be. Thank you, pup. Shh, don't wag so hard, you'll startle the fish.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.hallo.0: Good morning! Or is it afternoon already? Without the school bell nobody knows what time it is. Come back later, pup. Once I know when later is.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.vraag.0: The school bell is gone! Now class never starts, and it never ends either. The pups have been at recess since Monday. They think it's wonderful. I don't.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.vraag.1: A bell is a thing, so blue on your meter. It smells of copper and chalk. Will you look for it? Then you get an A for sniffing.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.hint.0: In the night I heard jingling in the meadow, all the way at the back by the pond. The bell smells of copper and chalk. Blue on your meter!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.terug.0: DING-A-LING! Oh, how I've missed that. Recess is over, pups! ...They've already run off. An A with a gold star for you.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.dank.0: Ding-a-ling! Class starts on time again. The pups like that less than I do, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.hallo.0: Hello, dearie. My, how thin you are. Do you even have a scarf? Come back later and I'll knit you one. If I can find my wool.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.vraag.0: My ball of wool has rolled away, dearie. The lilac one. I was working on a sweater for the captain. It has one sleeve now. It looks so odd.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.vraag.1: Wool smells of sheep, so green on your meter. If you find it, I'll knit something for you too. Four little socks. One for each paw.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.hint.0: It rolled out the door, through the beach gate, all the way to the sand on the west side of the beach. Wool smells of sheep, dearie. Green!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.terug.0: My lilac ball! Full of sand, but I'll beat that right out. Now the captain gets his second sleeve. And you get four little socks. Nyeg, dearie.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.dank.0: The captain's sweater is finished. It has three sleeves by accident. But it's the thought that counts, dearie.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.hallo.0: Don't stand on the carrots! And no digging in my vegetable patch. Digging is for outside the fence. Come back later, pup.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.vraag.0: My little watering can is gone! My turnips are thirsty. I'm watering them with my hat now, but it leaks. And then I've got a wet head.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.vraag.1: A watering can is a thing: blue. It smells of rainwater and a little of turnip. Can you find it? Then you get the biggest carrot in the garden. To look at.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.hint.0: I last had it in the meadow, on the east side, where I pick clover. Blue on your meter, and it smells of rainwater.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.terug.0: My little watering can! Come along, little turnips, drink up! And for you: the biggest carrot in the garden. No, don't dig it up. Look.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.dank.0: The turnips are growing like weeds. And the weeds are growing like weeds too. Thanks to you and my little watering can, pup.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.pup.hallo.0: Yip! Yip yip! Play? I have a ball! Oh no. I HAD a ball. Yip...
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.pup.vraag.0: Yip! My bouncy ball is gone! It bounced and bounced and then it was GONE. I looked everywhere. Well, here. I looked here.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.pup.vraag.1: It's red and it's covered in drool. Mine! Will you find it? Will you find it? Will you find it? Yip!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.pup.hint.0: It bounced out the beach gate, to the beach! I'm not allowed to go there alone. It's covered in drool, so you'll smell it right away. Yip!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.pup.terug.0: MY BALL! Yip yip yip! You're the best dog on the whole island! After me. Play? Play!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.kapitein.vraag.0: Ahoy, landlubber! My little boat is ready. Shall I sail you back home? You'll end up exactly where you came from, with all your things. The island isn't going anywhere, and neither is your nose, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.kapitein.vraag_kl: Ahoy, sniff pup! Sailing home? With your Guhstation you can come back whenever you like. Can't find that little box? Just say so, I've got a few more in the hold.
Captain Saltsnout slides a new Guhstation over to you. It goes home with you, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.kapitein.plaat.0: Captain Saltsnout: Hold on, sniff pup! This music disc is for you. I've been playing it on my boat for years and the seagulls have had quite enough of it. Into the jukebox at home with it, nyeg!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_wakker.golven: Waves. Sand in your ears. And something wet sniffing at your snout...
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_wakker.hallo: Sniff sniff... Hey! You're okay! Nyeg, you're so wet.
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_wakker.wakker: Wake up, sleepyhead! You've washed ashore on Sniff Island.
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_wakker.pootjes: Wait a minute... pawsies?! A tail?! You're a DOG!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_wakker.kom: I'm Wendy Wagtail. Come along to the village, a doctor lives there!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_maatje.kef: Yip! The bucket! It's moving by itself!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_maatje.alweer: Again! Who keeps DOING that? I don't see anybody, nyeg!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_maatje.alleen_jij: There, above the well... does nobody see that?
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_maatje.zien: Hee hee... wait. You're looking at me. Can you SEE me?!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_maatje.blijf: Nobody ever sees me! I'm staying with you. Nyeg!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_spoor.sjaal: A scarf. Blue with stripes. It smells of... PAPA!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_spoor.spoor: Papa was here! His trail leads up the island, past the roadblock.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.les_gevonden: Found it! Go back to Master Trufflenose
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.breng_terug: Found it! Bring it back to %s
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.examen_klaar: All four scents found! Go back to Master Trufflenose for your diploma. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.daden_klaar: Your buddy's little tree is a young tree! Master Trufflenose is waiting for you in the meadow: time for your exam.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.versperring: You may only pass here as a Sniff Nose
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.zee: Nyeg, the sea is far too wild for doggy paws! The waves put you back on dry land
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.wakker.1: You're a dog on Sniff Island! Walk down the path to the village: Wendy Wagtail is waiting by the beach gate.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.wakker.2: Your own things are safe at home. With the memory card in your hotbar you can always go back home.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.maatje.1: %s: Hee hee! That bucket, that was me. And the rolling pin. And the school bell. And... well. I like hiding things. Sorry, nyeg.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.maatje.2: %s: Shall we bring everything back together? With every good deed my little tree in the meadow grows! When you sniff, I'll point the way.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.bloesem.1: %s: Look! My little tree is blooming, thanks to you. This blossom twig is for you. It goes home with you.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.bloesem.2: %s: Hey... do you smell that too? Between the stones by the little tree. Something strange. Have a sniff!
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.einde.1: A trace of Papa! It leads farther up the island, past the roadblock. You may only pass there as a Sniff Nose.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.einde.2: %s: Oh yes, this was in my hiding spot too. A gray-black little box with a guh snoot on it: a Guhstation! Put it down at home and you'll be back with me in no time.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.einde.plaat: %s: And Captain Saltsnout told me to give you this music disc. He's been playing it on his boat for years and the seagulls have had quite enough of it. Into the jukebox at home with it, nyeg!
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.einde.3: The first story of Sniff Island is done. You're a real Sniff Pup! To be continued, nyeg.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.doel.terug: A dock cottage (the boat to Sniff Island)
gui.guhs.snuffel.geur.deegroller: A rolling pin covered in dough
gui.guhs.snuffel.geur.dobber: A bobber that smells of fish
gui.guhs.snuffel.geur.stuiterbal: A bouncy ball covered in drool
gui.guhs.snuffel.daad.oma_bolwol: returned Granny Woolly's ball of wool
gui.guhs.snuffel.daad.tuinder_gietertje: returned Gardener Turnip's little watering can
block.guhs.guh_dakpan_grijs_plaat: Soft Gray Guh Roof Tile Slab
item.guhs.guh_dakpan_grijs_plaat: Soft Gray Guh Roof Tile Slab
block.guhs.guh_dakpan_grijs_trap: Soft Gray Guh Roof Tile Stairs
item.guhs.guh_dakpan_grijs_trap: Soft Gray Guh Roof Tile Stairs
block.guhs.shoji.lore: Click: the panel slides open. Two side by side slide open together. Nyeg!
item.guhs.shoji.lore: Click: the panel slides open. Two side by side slide open together. Nyeg!
block.guhs.tatami.lore: Two side by side become one mat. Sneaking: half a mat. Lovely for a chonky lie-down.
item.guhs.tatami.lore: Two side by side become one mat. Sneaking: half a mat. Lovely for a chonky lie-down.
block.guhs.toro.lore: Lights up by itself when it gets dark, and goes out again in the morning.
item.guhs.toro.lore: Lights up by itself when it gets dark, and goes out again in the morning.
block.guhs.geharkt_zand.lore: Rake it with a hoe for a different pattern. You can rake plain sand too.
item.guhs.geharkt_zand.lore: Rake it with a hoe for a different pattern. You can rake plain sand too.
block.guhs.geharkt_zand_ring.lore: Makes rings around a boulder or a circle by itself. Sneak with a hoe: turn it yourself.
item.guhs.geharkt_zand_ring.lore: Makes rings around a boulder or a circle by itself. Sneak with a hoe: turn it yourself.
block.guhs.bonsai_pot.lore: Snip it with shears for a different shape. Snip snip, nyeg.
item.guhs.bonsai_pot.lore: Snip it with shears for a different shape. Snip snip, nyeg.
block.guhs.guh_dakpan_roze_hoek.lore: Curls up by itself at the end and on the corner of your roof edge. Wahoog!
item.guhs.guh_dakpan_roze_hoek.lore: Curls up by itself at the end and on the corner of your roof edge. Wahoog!
