block.guhs.guh_dakpan_wit_hoek.lore: Curls up by itself at the end and on the corner of your roof edge. Wahoog!
item.guhs.guh_dakpan_wit_hoek.lore: Curls up by itself at the end and on the corner of your roof edge. Wahoog!
block.guhs.guh_dakpan_grijs_hoek.lore: Curls up by itself at the end and on the corner of your roof edge. Wahoog!
item.guhs.guh_dakpan_grijs_hoek.lore: Curls up by itself at the end and on the corner of your roof edge. Wahoog!
block.guhs.wolkenbed.hier_niet: You can't sleep here, nyeg! Not even on a cloud.
subtitles.guhs.wolkenweide.sfeer: Wind and little bells far away
item.guhs.koivoer.tooltip: Hold it near the water: the koi come for a bite. Right-click the water to scatter a handful, nyeg!
item.guhs.koi_emmer.tooltip: Empty the bucket into your own pond: your koi will live there for good
gui.guhs.wolkenschaapje.gehouden: This cloud lamb stays with you now. Baa-nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.koi: Rarity: Common (ponds of Babbledale and Blossom Lake)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.koi: A chubby, calm pond fish with guh eyes, rosy cheeks and two round guh ears for fins. There are red-and-white, tricolor, pink, blue and golden koi. Hold koi food and they come up for a bite. Scoop one up with a bucket of water and it lives in your pond for good. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.wolkenschaapje: Rarity: Only in the Cloud Meadow
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.wolkenschaapje: A lamb that is almost all cloud. It floats a hand's width above the grass and drifts gently around. Snip it with shears for cloud fluff: after a while it is just as fluffy again. Give it nibble feed or take it along on a lead, and it stays with you. Baa-nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.bloesemguh: A blossom-white guh with pink petals in his fur and a little blossom by his ear. He likes to lie under the guh blossom trees by the water all day, and takes a nap on the shore in the evening. Tame him with cheese nibbles!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.tanukiguh: A gray-brown guh with a dark little mask, a thick ringed bushy tail and a leaf on his head. Nobody knows why that leaf never falls off. Lives in Babbledale and naps by the babbling water in the evening. Tame him with cheese nibbles, nyeg!
gui.guhs.superkompas.biomes.tooltip: All biomes, per dimension. Pick one and your Super Compass points to the nearest!
gui.guhs.superkompas.sectie.guhmension.s: You have never been here. Step through a guh portal into the Guhmension, and this little lock opens by itself. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.superkompas.sectie.barbecuether: You have never been here. Find a barbecue pit in the Guhmension and step through the barbecue portal. It is hot there though, nyeg!
gui.guhs.superkompas.sectie.guheinde.slo: You have never been here. Deep under the Guhmension lies a Nibble Cellar, and there stands a portal. Do you dare? Nyeg!
gui.guhs.superkompas.sectie.echte_guhein: Nobody has been here yet... nyeg?
gui.guhs.biokompas.niet_geweest: You have not been here yet, nyeg...
gui.guhs.biokompas.tip_elders: This biome lies in: %s. Your Super Compass shows the way there!
gui.guhs.biokompas.niets: %s: not found nearby, nyeg. Walk a good bit further and I will search again!
gui.guhs.biokompas.elders: %s lies somewhere else: %s. Your Super Compass shows the way there!
quest.guhs.weeb.zwaai.e: You too, guh-chan? Wave us off! We'll bring something back for you. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.weeb.zwaai.n: Ittekimasu, senpai! We're off to Japan. Don't touch the figurines.
quest.guhs.weeb.cadeau: You get a present from Japan: %s
quest.guhs.weeb.ruil.ja: A double? Sugoi. Swapping is collecting too, senpai.
quest.guhs.weeb.ruil.hier: Here, guh-chan. You didn't have this one yet. Kawaii!
quest.guhs.weeb.ruil.enige: You only have one of those. That one's a keeper. Bring a double, nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.ruil.compleet: Your set is already complete, guh-chan. Sugoi! You can keep that double.
quest.guhs.weeb.compleet: Your whole set is complete. A true weeb. Wahoog, we're so proud!
gui.guhs.weeb.ballon: Evichonk and Nielschonk's balloon. Not real public transport, says Nielschonk.
gui.guhs.weeb.beschermd: Don't touch the Weeb House. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.figuurtjes: Don't touch. That's a limited edition.
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.poster: It hangs exactly straight. Don't touch, senpai.
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.dakimakura: A guh dakimakura. It's Nielschonk's. Don't sit on it.
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.loket: Evichonk's mini counter. Stamps, an ink pad and a little stack of passports.
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.nummerautomaat: Your number: 047. There are 46 guhs waiting ahead of you. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.loketbord.open: Counter open. Take a number. (Passports only at the Guh Town Hall.)
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.briefje: Gone to Japan for a bit. Back tomorrow. Don't touch the figurines. — E & N
gui.guhs.japan.lore: From Japan. A present from Evichonk and Nielschonk.
gui.guhs.japan.eten: From Japan. Yummy for you and for your guh. Itadakimasu!
structure.guhs.weebhuisje.tooltip: A guh-Japanese little house in Babbledale. Evichonk and Nielschonk live there. When they're home.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.1.1: Ohayo, guh-chan! Come in, shoes off. Kawaii little house, right?
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.1.2: Sugoi, a visitor! Want to see my figurines? Don't touch. That's a limited edition.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.1.3: Wait... Niels. It's cherry blossom season.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.2.1: Konnichiwa, guh-chan! Tea? It's real matcha. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.2.2: Have a seat, senpai. Not on the dakimakura. That one's mine.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.2.3: Wait... Evi. The new train line opens today. With a new Shinkansen.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.3.1: Ohayo! Take a number, guh-chan. Just kidding. The counter is closed today.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.3.2: Look, shelf three. All guh figurines. Kawaii, right? Don't touch.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.3.3: Wait... Niels. That one figurine comes out today. The limited edition.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.4.1: Konnichiwa, guh-chan. Smell that? Evi is making ramen. Sugoi.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.4.2: Itadakimasu! ...Hm. Tasty. But it's just not quite the real thing.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.5.1: Ohayo, guh-chan! Pretty, aren't they, our lanterns? Kawaii, nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.5.2: I hung them up myself, senpai. In timetable order.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.5.3: Wait... Niels. The lantern festival is this weekend.
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.1.n: By balloon. Again. That's not real public transport.
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.1.e: I've got the passports! All aboard, Niels. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.2.n: A balloon doesn't even have a timetable. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.2.e: But it has a view! Ittekimasu, guh-chan!
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.3.n: No platform, no track, no conductor. Not real public transport.
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.3.e: It does fly to Japan. Come on, senpai!
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.1.1: Tadaima! The Shinkansen was on time. To the second. It almost made me cry, nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.1.2: Here, guh-chan. A present from Japan. Arigato for waving us off!
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.2.1: Tadaima! I collected seven stamps. Seven! Every station has its own stamp.
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.2.2: And I got the window seat, senpai. Here, this is for you. Arigato!
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.3.1: Tadaima! There was a long line at passport control. They waved me right through. A true pro, chonk.
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.3.2: She knows every stamp by heart. Here, a little something from Japan. Kawaii, right?
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.4.1: Tadaima! Rode eleven trains. Zero minutes of delay. Sugoi.
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.4.2: He filmed every train, guh-chan. Every one. Here, for you. Arigato!
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.5.1: Tadaima! My passport is stamped full. I'll make myself a new one tomorrow. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.5.2: The balloon back had no timetable again. Oh well. Here, a present, senpai.
quest.guhs.dal.theeguh.1: Konnichiwa. Tea? Have a nice sit. The waterfall does the rest. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.dal.theeguh.2: Shh. Hear that? Babble, babble. Makes you all chonky.
quest.guhs.dal.theeguh.3: I've been sitting here all day. Tomorrow again. Wahoog, what a life.
block.guhs.botenhuisje_steigerlantaarn.l: Lights up by itself when it gets dark. For the end of your jetty
item.guhs.botenhuisje_steigerlantaarn.lo: Lights up by itself when it gets dark. For the end of your jetty
block.guhs.botenhuisje_hengelstandaard.l: No hook, just a blossom petal. That's how the Fisher Guh fishes
item.guhs.botenhuisje_hengelstandaard.lo: No hook, just a blossom petal. That's how the Fisher Guh fishes
block.guhs.botenhuisje_koiwindzak.lore: A cheerful koi on a pole, for by the water
item.guhs.botenhuisje_koiwindzak.lore: A cheerful koi on a pole, for by the water
structure.guhs.botenhuisje.tooltip: A light little boathouse with a jetty on a Blossom Lake: the Fisher Guh lends you his rowboat
structure.guhs.picknickeilandje.tooltip: Rare: guhs celebrate hanami under the biggest blossom tree of an island in a Blossom Lake
gui.guhs.roeibootje.te_ver: The rowboat belongs to its lake, nyeg. It bobs back to the jetty.
gui.guhs.roeibootje.geroepen: A rowboat is waiting for you at the mooring post.
gui.guhs.roeibootje.ligt_klaar: The rowboat is already waiting. Hop in!
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.optie.koivoer: Got some koi food for me?
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.optie.meer_bezig: What was I supposed to do again?
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.optie.meer_klaar: Tell me about the lake again
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.koivoer: Here, a handful of koi food. Scatter it on the water and they'll come by themselves, nyeg. I'll have some more for you tomorrow.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.koivoer_op: I'm out of food for today, chonk. The koi shouldn't get too chubby either. Come back tomorrow.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.bootje: Of course, nyeg. It's at the mooring post, hop in. Row wherever you like, as long as it's on the lake. If you leave it somewhere, it bobs away by itself and there'll be one waiting here again. That boat knows the lake better than I do.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.begin: You want to get to know the lake, nyeg? That can't be rushed. Four little things. First: feed a koi. Here's some koi food. Scatter it on the water by the jetty and watch what happens.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.voer_nog: Feed a koi first, chonk. Scatter the koi food on the water, right where they swim. No rush. They'll come.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.voer_klaar: Did you see that, nyeg? They don't come for you, they come for the food. But they stay for the company. Two: blossom petals float on the water. Bring me one. Pick it up gently, they're thin.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.blaadje_nog: A floating blossom petal, chonk. They lie on the water, mostly under the trees. One is enough.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.blaadje_klaar: Thank you, chonk. This petal fell from the tree, floated a little circle and now lies in my paw. Everything here goes in circles like that. Three: take the rowboat and row to a big island. Step out for a moment and look around.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.eiland_nog: The rowboat is at the mooring post, nyeg. Row to a big island, one with a good-sized tree, and step out for a moment. A stepping stone doesn't count. You don't even fit on one.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.eiland_klaar: You've been to the island, I can tell by your ears. Nyeg. From there this jetty is just a little line, isn't it? That's how small we are. The last one: catch a koi. Here's my bucket, scoop up water with it and then a koi. And then set it free again. That last part matters most.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.koi_nog: First scoop water into the bucket, chonk, and then a koi. Easy does it. And then you let it swim again.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.koi_loslaten: You've got one in your bucket, nyeg. Well done. And now the hard part: letting go. Pour it back into the water.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.klaar: Caught and set free again. Wahoog. Now you know the lake, nyeg: you may hold anything for a while, as long as you give it back. Here, for your own little spot by the water.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.klaar.chat: You know the lake! The Fisher Guh gave you two jetty lanterns, a fishing rod on a stand and a koi windsock.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.na: You already know the lake, chonk. Now all you have to do is come and sit. That's the hardest thing of all, nyeg.
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.voer: Feed a koi: scatter koi food on the water where koi swim
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.blaadje: Bring the Fisher Guh a floating blossom petal
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.eiland: Row the rowboat to a big island and step ashore
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.koi: Catch a koi with a bucket of water, and set it free again
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.loslaten: Set the koi from your bucket free in the water again
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.terug: Go back to the Fisher Guh on the jetty
gui.guhs.picknickeilandje.mand.pak: A treat from the picnic basket, from the hanami guhs. For you!
gui.guhs.picknickeilandje.mand.gehad: You've already had your treat, nyeg. The rest is for whoever comes next.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.ochtend.0: Good morning, nyeg. The mist still hangs over the water and the koi are sleeping in. So am I, really.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.ochtend.1: Up early, chonk? In the morning the lake is at its quietest. Just listen. ... Exactly. Nothing. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.middag.0: Ha, nyeg. Have a seat. The koi do their rounds and I do mine: sitting.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.middag.1: You know what's nice about fishing, chonk? You don't have to catch anything. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.avond.0: Look, the lantern is lighting up. That's how I know it's evening, nyeg. I don't have a watch. The lake is never late.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.avond.1: The sun sinks into the water and the koi turn to gold. Every single evening. Wahoog, right?
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.nacht.0: Shh, nyeg. The koi are asleep. I'm fishing for stars now: they don't bite either, but they reflect nicely.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.nacht.1: Still awake, chonk? Me too. At night you can hear the blossom fall. Plop. Plop. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.koi.0: They never bite, nyeg, that's why I don't fish for them. There's no hook on my line, just a blossom petal. The koi come to look, I look back. That's how we catch each other a little.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.koi.1: A koi lives to be a hundred, they say. So it has all the time in the world, nyeg. A guh could learn from that. I practice every day.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.koi.2: I used to want to catch the biggest koi in the lake. Now I know: the biggest koi is the one you let swim. Chonk. Deep, right? Just like the lake.
gui.guhs.hanami.lief.0: Look up, nyeg. Every petal falls only once. That's why we watch.
gui.guhs.hanami.lief.1: Come sit with us, chonk. There's cake. And blossom. That's all you need.
gui.guhs.hanami.lief.2: Shh... that one's asleep. Been tired of watching since the very first petal. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.hanami.lief.3: Hanami! That means: flower watching. We do it every year. And every day. Wahoog, you're here too!
gui.guhs.hanami.guh.0: Nyeg! Blossom! There! And there! And there too!
gui.guhs.hanami.guh.1: There are treats in the basket. Go on, there's something for everyone. Chonk!
gui.guhs.hanami.slaap.0: Zzz... nyeg... one more petal... zzz
structure.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.tooltip: A big floating island with a little lake, a waterfall and the cloud shepherd's hut. Rare!
structure.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.toolti: A half-collapsed little observatory on a high island. In the dark, extra many stars fall here.
structure.guhs.luchtballon_haven.tooltip: A jetty on the edge of an island with balloons. One ride a day down to the meadow.
block.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine_sterrenkaa: All the stars of the Guhmension, pricked out by hand.
item.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine_sterrenkaar: All the stars of the Guhmension, pricked out by hand.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.hallo: Nyeg! A visitor, all the way up here! I'm the cloud shepherd and these are my cloud lambs. Wahoog fluffy, nyeg? Shall I teach you how to turn fluff into a real cloud?
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.later: Take it easy, chonk. The clouds won't run off. Well... a little.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap1: Lesson one: fluff! Snip one of my lambs with shears. It only tickles, and in a few minutes it's a little puffball again.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.schaar: Here, take my spare shears. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap1.nog: Snip first, chonk. Right-click a cloud lamb with the shears.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap2: Wahoog lovely fluff! Lesson two: put four tufts of cloud fluff in a square on a crafting table. That gives you cloud blocks. There's a crafting table in my hut.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap2.nog: Four tufts of fluff, two by two. Not enough? Snip another lamb, or wait until the fluff is back.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap3: A real cloud! Lesson three: build a little cloud staircase with it. Three cloud blocks, each one step higher than the last. That gets you anywhere, nyeg.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap3.nog: Three cloud blocks going up at a slant, like little stairs. That's all it is.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap4: You could climb into the sky with that! Last lesson, and the most important one: resting. Sit on a cloud bench or snuggle into a cloud bed. They're right here by the hut.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap4.nog: Don't rush so, chonk. Sit on the cloud bench for a bit. It's part of the job.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.terug: Nice sit, nyeg? Come and see me for a moment.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.klaar: Nyeg! Now you're a real cloud maker. Here: some fluff to get started and a cloud lamp for your home. And if you like, you may take a lamb home with you.
gui.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.optie.schaapje: May I take a lamb home?
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.schaapje: This is a sweet one. Hold the lead tight on the way back! It eats nibble feed and gives you fluff at home. Take wahoog good care of it, nyeg?
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.schaapje_al: You've already been given your lamb, chonk. Two lambs with nibble feed get a little one all by themselves.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.dag: Bye, chonk! Come snip some fluff again sometime.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.praatje0: The lambs in the fold stay here, they belong to the island. But snipping fluff is always fine.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.praatje1: Did you know a cloud block is soft? You can fall onto it from very high up. Nyeg, no harm done.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.praatje2: The water from my little lake falls into a cloud. That's where the rain comes from, I think. Chonk.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.praatje3: The cloud lift takes you up and the cloud stream takes you back down. Just look at the little arrows.
gui.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.kudde_blijft: Nyeg! This lamb belongs to the cloud shepherd. Ask him for a lamb of your own.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.slaapt: Zzz... nyeg... zzz... five more little stars...
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.slaapt: The stargazer guh is asleep. Come back when it's dark.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.hallo: Oh... hello. Are you real, or am I dreaming you? It doesn't matter. Look up, chonk. They're all there again.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.nacht0: Every star is a guh who once said "nyeg" very loudly. That's what I think. Wouldn't that be nice?
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.nacht1: This little house used to have a whole roof. Then a star fell through it. Now I can see them better. Wahoog handy.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.nacht2: Sometimes one falls. Then I make a wish. Mostly I wish for another star.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.nacht3: Have a look through the telescope. If you're very quiet, the sky leaves a little stardust behind for you.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.nacht4: I sleep during the day. The sun is a star too, but she talks so loudly.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.stof: Shh... did you see that? A little stardust drifted past the lens. Hold out your hand.
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.stof_al: You've already caught stardust here tonight. Again tomorrow night, nyeg.
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.hallo: Ahoy, nyeg! Welcome to the Balloon Harbor. One ride a day, all the way down to the meadow below. Gently, with a view. All aboard?
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.vertrek: Hold on to the basket! Well, it goes wahoog slowly. Safe travels, chonk!
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.al: You've already had your ride today, nyeg. The balloon needs a rest too. Again tomorrow!
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.weg: The balloon is still on its way. A little patience, chonk, it'll be right back.
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.geblokkeerd: Nyeg... there's no free spot to land down below right now. I don't dare. Try again in a bit.
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.nee: No worries. Feel free to look around, the view is free.
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.geland: Landed softly! The balloon floats back to the harbor by itself. See you tomorrow, nyeg!
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.terug: Nyeg, the landing spot was taken. We're back up. You keep today's ride.
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.afgebroken: Nyeg, the ride was cut short. You're back on the jetty and you keep today's ride.
gui.guhs.luchtballon_haven.blijf_zitten: Nyeg! Stay snug in the basket.
gui.guhs.luchtballon_haven.praat: Talk to the balloonist guh for a ride.
block.guhs.bliksemsmidse_onweerswolkje.l: Rains gently on whatever stands below. Never really flashes, nyeg.
item.guhs.bliksemsmidse_onweerswolkje.lo: Rains gently on whatever stands below. Never really flashes, nyeg.
block.guhs.regenboogbrug_pot.lore: Stands at the end of the rainbow. Full again every day.
item.guhs.regenboogbrug_pot.lore: Stands at the end of the rainbow. Full again every day.
block.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje_schat.lore: A mountain of golden crumbs. The giant counts them. So they say.
item.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje_schat.lore: A mountain of golden crumbs. The giant counts them. So they say.
block.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje_kruimel.lore: From the hoard of the sleeping giant. Too pretty to eat. Almost, nyeg.
item.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje_kruimel.lore: From the hoard of the sleeping giant. Too pretty to eat. Almost, nyeg.
structure.guhs.regenboogbrug.tooltip: A rainbow you can walk across. At the end stands a pot.
structure.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje.tooltip: A little castle on the highest cloud. Something very big is snoring there.
structure.guhs.bliksemsmidse.tooltip: A dark little cloud that rumbles. The Smith Guh presses clouds into blocks there.
gui.guhs.regenboogbrug.pot.pak: The pot at the end of the rainbow! A handful of cheese nibbles and a chunk of rainbow for you. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.regenboogbrug.pot.leeg: The pot is empty for today. Tomorrow the rainbow will have filled it again, nyeg.
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.slaapt.0: Zzz... nibble... zzz... five more minutes, nyeg...
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.slaapt.1: Zzz... who's touching... my crumbs... zzz...
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.loer.tip: The giant opens one eye. Shhhh! Sneak, no running or jumping.
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.weg.0: AH... AH... ACHOO-GUH! You're blown right out of the castle. The giant rolls over and snores on.
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.weg.1: The giant yawns up a storm: WAHOOOOG. And there you are, outside on a cloud. Landed softly, nyeg.
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.weg.2: One sneeze and you're outside. He didn't even notice.
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.weg.3: Pffft! You fly outside like a bit of fluff. On tiptoe next time, chonk?
gui.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje.schat.pak: You take one golden nibble crumb from the giant's hoard. He just keeps snoring. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje.schat.leeg: One crumb a day is enough. The giant counts them, so they say. Come back tomorrow, nyeg.
gui.guhs.smidguh.hallo.0: Tap. Tap. Cloud in. Block out. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.smidguh.hallo.1: You give fluff. I press. You build. Chonk.
gui.guhs.smidguh.hallo.2: Hot here. Lightning does the work. I do the rest. Tap.
gui.guhs.smidguh.hallo.3: No fright. Flash is sweet. Rumble is tummy. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.smidguh.geen_pluis: No fluff? Snip a lamb. Then come back. Tap.
gui.guhs.smidguh.geruild: Pressed well. Sturdy block. Wahoog. Tap.
gui.guhs.biosystemen.gids.uitleg: Every time you wave Evichonk and Nielschonk off, they bring you a present from Japan. A double piece of the collection can be swapped with them for one you still miss. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.biosystemen.gids.tip: From the Japan Collection of Evichonk and Nielschonk
gui.guhs.titels.hint.biosystemen_weeb: Complete the Japan Collection of the Weeb House
gui.guhs.titels.hint.biosystemen_wolkent: Climb to the very highest islet above a Cloud Meadow
gui.guhs.titels.hint.biosystemen_gezondh: Get sneezed out of a Cloud Castle three times
gui.guhs.titels.hint.biosystemen_koiflui: Learn all about the lake from the Fisher Guh
gui.guhs.ringvlucht.uitleg: I'll take you to every place of your journey you have already been to. Hold on tight, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.niks: You haven't been anywhere else on your journey yet. Walk on first, then I'll fly you back later!
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.weg_kwijt: Hmm... I don't know the way there yet. Try again in a bit, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.niet_landen: There's nowhere safe to land there. Let's just stay here.
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.portaal: I can't take you that far yet: the grill portal is still closed for you.
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.bezig: Hold on, you're busy with something else.
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.spel: Not in the middle of a game, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.geland: The Smoke Guh gently puts you down at %s. Phew, wahoog!
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.er_is_er_een: A Travel Smoke Guh now hovers at the exit. He flies you to every place of your journey you have already been to, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.er_is_er_een.gouw: A Travel Smoke Guh now hovers at Guhdalf's camp. He can fly you straight to the Guhbarbecuether, and later anywhere you have already been!
gui.guhs.ringvlucht.plek.aanleg: The landing of the Elven Boats
scene.guhs.ringvlucht_vlucht.instappen: Climb on my back. No tickling, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringvlucht_vlucht.hou_vast: Hold on to my little smoke puffs!
scene.guhs.ringvlucht_vlucht_sam.instapp: Climb on my back. No tickling, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringvlucht_vlucht_sam.hou_vas: Hold on to my little smoke puffs!
scene.guhs.ringvlucht_vlucht_sam.sam: Wait for me! I want to fly too!
structure.guhs.knabbelpark.tooltip: A big pink park with a fountain, statues, Fawnguhs and the Park Ranger Guh (Guhmension)
block.guhs.park_bankje.lore: With two guh ears on the backrest. Sit for a bit, do nothing for a bit
item.guhs.park_bankje.lore: With two guh ears on the backrest. Sit for a bit, do nothing for a bit
block.guhs.park_lantaarn.lore: Put it on two cherry fence posts: a lamp post like in Nibble Park
item.guhs.park_lantaarn.lore: Put it on two cherry fence posts: a lamp post like in Nibble Park
block.guhs.park_prullenbak.lore: Throw something in (right-click) and it eats it. NYEG! Nice things it spits out again
item.guhs.park_prullenbak.lore: Throw something in (right-click) and it eats it. NYEG! Nice things it spits out again
block.guhs.park_eigen_beeld.lore: Right-click one of your own guhs with it: it poses and the statuette starts to look like it
item.guhs.park_eigen_beeld.lore: Right-click one of your own guhs with it: it poses and the statuette starts to look like it
gui.guhs.park.prullenbak.0: NYEG! The litter bin smacks its lips.
gui.guhs.park.prullenbak.2: The litter bin burps softly. Pardon!
gui.guhs.park.prullenbak.te_mooi: Nyeg? That's far too nice to throw away! The litter bin spits it out again.
gui.guhs.park.plaquette.1: In honour of Joostvadsje, who always takes good care of trapguh.
gui.guhs.park.plaquette.2: In honour of Liekguh and Lunde, guardians of all guhs
gui.guhs.park.plaquette.3: In honour of Grandpa Cheeseguh, who accidentally sat down on a little cheese and so invented the very first cheese nibble. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.park.beeld.joostvadsje: Joostvadsje, in bronze. He looks very proudly at trapguh.
gui.guhs.park.beeld.suusvadsje: Suusvadsje, in bronze, with a little bow on her head. Together with Joostvadsje she looks after trapguh.
gui.guhs.park.beeld.trapguh: Trapguh, small and in bronze, between Joostvadsje and Suusvadsje. So cute!
gui.guhs.park.beeld.liekguh: Liekguh, in white stone, with her little golden nose ring.
gui.guhs.park.beeld.lunde: Lunde, in white stone, with a heart on her forehead. She looks after all guhs.
gui.guhs.park.beeld.opa_kaasguh: Grandpa Cheeseguh, in old bronze, on his famous little cheese.
gui.guhs.park.al_gevoerd: This Fawnguh has had its treat already. Feed another one!
gui.guhs.park.poseert: %s strikes a pose! The statuette looks just like it now.
quest.guhs.reis.vaste_naam: %s belongs to this spot, with this name. It stays that way!
quest.guhs.park.wachter.hallo: Welcome to Nibble Park, nyeg! I'm the park ranger. I look after the flowers, the benches and the Fawnguhs. Do you feel like helping me for a day?
quest.guhs.park.wachter.park: This park was made in honour of a few very special guhs. Their statues stand in the statue garden. And at the back live the Fawnguhs: guhs with teeny tiny antlers. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.park.wachter.start: Lovely! Start in the statue garden: read the three plaques by the statues. Then you'll know who we honour here.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.plaquettes: Have you read the plaques yet? You have %s of %s. They stand in front of the statues.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.herten: The Fawnguhs are hungry! Give each of them a cheese nibble, over the fence of the deer pen.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.verzorger: The pen keeper could use a hand. She sits by the hay bales next to the deer pen.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.klaar: You honoured the statues, fed the Fawnguhs and helped the keeper. What a park day! And you know what? A Fawnguh would really love to come with you...
quest.guhs.park.wachter.beloning: Here's your very own Fawnguh! Take good care of it, just like Joostvadsje does for trapguh. And this statuette is for your guh: just let it pose. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.park.wachter.later0: Lovely weather in the park today, isn't it? Nyeg.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.later1: Do you throw your bits of paper in the litter bin? It loves that.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.later2: How is your Fawnguh doing? It may always come and visit!
quest.guhs.park.wachter.later3: Sitting on benches is a craft too. I practise every day. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.park.optie.park: What kind of park is this?
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.hallo: Hi! I look after the Fawnguhs. They're a little shy, but crazy about cheese nibbles.
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.voeren: You've fed %s of the %s Fawnguhs. Each one wants one, over the fence!
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.klusje: Will you help me? The hay rack is empty. Bring me %s wheat, then the Fawnguhs get lovely hay tonight.
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.tekort: You have %s wheat, I need %s for the hay rack.
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.dank: How sweet! The hay rack is full again. Hurry to the park ranger, he has something for you.
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.terug: Hurry to the park ranger in his little hut!
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.later0: The Fawnguhs like to sleep under the little shelter best. Shhh.
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.later1: Polishing antlers is quite hard, you know. They tickle!
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.later2: Thanks to you they've become totally chonky. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.park.hint.plaquettes: Read the three plaques in the statue garden (right-click).
quest.guhs.park.hint.herten: Feed each Fawnguh in the deer pen a cheese nibble (right-click with a cheese nibble).
quest.guhs.park.hint.verzorger: Talk to the pen keeper by the hay bales next to the deer pen.
quest.guhs.park.hint.hooi: Bring the pen keeper wheat for the hay rack.
quest.guhs.park.hint.terug: Go back to the park ranger in his little hut.
quest.guhs.park.hint.beeld: Right-click one of your own guhs with the statuette: it strikes a pose!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.hertguhtje: A guh with teeny tiny antlers and white spots. The Fawnguhs live in the deer pen of Nibble Park and are crazy about cheese nibbles. Help the park ranger, and one may come along with you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.uitleg: The Park Ranger Guh could use some help: read the plaques, feed the Fawnguhs and help the pen keeper. Then a Fawnguh may come along with you!
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.stap.0: Talk to the Park Ranger Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.0: Talk to the Park Ranger Guh in his little hut in Nibble Park.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.1: Read the three plaques by the statues in the statue garden.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.waar.1: The statue garden of Nibble Park
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.2: Give each Fawnguh in the deer pen a cheese nibble.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.waar.2: The deer pen of Nibble Park
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.3: Talk to the pen keeper by the deer pen and bring her wheat for the hay rack.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.4: Go back to the park ranger: he has something for you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.klaar: Done! Your own Fawnguh is coming along. Wahoog!
block.guhs.park_glijbaan.lore: Lay them like a little staircase going down: one block down for every block forward. Step in and... wheee!
item.guhs.park_glijbaan.lore: Lay them like a little staircase going down: one block down for every block forward. Step in and... wheee!
block.guhs.park_schommel.lore: Hang it under a beam, two blocks up. Right-click and off you swing, all by itself!
item.guhs.park_schommel.lore: Hang it under a beam, two blocks up. Right-click and off you swing, all by itself!
block.guhs.park_wip.lore: A seesaw for two. Right-click the end you want to sit on: up and down, up and down!
item.guhs.park_wip.lore: A seesaw for two. Right-click the end you want to sit on: up and down, up and down!
block.guhs.park_picknickkleed.lore: Red and white checks with teeny guh hearts. Lovely on the grass with a cup of tea.
item.guhs.park_picknickkleed.lore: Red and white checks with teeny guh hearts. Lovely on the grass with a cup of tea.
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.knabbel: You dig and dig... and find a CHEESE NIBBLE! There's bound to be another one tomorrow. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.0: You find... sand. Lots and lots of sand.
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.1: A seashell! Oh no, it's a pebble.
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.2: You find a guh's lost little sock. Nyeg?
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.3: A note: 'Come and dig again tomorrow. Love, the sandbox.'
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.4: You build a beautiful little sandcastle. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.parkplek.zandbak.vondst.5: A crumb of cheese nibble! Already eaten by a guh. Sorry.
gui.guhs.parkplek.eendjes.0: Quack-nyeg! The duckie gobbles it up.
gui.guhs.parkplek.eendjes.1: Quack quack! The ducklings hop with joy.
gui.guhs.parkplek.eendjes.2: Nom nom! What a chonky duckie that's going to be.
gui.guhs.parkplek.muziek.aan: The park's record box picks a record. Let's dance!
gui.guhs.parkplek.muziek.uit: Music off. The guhs catch their breath. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.parkplek.koi.plons: Splash! The Nibble Koi leaps out of the water for joy.
gui.guhs.parkplek.koi.emmer: Nyeg! The Nibble Koi live here. Not in a bucket, thank you.
quest.guhs.parkplek.kraam.hallo.0: Welcome to my stall! Treats for your picnic, and you pay in chonk. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.parkplek.kraam.hallo.1: A little cake with your tea? Or a seesaw for your own garden? Have a look around!
quest.guhs.parkplek.kraam.hallo.2: Cheese nibbles, cookies, apples... everything fresh and nice and chonky!
quest.guhs.parkplek.kraam.hallo.3: Psst... the swings here are the best in the whole Guhmension. I sell them too!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.knabbelkoi: Rarity: rare (only in the Japanese garden of Nibble Park)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.knabbelkoi: A koi in cheese nibble colours, holes and all. The Nibble Koi swim in the koi pond of the Japanese garden in Nibble Park, a wink at the koi of Babbledale. Give one a cheese nibble or koi food: splash!
block.guhs.park_verrekijker.lore: Right-click: look far away, just like through a real spyglass. Sneak = look normally again
item.guhs.park_verrekijker.lore: Right-click: look far away, just like through a real spyglass. Sneak = look normally again
block.guhs.park_wensstam.lore: Hang a renamed piece of paper on the trunk: your wish goes up in the tree
item.guhs.park_wensstam.lore: Hang a renamed piece of paper on the trunk: your wish goes up in the tree
item.guhs.park_kruimels.lore: Right-click: strew a handful. The Pigeonguhs come running right away!
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.hallo0: Hello, dear! Have you come to feed the Pigeonguhs too? They're such good company. Coo!
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.hallo1: I used to feed the pigeons with Grandpa Cheeseguh. He ate half the crumbs himself, nyeg.
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.hallo2: That chubby one is called Crumbs. And that one too. Actually, they're all called Crumbs.
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.hallo3: No running, now. Pigeons like it calm. And crumbs. Mostly crumbs.
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.kruimels: Here, a handful of breadcrumbs for you. Go on and strew them (right-click), they'll come straight over!
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.genoeg: You've still got crumbs, dear. Strew those first!
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.morgen: You'll get another handful tomorrow. Granny has to be a little careful too, nyeg.
gui.guhs.parkb.kruimels.gestrooid: You strew a handful of crumbs. Coo!
gui.guhs.parkb.duif.gevoerd: Coo! The Pigeonguh gobbles up your crumbs.
gui.guhs.parkb.verrekijker.kijk: You look through the telescope. Sneak (shift) to stop.
gui.guhs.parkb.verrekijker.toren: From the highest spot in the park you can see everything. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.applaus: The guh kids clap their little paws. Nyeg nyeg!
quest.guhs.parkb.kind.0: I want to see the puppet show! Will you click on the stage?
quest.guhs.parkb.kind.1: Shhh! It's about to start. I hope Mika comes again. Mika is so funny!
quest.guhs.parkb.kind.2: I've seen the show ten times already. I'm going to see it ten more times. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.parkb.kind.3: If you see Mika, you have to shout really loud. That's the rule.
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.gehangen: Your wish is hanging in the tree: "%s". It's bound to come true, nyeg!
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.vervangen: Your oldest wish makes way for your new one (you may hang %s per tree).
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.geen_naam: Write your wish on the paper first: rename it on an anvil.
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.vol: There's no free spot left on the branches. Try again in a little while.
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.info: %s wishes hang in this tree. Hang one yourself: right-click the trunk with a renamed piece of paper.
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.weg: You took your wishes down from the tree again.
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.gewist: Took %s wishes down from the tree.
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.mok0: Hmph. I'm just sitting here. Is that not allowed or something?
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.mok1: That sign is mean. I'm only a VERY little bit Mika.
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.mok2: Everybody's allowed on a bench. Except Mikas. That's just not fair...
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.mok3: Go away. Or... do you happen to have a cheese nibble? No? Hmph.
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.duw: Hey! This is MY bench! Hmph!
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.blij: A... a cheese nibble? For ME? Nyeg! Thank you! You know what? I'll go find a bench where Mikas ARE allowed to sit. Bye!
gui.guhs.parkb.mika.weg: The Mika hops away happily. He'll probably be back tomorrow.
gui.guhs.parkb.mika.terug: %s Mikas are back on their benches.
gui.guhs.parkb.cmd.toren: Lookout towers in this park: %s (at height %s, the highest plekje spot %s)
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.1: Welcome to the puppet theatre! Today: Guh and the Stolen Nibble. Shhh, it's starting!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.2: Hello, kids! Look what I've got: a really, really big cheese nibble. Mmm, nyeg!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.3: I'll just put it down here, on the edge. I'm off to get a napkin.
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.4: Hee hee hee... A nibble, just lying on the edge? That's MINE now!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.6: Behind me? Huh? I don't see anything at all...
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.8: AHA! Mika! My nibble! Give it back, you little muncher!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.9: Okay, okay... But can I have just one tiny bite? I was so hungry.
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.10: Of course! Sharing is sweet. Nibbling together tastes twice as good. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.11: The end! Give a clap with your paws. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.duifguhtje: Rarity: common (only in Nibble Park, near Granny Guh)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.duifguhtje: A chubby grey bird with a shiny green-and-purple neck and real guh eyes. Pigeonguhs live with Granny Guh in Nibble Park and love breadcrumbs: hold a few and they flutter around you. Coo!
gui.guhs.einde2.beschermd: Nyeg! This place stays whole, for every guh that comes after you.
gui.guhs.einde2.bed: Nyeg! This little bed already belongs to a chonky guh. Do your sleeping at home.
gui.guhs.einde2.taart: Nyeg! This cake is here for show, for every guh that comes after you. Bake your own cake at home.
gui.guhs.einde2.commando.geen: Nyeg: %s has no fixed spot in this world (not built yet, or no spot found).
gui.guhs.einde2.commando.zoekt: Nyeg: still searching for the fixed spot of %s (that takes a moment after start-up). Ask again in a bit.
gui.guhs.einde2.commando.staat_niet: Mind: %s is not standing there. Its start chunk already existed before this place was added.
gui.guhs.einde2.commando.geen_plek: Nyeg: %s has no spot '%s' (or it isn't fixed in this world yet).
gui.guhs.einde2.commando.geen_structuur: Nyeg: you aren't in (or right next to) a place of the outer islands.
structure.guhs.mika_vesting.tooltip: A fortress of purple Mika Stone on the outer islands: towers, bridges, a grease ship, the cook's kitchen and cells full of skinny guhs
advancements.guhs.guheinde.einde2_biomes: Visit all six regions of the outer islands
Mine crystal cheese in the Crystal Cheese Cliffs
Eat a nibble chorus fruit and suddenly stand somewhere else
item.guhs.knabbelkoorvrucht.lore: Chomp... floop! Suddenly you stand a little further on, nyeg
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.korstguh: Rarity: Uncommon (only in the Holey Cheese Hills)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.korstguh: A holey-cheese-yellow guh with a shield of baked rind that he fits into completely. Once tamed he rolls up into a little ball when you sneak next to him: give the ball a push or a tap and off he goes! He likes his naps best in a cheese hole.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.duinguh: Rarity: Uncommon (only in the Rind Desert)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.duinguh: A sand-colored guh with enormous ears. He never sinks into crumb sand: he runs right across it. Once tamed he digs himself into crumb sand until all you can see is his little ears. That's how he keeps watch. Or takes a nap, who can tell.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kruimelguh: Rarity: Rare (only in the Crumb Clouds)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kruimelguh: A cream-white guh full of crumbs, with a little cloud on his back. He is so light that he stays standing on crumb clouds and floats down ever so slowly when he steps off an island. He couldn't fall if he tried, and he does try.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.schimmelguh: Rarity: Rare (only on the Blue Cheese Plains)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.schimmelguh: A pale guh with little blue veins, just like blue-veined cheese, and glowing little mushrooms on his head and back. Once tamed he glows like a little lamp that walks along with you. He smells a bit strong. Best not to mention it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kristalguh: Rarity: Rare (only on the Crystal Cheese Cliffs)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kristalguh: A cliff-cheese-gray guh with golden cheese crystals growing out of him. He has a nose for anything shiny: once tamed he sniffs up a Crystal Cheese Nugget now and then, one a day at most. He even hands it over. Usually.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.koorguh: Rarity: Rare (only in the Nibble Chorus Forest)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.koorguh: A purple guh with a nibble chorus flower on his head and a neat white choir collar. Once tamed he sings along at the top of his lungs as soon as a music disc plays. Off-key, but with feeling. At the Disco Dynamo's party he counts for two.
gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.getemd.korstgu: %s is yours! Sneak next to him and he rolls up. Go on, push the little ball, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.getemd.duinguh: %s is yours! On crumb sand he digs in up to his little ears.
gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.getemd.kruimel: %s is yours! He floats down slowly and stands on crumb clouds.
gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.getemd.schimme: %s is yours! He now glows like a little lamp that walks along with you.
gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.getemd.kristal: %s is yours! Now and then he sniffs up a Crystal Cheese Nugget for you.
gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.getemd.koorguh: %s is yours! Put on a music disc and he sings along.
gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.brokje: %s sniffed up something shiny: a Crystal Cheese Nugget!
gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.zingt: %s sings along. Off-key, but with feeling.
gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.commando.gezet: A tamed %s is standing next to you.
gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.commando.geen: There is no biome guh of your own near you.
gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.commando.niets: No biome guh comes here right now (no land of the outer islands, no island ground, or already full).
subtitles.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.schimmel: Blue Cheese Guh starts to glow
advancements.guhs.guheinde.einde2_biomeg: Tame a guh of the outer islands of the Guh End
Give your rolled-up Rind Guh a push
Let your Dune Guh dig in until all you see is his little ears
Let your Chorus Guh sing along with a music disc
Tame a Rind Guh, Dune Guh, Crumb Guh, Blue Cheese Guh, Crystal Guh and Chorus Guh
item.guhs.flitskruimel.lore: A crumb that still flickers from an Ender Mika. Blink and it lies a little further off. Nyeg.
item.guhs.doosschil.lore: A round piece of cheese box, pushed out by a Hidey Guh for a nibble. Two around a chest: a Hidey Box.
block.guhs.schuildoos.tooltip: Keeps everything that is inside, even when you pick it up. Doesn't fit in another Hidey Box (a guh tried).
item.guhs.schuildoos.tooltip: Keeps everything that is inside, even when you pick it up. Doesn't fit in another Hidey Box (a guh tried).
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.gejat: Hey! An Ender Mika swipes a nibble from your hand. Stare right at it and it will drop it. NYEG!
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.laat_vallen: The startled Ender Mika drops your nibble. Quick, pick it up!
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.terug: The Ender Mika didn't dare eat it after all: your nibble is back in your pocket.
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.mijt_uit_vrucht: Pop! A Cheese Mite jumps out of your fruit. Watch your toes...
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.gekieteld: Tickle tickle! The Cheese Mite tickles your toes. Hic!
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.kusje: Smooch! A smooch from the Hidey Guh. It makes you float a little...
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.schil: Crack! The Hidey Guh pushes out a box shell. Thank you, guh!
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.schil_morgen: This Hidey Guh already gave a box shell today. A new one will have grown by tomorrow, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.schuilguh_dicht: Shut! The Hidey Guh is in its little box for a moment. Wait until it peeks again.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.ender_mika: Rarity: Rare, on the outer islands of the Guh End
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.ender_mika: A Mika that stood staring into the void for so long that it got all stretched out: tall, thin and purple-black, with glowing little eyes. It flits from island to island and adores cheese nibbles: hold one in your hand and it sneaks around behind you and swipes exactly one. It is terribly shy: stare right at it for two seconds and it drops your nibble in fright. Whack it and it shoves you over and flits away. If a Cheese Mite is around, it forgets everything and trudges after it, head over heels. NYEG.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kaasmijt: Rarity: Sometimes out of a nibble chorus fruit
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kaasmijt: A teeny-tiny critter made of cheese crumbs, with six little legs and two glowing feelers. Now and then one jumps out of a nibble chorus fruit you just took a bite of. It scurries up to you and tickles your toes, and that gives you the hiccups. Hic! After a couple of minutes it is gone again. Ender Mikas think Cheese Mites are the prettiest thing there is and trail after them dreamily: so with a little mite around, your nibbles are safe.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.schuilguh: Rarity: On the walls of a Mika Fortress
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.schuilguh: A sweet, shy guh that lives in a little round cheese box, stuck to a wall, the ceiling or simply the floor. Come closer calmly and it peeks out from under its little lid. With an empty hand you get a smooch: it makes you float for a moment (you land softly, it is still a guh). Give it a cheese nibble and it pushes out a box shell, once a day. If it gets a fright, its lid snaps shut. Shut!
block.guhs.kruimelkwal_pot.lore: A Crumb Jelly in a jar: it gives light. Break the jar and it floats free again.
item.guhs.kruimelkwal_pot.lore: A Crumb Jelly in a jar: it gives light. Break the jar and it floats free again.
item.guhs.leegteparel.lore: A thank-you from the Void Whale Guh. Hold it to your ear and you can hear it sing.
gui.guhs.einde2_zwevers.walvis.parel: The Void Whale Guh sings thank you and leaves a Void Pearl behind for you!
gui.guhs.einde2_zwevers.walvis.morgen: Yum, sings the whale. You already have today's pearl: come back tomorrow, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_zwevers.walvis.remt: Your whale slows down: something big hangs in front of its snout. Look another way.
gui.guhs.einde2_zwevers.commando.walvisz: %s can now see the Void Whale Guh.
%s can no longer see the Void Whale Guh.
subtitles.guhs.einde2_zwevers.kwal_pot: Crumb Jelly slips into a jar
subtitles.guhs.einde2_zwevers.eendguh_sc: Turtle-Duck Guh hides in its shell
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kruimelkwal: Rarity: In swarms in the Crumb Clouds
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kruimelkwal: A little jellyfish of glowing cheese crumbs that drifts through the Crumb Clouds in swarms. It weighs nothing, doesn't sting, and is secretly a trampoline: drop onto one and BOING, you bounce five blocks straight up (sneak, and you sink gently through). After a bounce, landing doesn't hurt. Scoop one up with a glass bottle and you have a Crumb Jelly Jar: the coziest lamp in the Guh End. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.leegtewalvisguh: Rarity: Legendary, between the outer islands (only for those who believe the captain)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.leegtewalvisguh: Huge, slow and chonkily content, it floats between the islands, singing so low that your nibbles tremble. Nibble Chorus grows on its back, and there is plenty of room to land and float along for a while. Feed it a Nibble Chorus Fruit and it thanks you with a Void Pearl (one a day, it is thrifty). You don't put an island on a lead, but whoever believes the old captain in the harbor pub and feeds a whale often gets one of their own: a flying home with a little house on its back.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.vleermuis_lemurgu: Rarity: Rare in the Crumb Clouds (and at the air temples)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.vleermuis_lemurguh: Half bat, half lemur, all guh: enormous ears, a ringed tail and little skin wings. It flutters from spot to spot in short hops and likes nothing better than napping upside down from a ceiling, wings wrapped around itself like a blanket. Sneak, and it sleeps on. Crazy about fruit: an apple, berries or a Nibble Chorus Fruit. Mind your nibbles, say the monks. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.otter_pinguinguh: Rarity: Rare on the Blue Cheese Plains (and at the Water Tribe)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.otter_pinguinguh: A penguin's body with an otter's snout, whiskers and four flippers. Walking is a waddle, but on ice and snow it flops onto its belly and slides away. At the Water Tribe you may sit on one: sledding on an Otter-Penguin Guh! Steer by looking, push off with forward, brake with back. It enjoys it most of all itself. Likes a little fish.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.das_molguh: Rarity: Rare in the Crystal Cheese Cliffs (and at Omashguh)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.das_molguh: A low brown digger with a badger's stripe and hefty claws. It is blind and keeps its little eyes comfortably shut, but it feels every step you take: walk past and it pokes its snout your way, sniffing (sneak, and it notices nothing). In soft ground it digs itself in and tunnels around with only a strip of back above the ground. It never leaves a hole: everything lies neatly in place afterwards. The first earthbenders, they say in Omashguh. Crazy about cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.schildpad_eendguh: Rarity: Rare in the Nibble Chorus Forest (and on the palace pond)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.schildpad_eendguh: A yellow duckling in a green turtle shell. It bobs on the water, waddles to the nearest pond when it is on dry land, and tucks itself into its shell for a moment when startled. Hold a piece of bread and it follows you everywhere; every bite is a contented quack-nyeg. In the Fire Nation even the grumpiest prince secretly feeds them.
item.guhs.appa_fluitje.lore: You can't hear a thing. One very big, very fluffy friend can.
item.guhs.appa_fluitje.tooltip: Blow: your Appa Guh comes to you. Anywhere in the Guh End; elsewhere only at your own Appa Platform.
item.guhs.appa_fluitje.tooltip.momo: Sneak + blow: your Momo Guh comes back to your shoulder.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.opstappen: You sit on %s's head. Jump = yip yip, sneak = down.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.instappen: You climb into %s's saddle basket. %s steers. Hold on tight, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.vol: The saddle basket is full. Not even a skinny guh fits in.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.guh_erop: %s hops into the saddle basket. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.guhs_eraf: Hup, off you go! Your guhs roll out of the saddle basket.

gui.guhs.guhdex.info.appa_guh: A sky bison with a guh snout: six legs, an arrow from his forehead to the tip of his flat tail, and two soft round guh ears above his horns. As big as a barn, as sweet as a guh. Click to get on; say 'yip yip' (jump) and he takes off, sneak and he sinks. He flies slower than Guh Wings, but he never gets tired and he does it anywhere. Three friends fit in his saddle basket: other humans, or your own guhs (click with a guh on your arm or on a lead). Sneak + click: the saddle chest. A pat on his flank and your guhs roll back out. Lost him? Blow your Appa Whistle. He always comes, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.momo_guh: Rarity: One per human: he picks the shoulder with the most nibbles
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.momo_guh: A flying lemur with enormous round ears, a ringed tail and big green guh eyes. He lives on your right shoulder and picks up everything lying within six blocks: hop, into your bag. What you throw away yourself he politely leaves alone. Now and then he 'borrows' a cheese nibble from your bag. You get it back. Really. Sneak + click a block with an empty hand and he stays there at home; sneak + click him (or sneak and blow your Appa Whistle) and he flutters back to your shoulder.

I'm finally back home in the palace. So why doesn't it feel like home, nyeg?
Everybody says I have my honor back. I'm not so sure anymore. Grmbl.
As Fire Lord I promise peace, tea and nibbles for everyone. Uncle has already made the tea.
I didn't find my honor again. I made it myself. With a little help, guh.
I MUST capture the Guhvatar! Only then will I get my honor back!
Uncle, I don't want tea! ...Well. One cup, then. Grmbl.
...*The Blue Spirit says nothing and silently points to the exit.*
...*A nod under the mask. Just for a moment, the grin seems to really smile.*
Uh... hello. Zuka here. I'm good now, you know. Really.
I'm teaching Aang Guh firebending. He just sneezed a little flame. I'm kind of proud, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.oom_: Ah, a guest! Come, sit down. Nothing makes a day better than a cup of jasmine tea.
A nibble tastes best when you share it. Ho ho ho, do have another one.
The tea here is hot water with a leaf in it. But the water is hot, and that is something.
I do my exercises every day: push-ups, sit-ups and a whole lot of patience, guh.
The White Lotus blooms for those who know which tile to play. A game of Pai Sho?
Even in the darkest times you can find light somewhere. Or a nibble. Usually both.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.suki: I'm Suki Guh, a Kyoshi Warrior. We fight with fans, and we're very good at it.
This isn't makeup, it's war paint. ...Though it does look extra nice today, nyeg.
Nobody escapes from The Boiling Rock. Unless you have a plan. And friends. And nibbles.
They took my fans, but not my courage, guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.yue_: Welcome to the Northern Water Tribe! Dad says I mustn't bother the guests. So: hello!
I look at the moon every evening. I think it looks back a little.
I'm always here, Sokka Guh. Just look up at night.
The moon and the ocean keep each other in balance. Just like nibbles and a nap, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.veer: Tickets, please! Tickets! ...A nibble is fine too. Two is even better.
The boat only leaves when everyone is on board. Or when I feel like tea, guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.sche: Tap, tap, tap! Building a boat is just like stacking nibbles: the bottom one has to be sturdy.
This will be my most beautiful ship so far. Until I build the next one, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.kroe: Welcome to the inn! Here you drink nibble juice and tell tall tales.
*polishes a mug* This one's already clean. But polishing is so cozy, guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.kapi: I once caught a fish as big as... no, bigger. MUCH bigger.
The void is just like a sea, only without water. And without fish. But with nibbles, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.ring: Fly through the rings, not into them! I used to do that last one. A lot.
Ready? Go! ...Oh, you don't have a glider yet. Then we'll wait a bit, guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.guha: Would you like a little pie? I always have one more, nyeg. Happiness is in the small things, and in the filling.
A good gust of wind, a lovely arc... and the pie lands right on an old master's head. Perfect!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.pakg: Hm. Only guhs with a mustache may join my lessons. ...Fine, you may too. But sit up straight.
Water is patient, young guh. It waves, it waits, and then it just goes its own way anyway.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.bumi: Hehehe-HONK! Guess how old I am? Wrong! Even older! Hehehe!
Want a piece of crystal candy? It tastes like rock. I just looove it, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.aard: Welcome to my palace! Have you met Bosco yet? He is my best friend. He is a bear.
There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. Right? That is what everyone tells me, anyway.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.arno: Welcome to the Northern Water Tribe, traveler. It is cold here, but the guhs are warm.
A chief listens to the moon and to his people. And sometimes to his tummy, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.pian: A sword is almost never drawn. A brush, on the other hand... every day, nyeg.
The best master does not teach you how to win, but who you are. And how to paint a lovely line.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.werk: Not finished yet, nyeg! No peeking! ...Okay, one little peek then.
Steam, cogs and a pinch of chonk: you can build anything with that. Except a good cup of tea.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.roku: I am Roku Guh, Guhvatar of long ago. Even a spirit gets a craving for a nibble now and then.
Friendship can last longer than a lifetime, young guh. Even if you have to look a while for where it went.
The statue looks stern and wise. There is a bit of moss behind its ear.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.kyos: I am Kyoshi Guh. Yes, my feet are big. They are great for standing firm.
A fan is for giving a cool breeze, nyeg. And sometimes for being very clear.
An enormous pair of stone boots. The rest of the statue is big too, but those boots...
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.joo_: Hello! I am Joo Dee Guh. I will be your guide today. Isn't Ba Sing Guh just lovely!
There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. Here everyone is safe and happy. Smile!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.kool: Cabbages! Fresh cabbages! Buy a cabbage, get a cabbage... no, just the one cabbage.
MY CABBAGES! ...Oh, they are all still here. Phew, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.loke: Form filled in? In triplicate? With your paw print? No? Then join the line. At the back.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.kei_: The Boulder Guh feels... conflicted. Between a nap and a nibble.
The Boulder Guh sits here quietly, like a boulder. The Boulder Guh is very good at sitting.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.aard: Ladies and guhs! Welcome to the EAAARTH RUMBLE! Today: the biggest cuddle of the year!
Who dares to take on the Blind Bandit? Nobody? Then I will have another nibble.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.fang: The Blind Bandit! Did you see her?! I... I am getting so... *foam* ...happy!
I have all her autographs. All little stones. She stamps them with her foot!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.luch: Nice wind today, nyeg. Shall I play you a song on my flute? It is about a flying bison.
Everything is air, everything moves. Except a chonky guh after dinner.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.post: Mail for Omashguh! Down the chute, round the bend, and plop: into the bin. Quick, huh?
I sort everything by color. And by how nice the envelope smells, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.prof: Knowledge is the most beautiful thing there is. After nibbles. That is scientifically proven.
I am measuring something here. What exactly? I will only know once I have measured it.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.kyos: Welcome to the island of Kyoshi Guh. We are a small village, but with a big statue.
In my day we had no Guhvatar. We had a cup of tea and that was plenty, nyeg.
We are the Kyoshi Warrior Guhs! Our fans are fast, but our cuddles are faster.
A warrior guh is always ready. Also for offering someone a nibble.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.wate: Cold, huh? Put your hood up, then your little ears stay warm, nyeg.
Here we fish, here we play, and here we slide down the ice hill on our tummies.
Halt! Who goes there? ...Oh, a friend. Go on through, and welcome.
I guard the gate. Mostly against Mikas. And against too much wind.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.ba_s: There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. Am I saying that right? Lovely, nyeg.
*whispers* I think someone in a big hat is watching us. Act normal.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.omas: Welcome to Omashguh! Have you tried the mail chute yet? Wheeeee!
Everything here goes down the chute: mail, parcels, and now and then a lost guh, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.kyos: Good day! Lovely weather for fishing. Or for chonking on the beach.
It is quiet here on the island. Apart from the sea serpent, but it always waves.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.geva: It is no fun in here, but we keep our spirits up. Who knows another song?
One day we will be out of here. Then we will all go and eat nibbles together, nyeg!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.zonn: Greet the sun with me! Paws up... and breathe... can you feel the warmth?
Fire is life, nyeg. It is warmth and energy. Not something to play around with.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.vuur: Hmph. This is a holy temple. Wipe your paws, and no shoving. That is our job.
We worship fire. And our hats. Mostly our hats.
Come along, this way. Not every Fire Sage is strict, you know.
The fire of Roku Guh still burns, if you know where to look.
What do you want? Fire flakes? Those are mine. ...Fine, one.
Long live the Fire Nation! And long live lunch. Mostly lunch.
Silence in class! Repeat after me: Fire Lord Mikai is the best. ...Why are you giggling?
I have stood here for thirty years with this stick. The stick has never hit anyone. I am proud of that.
The teacher says I may not dance. *shuffles a little anyway*
Who are you? Are you new? Can I borrow your horn? Oh, you don't have a horn.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.tone: I am the Guhvatar! How do I bend the air? Very simple: I wave my arms really hard.
See my arrow? I painted it myself. A little crooked, but with love.
*sob* Hope! I have so much hope! *sob* I always talk about hope!
My hair loops are made of wool. They itch, but the audience thinks they are gorgeous.
I'm hungry! Does anyone have meat? Hahaha! ...That is my joke. I only have one.
My boomerang is made of cardboard. It does not come back. Neither do I, once it is gone.
I am a little girl! *deep voice* A VERY little girl. Can you tell?
I play the smallest of the troupe. I am the biggest of the troupe. That is called acting.
MY HONOR! ...Is my mask on right? The scar is on the wrong side? Nobody will notice.
I have a Mika mask on a stick. That makes me very scary. Boo. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.vu: Kneel before Fire Lord Mikai! ...Or at least step aside. Or I'll shove you. A little.
I am the mightiest Mika so far. Every nibble in the world will be MINE. Nyeh-heh-heh.
The nibble comet is here! Feel my fire! ...It's lukewarm. But very impressively lukewarm.
From now on, call me Phoenix King. It fits my crown better, NYEG!
Hmpf. Conquering the world is so tiring. A nibble, on the other hand... nom.
*burp* ...That was not very fire-lordly. One more, then. I'm just chonky now.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.az: Almost perfect isn't perfect. And my two strands of hair are PERFECT.
I'll shove you aside. Very neatly, very precisely. Nyeh-heh-heh.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.ty: Your aura is all pink! ...Oh no wait, that's my fur.
Poke, poke, poke! Haha, kidding, I won't hurt you. Want to see me do a cartwheel?
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.zh: I am Zhao the Invincible! I say so myself, so it's true.
That moon fish, I want it in a little bag. For my collection. Grrr.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.lo: There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. It is calm here. Here everyone is safe.
*whispers* The Dai Li see everything. Even that you just ate a nibble.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.da: Move along. Nothing to see. There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh.
We are the Dai Li. We see everything. ...Where's my hat? Oh, it's over my eyes.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.vu: Move along, guh! Or I'll shove you with my shoving stick. Gently, but still.
Long live Fire Lord Mikai! ...Is it break time yet? I could go for some fire flakes.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.ge: NOBODY has EVER escaped from The Boiling Rock! ...Let me just count my keys to be sure.
One, two, three... how many keys did I have again? Don't you run off!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.mi: Sorry... the nibble soup is minus nibble again. Sorry.
Actually I'd like to bake little cakes for guhs. But that's not allowed here. Sorry, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.ve: I see everything through my spyglass! ...Except what happens behind me.
Nobody gets into my fortress! And whoever does gets SHOVED back out!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.dr: GRRRAAAH! ...Sorry, that's how dragon guhs say hello. Will you show me your fire too, little chonk?
We have been dancing for ages. Dance with us? Fire in every colour, and nobody gets burned.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.wa: I am He Who Knows Ten Thousand Things. Don't touch my books with greasy nibble paws.
You came for the knowledge, little guh? Not to get something out of it? Hoo-hoo.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.vo: *wags* We seek knowledge for the great owl! This scroll goes to shelf six.
*sniff* You smell of nibbles. That's not in any book.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.le: Talking... slowly... is... an... art... too... nyeg.
I am older than the nibble comet. And still just a guh: sweet, and very, very big.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.fl: FLOP! *licks your whole face* Flopsie happy!
*bounces up and down* Hug? Hug! HUG!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.lu: Mrrrooo! (A sky bison guh says hello. Six legs, so six times as many cuddles.)
*snorts* Mrrooo. (He thinks you may lie on his soft back for a bit.)
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.ma: *blub* Tui swims circles around La, and La around Tui. That's how the moon stays in the sky.
*blub-nyeg* Please don't put me in a little bag.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.oc: *blub* La is the sea and Tui is the moon. Together we swim in circles.
*blub* Swim with us? The water is nice and lukewarm.
item.guhs.maanvis_spawn_egg: Tui the Moon Fish Spawn Egg
item.guhs.oceaanvis_spawn_egg: La the Ocean Fish Spawn Egg
Welcome, little guh. What an... interesting little face you have. Do stay very, very calm.
I already have a thousand faces, nyeg. One more would look so... chonky on me.
*sniffs your hand* ...Do you smell a little like Nibble Chorus? My forest has smelled of ash for so long.
Shhh. Do you hear the forest whisper? It's whispering your name. ...No, just kidding. It's whispering 'nibble'.
Grrrum. Roku Guh and I flew above the clouds every morning. Mostly I miss the breakfast afterwards.
A spirit dragon flies wherever his heart wants to go. My heart mostly wants to go to the tea pavilion, nyeg.
We have swum in circles for ages. Push and pull, light and dark, Tui and La. Dizzy? Never.
No tides without the moon, no moon without the ocean. ...And no guhs without nibbles.
Bzzzz-hop! *looks at you VERY curiously* ...Bzzzz-HOP!
*sniffs your nose and zooms off* ...*comes back* ...*zooms off again*
I'm a little lost. But as long as I'm lit, I'm never completely in the dark, nyeg!
*winks* A lantern that winks? In the Spirit World that's perfectly normal, you know.
Shhh... go away. This is my dark little edge. I only push a little. *push*
I was once a thought nobody wanted to think. Now I push guhs aside. Nice career, nyeg.
I came here once for a single cup of tea. That was three hundred years ago. The tea is still delightful.
I know someone who will want to live here one day... round, a beard, says wise things about tea. I'm keeping a cushion free for him.
One order? Coming right up! *runs to the bank* ...Want a receipt with that, nyeg?
Just tell me what you need: I'll fetch it all from your bank and set the machines running. Fast, cheerful and chonky!
*puts a scroll down in front of you and taps it with its paw* ...Not reading? Then just follow me, nyeg!
Knowledge is never lost, says the owl. Only a little astray sometimes. That's what we're here for.
*looks at you with one eye* ...Kraa?
*shakes the mist off its feathers and stands on one leg*
I slept for ages around the stone lotus. Whoever lays all the tiles wakes me. That's you, then, nyeg.
The order began with one conversation over a game board. Everything that grows big starts very small.
You look like someone I was, a very long time ago.
*a sigh as deep as the mist itself*
*the distance rumbles softly, as if something very big is smiling*
*the mask slowly turns towards you*
*the mask looks. It keeps looking. You look back. It wins.*
Fire is not a toy, young guh. It eats everything you give it... your nibbles too.
Once I ran away from my own flame. Here in the mist I'm finally getting to know it, nyeg.
Is it really you, or am I dreaming about tea again? ...It doesn't matter. Sit down, nyeg.
Somewhere far away I'm simply drinking tea. This here is only a dream of mine. A cozy dream.
Hahaha! You still think in straight lines! Turn yourself around. Or turn the room around!
A mad old king knows: the answer that's right in front of you is usually the wrong one, nyeg.
No. ...Just kidding. I've learned you don't need a mustache to bend water.
Water forgets nothing. Not even the necklace I once carved, for someone I never forgot.
A sword is not a weapon but a brush. You paint your own story with it.
Breathe to the beat, parry to the beat. Rhythm is the quietest kind of courage, nyeg.
In Roku Guh's time we laid the first tile. One white lotus, in between all the flags.
The order belongs to no single nation. We belong to everyone who shares tea, wisdom and nibbles.
The password? ...A lotus blooms in the mud too. Welcome, nyeg.
I used to play Pai Sho every evening. I still do, just a little more see-through.
Ah, there you are! I was waiting for you. I like waiting. A sip of onion-banana juice? Very good for your chakras.
Let go of what weighs you down, young guh. Except your nibbles. You may keep those.
I once fought a spirit that stole faces. Hold on tight to yours, nyeg.
I used to think I had all the time in the world. Use yours well, Guhvatar.
Even an Air Nomad must stand firm sometimes, for those who love her.
The wind never blows for itself. It always carries something along: a leaf, a song, a whiff of nibbles.
You don't lead a nation with fire, but with good paperwork and a warm heart. Mostly the paperwork, nyeg.
I filled in forms my whole life. Even as a spirit I still carry a few.
*does a happy loop around your head* Bzzz-hop! I'm staying right here with you, nyeg.
*lands on your shoulder for a moment, sniffs your ear and zooms up again*
*settles on a leaf* I'll wait here. Bzzz... (sneak-click to take me along again)
*darts towards you* Bzzz-HOP! Along, along, along!
gui.guhs.einde2_geestmodellen.fang.vast: Fang is holding you tight. Hang on just a little longer, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.koh: Rarity: One, deep in his cave (and he'd rather you didn't come)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.koh: A gigantic centipede spirit who collects faces: hundreds of them, guhs' and Mikas' too. Whoever visits him shows nothing on their face: no laugh, no fright, no nyeg. He never really steals, but he does look very hungry.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.hei_bai_guh: Rarity: One, in the Whispering Wood
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.hei_bai_guh: A cute forest-spirit panda with a guh snout. When his forest is sad, he becomes a black giant with six arms and a white mask. A Nibble Chorus acorn from the Guh End calms him down: then he's small and cuddly again.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.fang: Rarity: One, on the Sky Path
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.fang: The spirit dragon of Guhvatar Roku Guh: red, see-through, with guh ears and long whiskers. He carries a Guhvatar on his neck where needed. Breakfast after a flight is the most important thing in the world to him.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.geest_koi: Rarity: Two, above the Sky Pond
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.geest_koi: Tui and La: the Moon Spirit and the Ocean Spirit, two gigantic glowing koi forever chasing each other. Push and pull, light and dark. Without them no tides, and without tides no beach to chonk out on.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.libelkonijnguh: A tiny bunny with a guh face and four dragonfly wings. Terribly curious: it follows you, sniffs your nose and zooms off as soon as you get too close. Whoever brings the lost lanterns home gets one that stays.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.lantaarngeest: Floating paper lanterns with a painted little face, in red, amber, pink and blue. They wink. They love getting lost, and love it even more when you bring them back to the lantern tree.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.schaduwgeest: Rarity: In the dark edges of the wood
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.schaduwgeest: Tall smoky shadows with two white eyes. They gently push you away from their dark little spot, nothing more. They can grumble with the best of them.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kennisvosje: Rarity: A few, at the White Lotus (and very rarely a golden one)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kennisvosje: Spirit foxes with round guh ears, family of Wan Shi Guh's foxes. They lug scrolls around. Follow one and it shows you a little secret. Seeing a golden knowledge fox is a story for your grandguhs.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.mistreiger: Rarity: On the roofs of the White Lotus
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mistreiger: Small white herons with tiny ears. They stand on one leg in the mist and fly up as soon as you get too close. Sneaking closer helps a little.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.oude_reigerguh: Rarity: One, coiled around the stone lotus
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.oude_reigerguh: A gigantic see-through crane spirit with guh ears and a red crown. He slept for ages around the stone lotus, until someone laid all the Pai Sho tiles. He knows the whole history of the White Lotus, from the very first tile.
item.guhs.koh_spawn_egg: Koh the Face Stealer Spawn Egg
block.guhs.geestengras.lore: Lilac grass. Everything's the other way round here, nyeg.
item.guhs.geestengras.lore: Lilac grass. Everything's the other way round here, nyeg.
block.guhs.geestenaarde.lore: Soil from the Spirit World. Smells of moonlight.
item.guhs.geestenaarde.lore: Soil from the Spirit World. Smells of moonlight.
block.guhs.geestenhout.lore: White wood with a blue grain. Only grows where nobody's looking.
item.guhs.geestenhout.lore: White wood with a blue grain. Only grows where nobody's looking.
block.guhs.geestenplanken.lore: Planks of spirit wood. They creak in another language.
item.guhs.geestenplanken.lore: Planks of spirit wood. They creak in another language.
block.guhs.schaduwhout.lore: Black wood with a white grain: spirit wood on a bad day.
item.guhs.schaduwhout.lore: Black wood with a white grain: spirit wood on a bad day.
block.guhs.schaduwplanken.lore: Planks of shadow wood. They look a bit stern.
item.guhs.schaduwplanken.lore: Planks of shadow wood. They look a bit stern.
block.guhs.gloeibladeren_cyaan.lore: Leaves that make their own light. Handy if you're scared of the dark.
item.guhs.gloeibladeren_cyaan.lore: Leaves that make their own light. Handy if you're scared of the dark.
block.guhs.gloeibladeren_roze.lore: A soft pink glow. The spirits find it cozy.
item.guhs.gloeibladeren_roze.lore: A soft pink glow. The spirits find it cozy.
block.guhs.schaduwbladeren.lore: Dark leaves from the edges of the wood. They whisper the loudest.
item.guhs.schaduwbladeren.lore: Dark leaves from the edges of the wood. They whisper the loudest.
block.guhs.maansteen.lore: Pale stone with a sheen of moon and ocean.
item.guhs.maansteen.lore: Pale stone with a sheen of moon and ocean.
block.guhs.maansteen_tegels.lore: Old tiles of the spirit paths. Not swept in a thousand years.
item.guhs.maansteen_tegels.lore: Old tiles of the spirit paths. Not swept in a thousand years.
block.guhs.maansteen_trap.lore: Stairs of moonstone. They go up, and also down.
item.guhs.maansteen_trap.lore: Stairs of moonstone. They go up, and also down.
block.guhs.maansteen_plaat.lore: Half a moonstone tile. The other half is still on its way.
item.guhs.maansteen_plaat.lore: Half a moonstone tile. The other half is still on its way.
block.guhs.nevelwater.lore: Water that falls up. Don't think about it, nyeg.
item.guhs.nevelwater.lore: Water that falls up. Don't think about it, nyeg.
block.guhs.geestpaddenstoel_steel.lore: The stem of a giant mushroom. Soft and a little spongy.
item.guhs.geestpaddenstoel_steel.lore: The stem of a giant mushroom. Soft and a little spongy.
block.guhs.geestpaddenstoel_hoed.lore: Glows teal with pink spots. Don't eat it.
item.guhs.geestpaddenstoel_hoed.lore: Glows teal with pink spots. Don't eat it.
block.guhs.lotusblad.lore: A pale lotus leaf drifting in the mist. Holds a chonky guh.
item.guhs.lotusblad.lore: A pale lotus leaf drifting in the mist. Holds a chonky guh.
block.guhs.geestlantaarn.lore: A lantern with a cool, blue light.
item.guhs.geestlantaarn.lore: A lantern with a cool, blue light.
block.guhs.geestenmasker.lore: A face from the wall of Koh's Cave. It looks at you, even when you look away.
item.guhs.geestenmasker.lore: A face from the wall of Koh's Cave. It looks at you, even when you look away.
block.guhs.meditatiesteen.lore: Sit still for a moment and click: your soul sniffs its way back to your body.
item.guhs.meditatiesteen.lore: Sit still for a moment and click: your soul sniffs its way back to your body.
block.guhs.gedenksteen.lore: An old stone with a story. Click to read.
item.guhs.gedenksteen.lore: An old stone with a story. Click to read.
block.guhs.lotuspuzzeltegel.lore: A piece of the White Lotus. Click to turn it.
