item.guhs.lotuspuzzeltegel.lore: A piece of the White Lotus. Click to turn it.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.geest: A world next to ours, where almost nobody can go. Except the Guhvatar. And whoever stands very close to the Guhvatar. The grass is lilac, the wood is white and the water falls up. Why? The spirits say: why not?
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.medit: Here your body sleeps, but your soul keeps sniffing around, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.lanta: Every lantern spirit belongs on this tree. But lantern spirits are curious and wander off: eight hooks are empty. They'll surely come back, if somebody shows them the way.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.geflu: The trees whisper. Mostly gossip about the Tea Spirit. Shadow spirits live in the dark edges: they nudge you aside a little and do nothing else. They're just shy.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.hei_b: The guardian spirit of a forest in the real world. When his forest burned down, he grew big and angry. An acorn from home makes him small and sweet again. Like everybody, really.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.koh.t: Show no emotion. Don't laugh, don't flinch, don't sneeze. Koh collects faces the way you collect nibbles. He never makes jokes. If he does make a joke anyway: don't laugh.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.witte: An old society of wise guhs who play Pai Sho, drink tea and quietly protect the world. Mostly drink tea. Lay the tiles as a lotus and the gate knows you're a friend.
The Guhvatar before you. Chonked out in a cheese ball for a hundred years and missed almost everything. Passed the torch to you. Laughs a lot, eats no meat, but lots and lots of nibbles.
Wise, calm, and an impressive beard. His best friend later became a Fire Lord with very bad ideas. Roku Guh says: choose your friends well. And your Fire Lords too.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.kyosh: Tall, strict, and with fans you'd rather not get against your ears. Turned a peninsula into an island, just because she could. Her followers still wear her makeup.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.kuruk: As a young Guhvatar he fought a hundred angry spirits. Then Koh stole the face of his beloved, Ummi Guh. Since then he trusts no centipede at all. Not even the little ones.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.yangc: Always said: the Guhvatar is there for the world, not for herself. Then she secretly ate the last nibble anyway. Nobody's perfect.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.szeto: As Guhvatar he mostly worked on paperwork. Filled everything out in triplicate, here in the Spirit World too. His pile is still around somewhere. Don't touch it: it's sorted.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.wan.t: The very first Guhvatar. Or was it a cheese nibble with big plans? The sources disagree. The sources are also a bit cheesy.
Nothing here yet. This stone is waiting for the Guhvatar of today. That's you, nyeg. No scratching: it's just been polished.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.top.t: Here you speak with the Guhvatars of old. They mostly talk over each other, and Roku Guh always starts with: when I was young...
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.hemel: Tui and La, the moon and the ocean: push and pull. As long as they swim their circles, the tide is right and the moon shines. Don't feed them: they're on a diet.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.theep: The Tea Spirit once came here for a cup and never left. He says: I know somebody else who wants to live here one day... round, beard, says wise things about tea.
Fang, Roku Guh's spirit dragon. He only flies with whoever Roku Guh trusts. And with whoever smells nice. Wash your ears, just to be safe.
King of a city on a mountain, and even madder than he looked. He ate crystal cheese rind and all and called it breakfast. His lesson: when everyone goes left, first have a quick look right. Then up. Then left once more, for fun.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.pakgu: Strict as winter ice, everyone said. But under the ice, water always flows. Long ago he carved a betrothal necklace for someone he loved very much. She chose another path, and he kept the little stone. The ice remembers everything, nyeg. Even what was soft.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.piand: Lived in a castle full of swords and never hurt anyone. He forged his finest sword from a falling star. His lesson: a sword is an extension of your arm, and your arm an extension of your heart. So keep your heart a little tidy.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.jeong: Jeong Jeong Guh, the Runaway Master

A firebending master who ran away, because fire was used far too often to burn instead of to warm. He teaches you patience first, then more patience, and only then a little spark. Light the candles, but leave every lotus leaf whole.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.miroh: He isn't really here: Uncle Miroh is still alive and drinking tea somewhere. This is a dream of him, kept by the White Lotus. He says: a good cup of tea doesn't solve every problem. Most of them, though. And you see the rest a lot more calmly afterwards.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.heili: Six pedestals round a stone lotus that nobody has ever seen open. Five tiles of the masters, and a sixth: the White Lotus itself. Beside it sleeps a heron as old as the order. Don't wake it. Or do, once you're ready.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.archi: Every scroll here is a secret the order kept: maps of old roads, recipes for tea nobody knows any more, Pai Sho moves that once stopped a war. A Knowledge Fox keeps putting them somewhere else. It calls that tidying up.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.leden: Before there were masters, there were ordinary guhs who poured tea for anyone who was lost. That's how the White Lotus began: with a cup, a game of Pai Sho and a place to sleep. The founder came from the days of Roku Guh. His name is forgotten, his teapot isn't.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.trap_: Five giant statues of the masters of the White Lotus stand along the road, half overgrown, with ears of stone. Whoever walks here walks between their lessons. Give them a nod. They don't say anything back, but they do notice.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.koh_g: Every arch here has a face. They watch. They don't blink. Walk on calmly and think of something boring, like Szeto Guh's forms. Whoever laughs here might get a new face from Koh. Or none.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.tui_l: Push and pull, moon and ocean: white with a black spot, black with a white one. By this islet they swim so close you can hear their scales rustle. Stand still for a moment. They've swum the same circles for a thousand years and never once had a quarrel.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.theet: Every day the gossip club of the Whispering Wood meets here. They talk about who got lost, who has a new face and who ate the last nibble. That last one is usually the Tea Spirit himself.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.moera: Everything here is connected to everything, say the roots. Sometimes you see someone you know in the still little pool. Or someone you're going to know. Don't look too long: the swamp loves a bit of gossip. And somewhere beyond the mist lies something you can't see yet.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.geest: A bell as big as a little house, cast back when nobody could remember anything yet. Whoever pulls the rope makes the Spirit World go quiet for a moment. Every spirit looks up. And then something small and strange happens. What, exactly? Not even the bell knows.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.schri: A little shrine for whoever travels the spirit paths, with a nibble as an offering. Nobody knows who leaves a fresh nibble here every day. The spirits suspect each other. It's surely the Tea Spirit.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.raads: I have a face but no head, I look at you but can't see you, and I live with someone who has a thousand of them. What am I? (Very small at the bottom: a mask.)
I fall upwards, I'm wet but not cold, you walk right through me and I just stay put. What am I? (Very small at the bottom: mist water, nyeg.)
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.gehei: Found it! Something invisible leaves a nibble here every day. Maybe for you. Maybe for the Guhvatar after you. Don't eat it: it's made of clay.
A Knowledge Fox sleeps here when nobody's looking. It keeps its finest scroll in here: a recipe for nibbles that never run out. It has never worked. The fox keeps trying.
The finest view in the Spirit World, says the Tea Spirit. He comes here when he wants a break from the gossip club. Don't tell anyone.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.terug: Your soul sniffs its way back to your body. Welcome back, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.geen_terug: Your body wasn't anywhere any more: you wake up at your bed.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.leegte: The mist gently lifts you back to the Meditation Circle. Don't look down, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.beschermd: Nothing changes in the Spirit World. Not even if you push really hard.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.niet_hier: Meditating only works in the Spirit World. Here it's just a stone.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.aangekomen: Your eyes glow. You float... and land softly in the Spirit World.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.opgelost: The lotus is whole! Somewhere an old gate sighs... (patience, nyeg)
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.geen_lore: This stone is so old that even its letters have fallen asleep.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.portaal: Go back to the Guh End through your portal. At the Nibble Mountain, where you come out, the cheese ball glows: click it and you are right back in your story.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.kaasbol: Far from your story? Click the glowing cheese ball at the Nibble Mountain (%s): it takes you straight back.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.kaasbol_h: The cheese ball glows close by. Click it and you are right back in your story.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.kaasbol_b: Click the cheese ball: on with your story!
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.verder: The cheese ball glows brightly... and takes you back to your story!
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.verder_ap: Appa rumbles, swishes his tail... and a gust of wind takes you back to your story!
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.geest: This step takes place in the Spirit World: meditate again at the spot where you meditated last time.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.wacht: The wind is still finding the way. Try again in a moment, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.geen_plek: The cheese ball knows no place for this step. Look in your Guhdex (Tales) for where to go.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.niets: There is no story to continue right now.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.kaasbol.melding: Something glowing is washing up at the Nibble Mountain... A cheese ball?
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.kaasbol.klik: The cheese ball is warm and hums softly. Something is knocking inside!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.vlucht.mislukt: Appa can't leave yet: the wind doesn't know the way to the Air Temple yet. Try again in a moment, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.vlucht.fluit: Appa lands. Got off? Whistle for him with your Appa whistle and he'll fly you on.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.doel.stap.2: The spirits in the Hall of the Guhvatars
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.doel.stap.3: Monk Guhatso on the pie terrace
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.doel.stap.4: The start arch of the Air Scooter Track
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.doel.stap.5: The column of wind to the balcony
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.doel.stap.8: The closed door of the workshop
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.beloning.luchts: Airbending (in the temple: air ball and air leap)
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.beloning.kreeg: You get the air nomad robe with the arrow and two air scooters for your guhs!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.welkom: There you are! The Hall of the Guhvatars is straight ahead: through the gate, across the square, the big white hall with the tower on top.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.hal: The Hall is straight ahead, the big white building with the tower on top. Inside on the right, Roku Guh and Kyoshi Guh are waiting. Well, their spirits. Don't be scared when they talk.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.luchtbal: Airball! Guhatso is by the pies on the terrace, west of the Hall, next to the court with the poles. I'll go and stand on my pole already. Fair warning: I'm good at it, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.scooter: The Air Scooter Track starts at the orange-and-yellow arch, south of the Airball Court, at the edge. Step on the line and you're standing on a ball of air: the most fun thing there is!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.zweef: To the balcony at the top of the tall tower? Step into the column of wind in the middle of the square in front of the Hall: the wind lifts you up there. Jump, and trust the wind.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.momo: A lemur guh snatched your nibble? Haha! They live all over the place here. Look, there he flutters, that glowing thing! Just follow him.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.stal: Appa's old stable is the white building with the green roof between the two northern towers. The saddle is to the right of the door, the apples are on the left. He hasn't had an apple in a hundred years!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.deur: Do you hear that ticking? It comes from the workshop, the long building east of the Hall. The door is in the west wall. Go and have a look!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.steiger: Something's moored at the jetty, down on the landing terrace on the east side. A ship? Ships never come here...
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.vlucht: No talking: run! Appa is waiting in the camp!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.na.0: Airbending is just like chonking: you mustn't try too hard.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.na.1: Up for some airball later? I've been practising in secret.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.na.2: It's less quiet here since you came. Nice, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.vroeg: Ha! A new face. Or an old face in a new body? Come back once you've seen the Hall.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.lucht: I am monk Guhatso. Well: the memory of him. Aang Guh was my best pupil. Airball is simple: the glowing ball floats above the poles and always comes to rest above a pole. Hop to a pole next to it and hit it with a left click towards Aang Guh's goal, at the north end of the court. Whoever falls into the cloud, the wind puts straight back on a pole. First to three!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.scoot: Well played! Now the Air Scooter Track. Walk south to the orange-and-yellow arch at the edge of the temple, and step on the line. You ride a ball of air: look where you want to go, W is faster, space jumps.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.zweef: And now the best part: gliding. Jump off the south balcony at the top of the tall tower and fly through the six rings. The column of wind in the middle of the square in front of the Hall takes you up.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.later: The wind forgets nothing, young Guhvatar. Nor do I. Especially not where the pies are.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.gewon: Ha! Three to fewer than three! Aang Guh, you've been beaten by the new Guhvatar. Pie for everyone!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.roku.raad.0: Air teaches you to let go. Water teaches you to go with the flow. Earth teaches you to stand. And fire... teaches you to be careful.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.roku.raad.1: Once I was too late to stop a fire. Be on time, Guhvatar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.roku.raad.2: A Guhvatar is not strong because he can do everything. He is strong because he is not alone.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.kyoshi.raad.0: Be kind. But never let anyone simply take your nibbles.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.kyoshi.raad.1: A fan is a weapon too. And a fine way to cool your tea.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.kyoshi.raad.2: I was the tallest Guhvatar ever. That means nothing. Except that I could reach everything.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.start: Airball! The glowing ball floats above the poles. Hop to a pole next to it and hit it (left click) towards Aang Guh's goal, on the far side. First to three!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.titel_: Hit the ball (left click) towards the goal on the far side
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.terug_: Floop! The wind puts you back on a pole.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.bal_te: The wind brings the ball back, right next to you.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.schiet: Aang Guh shoots at your goal! Stop it!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.jij: GOAL! The ball whooshes through Aang Guh's goal!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.blaast: Aang Guh blows the ball back to you!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.verlor: Aang Guh wins this time. Talk to Guhatso for a new match, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.weg: You left the court: the match stops. Talk to Guhatso to start again.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.klaar: You're standing on an air scooter! Look where you want to go, W is faster, S brakes, space jumps. Ride through every gate to the finish.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.stap_op: The Air Scooter Track starts here: step on the black-and-white line under the arch!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.uitleg: Look where you want to go - W is faster
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.te_laat: Time's up! No worries: step on the line under the start arch again and have another go.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.afgesta: You stepped off the air scooter. Step on the line under the start arch to ride again.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.terug_o: Whoosh! The wind puts you back on the track.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.gehaald: Made it in %s seconds! Guhatso claps his see-through little hands.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.balkon: Jump off the balcony: you glide and sink slowly. Look at the blue ring!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.je_zweeft: You're gliding! Look where you want to go. Looking down is faster.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.gemist: Just missed! No worries: on to the next blue ring.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.te_weinig: You glided through %s rings. No worries: the wind will put you back on the balcony in a moment, then you have another go.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.wind_komt: Guhatso: "And now: gliding!" In a moment the wind lifts you up to the balcony of the tall tower...
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.op_balkon: You're on the south balcony at the top of the tall tower. Jump off: you glide and sink very slowly. Look where you want to go and fly through the six rings; the next one lights up blue.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.zuil: Whoosh! The column of wind lifts you up to the balcony.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.neergezet: The wind sets you down gently on the square.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.momo.jat: Hey! A little Bat-Lemur Guh snatches the nibble out of your hand and flutters off!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.momo.volg: Follow the glowing lemur guh! He leaves a trail of little clouds and waits for you if you fall behind.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.momo.daar: There he is! The glowing lemur guh, right in front of you. Follow him!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.momo.toren: He flies into the Monks' Tower. After him, up the stairs!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.momo.wacht: Squeak! The lemur guh is waiting for you. Come on, follow the trail of little clouds.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.appa_komt: Appa plods into his old stable and sniffs at everything.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.zadel_gepa: You take Appa's saddle off the trestle. Now click Appa with it!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.zadel_klaa: The saddle is on! Appa looks at it approvingly.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.zadel_zit_: The saddle is already on Appa.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.doe_zadel: Take the glowing saddle off the wooden trestle, to the right of the door (right click).
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.doe_op_app: Click Appa with the saddle in your hand.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.doe_appels: Take apples from the barrel to the left of the door (right click).
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.doe_voeren: Click Appa with an apple in your hand.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.vol: Appa is full. Three apples is enough.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.appels: You take apples from the barrel. Now click Appa with them!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.klaar: Appa is happy: a whole saddle and a full belly. He licks your whole head. Eww. And: aww.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.deur.hier: The workshop! The closed door is in the west wall, under the lantern. Walk into it.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.deur.titel_onde: Something is moored at the jetty...
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.deur.klop: You knock on the closed door...
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.deur.werktuiggu: A voice behind the door: "Not finished yet, nyeg! Come back later. Much later!"
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.deur.gong: In the distance the wind gong rings. Something is moored at the jetty: down on the landing terrace, on the east side!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.ontsnap.start: Run west, to Appa in the camp by the campfire! Dodge the fireballs and Zuka's men.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.ontsnap.terug: Zuka's men put you back at the start of the jetty. One more time, nyeg!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.koning.oog: Oh, and grill skewer powder? You grind it from a grill skewer of the Spark Mikas in the Skewer Keep, in the Barbecuether. One skewer, two portions. There. Now you know everything, nyeg.
advancements.guhs.guheinde.einde2_h1_luc: Learn airbending in the Southern Air Temple
block.guhs.luchtscooter.lore: A toy for your guhs: a spinning ball of air. Whoosh, round and round!
item.guhs.luchtscooter.lore: A toy for your guhs: a spinning ball of air. Whoosh, round and round!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.luchtscoo: Guhs ride whooshing rounds on the air scooter.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.uitleg: A glowing cheese ball washes up at the Nibble Mountain. Inside: Aang Guh, the previous Guhvatar, and his sky bison Appa Guh. And you turn out to be the new Guhvatar. First: learn airbending in the Southern Air Temple.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.0: Open the glowing cheese ball that washed up at the Nibble Mountain.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.0: The Guheinde, at the Nibble Mountain (where the portal sets you down)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.1: Fly on Appa to the Southern Air Temple. Got off? Whistle for him with your Appa whistle.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.1: The Southern Air Temple, high above the void
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.2: Walk from the landing place up the big stairs to the north, through the temple gate and across the square. Go into the big white Hall with the tall tower on top. On the right (east) the spirits of Roku Guh and Kyoshi Guh stand in front of their statues, with a beam of light above their heads: talk to one of them.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.2: The big white Hall with the tall tower on top, north of the temple gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.3: Leave the Hall and go west. Monk Guhatso stands by the pies on the terrace above the Airball Court (the court full of poles). Talk to him and play airball against Aang Guh: hop from pole to pole and hit the glowing ball with a left click towards Aang Guh's goal. First to three!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.3: The pie terrace above the Airball Court, west of the Hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.4: Walk south from the Airball Court, to the edge of the temple. There stands the orange-and-yellow start arch with a beam of light and swirling little clouds. Step on the black-and-white line under the arch: you get an air scooter, and after 3-2-1 you're off. Look where you want to go, W is faster. Ride through every gate to the finish.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.4: The orange-and-yellow start arch, south of the Airball Court (the southwest corner of the temple)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.5: The wind takes you to the south balcony at the top of the tall tower on the roof of the Hall (later the column of wind in the middle of the square in front of the Hall does it too). Jump off the balcony: you glide and sink very slowly. Look where you want to go and fly through the six rings; the next ring lights up blue. You may miss one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.5: The south balcony at the top of the tall tower on the Hall (column of wind: the middle of the square in front of the Hall)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.6: A little Bat-Lemur Guh snatched your nibble! He flutters, glowing, right in front of you and leaves a trail of little clouds. Follow him: to the Monks' Tower in the northwest, into the tower and up, and over the roofs. If you fall behind, he waits for you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.6: Follow the glowing lemur guh (first to the Monks' Tower, northwest)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.7: Go to Appa's stable: the big white building with the green roof between the two towers in the north, behind the Hall (the door is on the south side). To the right of the door, take the glowing saddle off the wooden trestle (right click), then click Appa with it, and give him three apples from the barrel to the left of the door (right click Appa with an apple).
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.7: Appa's stable, between the two northern towers (behind the Hall)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.8: Something is ticking behind a closed door. Walk to the long, low building east of the Hall: the workshop. The big closed door is in the west wall, under the lantern and the beam of light. Walk into it or click it.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.8: The door in the west wall of the workshop, east of the Hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.9: The wind gong rings: something is moored at the jetty! Walk south, through the temple gate and down the big stairs to the landing terrace where you arrived with Appa. The wooden jetty sticks out into the void on its east side (beam of light).
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.9: The wooden jetty on the east side of the landing terrace (south, at the bottom of the stairs)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.klaa: Airbending learnt! Appa flies you to the Northern Water Tribe.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.kl: On the way to the Northern Water Tribe
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.9_vl: Escape! Run west across the landing terrace to Appa by the campfire in the camp (beam of light). Dodge Zuka's fireballs and his men.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.9_: The camp with the campfire, west on the landing terrace
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.kort.1: Fly with Appa to the Air Temple
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.kort.2: To the Hall, talk to a spirit
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.kort.3: Airball: Guhatso, west of the Hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.kort.4: Start arch south of the Airball Court
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.kort.9_: Run to Appa in the camp (west)!
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_h1_lucht.r: For a hundred years the Guhvatar slept in a cheese ball. Now the cheese ball is open, and the world is hungry.
High above the void floats the Southern Air Temple. This is where the air nomad guhs learnt to glide, to play and to share.
Aang Guh grew up here. It is quiet now, but the wind still knows the way.
Get to know the air, Guhvatar. She is light, free... and a little naughty. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.drijf: High above the void, something glowing drifts towards the Nibble Mountain. Slowly. Solemnly. A little crooked.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.plof: Plop. It rolls on a little... and lies still.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.barst: A glowing crack runs across the cheese. It grows wider. The light grows brighter.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.gaap: Haaaaa... What a nap. How long did I sleep? An hour? Two?
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.hallo: Oh! Hello! I'm Aang Guh. And that big hairy thing behind me is Appa. He's a sky bison. A guh sky bison.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.ogen: Suddenly something tingles in you, from your little ears to your toes. Your eyes begin to glow...
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.guhva: Whoa! Your eyes are glowing! Then you're... you're the new Guhvatar!
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.korra: ...Wait a moment. Your name isn't Korra, is it?
Korra? Never heard of her, nyeg. Forget I asked.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.stokj: I was the Guhvatar before you. I went for a little chonk in the cheese ball... and it turned into a hundred years. The baton is yours now.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.verha: But first you need to know what happened while I was asleep. Sit down. It's an epic story.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.vroeger: Long ago, the four nations lived together in chonkiness.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.trek: Then everything changed when the Fire Nation got peckish...
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.guhvata: One guh could bend all four elements and made sure every nibble was shared fairly: the Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.slaap: But just when the world needed him most, he curled up in a cheese ball. For a nap of a hundred years.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.mikai: Fire Lord Mikai ate and ate. And the more he ate, the hungrier the world became.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.jij: Now the cheese ball is open. The baton has passed to a new Guhvatar. To you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.jipjip: Come on! Appa will take us to my old home, the Southern Air Temple. That's where you'll learn airbending. Yip yip!
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_aankomst.temp: The Southern Air Temple. White, quiet and higher than the clouds.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_aankomst.thui: Home! Well... my old home. It's so quiet without the monks. Come on, first the Hall of the Guhvatars.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.beelden: The hall holds the statues of every guh who was the Guhvatar before you. Their eyes seem to follow you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.roku1: Welcome, young Guhvatar. I am Roku Guh. Long ago I stood where you stand now, with knees just as wobbly.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.kyoshi1: And I am Kyoshi Guh. One thing first: one element is not enough.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.roku2: Air, water, earth and fire. Learn all four, in that order. Only then can you stop Fire Lord Mikai.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.kyoshi2: And don't forget to eat. A hungry Guhvatar saves nobody. I speak from experience.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.voetstuk: In the middle of the hall, one pedestal is still empty. It seems to be waiting for someone.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_momo.gevangen: In his little nest under the roof, the lemur guh finally lets himself be caught.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_momo.terug: He puts your nibble neatly back in your hand. Then he climbs onto your shoulder and stays there.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_momo.naam: He has chosen you. From now on his name is Momo Guh, and he goes everywhere with you.
BOOM! A Fire Nation ship rams the jetty. Planks fly everywhere.
Three years I have searched. If I bring you to my father, I get my honor back!
Prince Zuka. Banished, angry, and very, very determined. His men jump onto the jetty after him.
Get the Guhvatar! But gently, mind you. Father wants him in one piece.
Appa is waiting in the camp at the other end of the terrace. Run!
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_geleerd.blaas: Zuka's fireball flies straight at you. You sweep your arm aside, and the wind goes with it.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_geleerd.zag_j: Did you see that?! You blew that fireball right aside! That's airbending!
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_geleerd.gelee: Air is light and free. Just like a guh after dinner. You've learnt it, Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_geleerd.volge: On to the Northern Water Tribe! Someone there will teach us waterbending. Yip yip!
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_knipoog_sjokk: On the Air Scooter Track, Shuckly has started his race too. He has all the time in the world.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.hal: The spirits of Roku-guh and Kyoshi-guh are waiting %s, in the big white Hall: up the stairs, through the gate, across the square.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.luchtbal: Monk Guhatso is standing %s, by the pies above the Airball Court. Talk to him.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.scooter: The orange-and-yellow start arch is %s, at the south edge of the temple. Step onto the line under it.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.zweven: The first ring is hanging %s. After that, the next ring always lights up blue.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.momo: The lemur guh is fleeing to the Monks' Tower, %s. Lost him? The door is on the south side of the tower.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.stal: Appa's stable with the green roof is %s. The door is on the south side.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.deur: The closed door of the workshop is %s, in the west wall of the long building east of the Hall.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.zuka: The jetty is %s: down the big stairs, on the east side of the landing terrace.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.les.1: Did you see that? That ball didn't fly because of your hand, but because of the wind you gave it. That was airbending! A tiny bit, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.les.2: Now without a ball. Press %s, pick Air Leap in your power wheel and jump on the wind!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.les.3: Air Leap and Air Ball work everywhere in the temple. Go on, try them!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.les.sprong: Whoa, did you see how high? Air doesn't push, air lifts you up. Now try Air Ball: a gust wherever you look.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.les.bal: Whoosh! That's it! Air is light and free. You'll learn the rest on the way: running, gliding... and maybe one day blowing away a fireball.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_hal.teks: The Hall of the Guhvatars. Two spirits are waiting for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_luchtbal: Monk Guhatso. He has a game for you, and pie.
This is where the Air Scooter Track begins.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_zweven.t: The first ring. Jump, and trust the wind.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_momo.tek: The Monks' Tower. That's where that lemur guh wants to go!
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_stal.tek: Appa's old stable. He's hungry, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_deur.tek: Something is ticking... behind that door.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_zuka.tek: The jetty. Something is lying there... something big.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.kracht.uitleg: New power: %1$s! Hold %2$s and pick it in your power wheel. Then tap %2$s to use it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ijsbrug.staat: A bridge of ice, just for you. Quick, it stays for a minute!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.slee.opnieuw: Almost! The otter is waiting for you at the top again. Once more!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.gondel.teller: A moon lantern at the stop! %s of %s.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.gondel.klaar: All the moon lanterns are up! Now to the palace: Yue Guh is waiting for us. I'll come along. To... see the palace.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.haven.net: A net falls over you. Fire Nation Mikas jump out from behind the barrels. Everything goes dark...
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.sluip.uitleg: The guards see everything in their cone (the little flames). Sneak past: crouching, they don't see you as far. Seen? Then you start again at your last rest point.
HEY! A guh! Back you go!
Who goes there? ...Back to your spot, little one!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.sluip.terug: Spotted! You're put back. Try again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ontsnap.klaar: You're off the ship! Nobody saw you. There's no trace of the Blue Spirit.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ontsnap.maske: On the jetty lies a little blue mask. Just the right size for a guh. Strange.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.maanvis.aang: I can feel the moon getting weaker. Come and sit by the pond. We're going to meditate.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.mediteer.weg: Your concentration is gone. Sit down quietly again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.mediteer.hoe: Hold sneak and keep still to meditate.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.geest.geen_we: There is no Spirit World in this world. The story goes on without it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.geest.weer: Your soul sniffs on in the Spirit World once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.ondertite: Don't move. Don't jump. Don't click anything.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.gezicht.0: Koh looks at you with the face of a guh...
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.gezicht.1: ...now with the face of a Mika. He grins.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.gezicht.2: ...now he laughs. Very loudly. Don't laugh along.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.gezicht.3: ...now he looks very sad. Don't cry along.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.gezicht.4: ...a guh again. He sniffs at your ear.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.weer: Ahhh. There you are again. Let's try once more. Look at me.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.fout.bewe: Ah! You moved. That was a feeling. May I borrow that little face? I'll give it back later, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.fout.spri: A little jump! From fright, or from joy? Both lovely. Both mine.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.fout.klik: Your hand slipped. What lovely nerves. What a lovely face.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.koh.fout: Koh has borrowed your face. It comes back by itself. You're at the mouth of his cave again: walk in and try once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.la.aang: Quick! Back to our bodies. We have to bring Tui back before La makes the whole sea angry.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.vis.gepakt: Carefully you lift the bag with the moon fish out of the cage. Tui is limp and gray. Hurry!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.vis.katara: You've got him! I'll keep the guards busy a little longer. Go, bring Tui to the pond!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.yue_maan.klaa: The moon glows again. The colors are back. But the fleet is still in front of the wall.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.storm.gegrepe: While everyone cheers, someone grabs you by the scruff. A hot breath. Then only snow...
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.storm.terug: The blizzard won't let you go. You're back with Zuka.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.klaar.1: Chapter 2 is done! You can waterbend. From now on Katara Guh and Sokka Guh travel with you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.klaar.boemera: Here, take my boomerang. I have another one. It always comes back. Just like me. And just like you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.klaar.2: You get a Water Tribe Parka for your guh and Sokka Guh's boomerang. Appa takes you all to Ba Sing Guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.klaar.geen_vl: Appa doesn't know the way to Ba Sing Guh yet. Whistle for him later: he'll take you there once he knows the city.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ijsbrug.hier_: There's nothing to freeze here. Try it at the end of the jetty in the wave pool.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.ijsbrug.kijk: Look at the islet when you freeze the bridge.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.stroom.geen_w: Water Current only works in the water, or in your gondola.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.0: Another tourist. Go to the market, they sell stick-on moustaches there.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.zw: Five targets. A whip of water. Hit them all. Moustache or no moustache.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.go: Stand by the wave pool and make three waves. No splashing. Waves.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.ij: Water can also stand still. Stand at the end of the jetty, look at the islet and freeze the way across.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.vr: My lessons are over for today. Go and play with your moustacheless friends.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.be: The Fire Nation stands before the wall. A good waterbender stays as calm as the ice. ...I am very calm. Very. Calm.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.pakguh.kl: You have become a true waterbender, Guhvatar. Without a moustache. Perhaps I should rewrite my rules.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.0: Won't Pakguh teach you anything either? Just wait. I have a plan. It's called: challenging him.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.tr: Water flows, it doesn't push. Move with it, not against it. That's what Pakguh says. I say: just hit that target.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.sl: Sokka wants to go otter surfing. I wouldn't. ...I'm totally going to.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.go: Push the gondola through the canals with waterbending. The stops are by the gate, on the west canal and on the east canal.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.yu: Sokka is in love. He's acting very weird. Even weirder than usual.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.be: Everything is gray without the moon. Even Sokka's jokes. Though those were always a bit gray.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.go: Go to the Wave Pulpit above the gate. I can feel it: the ocean is waiting for you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.katara.kl: I'm coming with you, Guhvatar. Someone has to teach you to wash your own socks. With water.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.0: Waterbending isn't for me. I have a boomerang. A boomerang always comes back. A boomerang never lets you down.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.sle: Otter surfing! Climb the ice wall, west of the gate. An otter-penguin guh is waiting at the top. Empty paws on it, and GO!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.gon: Gondola riding is just like otter surfing. But wetter. And slower. And without an otter.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.yue: Have you seen Princess Yue Guh? In the palace? Did she say anything about me? Tell her I'm funny. And tall.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.bel: I have a plan for the siege. Step one: don't get captured. Step two: ...still working on that.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.sokka.kla: I'm coming too! Who else is going to make the plans? And the jokes. Especially the jokes.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.yue.0: Welcome to the palace, Guhvatar. My father says the moon shines more beautifully here than anywhere else. He's right.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.yue.beleg: They say I was born with the power of the moon. I can feel her getting weaker now. Be careful.
Welcome to the Northern Water Tribe, Guhvatar. My ice is your ice. Don't slip.
Zhao Mika's fleet lies before the wall. My warriors hold the gate. You... you hold our hope.
My daughter shines over the city every night now. I'm proud of her. And of you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.poortwach: Halt! ...Oh, you again. Go on through. Wipe your paws.
The Guhvatar! Everyone is talking about that wave. I was there. I got very wet.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.zhao.0: I am Admiral Zhao Mika! I am going to make history! ...What are you looking at? Shoo, guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.zhao.1: Have you seen my ship? Impressive, huh? Don't touch anything. Especially not the buttons.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.wacht.0: Move along. This is a Fire Nation ship. No cuddling here.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.bewoner.0: Ice, ice and more ice. And sea prunes. Want a sea prune? Nobody ever wants a sea prune.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.bewoner.1: Have you seen the Wave Pulpit yet, above the gate? Nobody ever stands up there. Too high. Too cold. Too epic.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.bewoner.b: The Fire Nation! All guhs inside! ...I mean: all waterbending guhs OUTSIDE!
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.bewoner.n: That wave! Did you see it? The whole fleet drifted gently into the void. Nobody hurt. Only Zhao's pride.
I wave at the moon every night. Sokka Guh does too. He waves for a very long time.
quest.guhs.einde2_h2_water.rol.storm_zuk: Stay there. When the storm dies down, I'm taking you with me. Then I get my honor back.
It's... pretty cold. Not that I'm cold. I'm never cold. I'm from the Fire Nation.
I'm still here, Guhvatar. Every night. Tell Sokka he can stop waving. ...Or actually: don't let him stop.
The moon and the ocean keep each other in balance. Just like you will, with all four elements. On to Ba Sing Guh.
item.guhs.boemerang.lore: From Sokka Guh. Throw it: it always comes back, with everything it met along the way
gui.guhs.kledingbron.einde2_h2_water: The Guhvatar, chapter 2: the Northern Water Tribe
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.nevel: A pink spirit mist gently pushes you back. This path isn't for you yet, nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.uitleg: At the edge of the Guheinde floats a city of ice. There you learn waterbending from the strictest master with the longest moustache, meet the Blue Spirit, travel to the Spirit World and make a wave as high as a wall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.0: Fly on Appa to the Northern Water Tribe. Not on Appa? Click him and pick the golden star.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.1: Talk to Master Pakguh on the training square: through the gate in the ice wall, north along the great canal and up the grand stairs.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.1: The training square (above the grand stairs)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.2: Hit the five targets on the east edge of the training square with your power Water Whip (hold the power key and pick it).
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.3: Make three waves with Water Wave in the wave pool: the sunken pool with the jetty, just east of the training square.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.3: The wave pool (east of the square)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.4: Stand at the end of the jetty in the wave pool, look at the islet and use Ice Bridge. Then walk over the bridge to the islet.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.5: Climb the ice wall west of the gate to the Slide Pulpit, click an otter-penguin guh with an empty hand and slide down to the snow heap below.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.5: The Slide Pulpit (on the ice wall, west of the gate)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.6: Tonight is the Moon Festival. Get into the gondola in the basin below the grand stairs and use Water Current to take the moon lanterns to the three glowing stops: by the gate, on the west canal and on the east canal.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.6: The canals of the lower city
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.7: Princess Yue Guh has invited you. Go all the way up to the palace in the north of the city, through the big door, and talk to her in the throne room.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.7: The palace (at the top of the city)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.8: Chief Arnook Guh sends you to scout: go to the harbor outside the gate, on the east side, where Zhao Mika's black ship lies, and see what he is up to.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.9: Sneak off Zhao Mika's ship, back to the barrels on the harbor. Stay out of the guards' cones of little flames; crouching, they don't see you as far.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.10: Zhao Mika marched with soldiers to the spirit oasis, where the moon and the ocean live. Hurry there: all the way up, behind the palace, through the little door in the ice.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.11: Stand by the pond in the spirit oasis, hold sneak and keep still for three counts: then you meditate with Aang Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.12: In the Spirit World, take the only path without pink mist: west, through the Whispering Wood, to Koh's Cave under the ancient tree. When Koh looks at you: don't move, don't jump, don't click anything. Back in your body? Meditate again by the pond in the spirit oasis.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.13: The pink mist over the path east is gone: walk back to the Meditation Circle and follow that path to the Sky Pond, where Tui and La should be swimming. Back in your body? Meditate again by the pond in the spirit oasis.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.14: Tui, the moon fish, is in a cage aboard Zhao Mika's ship. Steal him back: go to the harbor outside the gate (east), sneak aboard and take him out of the cage in the cell at the back of the hold.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.14: The FNS Scorch Mark (in the harbor)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.15: Bring the moon fish back to the islet in the pond of the spirit oasis, behind the palace.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.16: Climb the stairs on the inside of the ice wall to the Wave Pulpit, the little balcony right above the gate, and stand on the light.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.17: Walk through the blizzard on the glacier to the light and listen for Appa's roar. If you walk out of the storm, Zuka pulls you back.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.nu.klaa: Done! You can waterbend, nyeg. Katara Guh and Sokka Guh travel with you to Ba Sing Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.waar.kl: On the way to Ba Sing Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_water.kort.4: An ice bridge to the islet
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_h2_water.r: With the wind in your ears you fly through the void on Appa's back.
Far away, above a sea that has no business being here, floats a mountain of ice.
On it stands a city of canals and snow, behind a wall as high as a cloud.
The Northern Water Tribe. Home of the best waterbender in the Guheinde.
He has a moustache. That turns out to matter.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_aankomst.intr: The Northern Water Tribe. A city of ice at the edge of the world. Well: at the edge of the Guheinde.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_aankomst.halt: Halt! Who goes there, flying in on a... six-legged plushie?
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_aankomst.aang: I'm Aang Guh! And this is the new Guhvatar. We've come to learn waterbending!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_aankomst.open: The Guhvatar? Here? ...Open the gate! And someone go wake Master Pakguh.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_aankomst.pakg: Pakguh is the best waterbender in the city. Come on, nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.dus: So you are the new Guhvatar. Hmm. And you want to learn waterbending.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.snor: I only teach guhs with a moustache. It has always been that way and that is how it stays. Look at my moustache. That is a moustache.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.domste: A MOUSTACHE? That's the silliest rule in the whole Water Tribe!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.oud: The silliest rules are often the oldest, young lady.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.uitdag: Then I challenge you. Here, on the square. If I win, you train the Guhvatar. And me.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.zweep: ...You have a strong whip, Katara Guh. And an even stronger will.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.goed: Very well. I will train you both. Moustache or no moustache.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_pakguh.kom_op: Come on, Guhvatar. Show him what a guh without a moustache can do!
The hold of the FNS Scorch Mark. You're tied to a post. Dark. Damp. It smells of charcoal and lost honor.
A feather under the nose. A yawn. And the guard sleeps like a baby Mika.
The Blue Spirit says nothing. He puts a finger to his mask: hush.
He unties your ropes and points at the stairs. Outside. And then he's gone, as quietly as he came.
Sneak off the ship. Stay out of the guards' light. When you sneak, they don't see as far.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.oase: The spirit oasis: the only warm spot in the Water Tribe. Here Tui and La, the moon and the ocean, have been circling each other for a thousand years.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.gesch: Admiral Zhao Mika makes history! Whoever has the moon has the Water Tribe. Grab that fish!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.nee: No! Without the moon fish there is no moon. And without the moon, no waterbending!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.lach: Hahaha! Now the moon is MINE. ...I mean: the Fire Nation's. But mostly mine.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.grijs: Tui is gone. La swims her circles alone. And then the color drains out of everything.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanvis.koh: We have to go to the Spirit World. To Koh. He knows how to save the moon.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.ti: The Journey to the Spirit World
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.zi: Eyes closed. Breathe in... breathe out... think of nothing. Except nibbles. No, not of nibbles either.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.gl: Then your tattoos begin to glow. Soft blue first. Then brighter. Then SO white that even the pond gets a fright.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.ge: CONGRACHONKULATIONS ON YOUR 10 CARPACCIO STREAK AT LA CUBANITA JOOSTCHONKY AND SUUSCHONKY!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.di: i think... we ended up in the wrong parallel dimension.....
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.va: ... ummmm... Those aren't the chonkies we thought.....
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.fo: Oh wait.. my bad... we were supposed to go here hehe
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.li: Your bodies stay sitting quietly by the pond. Your souls sniff on, nyeg. To the right world this time.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_reis.ec: For real this time. Promise. Hehe.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh.grot: Koh's Cave. Hundreds of faces stare at you from the walls. And then something moves in the dark.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh.waarschuw: Psst! Whatever happens: show NO emotion. Don't move, don't jump, don't click anything. Or he takes your face.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh.welkom: Ahhh... the Guhvatar. It has been a long time. I liked your previous face better, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh.vraag: You want to know about the moon and the ocean. Then first you must do something for me. Stand still. Look at me. And feel... nothing.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh.succes: Good luck. Don't laugh. Not even at his moustache. He has no moustache. That's exactly why.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_la_woede.vijv: The Sky Pond. Tui is gone. La swims alone... and La is ANGRY.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_la_woede.visi: A vision: a giant ocean spirit, red with rage, swallowing Zhao Mika's whole fleet. And the Water Tribe with it.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_la_woede.maan: Without the moon the ocean loses its balance. We have to bring Tui back. Quick, back to our bodies!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.teru: You put the moon fish back in the pond. But Tui barely moves. He's too weak. The moon in the sky stays gray.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.nee: No... he's still alive, but he's so weak...
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.ik: It isn't too late. When I was little, the moon gave me a piece of her light. I have carried it with me all this time.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.niet: Yue... what are you going to do? You're not going to do anything silly, are you? That's MY job.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.geve: I'm giving it back. I won't become less, Sokka Guh. I'll become... more. I'll become the moon. And I'll look at you every night.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.belo: Every night. Even when it's cloudy. Then I'll just look harder.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.lich: A soft light shoots up, through the opening in the glacier, straight into the sky. The moon glows again. All the color flows back into the world.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.dank: I'm still here. Just look up. I'm always here, Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.zwaa: ...I'll wave at you later. Don't laugh. From now on everyone's going to wave at the moon.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.maan: Above the Northern Water Tribe the moon shines brighter than ever. A tiny bit pink. With two little ears, if you look closely.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_yue_maan.nu: Tui lives. But Zhao Mika's fleet is still in front of the wall. Come on. The ocean is waiting for us.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.vloot: Zhao Mika's fleet lies in front of the ice wall. Dozens of cannons. Hundreds of Mikas. And one Guhvatar on a little ledge.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.kun: Can you do this? The ocean is big. Really very big.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.samen: You're not doing it alone. La will help you. Let the ocean flow through you... and don't forget: gently. Nobody may get hurt.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.gloed: Your eyes glow. You feel the ocean. It's angry, but it listens to you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.la: From the sea rises a giant glowing koi. La, the Ocean Spirit. She looks at you. She waits.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.golf: A wave as high as the ice wall rolls out over the sea. It lifts the ships, ever so carefully, and carries them away. Far away. Into the void.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.nee: No! My fleet! My HISTORY! ...Is this a barrel? I'm sitting on a barrel.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.niemand: Nobody is hurt. The Mikas bob home on driftwood and barrels. A few even wave. Gently, that is.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.jij: You did it! You moved the ocean! Well, the ocean moved you. Together!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.trots: Roku Guh would be proud of you. So am I. Very much.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.rust: The sea grows calm. The moon shines. And for the first time in days you can catch your breath...
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_golf.maar: ...But someone else has been waiting too. Behind you, in the shadow of the tower.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_sneeuwstorm.w: Everything is white. There's snow in your ears, in your nose and in your nibble pouch. You're lying in the middle of a blizzard.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_sneeuwstorm.e: At last, Guhvatar. You thought you were rid of me. Nobody is ever rid of me.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_sneeuwstorm.w: Somewhere on the glacier. We wait until the storm dies down. Then I take you home. To MY home. Then I get my honor back.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_sneeuwstorm.k: Zuka acts tough, but his ears are shaking. It's freezing. And far off, through the white storm... you see a little light.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_sneeuwstorm.g: Follow the light. Walk through the storm. Zuka is too cold to stop you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.gevonden: Appa sniffed you out. No offense. You smell like Zuka. That one is meant as offense.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.zuka: Zuka is still lying back there... in the snow. He's cold.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.niemand_: ...Then we take him along to the city, wrapped in Appa's blanket. We leave nobody behind in the snow. Not even him.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.team: Katara Guh, Sokka Guh... will you come with us? To Ba Sing Guh?
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.ja: Of course. You need a water teacher. And Sokka needs... us.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_team.plan: I already have a plan! ...Step one: Appa.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_welkom.intro: Two guhs in thick blue coats come walking out of the gate. One with a stern look. One with a boomerang and a hungry look.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_welkom.wie: So you're the new Guhvatar! I'm Katara Guh. And this is my brother, Sokka Guh. Welcome to the Northern Water Tribe!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_welkom.krijge: Hi. I'm the warrior of the family. And the funny one. And the clever one. Katara is... the rest.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_welkom.leren: We've come to learn waterbending! A Guhvatar has to master all four elements. I've got air already. Well: we have.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_welkom.maan: Then you're in the right place. We bend the water with the power of the moon. Up in the city, in the spirit oasis, the moon and the ocean themselves swim around: two spirit fish, Tui and La.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_welkom.druk: Two little fish that protect the whole city. No pressure, fishies.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_welkom.rook: But something's wrong. This morning a fisher saw black smoke over the sea. The Fire Nation is looking for the Guhvatar... and I think they're coming here.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_welkom.pakguh: So you have to learn fast. The best teacher is Master Pakguh, on the training square above the grand stairs. Only he has one really silly rule.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_welkom.snor: It's about moustaches. That's all I'm saying. I don't have a moustache either. Not yet. It's coming, I can feel it in my ears.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_zweep.ged: First lesson. Water is patient. It doesn't push, it flows. But when it has to... it taps.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_zweep.doe: Five targets. Hit all five with a water whip. I'm watching. My moustache is watching too.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_zweep.waa: Do you know why we practise on targets? So that later you can push someone away without hurting them. A whip of water only makes you wet.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_zweep.vuu: Exactly. If the Fire Nation comes, I want no one hurt. Not on our side and not on theirs. A good waterbender wins without anyone crying.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_golf.slec: Not bad. Not bad at all. For a guh without a moustache.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_golf.zee: Second lesson. A city on the ice lives off the sea. When the sea turns wild, a waterbender calms her down again. With waves.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_golf.bass: Over there, in the wave pool. Three waves. Nice, round, calm waves.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_golf.dwei: Waves, not splashes. Whoever splashes, mops.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_ijsbrug.m: Your waves are getting prettier than mine. Don't tell Pakguh.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_ijsbrug.h: I heard that. ...Last lesson for today. Water can also stand still.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_ijsbrug.b: If the Fire Nation breaks a bridge of the city, a waterbender simply freezes a new one. See that islet? That's where I want to see you standing. With dry paws.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_les_ijsbrug.g: A bridge of ice! It isn't slippery, is it? ...It's slippery, isn't it. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_otters.voorbi: Water can flow and water can stand still. You can do both now. My lessons are over for today.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_otters.pingui: Tomorrow we work on your balance. You stand like a penguin on an ice floe.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_otters.surfen: Balance? I've got just the thing! OTTER SURFING! That's how all the guh kids of the Water Tribe learn to stand on the ice.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_otters.waar: It's really true. Whoever slides down the ice wall without falling over won't fall over in a fight either. ...I'm not joining in. ...Okay, I'm joining in.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_otters.muur: Up on the ice wall, west of the gate, at the Slide Pulpit. The otters are already waiting. Bring empty paws!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanfeest.nog: WAAAHOO! Again! ...I mean: that was very grown-up and useful.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanfeest.fee: Look up. Tonight is the full moon. Then the whole Water Tribe celebrates the Moon Festival.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanfeest.maa: A round, silver moon rises over the ice wall. Somewhere in the city someone is already singing. Off-key, but with a lot of love.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanfeest.lan: Princess Yue Guh has invited the Guhvatar to the palace. But first the moon lanterns have to go to the three stops along the canals. Waterbenders do that themselves: with a gondola, pushed by water.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanfeest.yue: Yue Guh is very... nice. To talk to. About boomerangs. I'll come along. For the palace. Mostly the walls.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_maanfeest.gon: Pushing a gondola with waterbending? That's going to be my favourite lesson!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_paleis.welkom: Welcome, Guhvatar. I've heard a lot about you. Mostly from Sokka Guh. He talks a lot.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_paleis.nauwel: Me? Talk a lot? Not at all. Hardly. Almost never. Nice palace, by the way. Nice... walls.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_paleis.licht: Do you know why my hair is white? When I was little, I was very ill. My father took me to the oasis, and the moon spirit gave me a little of her light. Since then I can feel the moon.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_paleis.onrust: And today she is restless. Our scouts saw smoke over the sea.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_paleis.kampvu: Smoke? Like from a campfire? A cosy, small, harmless campfire?
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_paleis.vloot: Like from a fleet. The Fire Nation is coming. Admiral Zhao Mika is already in the harbor with his ship.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_paleis.post: Everyone to your posts. Guhvatar: go to the harbor and see what Zhao Mika is up to. He calls himself a writer of history. I don't like that one bit.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_paleis.voorzi: Be careful. An admiral who moors right in the middle of the Moon Festival has something big in mind.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kade.daar: There you are! We looked everywhere for you! You were suddenly gone. Who set you free?
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kade.masker: Someone in a blue mask. He didn't say anything. He just did... quiet.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kade.typisch: A mysterious rescuer in a mask. Typical. I want a mask too.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kade.zhao: Listen. Zhao Mika isn't on his ship any more. He marched into the city with soldiers, up the grand stairs. Past the palace. Behind it.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kade.oase: Behind the palace lies the spirit oasis. The moon and the ocean! I can feel it right down to my ears: something is going wrong. Hurry!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_vis_aan_boord: Psst! Over here, behind the barrels. I saw them: two soldiers with a wet sack. That sack was swimming.
Tui, the moon fish. Zhao Mika took him aboard his ship, the FNS Scorch Mark. In a cage, at the back of the hold.
No Tui, no moon. And without the moon La gets angrier and angrier. We saw it in the Spirit World.
Then we steal him back. I'll lure the guards on deck away. You sneak aboard: up the ladder, round the funnel, down the stairs to the cell.
Stay out of their little flames. And if they see you: just try again. That's what I always do.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_geest_aankoms: We're here! The real Spirit World this time. Don't look at the sky too long, it does weird things.
A thick pink mist hangs over three of the paths: north, east and south-east. Only the path west lies open.
Spirit mist. The spirits only let us through where we need to be right now. That's sweet of them. And a bit bossy.
Koh lives under the ancient black tree, beyond the Whispering Wood. He knows everything about the moon. But he takes your face if you twitch so much as a muscle. Come on!
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh_raad.rimp: Mmmm. Not a single wrinkle. A pity. You have a lovely face.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh_raad.even: The moon and the ocean hold on to each other. Push one away, and the other loses itself in rage.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh_raad.vijv: Go to the Sky Pond, Guhvatar. See what happens when the balance disappears.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh_raad.geda: You did it! You didn't pull a single face! I almost laughed myself.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_koh_raad.neve: Far away, at the Meditation Circle, the pink mist over the path east melts away. The way to the Sky Pond is clear.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_knipoog_balto: Snow at last! Nomguh must be here...
Did that one have a moustache?
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_knipoog_sjokk: On the rim of the palace terrace someone is crawling past. Very. Slowly.
Shuckly. On his way to the finish. He's almost there. Well... almost.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.pakguh: Master Pakguh is %s, on the training square: through the gate in the ice wall, north along the great canal and up the grand stairs. Talk to him (right-click).
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.zweep: The five targets stand %s, in a row on the east edge of the square. Pick Water Whip, look straight at a target (from close by) and use your power. Each target counts once.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.golf: The wave pool is %s: the sunken pool with the jetty, just east of the targets. Stand at its edge or on the jetty, pick Water Wave and make three waves.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.ijsbrug: The islet with the pavilion is %s. Walk along the jetty to its end, look at the islet, pick Ice Bridge and use it. Then walk over the bridge: it stays for a minute.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.slee: The Slide Pulpit is %s, up on the ice wall, west of the gate. Take the stairs on the inside of the wall up, click an otter-penguin guh with an empty hand and steer by looking (W pushes, S brakes). If you fall off, you're back at the top in a moment.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.gondel: The gondola is %s, in the basin at the foot of the grand stairs. Get in, pick Water Current and push it where you look, past the three stops: they are waiting for the moon lanterns. The next stop lights up. Paddling is fine too.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.yue: The great door of the palace is %s, at the very top of the city. Go inside: Princess Yue Guh stands in the throne hall, by her father's seat. Talk to her.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.haven: The harbor is %s: out through the gate and then east, where Zhao Mika's big black ship lies. Walk onto the harbor.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.ontsnap: You're on the ship. The harbor is %s: up the stairs behind the tower, behind the barrels round the funnel, and down the ladder to the pier. Stay out of the guards' cones of little flames and sneak.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.oase: The spirit oasis is %s: all the way up, behind the palace. Walk round the palace and go through the little door in the ice.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.mediteer: The pond is %s. Stand anywhere in the oasis, hold sneak and keep still for three counts. Above your hotbar the counts tick down.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.koh: Koh's Cave is %s: take the path without pink mist, west through the Whispering Wood, to the hollow roots of the ancient tree, and walk into the Passage of Faces. When Koh looks at you: don't move, don't jump, don't click anything. Back in your body? Meditate again by the pond in the spirit oasis.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.hemelvijve: The Sky Pond is %s: back to the Meditation Circle and then onto the path east, where the pink mist is gone. Back in your body? Meditate again by the pond in the spirit oasis.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.vis_halen: Tui, the moon fish, is aboard Zhao Mika's ship: steal him back! The harbor is %s, outside the gate on the east side. Start behind the barrels, climb the ladder on the side of the ship, sneak round the funnel and down the stairs behind the tower to the cell at the back of the hold. Tui hangs there in a cage.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.vis_terug: Bring Tui back quickly: the islet in the pond of the spirit oasis is %s, behind the palace. Just walk there.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.golf_kanse: The Wave Pulpit is %s: the little balcony right above the gate in the ice wall. Take the stairs on the inside of the wall up and stand on the light.
gui.guhs.einde2_h2_water.hint.storm: The light is %s. Walk straight at it through the snow and listen for Appa's roar. If you walk out of the storm, Zuka pulls you back.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_pakguh.t: Master Pakguh. The longest moustache in the Guheinde.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_zweep.te: Five targets. One water whip per target.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_golf.tek: The wave pool. Waves, not splashes.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_slee.tek: The Slide Pulpit. The otters are ready.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_gondel.t: The gondola, in the basin below the grand stairs. The moon lanterns are ready.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_yue.teks: The palace. Yue Guh is waiting inside.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_haven.te: The harbor. Zhao Mika's ship lies there.
There's the harbor. Sneak over there.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_oase.tek: The little door to the spirit oasis.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_mediteer: The pond of the moon and the ocean.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_vis_hale: The harbor. Start behind the barrels.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_vis_teru: Back to the pond. Tui is in a hurry.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_golf_kan: The Wave Pulpit. The ocean is waiting for you here.
scene.guhs.einde2_h2_water_kijk_storm.te: There! A little light in the storm.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.uitleg: The Earth Kingdom: a city with three rings of walls, a strict desk guh, a blind champion, a tea house that smells of jasmine... and a secret nobody says out loud. Learn earthbending, find Appa Guh again and survive the fall of Ba Sing Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.0: Fly with Appa Guh to Ba Sing Guh and land on the landing lobe: the stretch of grass on the west side, in front of the great outer wall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.0: The landing lobe, the grass in front of the west gate of Ba Sing Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.1: Nobody enters Ba Sing Guh without a stamp. Walk from the landing lobe to the big gate in the outer wall (east). In the passage, on the left, the strict desk guh sits behind his little window: talk to him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.1: The desk in the passage of the outer gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.2: Aang Guh needs an earth teacher, and the strongest earthbenders of the city fight in the Earth Rumble. Go through the gate into the city and walk southeast, to the big arena with the stands and the bell. Walk into the arena.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.2: The Earth Rumble arena, southeast of the gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.3: The Blind Bandit wants to teach you something. Go down from the stands and talk to Toph Guh, down in the ring of the arena.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.3: Toph Guh, in the Earth Rumble ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.4: Toph Guh sends you to the Middle Ring: there you wait until the Earth King will see you. Take the monorail. Walk back to the outer gate: left of it (north), inside the wall, stands the stair tower with the sign 'To the wall and the monorail'. Up top the car is waiting: stand in it and jump to push it with earthbending.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.4: The monorail car, on top of the outer wall by the gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.5: Somewhere in the Middle Ring there is said to be a tea house where the tea tastes like heaven. From station Middle Ring, take the stairs down and then go south: The Jasmine Dragon has a green roof and a dragon above the door. Go inside.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.5: The Jasmine Dragon, south of station Middle Ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.6: Uncle Miroh teaches you how to make tea. Go behind the counter into the kitchen (at the back, south side) and right-click the big kettle on the stove. Click again each time the little gauge is in the green.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.6: The kitchen of The Jasmine Dragon, behind the counter
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.7: Play a game of Pai Sho with Uncle Miroh: talk to him, behind the counter of the tea house.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.7: Uncle Miroh, in The Jasmine Dragon
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.8: Joo Dee Guh, the city's guide, might be able to take you to the Earth King. She stands in front of her house in the north of the Middle Ring (a house that is exactly the same left and right). Talk to her.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.8: Joo Dee Guh's house, Middle Ring north
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.9: Two Dai Li Mikas are following you, and Appa Guh and Momo Guh are alone at the camp. Go out through the outer gate, to your camp on the south side of the landing lobe, where Appa landed.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.9: The camp on the landing lobe
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.10: Appa is gone, taken by the Dai Li! Only the Earth King Guh can order them to give him back. He sits in the throne room of the big golden palace, in the middle of the city (the Upper Ring). Talk to him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.10: The throne room of the golden palace, in the middle of the city
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.11: Bosco smelled something at Lake Laogai, the lake in the east of the city. On its north side stands a wooden boat shed with a green roof ('Boat Rental CLOSED'): go in and down the stairs to the base. There: crouch, wait until the guards look away, and go. Seen = back to the start, nothing else.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.11: The boat shed on the north side of Lake Laogai, east in the city
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.12: Uncle Miroh is in danger: 'A' is coming for him and his nephew Zuka. He said he was going to the hill with the cherry tree today, on the landing lobe outside the outer wall (north of where Appa lands). Warn him. Appa is back: whistle for him, or walk.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.12: The hill with the cherry tree on the landing lobe
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.13: The Dai Li took Katara Guh and Zuka, deep under the palace. Uncle Miroh is coming with you. Go to the old gate in the palace garden, on the east side of the golden palace (a mossy gatehouse, 'No entry'), and follow the corridor down to the crystal cell and the crystal chamber.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.13: The old gate in the palace garden, east side of the palace
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.14: Ba Sing Guh has fallen. Flee on Appa Guh: it happens by itself, right after the fall. Did you leave in the middle and are you still in the city? Then walk to the camp on the landing lobe.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.14: The camp on the landing lobe
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.klaa: Earthbending learned, Appa Guh back, Toph Guh on the team. On to the Fire Nation!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.kl: On Appa's back, on the way to the Fire Nation
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.3_ba: Eyes shut: Toph's training course is the walled field right east of the arena (the way in is on its west side, by the sign 'Blindfold Course'). Step in: crouching is stomping. Walk towards the brightest light and stand on all six earth coins.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.3_: The walled training course right east of the arena
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.kort.3_: Find the six earth coins, blind
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.kort.4: Push the monorail to the Middle Ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.kort.6: Make tea at the big kettle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.kort.7: Play Pai Sho with Uncle Miroh
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.kort.13: Rescue Katara Guh in the catacombs
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.doel.0: the landing lobe of Ba Sing Guh
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_h3_aarde.r: After the Northern Water Tribe, Appa Guh flew for days over the void, on the way to the Earth Kingdom.
There lies Ba Sing Guh: a city with walls so high that even the clouds have to go around them.
Thousands of guhs live behind those walls. And all of them say nothing is going on.
Here you must learn earthbending. From the most stubborn teacher in the whole Guheinde.
And somewhere in the city a round old guh pours tea... for whoever walks in. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aankomst.begi: Ba Sing Guh. The walled city of the Earth Kingdom, on its own slab of cliff cheese in the void.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aankomst.muur: Whoa. No Mika gets through that. Not even a really chonky one.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aankomst.hoop: We're safe here. And they're sure to help us against the Fire Nation.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aankomst.knab: And they're sure to have the biggest nibble market in the whole Guheinde!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aankomst.poor: But first: the passport desk. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_loket.papiere: Form 3B, form 7Q and the declaration of chonkiness... also in order.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_loket.welkom: Welcome to Ba Sing Guh. Everyone is safe here. And there is no nibble shortage here.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_loket.poort: With a heavy sigh, the bars of the outer gate slide up.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aardrommel.ke: In this corner: the rock that never budges, the pebble that never cracks... THE BOULDER GUH!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aardrommel.ro: The Boulder Guh is ready to rock!
