scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aardrommel.ba: And in that corner: the champion. Small, blind... and never beaten: THE BLIND BANDIT!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aardrommel.ve: The Boulder Guh... feels... rather beaten.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aardrommel.ji: You there, in the stands. Your feet are loud, nyeg. You stomp like a sky bison. Come down here in a bit.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_jasmijn_draak: The Jasmine Dragon. It smells of jasmine, warm nibbles... and very faintly of Fire Nation.
Welcome, welcome! Come in, sit down. The tea is almost ready.
Sharing tea with a stranger guh is one of the true chonkinesses of life.
A cup of tea with a sour face tastes sour too, nephew.
I'm not your nephew... I mean: yes, uncle. Of course, uncle.
Zuka looks at you for a very long time. Then he turns away and polishes a cup that was already clean.
Will you help me with a pot of tea? The kettle is in the kitchen. I'll teach you, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_appa_ontvoerd: While you walked through the city, Appa Guh was napping by the camp. Momo Guh slept on his head.
Easy, big fella. You're going to stay with us for a while.
Appa roared. But hands of stone hold even a sky bison very still.
Momo Guh fled into the bushes. He watched until they were gone.
Day one. They took him under the city, deep under Lake Laogai, where the light never comes.
Day two. Appa didn't eat. He only looked at the little hole in the ceiling, where sometimes a cloud drifted by.
Day three. A Dai Li Mika threw him a cabbage. Appa sniffed it... and thought of your hands, which always smelled of nibbles.
And every night he hummed very softly. So you would hear him, if you ever came near.
At the camp there is only a tuft of white fur left.
Momo Guh comes out of the bushes and presses against your leg. His little ears are completely flat.
Appa is gone. Someone in this city knows where he is.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.tra: Behind the bars, in the dark: something big and white. Something humming very softly.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.kna: Well done, Guhvatar. All the way down here, without waking a single Dai Li Mika.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.nie: But there is nothing to see here. There is no sky bison in Ba Sing Guh.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.kna: And there is no nibble shortage either. Understand? In Ba Sing Guh, nothing is ever going on.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.dit: Oh no? Then what's THAT, behind those bars? A really big pillow?
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.lie: You lied to the whole city. The Earth King knows nothing!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.weg: The Earth King knows exactly what I tell him. ...Dai Li, we're leaving.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_weerzien.krak: You stomp. The floor trembles. The bars bend open as if they were made of clay.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_weerzien.appa: Appa Guh lifts his big head. He sniffs. He sniffs again.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_weerzien.lik: A big, wet, warm tongue. You're soaked from head to toe. You couldn't care less.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_weerzien.thui: Come on, let's go home. All of us.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.1: Over the hills, through the grass and the wind,
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.2: walks a young guh who is still just a kid.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.3: His helmet's too big and his little ears ache,
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.4: the moon shows the road that his tired feet take.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.5: The lantern is burning, the tea's waiting here,
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.6: the pillow lies soft, as it does every year.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.7: Lay down your spear, for the night is so mild,
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.8: sleep now, little guh, we are waiting, my child.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.delen: Some nibbles you share, even when there is no one left to share them with.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.titel: The Fall of Ba Sing Guh
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.kristal: Under the palace the crystals glow green. Here you found Katara Guh again. And Zuka.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.reunie: How cozy. A family reunion, deep under the ground.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.zuka: Zuka, dear brother. Choose. Come home with me... or stay with your tea uncle.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.weg: Zuka. Is it your own path, or a path someone else is laying out for you?
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.stil: It is very quiet in the crystal chamber. Zuka looks at his uncle. Then at his sister.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.thuis: Father misses you, Zuka. Really. Come with me, and you can live at home again. Then your ears can finally go back up.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.trots: You don't have to earn anyone's pride to be good, nephew. Not even your father's. Only your own.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.nu: There are too many of them! Guhvatar, the Guhvatar State. NOW!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.staat: Your eyes glow. The air around you hums. For a moment you feel every Guhvatar who came before you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.val: The lightning hits you right in the glow. You fall. It goes quiet and dark in your head.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.water: The spirit water of the North Pole... please. Please, let it work.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.ogen: A cool glow. Your eyes open. Katara Guh laughs through her tears.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.ga: Go! All of you! I'll keep them busy for a bit, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.miroh: Behind you, the Dai Li Mikas close Uncle Miroh in, in a cage of green crystal. He watches you go. And nods.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.gevallen: Ba Sing Guh had fallen. But the Guhvatar was still alive, and flew away on the back of a sky bison.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_leraar.binnen: We're in! I can already do air, I'm learning water from Katara... now just earth. But who's going to teach me?
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_leraar.geduld: Someone very strong. And very patient with a Guhvatar who flies into everything, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_leraar.affich: Look what was hanging by the gate: 'The Earth Rumble! Tonight: the strongest earthbenders of Ba Sing Guh!' If there's a teacher anywhere, it's there.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_leraar.kampio: A champion as a teacher? Yes! I want to go!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_leraar.pauze: And it says: snacks at half-time. That's important too. For the plan.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_leraar.arena: Somewhere in the southeast an arena is cheering. The ground rumbles softly under your paws.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_middenring.ti: I've got a title to defend. And I'll find you again, don't worry. You lot walk like a herd of sky bison.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_middenring.ki: Not bad, pebble. For an airbender.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_middenring.ko: Thank you, Toph. Now we have to speak to the Earth King. He needs to know what the Fire Nation is planning.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_middenring.mu: The king? He sits in the Upper Ring, behind three walls and a thousand forms. Nobody just walks in there.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_middenring.af: Then we ask for an appointment. And while we wait...
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_middenring.mo: ...you push the monorail to the Middle Ring. With earthbending. Good practice. There's a tea house there where the tea tastes like heaven, they say.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_uitnodiging.o: You want to speak to the Earth King, you said? Softly, nyeg. In this city even the teacups have ears.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_uitnodiging.d: The Dai Li's. The quiet guhs with the green hats. They keep the city calm. Sometimes a little too calm.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_uitnodiging.g: Our guide, Joo Dee Guh, has been looking for us all day. She can surely take us to the king.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_uitnodiging.l: Then go to her. And listen carefully to what she doesn't say.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_uitnodiging.z: Behind the counter Zuka polishes the same cup for the twentieth time. He heard everything.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_gevolgd.gliml: Joo Dee Guh smiles. She keeps smiling. She hasn't blinked even once.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_gevolgd.raar: Okay. This is weird. She didn't answer a single question. And look who's standing by the wall.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_gevolgd.miroh: Dai Li. They've been following us since the tea house. Uncle Miroh was right.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_gevolgd.appa: Appa and Momo are all alone at the camp... If the Dai Li are following us, who's watching them?
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_gevolgd.kamp: Exactly what I was thinking. Back to the camp. Right now.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_na_appa.schul: Appa... I should have been here. I should never have left him alone.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_na_appa.stene: It's not your fault. Look: hands of stone, pressed into the ground. This was the Dai Li.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_na_appa.dai_l: The quiet guhs with the green hats. They work for the city. So really they work for...
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_na_appa.konin: ...the Earth King. If anyone can order them to give Appa back, it's him.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_na_appa.palei: No more forms, no more appointments. We're going to the palace. Today.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_na_appa.momo: Momo Guh climbs onto your shoulder and holds on tight. His little ears stand up again, just a tiny bit.
A Letter with a Red Seal
Where Long Feng Mika stood lies a rolled-up letter. It has a red seal on it, with a little flame.
'To Long Feng. In the tea house The Jasmine Dragon two traitors of the Fire Nation are hiding: the banished prince Zuka and his uncle. Hold them until I arrive. A.'
Zuka?! The waiter with the scar... that's Zuka! The prince who's been chasing us since the Air Temple!
And that round guh with the teapot is his uncle. He was on that ship every single time. With tea.
But Uncle Miroh was kind to us. He poured us tea when nobody wanted to see us. If 'A' is coming for him...
He said he was going to the hill outside the wall today. To the cherry tree. 'For someone I miss.'
Then we go and warn him. A friend is a friend. Even if his nephew is chasing us.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_katara_weg.re: At the foot of the hill someone is panting. Sokka Guh comes running up, completely out of breath.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_katara_weg.ka: Katara's gone! She went to the tea house to warn Zuka... and the Dai Li took them both. Deep under the palace!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_katara_weg.wa: Uncle Miroh... we know who Zuka is. He's been after us since the Air Temple. Why, actually?
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_katara_weg.va: Because his father sent him away. Zuka once said something at the wrong moment, and got fire in his face. That's where the scar comes from. And one of his ears has never stood all the way up since.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_katara_weg.th: He may only come home if he brings the Guhvatar. He isn't hunting you. He's hunting a home.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_katara_weg.az: And 'A' is my niece Azula. If she is here, this city will fall. The Dai Li take their prisoners to the old catacombs under the palace. I'm coming with you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_katara_weg.ap: I'll get Appa and keep the sky clear. When you've got Katara: whistle. Loud!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kristalcel.st: Voices come from the crystal cell. You stop for a moment, in the dark, and listen.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kristalcel.oo: I always thought you were just an angry Mika chasing us. But your ear... and that scar... what happened?
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kristalcel.va: My father. I said something on the wrong day, to the wrong guh. He called it a lesson. Then he sent me away.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kristalcel.th: I can only go back if I bring the Guhvatar. Then I get my honour back. My home. And maybe... that he's proud of me.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kristalcel.wa: I have water from the North Pole with me. Spirit water. Maybe it can heal your scar...
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kristalcel.da: ...It's part of me. But... thank you. Really.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kristalcel.ne: Nephew! An old general still knows a few tricks with fire, nyeg. This crystal melts like sugar in tea.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kristalcel.ha: I am where the tea is warm and the hearts are too. Come, all of you. It isn't safe here.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kristalcel.ka: Further on, in the great crystal chamber, something glows green. Someone is already waiting for you there.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_miroh_gevange: Deep under the city, in the silence after the lightning. The crystal keeps growing.
Well, look at that. Uncle, in a cage of crystal. It suits you.
Crystal or clay, niece. Tea tastes the same everywhere, as long as you share it.
Dai Li, take him to the Fire Nation. Father will be pleased. One less traitor to drink tea with.
Uncle Miroh looks at his nephew for a long time. He says nothing. For the first time he has no wisdom for Zuka. Only a look that hurts more than lightning.
Come, little brother. We're going home. That's what you wanted, isn't it?
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_ontsnapping.v: Appa Guh shoots up out of the King's Well, over the walls of Ba Sing Guh. Behind you the lights of the city go out one by one.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_ontsnapping.w: Hey! Wait a minute, you lot!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_ontsnapping.h: Did you think you could fly off without me? I felt you coming at the wall.
I HATE flying, nyeg. But the Guhvatar can't even stand a pebble up straight yet. I'm coming along. I'll help you. And the Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_koers.waarhee: Okay. Ba Sing Guh has fallen, the king fled with Bosco. So... where do we go?
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_koers.miroh: They have Uncle Miroh. Azula is taking him to the Fire Nation.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_koers.vuur: And the Guhvatar still has to learn fire. There's only one place to do that.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_koers.vermomm: Straight into the Mika's den. ...In disguise, then. Red clothes, fake names. Maybe the Guhvatar should even go to school, then nobody notices a thing.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_koers.snor: I'm not wearing a fake moustache. ...Okay. A small one.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_koers.school: To school? I've never been to school! Fun!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_koers.west: Appa Guh turns west, where the sky is turning red. Behind you Ba Sing Guh gets smaller and smaller. On to the Fire Nation.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_knipoog_mewtw: He's here of his own free will. Really. We can't get him out anymore.
Somewhere, something pink giggles. Nobody looks.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_knipoog_sjokk: On the wall between the rings, Shuckly crawls along. He has come a very long way. He thinks.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.klaar: Chapter 3 is done: Ba Sing Guh. Toph Guh is part of the team. Appa Guh sets course for the Fire Nation...
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.aarde_geleerd: You learned earthbending! You feel the ground under your paws, and the ground feels you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.wacht: Next! ...Oh. You're not here yet. First land, then queue, then a desk. That's how it works.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.antwoor: The Guhvatar. Uh-huh. That's what they all say. Noted.
Guh. With a capital letter? Noted.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.vraag.1: To speak to the Earth King.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.antwoor: Sightseeing. Fine. The city is lovely. Nothing is going on.
The Earth King receives nobody. I'll just put down 'sightseeing'.
Plenty of nibbles in Ba Sing Guh. More than enough. I'll put down 'sightseeing'.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.vraag.2: Are you carrying any Mikas, fire or forbidden nibbles?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.antwoor: A lemur is not a Mika. He may come in. As long as he doesn't steal anything.
Nibbles aren't forbidden. Luckily, nyeg. I just had one myself.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.na.1: Your stamp is still valid. Next!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.na.2: I've already stamped two hundred times today. My paw hurts. Next!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.vroeg: What do you want? I'm fighting in a moment. Go sit in the stands, then at least I won't hear you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.ring: Watch closely. Well, watch. You know what I mean.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.les.0: So you're the Guhvatar. You walk as if the ground owes you something.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.les.1: Earth isn't water. Earth doesn't wait until you're ready. Earth stands firm. You have to learn that too.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.les.2: Close your eyes. No, really closed. There, next to the arena, is my training course. Go in and feel.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.les.3: Every few seconds the ground trembles, and when you crouch you stomp yourself. Somewhere in the floor are six earth coins. Stand on all six. With your eyes closed, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.bezig: %s of the %s. Stomp, feel, walk. No peeking.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.geleerd: See? You see with your feet. You're still a pebble, but a pebble that listens.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.na.0: I can see you coming, you know. With my feet.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.na.1: An earthbender stands firm. Even when everyone around him falls over.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.na.2: The Boulder Guh wants a rematch. The Boulder Guh doesn't get a rematch.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.na.3: I'm blind, not stupid. I know you just waved at me.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.mee.0: So. Ba Sing Guh has fallen, the king is gone, and you're going to the Fire Nation. Right?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.mee.2: Someone has to teach the Guhvatar that earth doesn't budge. You're all way too soft.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.mee.4: I HATE flying, nyeg. ...I'm coming along. And if anyone says a word about it, I'll stomp them off that bison.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.mee.5: Team Guhvatar is complete! Well... almost.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kei.0: The Boulder Guh is not angry. The Boulder Guh is just a little... pebbled.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kei.1: The Boulder Guh now trains with smaller opponents. Pebbles. Gravel. Sand.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kei.2: A rock that falls gets back up. So says the Boulder Guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.omroeper.0: Next week in the Earth Rumble: the Blind Bandit against... anyone who dares!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.omroeper.1: Tickets for the Earth Rumble! Nibbles at the break! Nibbles before the break too!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.omroeper.2: Whoever beats the Blind Bandit gets a golden belt. Nobody has ever gotten it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.vroeg: A new face! Come visit my tea house later, The Jasmine Dragon. Middle Ring, you'll smell it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.welkom: Sit down, sit down! Nobody leaves The Jasmine Dragon on an empty stomach.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.thee.ui: Good tea is patience, nyeg. Click the kettle in the kitchen. The water must almost boil but not quite, the leaves must steep but not drown, and pour to the brim... but not over it. Click when the little gauge is in the green.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.vroeg.0: Not yet. The water still has to wake up.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.laat.0: Oh dear, now it's boiling. Boiling water makes jasmine bitter. Once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.goed.0: Just right! The water is singing. Now the leaves.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.vroeg.1: Too early! The leaves haven't told their story yet.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.laat.1: Too long. Now they've drowned in their own story. Once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.goed.1: Ah, can you smell that? Now pour. Gently.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.vroeg.2: That's half a cup. Half a cup is half a friendship.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.laat.2: Over the brim! Never mind, the table was thirsty too. Once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.gelukt: Perfect. A cup of tea like a warm blanket. Here, take my old tea set. I have two anyway... or three... or five.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.ronde.0: First the water: click the kettle when the little gauge is in the green. Almost boiling, not quite!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.ronde.1: Then the leaves: let them steep, and click in the green.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.ronde.2: And now pour: almost full. Not over the brim!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.pai_sho: Do you play Pai Sho? No? No matter. It's very simple: you take turns laying a tile, and whoever lays a lotus first wins. A tile with four petals around it. Shall we?
You won! Ha! You're a natural. Or I'm getting old. Both, probably.
I won? Oh dear. Never mind. Losing is a game too, just with more tea.
A draw! The finest kind of result: nobody has to do the dishes.
You know, in hard times guhs look for hope in others. But hope is something you give yourself, nyeg. That is inner strength.
Take this table with you. A game is only a game when you share it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.0: A nibble you save for later is also a little bit a nibble of now.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.1: Whoever only looks at the summit never sees the flowers along the path.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.2: Pride is a heavy backpack. Tea is a light one. Your choice.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.3: My nephew is like a kettle: lots of steam, but inside just warm water.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.4: A guh who falls is not a guh who lost. Only if he stays down.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.5: Pai Sho teaches you that the finest move is sometimes the move you don't make.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.heropen: Welcome back to The Jasmine Dragon! This is the best day of my life... after that time with the perfect jasmine tea. Sit down, the pot is always ready.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.na.0: Tea? Of course tea. Always tea.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.na.1: Zuka writes me every week. He says the nibbles in the Fire Nation are shared fairly now. I'm so proud.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.na.2: This cup is on the house. Actually, they all are.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.na.3: Sit down, Guhvatar. Even heroes may chonk for a while.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.vroeg: We're not open yet. ...I mean: welcome. Says my uncle.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.ober.0: Tea. Yes. What kind of tea? ...I don't care. I'll just get tea.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.ober.1: I'm not a waiter. I'm... Never mind. I'm a waiter.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.ober.2: My uncle says I should smile more. This is my smile.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.ober.3: One more customer asking for 'the special nibble tea of the house'...
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.ober.4: Why are you looking at me like that? I have nothing to do with the Fire Nation. Nothing.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.lu_ten: My uncle? He's gone. To the hill outside the wall, the one with the tree. He goes there every year, on this day. ...Leave him be for a while. Or go to him. I don't care.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.val: Your friend. Katara Guh. The Dai Li took her, down, under the palace. My uncle is going with you. I... I'll see.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.hallo.0: Fresh cabbages! Crunchy cabbages! The finest cabbages in the whole Lower Ring!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.hallo.1: Cabbages, cabbages, cabbages! Mind my stall, it's new!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.hallo.2: A cabbage a day keeps the Mikas away. I always say that. Nobody believes it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.kapot.2: I moved to the Middle Ring. It's safe here, I thought... MY CABBAGES!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.kapot.3: The Upper Ring! Where nobody ever... MY CAAABBAGES!
You step aside for a cart full of tea crates, trip over a cabbage... and the whole stall collapses.
Momo Guh sees a cabbage. Momo Guh wants that cabbage. The stall thinks that's a bad idea.
Two Dai Li Mikas shoot past, under the ground. The stones go up. So do the cabbages.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.boos.1: You! You're that guh from... Well. It was an accident. Right? RIGHT?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.boos.2: Twice! Two stalls! I'm going to build a stall of stone. Of earth coin. With a wall around it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.geef.0: Three stalls. Three! You know what? Take it with you. I'll build a new one.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.geef.1: It probably won't break so quickly with you. ...Right?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.na.0: I built them all up again. All three. Please don't look at them.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.na.1: Cabbages! Fresh cabbages! At a safe distance from the Guhvatar!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.na.2: My cabbages have become famous. Tourists come to look. At the wreckage.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.welko: Welcome to Ba Sing Guh! I'm Joo Dee Guh. I'd be glad to show you everything. Everything there is to see.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.vraag: What would you like to know? I know everything about Ba Sing Guh. Everything I'm allowed to know.
Does the city know the Fire Nation is waging war?
Is there enough to eat for everyone?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.antwo: The Earth King is very busy. With important king things. He receives nobody.
War? Hee hee. In Ba Sing Guh we don't talk about... unpleasant things.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.knabb: There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.volge: Behind you, by the wall, there are suddenly two Dai Li Mikas. They're looking the other way. Very obviously. Better go back to the camp.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.na.0: There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.na.1: What a lovely day! Hee hee. There is no nibble shortage.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.na.2: Hello! I'm Joo Dee Guh. ...Have we met?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.0: A visitor! How lovely, I never get visitors. I'm the Earth King Guh, and this is Bosco. Bosco, say hello.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.1: You tell the king about Appa Guh. And about the Fire Nation, which has been grabbing nibbles for a hundred years.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.2: Your Majesty, the Guhvatar is tired from the journey. There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. And no sky bison.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.3: Bosco sniffs at your Appa whistle. His nose goes up. Then he turns and looks out of the window. At the lake.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.4: Bosco? What do you see there? Lake Laogai? But there's nothing there... Long Feng?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.6: Long Feng Mika looks at the lake too. Only for a moment. Just one second too long.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.waarhe: Long Feng lied to me? All these years? ...So there IS a nibble shortage?! Bosco, fetch the big nibble chest. We're going to share.
Are you a visitor? Long Feng says I'm very busy. Am I busy? I don't know.
Bosco ate three honeycombs today. That's a record. I'm very proud of Bosco.
In my city everyone is happy. Long Feng says so. Long Feng knows everything.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.na.0: I learn something new about my own city every day. Yesterday: there are POOR guhs in the Lower Ring. Who knew?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.na.1: Bosco misses Appa. They were almost friends.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.na.2: I got a pair of glasses. Now I see everything. Including what I'd rather not have seen.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.long_feng.0: The king has no time. Move along.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.long_feng.1: Are you lost? The exit is that way. Very far away.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.long_feng.2: There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. I'll say it one more time, and then I'll say it one more time.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.azula: Come closer, Guhvatar. I don't bite. I only shove. Very hard.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.dai_li.0: Move along, citizen. There is nothing to see here.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.dai_li.1: We are the Dai Li. We guard the culture of Ba Sing Guh. And the silence.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.dai_li.2: Do you have questions? Don't ask them.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.volger.0: Us? We're not following anyone. We just happen to be walking the same way.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.klant.0: The tea here is so good. I come every day. Sometimes twice.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.klant.1: That waiter is so grumpy. I always give him an extra nibble. Maybe it'll help someday.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.klant.2: They say the old owner was once a very famous general. Nah. Look at him with that teapot.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.klant.3: Psst. There is no nibble shortage. So they say.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.sluip.begin: The base under Lake Laogai. Dai Li Mikas everywhere, looking to and fro: the beam of dust in front of their noses shows where. Crouching makes you quiet (then they only see the orange bit); passing behind their backs is safe. Appa's chamber is at the end of the corridor with the cells, to the south.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.sluip.halt.0: Halt! Back to the hall, citizen.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.sluip.halt.2: There is nothing to see here. Really not. Back.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.sluip.halt.3: Lost? The exit is that way. Bye.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theebezoek.aa: Mmm! This tastes exactly like The Jasmine Dragon! Can I have another cup? And another?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theebezoek.ka: How cozy it is here. Your little house is as warm as your tea, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theebezoek.so: Tea is fine. But do you have nibbles with it too? Just asking. For the plan.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theebezoek.to: Tea is good. As long as we don't have to fly.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theebezoek.zu: My uncle would be proud of you. Not of me. I dropped my cup.
Even a Fire Lord likes his tea. Especially this one. You learned it from the best.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.monorail.uitleg: Jump (space) to push the car with earthbending. Crouch = get out.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theeset.wacht: The tea still needs to steep a little. Try again in %s minute(s).
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theeset.drink.0: Jasmine tea. For a moment you feel like a hero. A chonky hero.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theeset.drink.1: A cup of Uncle Miroh's recipe. Warm right up to your little ears.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theeset.drink.2: Tea! Your paws get faster. Or you think they do. Either is fine.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theeset.drink.3: Slurp. Ahhh. Exactly not too hot.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.jij: Your turn: click an empty square.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.wacht_k: The table is waiting for a second player...
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.wacht: Who's playing along? Have someone click the table within ten seconds. Otherwise a guh of the house plays. (Click again: play a guh right away.)
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.gewonne: You have a lotus! You win!
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.verlore: The other has a lotus. Better luck next time, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.gelijk: The board is full: a draw.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.regels: Take turns laying a tile on an empty square. Whoever first has a lotus (a tile with four of their own tiles above, below, left and right of it) wins.
block.guhs.pai_sho_tafel.lore: Take turns laying a tile; whoever lays a lotus first wins. Against a guh or against a friend.
item.guhs.pai_sho_tafel.lore: Take turns laying a tile; whoever lays a lotus first wins. Against a guh or against a friend.
block.guhs.theeset.lore: A cup of jasmine tea gives a small bonus. Put it in your guhhouse and the team comes over for tea.
item.guhs.theeset.lore: A cup of jasmine tea gives a small bonus. Put it in your guhhouse and the team comes over for tea.
gui.guhs.kledingbron.einde2_h3_aarde: Chapter 3 of the Guhvatar: Ba Sing Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.belonin: The Cabbage Man's stall (once you've seen it break three times)
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.loket: The strict desk guh sits %s, in the passage of the big gate, on the left behind his little window. Talk to him.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.aardrommel: The Earth Rumble arena is %s: through the gate into the city, to the arena with the stands and the bell. Just walk in.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.baan: Toph's training course is %s: the walled field next to the arena, the way in by the sign 'Blindfold Course'. Step in and find the six earth coins with your feet.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.monorail: The monorail car is waiting %s, on top of the outer wall. The stair tower up stands inside the wall, left (north) of the gate: sign 'To the wall and the monorail'.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.theehuis: The Jasmine Dragon is %s: down the station stairs, to the green roof with the dragon above the door. Walk in.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.thee: The big kettle is %s, at the back of the kitchen behind the counter. Right-click it to begin.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.pai_sho: Uncle Miroh is %s, behind the counter. Talk to him for a game of Pai Sho.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.joo_dee: Joo Dee Guh is %s, in front of her house in the north of the Middle Ring. Talk to her.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.kamp: The camp is %s: out through the outer gate, on the landing lobe, next to where Appa landed.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.koning: The Earth King Guh sits %s, in the throne room of the big golden palace in the middle of the city. Talk to him.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.laogai: The boat shed is %s, on the north side of Lake Laogai: wooden shed, green roof, sign 'Boat Rental CLOSED'. Inside, the stairs go down to the base.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.lu_ten: The hill with the cherry tree is %s, on the landing lobe outside the outer wall. Walk up the hill.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.val: The old gate is %s, in the palace garden on the east side of the golden palace: a mossy gatehouse with the sign 'No entry'. Behind it the stairs go down.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.hint.toph: The camp lies %s, on the landing lobe. Appa Guh is ready there to escape.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kijk_loket.te: The passport desk. Without a stamp you're not getting in.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kijk_aardromm: The Earth Rumble arena. Hear that cheering?
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kijk_baan.tek: Toph's training course. Eyes shut, feet open.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kijk_monorail: The monorail car. Step in, and push!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kijk_theehuis: The Jasmine Dragon. It smells of jasmine here.
Joo Dee Guh, the city's guide. She's smiling already.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kijk_kamp.tek: Your camp on the landing lobe. Appa and Momo are waiting there.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kijk_koning.t: The Earth King's palace. Somewhere in there he sits.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kijk_laogai.t: The boat shed at Lake Laogai. 'There is no base here.' Sure there isn't.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kijk_lu_ten.t: The hill with the cherry tree. Someone is sitting there.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kijk_val.teks: The old gate in the palace garden. Beneath it: the catacombs.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_kijk_toph.tek: The camp. Appa Guh is ready to fly away.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.team.theehuis: Smell that? Jasmine! That must be that tea house, down there.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.team.pai_sho: Uncle Miroh has a game board all set up. Pai Sho! Go ask if he wants to play a game.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.team.laogai: Bosco looked at the lake. Lake Laogai! Appa is there, I know it. And that sign by the boat shed is lying.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.baan.onder: Crouch = stomp · walk to the brightest light · %s/%s
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.monorail.onder: Tap space = push · crouch = get out
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.onder: Click the kettle when the little gauge is in the green
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.klaar_onde: Uncle Miroh's tea set is yours
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.sluip.onder: Crouch = quiet · stay out of their beam of dust
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pad.appa: Appa's chamber: %s. Follow the corridor with the cells.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pad.kristal: Follow the corridor and the little lights down: the crystal chamber is %s.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.aankomst.vermo: You're in disguise! As long as you wear Fire Nation clothes, everybody thinks you're an ordinary Mika pupil. Go to the little school: through the crater gate into the city, then left in front of the palace.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.uitnodigi: A pupil whispers: 'Stand on the floor! When the music starts: jump onto the square that lights up!'
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.start: The music starts! Every bar one square of the floor lights up: stand on it on the last beat (the bell). %s of the %s right and you win. Miss one? No matter, just keep dancing.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.sub: Stand on the square that lights up!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.weg: You step off the floor. The party goes on: come back to dance again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.bijna: Almost! %s right, %s needed. The music simply starts again: stay on the floor and dance once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.gewonnen: Wow! The whole cave cheers. Nobody has ever danced like that here!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.juf: Then the teacher is standing in the entrance. Everybody runs. You too: to the palace pond, where nobody looks. The turtle-duck guhs must be hungry.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.eendjes.gevoer: Splash! The turtle-duck guhs come swimming over. They quack contentedly. One nibbles your paw gently. Out of love.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.eendjes.zwarte: Tomorrow is the day: the Day of Black Sun. The team gathers on the beach next to the harbor: out through the crater gate, then east of the harbor gate.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.gevangenis.vol: Zuka slips into the corridor, to the cell next to the hall. Follow him, quietly.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.gevangenis.deu: The iron door creaks open. Someone left it ajar... Zuka?
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.kamp.vlucht: You slip out of the bunker. The team's camp lies west of the landing field: the team is waiting there.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.goedmaken.toph: So, Hothead. You want to say sorry. Nice. I listen with my feet, so do your best.
I... uh... Guhvatar? Help me out. What should I say?
Choose well, Guhvatar. I can feel it when he lies.
Toph: 'Hm. Honest. I feel no lie. Fine, Hothead, you can sit next to me. Not too close.' Now Katara-guh...
Toph stomps. Zuka flies a metre into the air. 'Warm? WARM?' Try again.
'Your honor, your honor...' Toph yawns very loudly. 'Try again, Hothead.'
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.goedmaken.kata: I don't trust him. He's betrayed us too often. Words are easy.
She's right. Guhvatar... what can I do?
Zuka makes nibble pancakes for everyone. They're burnt. Katara eats one anyway. 'Hm. Not bad. For a prince.'
Katara: 'A hug? From me? For him? No.' Try again.
Katara: '...What?' Zuka blushes up to his topknot. Try again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.goedmaken.sokk: Sokka-guh: 'To the gondola! It's on the crater rim, east of the harbor: up the stone stairs, the ones with the little flames.'
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.eendjes.klik: Click the bread basket on the south side of the pond.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.plan: Sokka: 'There's the gondola. Get in and we'll be on the prison roof in no time. And then: sneaking. Crouch! Guards notice you less.'
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.gonde: The gondola creaks across the boiling lake of cheese sauce...
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.binne: You're on the roof of the Boiling Rock. Sneak down and across the yard to Suki-guh's cell: the little lights show the way. Guards only see what's in front of them, and when you crouch only from very close. Spotted? No worries: you simply start again in the hall.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.sub: Stay out of the guards' sight
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.sluip: Two guards walk across the yard. Stay out of their sight, or crouch.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.betra: A guard Mika spots you! He gently shoves you back to the hall. Once more: behind his back, or crouching.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.geluk: You're out! Suki-guh is free, Sokka-guh is beaming, and Zuka belongs a little more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.hin: Zuka's fire has grown weak. 'I have to go back to the source,' he says. The ruin of the Sun Warriors lies far to the west, beyond the camp. A long stair leads up to their terrace.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.zon: The chief of the Sun Warriors: 'You want to understand fire? Climb the long stair. Up there you dance for the masters.'
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.sta: The Dancing Dragon! Step on the tile that lights up, one at a time, in a half circle. Zuka dances the other half. You have five beats per tile: no hurry.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.sub: Step on the tile that lights up
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.bru: Both dragons roar! Halfway there. They're watching...
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.opn: The flames flicker... No worries: step on the tile that lights up. Slowly, and together.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.weg: You leave the terrace. Come back to start the dance again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.gel: You can firebend! (Fire is the last element: you now know all four.)
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.ton: The team goes to rest on Ember Island for a bit, the beach in the southwest. Tonight there's a play in the open-air theater. About... you?
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.toneel.daarna: The White Lotus camp lies far to the east, beyond the crater. Too far to walk? Whistle for Appa-guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.miroh.1: Tomorrow the comet comes. Mikai will use it to eat everything there is to eat. You need advice, Guhvatar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.aang.1: Go and meditate! The Guhvatars before us know more than we do. Fang, Roku-guh's dragon, will fly you to the Peak of the Predecessors.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.miroh.2: A cup of tea for the road? No? Then go with a warm heart. That's good too.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.meditee: You close your eyes. The White Lotus opens for you... and your spirit goes travelling.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.geen_ge: You can't meditate right now (the Spirit World isn't there). Try again later with Uncle Miroh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.terug: You open your eyes in the tent. The tea is still warm. Outside, night falls.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.fang_wa: Fang is waiting for you at the start of his Sky Path, %s. Walk there: he'll fly you to the Summit of the Predecessors.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.miroh.komeet: The comet is coming closer. I'll make some more tea. Tea always helps a little.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.miroh.thee.0: Tea? Of course, tea. There's always tea for the Guhvatar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.miroh.thee.1: You let a good tea steep for a while. Just like a good nephew.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.miroh.thee.2: I've filled the pot again. Sit down, nyeg. Tell me what you've been up to.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.schildpad.wakk: You're standing on the quay. Was it a dream? No: the light is still inside you. Get on Appa-guh: the airship fleet is coming!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.geen_app: Appa-guh can't come right now. Try again in a moment.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.start: Appa-guh takes off. Ahead of you hangs Mikai's airship fleet, red and burning. Steer Appa past the ships (close, but not into them): the team jumps across and takes them down. Take down %s of the %s and follow the little lights to the column of light at the end.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.sub: Fly past the ships, follow the little lights
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.op_appa: Off Appa-guh! You float... Appa-guh is coming to get you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.botsing: Bonk! Appa-guh bumps into an airship (nobody hurt, only a dent in your pride).
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.neer.sok: Sokka-guh: 'Boomerang! Always the boomerang!' The ship sinks away, smoking.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.neer.top: Toph-guh: 'Metal is earth too, nyeg!' She folds the hull in half.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.neer.suk: Suki-guh: 'Kyoshi Warriors, forward!' The ship turns away and sinks into the clouds.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.stand: Taken down: %s of the %s. Follow the little lights!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.au: A blast of fire shoves Appa aside! (%s left)
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.geraakt: Hit too often: the fleet drives you back (the ships that are down stay down).
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.nog_niet: Too many are still flying! Taken down: %s of the %s. Turn around and help the team.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.opnieuw: Back to the start of the flight. Once more!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.gelukt: The airship fleet is down! Everybody safe on little parachutes. Appa-guh lands by the palace...
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.naar: Fire Lord Mikai is waiting on the rock pillars above the water. Four rounds, one for each element. Falling can't go wrong: you splash into warm water and are soon back on your pillar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.ronde.1: Round 1: air. Dodge eight fire blasts: every blast that flies past you counts. Above your hotbar you can see how many you have. Jumping is an air jump: high and far, from pillar to pillar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.ronde.2: Round 2: water. Mikai sets four pillars on fire. Douse the flames (right-click a flame).
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.ronde.3: Round 3: earth. Sparks rain down from the comet. Climb to the highest pillar (the column of light). Crouching is an earth jump: a rock column throws you up.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.ronde.4: Round 4: fire. Hit his blasts back (left-click a blast that comes close).
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.ronde.5: The Guhvatar State! Hit three blasts back and douse two flames. All the elements are yours.
He can't hit you any more. Mikai roars.
Every flame put out. Steam rises from the arena.
You're standing at the top. The comet is right above you.
His own fire hits him back in the face. But then...
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.plons: Splash! The water is lukewarm. Back on the pillar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.tijd: Mikai regroups. This round starts again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.opnieuw: Hit four times in a row (no harm done, only a shove). This round starts again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.duw_lucht: Hit: just a shove, that one doesn't count. Dodged: %s/%s
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.sub.3: Climb to the column of light
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.sub.5: Hit three blasts back and douse two flames
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.klaar: It's over. Go to the palace forecourt, straight ahead through the city: everybody is waiting there.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.bakker.vuurvlo: Fire flakes! Fresh! They crackle in your mouth. Two for the price of three!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.bakker.spannen: Such exciting times. I just keep baking. Baking helps.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.bakker.feest: Party! The war is over and the Guhvatar is in my shop! Here, on the house.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.bakker.morgen: Come back tomorrow, Guhvatar: I'll have something tasty for you again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.beloning.vuur: Chapter 4 is done! You get the Fire Nation disguise for your guhs (in the wardrobe of the Guhdex) and a bag of nibbles.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.beloning.final: You are the Guhvatar! You get your own statue, the title Guhvatar, Zuka's scar for your guhs and a big pile of nibbles.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.finale: The comet is coming. Uncle Miroh is waiting in the tent of the White Lotus.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.daarna: The story has been told, but the world is big: the Spirit World is completely open, the baker of the capital has a treat every day, and somewhere in the Air Temple stands an empty pedestal... that isn't empty any more.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.school: The little school is in the city, %s: in through the crater gate and then left, in front of the palace. Walk into the classroom.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.dans: The secret dance party is in the cave behind the little school, %s: into the alley on the west side of the school. Inside, step onto the dance floor.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.eendjes: The palace pond lies in the palace garden, east of the palace, %s. Click the bread basket on the south side of the pond, by the little sign.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.strand: The team is waiting on the beach next to the harbor, %s: out through the crater gate, then onto the sand east of the harbor gate, by the wooden barricades.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.cel: Zuka has gone down the corridor, to the cell next to the bunker's hall, %s. Follow him.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.kamp: The team's camp lies west of the landing field, %s. The team is sitting by the campfire.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.goedmaken: Stay in the team's camp, %s: Zuka wants to make up and asks you for the right words.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.drakendans: The ruin of the Sun Warriors lies far to the west, %s. Walk to the foot of the long stair and climb all the way up, to the round terrace.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.toneel: The open-air theater of Ember Island lies by the beach in the southwest, %s. Walk into the theater: the show starts by itself.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.tent: The camp of the White Lotus lies far to the east, beyond the crater, %s. Go into the big tent in the middle of the camp. (Too far to walk? Climb onto Appa-guh.)
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.miroh: Talk to Uncle Miroh in the tent of the White Lotus, %s (click him). He knows who can give you advice about the comet.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.schildpad: Rest for a while in the camp of the White Lotus, %s. Something happens in the night...
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.vloot: Go to the quay by the bite out of the crater rim, %s: Appa-guh comes there and you fly through the airship fleet.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.agni_kai: Go to the palace forecourt, %s: Zuka and Azula-Mika are ready for the Agni Kai.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.duel: Fire Lord Mikai is waiting in the duel arena among the rock pillars, %s: in the northwest, behind the ruin. Walk to the shore: the duel starts by itself.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.kroning: The coronation is on the palace forecourt, %s: walk through the city to the big square in front of the palace stairs.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.aftiteling: Go to the palace forecourt, %s: that's where the story ends.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.optie.toph.eerli: "Sorry I scorched your feet. That should never have happened."
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.optie.katara.doe: "Let him DO something instead of saying something."
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.beloning.vermomm: Fire Nation disguise (clothes for your guhs)
item.guhs.guhvatar_beeld.lore: With glowing eyes. Put it in your little house, nyeg
gui.guhs.titels.hint.guhvatar: Finish the story of the Guhvatar, in the Guheinde
gui.guhs.kledingbron.einde2_h4_vuur: The Legend of Guh: chapter 4 and the finale
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.uitleg: The capital of the Fire Nation, in the crater of a volcano of burnt cheese crust. You slip in disguised, you get to know the Fire Nation from the inside, and on the Day of Black Sun Zuka finally chooses his own path. Then: making up, learning fire from the dragons, a very bad play and a tent full of tea.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.stap.11: The tent of the White Lotus
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.0: Land in the capital of the Fire Nation
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.0: The landing field by the harbor
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.1: Go to the Fire Nation school in disguise (through the crater gate into the city, then left in front of the palace) and take a seat in class
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.1: The school in the crater, west of the palace
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.2: Dance at the forbidden party: stand on the square that lights up when the bar comes round
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.2: The dance cave, at the end of the alley next to the school
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.3: Feed the turtle-duck guhs in the palace pond (click the bread basket)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.3: The bread basket on the south side of the palace pond, in the palace garden east of the palace
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.4: Go to the invasion beach, outside the crater east of the harbor gate: today the sun goes out
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.4: The beach next to the harbor, by the wooden barricades
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.5: Follow Zuka through the bunker to Uncle Miroh's cell
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.5: The cell next to the hall of the bunker
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.6: Go back to the team's camp, west of the landing field
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.6: The camp next to the landing field
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.7: Help Zuka make up with Toph-guh and Katara-guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.7: The camp next to the landing field
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.8: Take the gondola to the Boiling Rock (up the stone stairs to the upper station on the crater rim, east of the harbor) and free Suki-guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.8: The upper station of the gondola on the crater rim
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.9: Dance the Dancing Dragon with Zuka at the Sun Warriors: their ruin lies far to the west, climb the long stair
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.9: The round terrace above the ruin, at the top of the long stair
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.10: Watch the play on Ember Island: walk into the open-air theater by the beach in the southwest
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.10: The open-air theater of Ember Island
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.11: Find Zuka and Uncle Miroh in the big tent of the White Lotus, far to the east beyond the crater
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.11: The big tent in the camp of the White Lotus
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.klaar: Chapter 4 is done! The comet is coming. Talk to Uncle Miroh in his tent.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.kla: The tent of the White Lotus
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.7_kat: Toph-guh has come round. Now Katara-guh: help Zuka find the right words
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.7_k: The camp next to the landing field
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.8_bin: Sneak across the yard to Suki-guh's cell (the little lights show the way). Crouching helps!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.8_b: The Boiling Rock, the prison on the island
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.kort.0: Land in the capital of the Fire Nation
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.kort.8: To the gondola of the Boiling Rock
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.kort.10: To the theater of Ember Island
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.kort.11: To the tent of the White Lotus
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.uitleg: The nibble comet is coming. Fire Lord Mikai wants to use its power to eat everything there is to eat, forever. The Guhvatars before you give advice, the Lion Turtle Guh teaches you something nobody knows any more, and then: the airship fleet, the Agni Kai, the duel on the rock pillars and a coronation.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.0: Talk to Uncle Miroh in his tent
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.waar.0: The tent of the White Lotus
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.1: Rest for a while in the capital. Something happens in the night...
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.waar.1: The capital of the Fire Nation
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.2: Fly on Appa-guh through Mikai's burning airship fleet: it starts at the quay by the bite out of the crater rim
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.waar.2: The quay at the bite out of the crater rim
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.4: Stop Fire Lord Mikai on the rock pillars, without hurting him
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.waar.4: The duel arena among the rock pillars, in the northwest behind the ruin
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.5: Go to the coronation on the forecourt
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.kla: You are the Guhvatar! Pick up a little party every day from the baker of the capital.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.waar.k: The capital of the Fire Nation
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.0_g: Fly with Fang to the Summit of the Predecessors in the Spirit World (back in your body? Talk to Uncle Miroh again)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.waar.0: Fang's Sky Path in the Spirit World
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.kort.0: Fly with Fang to the Summit
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.kort.4: The duel with Fire Lord Mikai
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_h4_vuur.re: Ba Sing Guh has fallen. Uncle Miroh has been taken. And you are still tired.
Appa-guh carries the team to the heart of the Fire Nation: a capital in a crater.
Here Fire Lord Mikai has his throne, his army and his hunger.
Disguised among the Mikas, you wait for the Day of Black Sun.
Fire is the last element. It is also the hardest. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.titel: In disguise in the Fire Nation
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.verte: The capital of the Fire Nation. A crater full of smoke, flags and lots of grumpy little flames.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.plan: Plan Disguise, just as we agreed above the clouds! Golden trims on top, and nobody says the word 'Guhvatar'. Nobody. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.moe: You're still tired from Ba Sing Guh. Take it easy, okay? We'll keep an eye on you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.schoe: Red? I can't see anyway. All I feel is that these shoes pinch.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.welko: Welcome to the Fire Nation! They're said to have the tastiest fire flakes. I think. I hope.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_school.beste: Good morning, class! Who knows the very best Fire Lord in all of history?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_school.knabbel: Very good. And who has the biggest stock of nibbles in the whole world?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_school.opgeget: Fire Lord Mikai too, miss! Because he's eaten all the others.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_school.oren: You there, new one. Your headband is crooked. It almost looks like... little ears.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_school.fluiste: Psst. Tonight, in the cave. Dancing is forbidden. Come!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.zon: The Day of Black Sun. In the middle of the day the moon slides in front of the sun.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.ach: For eight minutes no Mika can make fire. Eight minutes. That's the chance.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.pla: Everybody ready? This is it, nyeg. The plan of my life. I wrote it down three times.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.nu: Now or never. To the palace!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.lee: The throne room is empty. No guards. No Fire Lord. Only the curtain of flames, gone out.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.wis: Looking for my father? How cute. We've known for weeks, little Guhvatar. He's safe, far away. And the sun will be back any moment.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.val: She knew... It was a trap. Everybody back to the beach. Now!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.lui: Father. I have something to say to you. And this time you're going to listen.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.dur: You dare. On the one day I have no fire, you come to talk.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.weg: You sent me away because I stood up for others. That wasn't weak. It was the best thing I ever did.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.ban: I'm not afraid of you any more. I'm going to help the Guhvatar. And you... you're going to learn to share.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.les: The sun is back, prince. Now you get your lesson.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.bli: Mikai fires a bolt of lightning. Zuka catches it, leads it through his belly, out of his arm, and sends it away: into the ceiling.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.dag: Uncle Miroh taught me that. Something you never did. Goodbye, father.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.weg: Zuka walks away. For the first time he doesn't look back.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.ter: Back to the camp. All of us. We'll come back, I promise.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.pla: I had a plan B. Plan B was actually plan A too, but quieter.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.oom: And somewhere deep under the palace, Zuka goes to the only one he still wants to see.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.nee: Uncle. I did it. I said no to father. I said what I think.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.dra: Uncle Miroh says nothing. He slowly turns away, to the wall.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.goe: I know I hurt you in Ba Sing Guh. I'll make it up to you. Really. Someday.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.sti: Silence. Only the tick of a drop.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.ga: ...I'm going. Take care of yourself, uncle.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.opd: When Zuka is gone, Miroh does fifty push-ups. Then fifty more. Then fifty more again. The bars creak.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.ste: An old guh has to be strong... for when his nephew needs him again.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.avond: That evening, by the campfire. Someone is standing at the edge of the light.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.hoi: Hello. Zuka here. I'm... on your side now. Hi.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.eruit: You? After everything you've done? Get out. Now.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.eer: He spent a very long time looking for his honor. Maybe he found it. In the bin.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.leraar: The Guhvatar has to learn fire. Nobody else here can teach that. I can. A bit.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.voeten: He's telling the truth. I can feel it in his heartbeat. And in my feet. He once scorched them, you see.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.sorry: That was... an accident. Sorry, Toph.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.tweede: Let's give it a try. Everybody deserves a second nibble.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.eten: Zuka may stay. But nobody sits next to him at dinner.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kokend_rotsblo: Suki! I knew I'd find you. I had a plan for it. Seven plans, actually.
Cut the cable! Drop them in the cheese sauce!
Yoo-hoo! Can we come too? We're coming anyway.
Little brother. You look so... obedient. It doesn't suit you.
The gondola shoots into the station. Behind you the cable sinks groaning into the cheese sauce. Nobody falls in. Only Azula's good mood.
Thank you, Zuka. Sokka said you'd changed. He was right. Don't tell him.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.laatste: The last step of the Dancing Dragon. Then the terrace falls silent.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.oordeel: Now the masters judge. Show what burns in your hearts.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.menu: They're going to eat us. I thought this was a dance, not a menu!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.cirkel: Two dragon guhs, a red one and a blue one, circle the terrace. Their little ears stand straight up.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.regenbo: They breathe fire. It doesn't burn. Red, gold, blue, green, pink: every colour of the rainbow, and a few that have no name yet.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.leven: Fire isn't anger... Fire is life. It's energy. It's... warm. I had forgotten that.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.jij: You feel it too: fire that doesn't burn but warms. You learn to firebend.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.gezien: The masters have seen you. The fire in you is good. Go, and don't forget it.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.dank: Guhvatar... thank you. For the first time my fire feels like mine. I belong now, right? With the team.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.vuur_va: Zuka is one of the team. And from now on your fire burns. It warms.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.titel: The Boy in the Cheese Ball
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.vanavon: Ember Island. Tonight the open-air theater plays 'The Boy in the Cheese Ball'. You're sitting in the third row.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.guhvata: I am the Guhvatar! I only eat vegetarian nibbles and I laugh very loudly! HAHAHAHA!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.lach: ...I don't laugh like that, do I? I don't laugh like that, nyeg?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.hoop: Hope! Hope! All I talk about is hope! And I cry a lot. Sob! Hope!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.soms: I don't only talk about... okay. Sometimes.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.honger: I'm funny! I'm hungry! I'm funny because I'm hungry!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.reus: I AM A GIANT! I SEE EVERYTHING WITH MY EARS!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.tien: Finally an actor who gets me. Wonderful. Ten nibbles.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.eer: My honor! My hooonor! Where is my honor?! Has anybody seen my honor?!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.kant: The scar is on the wrong side. And I don't talk about my honor that often.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.doek: The curtain falls. The audience claps. You clap too. A little.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.samen: You know what? The story is all wrong. But we're sitting here together. And that is completely right.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.titel: The tent of the White Lotus
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.kamp: The camp of the White Lotus. Old masters around a fire, and one tent with a light inside.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.nooit: He's never going to forgive me. Why would he?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.spijt: Uncle... I'm sorry. I was so stupid. So lost. I betrayed you, while you always... always...
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.opstaan: Uncle Miroh stands up. Slowly. He puts his paws around his nephew.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.nooit_boo: I was never angry with you. I was sad, because I was afraid you had lost your way.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.haten: I thought you would hate me.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.neefje: Hate you? You're my nephew. That doesn't stop because you take a wrong turn once. Not twice either, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.thee: Come. There is tea. There is always tea.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.thee_drin: They drink tea. Not much is said. It doesn't have to be.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.lot: Destiny is a funny thing, Guhvatar. Tomorrow the comet comes. Tonight we drink tea.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.kopje: Sit down. There's another cup in the pot. And there's always one ready for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.top: The Peak of the Predecessors. Above the mist of the Spirit World wait the Guhvatars who came before you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.komeet: Tomorrow the nibble comet comes. Mikai wants to use its power to eat everything there is to eat. Everything. Forever.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.twijfel: I once hesitated when I should have acted. Because of that his family could stay hungry. Don't hesitate like I did, young Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.hard: I never hesitated. I was sometimes too hard. Be determined, but don't let your heart harden.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.geluk: A Guhvatar puts the world first. But don't forget that you belong to that world too, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.vissen: And rest. I once fished for three days in a row. That helped too.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.papier: Write everything down. Plans, lists, recipes. I had the finest desks of all the Guhvatars.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.alleen: You're not alone in this. We are always with you, even when you can't see us. Go back to your body. It is time.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_leeuwschildpad: You wake up. It is night. The ground beneath you is breathing.
You are lying on the back of an island... of a turtle... of a LION TURTLE. With little ears.
You clamber down over its shell, along its neck, onto the quay. And there, right in front of your nose: a head as big as a house. With a mane. And little ears. Its eyes are still closed.
One eye opens. Then the other. They are big and old, and they look at you very kindly.
I called you, in your sleep. The ones before you told you WHO you must be. I will show you HOW.

You tell it everything. About the comet, and about Mikai, who wants to eat the whole world. Everybody says: defeat him. But how do you defeat someone without hurting him? Even a Mika who eats everything?

Mikai's fire burns on his hunger. A hunger that never stops, even if he eats the whole world empty. Still that hunger, and his fire becomes a small, warm flame again. Enough for tea. Never again enough for war.

But be careful. Touch him while he is still full of fire, and his hunger pulls at your light. Tire him out first: with air, with water, with earth and with fire. Only when his fire is spent do you give him your light.
Come closer, little Guhvatar. I will let you feel it.
Do not be afraid, little Guhvatar. I am older than the oldest nibble.
You want to stop Mikai without hurting him. That is a good heart. It is also a hard heart to have.
Long before the Guhvatars, guhs did not bend fire or water. They steered the light within themselves. The energy.
Whoever keeps their own light strong can still the hunger of another. Take nothing from him that he needs. Give him rest.
A warm light flows through you, from your forehead to your paws. Now you know what you have to do.
Go. The comet is coming. And don't forget to eat, nyeg.
The Lion Turtle Guh slowly sinks back into the mist. The island is gone. You are standing on the quay.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.komee: The palace forecourt. The comet turns the whole sky red.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.agni_: An Agni Kai, little brother. A fire duel. Just you and me. On the day I become Fire Lady.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.niet_: I'll fight you, Azula. But you're not well. Let it go. Please.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.vlamm: Blue flames against red. They look alike. They are not.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.water: Look who's joining in. The water guh. Let's see how well you catch.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.zuka_: Zuka leaps in front of her. The lightning shoves him to the ground. He's breathing. He's still breathing.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.hou_v: Zuka! Hold on... I'm here. I'm right here.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.ketti: Azula chases Katara-guh across the square. Katara lures her above a grate full of water and freezes it all at once. A chain of ice holds Azula fast.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.ijs: Azula sits stuck in the ice and sobs. Nobody laughs. Katara stays with her for a moment.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.dank: You jumped in front of me. Thank you, Zuka. Lie still, I'll patch you up.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.ga: I'm glad it's you patching me up. Go, Guhvatar! Mikai is at the rock pillars!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_omslag.litteke: Mikai's fire throws you against a rock pillar. A sharp point hits your back, right on the old scar of Azula's lightning.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_omslag.alle: All the Guhvatars. Every one of us.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_omslag.ga: Hee-hee, me too! Go for it, nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_omslag.ogen: Your eyes glow. Air, water, earth and fire swirl around you like a ring of light. The Guhvatar State.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_omslag.laatste: The last round. All four elements. At once.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.ademt: Mikai lies on a pillar. He breathes heavily and looks at the comet. He's still hungry. Always hungry.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.poten: You put one paw on his forehead and the other on his heart. Just like the Lion Turtle Guh did.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.licht: Your light pushes against a dark, gnawing hunger. For a long time. Then yours wins.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.vol: What... what have you done? I... I'm full. I'm FULL.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.tevre: You have taken his endless appetite away. What's left is a round, content Mika who, for the first time in his life, has enough.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.vlamm: And his fire? It's still there: a small, warm flame above his paw. Enough for a cup of tea. Never again enough for a war. Just as the Lion Turtle Guh said.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.dutje: May I... may I perhaps take a nap?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.snurk: He falls asleep. He snores. It sounds almost sweet.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.ochten: The next morning. The forecourt is packed: Mikas, guhs, and a few puzzled turtle-duck guhs.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.kroon: Uncle Miroh places the crown on his nephew's head. It fits. Of course it fits.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.voorbi: The war is over. From today we share. Every nibble, every flame, every day.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.prober: I don't promise I'll get everything right. I do promise I'll try. With the help of my friends.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.oom: And that from now on I'll listen to my uncle. Mostly.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.vader: And my father? He is no longer Fire Lord, and he has no appetite left for the whole world. He lives by the palace pond now and shares his bread with the turtle-duck guhs. Every day. All by himself.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.plan: This is the best plan that ever worked. And I didn't even have a plan for it!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.voeten: I feel lots of happy feet.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.juiste: And you, Guhvatar... you were exactly the right guh in exactly the right place. I couldn't have passed it on to anyone better.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.dank: Guhvatar. You showed me who I could be. Thank you. The Fire Nation is your home too.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.mooist: The best day of my life... after that time with the perfect jasmine tea.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.theehu: I'm going to reopen the Jasmine Dragon. Drop by. There's always a cup ready for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.zo: And so peace came to the four nations. With fireworks. Lots of fireworks.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.aan: Aang-guh, the previous Guhvatar (who went for a little laze)
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.wat: Katara-guh and Sokka-guh, of the Water Tribe
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.zuk: Fire Lord Zuka, and Uncle Miroh with his tea
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.mik: Fire Lord Mikai, full at last
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.azu: Azula-Mika, who is having a little think
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.voo: Roku-guh, Kyoshi-guh and all the Guhvatars before you
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.wez: The Lion Turtle Guh, the dragon guhs and Fang
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.muz: The music: see the credits in the Guhboek
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.kni: A guh wink to Avatar: The Last Airbender
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.ied: And every guh who ever shared a nibble
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.ein: The story of the Guhvatar has been told. But the world is big, the tea is still warm, and there is so much left to discover. To be continued, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.kring: Behind Appa-guh, on the landing field, the team sits down in a circle. Into the Fire Nation: that much is settled. Now the how. In whispers.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.geheim: Like we decided up in the air: nobody may know who you are. And that's easier than it sounds. Azula thinks her lightning took you out in Ba Sing Guh. Everybody thinks the Guhvatar is gone. That's our secret weapon.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.komeet: In a few weeks the nibble comet comes. With its power Mikai wants to eat everything there is to eat. Everything. Forever.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.zwarte_zo: But first comes the Day of Black Sun: eight minutes without fire. Then our fleet arrives, and you have to be there. Well rested.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.tot_dan: And until then we're ordinary Fire Nation kids. Boring, red, and we bow to every little flame. My fake moustache is already on. A small one, as agreed.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.school: And that little school from up there was no joke, Aang-guh. It stands right in front of the palace: there we get to know the city, and how we get in later.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.kuzon: A hundred years ago I had a friend here. Kuzon-guh. Not everyone in the Fire Nation is mean, really. Maybe we'll still see that.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vijver.verstop: After the dance party the team slips into the palace garden. Nobody looks for runaway dancers here.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vijver.eendjes: Turtle-duck guhs! Monk Guhatso and I always fed them when I was nervous. It helps. Really, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vijver.morgen: Then let's feed them now. Tomorrow is the Day of Black Sun. Everybody's a little nervous.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vijver.strand: Tomorrow afternoon on the beach by the harbor: that's where our fleet arrives. Eight minutes. One chance. No pressure.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vijver.mand: That basket on the south side of the pond smells of bread. I can't see it, but you can. Go on, Guhvatar.
Who is in the Boiling Rock?
After the making up, the camp is quiet. Sokka-guh has been staring into the fire for an hour.
On the Day of Black Sun, when we ran back from the palace, Suki-guh held off the guards on the beach so we could get away. She and the guhs of our fleet. They were all caught.

You don't know her yet. Suki-guh leads the Kyoshi Warriors, from the village under the great statue of Kyoshi-guh. They fight with fans, and they're very, very fast. Long before you joined us, we fought side by side there. She got us out of the fire. Literally.
And Sokka-guh is a little bit in love. I can feel his heart thumping all the way over here.
I know where they are. The Boiling Rock: a prison on an island in a lake of boiling cheese sauce. Nobody has ever escaped.
There's only one way in: the gondola on the crater rim. I'm coming with you, Sokka-guh. I owe you that.
Then here's the plan: the gondola to the roof, sneak across the yard, find Suki-guh, and get everybody out. The rest guard Appa-guh.
And the Guhvatar's coming too! Three is better than two. Especially when one of the three is the Guhvatar.
At the top of the long stair lies the round terrace of the Sun Warriors. Left and right, two dark caves yawn.
Look. Ever since I chose your side, my fire is just a spark. It used to burn on anger. And that's run out.
Anger is poor fuel, prince. It burns bright, and then it's gone. The first firebenders learned it differently: from the dragons.
This is the Dancing Dragon, older than the Fire Nation itself. Two dancers, each half a circle, together one fire. Whoever dances it well sees what fire really is.
In the caves, two huge eyes open. The masters are awake: the last two dragon guhs. And they are watching. Closely.
And if they don't think we're good enough?
Then they'll be disappointed. Believe me: that's worse than being eaten. Dance, Guhvatar. Dance with your heart.
The head of the Sun Warriors
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.ti: A tile of the White Lotus
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.na: The curtain is closed and the audience heads home. One old guh stays behind, a sword on his back.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.pr: Prince Zuka. You still hold your sword too high, I see.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.me: Master Piandao-guh! You taught me swordfighting, long ago. What are you doing here?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.oo: I bring a message. Your uncle broke out of his cell on the Day of Black Sun. He twisted the bars like wet noodles.
