quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.klaar: You learned something and brought something. Come back whenever you like: every day I trade a piece of knowledge for a book.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.later.0: Bring me knowledge, and I give you a book. One a day. I'm an owl, not a printing press.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.later.1: My fox guhs are quick, but sometimes they put books on the wrong shelf. I suspect they do it on purpose.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.later.2: Everything in here is true. Except the cookbooks.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.ruil_morgen: You already traded today. Come back tomorrow.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.ruil: A fair trade. Read it well. And put it back neatly in your own bookcase later.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.hint.kennis: Give Wan Shi Guh three pieces of knowledge (map, compass, clock, spyglass, book): hold it and click him.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.hint.vos: Find a fox guh in the library and click it.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.hint.planetar: Turn the wheel of the planetarium, next to Professor Zei Guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.kietel: Hmmmmm? Who is tickling my shell? Come on down, little one. To my paw.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.slaap: *Zzzzzz... a deep, warm snore, as big as an island.*
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.wakker.1: Ah. A Guhvatar. I have seen quite a few. They come, they go. I swim.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.wakker.2: I am older than the islands, and almost as chonky. That's a compliment, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.vraag: Tell me, little one. What are you actually looking for?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.wijs.1: Strength. Hm. Whoever is strong can carry. Whoever is wise knows when to put something down.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.wijs.2: Rest. Good answer. Rest is not standing still. Rest is swimming without hurry.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.wijs.3: HOHOHO. At last someone who tells the truth. Nibbles are strength and rest at once.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.offer: Do you know what I haven't had for ages? A nibble. Put one in my paw.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.offer_no: A nibble, little one. Hold it and give it to my snout.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.kom_op_p: Come stand on my paw, little one. My eyes aren't what they used to be.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.klaar: Wear that scale well. It knows where I am, and I know where you are.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.morgen: One wisdom a day, little one. More is too heavy for a small tummy.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.dagwijsh: Whoever hurries misses the view. Whoever doesn't hurry sometimes misses the boat. Both are fine.
An island that swims is never lost. It is simply on its way.
The void seems empty. But sometimes something sings in it. Just listen.
You don't have to be able to do everything. You only have to know who can.
Sharing a nibble is eating twice. Once with your mouth, once with your heart.
Even an old turtle still learns something. Today I learned that you came to visit me.
Water flows around the stone. The stone is fine with that.
Sleep well, eat well, chonk well. The rest follows by itself.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.gevangen: The Lion Turtle Guh catches you!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.hint.poo: Walk to the raised paw of the Lion Turtle and stand on his palm.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.hint.kna: Hold a cheese nibble and click the snout of the Lion Turtle, on his palm.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.welkom: Oh! Don't be scared. I'm only the cook. I secretly cook for the captured guhs. Every day. And I'm so sorry I'm a Mika.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.optie.waarom: Why do you do it in secret?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.uitleg: Mikas aren't allowed to be nice. It says so in the Mika book, on page one. I tore out page one. Sorry.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.ingredienten: I want to make real soup. With 2 blue cheese mushrooms, 2 crystal cheese nuggets, 2 nibble chorus fruits and 1 crumb cloud.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.ingredienten_n: I don't have everything yet. Blue cheese mushrooms, crystal cheese nuggets, nibble chorus fruits, a crumb cloud. Sorry for asking so much.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.ingredienten_k: Oh, this smells like the whole Guh End! But the captain mustn't see me cook. Could you... distract him?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.kapitein_nog: The captain is downstairs. Think of something. Something he'll believe. Sorry.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.soep: He's gone! The soup is ready and the cells get a bowl. You know what? I'm leaving. I want a kitchen of my own. With a window.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.optie.ga: Go! I'll see you in the Void Harbor.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.vertrek: Sorry for leaving so fast. Sorry for the mess. See you in the Void Harbor!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.kapitein: WHAT DO YOU WANT? This is MY fortress. Say it quick, I'm busy with... things.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.afleiding.1: Look! A grease ship without a captain!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.afleiding.3: May I go through to the kitchen?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.afgeleid: WHAT?! A ship without a captain?! That can't be! That's NOT ALLOWED! I'm going to look! Nobody does anything until I'm back!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.haven: You came! Look, my own little kitchen. With a window! Onto the void! Here, the recipe for my Sorry Soup. Sorry it's so tasty.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.haven_vreemd: Hello? Do we know each other? Sorry. I'm new here. I'm sorry about all sorts of things.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.dagsoep: Here, a bowl of Sorry Soup. Still warm. Sorry there's only one.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.later.0: I have a window. I look at the void every day. Sorry, I'm just happy.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.later.1: The captain never found that ship. He's still looking. Sorry, captain.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.later.2: More soup tomorrow. Promise. Sorry it's only tomorrow.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.hint.ingredien: Gather the ingredients on the outer islands: blue cheese mushrooms, crystal cheese nuggets, nibble chorus fruits, a crumb cloud.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.hint.kapitein: Talk to the fortress captain on the ground floor and distract him.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.hint.terug: Go back to the cook in the fortress kitchen.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.hint.haven: Visit the cook in his new kitchen in the Void Harbor: The Sorry Spatula.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.briefje.2: Want a little grease boat of your own? Small, slow, flies anyway. With a chest and seats for your guhs.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.briefje.3: Bring 24 planks, 8 wool, 4 Mika's Grease and 2 flash crumbs to the shipyard in the Void Harbor.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.werf: Ah, my favorite skipper! Welcome to the yard. A new color? Another sail?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.geen_opdrac: A boat of your own? Then you need a commission. Take a look at the harbor board of a Mika Fortress.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.materiaal: For a little grease boat I need: 24 planks, 8 wool, 4 Mika's Grease and 2 flash crumbs. Then I start right away!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.begint: Everything's here! Watch the slip. Just a moment: hammer hammer, saw saw, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.af: Your little grease boat is done!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.af_sub: Go back to the shipwright guh
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.af_zeg: Done! The finest little boat I ever built. Come and christen it.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.doop: Here it is. A little grease boat of your own. Give it a color, a sail and a name. Please don't break a bottle on it.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.hint.briefj: Read the note on the harbor board at the pier of a Mika Fortress.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.hint.werf: Bring the materials to the shipwright guh in the Void Harbor.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.hint.materi: Gather 24 planks, 8 wool, 4 Mika's Grease and 2 flash crumbs.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.hint.doop: Talk to the shipwright guh to christen your little grease boat.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.haven.veer.welkom: The Chonky Wave sails to every place you know. For free! Where do you want to go?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.haven.veer.verder: I can also take you here:
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.haven.veer.mist: The ferry can't get there: that place can't be found yet.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.haven.veer.aan: The Chonky Wave drops you off at: %s
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.welkom: Welcome to the Guh Wing Ring Race! Eighteen rings, one landing strip, and the clock is running. Ready?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.welkom_terug: There's my racer! Your best time is %s. Can you go faster?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.uitleg: Fly through all eighteen rings, in order, and land on the landing strip. Under %s and you earn a title!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.niet_op_start: Stand on the starting platform first.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.mis: Out of the race! The wind sets you back on the start platform in a moment; then talk to the race master guh to start again.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.terug: Back on the start platform. Talk to the race master guh for a new round!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.titel: Under %s! You are a true Ring Racer!
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.kracht.geen: You don't know any chonk art here yet.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.kracht.aarde_mis: No ground in reach: look at the ground where the rock pillar should come up.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.kracht.aarde_hier: There is no room for a rock wall here.
gui.guhs.einde2_kracht.zij_luchtsprong.u: Leap high on the wind, and once more in mid-air. You always land softly.
gui.guhs.einde2_kracht.zij_waterloop.uit: Walk on water for fifteen seconds. Sneak to sink. You land softly too.
gui.guhs.einde2_kracht.zij_aardzuil.uitl: A rock pillar bursts up where you look (up to 12 blocks) and throws monsters into the air. Look at your feet: it lifts you. Sneak: a rock wall right in front of you. It all crumbles away after a few seconds.
gui.guhs.einde2_kracht.zij_handvlam.uitl: Shoot a fire bolt 10 blocks ahead. A monster gets a tap and catches fire for a moment. It lights campfires and candles; nothing else catches fire, and it never hits guhs.
key.guhs.einde2_kracht: Chonk Art (tap: use, hold: element wheel)
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.beloning.vetbootje: A little grease boat of your own
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.boek.door: From the library of Wan Shi Guh
item.guhs.einde2_zij_kristalsnoep_ring.l: From King Bumi Guh. Give it a lick: you dig extra fast for a while.
*lick* Crystal candy! You dig extra fast.
item.guhs.einde2_zij_zegenschub.lore: If you fall into the void of the Guh End, the old turtle catches you.
item.guhs.einde2_zij_spijtsoep.lore: From the sorry Mika cook. Sorry it's so tasty.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vestingbevrijder: Free six skinny guhs from the cells of the Mika Fortresses.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.ringenracer: Fly the Guh Wing Ring Race in under 45 seconds.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.omash.0: King Bumi Guh sits %s, on his throne in the throne room at the top of the palace of Omashguh.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.omash.1: Trial 1 begins %s: the room with the waterfall of glass, on the west side below the throne room. Go in and use your earth power there (your power key, H by default).
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.omash.2: Trial 2 begins %s, on the east side below the throne room: Flopsie's hutch. Take a good look at how big those paw prints are...
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.omash.3: The arena of trial 3 lies %s, in the middle below the throne room. Walk in and choose your opponent.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.omash.4: The loading platform of the mail chutes lies %s, in front of the palace. Step into a mail chute: the clock runs from the first bit of chute. Too late? Then the mail lift takes you back up.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.lucht.0: The air nun guh stands %s, by the stairs in the hanging hall: the temple hangs upside down below the island.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.lucht.1: The balcony of a silent wind corridor lies %s (the column of light points it out). Stand on the balcony and use your air power there. Four corridors run from the hall to the four sides, the fifth is the organ pipe at the bottom.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.lucht.2: A stray sky bison guh drifts %s (the column of light points it out). Fly there and click it, or aim your Air Ball at it from a distance: then it flies to its pen.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.lucht.3: The herd is home. The air nun guh is waiting %s, by the stairs in the hanging hall.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.vuur.0: Shyu stands %s, by the hatch behind the altar on the ground floor of the tower.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.vuur.1: The five fire doors stand %s, in a row at the top of the tower. Stand right in front of a door and use your fire power: the lock starts to burn. The column of light points out the next door.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.vuur.2: The fire doors are open, just for you (%s). Walk straight at a door: you step through it, into the sanctum.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.vuur.3: The spirit of Roku Guh stands %s, before his statue in the sanctum. Click him.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kyoshi.0: The leader of the Kyoshi Warrior Guhs stands %s, in the dojo on the east side of the village, before the wall of fans.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kyoshi.1: The golden tile lies %s, in the middle of the dance floor in the dojo. Stand on it and the dance starts by itself. Do what shows up big on screen: DUCK (shift), JUMP or TURN (look sideways). Ten of the sixteen right is enough.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kyoshi.2: The makeup table stands %s, under the mirror in the southwest corner of the dojo. Click it.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kyoshi.3: The foaming fan guh stands %s, next to his fan club stall by the gate, close to the landing place. Click him.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.bieb.0: Wan Shi Guh sits %s, at the very bottom of the library, in the owl hall. You get in through the window in the spire and then keep going down.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.bieb.1: Wan Shi Guh sits %s, in the owl hall. Hold a map, compass, clock, spyglass or book in your hand and click him.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.bieb.2: A fox guh with a book stands %s, next to the owl's platform. Click him.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.bieb.3: The planetarium lies %s: the side hall on the west side, at the height of hall 1. Click the lodestone of the wheel, next to Professor Zei Guh.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.schildpad.0: The highest point of his shell lies %s: walk through the forest on his back to the stone ring.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.schildpad.1: His raised paw lies %s, at the front below his head. Walk down along his flank and stand on the middle pad of his palm.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.schildpad.2: His snout is %s. Hold a cheese nibble in your hand and click it while you stand on his palm.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kok.0: The Mika cook stands %s, by his soup pot in the kitchen of the Mika Fortress.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kok.2: The fortress captain sits %s, behind his desk on the ground floor of the fortress. Talk to him.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kok.4: The Sorry Spatula, the cook's new little kitchen, lies %s, on the quay of the Void Harbor.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.bootje.1: The shipwright guh stands %s, at the shipyard on the west side of the Void Harbor, by the slipway.
Go in and use your earth power.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_omash_glijbaa: Step into a mail chute and slide down!
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_lucht_windflu: Stand on the balcony and let the wind sing.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_lucht_kudde.t: Click it, or blow at it with Air Ball.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_vuur_deuren.t: Stand before a door and use your fire power.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_vuur_heiligdo: The doors are open. Just for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_kyoshi_dans.t: Stand here, and follow the calls on the beat.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_kyoshi_schmin: Under the mirror in the dojo.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_kyoshi_fan.te: He has been waiting for years for a real warrior.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_bieb_vos.teks: He has a book for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_bieb_planetar: Turn the wheel next to Professor Zei Guh.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_schildpad_top: The highest point of his shell.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_schildpad_kop: A cheese nibble in your hand, and click.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_haven_kok.tek: His own little kitchen, on the quay.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_haven_werf.te: The shipwright guh is waiting by the slipway.
item.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvishoorn.lore: He blew on it for sixty years. Now, at last, somebody comes.
item.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvishoorn.tool: Blow (in the Guheinde): your own whale comes to you.
On his back with the horn in your hand: he swims where you look.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.hoorn.geen: You blow. A deep note rolls through the void... but there is no whale listening to you yet.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.hoorn.niet_hier: Your whale only swims in the void of the Guheinde. That's where he hears you.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.hoorn.komt: You toot the horn. Far away a low song answers: your whale is on his way!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wacht: Your story flight to %s is still waiting. Click Appa and pick the star, "On with the story", to fly on. Lost Appa? Blow your Appa Whistle, or click the cheese ball at the Nibble Mountain.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.uitleg: Pick a place, then Yip yip! and Appa flies there (steering is allowed). ★ = your story, ⌂ = your own Appa Platform.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.leeg: You don't know any buildings in the Guheinde yet. Go exploring, and Appa will remember them.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.niet_hier: Appa can't follow you into the Spirit World. Return to your body first.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.niet_op_app: Sit on Appa's head first, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.kan_niet: Appa can't fly there right now.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.op_weg: Yip yip! On our way to %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.verhaal_rij: On with the story: fly to %s
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.ver: Appa is too far away. Call him with the Appa Whistle first.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.nog_niet: Appa is still sniffing out the way there. Try again in a moment.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.leegte.op_weg: Appa rumbles, swishes his tail and dives into the void with you, on the way to %s...
block.guhs.einde2_reizen_appa_platform.l: The heart of your own Appa stable. Lay a 5x5 floor around it, with 3 blocks of air above.
item.guhs.einde2_reizen_appa_platform.lo: The heart of your own Appa stable. Lay a 5x5 floor around it, with 3 blocks of air above.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.klaar: %s is ready! Blow your Appa Whistle within %s blocks and Appa lands neatly on it.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.vloer: %s isn't finished yet: %s floor blocks are missing in the 5x5 square around the platform (for example at %s). Angry little clouds show where.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.ruimte: Something is still in the way above %s: %s blocks (for example at %s). Appa needs %s blocks of free air above the whole 5x5 square.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.weg: Your Appa Platform in this dimension is gone. Put down a new one.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.geen: You don't have an Appa Platform there (any more).
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.te_vroeg: Appa doesn't know this platform yet. Finish the whole story of the Guhvatar first, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.verplaat: This is now your Appa Platform in this dimension. The old one doesn't count any more.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.opgeruim: You packed up your Appa Platform. Put it down somewhere else and Appa will find it.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.alleen_g: You can only call Appa anywhere in the Guh End. In other dimensions you really need to build your own Appa stable: an Appa Platform with a 5x5 floor. There he hears your whistle.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.te_ver: %s is %s blocks away. Come within %s blocks and whistle again.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.komt: %s hears your whistle and lands on %s. Yip yip!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.platform.geschenk: Here, for you: an Appa Platform! Build a 5x5 floor at home with this in the middle, and Appa will always know where to land. Even outside the Guh End, nyeg.
Appa sniffs the platform, sneezes once and gives you an approving look. You got an Appa Platform.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.yip.aan_boord: Players aboard: %s. Friends can still climb on: right-click Appa.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.yip.blijft: Appa stays here. Blow your whistle on his head to pick a place.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.yip.niet_op: You're not on Appa any more. Pick again.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.doel.kroeg: to the harbor pub of the Void Harbor
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.doel.wachten: to the captain's spot, above the void
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wachten.0: The void is quiet. You wait...
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wachten.1: No wind. No birds. You wait a little longer...
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wachten.2: Was that... something? You hold your breath.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wachten.3: Deep below you the silence trembles.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wachten.4: There. A song, very far away.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wacht_weg: You're no longer at the captain's spot. Go back and wait above the void.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.inrichting.uitleg: Choose what stands on his back. Items in the chests are kept, even when you put the chests away.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.1: Yip yip! Hold on tight, new Guhvatar. Appa flies faster than he looks.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.2: A hundred years in a cheese ball. My legs are still asleep. Luckily my tummy is wide awake, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.3: Momo Guh sniffs your ear, decides your shoulder belongs to him, and settles down on it, very pleased.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.4: See those clouds over there? The Southern Air Temple floats behind them. My home. Now a little bit yours too.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.5: Water, earth, fire, air. Four elements. Sounds like a lot? It is a lot. But you have time. And nibbles.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.6: You know the best thing about flying? Nobody asks you anything up here. Only the wind, and the wind always says hi.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.7: There she is! Appa can already smell his stable. Hold on to your ears, we're landing.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.1: Off to the Northern Water Tribe! That's where you learn waterbending. Brr, I hope your fur is warm enough.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.2: The water master there is called Pakguh. He's very strict. And he has a very big moustache. Those two go together, I think.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.3: That was Zuka. He's been hunting me since... well, since yesterday. He wants his honour back, he says.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.4: I kind of get him. Everybody is looking for something. He's just looking in the wrong place.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.5: Momo Guh crawls out from under Appa's fur. Only now that the ship is really gone does he dare to squeak again.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.6: Ice! Miles of ice! I'm going to slide on my belly in a minute. Coming?
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.1: Okay team, the plan. Step one: we land in Ba Sing Guh. Step two: ...I'm still working on that.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.2: Aang, you're sitting crooked on Appa's head. Lean forward a little, then he steers more calmly.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.3: I've been flying him for a hundred years, Katara!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.4: You slept for a hundred years, Aang. That's not the same thing.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.5: See? I told you he'd come back! Nobody ever listens to Sokka Guh.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.6: Momo Guh pops up with a dried fish in his mouth. Sokka Guh's emergency fish.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.7: Hey! That was my emergency fish! For emergencies! That WAS an emergency!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.8: Zuka looked... tired. Almost sad. Did you see that too?
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.9: Everybody deserves a second chance. Even princes with a funny ponytail.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.10: The wall! Look how big that wall is! I could make a whole plan around that.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.1: I hate flying. There's no GROUND up here. I can't feel a thing, Sokka!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.2: That's why it's called flying, Toph.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.3: Everybody ready for the Fire Nation? We have to blend in with the crowd. Nothing silly.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.4: I'm just going to sit somewhere and pretend to be a rock. I'm really good at that.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.5: Honestly, I'm a little scared. But with you all here... a lot less.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.6: Plan for the disguise: I already made a moustache. Out of Appa fluff.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.7: Appa rumbles, very deep and very offended. Momo Guh tries to eat the moustache.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.8: Are we there yet? ...Are we there yet? I'm going to hug Appa's fur until we are.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.9: Whatever happens down there: we do it together. Deal?
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.10: Everybody puts a hand on Appa's fur. Even Toph. Appa rumbles, softly now.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.11: There it is. The crater. Stay close together, team.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.1: Appa likes this route. I can tell by his ears.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.2: You know what I'd do if I wasn't the Guhvatar? Air scooter. All day long.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.3: Look, a Crumb Jelly! Or a cloud. Or a jelly that wants to be a cloud.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.4: Are you comfy? There's a little blanket in the saddle basket if you're cold.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.5: It's so quiet up here. Not thinking about anything for a while. That's allowed too, you know.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.6: I drew a map on the way. It's upside down, but it IS pretty.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.7: Anyone hungry? I've got... no. I had. MOMO!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.8: If I ever get my own sky bison, I'll call him Appa Two. Or Bisonbert. Bisonbert is better.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.9: I can't feel the ground. I can't feel the ground. I can't feel the ground...
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.10: Tell me when we land. Then I'll pretend I enjoyed this again.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.11: Flying on Appa beats my old ship. At least nobody is shouting up here.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.12: Uncle would say the journey matters more than where you arrive. And then he would ask for tea.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.13: Momo Guh curls up in your hood and snores very softly.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.14: Momo Guh pinches a nibble from Sokka Guh's bag. Sokka Guh only notices much later.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.15: Appa's six legs move slowly with the wind, as if he is swimming through the air.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.16: Somewhere far away something is singing, low and long. The void is less empty than you think.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.team.zuidelijke_l: This is where I learned to fly. And to fall. Mostly to fall, nyeg.
Monk Guhatso always said: you can't float on an empty tummy. That's why he ate so much pie.
Aang shows me every corner. He laughs, but at the empty rooms his ears go very quiet.
A temple in the clouds... At home we only had snow. Lots and lots of snow.
I made a map of the temple. It's wrong, but it's very pretty.
Why are all the doors here round? Who builds round doors? ...Okay. They're quite handy.
A temple that floats. Great. A whole temple I can't feel a single bit of.
Tell me when we're back on real ground. I'll wait here. On a rock. Very still.
I once stood here with a ship full of plans. Now I stand here with a cup of tea. That feels better.
Aang wants to show me the airball tower. I have a feeling I'm going to lose.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.team.noordelijke_: Remember my first water whip? I hit Pakguh's moustache. By accident! ...Mostly by accident.
The ice here is so slippery. I've made Appa slip three times already. He didn't think it was funny.
This is where I learned I don't have to prove anything to people who won't look. Only to myself.
Grandma's necklace catches the moonlight so beautifully here. Then she feels very close.
Every evening I look at the moon for a bit. And the moon looks back, I think. That's normal, right?
Plan for today: fishing. Plan for tomorrow: more fishing. I'm getting better and better at plans.
Ice. It's like somebody put the ground in a glass of water. I feel everything... blurry.
They say it's beautiful here. I say: cold. We're both right.
I was here once in secret, wearing a blue mask. Nobody knows. ...Well, now you do. Shh.
The people here still look at me a bit sideways. Fair enough. I'm doing my best.
There's no nibble shortage here, they say. I checked. There IS a nibble shortage. In my tummy.
I still miss Appa every time I see these walls. Luckily he's back. I hug him twice as much.
This city keeps secrets in its walls. I still don't quite trust them.
Uncle Miroh's tea house smells of jasmine all the way to this square. It makes everything a bit softer.
I saw a whole cabbage stall get smashed here. Poor man. I came up with a plan for it: less cabbage.
The monorail! I want another go. And another. For research, obviously.
This isn't my city, but the stones know me. They say you stand well on your feet.
Want to see how the Blind Bandit moves a wall? ...Kidding. Or not. Mind your toes.
I poured tea for strangers here. It was the calmest thing I've ever done. Don't tell Uncle.
Uncle says a good cup of tea is never in a hurry. I'm learning. Slowly.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.team.vuurnatie_ho: I thought I'd be scared here. But the people... they're just people. With really tasty buns.
The turtle-ducklings in the palace pond already know me. I may have given them a bit too much bread.
We came here as strangers in disguise. Now the bakers say hello to us. Things can change.
You should see Zuka when nobody is watching. He feeds the ducklings. With a very small smile.
You know what I like best here? Everything. Except the extra hot fire flakes. My tongue is still mad at me.
I saw the play about us. In real life I was much funnier. Really.
The ground is warm here. I can live with that. Warm feet, happy Toph.
Everywhere I hear people whispering about the Guhvatar. You're famous, nyeg. Try not to sweat.
This was a home full of fear. I want it to become a home full of tea. Uncle is helping.
I walk here WITH you now instead of chasing you. The streets feel wider.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.komt: Behind you a steam whistle sounds. A grey ship with a red flag dives out of the clouds.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.zuka.h1_h2: GUHVATAR! You didn't really think I'd just let you go?! Fire!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.zuka.h2_h3: There you are again! Wherever you fly, I fly after you. That's a promise!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.team.h2_h3: Him again?! Does that guy really have no hobbies?
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.uitleg: Fireballs! Press a movement key and Appa dives aside: left, right, jump (up) or sneak (down).
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.weg: A sad little puff comes out of Zuka's smokestack. Coughing, the ship sinks away behind you. Nobody has so much as a scratch.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.score: Appa dodged %s of the %s fireballs. He snorts proudly.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.vuurbal: FIREBALL! Dive away: left, right, jump or sneak!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.geraakt: Boom! Appa gets pushed aside. He shakes out his fur: all fine, just a whiff of barbecue.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.ontweken: Appa dives away. The fireball hisses harmlessly past.
Have a seat, youngster. The rest of the pub has heard it a hundred times. And laughed a hundred times.
Sixty years ago I sailed a grease ship through the void. I was looking for the White Nibble (don't ask). In the middle of the night I heard something singing. Low. So low my nibbles trembled.
Then I saw him. A whale as big as an island, with little stars on his skin and ears like saucers. He looked at me. And then he was gone.
I never saw him again. They say he only shows himself to those who believe in him. And I... maybe I lost a bit of my believing.
So. Will you laugh along with the rest? Or do you believe an old captain?
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.ongelovi: Hm. You too. Come back if you ever want to believe. I'll be sitting here anyway, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.geloof: You believe me? Really? ...Then you have to see him. Fly to x %s, z %s, far beyond the harbor, above the void. Wait there. Quietly. He comes when you listen.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.wacht: Fly to x %s, z %s, above the void, and wait there very quietly. Don't get impatient: whales don't wear watches.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.bewijs: You saw him?! My ears are tingling! But the pub will only believe it with proof. Feed him a Nibble Chorus Fruit: he thanks you with a Void Pearl. Bring it to me.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.temmen: He's still swimming around, isn't he? Feed him often and he'll start to trust you. %s of %s. Then he'll be yours.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.klaar.1: My horn, on your whale. A story can't go on any better than that, youngster.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.klaar.2: Say hi to him from me when you see him. Tell him: the old captain is laughing again.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.klaar.3: I sit here every evening with a glass of nibble juice. And at least now they listen, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.hoorn: The captain presses his old horn into your hands. 'Sixty years I blew on it and nobody ever came. Feed him often and he'll be yours. And then he comes when YOU blow.'
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kroegbaas.spot.1: Did Grandpa Whale get you onto his bench again? Sixty years, the same story. He's sweet, really. But a whale? Come on.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kroegbaas.spot.2: What'll it be? Nibble juice? And if you ask about that whale, you get a free laugh with it.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kroegbaas.twijfel: You say you saw him? ...Without proof it's just a second tall tale, buddy.
A whale as big as an island. Of course. And I'm the Guh King. Bring proof, then I'll believe it.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kroegbaas.spijt.1: For sixty years I laughed at him. Now he gets free nibble juice every evening. The least I can do.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kroegbaas.spijt.2: Sometimes at night I hear something singing, out in the void. Then I smile. So does the captain.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.eigen: A Void Whale Guh of your own
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.van_ander: This whale already swims with somebody else. Find a free one, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.vertrouwen: The whale sings a soft thank-you. He trusts you a little bit more: %s of %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.getemd: The whale sings a new song. Just for you. This is YOUR whale now!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.uitleg: Blow the horn and he comes. Stand on his back with the horn in your hand and he swims where you look (look up or down: he climbs or sinks). Sneak + blow: furnish his back.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.kist_niet: This chest belongs to the boss of this whale. The whale winks, but won't let you in.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.tuin_niet: This little garden belongs to the boss of this whale. Looking is allowed.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.tuin: You pick two Nibble Chorus Fruits from the whale garden. Your whale is already smacking his lips.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.tuin_morge: The little garden is resting. Something new will grow tomorrow, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.dutje: You take a nap on the soft whale back. His song rocks you. You feel completely rested.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.wakker: You're still completely rested. Another nap later.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.huisje: You peek into the little house: a hammock, a teapot and a map with all your travels on it. It smells of nibbles.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.uitleg: In harbor pub The Chonky Whale an old captain guh has been telling of a whale that sings for sixty years. Everybody laughs at him. Only those who believe get to see it.

gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.nu.klaar: You have your own whale! Blow the horn and he comes.

scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.stil: It is dead quiet in the void. No wind. No birds. Only you, and your own breathing.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.lied: Then you hear it. Low, very far away... and yet everywhere at once.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.omhoog: Out of the depths beneath you something rises. Something big. Something very, VERY big.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.oogjes: Two enormous guh eyes look at you. Two round ears flap. And he sings. For you.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.gelijk: The old captain was right. All those years. The Great Singing One really exists.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.gelooft: And now he knows that you believe in him. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.sp: Look who's here! Come to hear a tall tale from Grandpa Whale too?
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.la: Hahaha! The Great Singing One! Tell us again about that time he...
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.pa: You lay the Void Pearl on the lectern. It glows, soft and purple. The whole pub falls silent.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.fl: That... that's a Void Pearl. You only get those from a...
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.ze: Sixty years I told it. Sixty years you all laughed. But this one here... this one believed me.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.so: Captain... I'm sorry. Really. The next round is on the house. For everyone!
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.ji: And to you, youngster. Come and sit with me in a bit. I've got something for you.

Thank you, nyeg!

quest.guhs.einde2_trap5_machines.werktui: Not finished yet, nyeg! Come back once you have brought the whole world back into balance. That takes a while, I know.
Ah! My workshop! Don't look at the mess, look at the possibilities. Mind those cogs, they bite.
For a hundred years I made things halfway. A wing without feathers, a stove without fire. I was waiting for someone to finish them.
Here, my Blueprint. Put it in every recipe of my machines: it just stays where it is. Every project leaves something working in YOUR world.
The Blueprint stays in the crafting grid. Lost it? Sneak-click the Mechanist Guh for a new one.
Project one: power through the air. A Chonk Transmitter sends the chonk power of its net to receivers nearby.
Put a Chonk Transmitter on your net and a Chonk Receiver within 32 blocks, with a machine on it. Short anywhere? Then everything stands still, as always.
Have a look at practice setup 1 in the workshop too.
Project two: your bank, everywhere. A Guh Terminal is a little window into your Bank Guh. No tablet, nyeg: a block.
Click your Bank Guh with the Bank Key and then the terminal. Give it chonk power, click it, and look: your bank!
A terminal also works in another dimension than your bank.
Project three: the Order Guh. He works at an Order Counter next to your Tinker Machines, in an apron. A sweet apron.
Link the counter to your bank. Order at the counter or with the Order button of your terminal: he takes everything out of the bank and runs the machines.
He makes intermediate products too, when there is a machine for them.
Project four: mail through the gate. A Nibble Gate Tube has a teeny Nibble Gate. It took me six years. It was mostly the ears.
Sneak-click one tube, sneak-click the other, and they're buddies. Put something in: it comes out at the other one, even in another dimension.
Both sides must be loaded and have chonk power.
Project five: home in one step. A Home Gate is yours alone, unless you let someone in. Put down as many as you like.
It charges with what your net has left over. The more gates you have, the more a jump costs. Your guhs on a lead jump along!
Hold an item, open the gate and click Icon: that becomes its icon.
Project six: the four elements, in machines. Air, water, earth, fire. I once built them for the war. Now they do something sweet.
An Air Blower, a Water Bearer, a Crust Pusher and a Fire Basket. Let each of them do its thing once in your world.
An Air Blower placed while you look down becomes a little lift.
Project seven: new sources. An Enderguh Wheel: a giant wheel in which a Wahoog Enderguh flies around. 50 chonk power!
And the shard of the nibble comet still lies by the duel square in the Fire Nation Capital. Pick it up and put it in your net. It's still glowing.
The shard lies there only for you. Step on it to take it.
Here, I'll make the first one for you. The rest you tinker yourself, with my Blueprint.
All finished? Really all of it? Come on, come on, tell me!
You did it. Everything works. Nothing is half done. I need to sit down for a moment.
I used to build balloons that rained fire. I thought I would never make anything good again.
Here: a diploma. I finished it completely. My first finished thing in a hundred years. And an extra Home Gate, for the road.
Next to the workshop there is a building site. The Mechanist Guh has one more big plan...
A machine with a sleeping snout has no chonk power. A surprised snout is full. A happy snout: all good!
A Chonk Receiver gives exactly what its net is short of. No more, no less. Tidy, nyeg.
The Comet Core is the strongest source so far. So far! I still have plans. Always.
My wooden fingers? Oh well. An experiment with a steam merry-go-round. It is still turning, somewhere.
You know what I love most about inventing? That something that didn't exist suddenly helps someone.
scene.guhs.einde2_trap5_machines_werkpla: Who's knocking on my door so chonkily? ...By all my cogs. The Guhvatar himself!
For a hundred years I tinkered with this door. It wasn't finished yet, nyeg. Today it is.
I used to build war balloons for the Fire Nation. I'm not proud of that. Really not.
Now that there is peace again, I want to make things nobody is afraid of. Come in! My ears are tingling already.

gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.plan1: You know what I used to do? Draw balloons. Beautiful balloons, for the Fire Nation.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.plan2: They turned them into war balloons. Ever since, my little ears droop a bit whenever I see a balloon.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.plan3: But now there's a factory in your world that never gets tired. So together we'll build a balloon that drops nothing but nibbles. A Peace Balloon!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.plan4: Five stages: cloth, basket, burner, nibble supply and decorations. Your factory delivers, I sew and screw. Bring everything to this board. In portions is fine, I count it all. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.fase1: The cloth! Soft, strong and a little cheese-yellow. I hung it on the crane right away.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.fase2: A basket of real wood, with box shell in the bottom. It never breaks, not even when a chonky guh jumps in.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.fase3: The burner is in! It runs on chonk power from your very own factory. No coal, no smoke. And look: it has a little snoot. It's happy.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.fase4: Bags full of nibbles. I only tasted three. Or five. For quality control, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.fase5: Ears on, little flags up, a snoot on the cloth... EUREKA! It's done!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.klaar: It's done. The burner purrs, the ropes are tight, the bags are full. Dare to come up into the sky with me?
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.wachten: No rush. A balloon likes to wait for a lovely moment.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.af1: Did you see them? Nibbles everywhere, happy little ears everywhere. That's how a balloon should be.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.af2: Here, a statuette for your shelf. And your own little hot air balloon, to float around calmly. You're a real Peacebringer now.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.zakje: The Peace Balloon is back from its round. There was still a little bag of nibbles in the basket. For you!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.morgen: You already have today's little bag. Tomorrow it'll scatter again, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.kwijt_ni: No worries, I had a spare. The old one has sprung a leak, it won't float anywhere anymore.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.kwijt_no: You don't have a little balloon from me yet. The Peace Balloon first!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.wijs_beg: My workshop is finished, but I have one more plan. A big plan! Come along to the board on the building site.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.wijs_fas: How is the balloon doing? We are at stage %1$s, %2$s. Just bring it to the board on the building site, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.wijs_kla: It's finished! It is waiting for you at the board on the building site. Click it and up we go.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.tip0: A tip: a Tinker Machine with a Blueprint of tent canvas sews faster than I do.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.tip1: Box shell? Give a Hidey Guh a cheese nibble and it pushes one out. One a day, per Hidey Guh.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.tip2: You make Light Rods from popped nibblechoir fruits and a guh crystal. Flash Crumbs drop from Ender Mikas.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.hint.bord: Bring everything to the board on the building site. In portions is fine.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.titel: New title: %s! Pick it in your Guhdex.
block.guhs.vredesballon.lore: The Peace Balloon, only small. Click it and it scatters a crumb.
item.guhs.vredesballon.lore: The Peace Balloon, only small. Click it and it scatters a crumb.
block.guhs.vredesballon.klik: Pff! A tiny crumb of nibble floats out of the little basket.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vredesbrenger: Build something with the Mechanist Guh that drops nothing but nibbles.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.uitleg: The Mechanist Guh's big project: an enormous balloon that scatters nibbles over the Guh End. Your factory delivers, he sews and screws. Everyone builds their own balloon.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.0: Click the board on the building site behind the Mechanist Guh's workshop.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.0: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.1: Bring 128 tent canvas (any color) and 64 Guh Wire to the board on the building site.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.1: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.2: Bring 256 logs and 16 box shells to the board on the building site.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.2: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.3: Bring 2 Fire Baskets, 1 Chonk Receiver, 96 grill coal and 16 crystal cheese to the board on the building site.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.3: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.4: Bring 512 cheese nibbles and 128 fried cheese nibbles to the board on the building site.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.4: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.5: Bring 64 light rods and 32 flash crumbs to the board on the building site.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.5: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.6: The Peace Balloon is done. Click the board and take off!
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.6: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.klaar: The Peace Balloon is floating. Come back to the board every day for a little bag of nibbles.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.klaa: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.kort.0: To the board on the building site
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.kort.6: Let the Peace Balloon take off!
scene.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon_vredesbal: Ropes loose? Little ears inside the basket? Then off we go. Burner on!
The burner purrs on chonk power. The cloth billows, and on top two big ears slowly stand up straight.
I used to draw balloons for war. And look at that. This one flies just for the fun of it.
Above the Southern Air Temple, the hatches of the nibble bags swing open...
Twelve! No, thirteen! Momo, that one was mine!
I can't see a thing, but I can feel crumbs everywhere. Best rain ever.
A balloon without a single cannon. Uncle would put the kettle on right away.
You know what the best thing about a balloon is? There's always one more place further on to float to.
And so the Peace Balloon drifted over the Guh End. Wherever it went, it rained nibbles. Nyeg.
advancements.guhs.guheinde.einde2_trap5_: Launch the Peace Balloon over the Guh End together with the Mechanist Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.uitleg: Deep under the islands of the Guh End lies Bikini Bottom, a little town under a giant soap bubble. The Krusty Nibble is looking for a new colleague, and Spongeguh Cheesepants can't wait to teach you everything. What could possibly go wrong, nyeg?
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.0: A soap bubble with a letter inside is floating your way, somewhere in the Guh End (it finds you, no need to search). Click it to pop it.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.0: Anywhere in the Guh End (the bubble finds you)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.1: Blow your Appa Whistle and pick Bikini Bottom in his list, or follow the Super Compass (the end tab). Land on the little island on top of the big soap bubble, deep between the outer islands.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.1: The little island on top of the soap bubble of Bikini Bottom, deep between the outer islands
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.2: On the little island, step into the bubble stream: the glittering column in the tube in the middle, its entrance is on the south side. It sets you down gently on the square of Bikini Bottom.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.2: The bubble stream in the middle of the little island, down to the square
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.3: Walk east from the square along Main Street to The Krusty Nibble (the building with the round roof). Go inside, through the door at the back on the right into the office, and click Mr. Krabguh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.3: Mr. Krabguh's office, at the back of The Krusty Nibble (east of the square)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.4: In the kitchen of The Krusty Nibble, stand behind the grill (the door all the way left in the back wall). Click the crates in the order on the ticket above the grill. Five orders and you are a real nibble cook.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.4: The grill in the kitchen of The Krusty Nibble
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.5: Mr. Krabguh wants jelly jam on the Nibble Patties, and Patguh knows everything about jellies. Walk south from The Krusty Nibble to Conch Street: Patguh is asleep in front of his big brown crumb rock (column of light).
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.5: Patguh's crumb rock on Conch Street, in the south of town
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.6: Spongeguh is taking his boating exam, and you are his driving buddy. Walk to Mrs. Puffguh at the start line of the Boating School, on the west side of town next to the pylon course (column of light).
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.6: Mrs. Puffguh at the Boating School, in the west of town
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.7: The alarm bell of The Krusty Nibble is ringing! Run to Mr. Krabguh: his office is at the back of the restaurant, the door at the back right behind the till. Something terrible has happened to his safe.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.7: Mr. Krabguh's office, at the back of The Krusty Nibble (on Main Street, east of the square)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.8: Plankmika has stolen the secret recipe! Cross the street to The Grease Bucket, the big grey bucket opposite The Krusty Nibble. At the back, in the lab, the recipe lies in a little safe. Stay out of Karen's cameras (the yellow patches on the floor) and only walk through a red laser when it is off.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.8: The Grease Bucket: the big grey bucket opposite The Krusty Nibble
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.9: You have the recipe! Bring it to Mr. Krabguh, in his office at the back of The Krusty Nibble, across the street.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.9: Mr. Krabguh, in his office at the back of The Krusty Nibble
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.10: Tonight there is a party in the Bubble Bowl, the big round stadium in the north of town (follow Bubble Lane from the square). Squidmika has to perform and you are his drummer! Climb onto the stage by the little steps at the side and stand behind the drum.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.1: The stage of the Bubble Bowl, the stadium in the north (up Bubble Lane)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.kla: The secret recipe is back and Squidmika is (for one evening) a star! Mr. Krabguh will have big news soon...
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.4_b: Start baking! Look at the ticket above the grill (the arrow points at the part that goes on now) and click that crate. Wrong? Flop, and just do that order again.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.4: The grill in the kitchen of The Krusty Nibble
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.5_b: Catch eight crumb jellies with Patguh's net: tap a jelly (left or right click). The Jelly Field is at the west end of Conch Street; Patguh waits at its edge.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.5: The Jelly Field at the west end of Conch Street
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.6_b: Click the practice boat at the start line and sail one lap: follow the lights, over the little bridge and back to the finish. Bump into things eight times at most. Spongeguh screams enough for two.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.6: The start line of the pylon course, in the west of town
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.8_b: You have the recipe! Plankmika thinks you are a customer and is coming with the menu. Run back outside the way you came: through the corridor and the empty bucket to the street.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.8: The front door of The Grease Bucket, on the street
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.10_: Hit the drum when a bubble pops on it: click exactly when the ring of bubbles touches the drum. Ten of the sixteen is enough, and missing costs nothing: Squidmika simply counts in again.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.1: Behind your drum on the stage of the Bubble Bowl
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.kort.4: Follow the ticket above the grill
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.kort.5: Catch 8 crumb jellies (west end of Conch Street)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.uitleg: Mr. Krabguh is opening a second restaurant and needs a manager. Spongeguh is sure it will be him. But then King Neptuguh's crown disappears, and Mr. Krabguh gets the blame. You, Spongeguh and Patguh are going to bring it back: all the way to Shell City. In the Patty Wagon. What could possibly go wrong, nyeg?
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.0: Mr. Krabguh has big news for everybody. Walk into The Krusty Nibble: the big restaurant on Main Street, east of Bubble Square.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.0: The Krusty Nibble, on Main Street east of the square
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.1: Spongeguh is sad: he won't be manager. Patguh knows what to do: ice cream! Go to the Guhfy Guhber ice cream parlour (the sundae on its roof), on Main Street west of the square, and sit down on your stool at the bar.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.1: Your stool at the bar of the Guhfy Guhber, west of the square
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.2: A horn blares across town: King Neptuguh is on Bubble Square, and he is furious. Run to his throne on the square, next to the lift.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.2: King Neptuguh's throne on Bubble Square
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.3: Krabguh is frozen and the crown is in Shell City. Spongeguh and Patguh are waiting by the Patty Wagon in front of The Krusty Nibble. Get in (click the car): you drive.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.3: The Patty Wagon in front of The Krusty Nibble
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.4: A tough Mika took the key of the Patty Wagon and is now asleep at his table. Go into The Thug Tug (the rusty tugboat by the road) and take the little key back without anybody seeing you move.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.4: The sleeping Mika's little key in The Thug Tug
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.5: The Patty Wagon can't cross the Trench. Walk with Spongeguh and Patguh along the road to the east, up the hill, until the road ends at a deep, dark gorge. Someone is waiting for you at the rim.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.5: The west rim of the Trench, east of The Thug Tug
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.6: Go down the zigzag path along the west wall to the dark bottom. That's where the monsters live... With a moustache you're scared of nothing. Right?
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.6: The zigzag path down, on the west wall of the Trench
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.7: At the top of the east rim of the Trench, step onto the road. There's an engine coming...
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.7: The east rim of the Trench, where the road to Shell City begins
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.8: That enormous boot... The crown must be in the Cyclops' souvenir shop: the big building with the giant scallop on its roof, on the north side of the square of Shell City. Go inside.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.8: The souvenir shop (giant scallop on the roof), north of the square of Shell City
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.9: Bring the crown home! Walk out of the gift shop, across the square to the beach, and onto the long pier that runs east into the void. Princess Mindy Guh is waiting at the head of the pier.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.9: The head of Shell City's pier, east of the beach
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.10: Bikini Bottom is wearing Plankmika's bucket helmets! Walk through the town gate onto the High Street and use your bubble blaster (right-click) to blow the buckets off the six Bikini Bottom guhs under the golden columns of light. Then on to the Bubble Bowl in the north.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.10: The High Street and Bubble Lane, behind the town gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.11: Plankmika is standing on the stage of the Bubble Bowl, about to crown himself. Climb onto the stage by the little steps at the front left or right: time for the loudest song Bikini Bottom has ever heard.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.11: The stage of the Bubble Bowl, at the end of Bubble Lane
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.klaa: The crown is back, Mr. Krabguh has thawed and Spongeguh is manager. And Spongeguh and Gary sort of live with you now. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.3_b: Drive out of the town gate to the east and follow the road to The Thug Tug, the rusty tugboat. Stay on the road: the Patty Wagon stops by itself at an edge. Park in the middle bay.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.3_: The parking bays of The Thug Tug, on the road to Shell City
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.4_b: Sneak to the sleeping Mika's little key. Does the barman's glass tinkle? Stand still: while the Mikas look, you may not move.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.4_: The sleeping Mika's little key in The Thug Tug
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.6_b: The monsters sang you on your way. Cross the bottom and climb the path up along the east wall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.6_: The path up on the east wall of the Trench
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.7_b: Run! Dennis Mika is after you. Follow the road down the hill to the east, through the gate of Shell City.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.7_: The gate of Shell City, east along the road
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.8_b: Under the drying lamp! Tilt the drying table with WASD and roll Patguh's tear along the wet trail to the socket on the wall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.8_: The drying table at the back of the souvenir shop
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.10_b: Everyone is free! Walk your whole parade up Bubble Lane to the north, into the Bubble Bowl: the big oval stadium.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.10: The Bubble Bowl, the stadium in the north of Bikini Bottom
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.0: To The Krusty Nibble (east of the square)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.1: Ice cream at the Guhfy Guhber (west of the square)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.2: To the throne on the square!
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.4: Get the little key in The Thug Tug
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.5: Walk to the rim of the Trench
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.6_: Climb up on the east side
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.7: Up onto the east rim of the Trench
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.8_: Roll the tear to the socket
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.9: To the head of the pier
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_verhaal.poort.balk: Pink bubbles hold you back. Finish the Guhvatar story first, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_verhaal.poort.1: <Spongeguh> (muffled, through the bubbles) Hellooo out there! Sorry, we're still closed! Come back when you've saved the world, then we'll bake patties together!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_verhaal.poort.2: Bikini Bottom and Shell City open for you as soon as you have finished the Guhvatar story (The Legend of Guh).
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_verhaal.poort.3: Not started yet, or a bit lost? The glowing cheese ball by the Nibble Mountain takes you to your story. After that you can come here as often as you like, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_verhaal.standin.klaar: [stand-in] %s: done (this step is still being built).
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_cast.praatje.kroeg_ba: What'll it be? Jelly juice, jelly juice or... jelly juice.
I've been polishing this mug since Tuesday. It just won't get clean, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_cast.praatje.kroeg_ui: Only real tough types get in. You are... small. Fine, come on in.
I'm the bouncer. I bounce people out. Very gently, mind you.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_cast.praatje.stoere_m: I'm so tough I drink my jelly juice without a straw.
See this tattoo? An anchor. I've never been on a boat.
The eye patch? Just for style. I can see fine, nyeg.
I once petted a sea urchin. With my bare paw. Yep. Tough, huh.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_cast.praatje.slapende: Zzzz... five more minutes, mum... zzzz...
Mmmh... don't touch my little key... zzzz...
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.hint.brief: A soap bubble with a letter is floating your way, somewhere in the Guh End. Click it when you see it!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.hint.reis: Off to Bikini Bottom (%s)! Blow your Appa Whistle and pick Bikini Bottom in his list, or follow the Super Compass (the end tab). Land on the little island on top of the big soap bubble.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.hint.bubbel: Step into the bubble stream: the glittering column in the tube in the middle of the little island (%s). The entrance is on the south side. It sets you down gently on the square of Bikini Bottom.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.hint.knabbel: Walk along Main Street to The Krusty Nibble (%s): the building with the round roof. Go inside, through the door at the back on the right into the office, and click Mr. Krabguh.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.hint.grill: Leave the office and take the door all the way left in the back wall of the restaurant: the kitchen. Stand behind the grill (%s), in the light beam. Spongeguh is waiting for you.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.brief.komt: A soap bubble is floating your way... with a letter inside!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.brief.meldin: A glittering soap bubble with a letter inside floats up to you. Click it to pop it.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.brief.weg: The bubble letter drifts off for a bit... it'll be back soon, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.sollicitatie: Click Mr. Krabguh (right-click) for your job interview
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.beloning.pet: You got the Krusty Nibble Cap! Clothes for your guhs, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.regel: Click the crates in the order on the ticket
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.bel: Ding! Order %1$s of %2$s: look at the ticket above the grill
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.klant: Table 1: a hungry Bikini Bottom guh
Table 2: a guh with a hat (extra cheese, please)
Table 3: a guh who wants "something green"
Table 1: a guh who likes it sour
Patguh, through the window: DOUBLE! Double double!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.plof: Flop! That wasn't on the ticket. No harm done: this order again.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.plof_: Tip: the arrow on the ticket points at the part that goes on now. You never lose anything.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.gesto: Baking stopped. Go back behind the grill to bake on (your orders still count).
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.naar_: Stand behind the grill, in the light beam
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.verde: You had %1$s of the %2$s orders done already. Bake on!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.tijd: Your time: %1$s (your best: %2$s). Just for fun: there was no hurry.
Your time: %1$s. That's your best time so far!
gui.guhs.kledingbron.einde2_sp_d1_start: Spongeguh story: your job interview at The Krusty Nibble
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.s: Mr. Krabguh is in his office, at the back on the right! Don't knock though, that costs a nibble.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.p: Working? I worked once too. It was terrible. I lay awake for a quarter of an hour.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.g: Nyeg. (Gary looks at you as if he already knows everything.)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.m: A customer! Or... no? Here for the job? Then you're late! No, wait, you're right on time!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.p: Daddy is always looking for staff. He pays in nibbles. Very small nibbles.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.o: No, I'm not the boss. Yes, I am unhappy. The office is at the back.
Squilliam, charmed. Rich, handsome, and I play the clarinet better than Squidmika. Do tell him.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.p: The secret recipe... one day it will be MINE! Mwahahaha. Ahem. Good afternoon, new citizen.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.j: Someone new in town? Can you drive a boat? No? Thank goodness, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.s: Howdy! I'm Sandy Guh. I live here in an air dome. Long story. Very long story.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.b: Welcome to Bikini Bottom! The mist is purple, but very healthy.
Have you tried the Nibble Patty yet? I eat three a day. Or five. Who's counting?
Watch out for Plankmika, the little one. He always wants the secret recipe, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.bakken: Look at the ticket above the grill! The arrow points at what goes on now. Bun first!
Is it jellyfishing time yet? No? ...And now?
Bake! Every second you chat costs me a nibble!
Daddy says you bake really fast. Well, he said: not too slow.
I hear the bell. I ignore the bell. That's how it works here.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_sp_d1_star: Ah, Bikini Bottom. Deep below the outer islands of the Guh End lies a dish of cheese rind, under a soap bubble as big as a mountain.
There live Spongeguh Cheesepants, his very best friend Patguh Star and Gary the snail, who only ever says "nyeg". But with feeling.
And there stands The Krusty Nibble, where Mr. Krabguh sells the tastiest burger of the Guh End. The recipe? Secret, of course.
Today someone starts a new job there. Guess who, mon ami.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_brief.plop: Pop! The soap bubble bursts. A little letter flutters out, still a bit wet from the soap.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_brief.vaca: Hello, hello, HELLO! This is Spongeguh Cheesepants, with a JOB OPENING! The Krusty Nibble in Bikini Bottom is looking for a new nibble cook!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_brief.eise: What you need: two hands, two little ears and a heart full of nibbles. Guhvatars welcome too! I've already laid out an apron for you. Nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_brief.biki: Ah, Bikini Bottom... A little town deep below the outer islands, under a soap bubble as big as a mountain. They bake the tastiest burger of the whole Guh End there. Allez, off you go!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_aankomst.e: Ah, there it is: a little island on top of an enormous soap bubble. And what lies underneath? Have a look, mon ami.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_aankomst.s: Bikini Bottom! Purple mist for sea water, flower clouds for lamps and a floor of crispy cheese rind. Everyone knows everyone. And almost everyone is sweet.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_aankomst.k: And there, with the round roof: The Krusty Nibble, Mr. Krabguh's restaurant. They are looking for a nibble cook... and that's you.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_aankomst.b: That glittering column in the middle of the island is the bubble stream. Step in and it sets you down gently on the square. No lift in the world is this soft, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_welkom.hal: HELLO! Is it you? It's you! It's really you! The new nibble cook!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_welkom.ik_: I'm Spongeguh Cheesepants! Square, full of holes, and Employee of the Week nine hundred weeks in a row!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_welkom.ger: That's Gary, my snail. He says you look very capable. And that he's hungry. He always says that.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_welkom.pat: Hi! I'm Patguh. I live under a rock. I have a job too, you know: I lie down. Very well, even.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_welkom.mee: Come on, come on! Mr. Krabguh is waiting in The Krusty Nibble, just east of here on Main Street! He loves new staff. And money. Mostly money.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_sollicitat: Eight hundred ninety-eight... eight hundred ninety-nine... NINE HUNDRED nibbles! Come to papa, my shiny little darlings.
Huh?! Who's there? A customer? No... a JOB SEEKER! Sit down. No, stand. Sitting costs extra.
First question: do you know what a nibble is? Exactly: money! Second question: do you like working very hard for very, very few nibbles?
You nod. You don't quite know why yourself.
HIRED! Here's your Krusty Nibble Cap. The cap comes out of your first paycheck. Just kidding! ...Half kidding.
Sigh. Another cheerful one. Just what this place needed: more cheer.
Spongeguh is in the kitchen, at the back on the left. He'll teach you the trade. Off to the grill! The customers are hungry and their nibbles are burning a hole in their pockets!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_bakken_uit: Welcome to the kitchen! And this... is the grill. Say hi to the grill. He's my best friend. After Patguh. And Gary.
A customer rings at a table, and then a ticket floats above the grill. It shows the burger, from the bottom up. The arrow points at what goes on now.
Around the grill stand five crates: bun, patty, cheese, sea lettuce and pickle. Click a crate and that part goes on the burger. Exactly in the order on the ticket!
Something wrong on it? Flop, the burger falls flat. No harm done, just start over! There's no hurry, only love. Five orders and you're a real nibble cook.
I'm so proud. I need to cry for a moment. No, later. Baking first!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_bakken_kla: FIVE! Five perfect Nibble Patties! You're a natural! A nibble prodigy! A... I've run out of words!
Sigh. Wonderful. Now there are two of them.
Hey! Hey! Are you done baking? I've got nets! Come JELLYFISHING! I'll wait at my rock! Come on, come on, come on!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_kijk_bubbe: The bubble stream: step in, the entrance is on the south side.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_kijk_knabb: The Krusty Nibble, on Main Street.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.hint.patguh: Walk to Patguh: he is asleep in front of his big crumb rock on Conch Street, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.hint.kwallen: To the Jelly Fields at the west end of Conch Street, %s. Tap eight crumb jellies with your net!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.hint.pufguh: Walk to Mrs. Puffguh at the start line of the Boating School, on the west side of town, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.hint.boot: Click the practice boat at the start line, %s, and sail the course.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.kwallen.regel: Tap a jelly with your net (left or right click). Catch %s!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.kwallen.pauze: Your jar is at %s/%s. Come back to the Jelly Field to catch more.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.kwallen.niet_: Patguh only catches jellies in the Jelly Field next to him, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.kwallen.al: That one was in your jar already and slipped out again. Try another one!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.kwallen.belon: You get three jars of jelly jam and Patguh's Flower Trunks (for your guh)!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.regel: Follow the lights. Bump %s times at most!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.instap: Click the practice boat to get in (again).
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.start_: Seatbelts on! Oh wait, there are no seatbelts. Hold hands then!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.gil.2: My little ears! My little ears saw my life flash by!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.gil.3: That was a pylon! Or a post! Or my whole future!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.gil.4: Everything's fine! Everything's fine! EVERYTHING'S FINE!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.gil.5: I can see my nibble-fruit house already! Is that heaven?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.opnieu: No worries: the boat is back at the start.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.zucht: Pffff... One more time then. I'll puff myself up a little in advance.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.klik.patguh_v: Tap them with your net! %s more and the jar is full. I'm counting along. On my fingers. I don't have that many.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.klik.sponsguh: Jellyfishing with Patguh? That's the most fun thing there is! After baking Nibble Patties. And after blowing bubbles.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.klik.pufguh_b: The practice boat is at the start line. Follow the lights, and when Spongeguh screams: just keep sailing.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.klik.sponsguh: I'm ready! Get in, driving buddy!
My exam! Mrs. Puffguh is waiting at the Boating School. I'm coming. My knees aren't yet, but the rest of me is.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.klik.patguh_e: Spongeguh is taking his exam again. I'd go and watch, but then I'd have to get up.
item.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kwallennet.l: A gift from Patguh. Tap gently, then floop!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.intr: Ah, Patguh Star. He ran to his rock to wait for you. But waiting is so tiring... He likes to sleep. And when he is done sleeping... he sleeps one more time. Magnifique.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.snur: Zzzz... five more minutes... zzzz... five more jellies...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.wakk: Huh?! Is it tomorrow already? Oh no, it's still today. Phew, I was just getting used to it.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.jam: Hey, there you are! I was just resting my eyes. Mr. Krabguh wants jelly jam on the Nibble Patties. And I know everything about jellies. Almost everything. I know they're called jellies.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.net: Here, a net for you! Just tap them gently, then floop, it's in the jar. Eight jellies and the jar is full.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.veld: The Jelly Fields are at the end of the street, to the west. Last one there is a rotten jelly! Nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_knipoog_roo: Bloop. Bloop. I am a jelly. Bloop.
GOTCHA! Look! This is the biggest jelly I have ever caught!
Hey! He's taking my net! ...Oh well. He needs it more.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kwallen_kla: And so, with eight jellies in a jar, a hero was born. A sticky hero, nyeg.
EIGHT! The jar is full! Mr. Krabguh is going to dance with joy. Or count money. Usually count money.
Here, three jars of jam for you. And my spare trunks with little flowers! They'll look lovely on you. On me too, by the way.
Oh right! Spongeguh is taking his boating exam today. Again. He's already shaking at the Boating School in the west. Will you go and help him? I'd go myself, but I still have to rest from resting.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.onde: Meanwhile, at the Boating School... Mrs. Puffguh has seen a great many exams. Too many, say her nerves.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.numm: Spongeguh Cheesepants. Exam number... thirty-eight. I wrote a little song about it. It is very short and it ends with screaming.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.klaa: This time it's going to work, miss! I've practised! In my head! And look: I brought a driving buddy!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.maat: A driving buddy? ...Fine. You steer, Spongeguh sits beside you. Then his hands are free for screaming.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.rege: One lap of the course: follow the lights, over the little bridge and back to the finish. You may bump into things eight times at most. Easy does it, nyeg?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.pani: I'm ready! ...Am I ready? I'm... a teeny bit ready. My little ears are trembling.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.boot: The practice boat is at the start line, a little way to the north. Get in, and above all: breathe.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_knipoog_guh: You shall not... pass... without a licence!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_examen_klaa: A pass? A PASS! Miss, I've got my licence! I'm going to frame it! And then frame the frame!
For now, Spongeguh. For. Now. You may only sail with your driving buddy beside you. It says so on it, in very big letters.
Did you hear that? We're a team! The best boat team in all of Bikini Bottom!
But far away, at The Krusty Nibble, a bell rang. Not just any bell. The bell that must never ring...
Mr. Krabguh's alarm bell! That means something bad. Or something very bad! Quick, back to The Krusty Nibble!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kijk_patguh: Patguh lives under the big crumb rock on Conch Street. He is asleep in front of it.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kijk_kwalle: At the west end of Conch Street the crumb jellies float. Patguh waits at the edge.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kijk_pufguh: Mrs. Puffguh waits at the start line of her pylon course, on the west side of town.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kijk_boot.t: The practice boat is ready at the start line. Click it to get in; Spongeguh hops in too.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.hint.7: The alarm bell! Mr. Krabguh is calling you: his office is at the back of The Krusty Nibble, %s. Walk in, past the till, the door at the back.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.hint.8: The Grease Bucket is the big grey bucket across the street, %s. Spongeguh keeps watch at the door.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.hint.9: Bring the recipe to Mr. Krabguh: his office at the back of The Krusty Nibble, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.hint.10: To the Bubble Bowl, the round stadium in the north, %s. Your drum is on the stage; the little steps are at the side.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.onder: Yellow = Karen is looking. Red = laser. Crouch = quieter.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.rustp: Rest point %s of %s: you start here again if Karen sees you.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.bijna: Karen almost sees you%s Out of the yellow patch!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.stand: Sneaking: rest point %s of %s  ·  Karen saw you %s times
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.weg.onder: Plankmika is coming with the menu: run outside!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.trommel.ond: Click the drum when the bubble pops: %s of the %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.trommel.bij: %s of the %s. Squidmika counts in again...
