gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.trommel.weg: The band is waiting for you: stand behind your drum again.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.beloni: The secret Nibble Patty recipe: from now on the grill bakes for you
Eight Nibble Patties, fresh off the grill
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.reg: Sneaking: stay out of the yellow patches on the floor (a camera of Karen's is looking there) and only walk through a red laser when it is off. Crouching makes you quieter: then a camera only sees you up close. Seen? Then you simply stand at the last rest point again.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.tro: (Nothing wrong: you are back at the last rest point. Watch how the camera swings to and fro, and go when it looks the other way.)
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.gez: Bleep. I see something moving, honey. Oh, it's the draught. Back to your spot.
Bleep. An intruder? Oh no, just a block of cheese with ears. Off you go, back.
Bleep-bleep. I saw you. I won't tell Plankmika. This time.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.las: Bleep! Laser touched. That tickles, doesn't it? Back to square one, honey.
Bleep! Red means: wait a moment. Try again.
Bleep! My lovely laser. It was just polished.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.plankmika: Sir! Madam! Wait a moment! I have a menu!
Grease balls of the day! Buy two, pay for two!
Karen, why is our customer running AWAY?!
Come back! The grease is still warm! Roughly!
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.buiten: Outside! Behind you sounds a very small, very cross "KAREEEN!". Off to Mr. Krabguh, across the street.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.trommel.r: Drumming: click the drum (left or right mouse button) as soon as a bubble pops on it. %s of the %s is enough. Missing costs nothing: Squidmika simply counts in again.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.beloning: For your guhs: Spongeguh's square trousers with a tie! And %s Nibble Patties. From now on the grill in The Krusty Nibble bakes for you too.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klaar: Part 1 is done: The Secret Recipe! Come back soon: Mr. Krabguh has big news, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.krab: My office! Now! At the back! Something TERRIBLE has happened!
Every minute without the recipe costs me... (counts on his claws) ...THREE cheese nibbles! Hurry up!
Have you got it? HAVE YOU GOT IT? Come to my office, the walls have ears here. And customers.
Tonight I'm selling Nibble Patties in the Bubble Bowl. At the entrance. At double the price. A party is a party!
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.spon: Do you hear that bell? That's the Krabguh bell! It only rings for fire, for money or for... money on fire!
I'd come along, but I squeak when I sneak. Listen: (squeak) ...see?
You've got the recipe?! I knew it! I didn't know it, but I KNEW it!
My singing voice is warmed up. Lalalaaa! Yes, it's warm. Maybe too warm.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.patg: I heard a bell. I thought: ice cream man. It wasn't the ice cream man.
Sneaking? I'm very good at that. I sneak out of bed every morning. Very slowly.
What's a recipe? Is that a kind of sandwich?
I'm going to stand at the front. I made a sign: 'SQUID'. I didn't know how to spell the rest.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.octo: A stolen recipe. Maybe it's a sign. A sign that I should have the day off.
If Plankmika catches you, can I take over your shift? No? Sigh.
The recipe is back. Hooray. I'm overjoyed. Can you tell? No? That's right.
Tonight I play against Squilliam. With a block of cheese as singer and a newbie on the drum. Sigh.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.plan: Recipe? What recipe? I know nothing. I'm just a very small Mika.
A customer?! In MY restaurant? Karen, get the grease balls!
The recipe is GONE! Karen! Who did that? ...Why are you looking at me like that, Karen?
I am NOT going to that party. I'm staying home to make a new plan. Plan AA. Very evil.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.pare: Daddy is shouting even louder than usual! That means: something with money.
Careful in that bucket. Everything smells of grease in there. Yuck.
Daddy is dancing! Daddy NEVER dances! What did you do?
I hope they play something you can dance to. Something from now. Not something from Daddy's time.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.gerr: Nyeg! (Gary taps his tail to the beat.)
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.bewo: Have you heard? There's been a break-in at The Krusty Nibble! The recipe is gone!
Without Nibble Patties I'll eat... grease today? No, then rather nothing.
The recipe is back, they say! I'm going to queue up right away!
Tonight: Squidmika in the Bubble Bowl! I'm bringing earplugs. Or not? I'm bringing them. Just in case.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.we: MY RECIPE! My secret Nibble Patty recipe is GONE!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.wa: Mr. Krabguh! I heard the bell! What happened?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.kl: The safe is empty! Last night my recipe was still in it. And now? Nothing! Zero! Zilch!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.ge: Who would do something so mean?!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.te: Ah, mes amis... let us rewind a little. To last night, across the street, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.mi: Plan A to Y: all failed! I am a genius without a plan, Karen!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.la: There's one more drawer in the cabinet, honey.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.st: Step one: wait until it's dark. Step two: take the recipe. Step three: NIBBLE PATTIES!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.be: Thank you Karen, my computer wife.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.na: That night, while all of Bikini Bottom lay snoring...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.kr: A creak. A squeak. And then: a very small, very mean giggle.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.oc: And so, mes amis, we are back at this morning.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.ee: There is only one creature in all of Bikini Bottom who is so mean... and so small...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.vr: Does this mean I have the day off?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.ha: Mr. Krabguh, we'll get it back!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.ji: You there, newbie! Plankmika doesn't know your face yet. Sneak into The Grease Bucket, across the street, and get my recipe back!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.wa: And I'll keep watch at the door! Very inconspicuously! ...VERY INCONSPICUOUSLY!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_knipoog_k: If you clone the recipe, you'll have two!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_sluip_uit: The worst lookout in Bikini Bottom
Psssst! Over here! I'm the lookout. Nobody sees me. I'm a bush.
Inside, Karen watches through cameras. Where the floor lights up yellow, she sees you. Wait until she looks the other way.
The red lasers blink: on, off, on. Walk through when they're off. And crouching makes you quieter!
Seen? No problem: then you're back at the last little rest point. The recipe is all the way at the back, in a little safe.
Good luck! I'll wave when I can't see you anymore. ...I'll wave already.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.op: Ah! The little safe opens, and there it lies: the secret recipe, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.le: The secret ingredient of the Nibble Patty is...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.al: Of course. It is always a cheese nibble.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.ie: Bleep. Someone is standing by the recipe, honey.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.kl: Someone? A CUSTOMER?! Finally a customer! Karen, switch off the security, I'm coming with the menu!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.we: This, mes amis, is the moment to get out of here very, very quickly.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.rec: MY RECIPE! Come to daddy, my little money machine!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.hel: You did it! You're a hero! A sneaking hero!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.fee: This calls for a celebration! Tonight I'm throwing a party in the Bubble Bowl, with free Nibble Patties! ...Half. Half free.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.uit: Tonight? In the Bubble Bowl? That's where Squilliam challenges me. He plays, I play, and the town chooses.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.ban: Only my band walked out yesterday. They found my music 'too beautiful'. They said. Roughly.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.sta: Squidmika! You don't need a band. The whole town is your band!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.dom: That is the dumbest thing I have ever heard. ...Do you have anyone for the drum?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.rit: You, newbie! You have rhythm. I could tell from your sneaking.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.avo: And so, mes amis, we went to the Bubble Bowl that evening. With a drum. And a great deal of hope.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_zoete_zeg: Sweet Nibble Victory
Ah, the Bubble Bowl! Tonight: the great music contest. All of Bikini Bottom is here, nyeg.
Ha! Squidmika! Where is your orchestra? All I see is a block of cheese and a newbie with a drum!
This is a mistake. This is an enormous mistake.
Squidmika... trust the nibble.
...One, two. One, two, three, four!
A silence. And then... cheering. A great deal of cheering.
This... this is... beautiful...
They... they're applauding ME?
Squidmika, you're a star!
And I've sold four hundred Nibble Patties! At the entrance! At double the price!
And so, mes amis, the secret recipe came home, and Squidmika Tentacles was the hero of Bikini Bottom for one evening. One evening, nyeg.
The Narrator
Mr. Krabguh
Spongeguh
Squidmika
Squilliam
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_kijk_kant: There, at the back of The Krusty Nibble: the office with the safe.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_kijk_vete: The big grey bucket across the street. At the back: Plankmika's lab.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_kijk_teru: Mr. Krabguh is waiting in his office, across the street.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_kijk_podi: The Bubble Bowl: your drum stands on the right of the stage. The little steps are at the side.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hint.knabbel: Pearl comes running: "Daddy has big news for everybody!" Go to The Krusty Nibble, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hint.ijssalon: Spongeguh and Patguh have run ahead to the Guhfy Guhber ice cream parlour (the sundae on its roof), %s. Sit down on your stool at the bar.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hint.plein: A horn blares across town! Run to King Neptuguh's throne on Bubble Square, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hint.rit: To The Thug Tug! Get into the Patty Wagon in front of The Krusty Nibble and drive out of the town gate to the east. Your goal: %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hint.kroeg: The little key is in The Thug Tug, the rusty tugboat, %s. Stand still when the Mikas look up!
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.beloning.ho: Your guhs can now wear the Guhfy Guhber Ice Cream Hat (look in the wardrobe)!
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hoorn: An enormous horn blares across all of Bikini Bottom. Somebody on the square is very, very angry.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.instapp: Click the Patty Wagon to get in. You drive!
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.poort: <Patguh> Bye Bikini Bottom! Bye bubble! Bye... er, what was my rock called again?
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.naad: <Spongeguh> According to the map it's only a little bit further. The map is a napkin with a stain on it, though.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.bijna: <Spongeguh> There! The rusty tugboat! Park in the middle bay, next to the anchor.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.uitgest: <Spongeguh> Hey, where are you going? We'll wait in the car. Click the Patty Wagon when you want to drive on!
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.nieuw: <Patguh> I put the Patty Wagon back in front of the door. It was a bit lost. Just like me.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.regel: Only move when nobody is looking. Does the glass tinkle? Freeze!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.balk: Little key: %1$s blocks to go  |  Rest point %2$s/2  |  Seen: %3$s times
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.tink: *tink tink* The barman taps his glass...
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.gezien_: Back to your rest point. Once more, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.rustpun: Rest point %s/2! If they see you, you start again here.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.weg: You left The Thug Tug. The stand-still game starts again when you come back in.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.sponsguh: Mr. Krabguh has news! I think I'm going to be manager. I'm already wearing my manager socks.
I'm not sad. My ears are just taking a little nap. Shall we go to the ice cream parlour?
Hear that horn? That sounds like a very angry king. Quick, to the square!
The Patty Wagon is out front! You drive, I'll wave.
Being quiet is hard when you're as happy as me. But I'm doing my best. Shh!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.patguh.0: Krabguh has news? I hope it's about ice cream. It's usually not about ice cream.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.patguh.1: ICE CREAM! At the Guhfy Guhber! On Main Street! Or another street! Come on!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.patguh.2: That horn is coming from the square. Or from my tummy. No, from the square.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.patguh.3: I call the front! No, the back. Where's the steering wheel? Never mind, you drive.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.patguh.4: I'm practising standing still already. I'm really good at it. I do it all day.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.meneer_k: Come in, come in! Everybody has to hear it. It's about MONEY. About more money!
Go and have an ice cream with him, colleague. But don't pay for it with my nibbles.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.octo_mik: Whatever the news is: I'm sighing in advance.
Manager. Me. Twice as many customers to dislike. Yippee.
An angry king on the square? Finally something interesting.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.bevroren: Mr. Krabguh says nothing: he's an ice cube. Only his eyes follow you. And the nibbles in your pocket.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_sp_d2_heen: Ah, Bikini Bottom. The recipe is back, the whole town has sung, and everything is the way it should be again, mes amis.
But deep in his office Mr. Krabguh counts his nibbles. And he dreams. Of more nibbles.
A second restaurant! And a second restaurant needs a manager. Spongeguh is sure of it: that'll be him.
What nobody knows yet: the road to Shell City is long, rough and full of tough Mikas. Voilà, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.nie: Listen up, everybody! The Krusty Nibble is... DOUBLING! Right next door comes The Krusty Nibble 2. Through the wall. Saves on rent.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.flu: A second restaurant needs a manager. I've been practising my manager face for years. Look. Look! This is it.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.wor: And the manager of The Krusty Nibble 2 will be...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.zuc: Hooray. Now I can sigh in two restaurants at once.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.maa: But... I've been Employee of the Week three hundred and twelve times! In a row!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.kin: You're my very best cook, lad. But a manager? You're just a kid. A very square kid.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.oor: Spongeguh's ears droop. Very slowly. All the way down to the floor, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.ijs: SPONGEGUH! I heard something really sad! You know what helps with that? ICE CREAM! Lots of ice cream!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.mee: You're coming too, right? The Guhfy Guhber has the biggest ice creams in the whole bubble. It's left. Or right. It's over there.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.ti: An ice cream at the Guhfy Guhber
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.to: Three Guhfy Guhber Nibble Towers! With extra everything, and extra extra everything on top.
Wow... I can't even see the top. Do you think there's snow up there?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.mo: It's... beautiful. The most beautiful thing I've ever seen. After a Nibble Patty.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.po: Say.. isn't there supposed to be a little toy with this?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.sp: ...Sir. This is an ice cream parlour. Not a toy shop.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.ge: He's got a point, though. I've never had a little toy either. Never.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.ha: Then the ice cream IS the little toy! CHOMP! ...AAAH! Cold in my ears!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.zi: Guhfy Guhber! Guhfy Guhber! GUHFY GUHBEEER!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.ho: Here. An ice cream hat for our new regular. On the house. As long as you stop singing.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_knipoog_ijs: Baltoguh in the ice cream parlour
Ice cream. Snow. Practically the same thing.
I'll keep looking a little longer, nyeg.
Next to his stool stands the medicine chest. He doesn't see it.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.na: That night, mes amis. It is dark. Just imagine it: under a bubble you can't really tell the difference.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.pl: Plan Z, part two. First the king's crown. And then... the blame for Krabguh. Heehee.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.pa: There. A parcel to Shell City. And this empty cushion... goes to Krabguh.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.ve: Plankmika puts the empty crown cushion on Mr. Krabguh's desk. Evil. VERY evil.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.za: I saw the crown cushion at Krabguh's! By chance. Completely by chance.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.ku: This cushion? I thought: a free cushion, I'll take that. Free is my favourite price!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.we: Crown? What crown? How much is it worth, by the way? ...I mean: I know nothing!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.fl: That crown has long been in Shell City. Heehee.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.di: THIEF! Then you get a cold punishment!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.no: No! Mr. Krabguh would never steal anything! Well... except maybe a nibble off the floor.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.sc: My guards saw a parcel leave last night. For Shell City. Where nobody has ever come back from.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.wi: Then WE will bring your crown back! Me, Patguh and... our new colleague!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.la: HAHAHA! A little square, a little star and a... little thingy! Very well.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.zo: If my crown is here before sunset, I'll thaw your boss. If not, he stays an ice lolly forever.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.ze: Er, Your Majesty? We live under a bubble. How are we supposed to see when the sun sets?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.mo: To the Patty Wagon! It's parked in front of The Krusty Nibble!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_rit.kijk: The Patty Wagon! The fastest bun in Bikini Bottom! With real sesame seeds on the roof.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_rit.voorlop: I've only got a provisional licence. For boats. And Mrs. Puffguh is still crying.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_rit.weg: Out of the town gate, east, and then just follow the road to a rusty tugboat. What could possibly go wrong, nyeg?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.kroeg: The Thug Tug. Only the very toughest Mikas of the whole void come here.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.stoer: I'm tough too. Look. Grrr. ...Was that tough?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.sleut: Can I hold the key for a bit? I've never held a car key. Only spatulas.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.mooi: Nice little key. It's mine now.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.he: Hey! That's the key of the Patty Wagon!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.baby: Come and get it. If you dare, baby.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.slaap: ...the tough Mika has fallen asleep. At his table. With the little key on his belt.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.tien: Patguh. There are ten more in there. And they're not asleep.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.ruikt: The Thug Tug. It smells of old grease, wet socks and tough stories.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.stoer_: Act tough, everybody. Nobody may notice that we're nice.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.baby: Only babies blow bubbles in here.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.stil: Nobody moves. For a very long time. Then the barman shrugs, and everybody looks away again.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.huiswe: When they look, you stand still. Then they don't see you. That's how I always do my homework.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.glas: Hear the barman's glass tinkle? Then they're about to look up. You go. We'll stay here... very... still.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_sleutel_ter: You got it! Without a single little bubble! You're a real silent hero.
I stood very still too. I'm still standing still, by the way. Look.
On to Shell City! Hang in there, Mr. Krabguh! Don't melt! ...No, wait. Do melt. Later.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kijk_knabbe: The Krusty Nibble. Mr. Krabguh is waiting inside with big news.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kijk_ijssal: The Guhfy Guhber ice cream parlour, with the sundae on its roof. Your stool is at the bar.
Bubble Square by the lift. That's where King Neptuguh has set down his throne.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kijk_mobiel: The Patty Wagon stands in front of The Krusty Nibble. Spongeguh and Patguh are already waiting.
The Thug Tug: the rusty tugboat by the road. The little key is inside.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.banter.lopen: The Patty Wagon can't cross the Trench. From here we walk, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.banter.benen: Walk? On my own legs? Exciting.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.hint.rand: Walk with Spongeguh and Patguh along the road to the east, up the hill, until the road ends at the Trench: %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.beloning.snor: Mindy Guh ties a moustache of nibble chorus string for your guhs too! (Guh clothes: the Nibble Chorus Moustache)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.monsters.omhoo: Cross the bottom and climb up along the east wall
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.regel: Follow the road to the town gate. Don't let Dennis catch you!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.uitleg: Dennis Mika is after you on his motorbike! Run (sprint!) along the road down the hill, through the gate of Shell City. If he catches you, he only shoves you back to the last rest point, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.weer: There's Dennis Mika again! Run, to the town gate!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.gepakt_s: Dennis shoves you back. Once more: sprint!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.gepakt_h: Dennis shoves you back to halfway. Once more!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.half: Halfway! If Dennis catches you now, you start here.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.kwijt: Dennis Mika lost you... Come back to the road east of the Trench and the chase goes on.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.regel: Tilt the table with WASD: roll the tear to the socket
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.uitleg: You're stuck in the Cyclops' hand, but you can tilt the table! W, A, S and D tilt it away from you, to the left, towards you and to the right. Roll Patguh's tear along the wet trail (the blue dots) to the socket on the wall. Off the trail? Then Patguh just cries a new one. Sneak = let go.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.weer: Back under the drying lamp! Tilt the table with WASD and roll the tear to the socket.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.los: You wriggle loose. Go back to the drying table to try again.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.nieuw.1: Don't worry, I've got plenty more!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.nieuw.2: Boohoo... there you go, a fresh one.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.klik.monster.2: La la la... la? (he forgot the words)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.klik.cycloop: Come in, come in! Everything is dried, and everything is fun. Hehe.
What could be at the end of the road? A really deep gorge, they say!
Walking is just like driving, but with your feet, nyeg.
With a moustache I'm scared of nothing. Almost nothing.
Hold on to your moustache, Patguh. It's windy here.
What sweet monsters! I'll send them a postcard.
A little more climbing and we're at the top!
The road starts again at the top of the rim. Come on!
Do you hear an engine too?
That enormous boot... I'm not saying anything. But I'm thinking a lot.
The souvenir shop is the building with the scallop on its roof!
Roll that tear, buddy... I'm nearly a cracker...
I fancy an ice cream. I always fancy an ice cream.
Do you know where we're going? Me neither!
I am a man. I am a man. I am... what was I again?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.klik.patguh.6_: Those monsters sing better than Octo.
I feel a sneeze coming on. Oh no, never mind.
My moustache is my best friend. After you.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.klik.patguh.7_: Why are we running? Oh right!
Souvenirs! I want one with my own face on it.
Do you think that shop sells ice cream too?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.klik.patguh.8_: Sniff... I can cry another tear, you know.
I'm as dry as a crust.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_knipoog_appa: Hi Spongeguh! Hi Patguh! You know you could just fly, right?
And I don't have a flying bison. Walking it is, nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.hallo: Psst! There you are! I'm Mindy Guh, King Neptuguh's daughter. Daddy mustn't know, but I've come to help you.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.monster: Princess! We have to get through that Trench over there. But monsters live down there... and we're only... well. Us.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.kindere: Mr. Krabguh says we're only kids.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.snor: Then let's make you MEN. With a moustache of nibble chorus string. Hold still, nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.harig: Patguh... I suddenly feel so... hairy.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.herkent: And the best part: with a moustache, nobody will recognise us!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.ga: Go now, brave gentlemen! Through the Trench, and on to Shell City: that's where Daddy's crown is. Good luck, nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.don: It's awfully dark down here... Patguh, are you holding my hand?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.han: Spongeguh... my hands are in my pockets.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.man: D-don't be scared, Patguh! We are MEN! ...Men with a very tiny little voice.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.moo: Sniff... That was the most beautiful thing I ever heard. After the ice cream truck.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.dan: Thank you, sweet monsters! Come on, Patguh: across the bottom, and up the other side!
We're up! We made it, Patguh. And nobody recognised us!
Uh-oh. That's Dennis Mika, Plankmika's hired hand. Act really... normal. We're just two gentlemen.
Good afternoon. I'm looking for a square and a star. Did they happen to come by here?
No sir. There's only us here: two respectable gentlemen. With a moustache.
Hm. Two respectable gentlemen with a moustache. Then I won't bother you any longer. Have a nice day, gentlemen.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_laars.au: ...Ow. Nothing wrong. I'm okay. I'm just a little... flatter.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_laars.voet: What WAS that? A really big foot?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_laars.laars: A diving boot. A really big diving boot... Patguh, I've got a funny feeling about that souvenir shop over there.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_laars.sleute: Ooh, souvenirs! I want a keyring with my own name on it!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.souv: Look at all these souvenirs! Dried starfish... dried cheeses... a dried... guh?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.kroo: Spongeguh! There! On that little cushion! King Neptuguh's crown!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.plan: That sneaky Plankmika sold it here! Quick, let's take it home, then Mr. Krabguh is saved!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.nieu: Aaah. New souvenirs. A little holey cheese with a moustache. A little star. And a fresh little vads. What a lovely day.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.help: Help! He's picking us up like a bag of crisps!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.lamp: A nice little dry under the lamp. Tomorrow you'll be in the shop window. Hehehe.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.knis: Patguh... I'm getting so... crispy. I've never been this thirsty.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.huil: Don't cry, Spongeguh. Crying wastes your water. ...Sniff. I'm crying a tiny bit myself.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.traa: Patguh! A tear! Water! If that tear reaches the socket...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.stop: ...then the socket goes fzzzt and the sprinklers come on! Will you help it roll? We can't move any more. We're crisps.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.ste: I'm a star again! A wet star!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.lev: I'm alive again! I'm not a keyring any more, nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.nat: Nooo! My souvenirs! Everything is WET! Who's been crying in my shop?!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.ik: Me. Sorry. It was a really lovely tear, though.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.han: ...Is that a towel? For me? ...Thank you, little one.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.kro: King Neptuguh's crown! Home we go, before the sun goes... er, before it gets dark... er. Home we go!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.thu: But how do we get home? The Patty Wagon is on the wrong side of the Trench.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.pie: At the pier, maybe? Someone by the Void Sea will know what to do. Come on!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_kijk_rand.te: This is where the road ends: at the Trench. There, at the rim, someone is waiting for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_kijk_pad.tek: Down along the west wall, across the dark bottom, and up again along the east wall.
Shell City Gifts & Stuff: the building with the giant scallop on its roof.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.hint.pier: The crown has to go home, and fast! Walk to the head of the long pier, %s: east past the beach, out into the void. Princess Mindy Guh is already waving there.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.hint.emmers: Behind the town gate, Bikini Bottom guhs are walking around with a bucket on their head, %s. Go to the golden columns of light and blow the buckets off with your bubble blaster (right-click).
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.hint.bellen: Everyone is free! Walk to the Bubble Bowl, %s: up Bubble Lane to the north.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.hint.podium: Plankmika is standing on the stage of the Bubble Bowl, %s. Climb onto the stage by the little steps at the front left or right.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.op: David Hasselguh dives under the pier. Hop, onto his back!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.weer: <David Hasselguh> There you are again! Climb on, I'm still swimming that way.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.mislukt: David Hasselguh can't carry you right now. Stand on the head of the pier again.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.1: <David Hasselguh> Everyone comfy? Don't pull my back hair, I just combed it.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.2: <Patguh> Look! Down there! Our houses are so tiny! ...Oh no, that's a crumb.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.3: <Spongeguh> Hang in there, Mr. Krabguh! We're coming with your crown and your ice-free future!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.4: <David Hasselguh> I'll drop you off at the jetty in front of the town gate. You'll have to run the last bit yourselves. I'm tired from all this being handsome.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.blijf: Stay seated, nyeg: David Hasselguh is swimming you home.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.spel.regel: Blow the buckets off %s guhs with your bubble blaster
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.spel.naar_b: Off to the Bubble Bowl, in the north
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.spel.blazer: Spongeguh pushes a bubble blaster into your paws: "Aim at the bucket and blow away!" (right-click)
Patguh found your bubble blaster in a puddle of sauce. Here you go, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.spel.mis: Missed! Come a bit closer and aim at the bucket.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.1: <Bikini Bottom Guh> Huh? Where am I? Why do I smell of bucket?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.2: <Bikini Bottom Guh> All this time all I could see was my own nose. Thanks, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.3: <Bikini Bottom Guh> I had to keep saying 'Plankmika is the boss'. I thought it was a silly song.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.4: <Bikini Bottom Guh> My ears! My ears are still there! Wahoog!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.5: <Bikini Bottom Guh> Finally! I really need to pee. ...After the concert.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.6: <Bikini Bottom Guh> I'm coming with you! I can cheer really loudly, listen: WOOOOH!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.sponsg: What an adventure! Any moment now I'll be totally unspongeably excited, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.patguh: I'm just following you. That's my plan. It has been my whole life.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.emmer: Plankmika... is... the... boss... (the bucket echoes a little)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.vrij: I'm coming with you to the Bubble Bowl!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.plankm: Any moment now, I'll be king of Bikini Bottom! Mwahaha! ...Why are you looking at me like that?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.bewone: Psst. I'm hiding behind my mailbox. Someone is walking around here with buckets!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.meneer_k: Ah, the hero of the crown! A Nibble Patty? Hold cheese nibbles in your paw and click me: three nibbles a patty. No haggling.
I've never had such a cold day in my life. Brrr. I sleep under three blankets now.
<Mr. Krabguh> One Nibble Patty, fresh off the grill. The secret ingredient stays secret, nyeg!
<Mr. Krabguh> Three cheese nibbles, lad. Not two. Not two and a half. Three.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.sponsguh: Being manager is amazing! I've held seven meetings already. With myself.
Coming to flip a patty later? The grill misses you, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.patguh.1: I'm the official best customer now. I've got a card. It's a bit of cardboard.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.patguh.2: I'm still practising on the guitar. It's still made of cardboard.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.parel_gu: Daddy says you thawed him out. I say I'm knitting him a scarf now!
Those bucket helmets were SO not in fashion.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.octo_mik: It was so nice and quiet under that bucket. Nobody talking to me.
That concert? I didn't hear it. I can't hear anything. La la la.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.octoliam: Hmph. Rocking. Anyone can do that. I could do it too. If I wanted to.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.plankmik: I wasn't in a bucket. YOU were in a bucket! ...Wait, that's not right either.
Plans A to Z are used up. Tomorrow I start on Plan Ä.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.juf_pufg: I heard you rode a giant guh. Without a licence! I'm puffing up just thinking about it.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.bikinibo: I still can't believe I had a bucket on. I can still feel a rim on my ears.
That concert! I sang 'Guhfy Guhber' all night long. So did my neighbours. Not by choice.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.cycloop_: My shop only sells wet souvenirs now. They'll dry. Someday.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.david_ha: Another ride? I'm always swimming somewhere anyway. I'll just keep training, watch.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.loopgraa: Rrrraaah! ...Sorry, force of habit. How did that song go again? La la laaa.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.beloning: Spongeguh part 2 is done! You got: Spongeguh as your buddy, Gary the snail, Plankmika's antennas for your guhs and the title Guhfy Guhber. From now on Mr. Krabguh sells you Nibble Patties for cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.beloning.al: Spongeguh and Gary will come and visit you, nyeg!
item.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_bellenblaz: One well-blown bubble and any bucket flies off. Also works just for fun.
Right-click: a stream of soap bubbles.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.guhfy_guhber: Rock so hard that the buckets fly off (Spongeguh part 2).
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_hasselguh: There you are! And... is that my father's crown?!
Rescued from the gift shop! With only a teeny bit of dehydration, nyeg.
I'm still a bit of a raisin.
Quick! Daddy wants his crown back before the bubble sun sets. Otherwise Mr. Krabguh stays an ice lolly forever.
But Bikini Bottom is all the way on the other side of the trench! We'll NEVER make it on foot!
That's why I'm calling a friend.
Anyone need a lift? I'm swimming that way anyway.
Wow. He's like a mountain. A mountain with muscles.
Thank you. I train every day. Three times. Climb on and hold on to your ears.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_thuis.rui: Home! I can smell the grill already! And... something else. Does that smell like... metal?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_thuis.mod: Why is everyone wearing a bucket on their head? Is that fashionable now?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_thuis.pie: BEEP. Attention, citizens of Bikini Bottom. This is Karen, on behalf of the new boss.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_thuis.mua: MWAHAHA! You're all wearing a Plankmika bucket helmet! Now you'll do exactly as I say!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_thuis.lim: He means: come to the Bubble Bowl. He's crowning himself king there. There will be lemonade.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_thuis.kar: Karen! Don't give away the lemonade!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_thuis.bla: No time to lose! Here, my bubble blaster! One well-blown bubble and that bucket flies off.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_thuis.pla: You free the guhs, and then we all run to the Bubble Bowl!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_thuis.aan: And I... I'm going to cheer really loudly.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_guhfy_guh: I'm a Guhfy Guhber
Ha! There you are at last. Too late! All of Bikini Bottom is wearing my buckets. I'm the boss of EVERYTHING now!
Not everyone, Plankmika! We blew six of them free!
Six? Ha! There are hundreds more! They only listen to me. Unless... no. That doesn't exist.
What doesn't exist?
Music that rocks so hard a bucket jumps off by itself. Pure nonsense! Hahaha!
...Have you still got your drum? Patguh, grab a guitar! It's made of cardboard, but that doesn't matter!
Bikini Bottom! This song is for you!
NO! My buckets! My beautiful, shiny buckets!
WHO dares to rock this hard in MY town?
King Neptuguh! Your crown! We brought it all the way back from Shell City!
My crown! But... who stole it, then, if it wasn't poor Krabguh?
BEEP. Plankmika. It was Plankmika. I recorded everything. From three camera angles.
Karen!! ...Er. I'm just going to... go somewhere else.
HAHAHA! What nerve, that little one. Krabguh, you are free!
Brrr! What did I miss? Were there customers? Did they pay?
Spongeguh, lad... you saved everything. You're the manager of the new Krusty Nibble!
ME?! MANAGER?! I'm going to faint. No, I'm not going to faint. I'm going to CHEER!
And I'll be the customer! The very best customer!
Wonderful. Now he's got a hat as well. Could somebody give me my bucket back?
Plankmika
Spongeguh
Spongeguh
Patguh
King Neptuguh
King Neptuguh
Karen
Mr. Krabguh
Squidmika Tentacles
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_bedankt.c: You were the best co-worker, driving buddy, bucket blower and drummer I've ever had.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_bedankt.l: On my days off I'll come and stay with you. I'll bring my own spatula!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_bedankt.g: Gary wants to come too! He says your house must be nice and damp.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_bedankt.w: I'm coming too! ...Where do you live, actually?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_bedankt.s: Et voilà, nyeg: Bikini Bottom got its crown back, Mr. Krabguh got his warmth back, and you got two new housemates.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_kijk_pier: The head of the pier: Princess Mindy Guh is waiting there.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_kijk_emme: Behind the town gate: guhs with a bucket on their head.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_kijk_podi: The Stage of the Bubble Bowl
The little steps up to the stage.
subtitles.guhs.einde2_sp_audio.moment.cy: Music: suspense in the souvenir shop
guhs.einde2_sp_audio.muziek_bikinibodem_: Kevin MacLeod - Island Meet and Greet
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_zoete_zeg: ♪ Spongeguh takes a deep breath... ♪
One crumb on its own is so small in the sea,
a bubble you blow drifts away on the breeze.
But look all around you: the whole town is here,
with drums and with ears full of cheer!
So switch on the lights... and hold on to your ears...
This is our sweet nibble victory!
Hear the bottom thumping, hear the bubbles go!
All together we are never shy,
because together nobody can beat us!
This is our sweet nibble victory!
Together nobody... can... beat us, yeaaah!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_guhfy_guh: ♪ A guitar tears through the Bubble Bowl! ♪
They said: kiddo, you're nothing but a kid,
with an ice-cream hat on and your ears flapping in the wind.
But the small ones blow the biggest bubbles of all,
and whoever laughs with their ears wins the game!
I'm a Guhfy Guhber!
With ice cream on my head and a nibble in my hand!
I'm a Guhfy Guhber!
The loudest little guh in all the land!
Buckets off! Buckets off!
Bikini Bottom, wake up... NYEG!
I'm a Guhfy Guhber!
With ice cream on my head and a nibble in my hand!
I'm a Guhfy Guhber!
The loudest little guh in all the land!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.lie: ♪ One monster hums a little tune... and then they all sing! ♪
Deep in the Trench, where the light never goes,
we monsters sing, and nobody grumbles.
We look scary, with teeth this long,
but whoever sings with us is never scared again!
gui.guhs.verhalen.sandy_boomkoepel.uitle: In the east of Bikini Bottom stands a glass dome full of real air, with a Guhmension tree inside. That is where Sandy Guh lives: karate champion, inventor, and secretly a little homesick for the pink sky back home.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sandy_boomkoepel.nu.0: Go to the glass tree dome in the east of town (south of the rest home), step in through the airlock on its west side and walk up to Sandy Guh.
Sandy Guh's tree dome, east in Bikini Bottom
gui.guhs.verhalen.sandy_boomkoepel.nu.1: Step onto the karate mat in the dome. Sandy Guh shoves: when she shouts HAI, step aside or jump. Dodge her ten times. If she gets you, that one simply doesn't count.
The karate mat in the tree dome
gui.guhs.verhalen.sandy_boomkoepel.nu.2: With the last KABOOM three parts of Sandy's rocket flew into town: the nose cone (by the Jelly Field in the northeast), the exhaust pipe (behind the little houses on the West Ring) and the antenna (between the houses of Conch Street). Walk over them to pick them up.
All over Bikini Bottom (follow the column of light)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sandy_boomkoepel.nu.3: Bring the three parts to Sandy's broken rocket, in the tree dome next to the tree.
The rocket in the tree dome
gui.guhs.verhalen.sandy_boomkoepel.nu.kl: Done! Sandy's rocket went up. A tiny bit. You got her air helmet.
Visit Sandy Guh in her dome
To the rocket in the dome
gui.guhs.verhalen.vliegende_guhlander.ui: Sometimes a green ghost ship drifts over Conch Street. Whoever waits patiently at the mooring may come aboard with the ghost captain. He has been trying to scare somebody for a hundred years. It never works.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vliegende_guhlander.nu: Go to the mooring of The Flying Guhchman: the ring of stones with the little sign, east of Patguh's rock on Conch Street. Stay on the stones until the ship comes: ten counts, shown above your hotbar.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vliegende_guhlander.wa: The mooring on Conch Street, east of Patguh's rock
gui.guhs.verhalen.vliegende_guhlander.nu: Step into the bubble stream at the mooring: it takes you up to the deck. Walk over to the ghost captain there.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vliegende_guhlander.wa: The deck of The Flying Guhchman, above Conch Street
gui.guhs.verhalen.vliegende_guhlander.nu: The captain's three lanterns blew away: one among the Crumb Jellies in the field east of the mooring, one behind The Grease Bucket (north of the mooring) and one by Spongeguh's Nibble Chorus Fruit house, in the west. Walk over them.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vliegende_guhlander.wa: All over Bikini Bottom (follow the column of light)
gui.guhs.verhalen.vliegende_guhlander.nu: Go back to the mooring. The ship comes again (five counts): take the bubble stream up and bring the captain his lanterns.
Done! The ghost captain can find his way again. You got a ghost lantern and its recipe.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vliegende_guhlander.ko: The lanterns back to the captain
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.uitleg: In the rest home on the east side of town live two elderly superheroes. They still save Bikini Bottom. After their afternoon nap. If they can find their things.
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.nu.0: Go to the rest home in the east (north of the tree dome; the door is on the west side) and walk up to Mermaid Guh and Barnacle Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.waar.0: The rest home, east in Bikini Bottom
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.nu.1: Mermaid Guh's belt is in the invisible boatmobile, on the car park on the south side of the rest home. Search nothing for something and pick up the belt.
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.waar.1: The car park on the south side of the rest home
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.nu.2: Bring the belt back to Mermaid Guh, inside the rest home.
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.waar.2: The rest home, east in Bikini Bottom
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.nu.3: Drive the invisible boatmobile to the front door of The Krusty Nibble (west of the rest home, on Main Street) and pick up the heroes' lunch.
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.waar.3: The front door of The Krusty Nibble
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.nu.klaar: Done! Lunch is saved. You got a real hero cape.
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.waar.klaar: The rest home, east in Bikini Bottom
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.nu.3_b: Bring the heroes' lunch back to Mermaid Guh and Barnacle Guh in the rest home. Toot toot!
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.waar.3_b: The rest home, east in Bikini Bottom
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.kort.1: Find the belt in the boatmobile
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.kort.2: The belt back to Mermaid Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.zeemeerman.kort.3_b: The lunch back to the rest home
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.hallo: Hey there, neighbor guh! Welcome to my tree dome! Take a look around: in here there's air. Real air!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.lucht: I built it all by myself. A glass dome, an airlock, and a Guhmension tree to sleep under.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.helm: Wait, your air helmet first. *plop* There!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.grap: Haha, don't worry: guhs breathe anywhere. But you look sooo cute with a fishbowl over your little ears.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.roze: I'm from the Guhmension. The sky is pink and soft there. Down here I miss that a little sometimes, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.karate: But enough moping! Fancy a round of karate? On the mat over there. I shove, you dodge. HAI-YA!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy_raket.ond: The nose cone, the exhaust pipe, the antenna! All three! Just a few screws...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy_raket.aft: Ready for launch! Three... two... one... WAHOOG!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy_raket.spr: It went up! It really did! A tiny little bit. A hop is a bit like flying too, isn't it?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy_raket.roz: One day I'll fly it all the way up, through the void, until the sky turns pink again.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy_raket.hel: Here, keep that air helmet. Then you'll always have a little piece of my dome with you. Thanks, buddy!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_guhlander.mist: Ah... the mist is rising, mes amis. Look up. There, out of the mist... a ship!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_guhlander.boe: BOOOOO! Who disturbs the eternal rest of The Flying Guhchman?!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_guhlander.leven: A living guh! Nobody has come by in a hundred years. I'm rather out of practice with my boos.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_guhlander.boord: Come aboard, if you dare! My bubble stream takes you up to the deck. BOO. That was an invitation.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_guhlander.kolom: Vous voyez? A bubble stream bubbles up, straight to the deck. The ghost ship is waiting for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.titel: The Night of the Chopping Chopper
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.kaars: A little later, on deck... by candlelight, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.verhaal: Sit down, living guh. I'll tell you the scariest story of the seven voids: The Night of the Chopping Chopper.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.nacht: It was a dark night. In a quiet kitchen. And then it came: tok... tok... TOK.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.dichter: It came closer. Tok. Tok. A knife. A board. And sobbing, heartbreaking sobbing...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.uien: He was chopping onions. For the soup. That's why he was crying so much. Hahaa! Scary, huh? Your little ears are still shaking!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.lantaarn: But now something really scary: my three ghost lanterns blew away. Into town. All of them.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.vraag: Without their light I'll never find my way back through the mist. Will you bring them back? I'll just blow you down.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_helden.bezoek: A visitor! Have you come for an autograph? Or... have you seen a SUPERVILLAIN?!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_helden.riem: He hasn't put his belt on yet today, young hero. Without his belt he does nothing heroic. Except sleep.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_helden.kwijt: My belt! It must be in the invisible boatmobile. On the car park, on the south side.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_helden.onzichtb: The trouble is, chief: the boatmobile is invisible. We'll never find it again.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_helden.ga: Young hero! Find my belt! Go, go, GO! ...We'll just have a little nap.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.sandy.0: Sandy Guh lives in the glass tree dome %s. Go in through the airlock on its west side.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.sandy.1: Step onto the karate mat in the tree dome, %s. Sandy shouts HAI? Step aside or jump!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.sandy.2: The nearest rocket part is %s. Follow the column of light and walk over it.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.sandy.3: Bring the parts to Sandy's rocket in the tree dome, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.guhlander.0: The mooring of The Flying Guhchman is %s: the ring of stones east of Patguh's rock. Wait there for the ship.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.guhlander.1: Step into the bubble stream at the mooring, %s: it takes you to the deck of the ghost ship.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.guhlander.2: The nearest ghost lantern is %s. Follow the column of light and walk over it.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.guhlander.3: Back to the mooring, %s. The ship comes again: up to the captain!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.zeemeerman.0: Mermaid Guh and Barnacle Guh live in the rest home %s. The door is on the west side.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.zeemeerman.1: The invisible boatmobile is on the car park %s, on the south side of the rest home. The belt is in it.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.zeemeerman.2: Bring the belt to Mermaid Guh in the rest home, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.zeemeerman.3: Toot toot! Drive the invisible boatmobile to the front door of The Krusty Nibble, %s.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_koepel.tek: A glass dome full of air, with an airlock on the west side.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_mat.tekst: This is where Sandy Guh trains. She shoves, you dodge.
Flung away by the last KABOOM. Walk over it.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_raket.teks: A few more screws, then... WAHOOG?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_trap.tekst: A ring of stones and a sign: sometimes. Boo.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_stroom.tek: Straight up to the deck of the ghost ship.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_lantaarn.t: Blown out of the mist. Walk over it.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_rusthuis.t: Two retired heroes live here. The door is on the west side.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_parkeer.te: The invisible boatmobile is parked here. Probably.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_knabbel.te: Fetch the heroes' lunch here. Heroic, right?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.open: Bikini Bottom is alive! Sandy Guh in her tree dome, the ghost captain of The Flying Guhchman and the old heroes in the rest home could use your help. Look in your Guhdex under Tales, below Spongeguh Cheesepants.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.beloning.spooklan: A ghost lantern and its recipe
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.later: Hey there! I'm Sandy Guh. Sort out your job with Mr. Krabguh first, then we'll do karate, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.helm_op: Your air helmet is on. Blub.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.karate.rege: She shouts HAI? Step aside or jump! Dodge her 10 times.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.karate.gera: A gentle shove! That one doesn't count, nothing else happens. (%s/%s)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.karate.pauz: Paused: step back onto the mat to carry on. (%s/%s)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.karate.klaa: You're faster than a jellyfish on roller skates!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na_karate.1: Wow! You're fast! Faster than a jellyfish on roller skates!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na_karate.2: Say, will you help me out? My rocket went KABOOM last week, and three parts flew out of the dome, into town.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na_karate.3: The nose cone, the exhaust pipe and the antenna. Can you find them? Then we'll finish it together!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.onderdeel.a: All three! Bring them to Sandy's rocket in the tree dome.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.klik.karate: On the mat, buddy! Dodged: %s out of %s. HAI!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.klik.onderd: Found: %s out of %s. Follow the column of light, they're all over town!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.klik.raket: You've got all three? Come along to the rocket!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na.1: A little karate every day keeps your ears supple!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na.2: I tried the rocket again. It went up a tiny bit again. Progress!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na.3: Nice little helmet you've got on. Suits you better than me, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.klaar.onder: You got the air helmet (guh clothes)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.wacht: The ghost ship is coming... %s. Stay on the mooring.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.terug.o: Take the bubble stream up to the deck.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.lantaar: The captain counts along from his deck: %s out of %s. Boo.
All three! Back to the mooring: the ship will come and fetch you again.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.dank.1: My lanterns! All three! Now I can find my way through the mist again.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.dank.2: And the best part: when I saw them glow, I scared myself silly. At last I've given somebody a fright!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.dank.3: Here, take one with you, and the recipe too. Then it'll be a bit spooky at your place as well. BOO! Bye!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.klik: Boo. We'll talk on deck, living guh.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.na.1: BOO! ...Did you jump? No? I'm still practising.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.na.2: My lanterns burn like never before. Spookily pretty, huh?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.klaar.o: You got a ghost lantern and its recipe
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.later.zeem: MERMAID GUH! Er... come back later, young hero. After my nap. And after your first day at work.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.later.moss: He means: we're not ready yet. Come back when you work in town.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.bonk: BONK! You walk into something that isn't there. The invisible boatmobile!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.riem.onder: Bring it back to Mermaid Guh in the rest home.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.band.1: MY BELT! Click... I can feel it already: my powers are coming back! I feel twenty years younger!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.band.2: Thirty, chief. You hadn't worn it for thirty years.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.band.3: Time for a heroic deed! The most dangerous one of the day: fetching lunch from The Krusty Nibble!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.band.4: Take the invisible boatmobile, young hero. It's outside. I think. Toot toot!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.lunch.onde: Two Nibble Patty meals. Back to the rest home!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.lunch.teru: Bring the heroes' lunch back to the rest home, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.toet: Toot toot! You're driving the invisible boatmobile.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.dank.1: Lunch! Saved! Just in time for our afternoon nap.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.dank.2: Another town full of happy tummies. Good work, young hero.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.dank.3: You deserve this: a real hero cape. Wear it with pride! ...And wash it now and then.
My belt! It's in the invisible boatmobile, out on the car park. Go, go!
The car park on the south side. You'll feel it right away. Literally: bonk.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.klik.lunch: Lunch, young hero! At the front door of The Krusty Nibble! Toot toot!
Two meals. Mine without the pickle, please.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.na.zeemeer: MERMAID GUH! ...Sorry, I just have to shout that now and then.
That cape suits you, young hero. Almost as well as it suits me.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.na.mosselg: He fell asleep with his belt on again. Progress.
Thanks for lunch. It was the most exciting thing we've done in weeks.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.klaar.tite: Mermaid Guh and Barnacle Guh: done!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.klaar.onde: You got the hero cape (guh clothes)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.binnen: Paintings of Octo hang everywhere. All of Octo. Made by Octo.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.portret.0: Octo, serious, with his clarinet. The frame is bigger than the painting.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.portret.1: Octo, even more serious, in front of a sunset. He sighs, even on canvas.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.portret.2: Octo as a marble statue. Underneath it says: Masterpiece.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.portret.3: Octo painting a painting of Octo painting a painting.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.stem.1: (from upstairs) Who's touching my clarinet?! That's a work of art, not a toy!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.stem.2: (from upstairs) Sigh. Even my clarinet sounds better when I play it. A little bit.
gui.guhs.safari.beschermd: This is Safaripark Vadse Bergen, chonk: no breaking or building here!
gui.guhs.safari.storing: The safari park is closed for a moment (malfunction). Try again in a bit.
gui.guhs.safari.welkom: Welcome to Safaripark Vadse Bergen! Look around carefully: the animals love to hide. Vahoeg!

guhs.configuration.language.tooltip: The language you read the Guhs texts in. AUTO follows the Minecraft language (Dutch for nl_nl, English for anything else); NL is always Dutch, EN always English. Only for you, also on servers. You can also switch with the language button in your Guhdex.
guhs.configuration.languageChosen.toolti: Off = the question 'Which language for Guhs?' comes once more when you join a world or server.
book.guhs.logboek626.1:
Logbook of
EXPERIMENT 626

Made by the
mad professor
Jumba-guh.
book.guhs.logboek626.2:
Goal: make the chonkiest guh ever.
So chonky that he's TOO CHONKY.

...
book.guhs.logboek626.3:
Reading 1: chonky.
Reading 2: very chonky.
Reading 3: WAHOOG.
Reading 4: the meter is broken. Nyeg?!
book.guhs.logboek626.4:
Conclusion:
A guh can never be too chonky.

INCALCULABLY WAHOOG.

(626 has escaped. He is sweet.)

item.guhs.safaricamera.uitleg: Hold right-click to zoom in, let go to take a photo.
item.guhs.safaricamera.uitleg2: The bigger in the picture, the more stars. A sleeping or playing animal is extra nice. Vahoeg!

gui.guhs.safari.dex.afdrukken.tip: Make a photo card of your best photo of this animal (costs 1 sheet of paper).
gui.guhs.safari.dex.nog_niet: Not photographed yet. Find this animal in the park and take a nice photo!
gui.guhs.safari.dex.badge.klaar: Every animal of this zone is in! Collect your zone badge from the expert guh in the experts' pavilion.
gui.guhs.safari.dex.badge.nog: %s species to go for the zone badge of %s.
gui.guhs.safari.dex.sterren.uitleg: Big and clearly in the picture, not behind leaves: up to 2 points. In the middle and the animal looks at you: 1 point. Something special, like sleeping, eating or playing: 1 point. A baby, a whole family or two species together: 1 point. 0-1 point is ★, 2-3 is ★★ and 4-5 is ★★★. Hold the camera a moment to zoom in!
gui.guhs.safari.dex.geheimpjes.uitleg: Secrets are hidden all over the park. Look around carefully, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.hallo: Hello there, junior ranger! I'm Guhmbo, head ranger of Safaripark Vadse Bergen. Can I help you with anything, njeg?
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.optie.tip: Got a tip of the day?
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.tip: Psst... this morning I saw the %1$s in the %2$s, somewhere near x %3$s, z %4$s. Sneak up carefully, chonk, or it hides!
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.uitleg: Spot and photograph every animal for your Safari-dex! At the experts' pavilion you get a badge when a zone is full. In the petting corner you can help out, in the gift shop you shop with Safari coins, and in the lodge you sleep like a log. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.fotograaf.hallo: Click-click! I'm Flitsguh. The closer, the sharper, and an animal doing something fun gives extra stars. Njeg, and don't move!
gui.guhs.safari.fotograaf.camera: You don't have a camera yet! Here, this one's yours. Photos of animals go into your Safari-dex. Say cheese... or rather: say knabbel!
gui.guhs.safari.verzorger.hallo:
Hi! I'm Knuffelien from the petting corner. Today they fancy:
%s
Will you help? Feeding, brushing, or walking the alpaca on the lead!
gui.guhs.safari.verzorger.optie.voer: May I have a bag of food?
gui.guhs.safari.verzorger.voer: Here you go: a bit of everything, plus a brush and a lead if you didn't have them yet. Guess what they like today, njeg!
gui.guhs.safari.verzorger.voer.al: You already had a bag today, chonk. Tomorrow again!
gui.guhs.safari.verkoper.hallo: Welcome to the gift shop! Everything for Safari coins, and nothing is too chonky.
gui.guhs.safari.lodge.hallo: Welcome to the lodge! Take a hut: sleep here and you wake up here too. And early risers get double coins for their first photo of the day. Sleep tight, njeg!
gui.guhs.safari.lodge.vroege_vogel: Good morning, early bird! Your first photo today pays double Safari coins.
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.1: Welcome to Safaripark Vadse Bergen! I'm Guhmbo, the head ranger. So glad you're here, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.2: More than forty kinds of animals live here, from lions to sloths. Some hide really well, so look around carefully.
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.3: Photograph them for your Safari-dex: the nicer the photo, the more Safari coins.
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.3.camera: Here's your camera! Photograph the animals for your Safari-dex: the nicer the photo, the more Safari coins.
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.4: The experts in the pavilion, the petting corner, the gift shop and the lodge: have a look everywhere. Njeg, happy spotting!
gui.guhs.safari.bus.terug: Toot toot! The Guh safari bus takes you back home. See you on the next safari, vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.expert.savanne.nog: I'm the Savanna expert. You photographed %1$s of the %2$s species here. %3$s to go, chonk! Come back when they're all in.

gui.guhs.safari.expert.australie.nog: G'day, njeg mate! You've snapped %1$s of the %2$s outback species. %3$s to go, no worries, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.expert.australie.al: Strewth, what a vahoeg outback expert! %1$s of the %2$s species. Good on ya, mate!
gui.guhs.safari.expert.australie.belonin: Crikey! Every species of %s in the pocket! Here, mate: your badge, a painting and 100 Safari coins. No worries, njeg!
gui.guhs.safari.aaihoek.voer.paprika: something bright red with a stalk
gui.guhs.safari.aaihoek.geborsteld: %s is all shiny after the brushing!
gui.guhs.safari.aaihoek.bah.niet: Yuck! %s doesn't eat that at all, njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.aaihoek.bah.vandaag: Yuck! %s doesn't fancy that today. Ask the keeper.

gui.guhs.safari.aaihoek.tip.cavia: Squeak squeak! The guinea pig hopes for a treat.
gui.guhs.safari.aaihoek.tip.ezeltje: Hee-haw! The donkey wants a brushing.

gui.guhs.safari.aaihoek.wandel.stap: Point %1$s of %2$s, the alpaca trots happily along!
gui.guhs.safari.aaihoek.wandel.klaar: Loop done! The alpaca is tired but happy.
gui.guhs.safari.aaihoek.wandel.weg: The alpaca trotted back to its pen.
gui.guhs.safari.aaihoek.wandel.al: You're already walking an alpaca, njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.aaihoek.wandel.bezet: Someone is already walking this alpaca.
gui.guhs.safari.bezoeker.0: Njeg, I just saw a lion!
gui.guhs.safari.bezoeker.1: I'm on safari, I'm not coming home with you, chonk.
gui.guhs.safari.bezoeker.2: Have you found the okapi yet? I've been looking all day!
gui.guhs.safari.bezoeker.3: Those penguins are even chonkier than me. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.label: SAFARI
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.grap.0: Everything in stock, except the elephant.
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.grap.1: Don't put plushies in your mouth. Not even if you're a lion.
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.grap.2: New: penguin hats for penguins (no penguins found who want one).
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.grap.3: Pay with Safari coins. Knabbels get eaten.
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.grap.4: The giraffe found this shop too low.
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.grap.5: Free gift wrapping? No, njeg. Chonky gift wrapping: yes!
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.kleine_lettertjes: Small print: animal home signs only for animals in your Safari-dex, one per species per 7 days. Animals are not returnable.
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.leeg: The shelves are empty. Come back later, njeg!
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.tekort: %s Safari coins short. Go snap some more animals, njeg!
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.nee.onbekend: I don't sell that (any more), njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.nee.niet_hier: You can only buy in Safaripark Vadse Bergen, njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.nee.max: You have enough of those already, njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.nee.eis: You can't buy that yet, njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.nee.te_duur: You don't have enough Safari coins for that yet, njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.nee.mislukt: That didn't work. You still have your coins, njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.blauwdrukken.uitl: Build the lodge, the ranger post or the lookout tower at home. Coming soon, chonk!

gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.leeuw: Lions sleep up to 20 hours a day. Nice and chonky.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.luipaard: A leopard drags its food up a tree, so nobody steals it.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.olifant: Elephants recognise each other after years. They never forget a cuddle.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.neushoorn: A rhino horn is made of the same stuff as your nails.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kafferbuffel: Buffalo vote together which way the herd goes.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.dikdik: A dik-dik is only as big as a chonky cat.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.giraffe: A giraffe's tongue is bluish and up to 45 cm long.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zebra: No two zebras have the same stripes.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.stokstaartje: Meerkats take turns keeping watch. Always upright!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.jachtluipaard: The cheetah is the fastest land animal, but super sleepy after a sprint.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.struisvogel: An ostrich egg is as big as 24 chicken eggs. Giant omelette!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zeekoe: Manatees are related to... elephants! You can tell by the chonk.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.nijlpaard: Hippos can't swim: they walk along the bottom.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.flamingo: Flamingos are pink because of what they eat.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.capibara: Capybaras are friends with everyone. Really everyone.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.krokodil: A crocodile can stay under water for an hour, and smile at the same time.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.rode_panda: Red pandas use their fluffy tail as a blanket.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.reuzenpanda: A giant panda eats bamboo for about 12 hours a day. Vahoeg.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.gibbon: Gibbons sing a duet together in the morning.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.luiaard: Sloths only come down once a week to go to the toilet.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.okapi: The okapi looks like a zebra, but is related to the giraffe.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.orang_oetan: Orangutans build a new bed of leaves every evening.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.toekan: A toucan's beak is big, but very light.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.gekko: Geckos walk up walls thanks to tiny hairs on their toes.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.glimworm: Glow-worms make their tail glow to lure snacks.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.pinguin: Emperor penguins cuddle together against the cold: the huddle!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.ijsbeer: A polar bear has black skin under its white fur.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zeehond: Seals can sleep under water, with their nose shut.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.narwal: A narwhal's tusk can grow up to 3 metres long.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.octopus: An octopus has three hearts. Triple sweet!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.sabeltandtijger: Sabre-tooth tigers lived in the ice age. Luckily this one is sweet.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.mammoet: A mammoth had thick fur and a layer of fat: extra chonk.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.wolharige_neushoo: The woolly rhino pushed snow aside with its horn.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.bever: Beavers have orange teeth: there's iron in them.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.vuursalamander: Fire salamanders love rain and wet stones.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.egel: A hedgehog has about 5000 spines. No cuddles without a glove.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.otter: Otters hold paws when they sleep, so they don't drift apart.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.das: A badger sett can be hundreds of years old.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.edelhert: A red deer grows new antlers every year.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.ooievaar: Storks clatter their beak to say hello.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.specht: A woodpecker taps up to 20 times a second. Tok tok tok!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.koala: Koalas sleep up to 22 hours a day. Even chonkier than a lion.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kangoeroe: A baby kangaroo is as big as a bean when it's born.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.wombat: Wombats make square droppings. Yes, really.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.quokka: The quokka is called the happiest animal in the world.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.prieelvogel: A male bowerbird decorates his bower with blue things.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.gouden_dikdik: A golden dik-dik? That doesn't exist. Except this one.

gui.guhs.safari.kabel.onderweg: The gondola is on its way. Wait on the platform!

gui.guhs.safari.kabel.blijf_zitten: Stay seated, chonk! It's very high up here.

gui.guhs.safari.kano.vrij: Your own canoe! W/S paddle, A/D steer. Sneak = get out.

gui.guhs.safari.ranger.bedankt: [Ranger Guh] Thanks for listening, chonk! Here are some Safari Coins.
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.bedankt_vol: [Ranger Guh] Thanks for listening! (You've earned enough coins from talks today.)
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.hoi: [Ranger Guh] Hi! Shh, not so loud, or the animals get scared. Vahoeg!

gui.guhs.safari.feit.entree.0: Welcome aboard the safari truck! Arms and paws inside the truck, chonk.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.entree.1: In the petting corner live a goat, an alpaca, a guinea pig and a donkey. They love cuddles.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.entree.2: The timetable board by the square shows when it's feeding time. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.entree.3: Every animal in this park is as sweet as a guh. Well, almost.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.savanne.0: Lions sleep up to 20 hours a day. We call that a chonky lion.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.savanne.1: A giraffe has as many neck bones as you: seven! Just a lot longer.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.savanne.2: Meerkats take turns standing guard. Look: one is always standing up!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.savanne.3: Every zebra has its own stripe pattern, just like your fingerprint.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.delta.0: Hippos can't swim: they just walk along the bottom. Super chonky.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.delta.1: Flamingos are pink because of what they eat. If you eat lots of cheese, do you turn yellow?
gui.guhs.safari.feit.delta.2: A capybara is the most relaxed rodent in the world. Anyone may sit on its back.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.delta.3: The manatee is related to the elephant. Really, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.regenwoud.0: A sloth only goes to the toilet once a week. Now that's taking it easy.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.regenwoud.1: The okapi looks like a zebra but is related to the giraffe. Very shy!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.regenwoud.2: Orangutans build a new bed of leaves in the tree every evening.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.regenwoud.3: Glow worms live behind the waterfall. They make their own light, like night lights.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.bamboe.0: A giant panda eats bamboo up to 12 hours a day. A real snack guh.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.bamboe.1: Red pandas use their thick tail as a blanket when it's cold.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.bamboe.2: Gibbons swing from branch to branch so fast it looks like they fly.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.bamboe.3: In the mist of the bamboo mountains you can hear the pandas munching. Listen!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.ijskust.0: Penguins can't fly, but they swim super fast. And slide on their bellies!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.ijskust.1: Under its white fur a polar bear is actually black. Funny, right?
gui.guhs.safari.feit.ijskust.2: Seals can close their nostrils under water.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.ijskust.3: If you're lucky you'll see the northern lights here at night. And maybe the narwhal...
gui.guhs.safari.feit.oertijd.0: Mammoths lived long ago, but here they're just staying for a while.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.oertijd.1: The sabre-toothed tiger has long teeth, but mostly uses them to smile.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.oertijd.2: In the warm springs the mammoths take a nice hot bath.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.oertijd.3: A woolly rhino wears its own winter coat. Always!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.europa.0: Beavers build dams from branches and mud. Real master builders!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.europa.1: A hedgehog has about 5000 spines. Don't pet it the wrong way!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.europa.2: Otters hold paws while they sleep, so they don't drift apart.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.europa.3: A badger lives in a sett with lots of little rooms. Cosy!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.australie.0: A kangaroo can't walk backwards. Only hop forwards!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.australie.1: Koalas sleep up to 18 hours a day. Almost as much as a chonky guh.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.australie.2: Wombat poop is square. Really, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.australie.3: The quokka is the happiest animal in the world. It's always smiling!

gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.regenwoud: the old pot in the temple ruin
gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.bamboe: the old teapot behind the pagoda
gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.ijskust: the barrel in the hold of the shipwreck
gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.oertijd: the fossil in the ice cave
gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.europa: the old ranger chest in the hollow oak
gui.guhs.safari.dexvol: Every animal in Safaripark Vadse Bergen is in your photos! You are the Safari King. VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.ranger: A guh sneaked into the park, dressed up as a zebra! He thinks nobody notices. Can you find him? He's probably hanging around the zebras on the savanna.
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.ranger_bezig: Found that dressed-up guh yet? He keeps hiding with different animals.
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.ranger_klaar: Stripey lives with you now? Good. Take good care of him, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.1: Chonk! I really am a zebra. Just look at my stripes! ...Okay, you got me. But you'll never catch me! *runs off to the bamboo*
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.2: I am a giant panda. I eat bamboo. Nom nom. ...Huh, you again?! *waddles off to the ice*
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.3: Penguins sure are cold here. Brrr. ...Okay okay, you win. Can I come home with you? I still have my zebra suit!
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.klaar: Stripey is your guh now! He's wearing his homemade zebra suit. +%s Safari coins
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.niet_nu: Psst! I'm just a %s, really. Nothing to see here. Chonk.
gui.guhs.safari.olifant.start: Pfff... Visitors secretly fed me snacks, and now I don't fit through my gate anymore. You can't be too chonky, you know... but I am a little too VAH. Will you help me with a diet? I'd like an apple, a carrot and a slice of melon.
gui.guhs.safari.olifant.loopband: That was nice and healthy! Now a little run on the elephant treadmill next to my stable. Click the treadmill a few times to cheer me on!
gui.guhs.safari.olifant.even: Dikkie is catching his breath. Wait just a moment...
gui.guhs.safari.olifant.klaar: Dikkie fits through his gate again! He is SO happy. +%s Safari coins
gui.guhs.safari.olifant.na: Look how slim I am! Well... a little. Thank you!
