emote.guhs.schrikken.description: Jumps back with his paws in the air. Nyeg, a crocodile!
emote.guhs.rechtop.description: Stands up on his hind paws and looks around, just like a meerkat.
gui.guhs.safari.dex.bewoners.uitleg: Every zone has a few animals with a name. See a name tag? Take a photo of it!
gui.guhs.safari.bewoner.gefotografeerd: You photographed %s! A famous resident of the park.
item.guhs.safari_pandaijsje.lore: Vanilla with chocolate ears. Nice and quick!
item.guhs.safari_pandaijsje.op: Mmm, panda ice cream! Your feet speed up all by themselves.
item.guhs.safari_zebrastreep.lore: Black, white, black, white... and hop!
item.guhs.safari_zebrastreep.op: Zebra Stripe! You jump like a happy zebra.
item.guhs.safari_pinguinijsje.lore: So cold it makes you swim.
item.guhs.safari_pinguinijsje.op: Brrr! You swim like a penguin now, njeg.
item.guhs.safari_flamingosorbet.lore: Pink, sweet, and you can see everything at night.
item.guhs.safari_flamingosorbet.op: Flamingo sorbet! Your eyes sparkle in the dark.
item.guhs.safari_marshmallow.lore: From the campfire. Crispy outside, vads inside.
gui.guhs.safari.ijsverkoper.hallo: Welcome to the Ice Cream Stand! I'm Melty. Every animal ice cream costs %1$s Safari coins (you have %2$s). What'll it be, vads?
gui.guhs.safari.ijsverkoper.arm: Oops, you don't have enough coins. An ice cream costs %s Safari coins. Take some nice photos and come back, njeg!
One panda ice cream! Careful, it's watching you with its chocolate eyes.
One zebra stripe! Or is it white with black stripes? Nobody knows.
One penguin ice cream! Eat it quickly, before it waddles off.
One flamingo sorbet! Eating it on one leg is allowed.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.welkom:
Come and sit down, vads, the fire is warm. Here, three marshmallows to roast. Listen...

%s
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.0: Once upon a time a giraffe wanted to whisper a secret. But by the time the secret got all the way down his neck, he had forgotten what it was. Now he just whispers "guh". Everybody thinks that's a fine secret.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.1: The penguins once threw a dance party. They danced all night, but nobody could tell it apart from walking. "That IS our dance," said the oldest penguin proudly.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.2: A hippo once tried to hide behind a single reed. Very still. VERY still. The ranger walked past three times and said: "Good morning, hippo." The hippo is still offended.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.3: The kangaroo once found a guh in her pouch. "How did you get in there?" she asked. "No idea," said the guh, "but it's warm and there are cookie crumbs." They are best friends now.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.4: The mammoth was too warm once. He wanted to take off his coat, but he couldn't, because he WAS his coat. Since then he lives in the Ice Age. Vahoeg, he says, much better.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.5: A zebra once walked past a freshly painted fence. Now she has one white stripe too many. Nobody noticed, except the zebra herself. She counts them every morning.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.6: The sloth started telling a joke on Monday. The punchline came on Friday. Everybody had forgotten the start, but they laughed anyway. That's how polite they are here.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.7: Once there was a panda who didn't feel like bamboo. "What do you want then?" asked the keeper. The panda thought for a very long time and said: "...bamboo." It was a long day.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.8: Every evening the flamingos hold a contest: who can stand on one leg the longest. There has never been a winner, because they all fall asleep at the same time. Njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.0: Shh! There, through my binoculars... a %s! It doesn't know I can see it. Hehe.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.1: I've been sitting here since breakfast. I just saw a %s. Or was it a bush? No, a %1$s after all. I think.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.2: Look, look! A %s! I already have seventeen photos. All a bit blurry, but with lots of love.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.3: My binoculars say: %s. My tummy says: lunch. I'm listening to the binoculars first.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.4: A %s! It just looked straight at me. I waved back very politely, vads.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.5: There goes a %s. Ten points for style and nine for waddling.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.hint.0: Psst... yesterday I saw a %s far, far away, in the %s. Rare, you know! Don't tell anyone. Except you.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.hint.1: Do you know what I've never seen? A %s. They say it hides in the %s. If you find it, will you tell me?
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.hint.2: Tip from an old watcher guh: whoever is quiet in the %2$s might see a %1$s. I'm never quiet. That's why I never see it.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.niks: I see... grass. Very nice grass, mind you. I'll wait a little longer, an animal is bound to come by.
gui.guhs.safari.melding.praatje: a ranger talk at the %s stop (%s)
gui.guhs.safari.melding.nacht: the night safari with lantern trucks (%s)
gui.guhs.safari.melding.parade: the penguin parade through the Ice Coast and the village (%s)
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.goed: Well done, vahoeg! +%s Safari coins for the clever one.
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.goed_vol: Well done! (Your quiz pot for today is already full, njeg.)
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.fout: Njeg, too bad! The right answer was: %s
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.te_laat: That question is over. There will be a new one at the next stop!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.instappen: All aboard! Look down through the glass bottom. You can get off at any jetty.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.onderweg: The glass-bottom boat is out on the water. Wait at the jetty, the next one comes soon!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.blijf_zitten: Stay seated, njeg! Or you'll get soaking wet.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.terug: Back at the jetty! You can get off here. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.delta.0: Look down! Those are the hippos. They can stay under water for 5 minutes.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.delta.1: Hippos don't really swim: they bounce along the bottom. Hop, hop!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.delta.2: See that manatee? It eats 50 kilos of water plants a day. Vads!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.ijskust.0: There, under the glass: penguins! Under water they almost fly, that fast.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.ijskust.1: The narwhal feels with its long tooth how cold and salty the water is. Clever, eh?
gui.guhs.safari.boot.ijskust.2: Penguins sometimes give each other a pretty pebble as a present. Njeg, how sweet!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.halte: %s jetty! You can get on and off here. Or just stay seated.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.savanne.0: The savanna is coming up! Watch the zebras coming to drink. Slurp, slurp!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.savanne.1: The lion family is sunbathing on Pride Rock. Don't wave too hard, they're asleep.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.savanne.2: An elephant drinks up to 200 litres of water a day. That's a lot of guh cups!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.regenwoud.0: The rainforest! Hear the monkeys? They're shouting at the boat. Njeg, what a racket!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.regenwoud.1: Below us fish swim between the tree roots. Look through the glass!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.regenwoud.2: It rains almost every day in the rainforest. Good thing the jetty has a roof.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.europa.0: We're sailing into the European Forest. The beavers build their dams here. Gnaw, gnaw!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.europa.1: See that fox between the trees? It's just as curious as a guh.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.europa.2: Beavers can stay under water for 15 minutes. Longer than the skipper!
gui.guhs.safari.fm.aan: ♪ Safari FM ♪ The park's own station! Wiggle along in the truck.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.0: Grandpa Cheeseguh's cheese nibbles: now with extra holes! The holes are free.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.1: Sand in your fur? Try Vads Shampoo! Now with the scent of wet zebra.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.2: Found: one pair of penguin sunglasses. It does look very cool now.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.3: Come to the Ostrich Race! Winners get eternal glory, losers just a little bit.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.4: Out of coins? Answer the quiz questions in the truck! The guide knows everything. Well, almost.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.5: New in the gift shop: a cuddly hippo that snores just as loud as the real one!
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.6: The weather: sunny on the savanna, snow on the ice coast and vahoeg everywhere.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.7: This was Safari FM. Don't forget to wave at the giraffe. It (almost) waves back!
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.entree.0.vraag: What is this safari park called?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.entree.1.vraag: What must you NOT do near the animals?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.entree.2.vraag: How do you ride through the park?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.savanne.0.vraag: What is the biggest land animal?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.savanne.1.vraag: Why does a zebra have stripes?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.savanne.2.vraag: How long is a giraffe's neck, roughly?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.delta.0.vraag: Where do hippos like to be during the day?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.delta.2.vraag: How does a crocodile cool down?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.delta.2.goed: It lies with its mouth open
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.regenwoud.2.vraag: Why is a poison dart frog so brightly coloured?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.regenwoud.2.goed: As a warning: don't eat me!
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.regenwoud.2.fout2: It just came from the hairdresser
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.bamboe.0.vraag: What does a giant panda eat almost all day?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.bamboe.1.vraag: How many hours a day does a panda eat, roughly?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.bamboe.2.vraag: What colour is a red panda?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.ijskust.0.goed: No, but they swim really well
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.ijskust.1.vraag: What is a narwhal's long 'horn' really?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.ijskust.2.vraag: Why doesn't a polar bear feel cold?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.ijskust.2.goed: A thick layer of fat and a warm coat
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.ijskust.2.fout2: It always sits by the stove
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.oertijd.0.vraag: How did a mammoth stay warm?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.oertijd.1.vraag: What did a mammoth use its tusks for?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.oertijd.1.goed: To push snow aside and find food
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.oertijd.2.vraag: Which ice age animal had very long fangs?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.europa.2.vraag: How do otters stay together while they sleep?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.australie.0.vraag: Where does a kangaroo carry her baby?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.australie.2.vraag: How far can a kangaroo jump in one leap?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.australie.2.fout2: All the way to the moon
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.ranger_2: He keeps hiding with different animals, so keep your eyes open. The top right of your screen shows where to look. Good luck, sniffer!
gui.guhs.safari.tracker.waar.zebra: with the zebras on the savanna
gui.guhs.safari.tracker.waar.reuzenpanda: with the giant pandas in the bamboo
gui.guhs.safari.tracker.waar.pinguin: with the penguins on the Ice Coast
gui.guhs.safari.tracker.start.vermomd: Not started yet. Talk to the head ranger in the entrance village.
gui.guhs.safari.tracker.start.olifant: Not started yet. Pay Dikkie a visit in his stable on the savanna.
gui.guhs.safari.dex.quests.uitleg: What you are doing now also shows in the top right of your screen while you are in the park.
gui.guhs.safari.guhdex_gekregen: You had no Guhdex yet, njeg! Here's one from the rangers: your Safari dex lives in it.
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.leeuw: Lions sleep up to 20 hours a day. Nice and chonky. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.luipaard: A leopard drags its food up a tree, so nobody steals it. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.olifant: Elephants recognise each other after years. They never forget a cuddle. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.neushoorn: A rhino horn is made of the same stuff as your nails. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kafferbuffel: Buffalo vote together which way the herd goes. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.dikdik: A dik-dik is only as big as a chonky cat. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.giraffe: A giraffe's tongue is bluish and up to 45 cm long. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zebra: No two zebras have the same stripes. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.stokstaartje: Meerkats take turns keeping watch. Always upright! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.jachtluipaard: The cheetah is the fastest land animal, but super sleepy after a sprint. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.struisvogel: An ostrich egg is as big as 24 chicken eggs. Giant omelette! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zeekoe: Manatees are related to... elephants! You can tell by the chonk. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.nijlpaard: Hippos can't swim: they walk along the bottom. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.flamingo: Flamingos are pink because of what they eat. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.capibara: Capybaras are friends with everyone. Really everyone. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.krokodil: A crocodile can stay under water for an hour, and smile at the same time. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.rode_panda: Red pandas use their fluffy tail as a blanket. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.reuzenpanda: A giant panda eats bamboo for about 12 hours a day. Vahoeg. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.gibbon: Gibbons sing a duet together in the morning. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.luiaard: Sloths only come down once a week to go to the toilet. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.okapi: The okapi looks like a zebra, but is related to the giraffe. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.orang_oetan: Orangutans build a new bed of leaves every evening. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.toekan: A toucan's beak is big, but very light. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.gekko: Geckos walk up walls thanks to tiny hairs on their toes. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.glimworm: Glow-worms make their tail glow to lure snacks. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.pinguin: Emperor penguins cuddle together against the cold: the huddle! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.ijsbeer: A polar bear has black skin under its white fur. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zeehond: Seals can sleep under water, with their nose shut. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.narwal: A narwhal's tusk can grow up to 3 metres long. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.octopus: An octopus has three hearts. Triple sweet! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.sabeltandtijger: Sabre-tooth tigers lived in the ice age. Luckily this one is sweet. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.mammoet: A mammoth had thick fur and a layer of fat: extra chonk. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.wolharige_neush: The woolly rhino pushed snow aside with its horn. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.bever: Beavers have orange teeth: there's iron in them. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.vuursalamander: Fire salamanders love rain and wet stones. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.egel: A hedgehog has about 5000 spines. No cuddles without a glove. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.otter: Otters hold paws when they sleep, so they don't drift apart. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.das: A badger sett can be hundreds of years old. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.edelhert: A red deer grows new antlers every year. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.ooievaar: Storks clatter their beak to say hello. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.specht: A woodpecker taps up to 20 times a second. Tok tok tok! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.koala: Koalas sleep up to 22 hours a day. Even chonkier than a lion. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kangoeroe: A baby kangaroo is as big as a bean when it's born. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.wombat: Wombats make square droppings. Yes, really. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.quokka: The quokka is called the happiest animal in the world. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.prieelvogel: A male bowerbird decorates his bower with blue things. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.gouden_dikdik: A golden dik-dik? That doesn't exist. Except this one. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.algemeen: Living here: %s! A real resident of the park. Don't tap on the glass, they don't find that chonky at all.
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.leeg: This board is still waiting for an animal. It's standing here very patiently, nyeg.
gui.guhs.safari.expert.kriebelhuis.nog: Ahem! Professor Kriebelguh, creepy-crawly connoisseur. *peers through magnifying glass* You've photographed %1$s of the %2$s Creepy-Crawly House species. %3$s to go! Look in the Night Hall too: they're awake by day in there, chonk.
gui.guhs.safari.expert.kriebelhuis.al: *peers through magnifying glass* Ah, a true creepy-crawly expert! Already %1$s of the %2$s species. Even found the stick insect? Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.expert.kriebelhuis.belon: *drops magnifying glass* All species of %s in your dex?! Fascinating! Here's your zone badge and 100 Safari Coins. I'm writing this in my notebook right away, chonk.
item.guhs.safari_verblijfsbord.terrarium: Place it and a little glass tank appears, with the creatures living inside. Cosy indoors too!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kameleon: A chameleon can look two ways at once with its little eyes.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.reuzenschildpad: Giant tortoises can live past 150. Slow and steady, chonk.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.slang: A snake smells with its tongue. That's why it keeps sticking it out.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.hoornkikker: A horned frog is almost all mouth. Chomp!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kraaghagedis: When a frilled lizard gets a fright, it opens its frill and runs off on two legs.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.gifkikker: Poison dart frogs are so brightly coloured to say: don't eat me!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.baardagaam: A bearded dragon waves its little paw to say hello.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.mier: An ant can lift 50 times its own weight. So strong!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.springspin: A jumping spider has eight eyes and jumps 50 times its own length.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.wandelende_tak: A stick insect sways to and fro, just like a twig in the wind.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.mestkever: A dung beetle navigates by the stars. Yes, by the Milky Way!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.slak: A snail has thousands of tiny teeth.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.vogelspin: A tarantula is fluffy like a plushie, but it doesn't like cuddles.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.hommel: A bumblebee buzzes so loud because it shivers its wings warm.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kiwi: A kiwi is the only bird with nostrils at the tip of its beak.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.schubdier: A pangolin rolls into a ball when it's scared. A living pine cone!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.spookdiertje: Each eye of a tarsier is bigger than its brain.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.plompe_lori: The slow loris does everything very, very, very slowly. Chonk to the bone.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.fruitvleermuis: Fruit bats sleep upside down, wrapped in their wings like a blanket.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.galago: A bushbaby jumps up to two metres high. Boing!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.suikereekhoorn: A sugar glider glides from tree to tree with a skin flap between its legs.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.fennek: With its giant ears a fennec fox can even hear a beetle walking under the sand.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zeepaardje: With seahorses, the dad has the babies. Nice for mum!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.pijlstaartrog: A stingray 'flies' under water with its big fins.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zeeschildpad: Sea turtles swim thousands of kilometres and always find their way back to their beach.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.clownvis: A clownfish lives safely among the stinging arms of an anemone.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kwal: Jellyfish have no brain, no heart and no bones. Very pretty though.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kogelvis: A pufferfish puffs up into a spiky ball when it's startled.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zeester: A starfish can grow back an arm. And the sea urchins are its best friends.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.babyhaai: Sharks have rows of teeth: when one falls out, the next one moves forward.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.regenboogvis: Rainbowfish swim in a school: together they turn like one big fish.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.lantaarnvisje: A lanternfish makes its own light, deep in the dark sea.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.dumbo_octopus: The Dumbo octopus flaps its little ears, just like the elephant from the film.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.pelikaan: A pelican's throat pouch holds more than its stomach. Gobble!

block.guhs.knabbelportaal.lore: A little cloud of pink cheese. Right-click: send your guhs into retirement in the Eternal Nibble Fields, or fetch them again.
item.guhs.knabbelportaal.lore: A little cloud of pink cheese. Right-click: send your guhs into retirement in the Eternal Nibble Fields, or fetch them again.
gui.guhs.band.plek.in_de_knabbelvelden: Retired in the Eternal Nibble Fields. nyeg, not dead at all, just retired!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.storing: The Nibble Fields are lost for a moment (a glitch). Try again later, nyeg.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.welkom: Welcome to the Eternal Nibble Fields! Your retired guhs nibble, nap and play here. Forever. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.beschermd: No breaking or building in the Nibble Fields: everything here is just right already. nyeg!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.te_ver: You are too far from the Nibble Portal.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.aangekomen: %s has arrived in the Eternal Nibble Fields. Enjoy your retirement!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.zakken_vol: Your pockets are full: %s is waiting for you at the portal.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.mee: %s is coming home with you! Put it down wherever you like. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.aai.1: %s purrs like a Cheese Nibble in the sun.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.aai.2: %s floats up a little, from sheer happiness.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.aai.4: %s gives you a ghost hug. Chilly, but sweet.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.vraag.uitleg: It goes into your pockets as a picked-up guh, with everything it has.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.melding.weg: %s guh(s) on their way to the Nibble Fields. Bye bye!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.melding.thuis: %s guh(s) back home! In your pockets (or at the portal).
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.melding.kwijt: A guh could not be found. Where has it gone this time?
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.niet.dood: Up in the clouds... nyeg. The Snuggleheart helps there, not the portal.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.niet.opgepakt: Picked up (an item somewhere). Put it down first.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.niet.weg: On holiday or at the office. Bring it back first.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.bezig.huisje: Lives in a Guh House. It moves out.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.bezig.guhwiel: Is running in a Guh Wheel. The wheel stops.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.bezig.guhkamer: Is staying in the Guh Room.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.bezig.rijdt: Is riding something or riding along.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.sub: Njeg, not gone for good, just retired! Pick guhs and other vadsjes and send them off or bring them back.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.leeg_thuis: You have no guhs at home. Tame one with Cheese Nibbles!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.leeg_velde: Nobody has retired yet. It is very quiet here.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.niks_gevon: No guh found with that name.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.kies: Click a guh to see everything about it.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.al_lang: Yours for a very long time
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.vraag.teks: These vadsjes are busy with something: %s
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.vraag.uitl: They stop and retire (out of their house, off the Guh Wheel, out of the chest they are kept in...).
item.guhs.bouwkeet_upgrade_guhrad.lore: Click a Building Shed: builder guhs and wireless materials. Little teeth, nyeg!
item.guhs.bouwkeet_upgrade_zout.lore: Click a Building Shed: nature shapes, the leveller and block text. Always straight, never crooked.
item.guhs.bouwkeet_upgrade_saus.lore: Click a Building Shed: paint machine, tunnel drill and publishing in the library.
item.guhs.bouwkeet_upgrade_gloei.lore: Click a Building Shed: shapes up to 64 big and... POOF!
item.guhs.bouwkeet_upgrade.naar: Makes a shed a %s (draws %s chonk power)
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.0: Shape wand and brushes, shapes up to 16, roofs, own blueprints up to 16, the library. Builds up to 64 blocks away
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.1: Builder guhs, shapes up to 24, wireless material from every chest on the vadsnet. Builds up to 96 blocks away
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.2: Nature shapes, the leveller, block text, blueprints up to 32. Builds up to 128 blocks away
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.3: Paint machine, tunnel drill, publishing in the library. Builds up to 160 blocks away
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.4: Shapes and blueprints up to 64, and Poof! Builds up to 192 blocks away
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bediening.uitleg: Move, turn or mirror the ghost, and see what you're still missing.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.loslaten.uitleg: The ghost stays, but this shed doesn't build it any more. That way you can pick a new project.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.geen_project: No project yet. Pick a shape, a roof or a blueprint, and the shed puts down a ghost of it.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bank_gekoppeld: The Bank Guh is linked: the shed takes blocks from it too.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.upgrade.al: This shed is already a %s or better.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.upgrade.eerst: First the shed has to become a %s.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.binnenkort.vormen:
Soon you'll pick a shape here: sphere, dome, tower, arch, heart, guh silhouette and lots more. Hollow or filled, with your own blocks.

Until then: try ghost building with the test hut!
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.binnenkort.daken: Soon you'll pick a roof here: gable roof, hip roof, tent roof or the guh ear roof.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.binnenkort.blauwdrukke: Soon your own blueprints, the catalogue and the server library will be here.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.proefhuisje.uitleg: A little pink guh house in front of the shed's door, to try ghost building.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bank.geen: No Bank Guh linked (click the shed with a Bank Key).
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bank.ja: Bank Guh linked: the shed takes blocks from it.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bank.kwijt: The linked Bank Guh isn't anywhere any more.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.draadloos.ja: Wireless materials: %s chests on the chonk net
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.draadloos.nee: Wireless materials: from the Guh Wheel Shed (with chonk power)
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.vk.ja: Draws %s chonk power: the shed is running!
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.vk.nee: Wants %s chonk power but gets none: it works as handiwork.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.uitleg: Pick up to %s of your own guhs as builder guhs. Working now: %s.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.vanaf: Builder guhs come with the Guh Wheel Shed (with chonk power). Then they put on a little helmet and build along!
gui.guhs.bouwguh.geen: None of your own guhs near the shed.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.kan_niet: That won't work: four builder guhs already, or that guh is too far away.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.praat.1: %s whistles a tune... %s blocks to go.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.praat.2: %s: wahoog, this is going to be pretty! %s to go.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.praat.3: %s nudges a block straight. %s to go.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.pof.onder: There it is, all at once.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.status.0: A ghost: move it into place and press Build!
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.terug.uitleg: Undoes your last building action (the last 5). The blocks you used come back, and so does what stood there.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.weg.uitleg: Removes the ghost. What's already built stays.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.alsnog.vraag: You don't have all the blocks. Build anyway? What's missing stays a ghost until you have it.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.vriend.erbij: This player may touch the ghost too
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.vriend.eraf: This player may no longer touch it
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.te_ver: You're too far from the ghost.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.mist: Done, but %s blocks were missing: they stay a ghost. Press Build! again later.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.nee.te_veel: You already have ten ghosts open. Build or remove one first.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.nee.beschermd: No building here: this is a protected building.
gui.guhs.safari.kriebelhuis.balie.hallo: Welcome to the Kriebelhuis! Tickets are free, tickles too. First the terrarium, then the Kriebelzaal, the Nachtzaal (shh, some critters are sleeping) and the Diepzeezaal. Don't miss the pink tunnel, njeg!
gui.guhs.safari.kriebelhuis.winkel.hallo: A tickly welcome to the shop! Have a look around.
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kameleon: A chameleon can look two ways at once with its little eyes. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.reuzenschildpad: Giant tortoises can live past 150. Slow and steady, chonk. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.slang: A snake smells with its tongue. That's why it keeps sticking it out. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.hoornkikker: A horned frog is almost all mouth. Chomp! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kraaghagedis: When a frilled lizard gets a fright, it opens its frill and runs off on two legs. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.gifkikker: Poison dart frogs are so brightly coloured to say: don't eat me! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.baardagaam: A bearded dragon waves its little paw to say hello. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.mier: An ant can lift 50 times its own weight. So strong! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.springspin: A jumping spider has eight eyes and jumps 50 times its own length. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.wandelende_tak: A stick insect sways to and fro, just like a twig in the wind. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.mestkever: A dung beetle navigates by the stars. Yes, by the Milky Way! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.slak: A snail has thousands of tiny teeth. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.vogelspin: A tarantula is fluffy like a plushie, but it doesn't like cuddles. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.hommel: A bumblebee buzzes so loud because it shivers its wings warm. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kiwi: A kiwi is the only bird with nostrils at the tip of its beak. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.schubdier: A pangolin rolls into a ball when it's scared. A living pine cone! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.spookdiertje: Each eye of a tarsier is bigger than its brain. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.plompe_lori: The slow loris does everything very, very, very slowly. Chonk to the bone. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.fruitvleermuis: Fruit bats sleep upside down, wrapped in their wings like a blanket. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.galago: A bushbaby jumps up to two metres high. Boing! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.suikereekhoorn: A sugar glider glides from tree to tree with a skin flap between its legs. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.fennek: With its giant ears a fennec fox can even hear a beetle walking under the sand. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zeepaardje: With seahorses, the dad has the babies. Nice for mum! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.pijlstaartrog: A stingray 'flies' under water with its big fins. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zeeschildpad: Sea turtles swim thousands of kilometres and always find their way back to their beach. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.clownvis: A clownfish lives safely among the stinging arms of an anemone. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kwal: Jellyfish have no brain, no heart and no bones. Very pretty though. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kogelvis: A pufferfish puffs up into a spiky ball when it's startled. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zeester: A starfish can grow back an arm. And the sea urchins are its best friends. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.babyhaai: Sharks have rows of teeth: when one falls out, the next one moves forward. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.regenboogvis: Rainbowfish swim in a school: together they turn like one big fish. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.lantaarnvisje: A lanternfish makes its own light, deep in the dark sea. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.dumbo_octopus: The Dumbo octopus flaps its little ears, just like the elephant from the film. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.pelikaan: A pelican's throat pouch holds more than its stomach. Gobble! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.geitje: Little goats climb on everything, even on other little goats. The higher, the chonkier. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.alpaca: An alpaca only spits when it's really cross. Mostly it's just very fluffy. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.cavia: Happy guinea pigs do little jumps in the air. That's called 'popcorning'! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.ezeltje: Little donkeys remember places and friends for a very long time, sometimes 25 years. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.anemoon: An anemone looks like a flower, but it's an animal! The clownfish lives safely in between. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zee_egel: A sea urchin walks on hundreds of tiny feet, very slowly across the bottom. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.critter.blijft: This little critter lives here in the Kriebelhuis. Looking is fine, taking it home isn't, nyeg!
item.guhs.vormstaf.lore: Click a block: your shape stands there as a ghost. Sneak-click: that block becomes your material. Hold the Shape Wand key for the menu.
item.guhs.vervangkwast.lore: Repaints blocks into your own block, in the same shape (a stair stays a stair). Sneak-click: pick the block.
item.guhs.mengkwast.lore: A mix of up to four blocks (70/20/10). Sneak-click blocks to add them to the mix.
item.guhs.patroonkwast.lore: Stripes, checkerboard, gradient, little guh faces. Animal patterns open once that animal is in your safari dex.
item.guhs.verweerkwast.lore: Moss, cracks and ivy: makes everything a little old and cosy.
item.guhs.egaliseerder.lore: Flatten, a slope, a pit or pond, or a hill. Works from a Salt Shed.
item.guhs.verfmachine.lore: Recolours wool, concrete and terracotta in one go, even as a rainbow gradient. Works from a Sauce Shed.
item.guhs.tunnelboor.lore: Round, square or vaulted, lined and with little lamps. No mining mode, just a pretty tunnel. From a Sauce Shed.
item.guhs.blauwdruk.lore: Click a block: the design stands there as a ghost. Never runs out.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.gekoppeld: Linked to this shed (%s). Your tool now works at its level!
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.geen_keet: Sneak-click a Building Shed to link (otherwise: handiwork)
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vanaf: Works from a %s (link it to such a shed)
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.dicht.natuur: Nature shapes come with a Salt Shed, chonk.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.dicht.bloktekst: Block text comes with a Salt Shed, chonk.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.dicht.dex: Photograph this animal in the safari park first (Guhdex), then you may use its pattern!
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.kwast.kies_blok: Pick a block first: sneak-click it with the brush.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.kwast.kies_mix: Pick blocks first: sneak-click them with the brush (up to four).
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.kwast.kies_twee: This pattern needs at least two blocks in the mix.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.kies: Pick a block from your hotbar (or offhand):
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.kies.uitleg: Pick a block from your hotbar. Or sneak-click a block in the world with the tool.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.plaats_spook.uitleg: Puts it in front of the shed's door as the project. Then: move, turn, Build!
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.rond.uitleg: scroll: size · shift: height · ctrl: thickness · H: hollow
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bezig: The shed is still building. Wait a moment, or pause first.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.vormstaf: Click a block to put your shape down as a ghost. Sneak-click a block: wall material.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.vervangkwast: Every click repaints a little ball of blocks into your block, in the same shape.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.mengkwast: Every click paints a little ball of blocks in your mix (70/20/10).
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.patroonkwast: Every click paints a pattern. Animal patterns colour wool, concrete and terracotta.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.verweerkwast: Every click makes it old: moss, cracks, ivy.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.egaliseerder: Click the ground: the new terrain stands there as a ghost. Look at it, then press Build!
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.verfmachine: Click in the middle of your build: all wool, concrete and terracotta around it gets a new colour.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.tunnelboor: Click a wall: the tunnel goes the way you look. Sneak-click a block: lining.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.hoek1: First corner: %s, %s, %s. Now click the other corner.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.uitleg: You see the pink frame in the world. Empty spots inside the building come along.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.te_groot: Too big! This level allows up to %s blocks.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.leeg: There's nothing in the frame, chonk.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.vol: You already have %s blueprints. Throw one away first (Design Desk).
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.bewaard: Blueprint "%s" saved (%s blocks)! You'll find it in the Building Shed and at the Design Desk.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.leeg.eigen: No own blueprints yet. Set your Shape Wand to Capture and click your nicest build!
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.leeg.bibliotheek: Nothing published on this server yet. Be the first (from a Sauce Shed)!
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.plaats.uitleg: Becomes this shed's project: a ghost in front of the door.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.print.uitleg: A blueprint to take along (costs a sheet of paper). Click a block with it, anywhere.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.papier: You need a sheet of paper to print.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.weg: Throw away (only your own, or as op)
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.kwijt: This blueprint doesn't exist any more. Thrown away?
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.bureau.uitleg: You publish in a Building Shed (from a Sauce Shed).
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.uitleg: Publish in the server's library, with your name on it!
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.vanaf: Publishing comes with a Sauce Shed (and no bigger than the shed allows).
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.te_groot: Too big for this shed: it allows up to %s.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.ok: Published! Everyone on the server can build it now.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.vol: You already have %s in the library. Remove one first.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.al: That one is in the library already, chonk.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.winkel.uitleg: Build this park building at home: a blueprint you can put down anywhere.
item.guhs.pastelbaksteen_wolkje_vplaat: Cloud Grey Pastel Brick Vertical Slab
item.guhs.pastelbaksteen_muisgrijs_vplaa: Mouse Grey Pastel Brick Vertical Slab
item.guhs.pastelbaksteen_hemelsblauw_vpl: Sky Blue Pastel Brick Vertical Slab
item.guhs.dakpan_kersrood_vplaat: Cherry Red Roof Tile Vertical Slab
item.guhs.dakpan_hemelsblauw_vplaat: Sky Blue Roof Tile Vertical Slab
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.hallo: Hi! I'm the ranger of Beaver Brook. That's Spaander over there, my beaver. Want to know something, njeg?
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.aaien: Of course! Spaander loves a good pat. But he lives here with me: no taking him along and no taming. Want beavers of your own? At Safaripark Vadse Bergen you can get an enclosure sign for them.
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.bus: Safaripark Vadse Bergen? The safari bus goes there, from a bus station here in the Guhmension. Check your Superkompas, or ask a travel guh. Lots more beavers live there, at a real beaver lodge!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.0: A beaver can gnaw down a little tree in a single night. Its teeth are orange from the iron in them: rock hard, njeg!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.1: Behind a beaver dam the water can't run away, so a pool forms. In it they build their lodge, with the front door under water. Clever, vads!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.2: Suddenly hear a SPLAT? That's a beaver slapping the water with its flat tail. It means: watch out, everybody inside!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.3: A beaver can stay under water for a whole quarter of an hour. I can't even manage ten seconds.
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.4: Beavers don't eat fish, you know. Bark, leaves and water plants: a nibbling vegetarian!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.5: Their fur is so thick their skin never gets wet. They comb it with a split little claw on their hind foot.
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.6: A beaver family works on one dam together, year after year. Just like a building crew of guhs!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.7: See gnawed little stumps and paw prints? A beaver came by there. Just follow them to the water.
gui.guhs.beverbeek.aai.3: Spaander nibbles your sleeve for a moment. Sweet!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.klaar: The %1$s family is done: %2$s! Come and see.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.transport.start: The kangaroo gets going: hop hop, from chest to chest!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.sjouwen.start: The elephant starts carrying for the Bouwkeet!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.bank_gekoppeld: Bank Guh linked: the family also takes its blocks from the bank.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.wijs.een: Close the menu and click the spot for the job with the vormstaf.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.wijs.twee: Close the menu and click two points with the vormstaf (first A, then B).
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.wijs.uitleg: The menu closes. Then click with a shape wand on the block (or the 2 blocks) where the job should go, within 48 blocks of the sign. You have 2 minutes.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.herbereken.uitleg: Moved the ghost? Then they work it out again at that spot.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.grootte.0: Grumpy family: they build it small.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.grootte.1: Content family: they build it normal.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.grootte.2: Happy family: they build it big and extra pretty!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.onderweg: On a work outing to the job: %s
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.status.spook: Ghost ready: %s. Press Bouw! in the ghost.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.bank.nee: No Bank Guh (click the board with a Banksleutel).
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.verblijf.uitleg: Puts a proposal down as a ghost: an enclosure with everything this animal loves, with a fence around it. Nothing is built yet. Like it? Choose Approved: the animals build it themselves, with your blocks (from your inventory and the linked Bank Guh).
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.al_bezig: This family is already on a job. One job per board, chonk!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_water: Nothing flows here, njeg. Let the digging crew dig a stream first.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.te_breed: That water is too wide to cross. Find a narrower bit.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_plek: There is no flat spot near here.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.te_scheef: It's too uneven here. Let an elephant stamp it flat first.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_heuvel: There's no hill here to dig into.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_omgevalle: There are no fallen trees here.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.al_vlak: It's nice and flat here already!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_tweede_bo: There's no second tree 5 to 20 blocks away.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.wijs_aan: Point out a spot yourself with the vormstaf.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.wijs_aan_twee: Point out two points yourself with the vormstaf.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.niets_te_doen: Nothing left to do there: it's done already!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_gras: There's no grass here to plant on.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.te_ver: Too far away: a job may be up to 48 blocks from the board.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.twee_kisten: Point out two chests (first the one to take from, then the one to put into).
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.andere_helper: Another family is already working there. One helper at a time!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.te_klein: That wall is too small for wood carving.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_kamer: That's not a room: point out the floor of a space with walls and a ceiling.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_muur: Point out a wall with air in front of it.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_tunnel: Point out a tunnel, cave or cellar (underground).
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_soort: This animal doesn't know what it needs.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.dam: The beavers find the narrowest spot of a stream, build a dam there and the water behind it rises into a beaver pond.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.burcht: A beaver lodge in the water: a heap of sticks and mud with a dry room and a front door under water.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.brug: A wooden bridge over the narrowest bit of water, with railings.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.steiger: A jetty from the shore into the water, with little lanterns at the end.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.vlonder: A boardwalk along the shore, above the water.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.kappen: The beavers gnaw the trees down. Cosy little stumps stay behind.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.kelder: A cellar underground, with a ladder down and a little light.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.tunnel: A tunnel into the hill, with wooden beams and lanterns.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.vijver: A pond, level with the ground, with water lilies.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.holletjesne: A burrow network: little rooms underground with tunnels and two exits.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.beekje: A little stream running down the hill, with a gravel bed.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.sjouwen: The elephant carries for a Bouwkeet nearby: that project goes faster.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.opruimen: The elephant clears away fallen trees.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.stampen: The elephant stamps the ground flat.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.slopen: The demolition crew takes a building or a boulder away. Point it out with the vormstaf.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.zebrapad: The herd walks a path from the board to a spot, over the terrain.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.planten: Plant trees, bushes, flowers or an orchard.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.boomhut: A treehouse in a tree, with a ladder and a little roof.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.touwbrug: A rope bridge between two trees.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.hangbrug: A suspension bridge that sags a little in the middle.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.iglo: An igloo with an ice window and a little entrance tunnel.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.ijsglijbaan: An ice slide with a ladder up.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.ijssculptuu: An ice sculpture of a guh!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.ijsvloer: The water freezes into an ice floor.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.badje: A warm bath with a little campfire next to it.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.hottub: A round hot tub with a stone rim.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.stapstenen: Stepping stones to cross the water.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.modderglijb: A mud slide into the water. Wheee!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.oever: Pink flowers, reed and water lilies along the shore.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.sneeuwschui: The mammoth pushes the snow away, into little heaps at the edge.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.sneeuwlaag: The mammoth lays a layer of snow.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.buideltrans: The kangaroo hops things from one chest to another.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.houtsnijwer: The woodpecker taps a pattern into a wooden wall.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.inrichten: The octopus furnishes a room. Point out the floor.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.slingers: The gibbon hangs garlands between two points.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.gevel: The gecko livens up a facade: ivy and flower pots under the windows.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.licht: The glow-worms light up a tunnel, cave or cellar with a soft glow.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.decoreren: The bowerbird decorates a spot in a colour theme.
gui.guhs.safari.guhziet.eng.1: %1$s: Uhh... that %2$s is looking at me.
gui.guhs.safari.guhziet.eng.2: %1$s: I'm not scared of that %2$s at all. Only a teeny bit.
gui.guhs.safari.guhziet.groot.0: %1$s: Njeg, a %2$s! Even chonkier than me!
gui.guhs.safari.guhziet.groot.2: %1$s: A %2$s! Can I ride it? No? Okay.
gui.guhs.safari.guhziet.baby.1: %1$s: Look, a baby %2$s! Can it come home with us?
gui.guhs.safari.foto.nacht: in the dark, with glowing eyes
gui.guhs.safari.dex.schilderij.tip: Your best photo as a painting to hang up (2 sheets of paper).
gui.guhs.safari.schilderij.papier: You need %s sheets of paper for a painting.
gui.guhs.safari.schilderij.klaar: A painting of your %s! Hang it up nicely.
painting.guhs.safari_foto.title: My safari photo: %s
painting.guhs.safari_foto.author: A photo from Safari Park Vadse Bergen
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.speelgoed: For your home animals: it makes them happy.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.hangmat.0: Zzz... huh? Oh, g'day mate! Nothing going on, I'm testing this hammock. For three weeks now. Beauty of a hammock.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.hangmat.1: No worries, mate. Koalas sleep twenty hours a day. I do twenty-one. I win.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.hangmat.2: Strewth, is it noon already? Wake me when the kangaroos do something exciting. Zzz...
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.post.0: G'day! Sending a postcard? No worries, mate. The last one never arrived, by the way... it must still be lying around here somewhere.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.post.1: Mail for the wombats? Nah, they just dig a tunnel to the neighbours. Easy as.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.post.2: Quiet day, mate. It's always a quiet day. Fair dinkum.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.kamp.0: G'day! Have a seat by the fire. In the evening the wombats potter about here, if you're quiet.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.kamp.1: Know what a billabong is, mate? A little pond where the kangaroos come to drink. Over there by the windmill!
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.kamp.2: Crikey, what stars tonight. Out in the outback you see them all. Even that one that looks like a guh.
painting.guhs.safari_kriebelhuis.title: Creepy-crawly friends (2×1)
gui.guhs.safari.bus.chauffeur.hallo: Hello, vads! I'm Toeter, driver of the Guh Safari Bus. It's free and it's yellow. Fancy a ride to Safari Park Vadse Bergen?
gui.guhs.safari.bus.chauffeur.straks.ant: Fine, I'll wait here. I still have a nibble anyway.
gui.guhs.safari.bus.instappen: You get on the Guh Safari Bus...
gui.guhs.safari.bus.storing: The bus won't start. Try again in a moment, njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.bus.al_bezig: Hold on, you're already watching a scene.
gui.guhs.safari.bus.guhs_mee: %s of your guhs ride along on the roof.
gui.guhs.safari.bus.niet_bouwen: This bus station belongs to everyone: no breaking or building here.
commands.guhs.safari.busstation.nee: No bus station fits here (too steep or no room). Try a flatter spot.
commands.guhs.safari.busstation.geen: No bus station found within %s blocks.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.titel: By Guh Safari Bus to the park
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.weg: Seatbelts on, snout forward! Off we go, vads!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.savanne: Smell that? That's the savanna. Or my lunch. Both tasty.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.zebra: Njeg, hold on! Zebras always have right of way.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.poort: Look, the elephant gate! Welcome to Safari Park Vadse Bergen!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.uitstappen: Last stop! Get off on the cuddly side. Have fun, and don't feed the animals without asking!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.grap: Do you know why the zebra has stripes? So it doesn't get lost in the barcode shop. Njeg.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_1.titel: By Guh Safari Bus to the park
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_1.weg: Seatbelts on, snout forward! Off we go, vads!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_1.savanne: Smell that? That's the savanna. Or my lunch. Both tasty.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_1.zebra: Njeg, hold on! Zebras always have right of way.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_1.poort: Look, the elephant gate! Welcome to Safari Park Vadse Bergen!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_1.uitstappen: Last stop! Get off on the cuddly side. Have fun, and don't feed the animals without asking!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_1.grap: Did you know a flamingo turns pink from what it eats? I mostly eat cheese nibbles. Just look at my cheeks.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_2.titel: By Guh Safari Bus to the park
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_2.weg: Seatbelts on, snout forward! Off we go, vads!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_2.savanne: Smell that? That's the savanna. Or my lunch. Both tasty.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_2.zebra: Njeg, hold on! Zebras always have right of way.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_2.poort: Look, the elephant gate! Welcome to Safari Park Vadse Bergen!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_2.uitstappen: Last stop! Get off on the cuddly side. Have fun, and don't feed the animals without asking!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_2.grap: An elephant never forgets. I always forget where I parked the bus. Luckily it's yellow.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_terug.titel: By Guh Safari Bus back home
scene.guhs.safari_bus_terug.zon: The sun is already setting behind the thatched lodge. What a day, huh?
structure.guhs.safari_busstation.tooltip: The free safari bus leaves here for Safari Park Vadse Bergen (Guhmension)
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.bus.richting: Safari Park Vadse Bergen? The safari bus goes there! The nearest bus station is about %1$s blocks to the %2$s. Your Superkompas points to it too, under Knus. Lots more beavers live there, at a real beaver lodge!
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.familie.uitleg: The four animals of this sign: their names, how they feel, call them back or let them hide.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.verblijf.uitleg: How big the enclosure is (the animals stay inside), show its edge and where they sleep at night.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.tevreden.uitleg: How happy the family is and what they still want. Hover over a line for help.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.cadeautjes.uitleg: Happy animals sometimes leave a gift. Collect them here.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.info.uitleg: A fact about this animal, your best photo and when you may buy a sign of this species again.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.bouw.uitleg: Let the family build something: they look at the terrain themselves and build something that fits.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.bezorgen.uitleg: The stork brings parcels to a friend's stork mailbox.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.niet_jouw: This sign belongs to %s: you may only look.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.al_klus: This sign already has a job: %s. Stop it first (Build Job tab, Stop). A sign does one job at a time.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.al_voorstel: There is a proposal already: %s. Approve or cancel it first (Happiness tab).
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.geen_slaapplek: No sleeping spot has been chosen yet.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.geen_cadeaus: No gifts yet. Happy animals (60% or more) leave one now and then.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.geen_vrienden: Nobody else has placed a stork mailbox yet.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.geen_bestemming: First choose who the parcel is for.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.geen_spook: This job has no ghost (the animals only carry or deliver): there is nothing to move.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.bouwt_al: The ghost is already being built. Pause it first in the ghost panel.
gui.guhs.verblijf.hernoem.veld.uitleg: Type a name (empty = no name). Then click Name.
gui.guhs.verblijf.hernoem.uitleg: Gives this animal the name from the box. You see it above its head.
gui.guhs.verblijf.terugroepen.uitleg: All animals come straight back to the sign, also when they are hiding.
gui.guhs.verblijf.verstoppen.uitleg: The animals hide for 20 seconds (handy when you want to build). Then they come back by themselves, or earlier with Call back.
gui.guhs.verblijf.vorm.uitleg: Switch between a round and a rectangular enclosure.
gui.guhs.verblijf.schuif.uitleg: Drag to make the enclosure bigger or smaller. You see the new edge straight away.
gui.guhs.verblijf.rand.uitleg: Shows the enclosure's edge with pink dust on the ground (2 minutes, or until you hide it). The animals stay inside that edge.
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.wijs.uitleg: The menu closes. Walk to the spot and right-click a block inside the enclosure: that is where the animals sleep at night. Click the sign to stop.
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.wijs.begin: Right-click a block inside the enclosure: that is where they sleep at night. (Click the sign to stop; you have 2 minutes.)
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.wijs.gestopt: Stopped pointing at a sleeping spot.
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.gezet: Sleeping spot chosen at %s. Sleep well!
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.weghalen.uit: Without a sleeping spot the animals sleep wherever they are.
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.geen: No sleeping spot yet: they sleep where they are.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tevreden.hover: Hover over a line to see how to tick it.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.water: Have at least %s blocks of water inside the edge (dig, then pour a bucket of water in).
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.blokken: Put at least %s of these blocks inside the edge: %s.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.waar: Everything inside the edge counts, from 6 blocks below to 10 above the sign.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.ruimte: Make the enclosure bigger: a radius of at least 12, or a rectangle of at least 8 by 8 (Enclosure tab).
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.geaaid: Pet one of the animals today: right-click with an empty hand.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.speeltje: Put a %s within 8 blocks inside the enclosure. Sold in the safari gift shop (Animal toys), or craft it.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.vrienden: Place an enclosure sign of a friend within 24 blocks of this sign: %s.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voer.traktatie: Treats (feeding is optional: they feed themselves): %s. A treat gives hearts.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.klaar: There is the proposal (the ghost). Look around and choose Approved or Cancel in the sign.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.uitleg: The proposal stands there as a ghost. Like it? Choose Approved: the animals walk over and build it with your blocks. If something is missing, they build what is there and the rest stays a ghost.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.annuleren.uit: Removes the proposal. Nothing was built or paid yet.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.goed.uitleg: The family goes on a work outing and builds the enclosure themselves, block by block. The blocks come from your inventory and the linked Bank Guh.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.tekort: Not everything is there yet (the rest stays a ghost until you have it): %s
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.gaan: Work outing! The %s family is going to build the enclosure.
gui.guhs.verblijf.cadeautjes.pak.uitleg: All gifts go to your inventory (full? then they drop on the ground).
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.kies.uitleg: Click to choose the next friend with a stork mailbox.
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.stuur.uitleg: The stork takes the items from a chest next to the sign and flies to your friend's stork mailbox.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.variant.uitleg: Click for the next variant of this job.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.zoek.uitleg: The family looks for a good spot themselves (within 48 blocks of the sign) and puts the job down as a ghost. You can still move it after.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.bedien.uitleg: Opens the ghost panel: move, turn, build or pause.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.stop.uitleg: Stops the job: the ghost goes (what is built stays) and the family comes home.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.bank.uitleg: Click the sign with a Bank Key to link a Bank Guh: the family then also takes their blocks from the bank.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.bereik.buiten: Careful: part of the building (%s blocks, red) is outside the shed's reach (%s blocks). That part is not built.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.bereik.buiten.klaar: Part of the building (%s blocks) is outside the shed's reach (%s blocks): it stays a ghost.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.bereik.tip: Tip: a higher shed level has a bigger reach. Or move the ghost closer to the shed.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.bereik.tip.volgend: Tip: move it closer to the shed, or upgrade the shed: the next level builds up to %s blocks away.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.bereik.tip.max: Tip: move it closer to the shed.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.nodig.hover: Hover over a block for its name.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.lijstje.uitleg: Export to a list: you get a book with every block that is still missing (name and count). Handy at the crafting table.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.lijstje.niets.uitleg: Nothing is missing (in creative it builds for free).
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.lijstje.gegeven: The shopping list is in your inventory.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.raster.uitleg: Click a tile. Grey = still locked (hover to see why).
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.raster.knop: Click: choose from all options. Shift-click: one back.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bouw.uitleg: Let the shed build the ghost. If something is missing, it first asks whether to build anyway (what's missing stays a ghost).
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.pauze.uitleg: Pauses the building. Build! goes on.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niet_jouw.uitleg: This is not your shed: only the owner may build.
commands.guhs.safari.kaartwand: Map wall: the %s maps go back on the wall as soon as the entrance hall is loaded
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.alles_er: All blocks are there! (from your inventory and the linked Bank Guh)
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.lijstje.uitle: Gives you a booklet with every block still missing for this proposal: the exact name and how many. Handy next to the crafting table.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.niets_nodig: Nothing is missing: all blocks are there.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.later: %1$s is in the pockets of %2$s, who is not online now. As soon as %2$s logs in, %1$s comes to you!
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.wereld: %s is walking around somewhere. It drops everything and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.zit: %s is sitting somewhere (you told it to sit). It gets up and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.huisje: Note: %s lives in its Guh House now. If you call it, it moves out of the house: its spot and its chores there are gone.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.slaapt_in_h: Note: %s is asleep in its Guh House. It wakes up and moves out of the house: its spot and its chores there are gone.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.rijdt_op: %1$s is being ridden. The rider gets off and %1$s comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.rijdt_mee: %s is riding along on something. It gets off and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.item_speler: Note: %s is a picked-up guh in a player's pockets. It leaves those pockets and comes to you. If that player is not online, it comes as soon as they log in.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.item_kist: Note: %s is a picked-up guh in a chest now. It leaves the chest and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.item_rugzak: Note: %s is a picked-up guh in another guh's backpack. It leaves the backpack and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.item_bank: Note: %s is a picked-up guh in a Bank Guh. It leaves the Bank Guh and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.item_grond: %s is lying on the ground as a picked-up guh. It jumps up and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.guhwiel: Note: %s is running in a Guh Wheel now. If you call it over, the wheel stops and makes no more vadskracht.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.guhkamer: %s is staying in the Guh Room. It checks out and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.schouder: %s is sitting on someone's shoulder. It jumps off and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.in_guh: %s is inside another guh. It comes out and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.onbekend: We don't know exactly where %s is. We'll look for it; if we can't find it, you'll hear.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.in_de_wolkj: %s is in the little clouds. Calling won't help, but the Cuddle Heart will.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.bij_jou: %s was already with you. It comes a little closer.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.op_vakantie: Note: %s is on holiday (Travel Agency). If you call it now, it cuts its trip short: no postcard and no souvenir.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.op_kantoor: Note: %s is at work in the office. It clocks out right away; you still get the pay for the shifts it already finished.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.bezig.opgepakt: Picked up and kept somewhere (see below). It is taken out first.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.beverguh: Rarity: Only in the Beaver Brook
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.beverguh: A chestnut-brown guh with two orange buck teeth and a flat scaly tail. Nibbles anything made of wood (your door too, sorry vads). Lives in the Beaver Brook among the beavers. Tame it with cheese nibbles, njeg!
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.verloren: %s lay on the ground as a parcel, but the parcel is gone (burned or lost). Njeg... It is in the clouds now: bring it back with the Cuddle Heart!
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.knop.uitl: Choose who lives in this family: a parent or a little one for each animal (and whether a parent is a male or a female). Who changes is swapped with a puff; there are always four.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.uitleg: Choose for each animal whether it is a parent or a little one, and whether a parent is a male or a female. With the %s, males and females look the same.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.uitleg.ge: Choose for each animal whether it is a parent or a little one, and whether a parent is a male or a female: with the %s you can see the difference.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.ouder_kin: Click to switch between a parent (grown-up) and a little one.
Click to switch between a male and a female. Two males or two females is fine too.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.wissel: Who you change is swapped with a puff. Its name stays.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.klaar.uit: The family is put together like this. Who changes is swapped; there are always four.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.annuleren: Back to the sign; the family stays as it is. You can always change it later with Put the family together on the Family tab.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.reden.gee: There has to be at least one parent in the family.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.ongeldig: That can't be: a family has at least one parent.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.grotguh: Rarity: Only deep in the caves of the Guhmension
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.grotguh: A deep pink guh with tiny crystal specks in its fur that twinkle softly in the dark. Lives under the wool, most of all in the Glitter Cavern. See something twinkling in a cave? Chances are it's a Cave Guh, njeg! Tame it with cheese nibbles.
block.guhs.lapiserts_kristal: Guh Crystal Stone Lapis Lazuli Ore
block.guhs.kaasknabbelerts_kristal: Guh Crystal Stone Cheese Nibble Ore
block.guhs.kaaskorrelerts_kristal: Guh Crystal Stone Cheese Crumb Ore
block.guhs.knuffelnaad.lore: The seam at the very bottom of the Guhmension. You can't get through it, nyeg.
block.guhs.guhklei.lore: Drops clay balls (bake those into bricks). Smelt the block itself into pink terracotta.
block.guhs.glitterrank_bes.lore: Right-click to pick the glitter berries.
block.guhs.pluiskussen.lore: Soft landing: no fall damage and a tiny bounce.
block.guhs.kristalpegel.lore: Hangs and stands just like dripstone. The tips drip a little cheese sauce. Mind your head!
block.guhs.knuffelwortelaarde.lore: Use bone meal and snuggleroots grow underneath.
block.guhs.belletjeskristal.lore: Plays a little note when you step on it or hit it. Every spot has its own note: play a song!
block.guhs.belletjestrosje.lore: Click it and it tinkles. Every spot has its own note.
block.guhs.bronnetje.lore: A bubbly little spring stone. Underwater, bubbles burble out of it and pink sparkles shimmer above the stream.
block.guhs.glinsterriet.lore: Grows along the streams and sparkles softly pink, especially at night.
enchantment.guhs.mika_mepper.desc: Double damage against Mikas. Not for the Mika Whacker itself: that one whacks hard enough already!
enchantment.guhs.pluisval.desc: Land on wool, felt or fluff without fall damage. Poof!
enchantment.guhs.glitterzicht.desc: A softly sparkling night vision, but only underground.
enchantment.guhs.spaarguhtje.desc: Whatever you mine and pick up goes straight to the Bank Guh of the Bank Key in your inventory. Ka-ching!
enchantment.guhs.bakvads.desc: Whatever you mine comes out of the ground already smelted. Nice and warm!
enchantment.guhs.aaizacht.desc: Your hits never hurt your own pets or villagers: they just get a pat instead.
enchantment.guhs.vadsvlijt.desc: Mine much faster through wool, felt and cheese nibble blocks.
enchantment.guhs.kaasknabbelgeur.desc: You smell like cheese nibbles: every wild guh nearby comes over and follows you around.
item.guhs.vahoege_vadsknakker.lore: Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and shears in one. Right-click is smart: logs, grass, a sheep... Sneak = path
item.guhs.vahoegietstaaf.lore: Makes wahoog chonk super on the smithing table (with the template)
item.guhs.super_vads_sjabloon.lore: Smithing table: template + a wahoog chonk item + a Wahoogite Ingot. Copy it with 7 wahoogite and guh crystal stone
block.guhs.wolkenliftje.lore: Jump on it: up to the next one above. Sneak: down to the next one below
block.guhs.pluisladder.lore: Put it against a wall at the edge of a hole: it rolls itself out all the way to the bottom
block.guhs.terrariumbodem.lore: Build it into a terrarium (with terrarium glass): the critters walk all over it
item.guhs.mijnlampje.lore: A pink little helmet with a lamp for your guh: he lights up the dark wherever he goes
block.guhs.toverguh_boekenstandaard.lore: The Toverguh's workstation: he sells Spell Booklets.
block.guhs.guhrad_werkbank.lore: The Vads Mechanic's workstation: guh wheels, guh wire, guh ovens and more chonk power.
block.guhs.ertsenkist.lore: The Miner's workstation: layer stones, guh clay and lamps; he buys your ores.
block.guhs.kristalslijpsteen.lore: The Crystal Cutter's workstation: cuts guh crystal and wahoogite into sparkle blocks.
item.guhs.opgepakte_villager.hint: Right-click a block to put him down
gui.guhs.villager_oppakken.kan_niet: You can't pick up this villager, nyeg.
gui.guhs.villager_oppakken.handelt: Hang on: this villager is busy trading!
gui.guhs.safari.camera.nieuw: You didn't have a safari camera with you, so the rangers are giving you a new one. Click click, wahoog!
item.guhs.kaassauslopers.uitleg: Your guh walks on top of every cheese sauce with these, the hot frying sauce too. Not on real lava, vads!
item.guhs.lavalopers.uitleg: Your guh walks on top of real lava and every cheese sauce with these. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.kledingbron.loot_barbecuether: Chests of the Mikas in the Barbecuether
gui.guhs.kleding.prijs.hint.lavalopers_o: upgrade at the tailor: cheese sauce striders + 4 magma cream + 1 wahoog chonk (right-click him with magma cream)
gui.guhs.kleding.prijs.hint.kisten_in_de: rare in the chests of the Old Cheese Mineshaft
gui.guhs.kleding.prijs.hint.kisten_van_d: rare in the chests of the Mika Grill Palace and the Skewer Keep
gui.guhs.voetjes.mist: The tailor can upgrade your cheese sauce striders to lava striders, but he still needs: %s.
gui.guhs.voetjes.mist.lopers: cheese sauce striders (in your bag, or unlocked)
gui.guhs.voetjes.al: You already have the lava striders, vads! Use them in your guh's wardrobe.
gui.guhs.voetjes.opgewaardeerd: The tailor melts the wahoog chonk and the magma cream into your cheese sauce striders... Lava striders! Now your guh even walks on real lava, njeg!
block.guhs.golfrek.lore: Deco from the Golfguh's shop. Guh golf clubs, ready for the next round!
block.guhs.golfbal_tee.lore: Put up to 4 on one block, like candles.
block.guhs.golf_vlaggetje.lore: Right-click: flag out, flag in. Your own little green!
block.guhs.golfkarretje.lore: Right-click to sit in it. Vroem... well, it doesn't drive. Njeg.
block.guhs.golftrofee.lore: For 18 holes at or under par. Right-click: who won it, and the record.
quest.guhs.golf.start_achter: Yay! The back 9: a Tour of the Guhmension! Your ball is on hole 10. 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.golf.start_alle: All 18 holes! That's a vadsy lot of golf. Your ball is on hole 1. 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.golf.geen_achter: Njeg, this course only has 9 holes. The back 9 are on the newer golf courses!
quest.guhs.golf.achter_dicht: The back 9 are still locked: first play the front 9 at or under par once, guhtje!
quest.guhs.golf.achter_open: Njeg! At par! The gate to the back 9 is open: a Tour of the Guhmension, from the Kaasmoeras right into the Big Guh Mouth. Dare you?
quest.guhs.golf.achter_open_elders: Njeg! At par! The back 9 are open for you now, on every 18-hole guh golf course. This one only has 9...
quest.guhs.golf.trofee: ALL 18 AT OR UNDER PAR! The Golfguh gives you the Golf Trophy, with your name on it. VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.golf.bar_n: Hole %s/%s: %s (par %s) | stroke %s/%s | %s blocks to go | total %s
gui.guhs.golf.play_voor.tooltip: Holes 1-9, the classic guh golf course
gui.guhs.golf.play_achter.tooltip: Holes 10-18: a Tour of the Guhmension, more golfballetjes per hole
gui.guhs.golf.play_alle.tooltip: The whole course: a big bonus, your own 18-hole record and at par the Golf Trophy
gui.guhs.golf.achter_dicht: Locked: first play the front 9 at or under par once
structure.guhs.mijningang_hutje.tooltip: A little hut with a cloud lift down. Your own mine starts here!
structure.guhs.knuffelslaapzaal.tooltip: An underground dormitory full of canopy beds and sleeping guhs. Shhh!
structure.guhs.mijnguhdorp.tooltip: The Mijnguh's underground village around a warm sauce lake. With a cloud lift up.
structure.guhs.paddenstoelendorpje.toolt: Giant mushrooms with a little house in the cap, lights on strings and a sparkly brook.
structure.guhs.verlaten_guhmijn.tooltip: An old tunnel network of the miner guhs, with loot sleds, a canteen and caved-in bits.
structure.guhs.grotschilderingen.tooltip: Old guh paintings on the cave wall: how everything turned pink, and the Cuddle Heart.
structure.guhs.sausmeer_vissershutje.too: A hut on stilts by a warm cheese sauce lake. The fish don't bite, the cheese does.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_dorp.1: Welcome to the Mijnguh village! Here we dig, we nibble and then we dig some more.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_dorp.2: Bulk is lovely! The Mijnguh in the stall trades building stuff for nibbles.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_dorp.3: The sauce lake is warm. Swimming is allowed, slurping is not. I tried. Njeg.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_dorp.4: Above us lies a whole mountain of pink wool. We just live under it. Cosy, right?
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_dorp.5: The side tunnels lead to the neighbours. Be quiet near the dormitory!
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_ingang: Going down? Step onto the little cloud. The ladder is fine too, for the brave.
The mine is at the bottom. Bring a lamp, it's darker down there than inside a bag of cheese nibbles.
Two little clouds: one goes up, one goes down. Don't mix them up, njeg!
I'm the lift guh. I don't press any buttons, but I do stand here very professionally.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_mijn.1: This mine is older than my grandma. And my grandma is very old.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_mijn.2: First nibble, then dig. Guhs have done it this way for ages.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_mijn.3: The tunnels go every which way. I got lost three times myself. Today.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_mijn.4: There are still little sleds full of loot here. Help yourself, the old miner guhs retired long ago.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_slaapz: Shhh... the baby guhs are asleep. If they wake up, everybody wants a nibble.
Counting sheep helps. I always fall asleep myself at sheep number three.
The alarm clock is set to never. That's the best time around here.
Pet a sleeping guh very gently, and it wakes up happy.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_padden: Welcome to our little village! Knock first, then you climb right up the stem.
My house is in the cap. Mind your head, it's only a little hat.
Lights on strings, a sparkly brook, mushrooms: what more could a guh want?
No, you may not eat my house. Not even a tiny bite. Njeg!
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_visser: I'm Henk Hengel. They're not biting today. Only the cheese is.
Caught today: zero fish and three socks. A good day!
A fishing licence costs one nibble. I ate it myself.
The sauce is warm. Don't drink it, do dip in it.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_gids.1: I'm Granny Pluis, the guide. Long ago everything was grey and cold. Brr!
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_gids.2: Then a guh found the very first pink ball of wool. Look, up there on the wall!
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_gids.3: Spinning, spinning, spinning... and that's how the whole Guhmension turned pink.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_gids.4: Every guh carries a little piece of the Cuddle Heart. You share it by being kind.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_gids.5: Don't touch, please: the paint is only three thousand years old.
block.guhs.mijn_guhhuisje.lore: Up to 4 of your guhs live in it and slowly mine out the ground below. Click it with a picked-up guh
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.vol: Full! A Mining Guh House holds at most %s guhs
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.trekt_in: %s moves into the Mining Guh House. Pickaxe at the ready, nyeg!
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.niet_jouw_guh: Only your own tame guhs can live here
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.laat_zien.tooltip: Pink sparkles briefly show the edge of the area
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.rugzak_legen.tooltip: The residents' backpack saddles get emptied into the chest (as much as fits)
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.vak.knabbels: Cheese nibbles: the guhs work four times as fast (one nibble per 20 blocks)
