gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.vak.sleutel: A Bank Key: whatever gets mined goes into that Bank Guh
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.0: No guhs live here yet. Click with a picked-up guh!
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.1: Busy mining: %s of the %s guhs at work
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.3: Done! There's nothing left to mine
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.4: There's nobody nearby to do the work
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.6: Put a chest next to the house, or a Bank Key inside
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.7: Hang on: part of the area isn't loaded
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.8: Too deep: the guhs never mine below y 10
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.vraag: Hey, you there! Can you help me out? I'm building a house for guhs who love to dig, but I'm a few things short.
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.vraag.2: Bring me %s feltstone, a guh clay and a Wahoogite. Then the Mining Guh House is yours, with a little helmet for your guh!
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.nog_niet: Not everything yet: feltstone %s/%s, guh clay %s/1, Wahoogite %s/1. Keep digging, nyeg!
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.klaar: WAHOOG, that's everything! Here's your Mining Guh House. Put it on or under the ground and let your guhs move in.
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.klaar.2: And this lamp helmet is for your guh. Give the diggers some nibbles and they'll work four times as fast!
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.nog_een: Another one? Coming right up! Here's another Mining Guh House.
block.guhs.rookguh_platform.lore: Your very own landing spot for the Smokeguh, in every world. Click it: he'll fly you anywhere
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.geschenk: You did it, the whole Journey of the Nibble Ring! Here's your very own Smokeguh Platform. Put it wherever you like, and I'll always fly you there.
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.geschenk_: Hi, it's me, the Smokeguh! Since you finished the whole Journey of the Nibble Ring, you get your very own Smokeguh Platform. Put it wherever you like, and I'll always fly you there. Nyeg!
(One per player, in every world: if you put it somewhere else, your landing spot moves along with it. Click it to fly.)
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.neergezet: This is your Smokeguh Platform now. The Smokeguh lands here!
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.verhuisd: Your Smokeguh Platform has moved here. The old one doesn't count anymore.
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.opgeruimd: Your Smokeguh Platform is gone. Put another one down for a landing spot.
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.te_vroeg: The Smokeguh only gets to know you once you've finished the Journey of the Nibble Ring.
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.weg: Hmm, your platform isn't there anymore. Put it down again!
item.guhs.schatschepje.lore: Right-click or left-click the treasure field to dig. Soft, because the field is fluff.
item.guhs.glimnetje.lore: Right-click: swing your net at the glowworms right in front of you.
item.guhs.glimpotje_rug.lore: The more glowworms in it, the brighter it glows.
gui.guhs.kledingbron.lichtjespuzzel: The Little Lights Puzzle (in the cave)
gui.guhs.spelgroep.schatgraven.waar: Deep under a pink hut in the Guhmension: sneak on the cloud lift, down to Captain Shovelsnout.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.glimwormvangen.waar: Deep under a pink hut in the Guhmension: Miss Glimmy's dark hall.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.lichtjespuzzel.waar: Deep under a pink hut in the Guhmension: Master Blinky's lamp hall.
structure.guhs.grotspel_schatgraven.tool: Cave minigame: dig up treasure with Captain Shovelsnout and Sniffy, treasure coins and a pirate outfit
structure.guhs.grotspel_glimwormen.toolt: Cave minigame: catch glowworms with Miss Glimmy, glimmer coins and glowworm feelers
structure.guhs.grotspel_lichtjes.tooltip: Cave minigame: switch on every toadstool lamp with Master Blinky, lamp coins and a glowing hat
gui.guhs.grotspel.bezig: %s is playing right now. Watch for a bit, or have a look in my shop!
gui.guhs.grotspel.no_build: No rebuilding, guhtje: this is a game hall!
quest.guhs.grotspel.bezig: %s is playing right now. Just a moment, guhtje!
quest.guhs.grotspel.elders: You're still busy with another game! Finish that one first.
quest.guhs.grotspel.kapot: Oops... my hall is broken. I can't run a game like this.
quest.guhs.grotspel.vol: Your pockets are full! Make some room for your things.
quest.guhs.grotspel.gestopt: Stopped. No points this time, but a hug.
quest.guhs.grotspel.weggelopen: You walked away! The game is over.
quest.guhs.grotspel.eerste_record: Your first score on this level: %s!
quest.guhs.grotspel.cadeautje: Your very first game! A present: 16 cheese nibbles and something nice for your home.
quest.guhs.grotspel.huis_record: The record of the whole world! Your name is at the top of the board.
gui.guhs.schatgraven.hallo.0: Ahoy, guhtje! Treasure lies buried under this fluff field. Grab my soft shovel and dig it up! Sniffy helps you sniff. Your records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.schatgraven.hallo.1: Guhrrr! I mean: arrr! Who's digging up my treasure today? Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.schatgraven.hallo.2: Watch out for the squeaky cheese, it squeaks your time away! But a golden cheese... wahoog! Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.schatgraven.bezig_jij: Dig, dig, guhtje! Do you want to stop?
gui.guhs.schatgraven.uitleg: You have 90 seconds. Right-click (or left-click) the fluff field with the soft shovel to dig a spot open. Sniffy sniffs along: COLD, warm or HOT (then he jumps!). Every treasure is 10 points, the golden cheese 25, a squeaky cheese costs you 10 seconds. Found everything? Then the seconds left count too! Easy: a small field and lots of help from Sniffy. Hard: the whole field, and Sniffy sniffs less often.
gui.guhs.schatgraven.snuffie.veld: Sniffy: onto the field first, guhtje!
gui.guhs.schatgraven.rust: That bit isn't part of the game now.
quest.guhs.schatgraven.start: Arrr, %s! Sniffy is already sniffing. Ready? 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.schatgraven.hoe: Right-click the field with the shovel to dig. Sniffy beeps: cold, warm, HOT.
quest.guhs.schatgraven.uitslag_geen_goud: The golden cheese stayed hidden (that would have been %s points)
quest.guhs.schatgraven.uitslag_niet_alle: Not everything found: no time bonus
quest.guhs.schatgraven.oordeel_goed: Arrr! You're a real treasure guh! I'll fill the field in again.
quest.guhs.schatgraven.oordeel_aardig: Nicely dug, guhtje! Sniffy wags his tail.
quest.guhs.schatgraven.oordeel_oefenen: Oh well, the treasure is still there. Next time listen to Sniffy better!
quest.guhs.schatgraven.snuffie.0: Sniff sniff! Do you smell cheese too?
quest.guhs.schatgraven.snuffie.1: I'm Sniffy. My nose is my shovel!
quest.guhs.schatgraven.snuffie.2: Squeaky cheese smells nice too... that's the problem.
gui.guhs.glimwormvangen.hallo.0: Psst, quietly! The glowworms flutter about here. Catch them with my net and put them in the jar on your back. Your records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.glimwormvangen.hallo.1: A golden glowworm is five times as glimmery! Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.glimwormvangen.hallo.2: The more you catch, the brighter my hall. I like reading in bed, you see? Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.glimwormvangen.bezig_jij: Catch them, guhtje! Do you want to stop?
gui.guhs.glimwormvangen.uitleg: You have 60 seconds. Swing your net (right-click) at the glowworms right in front of you, or tap them. Some are quick, some hide in the glow bushes. A golden glowworm is 5 points. Every catch goes in the jar on your back, and the more you catch, the brighter the jar and the hall. Hard: more and quicker glowworms, and it starts darker.
quest.guhs.glimwormvangen.start: Net ready, jar on your back, %s! Shhh... 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.glimwormvangen.hoe: Right-click with the net: you catch the glowworms right in front of you.
quest.guhs.glimwormvangen.oordeel_goed: What a light! Now I can finally finish my book. Thank you, guhtje!
quest.guhs.glimwormvangen.oordeel_aardig: Lovely! I can see my toes again.
quest.guhs.glimwormvangen.oordeel_oefene: It's still a bit dark... but it is cosy!
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.hallo.0: Oh dear, my toadstool lamps are all mixed up! Jump on a lamp: it switches, and so do its four neighbours. Switch them all on, so I can read my paper again. Your records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.hallo.1: One more lamp is one more guh! Or something like that. Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.hallo.2: Think first, then jump! Fewer jumps is more coins. Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.bezig_jij: Jump, jump! Do you want to stop?
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.uitleg: The big raster has 7 by 7 lamps. Jump on a lamp (or crouch on it): it and its four neighbours switch, on becomes off and off becomes on. Switch them ALL on before the time is up. Every puzzle can be done, and I know the fewest jumps it takes: the closer you get to that and the faster you are, the more lamp coins. Hard: a trickier puzzle and less time.
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.balk: Lamps on %s/%s  |  jumps %s (can be done in %s)  |  %s
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.start: A new puzzle, %s! Look closely, think... 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.hoe: Jump on a lamp (or crouch on it): it and its neighbours switch. Every lamp on = done!
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.uitslag: Solved in %s jumps (it could be done in %s)
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.oordeel_goed: Everything on! I can read my paper again. It says you're very clever!
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.oordeel_aardig: Well done! It's nice and bright in here again.
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.oordeel_oefene: Hmm, still a few dark spots. Try again, guhtje!
block.guhs.ertskarretje.lore: Deco from Conducteur Piepwiel. Right-click to sit in it. Choo choo... it doesn't ride, guhtje.
block.guhs.stationsklokje.lore: It always says five past guh.
block.guhs.seinlampje.lore: Red over green. Gives light, never gives a ticket.
block.guhs.kegeltje.lore: A plush guh pin from De Guhde. It doesn't fall over here. Piep!
block.guhs.wolbalrek.lore: Three wool balls, ready to roll.
item.guhs.kegelgrot_wolbal_leen.lore: Look where it should go, hold right-click for power, let go to bowl. Stand left or right for a little hook; sneak for a straight ball.
item.guhs.kegelgrot_wolbal_leen.leen: On loan: back to De Guhde after the game.
structure.guhs.karretjeswissels.tooltip: Cave minigame: sort the ore carts with the switches, ertsbonnetjes and a conductor's cap
structure.guhs.kegelgrot.tooltip: Cave minigame: guh bowling with De Guhde, kegelknopen and a bowling outfit
gui.guhs.spelgroep.karretjes.waar: Under a little station hut somewhere in the Guhmension: down with the Wolkenliftje to the Switch Cave, with Conducteur Piepwiel on the balcony.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.kegelen.waar: Under a little hut with a giant pin on its roof somewhere in the Guhmension: down with the Wolkenliftje, De Guhde is behind the counter.
gui.guhs.mijnspellen.niet_bouwen: Njeg, this cave is a game hall: no building or digging here!
quest.guhs.karretjes.hallo1: Tuut tuut! Conducteur Piepwiel here. The ore carts are waiting, and so are the bins. Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.karretjes.hallo2: Welcome to the Switch Cave! Every cart in the right bin, and no derailing... we don't even have that. Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.karretjes.hallo3: Psst. The coal cart once ended up in the vads bin. The vads tasted of soot for a week. Njeg! Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.karretjes.hallo4: All aboard! Well, not you. The ore. Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.karretjes.uitleg: The carts roll out of the tunnel, each full of one ore: the colour of its load says which bin it belongs in (the ore is also in the wall behind its bin). On the railing there is a lever above every switch: on = right, off = left; the rail shows where the switch sends the next cart. A cart in the wrong bin is gone; %s gone and your shift is over. They come ever faster, guhtje! But calmly at first: the first carts roll slowly, the very first one waits in the tunnel mouth, and the bar at the bottom always says which ore comes next, so you can set the switch early. On track 1 the right bin sparkles. The signs on the balcony wall show it too.
quest.guhs.karretjes.bezig: %s is on shift right now. Watch from the balcony, it's quite exciting!
quest.guhs.karretjes.bezig_jij: You're on shift! %s right, %s gone. Keep your paws on the levers!
quest.guhs.karretjes.kapot: Njeg... I can't find my rails. This cave isn't quite right.
quest.guhs.karretjes.start_makkelijk: Track 1! Two switches, three bins. Tuut tuut, here they come...
quest.guhs.karretjes.start_medium: Track 2! Three switches, four bins. Mind the gold, it's shy.
quest.guhs.karretjes.start_lastig: Track 3! Five switches, six bins. Even I get dizzy. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.karretjes.hoe: Levers on the railing: on = right, off = left (as you look at the tracks). Every cart in the bin of its ore!
quest.guhs.karretjes.gestopt: Shift over! The carts go back to the depot.
quest.guhs.karretjes.weggelopen: You left your post... the carts stopped by themselves.
quest.guhs.karretjes.te_lang: That was a very long shift! Time for a nap, guhtje.
quest.guhs.karretjes.tien1: %s carts right! You're a natural, guhtje.
quest.guhs.karretjes.tien2: %s! The bins are getting full. Njeg!
quest.guhs.karretjes.tien3: %s! Shall I make you head conductor?
quest.guhs.karretjes.telling: Shift over: %s carts in the right bin (%s).
quest.guhs.karretjes.eerste_record: Your first shift on this track: %s carts. That's your record now!
quest.guhs.karretjes.geen_record: Your record on this track stays %s.
quest.guhs.karretjes.grot_record: The best shift of the whole world on this track! Your name is on the board.
quest.guhs.karretjes.oordeel_top: Phew! I've never seen anything like it. Want my cap? (No. Buy one. Njeg.)
quest.guhs.karretjes.oordeel_goed: Very good! The ore thanks you, and so do I.
quest.guhs.karretjes.oordeel_aardig: Not bad! Next time a bit quicker on the levers.
quest.guhs.karretjes.oordeel_oefenen: The coal got mixed up with the vads again... practice makes perfect, guhtje!
quest.guhs.kegelen.hallo1: Hey, guh. The Guhde abides. Fancy a game? Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.kegelen.hallo2: That rug really tied the cave together, you know. Bowl a game? Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.kegelen.hallo3: The pins squeak when they fall. Don't worry, they like it. Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.kegelen.hallo4: Strike! Oh, wait, I'm just practising saying it. Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.kegelen.uitleg: Ten frames, two balls each (a strike: all ten with the first ball, a spare: all ten with two). A strike counts 10 + your next two balls, a spare 10 + the next one; in the 10th frame you get bonus balls. Look where the ball should go, hold right-click for power and let go. Stand left or right on the approach and it hooks towards the middle; sneak for a straight ball.
quest.guhs.kegelen.bezig: %s is bowling now. Grab a seat, have a kaasknabbel.
quest.guhs.kegelen.bezig_jij: You're at %s points, man. Keep rolling.
quest.guhs.kegelen.kapot: Njeg... the lanes are gone? That's... not cool, man.
quest.guhs.kegelen.vol: Your paws are full! Make room for the ball first.
quest.guhs.kegelen.start_makkelijk: The straight lane. Mind the gutters, they're hungry.
quest.guhs.kegelen.start_medium: The bendy lane! Bounce off the bumpers, it's allowed.
quest.guhs.kegelen.start_lastig: The obstacle lane. Two posts and a Mika who won't sit still. Good luck, guh.
quest.guhs.kegelen.hoe: Look at the pins, hold right-click, let go. Left or right of the middle = a hook; sneak = straight.
quest.guhs.kegelen.gestopt: Game over, man. The ball goes back on the rack.
quest.guhs.kegelen.weggelopen: You walked off the approach... the pins went to sleep.
quest.guhs.kegelen.te_lang: The ball got cold, man. Another time!
quest.guhs.kegelen.strike1: STRIKE! The pins squeak for joy!
quest.guhs.kegelen.eerste_record: Your first game on this lane: %s points. That's your record now!
quest.guhs.kegelen.geen_record: Your record on this lane stays %s.
quest.guhs.kegelen.grot_record: The best game of the whole world on this lane! Your name is on the board.
quest.guhs.kegelen.oordeel_top: Whoa. That was... like, the best thing I've seen in this cave. Respect, guh.
quest.guhs.kegelen.oordeel_goed: Nice game, man. The pins will talk about it for days.
quest.guhs.kegelen.oordeel_aardig: Not bad! A little more hook next time.
quest.guhs.kegelen.oordeel_oefenen: The gutters say thank you. Practice, guh, practice.
gui.guhs.kegelen.sta: Stand on the approach of your lane!
gui.guhs.kegelen.kijk: Look down the lane, at the pins!
gui.guhs.kegelen.strike_sub: All ten pins! Piep piep piep!
structure.guhs.vadsmijnstadje.tooltip: An underground town full of guh villagers in a big cave hall, with a guh wheel plant on the square.
structure.guhs.grotdisco.tooltip: A secret disco in a crystal geode. DJ Njeg spins, the guhs dance up vads power.
structure.guhs.oude_wolspinnerij.tooltip: De Wolclub: guhs spin wool together around tea tables. A water wheel makes vads power.
structure.guhs.sterrengrot.tooltip: A quiet dome cave with a star ceiling, a picnic and a little star pond.
structure.guhs.knuffelkuil.tooltip: A ball pit full of plush blocks. Six little guhs play hide and seek. Find them all!
structure.guhs.verrassingsfeestje.toolti: A hidden cave where guhs prepare a birthday party. With a giant cake. Shhh!
structure.guhs.oude_guhtempel.tooltip: The huge, half buried temple complex of the old guhs. With the Great Guh and the Golden Cheese Nibble.
structure.guhs.oude_bankkluis.tooltip: The old vault of the Bank Guh. Someone tried to break in. Someone with a moustache.
gui.guhs.kleding.prijs.hint.verrassingsf: in the chest of a Surprise Party under the wool
Hands in the air! Every dancer gives vads power to the Disco Dynamo!
I'm DJ Njeg. My favourite record? 'Vahoeg, vahoeg', the remix.
Up there it's just a mountain of wool. Down here it's a party. Don't tell anyone!
A milkshake at the bar? Strawberry, mint or choco. Free, if you dance.
Danced out? Sit on a cushion for a bit. Five minutes. Then back to vadsing!
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_spinne: Welcome to De Wolclub! Long ago everything was grey. Then we picked up our spinning wheels... and now? Pink! Vahoeg!
Nobody has to work here. We spin because it's cosy. And every five minutes there's a break.
Three guhs run in the guh wheels. That makes vads power for the spinning mills, so our paws don't have to.
Take a bale of wool, go on. There's plenty of wool, the whole Guhmension is full of it!
In the weaving corner we make little rugs, blankets and fabrics for guh clothes.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_sterre: Look, there! That constellation is called the Great Cheese Nibble.
You see the stars best under the ground. No little clouds in the way!
I counted them all. There are... uh... a lot. Vahoeg.
Lie down on a cushion and look up. You'll turn a little vads all by yourself.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_kuil.1: ...8, 9, 10! Ready or not! Have you seen the others? They're somewhere in the plushies.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_kuil.2: Hide and seek is the best game. Unless you're the seeker. Then it's the second best.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_kuil.3: Jump into the pit! You sink a little into the plushies.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_kuil.4: Shoes off, please! Guhs don't have shoes, so that's easy.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_kuil.5: Found guhs have often fallen asleep. Give them a pet to wake them up!
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_feestj: SURPRISE! Oh, it's only you. We're still practising.
This party is for you! Or for whoever walks in. So, for you!
There's a guh inside one of the presents. Guess which one. No shaking!
The cake is made of plush blocks. Don't bite, do cuddle. Njeg!
Grab a party hat from the chest. A party without a hat doesn't count.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_tempel: This temple is older than the cheese. And the cheese is very old.
The old guhs built everything from soft stone. So nobody got hurt walking into it.
At the back stands the Great Guh with the Golden Cheese Nibble. Don't lick it, I tried.
There's a hole in the forecourt. I know, because I was in it. Njeg!
The slide in the east wing is the fastest way out. Wheee!
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_bank.1: I've guarded this vault for a hundred years. There was only one break-in. By a Mika. It failed. Njeg!
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_bank.2: See those paw prints? Mika came through the wall, but the vault held. Just a little dent.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_bank.3: Interest? Zero point zero nibbles. But your savings are very cosy together.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_bank.4: The door code? I forgot it. Luckily the door is open.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_bank.5: Take something, go on. The old bank guhs retired long ago.
structure.guhs.verlaten_sledestation.too: An old underground sled station with platforms, sleds and a ticket office. Departs: never.
structure.guhs.kaasmakerij.tooltip: Sauce pumps, cheese vats and giant cheese wheels by a warm sauce lake. No diving into the vat!
structure.guhs.verzonken_guhhuisje.toolt: House Pluis once sank through the wool. Crooked, mossy, and someone still lives there.
structure.guhs.reuzenguh_fossiel.tooltip: The skeleton of an ancient guh, deep in the crystal stone. Yes, the ears really were that big.
structure.guhs.kristalkwekerij.tooltip: Beds full of guh crystals in four growth stages. Don't touch, they're still growing!
structure.guhs.verdwaalde_bouwploeg.tool: An abandoned building site: half a tunnel, a little crane and stacks of building stuff.
structure.guhs.grotguh_holen.tooltip: The cosy home of the Cave Guhs: sleeping burrows, a campfire and a nibble stash.
structure.guhs.badhuis.tooltip: A Roman bathhouse under the wool: three bath halls, nibble tubs and cheese shakes.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_statio: Welcome to Diepewol Station! The next sled leaves... some day.
A ticket? One nibble. Where to? Nowhere, the track caved in. Njeg.
Sleds full of cheese nibbles used to ride here. Now only the dust rides along.
I've been selling tickets for thirty years. Never sold a single one. Maybe tomorrow!
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_kaas.1: Njeg! We make ALL the sauce here.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_kaas.3: Old? Not at all. The cheese is old. The dairy is brand new.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_kaas.4: Tasting is allowed, but only with a nibble. Without a nibble it's just slurping.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_huisje: I was only taking a nap... and then I lived underground.
My neighbours still live upstairs. Sometimes I wave at the ceiling.
The house is still sinking a little. One paw a day. Cosy, right?
The post never comes down here. Nice and quiet though, njeg.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_fossie: Look at those little ears! A real ancient guh.
There was still a cheese nibble in its tummy! A fossil nibble. Don't eat it.
I've been digging here for twenty years. With a teaspoon. It's going well.
I think it just lay there vadsing for a very long time. A very, very long time.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_kweker: A sip and a song every morning. That's how they grow fastest. Njeg!
Don't touch, please, they're still growing. And they're very shy.
This one is only four weeks old. Look at it sparkle!
If you're very quiet, you can hear them grow. Pling. Pling.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_bouwpl: We were on our way to a job. Three years ago. Left was right, wasn't it?
We'll finish that tunnel, don't worry. A little break first. Three years now.
Take some stones with you. Then we don't have to lug them back.
The crane works fine. It's just having a nap, like Henk.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_grotgu: Welcome to our burrows! We're Cave Guhs. We sparkle in the dark, njeg.
Every little burrow has a nest, a cushion and a lamp. A guh needs nothing more.
The sun? Never heard of it. We have crystals. They're warm too. A little.
Take a nibble from the stash. Just one. I'm counting them, mind you.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_badmee: Njeg! No diving into the cold bath!
Rinse first, then vads. That's how we do it at The Warm Nibble.
Bubbles are free. Foam too. My whistle isn't.
No running by the bath! Vadsing is fine. Lots of vadsing.
quest.guhs.onderwol_bouw.onderwol_barguh: A cheese shake costs three nibbles. The straw is free.
A cold shake after the warm bath. That's how the old Roman guhs did it.
Cheese in your shake? Of course. Everything is better with cheese.
gui.guhs.kleding.prijs.hint.in_badhuis_d: In the chests of the Warm Nibble bathhouse, under the wool
quest.guhs.karretjes.rustig: Calm start: the first carts roll slowly and the very first one waits in the tunnel mouth. The bar at the bottom always says which ore comes next: set the switch early!
gui.guhs.vadskracht.guhrad.rust: The guh is taking a break: the lever is on
block.guhs.vadslamp.lore: On 1 chonk power: light level 15, and it lights up a much bigger area than a normal lamp
block.guhs.vadsschakelaar.lore: Put it in a line of Guh Wire: on, the chonk power goes through; off, everything behind it sleeps
block.guhs.vadsschakelaar.aan: Switch on: the chonk power goes through
block.guhs.vadsschakelaar.uit: Switch off: everything behind it sleeps
structure.guhs.guhtechniek_beurs.tooltip: A glass hall where every guh machine really works, with the Dream Factory in the middle
gui.guhs.techbeurs.kijken: Looking is fine, taking is not: this belongs to the fair!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.welkom.1: Welcome to the Guh Technology Fair! Everything here really runs. Go ahead and flip the little switches off and on again, nyeg!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.welkom.2: Looking is fine, taking is not: what's in the stands belongs to the fair. The fair guhs tell you how to build it yourself.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.welkom.3: In the middle is the Dream Factory: everything works together there. My favourite stand!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.guhrad.1: My guh has been running all day. He thinks there's a nibble at the end. Don't tell him!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.guhrad.2: You build a Guh Wheel yourself: start at the quest 'A Guh at Work' in Guh Technology. A happy guh gives 15 instead of 10.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knuffel.1: This is the only generator you're allowed to cuddle. I wouldn't try it with the others.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knuffel.2: Quest 'Happy Guhs Run Faster' (Project 1): tame guhs come and lie on the cushion by themselves, each gives 3 chonk power.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.disco.1: These guhs have been dancing since the opening. The record still hasn't ended.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.disco.2: Quest 'Dancing for the Factory' (Project 1): click your Disco Dynamo with a music disc and up to 4 guhs come dancing.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.blub.1: The little stove eats cheese nibbles. So do I. We don't share.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.blub.2: Turn the switch off: the Nibble Battery keeps the lamps on! 'The Blub Stove' is in Project 3, the battery in Project 2.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.kern.1: A real star, in a little cage. In the evening he's allowed out for a bit to twinkle.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.kern.2: This core runs half the fair: 200 chonk power! You build it at the end of The Great Nibble Machine, with a glowstar.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.molen.1: Milling without wind! The miller next door is a little jealous.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.molen.2: Quest 'Milling Without Wind' for the Chonk Mill and 'The Oven with a Little Snoot' for the Guh Oven, both in Project 1.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.oogster.1: He harvests, he plants again and he never complains. I wish I were like that.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.oogster.2: Quest 'The Field That Harvests Itself' (Project 2). Point his snoot at your field, with water and light nearby.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.buizen.1: The nibbles go back and forth all day. They're having a great time.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.buizen.2: Start with 'From Chest to Chest' and 'The Filter Piece' in Project 2; the Stock Meter is at 'Enough Is Enough'.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.opzuiger.1: Don't drop anything here. Really. He's faster than you.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.opzuiger.2: Quest 'The Slurper' (Project 2). The Guh Clock that taps the dropper is a sensor from 'Enough Is Enough'.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knabbelaar.1: One puts a stone down, the other nibbles it up. True friendship!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knabbelaar.2: First get the recipe card at 'Nibbling Machines' (Project 4), then 'Stone Without a Pickaxe' and 'The Placer'.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knutsel.1: Nine nibbles in, one block out, and back again. They're very good at it.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knutsel.2: Draw a recipe on the Drawing Table ('The Drawing Table') and put the drawing in the Tinker Machine ('Tinkering Without Hands').
quest.guhs.techbeurs.plantagebak.1: A whole forest in a box. Well, one tree. But a very nice one.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.plantagebak.2: You earn the recipe card at the Grill Camping; quest 'A Forest in a Box' (Project 4). Chop the tree down and it plants a new one.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.pomp.1: The source never runs dry. We're very proud of that here, nyeg.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.pomp.2: Pumps, hoses and vats are in Project 3, 'Sauce on Tap'. Start at the recipe card 'Sauce and Hoses'.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.sauzen.1: Potions, fried snacks and grill coal from one and the same hose. Now that's what I call a sauce street!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.sauzen.2: See 'Fry-Up on the Assembly Line', 'Potions That Brew Themselves' and 'The Grill Coal Line' in Project 3.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.bezorg.1: Our Delivery Guhling delivers everything. Except the weekend, he keeps that for himself.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.bezorg.2: Recipe card at 'The Delivery Guhling' (Project 4), then 'The Scooter Station' and 'Stop Posts': green picks up, orange delivers.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.droom.1: This is the Dream Factory: cheese nibble plants in, fried nibbles and vahoege potions out!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.droom.2: Every machine here also has its own stand at the fair. Build them all and make your own dream factory at home.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.droom.3: Turn off the big switch by the core and watch everything fall asleep. Do switch it back on, though!
gui.guhs.kegelen.zetter_pauze: The pin setter takes a break: The Guhde sets your pins by hand.
item.guhs.blubguh_item.tooltip: Right-click the ground to put it down. Squish!
gui.guhs.piep.menu.speciaal.blubguh.tool: It hops onto your head, like a soft little hat. Sneak + right-click a block: off it hops.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.blubguh: A soft Blub from a dream, with a bit of guh in it. How much guh? Its Blub-Guh-Meter says!
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.titel.puur: A Pure Blub! No guh at all. Rare!
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.titel.vol: A Full Guh! Almost a real guh. Rare!
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.strik.tooltip: Click: the next color (after the last one: no bow again).
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.schouder.tooltip: It hops onto your head, like a soft little hat. Sneak + right-click a block: off it hops.
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.liedje.tooltip: He squeaks a little song and the guhs nearby get very sleepy.
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.verstop.tooltip: He hides somewhere nearby. Find him within a minute (right-click)!
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.hupsen.tooltip: He hops in circles around you, faster and faster. Record: %s hops.
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.truc.0.tooltip: Sit down or stand back up (like Chonk around).
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.truc.1.tooltip: Spin around in a circle. The guhs nearby cheer!
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.truc.2.tooltip: Play dead... and get back up.
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.truc.3.tooltip: A big jump with a somersault.
gui.guhs.blubguh.op_schouder: %s sits on your head. Squish! What a hat.
gui.guhs.blubguh.liedje: %s squeaks a lullaby... squeak, squeak, squeeeak...
gui.guhs.blubguh.liedje.klaar: Shh... %s guhs got very sleepy. Njeg.
gui.guhs.blubguh.verstop.start: %s is hiding! Count to ten... and find it within a minute!
gui.guhs.blubguh.verstop.geen_plek: %s can't find a good hiding place here.
gui.guhs.blubguh.verstop.op: Njeg, not found! %s comes out by itself. Squeak!
gui.guhs.blubguh.hupsen.record: New record! %s hopped around you %s times! (record: %s)
commands.guhs.blub.spawn: Blub-guh made: meter %s, kind %s, tint %s, size %s
commands.guhs.blub.raster: The grid is in front of you: 5 kinds x meter 0 / 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 (tame, sitting).
commands.guhs.blub.groepje: Made %s random Blub-guhs (the real spawn dice).
commands.guhs.blub.info: %s: Blub %s Guh %s%% | kind %s | tint %s | size %s | %s | %s | bow %s
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.0: Sit! %s sits down nicely (or stands back up).
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.2: Play dead! %s flops over... and gets back up. Nyeg, he's alive!
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.kast.tooltip: Bows and (later) more: pick what it wears.
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.trucjes.tooltip: All your Blub's tricks and ear moods.
gui.guhs.blubguh.kast.uitleg: Click to put it on. Bows are free, the rest you unlock with Blub clothing!
gui.guhs.blubguh.snoes_eerst: This Blub doesn't know you yet... help Snoes fall asleep first, njeg!
commands.guhs.blub.snoes.aan: Snoes was helped: you see wild Blubs now (and can tame them).
commands.guhs.blub.snoes.uit: Snoes not helped yet: wild Blubs are invisible to you again.
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc_melding.0: Sit! %s sits down nicely (or gets up again).
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc_melding.2: Play dead! %s flops over... and gets up again. Njeg, alive!
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.zitten.tooltip: Sit or get up again (like Rondvadsen).
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.rondje.tooltip: A little spin. The guhs nearby cheer!
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.dood.tooltip: It flops over... and gets up again. The guhs cheer.
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.sprong.tooltip: A high jump with a somersault.
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.hupsen.tooltip: It hops in circles around you, faster and faster. Record: %s hops.
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.slaapliedje.toolti: It squeaks a little tune and the guhs nearby get very sleepy.
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.verstoppertje.tool: It hides somewhere nearby. Find it within a minute (right-click)!
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.squish.tooltip: A squish hug: flat as a pudding, and up again.
block.guhs.weer_vadser.lore: Makes its own weather all around. Right-click: pick a weather!
block.guhs.weer_vadser.lore.kracht: Needs %s vadskracht while it makes any weather but normal
item.guhs.weerpotje.gebruik: Right-click: the weather is yours for good, in every Weather Vadser
gui.guhs.weer.ontgrendeld: Unlocked: %s! Pick it in your Weather Vadser. VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.weer.al_gehad: You already had %s, njeg! Give the jar to a friend.
gui.guhs.weer.op_slot: %s is still locked. Find its weather jar first!
gui.guhs.weer.uitgezet: The Weather Vadser is back to normal. Just weather, vads.
gui.guhs.weer.gekozen_slaapt: Weather: %s, but the Weather Vadser is napping: it needs %s vadskracht.
gui.guhs.weer.scherm.uit: Now: just the world's weather. Pick one!
gui.guhs.weer.scherm.slaapt: Zzz... the Weather Vadser needs %s vadskracht
gui.guhs.weer.slot_hint: Locked! You find its weather jar here: %s
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.normaal.uitleg: Just the world's own weather. The Weather Vadser takes a nap and asks no vadskracht.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.zon.uitleg: Nice and sunny, even when it rains everywhere else.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.regen.uitleg: Rain! In cold places it snows. Blubs jump in the puddles.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.onweer.uitleg: Rumble rumble! A flash now and then, but nobody gets hit and nothing catches fire.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.pluisjes.uitleg: Soft pink fluff drifts down. Guhs hop to catch it.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.bellen.uitleg: It rains soap bubbles! Blub-guhs love it and blow along.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.knabbel.uitleg: Now and then a cheese nibble drops from the sky. Not too many, vads.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.regenboog.uitleg: Soft sunny rain with a big rainbow. Guhs and Blubs dance in the puddles.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.hartjes.uitleg: Little hearts float down. Your tame guhs and Blubs get extra cuddly.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.sterren.uitleg: At night stars fall with glittering tails. Make a wish!
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.knusmist.uitleg: A soft pink fog. Everything gets cosy and the guhs get sleepy.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.bloesem.uitleg: Blossom petals blow by. Smells like the Bloesemmeertje.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.pluisjes.bron: chests in the Old Wool Mill, the Cloud Meadow's cloud chests and the little chest in the Cloud Herder's hut
item.guhs.weerpotje_bellen.lore: A jar full of soap bubbles. Don't shake!
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.bellen.bron: chests in the Guh Bubble and in Bikini Bottom
item.guhs.weerpotje_knabbel.lore: Cheese nibbles under a little cloud. Mmm.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.knabbel.bron: the treasure chest of a Cheese Nibble Nest, or win the Nibble Games
item.guhs.weerpotje_regenboog.lore: A bit of rainbow with a little shower.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.regenboog.bron: the little chest at the end of the Rainbow Bridge, the Travel Agency's souvenir 'Rainbow in a Jar', or a gold medal on the Guh Circuit
item.guhs.weerpotje_hartjes.lore: Hearts! The jar is warm when you hold it.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.hartjes.bron: chests at a Guh Picnic and a Surprise Party
item.guhs.weerpotje_sterren.lore: A bit of night sky with falling stars.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.sterren.bron: the Guh Observatory, the Star Cave, or connect a constellation with the telescope
item.guhs.weerpotje_knusmist.lore: Pink fog. Sniff it and you get sleepy.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.knusmist.bron: chests in the Cuddle Dormitory and the little chest in the Cuddle Bath
item.guhs.weerpotje_bloesem.lore: Blossom petals that never stop blowing.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.bloesem.bron: the chest on the Bloesemmeertje's picnic island and the little chest in the Klaterdal tea house
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.knuffel_guh.toolti: It looks for the nearest tame guh (within 8 blocks) for a big hug.
gui.guhs.huisje.alleen.blub.hint: Only a Blub can do this. Let one live in this huisje: squish!
gui.guhs.huisje.alleen.sjokkel.hint: Only Sjokkel can do this, very slowly. Does he live here? Tink tink!
gui.guhs.blubguh.knuffel.geen: %s looks around... but there's no tame guh to hug. A hug for you then? Squish!
gui.guhs.klus.blub_bellen.tip: Blubs only: blows water bubbles over the crops, they grow a little faster
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.blub_bell: crops that are still growing around the huisje (wheat, carrots, potatoes, kaasknabbel plants...)
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_blub_bel: I blew bubbles over the little plants. Blub! They grew a bit from it.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.blub_bellen: Did you know the plants at %s grow a bit faster? I blow bubbles over them. Blub blub!
gui.guhs.klus.blub_bezorgen.tip: Blubs only: brings kaasknabbels from the chest to the tame guhs and critters nearby
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.blub_bezo: kaasknabbels in the chest next to the huisje or in the Bank Guh, and tame guhs or critters nearby
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_blub_bez: Hop, hop, knabbel! Everyone got one. Me a little too. Njeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.blub_bezorgen: Did you know everyone at %s got a knabbel from me? Delivered with a hop!
gui.guhs.klus.blub_zingen.tip: Blubs only: squeaks the lullaby in the evening, the huisje's guhs are well rested the next day
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.blub_zing: the evening (once a day) and guhs living in this huisje
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_blub_zin: Squeak, squeak, squeeeak... They all slept so well. Me too.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.blub_zingen: Did you know the guhs of %s sleep so well? I sing them to sleep. Shh...
gui.guhs.klus.blub_bad.tip: Blubs only: gets a Blub bubble bath ready with foam, guhs feel fresh and happy from it
a Blub bubble bath around the huisje
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_blub_bad: Foam, foam, foam! The guhs got in. They smelled of bubbles.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.blub_bad: Did you know there's a bubble bath ready at %s? I foamed it myself!
item.guhs.droomzand.lore: Glitters like a sleepy little star. The Sand Guh says: don't rub it in your eyes, vads!
block.guhs.zeepbelglas.lore: See-through, with every colour of a soap bubble. No poking, njeg!
block.guhs.droomzandblok.lore: Nine dream sands in one block. The glitter drifts up: it wants to go back to the stars.
block.guhs.slaapliedjesgras.lore: Hums softly when you walk over it. On tiptoes? Then it keeps sleeping.
block.guhs.maanbloemetje.lore: Only opens at night, and then glows softly. By day it naps, just like a vadsig guh.
block.guhs.droomzee.lore: The soft sea under the dream islands. You sink through it ever so slowly, like through a little cloud.
block.guhs.doos_knabbels.lore: A guh always picks the box. Always. Right-click in the evening: tuck your guh in.
item.guhs.droomkussen.lore: In a dream: right-click to wake up. At home: just very soft.
gui.guhs.dromen.reis.geen_droom: Guh Dreamland does not exist in this world. Not even in your dreams.
gui.guhs.dromen.reis.spel_bezig: Finish your game first, then you can dream!
gui.guhs.dromen.reis.kussen: You got a Dream Pillow: right-click with it to wake up.
gui.guhs.dromen.kussen.thuis: So soft... but you're not dreaming. Tuck a guh in first and go to sleep.
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.met: You tuck %1$s in, with %2$s. Sleep tight, njeg! Now go to sleep in a bed close by: you'll dream of %3$s.
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.zonder: You tuck %1$s in. Sleep tight, njeg! Now go to sleep in a bed close by: you'll dream of %2$s. (Give something along for another dream!)
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.uit: %s is awake again. Playing a bit longer after all?
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.geen_bedtijd: It's not bedtime yet, vads! Come back in the evening.
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.bezet: A guh is already sleeping here. Shh!
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.geen_guh: No guh of yours nearby to tuck in.
gui.guhs.dromen.regels.niet_bouwen: You can't build or break anything in a dream. Only dream, njeg.
gui.guhs.dromen.regels.bubbel: Plop! A Blub bubble caught you.
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.grap0: Alarm Guh: RIIIING! Good morning, sleepyhead!
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.grap1: Alarm Guh: Five more minutes? Nope. RING!
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.grap2: Alarm Guh: I set myself to 'vahoeg early'. Ring ring!
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.grap3: Alarm Guh: Wake up! The nibbles are getting cold!
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.grap4: Alarm Guh: Sorry, I have to. It's in my job description. RING!
gui.guhs.slaapzorg.ontbijt.te_vroeg: Shh... %s is still asleep. Breakfast in bed is for the morning, njeg!
gui.guhs.slaapzorg.ontbijt.lekker: Breakfast in bed! %s stretches, munches it all up and is well rested all day. VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.slaapzorg.ontbijt.nog_een: %s munches one more nibble. So vadsig!
block.guhs.muziekdoosje.lore: Right-click: a lullaby. Every guh around yawns and softly falls asleep. Shh!
block.guhs.mobiel.lore: Hang it above a guh bed. It turns slowly; right-click and it plays the lullaby.
block.guhs.nachtkastje.lore: With a little lamp on top. Right-click: lamp on or off.
block.guhs.droomvanger.lore: Catches bad dreams, lets sweet ones through. Hang it on a wall.
block.guhs.slaapmasker_kapstok.lore: For all the guhs' sleep masks. One with little ears!
block.guhs.krabpaal.lore: Tame guhs hop on top by day and look around, just like a kitty.
block.guhs.krabpaal_blauw.lore: Tame guhs hop on top by day and look around, just like a kitty.
block.guhs.maanlampje_maan.lore: Right-click: on or off. A soft light, so nobody is scared of the dark.
block.guhs.maanlampje_ster.lore: Right-click: on or off. A soft light, so nobody is scared of the dark.
block.guhs.maanlampje_wolkje.lore: Right-click: on or off. A soft light, so nobody is scared of the dark.
block.guhs.maanlampje_guh.lore: Right-click: on or off. A soft light, so nobody is scared of the dark.
block.guhs.glas_restje: Glass with a little bit left
item.guhs.glas_restje: Glass with a little bit left
block.guhs.glas_restje.lore: Don't throw it away, it's not empty yet! (Rommelguh)
block.guhs.glas_restje.lore2: Click with another glass: one more. Empty hand: a sip.
gui.guhs.glas_restje.slokje2: You take a sip. A little bit stays behind, of course.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.gespawnd: %s is right in front of you, njeg!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes.grap.0: ...njeg. I'm just a little tired. For a long time now.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes.grap.1: Everyone has a little place to sleep. Not me.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes.grap.2: My ear? It's been bent since... always, really.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes.grap.3: When I close my eyes, it's so quiet. Too quiet.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes_blij.grap.0: I slept! Really slept! Njeg njeg!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes_blij.grap.1: That box is the coziest spot in the whole world.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes_blij.grap.2: Welcome to Guhdreamland! Sweet dreams already!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes_blij.grap.3: The cat house is very pretty too, though. For daytime.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.zandguh.grap.0: A pinch of dream sand and poof: the nicest dreams. Don't rub your eyes!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.zandguh.grap.1: I've been sprinkling for four hundred years. My sack has never been empty. Vahoeg.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.zandguh.grap.2: Are you yawning? Good. Then it works.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.wekkerguh.grap.1: Five more minutes? Everyone says that. Always.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.wekkerguh.grap.2: Want to wake up? Then I'll ring you gently back to your bed.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.wekkerguh.grap.3: I've hit snooze 3 times today already. Breaking records, njeg.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.rommelguh.grap.0: Don't throw it away! It's not empty yet!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.rommelguh.grap.1: I collect glasses. With a little bit left. It's a hobby.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.rommelguh.grap.2: Tidy up? Tomorrow. Or the day after. Or in a dream.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.rommelguh.grap.3: This one's from Tuesday. Or last Tuesday. Cheers!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.droom_omaguh.grap.0: I'm knitting a scarf. Who for? You'll see, dear.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.droom_omaguh.grap.1: Another cookie, dear? There are plenty.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.droom_omaguh.grap.2: At the family day there were so many of us. And still I missed one...
gui.guhs.droomwezens.droom_omaguh.grap.3: Stitch, stitch, drop... oh well, a little hole is cozy.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.kussengevecht_guh.g: PILLOW FIGHT! Not on the snout, that's the rule.
Watch out, this one's extra fluffy! FLUMP!
I've never lost. I've never won either. Njeg.
Feathers everywhere. That's how you know it was a good fight.
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.wakker: This little mailbox only works in a dream. At home it only gets junk mail.
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.plein: Dream Post delivers you to: %s. Click an island's little mailbox to float there!
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.nergens: nowhere yet! First walk the cloud paths to an island, njeg.
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.onbekend: You've never been there! Dream Post only delivers to known addresses. Take the cloud path to %s first.
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.post0: You climb into the mailbox. Stamp on your nose, and... plop! Sent by registered mail.
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.post1: Dream Post, fast and soft. Do not crumple, njeg!
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.post2: A big bubble takes you along. Sender: the Dream Square.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom0: of a cheese nibble as big as a house. It lives inside.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom1: that it can fly, but only a little bit, and then it lands in a box.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom2: that all the pillows in the world are its own. Njeg.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom3: of a Blub that says 'blub'. Nothing else happens. Beautiful dream.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom4: that it's the owner and you're the guh. You do get nibbles every day.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom5: of a rainbow made of cheese. It already took a bite.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom6: that it's in Guh Dreamland, dreaming that it's dreaming. Vahoeg.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom7: of a very long guh sled with every guh on the server in it. Somebody sits on its ear.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom8: that it got a whole cat house... and still lay down in the box.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom9: of a rubber duck that says 'njeg' instead of 'quack'. Or the other way round.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom10: that it's always Saturday morning, with cartoons and pancakes.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom11: that it's vadsier than ever. Incalculably vahoeg even.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.alleen0: The fountain bubbles. Everybody's asleep already, except you. It dreams you're a guh.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.alleen1: The fountain dreams of a nibble. Oh wait, you just threw one in. Thank you!
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.alleen2: Shh... the fountain only hears a very soft 'njeg' far away.
gui.guhs.dromen.koortje.volgt: %s softly peeps a %s and hops after you.
gui.guhs.dromen.koortje.schuw: Too wild! %s startles and hops away. Sneak, vadsje.
gui.guhs.dromen.koortje.verkeerd: Njeg... this isn't my hill. I'm the %s!
gui.guhs.dromen.koortje.goed: %s is on the %s hill. Ears up! (%s/5)
gui.guhs.dromen.koortje.zingt: The Blub choir sings the lullaby... shh.
gui.guhs.dromen.koortje.stukje: You found Snoes' song! He will never forget it.
gui.guhs.dromen.koortje.klaar: How lovely. The Blubs are tired and hop away again... again tomorrow?
gui.guhs.dromen.koortje.niet_temmen: %s sings in the choir, it can't be tamed, njeg!
gui.guhs.sterren.gevangen: Caught! A little star full of dream sand, vahoeg!
gui.guhs.sterren.weg: Njeg... that little star already faded.
gui.guhs.sterren.grote_ster.sub: A wish: a little place of his own.
gui.guhs.sterren.grote_ster.chat: You catch the big falling star. It whispers a wish: 'a little place of my own to sleep'. That is a piece of Snoes's dream!
gui.guhs.sterren.grote_ster.al: The star twinkles at you. You already have Snoes's wish, vads!
block.guhs.stuiterkussen_boter.lore: Boing! Jump on it and you bounce high into the air. Sneak to just stand on it.
block.guhs.stuiterkussen_vanille.lore: Boing! Jump on it and you bounce high into the air. Sneak to just stand on it.
block.guhs.stuiterkussen_roze.lore: Boing! Jump on it and you bounce high into the air. Sneak to just stand on it.
block.guhs.stuiterkussen_hemelsblauw.lor: Boing! Jump on it and you bounce high into the air. Sneak to just stand on it.
block.guhs.stuiterkussen_lavendel.lore: Boing! Jump on it and you bounce high into the air. Sneak to just stand on it.
block.guhs.stuiterkussen_perzik.lore: Boing! Jump on it and you bounce high into the air. Sneak to just stand on it.
block.guhs.stuiterkussen_aqua.lore: Boing! Jump on it and you bounce high into the air. Sneak to just stand on it.
block.guhs.stuiterkussen_wolkje.lore: Boing! Jump on it and you bounce high into the air. Sneak to just stand on it.
gui.guhs.herinnering.bel: A memory bubble... there's a little film inside.
gui.guhs.herinnering.bel_gezien: You know this film already. Click the bubble to watch it again.
gui.guhs.herinnering.bel_dicht: This bubble is still shut. Watch the other two memories first.
gui.guhs.herinnering.persoon_snoes: A little Snoes, from long ago. He doesn't see you. He's inside his memory.
gui.guhs.herinnering.stukje: Piece found: the memory. Snoes thought he was always alone... but he never quite was.
gui.guhs.droombadje.start: Plop! A bubble takes you along. Sneak = hop out.
gui.guhs.droombadje.uit: Plop! The bubble popped. Gently down, vads...
gui.guhs.droombadje.klaar: The bubble sets you down gently. Njeg, what a ride!
gui.guhs.droombadje.stop: Click the bath thing! (The bubble waits a moment.)
gui.guhs.droombadje.al: You already have that one, vads. On to the next cloud!
gui.guhs.droombadje.alle: All three bath things! Bring them to Snoes by the little bath.
gui.guhs.droombadje.snoes.nog: Snoes: 'A... bath? I've never had a bath. Without a duck and soap I don't dare...' (%s/3)
gui.guhs.droombadje.snoes.al: Snoes: 'I've never been this clean. I smell of bubbles! Njeg!'
gui.guhs.droombadje.stukje: A piece of Snoes' dream: clean and warm. (%s/5)
scene.guhs.droombadje_snoes_bad.kijk: Is that... all for me? A duck, a soap and... foam?
scene.guhs.droombadje_snoes_bad.teen: Just one toe first. Ooh. Warm!
scene.guhs.droombadje_snoes_bad.blub: Blub blub blub... I'm a bubble!
scene.guhs.droombadje_snoes_bad.dank: I've never had a bath before. Thank you, vadsje.
scene.guhs.droombadje_snoes_bad.vertelle: Snoes is clean and warm. A piece of his dream comes back.
gui.guhs.molentje.tandwielen_goed: All cogs point up. Now for some blowing!
gui.guhs.molentje.kussen.komt: A Blub-guh hops over to the blowing cushion!
gui.guhs.molentje.kussen.bezet: A Blub is already blowing on this cushion. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.molentje.kussen.geen_blub: No Blub nearby... they must be hopping around the mill somewhere.
gui.guhs.molentje.kussen.niet_hier: This cushion only works at the Maanmolentje in Guhdromenland.
gui.guhs.molentje.draait: The sails are turning! The Zandguh is grinding droomzand. Go and see him!
gui.guhs.molentje.stil: The sails have stopped. Again? Turn the cogs and call the Blubs!
gui.guhs.molentje.zandguh.hint.0: The mill stands still, vadsje... Three Blubs on the blowing cushions have to blow the sails going.
gui.guhs.molentje.zandguh.hint.1: And the cogs on the wall! All arrows up, or nothing turns. Click, click, njeg.
gui.guhs.molentje.zandguh.hint.2: Careful: a cog always turns its neighbour along a little. Vahoeg clever, huh.
gui.guhs.molentje.zandguh.droomzand: It's turning! Here, a little bag of freshly ground droomzand. For Snoes' sweetest dream. Sleep tight, vadsje!
gui.guhs.molentje.zandguh.al: You already got your little bag, njeg. Wait until the mill turns again!
gui.guhs.molentje.stukje: A piece of Snoes' dream: the droomzand!
gui.guhs.molentje.cmd.los: Maanmolentje: cogs up, %s Blubs on the cushions.
gui.guhs.molentje.cmd.geen: The Maanmolentje wasn't found (are you in Guhdromenland?).
block.guhs.molen_tandwiel.lore: Click to turn it. All arrows pointing up? Then the mill can grind!
block.guhs.blaaskussentje.lore: Click it at the Maanmolentje: a Blub-guh comes to sit on it and blows bubbles at the sails.
block.guhs.molenwieken.lore: The sails of the Maanmolentje. They only turn when there's enough blowing, njeg.
gui.guhs.snoes.verschijnt: Somebody is sitting next to your bed... a ruffled guh with a bent ear. He yawns, but he doesn't sleep. Talk to him.
gui.guhs.snoes.proloog.0: Njeg... hi. I'm Snoes. Sorry, I'm just sitting by your bed for a bit. It's so cosy here.
gui.guhs.snoes.proloog.1: Everybody has a little place to sleep. A basket, a nest, a box... Not me. I've never slept anywhere.
gui.guhs.snoes.geen_bedtijd: It's not bedtime yet, njeg. Come back tonight, then... maybe...
gui.guhs.snoes.ingestopt: Will you... tuck me in? Oh. Oh! It's soft. I'll close my eyes. But I won't sleep, you know.
gui.guhs.snoes.ingestopt_vloer: There's no box or basket here... but a little blanket on the floor is nice too. I'll close my eyes. But I won't sleep, you know.
gui.guhs.snoes.ga_slapen: Snoes is tucked in. Now go to sleep yourself, in your bed next to him. Maybe you can get into his dream...
gui.guhs.snoes.wakker_liggen: I'm lying here. Eyes open. Counting sheep doesn't help: I count guhs, and they all come for a cuddle.
gui.guhs.snoes.ander: Oh, hi! I'm waiting for somebody else, njeg. But you may pet me for a bit.
gui.guhs.snoes.thuis.0: You dream about me? Really? How many pieces do you have? %s of the five? Njeg...
gui.guhs.snoes.thuis.1: Last night I had my eyes closed for a moment. One second. Maybe two. (%s/5 pieces)
gui.guhs.snoes.thuis.2: Bubbels the Blub says you're searching well. A little longer, and then... then maybe I dare to sleep. (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.droom.0: Is this my dream? It's so soft here. You already have %s pieces!
gui.guhs.snoes.droom.1: I can see the islands, but I don't dare go there. You do! (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.droom.2: When all the pieces are here, maybe... maybe then I'll sleep. (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.klaar: Snoes is asleep. He lives on the Dream Square now, in his box of nibbles, and he greets everybody who comes to dream. And the wild Blub-guhs show themselves to you now too!
gui.guhs.snoes.blij.0: %s! I slept again! In my box! Njeg njeg njeg!
gui.guhs.snoes.blij.1: Hi %s. The kitty house is very pretty, you know. I sit in it in the daytime. At night: box.
gui.guhs.snoes.blij.2: %s, do you know what I have now? A place. My very own place.
gui.guhs.snoes.blij.3: Welcome to the Dream Square, %s! Want a nibble? They're in my bed.
gui.guhs.snoes.blij.vreemde: Hi! I'm Snoes. I live here, in that box. Somebody helped me to sleep. Maybe you'll help somebody too?
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.welkom.0: Blub! Hi! I'm Bubbels, your dream guide. Welcome to Guh Dreamland!
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.welkom.1: Snoes can't dream. His dream blew over the islands in five pieces, blub.
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.welkom.2: A song, a star, a memory, a bath and dream sand. Find them, and we'll help him together!
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.welkom.3: Walk over a jetty to an island, in any order you like. I'll hop along!
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.terug: There you are again! Blub! We have %s of the five pieces.
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.stukje.liedje: The song! Now Snoes finally knows a lullaby. Blub-blub-bluuub! (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.stukje.ster: The falling star! He wishes for something... a place of his own. (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.stukje.herinnering: A nibble, a Blub, a star guh... He thought he belonged nowhere. But he was never quite alone. Blub... (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.stukje.bad: His first bubble bath ever! Clean and warm. That makes you sleep well. (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.stukje.droomzand: Dream sand, freshly ground! A pinch, and your eyes grow heavy... (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.alles: All five! Blub blub blub! Come to the Dream Square quickly, everybody's coming to watch!
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.mee: May I... come home with you? I want to be your Blub. Blub?
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.thuis: Blub! So this is where you live. Nice! I'm staying. Forever.
gui.guhs.snoes.status.alles: Snoes' dream is complete! To the Dream Square!
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.zandguh.nog: The mill stands still, little vads. No wind, no dream sand. Maybe the Blubs can blow? They're good at bubbles.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.zandguh.klaar: Snoes' dream sand is in a little bag with a bow. The finest sand I ever ground.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.droom_omaguh.nog: Touch the memory bubbles on Memory Island, dear. Little things make the loveliest memories.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.droom_omaguh.klaar: A nibble, a Blub and a little star. You see, dear: nobody is ever quite alone.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.rommelguh.nog: Memories? I keep everything! But Snoes's are in three bubbles on Memory Island.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.rommelguh.klaar: I saved a glass for Snoes. Not empty yet. Definitely.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.kussengevecht_guh.no: Higher! Bounce higher! The star only falls when you're at the top. PILLOW!
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.kussengevecht_guh.kl: You have the star! We celebrate that with... PILLOW! Njeg!
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.wekkerguh: %s more pieces, then Snoes may sleep in. Until then: I only ring when you ask.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.verteller: From every island they come to the Dream Square.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.oma: There he is! Come here, dear. There are pink guh cakes, and one is just for you.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.rommel: I brought glasses! They're not empty yet.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.verteller: You built a beautiful kitty house for Snoes.
...but Snoes crawls into the box of nibbles anyway.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.lachen: Hahaha! Of course the box! A guh always picks the box! Njeg!
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.zand: A pinch of dream sand... sleep tight, little Snoes.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.einde: Snoes is asleep. For the very first time.
block.guhs.wolkjeshout_gezicht: Sleepy Guh Face in Cloudlet Wood
block.guhs.koorkom_podium.lore: At dusk the wild Blubs gather here to squeak their lullaby. Shh!
item.guhs.handdoekje.lore: Right-click: dry off. You feel fresh and happy, vads!
gui.guhs.weide.handdoekje: Nicely dried off. Fresh and happy!
block.guhs.wolkjeshout_gezicht.lore: He's asleep. Or is he pretending? Njeg...
block.guhs.bubbelsap.lore: Shiny rainbow sap. Blubs love to bathe in it.
gui.guhs.weide.badguh.1: Welcome to the Bubble Sap Pools! Take a towel, vads. No peeing in the sap, njeg!
gui.guhs.weide.badguh.2: Here you go, a warm towel. Fresh from the cloudlet tree!
gui.guhs.weide.badguh.3: You already have one, you vahoeger! A fresh towel tomorrow.
gui.guhs.weide.badguh.4: Shhh... the Blubs are bathing. It makes them bubbly. You too, by the way.
gui.guhs.weide.tp.geen: No Singing Meadow found nearby. Njeg!
gui.guhs.weide.alleen_guhmension: That only works in the Guhmension, vads.
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.meter_uitleg: How guh is this Blub? At 0% it is a real Blub, at 100% almost a guh (with round guh ears!). The meter is set at birth and never changes, not even if you cuddle it a whole lot. Baby blubs get something in between their parents. Exactly 0 (Pure Blub) and exactly 100 (Full Guh) are very rare. Njeg!
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.knuffel.tooltip: A soft plush of exactly this Blub: same kind, tint, meter and bow. Costs 1 wool.
gui.guhs.blubguh.knuffel.gemaakt: A plush of %s! It looks just like it. Squish!
gui.guhs.blubguh.knuffel.geen_wol: You need 1 wool for a plush. Njeg, no wool, no plush.
item.guhs.blub_knuffel.leeg: A plain blue Blub plush. Have one made of your own Blub: in its menu!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.blubguh: Rarity: Rare (De Zingende Weide and Guh Dreamland; you only see wild Blubs once you helped Snoes)
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.sterrenvisje: Rarity: Rare (the moon pond of the Moon Mill, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.sterrenvisje: A tiny fish with little stars for fins. It glows softly in four colours and leaves sparkles behind. Smells of star dust. Don't feed it: it only eats dreams.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.snoes: Rarity: Unique (by your bed, one evening; later on the Dream Square)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.snoes: A scruffy stray guh with a bent ear and a plaster. He never had a place of his own, so he never dared to sleep. After his dream he sleeps in a box of nibbles (not in the lovely cat house, of course).
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.zandguh: Rarity: Unique (the Moon Mill, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.zandguh: The guh who grinds dreams into dream sand. Nightcap, starry nightgown and a sack full of glitter. He never sprinkles too much, or you'd sleep through breakfast. Very sleepy.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.wekkerguh: Rarity: Unique (the Dream Square, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.wekkerguh: A guh with an alarm clock on his back and little bells on his ears. Talk to him and you wake up. He rings very softly, because nobody likes waking up loudly. Njeg... five more minutes?
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.rommelguh: Rarity: Unique (the Memory Island, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.rommelguh: Wherever Rommelguh has been, there's a glass with a little bit left. Juice, cola, lemonade... they're never quite empty. 'That one isn't finished!' he says. Tidying up? Tomorrow. Maybe.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.droom_omaguh: Rarity: Unique (the Memory Island, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.droom_omaguh: Grandma guh as she is in the memory of the Guh Family Day: with knitting needles, a ball of wool and a tin full of pink guh cookies. 'Another cookie, sweetie?' Yes, grandma.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kussengevecht_guh: Rarity: Rare (the Star Pillow Field, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kussengevecht_guh: Pyjamas on, nightcap on and a pillow in his paws. He throws his pillow at anyone who comes close. It never hurts, only feathers. Only soft fights, njeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.bubbelbadguh: Rarity: Rare (the bath hut by the Bubble Sap Pools in De Zingende Weide)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.bubbelbadguh: Lifeguard Bubbles of the Bubble Sap Pools. He hands out a little towel every day and keeps an eye on the bathing Blubs. He always smells of soap and sings while drying off.
gui.guhs.meterkaart.vak.ja: Filled! You tamed or bred one like this.
gui.guhs.meterkaart.vak.nee: Still empty: tame or breed a Blub of this kind and meter.
gui.guhs.meterkaart.nieuw: New box on your Blub meter map! (%s/%s)
gui.guhs.meterkaart.nieuw_goud: A GOLDEN box on your Blub meter map! (%s/%s)
gui.guhs.droomsfeer.inslapen.1: The moon tucks you in softly...
gui.guhs.droomsfeer.inslapen.2: You drift off on a little cloud...
gui.guhs.droomsfeer.inslapen.4: Your little eyes get as heavy as knabbels...
gui.guhs.droomsfeer.wakker.1: You have a big stretch... njeg!
block.guhs.verhuisdoos.lore: 'Fragile: guh'. Right-click in the evening: tuck your guh in.
block.guhs.schoenendoos.lore: The shoes are gone, the guh is in. Right-click in the evening: tuck your guh in.
block.guhs.pizzadoos.lore: Still warm and it smells of cheese. Which guh could ever say no to that?
item.guhs.zeepje.lore: Give it along when you tuck your guh in: you dream of the Cloud Bath.
item.guhs.sterlampje.lore: Give it along when you tuck your guh in: you dream of the Star Cushion Field.
item.guhs.fotootje.lore: An old little photo of a family day. Give it along when you tuck your guh in: you dream of Memory Island.
gui.guhs.droomspul.postguh.0: Mail for you? Njeg... only a dream. I deliver those for free.
gui.guhs.droomspul.postguh.1: One mailbox per island. But only to islands you've been to, otherwise I don't know your address!
gui.guhs.droomspul.postguh.2: Stamps? Here you pay with yawns. I've had three already today.
gui.guhs.droomspul.postguh.3: Yesterday I delivered a hug. It was a bit squashed, but still very sweet.
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.vraag: Ring? Do you really want to wake up already, vadsje? It's still so cosy here...
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.nog_even: Alarm Guh hits his own snooze button. Zzz...
gui.guhs.dromen.bed.vraag: %s yawns and looks at you sleepily. Will you dream together, or do you just want a good sleep?
gui.guhs.dromen.bed.weg: Your dream buddy is just too far away... njeg.
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.thuis_mee: Bubbels was still with you (on your head or in your pockets) and simply comes home with you. Blub!
gui.guhs.blubguh.snoes_eerst_droom: This Blub squeaks friendly, but won't come along yet... let Snoes sleep first!
gui.guhs.snoes.hud.bij_bed: Talk to Snoes by your bed.
gui.guhs.snoes.hud.ingestopt: Lie down in your bed next to Snoes and choose 'Dream together'.
gui.guhs.snoes.hud.zoek: Find the pieces on the islands (Dream Post takes you back quickly).
gui.guhs.snoes.hud.terug: Sleep next to Snoes to dream on.
gui.guhs.snoes.hud.finale: All found! Go to the Dream Square.
item.guhs.roze_zaadjes.lore: From the pink grass of the Singing Meadow. Plant them on farmland: pink grain grows from them.
item.guhs.roze_graan.lore: It glitters a little. Nobody knows why. Njeg, it just does.
item.guhs.roze_broodje.lore: Guhs and Blubs adore it: it tames them just as well as a kaasknabbel. Vahoeg tasty!
item.guhs.roze_knabbelkoekje.lore: A cookie with a kaasknabbel in it. A little snack for your guh (and secretly for you too).
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.droom.uitleg: A piece of Guh Dreamland: the dream sky with the sleepy moon, falling stars to catch, floating and dream music. The guhs get sleepy.
item.guhs.weerpotje_droom.lore: A bit of dream sky with a sleepy little moon. Shh!
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.droom.bron: the dream chest at the top of the Star Cushion Field, in Guh Dreamland
block.guhs.droomkistje.lore: Stands at the top of the Star Cushion Field, by the big star. You may peek inside once a day!
gui.guhs.droomweer.kistje.morgen: Come back tomorrow, vadsje! The chest is taking a nap.
gui.guhs.droomweer.kistje.eerste: The dream chest held a weather jar: Dream Weather! Open it and your Weather Vadser can dream. VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.droomweer.kistje.eerste.sub: A piece of Guh Dreamland, for at home
gui.guhs.droomweer.kistje.cadeau: The dream chest gave you dream sand and %s. See you tomorrow, vadsje!
scene.guhs.herinnering_knabbel.k1: Long ago. Snoes was only a very little guh.
scene.guhs.herinnering_knabbel.k2: In the grass lay something yellow. It smelled of cheese.
scene.guhs.herinnering_knabbel.k3: Is that... for me? There's no name on it.
scene.guhs.herinnering_knabbel.k4: He waited. Maybe someone would come for it. Nobody came.
scene.guhs.herinnering_knabbel.k6: His very first cheese nibble. Nobody saw. But he never forgot it.
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.titel: Memory: the first night with a Blub
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.b1: A cold night. The wind whistled through the grass.
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.b2: Brrr. Everyone has a place. I only have wind.
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.b3: Then something soft came hopping along. It squeaked, very softly.
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.b5: The Blub snuggled up to him, out of the wind. It said nothing. It just stayed.
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.b6: For the first time, Snoes slept. Only a little bit. When he woke up, the Blub was gone.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s1: A clear night. Snoes lay in the grass, counting stars.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s2: One, two... a hundred... one more... and one more...
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s3: Then he saw it: a few stars together. Two little ears. A little snout.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s4: A guh! There's a guh living up there too. All alone... just like me.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s5: He waved. The stars twinkled back.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s6: Then together we're a little less alone. Good night, star guh. Njeg.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s7: Snoes had a place nowhere. But from that night on he knew: there's always someone who twinkles back.
effect.guhs.stil.uitleg: You make no sound at all: knabbel sensors don't hear you walk, eat or dig, and the Vadswaker can neither hear nor sniff you. Shh... even your tummy rumbles in a whisper.
effect.guhs.onvahoeg.uitleg: You feel a little less vahoeg for a while: you walk 12% slower and get hungry faster. Never dangerous, just a bit sad.
effect.guhs.gezellig.uitleg: Every 4 seconds you heal a little (half a heart, more when it is stronger) and pink hearts float around you. Tea with guhs, njeg!
effect.guhs.uitgerust.uitleg: You walk 10% faster, and when you are hurt you heal half a heart every 5 seconds. A well-rested guh does its chores 15% faster. VAHOEG well slept!
effect.guhs.blosjes.uitleg: Little hearts float around you, and now and then you heal half a heart. An ice cream just makes you blush.
effect.guhs.zweverig.uitleg: Gravity is 60% lower: you jump higher and float gently down, and a fall only hurts after 16 extra blocks. Like an ice-cream cloud!
effect.guhs.besties.uitleg: Every 2.5 seconds you heal a little (half a heart, more when it is stronger) and now and then a heart appears. Best friends, just like Schilly and its guh.
effect.guhs.fris_van_binnen.uitleg: You walk 25% faster and sparkle now and then. Poepschilly did a fine scrubbing job!
effect.guhs.lief_kijken.uitleg: Guhs within 8 blocks make hearts, and a kaasknabbel gets an extra chance to tame a wild guh right away. Taming muisjes is easier, and Poepschilly and guhxolotls let themselves be tamed at once. Who can resist that little face?
effect.guhs.sausdieren_stuiter.uitleg: Falling doesn't hurt, and when you fall more than a block and a half you bounce back up. Boing, vads!
effect.guhs.torenpeper_peperadem.uitleg: A tiny flame comes out with every breath, and you can't freeze. It sets nothing on fire, promise.
effect.guhs.hik.uitleg: About every second and a half a hiccup: a little hop and a squeaky 'hic!'. Completely harmless, just a bit silly.
effect.guhs.fris_en_blij.uitleg: Every few seconds a heart and now and then a happy little dance. Nothing more: just fresh and happy after a bubble bath!
effect.guhs.bubbelig.uitleg: You jump a bit higher, you land a bit softer (2 extra blocks without fall damage) and little bubbles pop around you. Harmless and very bubbly.
effect.guhs.uitleg.onbekend: A guh effect. What it does exactly? The guh keeps that secret for now, njeg!
effect.minecraft.mining_fatigue.uitleg: You mine and attack much slower.
effect.minecraft.strength.uitleg: You hit harder (+3 damage per level).
effect.minecraft.jump_boost.uitleg: You jump higher and land softer.
effect.minecraft.resistance.uitleg: You take less damage (20% per level).
effect.minecraft.fire_resistance.uitleg: Fire and lava don't hurt you.
effect.minecraft.invisibility.uitleg: You are invisible, but your armour and items are not.
effect.minecraft.blindness.uitleg: You can barely see and can't sprint.
effect.minecraft.night_vision.uitleg: You see everything in the dark.
effect.minecraft.weakness.uitleg: You hit softer (-4 damage per level).
effect.minecraft.poison.uitleg: You slowly lose health, but it won't kill you.
effect.minecraft.wither.uitleg: You slowly lose health, and this one can kill you.
effect.minecraft.health_boost.uitleg: You get extra hearts (2 per level).
effect.minecraft.absorption.uitleg: Golden extra hearts that take the damage first.
effect.minecraft.saturation.uitleg: Your hunger is filled up at once.
effect.minecraft.glowing.uitleg: You have a glowing outline everyone sees through walls.
effect.minecraft.luck.uitleg: A bit more chance on good loot from chests and fishing.
effect.minecraft.unluck.uitleg: A bit less chance on good loot.
effect.minecraft.slow_falling.uitleg: You fall very slowly and take no fall damage.
effect.minecraft.conduit_power.uitleg: Under water you can breathe, see better and mine faster.
effect.minecraft.bad_omen.uitleg: A bad omen: walk into a village or a trial chamber with it and things get exciting.
effect.minecraft.hero_of_the_village.uit: Villagers give you discounts and gifts.
effect.minecraft.darkness.uitleg: Now and then it gets very dark around you.
effect.minecraft.trial_omen.uitleg: Trial spawners get tougher: stronger enemies, better loot.
effect.minecraft.raid_omen.uitleg: A raid on this village starts any moment now.
effect.minecraft.wind_charged.uitleg: When you die, a gust of wind bursts out of you.
effect.minecraft.weaving.uitleg: When you die, you spin cobwebs around you.
effect.minecraft.oozing.uitleg: When you die, little slimes come out of you.
effect.minecraft.infested.uitleg: When you are hurt, silverfish may crawl out of you.
Under water you don't run out of breath.
gui.guhs.snoes.knuffeltje: Snoes gives you a little plush Blub: "For your guh's back. Then they never sleep alone either. Njeg." (Use it up and dress your guh in it!)
item.guhs.droompyjama.lore: Soft, warm and full of little stars. Protects against nothing, except nightmares.
item.guhs.droompyjama.bonus.1: Whole set: you fall asleep faster (quicker dream fade)
item.guhs.droompyjama.bonus.2: Whole set: falling dream stars give extra dream sand more often
item.guhs.droompyjama.bonus.3: Whole set: in bed your dream buddy asks sooner whether you're going to dream
gui.guhs.blubguh.kast.op_slot: Still locked: unlock it with Blub clothing (the dream shop has them!)
gui.guhs.blubguh.kleding.ontgrendeld: %s now hangs in the Blub wardrobe of all your Blubs!
gui.guhs.blubguh.kleding.al_gehad: %s is already in the wardrobe. Give it to a friend, njeg!
item.guhs.blubkleding.gebruik: Right-click: in the Blub wardrobe for good
item.guhs.blubkleding_slaapmutsje.lore: With a pompom dangling over one ear. Sleep tight, little vads!
item.guhs.blubkleding_sjaaltje.lore: Knitted by Granny guh, one stitch loose. That's how it should be, njeg.
item.guhs.blubkleding_sterrenkroontje.lo: For the princess or prince of the dream sea. Sparkles a bit.
item.guhs.blubkleding_bubbelhelm.lore: A soap bubble around your whole Blub. He's not called Bubbles for nothing.
item.guhs.blubkleding_pyjamaatje.lore: Striped, warm, and his face stays free. Bedtime!
item.guhs.blubkleding_slaapmaskertje.lor: With embroidered closed eyes. He sees nothing, but he dreams.
item.guhs.blubkleding_bloemenkransje.lor: Made of real moon flowers. Smells of night air and nibbles.
item.guhs.blubkleding_brilletje.lore: Granny style. He doesn't read with them, but he looks very wise.
item.guhs.vlieg_diploma.lore: For whoever flew the whole cloud-ring course of the Flying Dream. Without getting lost even once (well... almost).
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.omhoog: The Rookguh puffs up its little cheeks and floats you up... to the Flying Dream! Don't look down, vadsje.
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.omlaag: Hop on its back! The Rookguh takes you gently back down to the Dream Square.
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.rij: You're on a Rookguh! Forward = fly where you look, jump = up, sprint = faster, sneak = hop off. Fly through the cloud rings for the course!
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.bezet: Someone is already on this Rookguh. Njeg, wait your turn!
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.kwijt: Too long without a ring... the clock stopped. Start again at the first ring!
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.record: New record: %s! Vahoeg fast. (You already had today's reward.)
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.record_beloning: New record: %s! The Rookguh hiccups with pride. Here, some dream sand.
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.diploma: Your first whole course, in %s! Here's your Flying Diploma, and a little bag of dream sand. Pilot-guh worthy!
block.guhs.droombrievenbus_wolkje.lore: Stands on the Dream Square. Click it in a dream: Dream Post takes you to your own dream cloud. Sneak-click: how to let friends build along.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.nog_niet: Your dream cloud isn't ready yet... help Snoes fall asleep first, njeg!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.geen_wolkje: They have no dream cloud yet. Not dreamed vads enough!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.bezoeker: You're visiting. Looking is fine, building isn't. Wipe your paws!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.niet_van_jou: Not yours, vadsje! When visiting you only look.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.bus.uitleg: Your dream cloud is yours: build whatever you like! Let friends build along: /droomwolkje vriend <name> (remove: /droomwolkje weg <name>, the list: /droomwolkje vrienden). Visit someone: /droomwolkje bezoek <name>. Back to the square: the jetty with the big bubble.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vriend.erbij: %s may now build along on your dream cloud. Vads together!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vriend.weg: %s no longer builds along on your dream cloud.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vriend.melding: %1$s invited you to build along on their dream cloud! (/droomwolkje bezoek %1$s)
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vriend.zelf: Yourself? You may already do anything on your own cloud, njeg.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vrienden.geen: Nobody builds along on your dream cloud yet.
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.vrienden.lijst: Building along on your dream cloud: %s
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.bezoek.droom: Visiting happens in a dream. Have a good sleep first!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.gast.knuffel.jij: You gave %s a hug. Now it dreams even sweeter!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.gast.knabbel.jij: You gave %s a nibble. Munch munch, in its sleep!
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.gast.bericht.knuffe: %s gave %s a hug in Guh Dreamland 💤
gui.guhs.droomwolkje.gast.bericht.knabbe: %s gave %s a nibble in Guh Dreamland 💤
block.guhs.droombed.lore: A starry quilt and a moon for a pillow. Count sheep and stars here.
block.guhs.guh_hoofdbed.lore: The headboard is a big guh. Sleep with your head against a guh and you dream vads.
block.guhs.blub_bed.lore: A real Blub block to sleep in, with stubby legs and ears. It almost squeaks when you get in.
block.guhs.wolkenhemelbed.lore: Sleeping under a cloud, with a little rainbow. No rain ever falls out of it, promise.
block.guhs.guh_blub_mandje.lore: At night a guh and a Blub curl up in it together. Cuddling together is twice as warm.
block.guhs.stapelbedje.lore: For two guhs, top and bottom. Whoever sleeps on top gets the first nibble tomorrow.
block.guhs.luciferdoosje.lore: A little bed for squeaky mice, with a checkered blanket. Squeak... squeak... (that's snoring).
block.guhs.schelpbedje.lore: For Schilly and Poepschilly. Squabbling by day, cuddling in the shell at night.
