block.guhs.guh_hoofdbank.lore: A long bench bed with a big guh face as its backrest. Everyone their own nook: guh, Blub, mouse and Schilly.
block.guhs.slaaptreintje.lore: A locomotive with a guh snout and three carriages. Next stop: Dreamland. All aboard, zzz!
block.guhs.kussenfort.lore: Walls of pillows, little flags and a nest for everyone. The only fort where you have to whisper.
block.guhs.droomschuitje.lore: A little boat in the crescent moon, with stars on strings. It rocks you to sleep; nobody gets seasick.
block.guhs.boomhut_stapelbed.lore: Three floors and a birdhouse: the wettest at the bottom, the highest on top, the mouse the cosiest.
block.guhs.quiltbed.lore: A big bed with a patch of quilt for every critter. Whoever rolls over the seam owes a nibble.
block.guhs.badkuipbed.lore: An old bathtub full of foam, with blankets of bubbles. The Schillys keep their corner wet.
block.guhs.knuffelnest.lore: The big round nest for eight guhs, with little ears on its rim. All in a circle, heads towards the nibble bowl.
block.guhs.guhhuisje_villa.lore: Two floors, a little balcony, a crown on the roof and room for twenty vadsjes. Villa Vadsvorst!
gui.guhs.huisje.bereik.tooltip: How far your residents wander, do chores and play: %1$s by default, from %2$s to %3$s blocks. Slide and watch the blue dome. Bigger isn't always vadsier, njeg!
advancements.guhs.lieve_vadsjes.huisje_v: Build a Guh Villa: two floors, a crown and room for twenty vadsjes
block.guhs.droomkraampje.lore: The Sandguh's stall on the Dream Square. Click it: dream things for dream sand!
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.label: zzz
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.leeg: The stall is still empty... the Sandguh is napping.
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.kleine_lettertjes: Paid with dream sand. A dream sand block counts as 9; you get your change back.
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.grap.2: "Buy something and get a yawn for free."
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.grap.3: "Dream sand is not beach sand. Neither is vadsigheid."
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.grap.4: "Zzz... oh, a customer! Have a look around."
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.tekort: You're %s dream sand short. Catch some stars!
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.nee.max: You already have that one. One is enough, says the Sandguh.
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.nee.onbekend: That isn't here (any more). Dreamt it, maybe?
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.nee.mislukt: That went wrong; your dream sand is back.
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.blub_knuffel.uitleg: A Blub plushie of a random wild Blub: which kind, meter and size? Surprise!
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.bed.uitleg: A brand new bed, fresh from the dream.
advancements.guhs.quest.droomwinkel_geko: Buy something in the dream shop
item.guhs.dirigeerstokje.lore: With a little star on the tip. The Blubs of the Koorkom listen to it. Mostly.
item.guhs.dirigeerstokje.gebruik: Click near the podium of a Koorkom: the Blubs come to sing. On the beat, look at the Blub that lifts its ears, and click!
item.guhs.gouden_dirigeerstokje.lore: Only for true maestros. Conducts exactly the same, only much more vahoeg.
gui.guhs.dirigent.geen_podium: Find the podium of a Koorkom first, in the Singing Meadow.
gui.guhs.dirigent.al_bezig: Someone is already conducting here. Wait your turn, vadsje!
gui.guhs.dirigent.snoes_eerst: You can't see the wild Blubs yet... help Snoes fall asleep first, njeg!
gui.guhs.dirigent.geen_blubs: There are no Blubs here to conduct. The choir is out for a bit, njeg.
gui.guhs.dirigent.begin: Tap tap with the baton! %s Blubs hop to the podium.
gui.guhs.dirigent.verzamelen: The Blubs are finding their spot...
gui.guhs.dirigent.naast: Huh? There was no beat. Click in time!
gui.guhs.dirigent.gestopt: The concert has stopped. The Blubs hop on.
gui.guhs.dirigent.einde.0: Oops... the Blubs squeaked every which way (%s/%s points, %s perfect, best combo %s). One more time?
gui.guhs.dirigent.einde.1: ★ A sweet little song! %s/%s points, %s perfect, best combo %s.
gui.guhs.dirigent.einde.2: ★★ Beautifully sung! %s/%s points, %s perfect, best combo %s.
gui.guhs.dirigent.einde.3: ★★★ VAHOEG! A true maestro! %s/%s points, %s perfect, best combo %s.
gui.guhs.dirigent.prijs: The Blubs give you a thank-you: %s!
gui.guhs.dirigent.goud: What's sparkling there? A GOLDEN conductor's baton, for the very best maestro!
item.guhs.kussengevecht_kussen.lore: Left-click someone on the bed: poof! Never hurts, only flying.
item.guhs.opeenrij_schijfje.lore: A pink guh on one side, a blue Blub on the other. Always a hit.
item.guhs.wieishet_kaartje.lore: There is a guh on it. Or is it another guh? Njeg.
gui.guhs.gezel.npc.wieishet: Guess who? Against a guh or a friend
gui.guhs.gezel.npc.opeenrij: Four in a row! Against a guh or a friend
quest.guhs.gezel.kussenbaas.hallo: Pyjamas on, pillow in your paws and up on the big bed! Whoever stays standing longest wins. Whoever falls off lands softly in the cushion pit. Players standing close by join in, and my guh friends fill up the rest. Njeg!
quest.guhs.gezel.kussenbaas.uitleg: Left-click someone with your pillow: poof, off they fly a little. It never hurts. Fall off the bed and you lie in the cushion pit and watch. The last one on the bed wins (after two minutes everybody still standing wins). You get 10 points for everyone you push off, and 50 for winning. Friends join in when they stand within %s blocks of me when you start.
gui.guhs.gezel.kussen.uitleg: Pillow fight! Left-click someone with your pillow. Last one on the bed wins!
gui.guhs.gezel.kussen.jij_af: Poof! You are in the cushion pit. Nice and soft, njeg.
gui.guhs.gezel.kussen.niemand: Everybody is in the pit. A draw, and a nap.
gui.guhs.gezel.uitleg.opeenrij: Take turns dropping a disc into the board.
gui.guhs.gezel.uitleg2.opeenrij: Four in a row wins: guhs against Blubs!
gui.guhs.gezel.uitleg.wieishet: Ask yes/no questions about the other one's guh.
gui.guhs.gezel.uitleg2.wieishet: Whoever first guesses the right guh wins!
gui.guhs.gezel.wacht2: Ask a friend to choose 'Find an opponent' too.
gui.guhs.gezel.ander_open: The other one has %s guhs left
gui.guhs.gezel.log.gelijk: The board is full: a draw.
gui.guhs.snoes.verhuisd: Snoes toddles along with you and plops down beside your new bed. Njeg, it's cosy here too.
block.guhs.mega_oven.lore: An industrial guh bakery of 3 by 2 by 2. Bakes in bulk and eats mountains of nibbles and grain. Empty hand: next programme. Sneak + empty hand: take out the baking.
block.guhs.knabbel_weerstation.lore: A weather tower. As long as it eats nibbles, every Weather Vadser up to 16 blocks away makes its weather over 150 blocks: your whole base!
block.guhs.sterrenkoepel.lore: The Vadsiness Monument. Feed it nibbles: every level lights up a new guh constellation, up to a whole sky full of guhs. Everybody gets something sweet from it.
block.guhs.draaimolen.lore: A guh fun fair ride. A cheese nibble is a ticket: tame guhs nearby ride along and get happy (then they do their chores better and run faster in a Guh Wheel).
block.guhs.wolkenvanger.lore: A dish for the roof that condenses passing little clouds into fluff. The higher it stands, the more fluff. A chest under it catches it.
gui.guhs.koepel.station.aan: The weather station runs: every Weather Vadser up to %2$s blocks from here makes its weather over %1$s blocks.
gui.guhs.koepel.station.uit: The weather station is asleep: it wants %s vadskracht and nibbles. Njeg...
gui.guhs.koepel.koepel.nieuw: ✦ A new constellation lights up on the Star Dome: %s (%s/%s)! Everybody feels rested for a while. VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.koepel.koepel.vol: The whole sky of guhs is lit already. Incalculably vahoeg!
gui.guhs.koepel.koepel.gevoerd: %s nibbles in the dome! %s more to the next constellation.
gui.guhs.koepel.koepel.stand: Star Dome: %s/%s constellations, %s more nibbles to the next one. The biggest givers:
gui.guhs.koepel.molen.rit: All aboard! The merry-go-round turns, guhs ride along.
gui.guhs.koepel.molen.slaapt: Ticket bought, but the merry-go-round wants %s vadskracht. Njeg!
gui.guhs.koepel.molen.kaartje: A cheese nibble is a ticket.
gui.guhs.koepel.vanger.stand: The cloud catcher catches a bit of fluff here every %s seconds.
gui.guhs.koepel.vanger.dak: The cloud catcher wants open sky above it: put it on the roof!
gui.guhs.koepel.vanger.uitlezing: One bit of fluff per %s seconds
block.guhs.hamsterknooppunt.lore: The main station of your hamster tube network. Runs on vadskracht and fills a buffer; every trip costs %s VK (buffer: %s VK). Without vadskracht your whole network stands still, njeg.
block.guhs.hamsterknooppunt.nieuw: This is your Hamster Junction now! Run a guh wire to it and the hamster tubes start rolling.
block.guhs.hamsterknooppunt.verhuisd: Your Hamster Junction moved here. The old one does nothing any more.
block.guhs.hamsterknooppunt.niet_meer: This is not (or no longer) your Hamster Junction. A newer one stands somewhere.
block.guhs.hamsterknooppunt.stand: Hamster Junction: %s / %s VK in the buffer, a trip costs %s VK. Stations in your network: %s.
block.guhs.hamsterbuis_station.lore: Put it anywhere, in any dimension. Step into the tube and pick where to go: whoosh! Needs no vadskracht itself, your Hamster Junction pays (%s VK per trip).
block.guhs.hamsterbuis_station.geen_knoo: This station is registered, but you have no Hamster Junction yet. Without a junction nothing rolls.
block.guhs.hamsterbuis_station.niet_van_: This is someone else's hamster tube. Ask if you may (dream cloud friends always may)!
block.guhs.hamsterbuis_station.weg: That station doesn't exist any more. It was taken out of the network.
block.guhs.hamsterbuis_station.stil: The hamster tube network stands still: the junction's buffer has less than %s VK. Give the junction vadskracht!
gui.guhs.hamsterbuis.openbaar.tooltip: Public: everyone may travel with this station. Private: only you and your dream cloud friends.
gui.guhs.hamsterbuis.ga_stil: The network of %s stands still (%s): the junction has too little vadskracht.
gui.guhs.hamsterbuis.geen_knooppunt: No Hamster Junction: this network stands still.
gui.guhs.hamsterbuis.geen: No other stations yet. Put another one down, somewhere far away, and come back!
block.guhs.mega_knuffelcentrale.lore: A giant 5 by 3 cushion where 16 tamed guhs cuddle together: 22 vadskracht per guh, up to 352 in all. Do look after them: knabbels, pink buns or blocks of kaasknabbels, and one wool a day for fresh blankets. One per net.
gui.guhs.centrale.leeg: No guh on the giant cushion yet: tamed guhs within %s blocks come by themselves
gui.guhs.centrale.honger: Hungry! Without food they only cuddle at %s percent
gui.guhs.centrale.dekens_oud: The blankets are not fresh any more: %s percent. One wool a day, vads!
advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_bronnen_: Let guhs cuddle on a Mega Cuddle Plant
advancements.guhs.techniek.centrale_expo: Sell bulk to a guh villager for something rare
block.guhs.kaaskas.lore: The heart of a glass greenhouse. With vadskracht (12) and kaassaus the crops around it (9 by 9) grow much faster. Vahoeg many nibbles!
item.guhs.kaaskas.lore: Put it among your crops and give it vadskracht (12) and a bucket of kaassaus.
gui.guhs.kaaskas.wacht_saus: Waiting for kaassaus (bucket or Sauce Hose)
block.guhs.sorteerband.lore: What lies on it rides along to the end. There a guh with the chore Sorter puts it in the right chest. Njeg, tidy is nice!
gui.guhs.klus.kassier.tip: Walks into the Cheese Greenhouse, picks everything that is ripe in one go and plants it again right away. The harvest goes to the chest or the Bank Guh. Only in a greenhouse of yours. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.kassier.g: Nothing ripe yet. Crops growing in your greenhouses: %s
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.kassier.n: a Cheese Greenhouse you placed yourself in the chore area, with crops around it. They pick everything that is ripe and plant it again.
I picked the whole greenhouse empty! It smelled of cheese and little plants. Vahoeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.kassier: Did you know there is a greenhouse full of nibbles at %s? I pick it empty. Njeg!
gui.guhs.klus.sorteerder.tip: Waits at the end of a Guh Sorting Belt, picks up what arrives and puts it in the chest that already holds that kind. Put one thing in a chest yourself and it knows where it belongs. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.sorteerde: Things waiting at the end of a sorting belt: %s
Sorting belts: %s. Nothing is waiting right now
No sorting belt in the chore area
a Guh Sorting Belt in the chore area, and chests next to the huisje that already hold one of each kind. What has no chest of its own goes to the Bank Guh or another chest.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_sorteerd: Everything went into the right chest. I am vahoeg tidy today.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.sorteerder: Did you know a belt runs at %s? I sort everything into the right chest!
block.guhs.spinmachine.lore: Spins fluff into white wool: 2 fluff is 1 wool. Runs on vadskracht. Whirrr!
block.guhs.verfbad.lore: Wool (or glass, clay, cuddle blocks...) + dye = coloured. Splash!
block.guhs.knuffelrecycler.lore: Old plushies, guh clothes, wool and cushions turn back into fluff. Nothing is wasted, njeg!
block.guhs.scheerstal.lore: Keep your tame Cloud Lambs around it (6 blocks): the stable shears them by itself and keeps the fluff.
block.guhs.bouwblokken_fabriek.lore: A smart stonecutter that paints too. Put down an example and it makes it in bulk. Link a Bank Guh or a chest!
block.guhs.kleurmolen.lore: Grinds flowers into dye, with a bonus: 2 to 3 per flower. All 16 colours!
block.guhs.regenboogpers.lore: Presses fluff and cheese sauce into any colour you pick. No flowers needed!
item.guhs.pluis.lore: Soft, white and a little tickly. Spin it into wool in the Spinning Machine.
item.guhs.wolkenschaapje_item.tooltip: A picked-up cloud lamb (name and all). Right-click a block: it hops off again. Bleh!
gui.guhs.fabriek.knuffelrecycler.leeg: Waiting for old plushies, clothes, wool or cushions
gui.guhs.fabriek.scheerstal.geen_schaapj: No fluffy Cloud Lamb within %s blocks
gui.guhs.fabriek.regenboogpers.geen_saus: Waiting for cheese sauce (bucket, Sauce Vat or sauce pipe next to it)
gui.guhs.fabriek.bouwblokken.bank_weg: The linked Bank Guh is nowhere to be found
gui.guhs.fabriek.bouwblokken.geen_voorbe: Put an example in the middle slot: that is the block it makes
gui.guhs.fabriek.bouwblokken.geen_bron: No blocks (or dye) to make that from
gui.guhs.fabriek.koppel.lege_sleutel: This Bank Key doesn't know a bank yet. Click a Bank Guh first!
gui.guhs.fabriek.koppel.bank: Linked to the Bank Guh! Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.fabriek.koppel.klik_kist: Now click a chest (within %s blocks). The factory again: forget all links.
gui.guhs.fabriek.koppel.geen_kist: That's not a chest. Linking stopped.
gui.guhs.fabriek.koppel.te_ver: Too far! A chest can be at most %s blocks away.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.sub.wolkenschaapje: Cloud Lamb: a little cloud on legs
gui.guhs.piep.menu.speciaal.wolkenschaap: Hug your lamb: you become as light as a cloud and float down gently.
gui.guhs.piep.opgepakt.wolkenschaapje: You pick up %s. It's just like a pillow. Bleh!
gui.guhs.wolkenschaapje.knuffel: %s gives you a fluffy hug: you're as light as a cloud!
gui.guhs.wolkenschaapje.knuffel_rust: Your lamb needs a little rest (%s s)
gui.guhs.klus.scheren.tip: Shears the tame Cloud Lambs in the chore area and brings the cloud fluff to the chest. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.scheren.k: The lambs are still bald: the fluff is growing back
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.scheren.n: tame Cloud Lambs in the chore area
I sheared a cloud lamb. It said bleh. I said bleh too. Now we both have fluff.
gui.guhs.klus.bloemetjes.tip: Picks the flowers in the chore area (they keep standing) and brings exactly those flowers to the chest: food for the Colour Mill. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bloemetje: No flowers in the chore area
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_bloemetj: I picked flowers and they just kept standing. Magic flowers! Or I'm very careful.
block.guhs.fossiel_broedmachine.lore: Put a fossil and cheese nibbles in: under the glass bell it hatches an egg. After a whole day an ancient guh crawls out!
block.guhs.fossiel_broedmachine.lore.kra: %s vadskracht while it hatches, %s cheese nibbles per egg
gui.guhs.fossiel.al_een: There is already a fossil under the bell, vadsje. One egg at a time!
gui.guhs.fossiel.uitgekomen: Crack! A baby %s crawls out of the ancient egg. It squeaks at you right away: VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.fossiel.status.leeg: The bell is empty. Put a fossil in (and 16 cheese nibbles).
gui.guhs.fossiel.status.broedt: The egg of a %s is hatching: %s%%
gui.guhs.fossiel.status.broedt_slaapt: The egg of a %s is paused at %s%%: no vadskracht!
gui.guhs.fossiel.status.knabbels: A fossil of a %s. Still needs cheese nibbles: %s of %s.
gui.guhs.fossiel.status.kracht: A fossil of a %s, ready to hatch. Now %s vadskracht!
gui.guhs.fossiel.mammoet_wol: %s shakes its coat: wool for you!
gui.guhs.fossiel.stokstaartje_ziet: %s stands on its hind paws and points: a %s, %s, %s blocks away!
item.guhs.fossiel_mammoet.lore: A bit of tusk in stone. Deep under the wool there once lay a whole woolly guh, njeg.
item.guhs.fossiel_tguh.lore: A little skull with very many teeth. Luckily it only eats cheese nibbles.
item.guhs.fossiel_pteroguh.lore: A wing bone with a crest. This guh flew around before cheese even existed!
item.guhs.fossiel_stokstaartje.lore: A tiny skeleton that still stands upright. It keeps watch, even as a fossil.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.mammoetguh: Rarity: Only from the Fossil Hatchery
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mammoetguh: A woolly brown ancient guh with a little trunk and two tusks. Strong as a vads bear: in a guh house it does its chores twice as fast. Cuddle it and it shakes a bit of wool out of its coat. Hatches from a Mammoth Guh Fossil, njeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.tguh: Rarity: Only from the Fossil Hatchery
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.tguh: A green ancient guh with teeny tiny arms and a thick tail. The best watcher there is: with the Watch chore it spots monsters coming from very far away and chases them off. Can't touch its own nose. Hatches from a T-Guh Fossil!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.pteroguh: Rarity: Only from the Fossil Hatchery
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pteroguh: A teal ancient guh with little wings and a crest on its head. When it lives in a guh house it flies what the chores bring in to chests that stand much further away. Flap flap, vads! Hatches from a Pteroguh Fossil.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.stokstaartjeguh: Rarity: Only from the Fossil Hatchery
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.stokstaartjeguh: A sand-coloured ancient guh with dark patches around its eyes. When it stands still it stands up and keeps watch. When it spots a rare guh nearby it shows you the way. Hatches from an Ancient Meerkat Fossil!
block.guhs.lanceerplatform.lore: Build your own Cheese Rocket here, in four steps. Click it with the things on you; sneak-click: what is still needed.
block.guhs.terugkeercapsule.lore: Click it and you're home in a jiffy. Pack your cheese moon crystals!
block.guhs.kaasmaankristal_erts.lore: Only in the craters of the Cheese Moon. Sparkles like a guh that spots a nibble.
item.guhs.kaasmaankristal.lore: Astronaut Kaasje gladly swaps them for souvenirs.
block.guhs.maanvlaggetje.lore: Plant it on the Cheese Moon: one small step for a guh, one giant nibble for guhkind.
gui.guhs.raket.stap.klaar: %s is done! The rocket grows, njeg!
gui.guhs.raket.volgende: Next step: %s. Sneak-click the pad to see what's needed.
gui.guhs.raket.bemanning.uitleg: Bring %s of your own guhs in an astronaut suit to the pad and click it: then they climb in.
gui.guhs.raket.bemanning.nodig: %s astronaut guhs are ready, %s are needed. (Your own guhs, in an astronaut suit, close by.)
gui.guhs.raket.klaar_voor_lancering: The Cheese Rocket is ready! Click the pad: 5... 4... 3...
gui.guhs.raket.naar_maan: Click the pad and the rocket takes you to the Cheese Moon.
gui.guhs.raket.gelanceerd: Launch successful! Next stop: the Cheese Moon.
gui.guhs.raket.cmd.stap: The pad now has %s steps done.
gui.guhs.raket.cmd.spullen: All rocket things are in your bag.
gui.guhs.raket.cmd.bemanning: Three astronaut guhs are ready for you.
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.aankomst: Welcome to the Cheese Moon! It smells... very much of cheese here. Go on, jump: everything is lighter here.
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.terug: The capsule sets you down gently at home. See you next time, Cheese Moon!
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.kaasje.praat.0: Kaasje: "Hello earthling! Or... guhling? Mind the craters, that's where the prettiest crystals are."
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.kaasje.praat.1: Kaasje: "I've lived here a long time. The nibbles are free here, you just have to take a bite."
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.kaasje.praat.2: Kaasje: "Vahoeg, a visitor! Got cheese moon crystals for me? Then I've got souvenirs for you."
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.kaasje.ruil: Swapping: click with cheese moon crystals in your hand. %s = little moon flag, %s = cheese moon rock, %s = mini rocket. (Sneak-click: always the flag.)
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.kaasje.gekocht: Kaasje gives you: %s. "Safe travels, and don't forget to wave!"
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.vlag: You planted a flag on the Cheese Moon! One small step for a guh...
scene.guhs.raket_lancering.titel: The launch of the Cheese Rocket
scene.guhs.raket_lancering.klaar: All guhs aboard? Seatbelts on, ears down!
scene.guhs.raket_lancering.weg: There she goes, straight to the Cheese Moon!
advancements.guhs.quest.raket_romp.title: A hull with ears
advancements.guhs.quest.kaasmaan_bezocht: Set foot on the Cheese Moon
gui.guhs.vadskracht.telt_deels: Counts for %s%%: after %s %s a guh gets a bit lazy, nyeg
gui.guhs.vadskracht.afnemend: %s Guh Wheels in this setup: together still %s%% as chonky. Better build a second setup!
block.guhs.guh_wheel.lore.afname: The first 4 Guh Wheels in a setup count in full. Every wheel after that gives 75% of the one before: guhs don't like running in a traffic jam.
block.guhs.knabbelketel.lore: A boiler with a guh face that burns cheese nibbles. Right-click with nibbles or a block of cheese nibbles (that burns nine times as long), or let a Nibble Pipe fill it. Smells of melted cheese.
block.guhs.knabbelketel.lore.kracht: Gives %s chonk power and eats %s cheese nibbles an hour
block.guhs.knabbelketel.koud: The boiler is cold: throw in some cheese nibbles!
block.guhs.knabbelketel.brandt: It burns: %s nibbles left in the tray, this nibble %s more seconds
block.guhs.knabbelketel.gevoerd: Nom! %s nibbles in the tray now
block.guhs.knuffelsteen_generator.lore: Cheese sauce and water meet and out rolls cuddlestone, on 4 chonk power: 60 a minute. Put it next to a water source and only cheese sauce has to go in. The stones go into a chest, the bank or a pipe next to it by themselves.
block.guhs.knuffelsteen_generator.water_: Water from the source next to it: free, nyeg!
block.guhs.saustank.lore: A Sauce Vat with steel hoops for 64 buckets of one sauce. A meter sits on its belly. Pick it up and the sauce comes along. Almost a swimming pool of cheese sauce.
block.guhs.sausbuis.lore: A thick pipe for sauce over long distances. Joins pumps, vats, tanks, hoses and sauce machines by itself, and counts as only a sixteenth of a hose: up to 4096 pipes in one line.
block.guhs.weer_vadser.lore.straal: Radius %s blocks. With a Cloud Antenna on top or next to it that grows up to %s: right-click the Weather Vadser with the antenna
block.guhs.wolkenantenne.lore: Weather Vadser radius %s blocks, costs %s chonk power
block.guhs.wolkenantenne.lore.hoe: Put it on top of or next to the Weather Vadser, or right-click the Weather Vadser with it. First I, then II, then III.
gui.guhs.weer.antenne.al: This Weather Vadser already has Cloud Antenna %s or better
gui.guhs.weer.antenne.eerst: First Cloud Antenna %s, nyeg: one cloud at a time
gui.guhs.weer.antenne.erin: Cloud Antenna %s on! Radius now %s blocks, costs %s chonk power
quest.guhs.techbeurs.aanbouw.1: Welcome to the annex! The simple little things live here. Simple, but very cute.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.aanbouw.2: Upstairs is the Factory Hall and right at the top the Dome. Take the stairs, or the cloud lift if you're lazy. I'm lazy.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.fabriek.1: Welcome to the Factory Hall! Machines here make everything you're too lazy to make yourself. So everything.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.fabriek.2: Every sign says how much chonk power a machine eats. The boiler stand at the back keeps everything here going.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.kaaskas.1: I'm the Cashier! I pick all day long. Not to be confused with picking for myself.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.kaaskas.2: Cheese sauce and chonk power in the Cheese Greenhouse, and everything within 9 by 9 grows like crazy. Add a guh with the chore Cashier.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.sorteer.1: I'm the Sorter. Nibbles with nibbles, wool with wool, and socks... I'm still looking for those.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.sorteer.2: Lay Sorting Belts one after another. A guh with the chore Sorter puts everything in the chest that already holds one.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.koepel.1: Welcome to the Dome! The very biggest machines live here. And the nicest view. And me.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.koepel.2: Under the glass dome stands the Star Dome: feed it nibbles and a guh constellation lights up.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.raket.1: The rocket is half done. Just like my homework. But the rocket really is going to the Cheese Moon one day!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.raket.2: Place your own Launch Pad and build in four steps: hull, engine, fuel and crew. Then: countdown!
gui.guhs.maagwand.boerp: BURP! Your stomach isn't resistant enough yet for this very vadsy vads.
gui.guhs.maagwand.eerst: First eat %s more of %s to grow more resistant. This vads needs: %s.
gui.guhs.maagwand.eerst_leeg: First eat more vads your stomach can handle to grow more resistant.
gui.guhs.maagwand.gestegen: VAHOEG! Your stomach wall is now: %s! Bonus: %s.
gui.guhs.maagwand.bonus.4: no more hunger cramps from rotten vads

item.guhs.driedubbel_gefrituurde_kaaskna: More grease than nibble. Your doctor quietly weeps.
item.guhs.kaaskroket.lore: Crispy outside, lava hot inside. Wait before biting.
item.guhs.frikandel_guhspeciaal.lore: With cheese sauce, nibble onions and wahoog curry. Nobody knows what is in it, and that is for the best.
item.guhs.bitterguhllen.lore: Round, crispy and looking at you a bit. With a dollop of mustard.
item.guhs.kaassoufflguh.lore: A crispy little pillow full of molten chonk.
item.guhs.patatje_kaassaus.lore: From the pan, into a paper cone, under the sauce. Wahoog.
item.guhs.patatje_vads.lore: With an extra layer of chonk, for the chonkers among us.

item.guhs.patatje_guhspeciaal.lore: Fried twice and golden with pride.

gui.guhs.knus.snackrecepten.patatje_oorl: In the frying pan: a poisonous potato (the pan takes the poison out, njeg).

gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.hallo: NJEG! Welcome to the Fry Cone! What will it be, little chonk? Everything fresh from the fat!
gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.uitleg: Pay me in Cheese Nibbles and you know the recipe forever. After that you just fry it at home in your own frying pan, you never have to come back. But do come by, chonk!
gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.recepten: Which recipe shall I teach you? You pay in Cheese Nibbles.
gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.alles: You know them all, wahoog! I have nothing left to teach you. You should be behind this counter!
gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.te_duur: Njeg, that recipe costs %s Cheese Nibbles and you don't have them on you. Come back later!
gui.guhs.snackbar.guh.geleerd: You now know the recipe for %s! Fry it at home in your pan.

item.guhs.churros_guhtella.lore: One more thing that makes Linguhs queasy. Doubly tasty then, njeg.
item.guhs.suikerspin.lore: A little cloud of sugar on a stick. Sticks to your guh moustache.
item.guhs.poffertjes.lore: A tray full, under a mountain of powdered sugar. Vahoeg!
item.guhs.oliebollen.lore: Round, warm and vadsig. Just like a guh.

erfenis.kaart.nieuws.gezellig.3: %s is taking an afternoon nap. All of %s is quiet. Shhh.

erfenis.koppeling.brief.tekst:
Congratulations, nyeg! You have been chosen (by me, with a die) to take over a lovely piece of land: an old farm on the edge of the Guhmension. Roomy lot, lots of green (SO much green), a charming little shed. Folks call this sort of thing a fixer-upper. The structural report is short but honest: chonky.

Asking price: one (1) cheese nibble. No, that's not a typo. Pay the nibble and you get the Inheritance Gate: put it in your own base and step right onto your little estate. Wahoog!
erfenis.koppeling.brief.geen_knabbel: You don't have a cheese nibble on you, nyeg! Guhrrit really won't do it for less.
erfenis.koppeling.brief.kwijt: You don't have Guhrrit's letter on you anymore. Where did that thing go now?
erfenis.koppeling.brief.gekocht: Sold! Guhrrit happily tucks the cheese nibble into his inside pocket. You get the Inheritance Gate and a Delivery Chest. Put the gate in your base and step through to your inheritance. Wahoog!
erfenis.koppeling.brief.extra: Another Inheritance Gate, please. Guhrrit winks: "Anything for you, nyeg."
erfenis.koppeling.brief.bezorgd: Mail for %s! A fat envelope from realtor Guhrrit. It smells a little like cheese, nyeg.
erfenis.koppeling.hekje.op_slot: This gate is locked. First the letter from realtor Guhrrit, nyeg!
erfenis.koppeling.hekje.dicht: The gate squeaks, but nothing happens. Try again in a moment.
erfenis.koppeling.leverkist.post: Mail from your inheritance: %s bits and bobs in your Delivery Chest!
erfenis.koppeling.leverkist.post_vol: Mail from your inheritance: %s bits and bobs in your Delivery Chest. The rest waits until there's room again.
erfenis.koppeling.leverkist.van_jou: This Delivery Chest is yours now: mail from your inheritance goes in here.
erfenis.koppeling.dorpszender.stand: Village Transmitter: I'm sending %s CP. %s CP arrives in your village (a quarter blows away on the way, nyeg).

erfenis.koppeling.decobon.ingewisseld: Deco Voucher handed in! You now have %s Deco Voucher(s) for the deco shop in your village.

sherlock.bericht.wacht: %s has to wait a bit. First: %s.
sherlock.bericht.klaar: There's a new little case in the Detective Agency's mailbox: %s! %s
sherlock.bericht.glas: You get Sherlock's magnifying glass. Hold it in your village during a case: the clues will sparkle!
sherlock.bericht.alles_gevonden: All clue cards found! Go to the clue board in the Detective Agency and point out the culprit.
sherlock.bericht.sticker: Sticker in your Sniffer's Notebook: First try!
sherlock.bericht.pet: You get Sherlock's checkered cap (the Guhlock Cap) for your guhs!
sherlock.glas.grap.0: This is grass. Very suspicious grass.
sherlock.glas.grap.1: You see... your own nose. Magnified.
sherlock.glas.grap.2: An ant! Oh no, a crumb. Oh no, an ant with a crumb.
sherlock.glas.grap.3: Nothing to see. Just lots and lots of chonk.
sherlock.glas.grap.4: Hmm. This pebble looks guilty. But there's no case.
sherlock.glas.grap.5: Without a case, a magnifying glass is just a very round little window.
sherlock.glas.niet_hier: Nothing to sniff out here. The clues are in your own village.
sherlock.glas.heet: Very warm! Something is close by. Look at it and try again.
sherlock.glas.warm: Warm... the clues aren't far away.
sherlock.glas.koud: Cold. Brrr. Try looking somewhere else in the village.
sherlock.glas.alles: All clues found! Ask the witnesses, or go to the clue board.
sherlock.optie.toon: Take a look at this clue...
sherlock.getuige.klaar: Thanks for stopping by, sniffer! I've already told you everything.
sherlock.vadson.rust: No case right now. I'm reading through my Sniffer's Notebook again. So exciting!
sherlock.vadson.klaar: There's a new little case in the mailbox! Take a look in the Sniffer's Notebook!
sherlock.vadson.tip.sporen: We're still missing %s clue(s). Hold the magnifying glass and walk around: whatever sparkles is a clue!
sherlock.vadson.tip.getuige: All clues found! But %s surely knows something more. Go and ask!
sherlock.vadson.tip.bord: We have everything! Pin three clue cards on one suspect on the clue board and point out the culprit.
sherlock.bord.te_weinig: Pin at least three clue cards on %s first, sniffer. Otherwise nobody will believe us.
sherlock.bord.fout.0: Hmm, that doesn't quite add up. Take another good look at the clue cards!
sherlock.bord.fout.1: No problem! A real sniffer simply tries again.
sherlock.bord.fout.2: Sherlock mumbles in his sleep: 'cold... colder...' Try someone else!
sherlock.bord.haring: Wait a minute... this clue card doesn't fit: %s. I've turned it red. Take that string off!
sherlock.klik.ander: Hello! I help this village's sniffer. Your own little cases are in your own village, nyeg.
sherlock.klik.oehoe: Hoo, hoo. I'm guarding something here. What exactly? That's a secret. Whoo knows.
sherlock.klik.morris: Move aside, move aside. Time is asphalt.
sherlock.klik.pim: Hi! Wanna see my little carrots? They're growing super fast. A little bit.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.rechter: Silence in the court! ...Well, you may whisper.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.morris: Hmph. Just wait until the judge hears me out.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.pim: I'm so nervous. I've already petted my little carrot three times.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.vadson: I'm writing everything down! Even that the judge is eating his gavel.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.oehoe: Hoo, hoo. I'm guarding the witness stand.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.guhrrit: What an exciting case! Structural report of this courtroom: chonky.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.oma: I'm knitting a little scarf for the judge, sweetie. He's cold under his wig.
sherlock.guhrrit.0: Structural report: chonky. Emotional report: very chonky.
sherlock.guhrrit.1: One cheese nibble for a whole homestead. A bargain! I'd take it myself, if I weren't so busy.
sherlock.guhrrit.2: I've always said it: this is a fixer-upper. With the emphasis on upper!
sherlock.guhrrit.3: Just look at that view. Well, right now it's nettles. But they'll bloom soon!
sherlock.guhrrit.4: I'm off on vacation soon. I'll send you a postcard. With sunshine on it!
sherlock.guhrrit.5: Paperwork? All sorted! I put a little squiggle under everything.
sherlock.cmd.alles_klaar: All cases have already been solved!
sherlock.cmd.geen_zaak: There's no case running right now.
sherlock.rechtbank.welkom: You're in the neighboring village's courtroom. Everyone is here!
sherlock.rechtbank.bewering.1: The land was sold for one nibble. One nibble is not a REAL price! So the sale is invalid!
sherlock.rechtbank.bewering.2: That will is fake! It isn't even signed!
sherlock.rechtbank.bewering.3: That nibble was made of plastic! So nobody ever really paid!
sherlock.rechtbank.kies: Sniffer, show your best evidence! Pick it from your clue board.
sherlock.rechtbank.fout.testament: We've already seen the will, sniffer. Something else, please.
sherlock.rechtbank.fout.laatste_bladzijd: A signature, how lovely. But that's not what this question is about.
sherlock.rechtbank.fout.kaasknabbel: A nibble! Yummy. But that's not what this is about yet. Munch?
sherlock.rechtbank.fout.rood_veertje: A feather? What does a feather have to do with this? It is a lovely red, though.
sherlock.rechtbank.fout.glimmend_knoopje: A button belonging to Mr. Morris. Glad it's back. But it proves nothing.
sherlock.rechtbank.hint.1: Psst... what did Grandpa Nibble say in his will again? About the price?
sherlock.rechtbank.hint.2: Psst... a signature. What did we find under the oldest little tree again?
sherlock.rechtbank.hint.3: Psst... plastic? Who was it that took a little taste of that nibble again?
sherlock.rechtbank.terug: Court adjourned. Want to go home, sniffer? Or look around a bit more?
sherlock.rechtbank.thuis: You're back home. The village stays yours. And from now on, Morris parks very neatly in his Little Nibble Parking.
sherlock.ui.proloog.ja: Prologue: a rusty little key with a tiny cheese
sherlock.ui.testament.tekst: My homestead goes to whoever takes good care of it, for the price of one nibble. Not to anyone in a necktie. (Grandpa Nibble)
sherlock.ui.uitleg: Click a clue card, then a suspect: that pins a red string. Right-click a clue card to unpin it. Three strings on one suspect? Accuse!
sherlock.ui.uitleg_kies: You're holding '%s'. Now click a suspect.
sherlock.ui.uitleg_rood: Chonkson turned a clue card red: it doesn't fit. Remove the string (right-click) or pin it somewhere else.
sherlock.ui.uitleg_verzamel: Talk to all the witnesses in your village. Each statement gets pinned here, next to the will.
sherlock.welkom.0: Good afternoon! Sherlock Guh, famous sniffer. I say so myself, but it's also true. Nyeg.
sherlock.welkom.1: And I'm Doctor Chonkson! I write everything down in the Sniffer's Notebook. EVERYTHING. Even what we have for lunch.
sherlock.welkom.2: This village smells of mystery. And of cookies. Mostly of mystery... zzz...
sherlock.welkom.3: He's asleep. He does that a lot. Here, take his magnifying glass. Hold it in your village and the clues will sparkle!
sherlock.welkom.4: As soon as there's a little case, it'll be in the agency's mailbox. Wahoog, how exciting!
sherlock.proloog.0: Something glints among the nettles: a rusty little key, with a teeny cheese as a charm.
sherlock.proloog.1: What could it belong to? You put it in your Finds Box. Maybe someone will know later...
sherlock.zaak.eieren.kort: The Chicken Coop hasn't produced any eggs for two days. Where did they go?
sherlock.zaak.eieren.wacht: build the Detective Agency (available from Homestead level 3)
sherlock.zaak.eieren.intro.0: Sherlock! SHERLOCK! The Chicken Coop hasn't laid a single egg in two days!
sherlock.zaak.eieren.intro.1: Hmm. No eggs. That is... eggless. Egg-stremely suspicious.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.intro.2: Sniffer, take the magnifying glass and search around the Chicken Coop. Meanwhile I'll think very hard. With my eyes closed.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.intro.3: And ask Farmer Bonnie what she saw! She sees everything. Really everything. It's a little spooky.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.0: Henry the Rooster?! But why would a rooster take eggs?
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.1: Follow the little footprints to the reeds, Chonkson. As I said... zzz... romance.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.2: In the reeds by the pond lies a huge heart made of eggs. Next to it sits a little duck, with very big eyes.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.3: Cock-a-doodle-doo means 'I love you' in Duck. I think.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.4: How sweet! And look, under the heart there's an old tag: 'Property of Grandpa Nibble'...
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.5: Grandpa Nibble? Who is Grandpa Nibble? I'll write it down. With a question mark. A BIG question mark.
A feather! A FEATHER, Sherlock! And a red one, too. Which chicken is red?
sherlock.zaak.eieren.kaart.pootafdrukjes: Three little toes, heading for the Duck Pond. Someone was hopping along very happily here.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.kaart.hartjesschaal: Someone drew a little heart on it. With a beak, by the look of it. How romantic, nyeg!
sherlock.zaak.eieren.kaart.stagiairspasj: A badge from Morris-Mika Property Development. What was Pete doing at our gate?
sherlock.zaak.eieren.kaart.bonnie_zuchte: Bonnie heard someone sighing at night. 'Very romantic sighing', she says.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.fout.pim: Me? I can't even lift an egg, nyeg. I was only by the gate because the flowers there are so pretty...
sherlock.zaak.eieren.fout.eendje: Quack?! Quack quack! (The little duck is deeply offended and swims an angry little lap.)
sherlock.zaak.eieren.getuige.bonnie.hall: Sniffer! Are you here about the eggs? I see everything, you know. EVERYTHING.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.getuige.bonnie.gezi: At night I heard someone sighing by the pond. Very romantic sighing. And someone whispering 'cock-a-doodle-doo'. Very softly.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.getuige.bonnie.waar: Me? I was in my little bed, with one eye open. Like always. That's why I see everything.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.getuige.bonnie.toon: Oh, I know that! I've seen that already. I see everything, remember?
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.kort: The first batch of cookies is gone. Only empty baking tins are left.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.intro.0: Sherlock, disaster! The very first cookie from the bakery has vanished! Only the baking tins are left.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.intro.1: Empty baking tins... that means the cookie is no longer in them. Write that down, Chonkson.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.intro.2: Written down! Sniffer, there's a trail of crumbs across the path. Follow it with your magnifying glass!
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.0: The baby guhs?! But they're still so little!
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.1: Behind the playground, two baby guhs sit at a teeny tiny table, with their plushies and the whole cookie.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.2: It was a veeery important meeting, nyeg.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.3: A tea party. As I was saying. Say, is there a little piece left?
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.4: Look, the last crumbs disappear into a crack in the floor of the old shed. When you tap it, it sounds hollow...
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.5: Hollow! There's something UNDER the shed! I'm writing it down. With three exclamation marks.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.kaart.kruimelspoo: Crumbs! They lead from the bakery to... the playground? Very small bites.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.kaart.handjes_in_: Teeny tiny hands in the flour
Little handprints in the flour. SO small. Who on earth has such tiny hands?
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.kaart.theeservies: Behind the playground: a doll's tea set, with crumbs on every little plate.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.kaart.meelzak.tek: The sack says 'Flourcap'. It's open. But flour isn't cookies, is it?
Flourcap saw two teeny tiny flour ghosts by the playground at night.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.fout.meelmuts: Me? I only eat flour. Raw. With a little spoon. That's healthy, right? ...Right?
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.fout.pim: Cookies? Morris won't let me have cookies. 'Cookies are not efficient,' he says. Sniff.
Achoo! Sorry, I'm always covered in flour. What do you want to know, Sniffer?
Last night I saw two teeny tiny flour ghosts! They walked to the playground, giggling. Ghosts don't giggle, do they?
I was in the windmill. I'm always in the windmill. I'm the miller. It says so on my cap.
Hmm, that's flour. My flour! I know every grain personally.
sherlock.zaak.spook.kort: At night, the shed creaks and whispers. The builder refuses to work: 'It's haunted!'
sherlock.zaak.spook.intro.0: Sherlock! The builder won't work on the shed anymore. He says it's haunted!
sherlock.zaak.spook.intro.1: Ghosts don't exist, Chonkson. Unless they do exist. Then they do.
sherlock.zaak.spook.intro.2: Pardon me, pardon me, out of the way. I just need to... take some measurements. Nothing to see here. Move along.
sherlock.zaak.spook.intro.3: Who was THAT? He just shoved you aside! In a shiny suit!
sherlock.zaak.spook.intro.4: A guh with a tape measure. Interesting. Sniffer, search in and around the shed. I'll keep an eye on... zzz...
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.0: You open the hatch. In the dark, two big round eyes open.
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.1: Hoo, hoo, who gave you that little key?
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.2: The ghost is an OWL! A snuggle owl!
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.3: I'm Hoo-hoo. I was Grandpa Nibble's best friend. I've guarded this hatch for years. Anyhoo.
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.4: As I was saying: a ghost with feathers. But then who was walking around in those big shoes?
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.5: Look, a flyer in the grass: 'Coming soon: NIBBLE PARKING. 400 spaces. 0 flowers.' From Morris-Mika!
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.6: The hatch stays shut for now, though. It's full of roots. Who seeks beneath the oldest, finds the newest.
There's a HATCH in the floor! With fluffy feathers on it. Ghosts don't have feathers, do they?
sherlock.zaak.spook.kaart.grijs_dons.tek: Very soft gray down. Like a tiny ghost coat.
sherlock.zaak.spook.kaart.luik_slotje: A hatch with a little lock
sherlock.zaak.spook.kaart.luik_slotje.te: A little lock with a cheese on it... Wait. Your rusty little key fits! Click!
sherlock.zaak.spook.kaart.schoenafdrukke: Enormous shoes. Shiny and polished. A Mika's! But ghosts don't wear shoes, do they?
sherlock.zaak.spook.kaart.hoe_hoe.tekst: Bob heard whispering at night. 'It sounded like hoo, hoo,' he says.
sherlock.zaak.spook.fout.morris: Me? A ghost? Ridiculous. I'm a property developer. I develop properties. Here's my card.
sherlock.zaak.spook.fout.pim: Me? I'm scared of the dark. I sleep with a nightlight shaped like a carrot.
sherlock.zaak.spook.getuige.bouwer.hallo: I'm not going in there anymore, nope. No way. I'm a tough builder, but I'm not crazy.
sherlock.zaak.spook.getuige.bouwer.gezie: At night I heard creaking. And whispering! It sounded like: 'hoo, hoo'. That's how ghosts talk, right?
sherlock.zaak.spook.getuige.bouwer.waar: I was in my site shed. With the door locked. And the curtains closed.
sherlock.zaak.spook.getuige.bouwer.toon: That? Brrr. Put it away. Or no, give it here. No, never mind.
sherlock.zaak.wol.kort: Every night, a little bit of wool vanishes from storage. Very neatly, mind you.
sherlock.zaak.wol.wacht: build a Weaving Mill and deliver 10 orders
sherlock.zaak.wol.intro.0: Sherlock, wool is vanishing from storage! A little bit every night. Very neatly, mind you.
sherlock.zaak.wol.intro.1: Stealing neatly... that's almost sweet. Sniffer, follow the wool.
sherlock.zaak.wol.intro.2: And ask Woolly from the sheep what she knows! Though she usually forgets everything.
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.0: A granny? In the order cart?
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.1: Out of the neighboring village's cart climbs Granny Knitguh, with a scarf at least twenty meters long.
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.2: I didn't steal it, sweetie, I borrowed it in advance.
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.3: It's a giant scarf for the village party. For the bandstand! Or for a very long guh.
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.4: You know, I knew Grandpa Nibble. He gave everything away for a nibble. He always said: a homestead is only worth something if someone loves it.
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.5: As I was saying: knitting. Chonkson, write this down: Grandpa Nibble. That name again.
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.wolspoor: A strand of wool across the meadow
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.wolspoor.tekst: A thread of wool, all the way from storage to the cart square. Who walks wool over to the carts?
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.breinaalden.teks: Two knitting needles! With a pink pom-pom on them. Someone's been knitting up a storm.
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.krullerig_regelt: An order letter with an extra line
At the bottom of the order, in curly handwriting: 'And a little wool, sweetie.'
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.schapenwol_hek.t: A tuft of wool on the fence. The little sheep looks very innocent. TOO innocent?
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.welke_wol.tekst: Woolly can't remember anything about wool. But she does remember a granny in a cart...
sherlock.zaak.wol.fout.postguh: I just deliver! What's in my cart is none of my business. Even if it's knitting.
sherlock.zaak.wol.fout.wolletje: What wool? I don't have any wool. Oh wait, I look after the sheep. So I do have wool. What wool?
sherlock.zaak.wol.fout.schaapje: Baaaah! (The little sheep shows you all her wool is still on her. Every bit.)
sherlock.zaak.wol.getuige.wolletje.hallo: Hello! Who are you again? Oh right, the Sniffer! Or was it the baker?
sherlock.zaak.wol.getuige.wolletje.gezie: What wool? ...Oh! Wait. I did see a sweet granny sitting in the order cart. She said 'hello, sweetie' and just kept knitting.
sherlock.zaak.wol.getuige.wolletje.waar: I was with the sheep. I think. Or with the ducks. Somewhere with animals.
sherlock.zaak.wol.getuige.wolletje.toon: Oh, how pretty! What is it? Did I make that? No? Shame.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kort: Under the shed lies Grandpa Nibble's old cheese cellar, with his diary. But the last pages have been torn out!
sherlock.zaak.kelder.intro.0: Hoo, hoo! The carrots are gone. The hatch opens. Come on in, sniffer.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.intro.1: Under the little shed lies a cozy old cheese cellar. On a little table lies a thick diary: 'Grandpa Nibble'.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.intro.2: His diary! But look... the last pages have been torn out!
sherlock.zaak.kelder.intro.3: Torn. That is the opposite of glued. Find the pages, sniffer.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.0: In the bunny run lies the softest nest ever: made entirely of diary pages. Three little bunnies are asleep in it.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.1: So the evidence has... gotten cozy?
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.2: (The bunnies blink. One yawns. They think it's a very nice nest.)
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.3: As I was saying: nibblers. Let them keep it, except for one page. Read it out, Chonkson.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.4: 'My homestead goes to whoever cares for it lovingly, for the price of one nibble. Not to anyone in a necktie.' A WILL!
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.5: So it wasn't a scam! It was Grandpa's wish! But... the very last page, with his signature, is missing.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kaart.geknabbelde_r: The edges aren't torn. They've been nibbled! By tiny little teeth.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kaart.angora_pluisj: Super-soft fluff on the cellar step. Bunny fluff! Doesn't that come from...
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kaart.papier_in_ren: Paper clumps in the Bunny Run
Paper scraps in the hay of the bunny run. Folded up very softly.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kaart.visitekaartje: 'Morris-Mika Property Development: we turn green into gray.' Was he here?!
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kaart.knabbel_knabb: Hoo-hoo was asleep. But she did hear lots of nibbling. Nibble nibble, all day long.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.fout.morris: Me? Make evidence disappear? I just left my card lying around. By accident. On purpose. By accident.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.fout.pim: I can't read in the dark at all! And I'm scared of cellars. And of diaries.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.getuige.oehoe.hallo: Hoo, hoo... yawn. You're waking me up, sniffer.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.getuige.oehoe.gezie: I was asleep. Owls sleep during the day, you know. But I did hear lots of nibbling. Nibble nibble, all day long.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.getuige.oehoe.waar: In my little nest above the hatch. Where else? Whoo knows.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.getuige.oehoe.toon: Hoo... that smells of carrot. And of hay.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kort: Just before the first village party, the bell of The Chonky Cow café has vanished!
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.intro.0: Sherlock, the first village party! Music! Cake! And... the cowbell of The Chonky Cow café is gone!
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.intro.1: A party without a bell is a... party. But without a bell. Terrible.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.intro.2: Cooper from the café is all upset. Sniffer, search by the bandstand!
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.0: Behind the bandstand stands Bertha the Cow, holding the bell to her snout like a microphone. She's singing. Very loudly.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.1: Moo. That's French for 'I am an artiste'.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.2: As I was saying: talent. Let her perform, Chonkson.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.3: Stop the music! Listen up, everyone: I have a BUILDING PERMIT. In one month, this will all be asphalt!
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.4: Morris accidentally knocks over the party cake. Luckily it lands on a big soft cushion.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.5: A building permit for Nibble Parking... Sniffer, this is getting serious.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kaart.hoefafdruk: Hooves! On the stage! Someone was... dancing here?
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kaart.bladmuziek: The music is half eaten. The song is called 'Moo, Moo, Baby'.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kaart.emmer_podi: Written on the bucket in chalk: 'MY STAGE'. In hoofwriting.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kaart.folders.te: 'Coming soon: Nibble Parking!' Pete left them everywhere. But a bell?
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kaart.vals_met_g: Cooper says Bertha the Cow has been practicing in the meadow every night for weeks. Off-key, but with feeling.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.fout.pim: I had to hand out Morris's flyers. I did draw a little flower on them, though. Secretly.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.fout.muzikanten: Us? We've got our own bell! Ring-ring! See? Well, okay, it's a bicycle bell.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.getuige.koos.hal: Welcome to The Chonky Cow! Can I get you a drink? Or a bit of gossip?
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.getuige.koos.gez: Bertha the Cow has been practicing in the meadow every night for weeks. Off-key, but with feeling. She dreams of the stage, if you ask me.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.getuige.koos.waa: I was behind the bar. I'm always behind the bar. You hear everything from there.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.getuige.koos.too: Yikes. Those are chew marks. I know only one someone who eats sheet music.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kort: In the morning, the boundary posts of your plot have moved two squares inward. Your village is suddenly smaller!
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.intro.0: Sherlock! The boundary posts have been moved! Our village has gotten two squares smaller!
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.intro.1: Smaller? That's the opposite of bigger. Very bad.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.intro.2: Sniffer, walk along the edges of the plot. That's where the posts are!
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.oplossing.0: It was me... Morris said I had to. I tied a bow around it, so it would be less mean.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.oplossing.1: All I really wanted was to grow a carrot, nyeg.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.oplossing.2: Aww, Pete. Come here. You can have a little veggie garden here. A REAL one!
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.oplossing.3: Really? Then I'll tell you everything. Morris wants the sale declared 'invalid'. Because 'one nibble isn't a real price,' he says.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.oplossing.4: As I was saying: a bow. Sniffer, we have an informant.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kaart.schouderafd: Someone pushed against the post with their little shoulder. A veeery little shoulder.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kaart.touw_strikj: Around the post is a rope with a neat pink bow. To make it less mean?
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kaart.moestuinboe: A notebook full of drawings of carrots. The cover says: 'Pete's'.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kaart.plattegrond: A map of our village. With new boundaries, in Morris's handwriting!
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kaart.kleintje_hu: Hoo-hoo saw a little one by the posts at night. 'He was crying a bit,' she says.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.fout.morris: I didn't move anything. I never move anything myself. That's what I have... interns for.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.fout.bouwer: Me? When I move posts, they stand straight. These are crooked. With a bow. Not my style.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.getuige.oehoe.hal: Hoo, hoo. I saw it, Sniffer. Owls see everything in the dark.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.getuige.oehoe.gez: A little one. He pushed the posts with his little shoulder. And he was crying a bit. Hoo sad.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.getuige.oehoe.waa: On my branch. I'm always on my branch. I put a little cushion on it.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.getuige.oehoe.too: Hoo... that bow. I've seen a bow like that before. On a little Mika.
sherlock.zaak.licht.kort: At night, a light flickers in Grandpa's cellar, and candles keep vanishing.
sherlock.zaak.licht.intro.0: Sherlock, there's a light flickering in Grandpa's cellar at night! And candles are vanishing from the candle maker's!
sherlock.zaak.licht.intro.1: Light in the dark... that's exactly where light belongs. Suspicious all the same.
sherlock.zaak.licht.intro.2: Sniffer, search around the cellar. And Bonnie has surely seen something again!
sherlock.zaak.licht.oplossing.0: In the cellar, around a candle, sits a whole family of glowworm guhlings. They've moved in to be cozy.
sherlock.zaak.licht.oplossing.1: As I was saying... little lights. (He's only just waking up.)
sherlock.zaak.licht.oplossing.2: Wait... in the green light, something appears on the cellar wall! Invisible honey ink!
sherlock.zaak.licht.oplossing.3: 'The last page lies under my oldest little tree.' (Grandpa Nibble)
sherlock.zaak.licht.oplossing.4: The oldest little tree! That's in the last overgrown patch of the village!
sherlock.zaak.licht.kaart.glinsterstof.t: Green glitter dust. It glows a little. Or am I imagining that?
Melted candle wax, in teeny tiny drops. Warm, cozy, and very small.
sherlock.zaak.licht.kaart.zoemende_honin: The pot is buzzing! But there are no bees inside. Just... little lights?
sherlock.zaak.licht.kaart.uilenveertje_t: An owl feather on the cellar stairs
A feather from Hoo-hoo! Was she in the cellar at night?
sherlock.zaak.licht.kaart.groene_lichtje: Bonnie saw little green lights. 'Very small ones. Veeery many,' she says.
sherlock.zaak.licht.fout.oehoe: Hoo, hoo many times do I have to say it? I GUARD the cellar. I don't throw parties in it.
sherlock.zaak.licht.fout.pim: I do sleep with a nightlight, yes. But it's a carrot. Not a candle.
sherlock.zaak.licht.getuige.bonnie.hallo: Sniffer! I've seen something again. Of course. I see everything.
sherlock.zaak.licht.getuige.bonnie.gezie: Green lights! Very small ones. Veeery many. They danced into the cellar with candles on their backs.
sherlock.zaak.licht.getuige.bonnie.waar: I was in my little bed. With one eye open, as always.
sherlock.zaak.licht.getuige.bonnie.toon: Oh, that sparkles just like those little lights! See, I told you so.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.titel: The Tin Under the Little Tree
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kort: Under the oldest little tree you dig up an old cheese tin. But it's empty!
sherlock.zaak.blikje.intro.0: Under the oldest little tree you dig up an old cheese tin. You open the lid...
sherlock.zaak.blikje.intro.1: EMPTY?! The tin is empty! Someone got here before us!
sherlock.zaak.blikje.intro.2: An empty tin is a tin with nothing in it, Chonkson. There is a thief. Or a kind someone. Search, sniffer.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.0: Hoo, hoo many times do I have to say it? I GUARD things.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.1: When that Mika came digging, I hid the page in my little nest. Here. It's yours.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.2: The last page! With Grandpa Nibble's signature! A little pawprint!
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.3: As I said. We have everything. Now all we need is... zzz...
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.4: Then a red letter drops into the mailbox. The envelope says: SUMMONS.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.5: Morris-Mika is taking us to court! Sniffer, we have to prepare our case!
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kaart.veertjes_boom: Owl feathers by the little tree
More feathers. Soft and downy. Someone landed here.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kaart.nesttakje: A nest twig with paper scraps
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kaart.nesttakje.tek: A twig from a nest, with a little scrap of old paper stuck to it.
From Realtor Guhrrit, on vacation: 'Keep a good eye on your things, okay!'
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kaart.glimmend_knoo: A button from a shiny suit. Morris's! He's been here!
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kaart.iets_wits.tek: Pete saw Hoo-hoo fly off with something white in her beak. Just before Morris came to dig.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.fout.morris: Yes, I was here. I slipped. My button came off. But the tin was already empty! Hmph.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.fout.pim: Me? I only dig for little carrots! And those don't come in tins.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.fout.makelaar: (A postcard from the sunshine:) 'Me? I'm lying on the beach, darling! But keep a good eye on your things, okay!'
sherlock.zaak.blikje.getuige.pim.hallo: Hi sniffer! I'm your informant now. I even have an informant hat. Well, a little bucket.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.getuige.pim.gezien: I saw Hoo-hoo fly off with something white in her beak! Right after that, Morris came with a shovel. He slipped. Hehe.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.getuige.pim.waar: In my veggie patch. My little carrots are already sooo big. Wanna see them?
sherlock.zaak.blikje.getuige.pim.toon: Oh! That button is Morris's. He was really cross about it. He only has six left.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kort: Morris-Mika is taking you to court. Gather testimony from everyone who knew Grandpa Nibble.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.wacht: first solve The Tin Under the Little Tree
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.intro.0: A trial! Sniffer, we need witnesses. Everyone who knows something about Grandpa Nibble.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.intro.1: Talk to Hoo-hoo, Granny Knitguh, Pete, Henry the Rooster... and the realtor, if he ever comes back.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.intro.2: I'm back! What did I miss? A trial? How fun!
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.intro.3: He has a sunburn. And a sombrero. I'm writing it down.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.oplossing.0: We have all the witnesses! Our case is airtight, Sniffer!
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.oplossing.1: As I was saying: airtight. Now just a level 9 Homestead, and then we're off to the judge.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.oplossing.2: I'm coming along! I'll bring my best sombrero. Trials are SO much fun.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kaart.oehoe_: Hoo-hoo guarded the last page, at Grandpa Nibble's own request.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kaart.oma_ke: Granny Knitguh: 'Grandpa Nibble wanted to give his homestead to someone sweet. He said so every day.'
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kaart.pim_bi: Pete tells you everything about Morris's plans. Bows and all.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kaart.hendri: Henry didn't see a thing. But he'd love to come. With his duckie.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kaart.guhrri: Guhrrit carried out the will. And he knows something about that cheese nibble...
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.getuige.oeho: Hoo, hoo. A trial? I'd love to testify. I'm even wearing a little bow for it.
Grandpa Nibble gave me the last page. 'Guard it well, Hoo-hoo,' he said. And so I did. Anyhoo.
Here. Always here. I guard things, remember?
Hello, sweetie! I'm knitting a warm little scarf for the judge. Courtrooms are always so drafty.
Grandpa Nibble said it every day: 'My homestead goes to someone who'll care for it lovingly.' I'll tell the judge, sweetie.
In the cart. I love riding along. All that bumping is so good for knitting.
I'll testify for you! I'm a little scared, though. Can I bring my carrot?
Morris says one nibble isn't a real price. And that the will is fake. But that's not true! I saw it!
I'm practicing my testimony. In my little veggie garden. The carrots are very good listeners.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.getuige.hend: Cock-a-doodle-doo! (Henry the Rooster stands very proudly on one leg.)
Cock-a-doodle-doo! I didn't see a thing. But I'd love to come. Can my duckie come too?
Cock-a-doodle-doo. By the pond. With my duckie. Romantic.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.getuige.guhr: Sniffer! Look at my tan! Structural report on my vacation: chonky.
I carried out Grandpa's will exactly: one nibble, for someone who takes loving care of the homestead. And I tasted that nibble for a sec. To check it was real! It was real. Delicious, even.
On the beach! With my sombrero. But now I'm back, for the trial. How fun!
sherlock.zaak.rechtszaak.kort: The trial against Morris-Mika, in the courtroom of the neighboring village. Pick the right evidence and shout: OBJECTION, NYEG!
sherlock.zaak.rechtszaak.wacht: upgrade the Homestead to level 9 (and solve The Preparation)
sherlock.beloning.recept_theetaartje: The Bakery now knows the recipe for the tea tart!
sherlock.beloning.oma_bestelling: Granny Knitguh now orders from you often, with a little extra on top.
sherlock.beloning.opas_kelder: Grandpa's cellar is now a cozy room in your Homestead, with spots for your finds!
sherlock.beloning.bertha_optreden: Bertha the Cow now performs at village parties!
sherlock.beloning.paaltjes_terug: Pete straightens all the boundary posts again, bows and all. Your village is exactly as big as always again! To say sorry, he slips you his nicest little carrot. Nyeg.
sherlock.beloning.testament: Grandpa Nibble's will is complete, with the last page!
sherlock.beloning.bureau_eindlook: Your Detective Agency gets its finest look!
gui.guhs.titels.hint.sherlock_speurneus: Solve your first little case with Sherlock Guh in The Inheritance.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.sherlock_spokenjage: Find out what's haunting the old shed.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.sherlock_archiefguh: Find the pages of a very old diary.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.sherlock_grenswacht: Put your village's moved boundary posts back.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.sherlock_lichtpuntj: Find out who makes light in the cellar at night.

scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_begin.open: Silence in the court! The neighboring village's courtroom is now in session.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_begin.zaak: Today: The Great Nibble Case. Morris-Mika versus the new owner of Grandpa Nibble's homestead. Munch.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_begin.bewe: Your Honor! The land was sold for one nibble. One nibble is not a REAL price! The sale is invalid!
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_begin.wakk: Zzz... huh? Has it started already? Sniffer, you're up.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar1.b: Grandpa Nibble's will: 'My homestead goes to whoever takes good care of it, for the price of one nibble.' It was his wish!
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar1.t: Objection sustained! A nibble is a perfectly fine price. Munch.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar1.b: That will is fake! It isn't even signed!
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar2.b: The last page, found under the oldest little tree! Signed with Grandpa Nibble's pawprint!
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar2.t: Sustained! A real pawprint. What an adorable little paw. Munch.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar2.r: That... that is a veeery convincing little paw.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar2.b: But that nibble was made of PLASTIC! So nobody ever really paid!
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.b: The cheese nibble itself! With Realtor Guhrrit's tiny tooth mark. He just had to taste whether it was real, didn't he?
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.t: Sustained! You can't taste a plastic nibble. This one is real. I had a little taste too. Munch.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.u: Verdict: the homestead stays with whoever takes good care of it. Court adjourned!
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.h: (He takes a bite out of his cheese nibble gavel.) Mmm.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.z: Sigh... You know, all I really wanted was somewhere to park my own little cart.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.p: Then why not just take a spot at our place? One parking space. With a flower box.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.b: A... Little Nibble Parking? For me? ...Flowers are actually kind of okay.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.k: But my nephews, the chicken thieves... they are a lot less nice. Keep a good eye on your eggs. Hehe.
erfenis.gebouw.hoeve.uitleg: The heart of your fixer-upper. From rickety shed (structural report: chonky) to a great snuggle homestead with a little tower. Keeps your Guhlders and decides how far everything can go.
erfenis.gebouw.opslagschuur.uitleg: All your goods go in here: eggs, wool, planks, cheese... The higher, the more fits. Don't stack them on the guhs, nyeg.
erfenis.gebouw.timmerschuur.uitleg: Home of extra builders in little yellow hard hats. Level 1: a 2nd builder. Level 7: a 3rd builder. Wahoog!
erfenis.gebouw.kippenhok.uitleg: Nibble chicks lay eggs (and lose feathers). The first Chicken Coop is free: a gift from the realtor.
erfenis.gebouw.schaapskooi.uitleg: Guh lambs give white wool. From Homestead 7 and level 7, cloud lambs join in: extra fluff!
erfenis.gebouw.konijnenren.uitleg: Guh bunnies with soft bunny fluff. And manure. Lots and lots of manure. Great for the flowers!
erfenis.gebouw.eendenvijver.uitleg: Guh ducklings give down and duck eggs. Quack means nyeg in Duck.
erfenis.gebouw.koeienstal.uitleg: Guh cows in the meadow give milk. Moo, but the sweet kind.
erfenis.gebouw.bijenhof.uitleg: Hives among the flowers: honey and wax. The bees buzz softly and chonkily.
erfenis.gebouw.mammoetwei.uitleg: Mammoth guhs with giant wool in big bulk. They need chonk power, or they doze off (snore).
erfenis.gebouw.akker.uitleg: Pick a crop, the residents do the rest: wheat, pink grain, carrots, flowers or fluffballs.
erfenis.gebouw.boomgaard.uitleg: Fruit trees and nibbleberry bushes. Picking is allowed, and a little snacking too.
erfenis.gebouw.bakkerij.uitleg: Bread, cookies, carrot cake and pink nibble cookies. It smells super wahoog in here.
erfenis.gebouw.weverij.uitleg: Wool becomes cloth scraps, bunny fluff becomes plushie fabric, cloud fluff and giant wool become wool again.
erfenis.gebouw.kaasmakerij.uitleg: Milk becomes cheese. From level 3 also cheese nibbles (only for home, nyeg!).
erfenis.gebouw.kaarsenmakerij.uitleg: Wax becomes candles in your favorite color, or lanterns. Needs chonk power, or the candles stay out.
erfenis.gebouw.bosje.uitleg: Woodcutter guhs chop logs (and always plant a new sapling in return).
erfenis.gebouw.houtzagerij.uitleg: Saws logs into planks or beams. For the village itself: only raw logs go home.
erfenis.gebouw.groeve.uitleg: Stone from the cliff face, and now and then a lump of clay.
erfenis.gebouw.steenbakkerij.uitleg: Bakes bricks from clay or stone, and smooth stone. The chimney puffs pink smoke.
erfenis.gebouw.zandkuil.uitleg: Raked sand under a little parasol. Sand Guh says: no use crying over spilled sand.
erfenis.gebouw.glasblazerij.uitleg: Sand becomes glass for the village, or glass shards to make your own glass at home.
erfenis.gebouw.bouwblokkenwerkplaats.uit: Makes Site Shed blocks of your choice from planks. Pick more than one and you get a cheerful mix.
erfenis.gebouw.guhhutje.uitleg: A home for new village guhs: hut, farmhouse, row house, villa. Someone moves in every 15 minutes.
erfenis.gebouw.marktplein.uitleg: Cart stalls for the orders from the neighboring villages. The higher, the more carts at once.
erfenis.gebouw.speeltuin.uitleg: Baby guhs on the swings attract new residents: extra room and moving in twice as fast.
erfenis.gebouw.guhpension.uitleg: Your own tamed guhs stay over here. They wander your inheritance and help a building: +5%% each.
erfenis.gebouw.detectivebureau.uitleg: Sherlock Guh and Doctor Chonkson. Cases come in at set times. Elementary, my dear nyeg.
erfenis.gebouw.dorpscafe.uitleg: Cooper pours cheese milk and knows all the gossip. All production +5%%, +10%% (level 5), +15%% (level 9).
erfenis.gebouw.muziektent.uitleg: A village party now and then. All production +5%%, +10%% (level 5), +15%% (level 9).
erfenis.gebouw.loket.uitleg: Hand in stuff from the main world here for the big renovations (Homestead 7 and up).
erfenis.gebouw.vadsmast.uitleg: Catches the chonk power your Village Transmitter sends out from home. For the top workshops and the little mammoths.

erfenis.vondst.ansichtkaart_3: a third postcard from the realtor
erfenis.vondst.trekguh: the Tractorguh: Grandpa's old pink tractor!
erfenis.vondst.deco_strooguh: a strawguh (a guh made of straw)

erfenis.vondst.dier_vlekjeskoe: a spotted cow with heart-shaped spots

erfenis.tut.welkom: There you are! Realtor Guhrrit, pleased to meet you. Structural report: chonky. Emotional report: very chonky. But with you here it'll all work out, nyeg!
erfenis.tut.1: First, let's make some room. Open the Top View and click an overgrown clump next to the open middle: Clear! Who knows what you'll find...
erfenis.tut.2: Look at that, open ground! Now build a Chicken Coop (Animals tab). The first one is free, from Grandpa's attic. Wahoog!
erfenis.tut.3: What a lovely coop. Now we just need someone to gather the eggs: residents move in on their own when there's room. A Guh Hut gives more room.
erfenis.tut.4: Your first resident! The neighboring villages have already sent carts. Open the World Map (or later the Market Square) and deliver an order.
erfenis.tut.5: Delivered and paid, now that's being neighbors. Now get the Homestead to level 2: check the Homestead panel to see what's still needed.
erfenis.tut.6: Homestead level 2! My work here is done: I'm going on vacation, nyeg. My bust and a mailbox are in your deco shed. I'll send you postcards!
