erfenis.knus.mijlpaal.1500: Coziness %s! Even the Mikas want to vacation here.
erfenis.knus.mijlpaal.2000: Coziness %s! The coziest village in the whole Guhmension. Almost.
erfenis.knus.mijlpaal.2500: Coziness %s! Title earned: It Doesn't Get Cozier. Really, it doesn't.
erfenis.knus.mijlpaal.5000: Coziness %s! Guhs from faraway lands write postcards about your village.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.erfenis_knus_250: Make your village in The Inheritance cozy: Coziness 250.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.erfenis_knus_1000: Coziness 1,000 in your village. Paths, fences, flowers: it all counts.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.erfenis_knus_2500: Coziness 2,500. It really can't get any cozier.
erfenis.decowinkel.ok.getrokken_voorraad: %s tiles of %s added! (Ƒ%s, %s free from your stock)
erfenis.fout.recept_geheim: You don't know that recipe yet. Maybe a sniffer knows more about it...
erfenis.afwerking.oma.extra: Granny Knitguh pinches your cheek and slips you a little extra: %s Guhlders. "For nibbles, sweetie!"
erfenis.afwerking.oma.decobon: Granny Knitguh slips you a Deco Voucher. "Buy something pretty with it, sweetie. Nothing with neckties."
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.bezorgd: A postcard from Realtor Guhrrit! It's also pinned to your Postcard Board.
erfenis.afwerking.boek.testament.0:
My will.

My homestead goes to whoever takes good care of it, for the price of one nibble.

Not to anyone in a necktie.
erfenis.afwerking.boek.testament.1:
Look after the chickens, the cows and the cookies. Say good night to Hoo-hoo every evening.

And let Bertha sing. Even if she's off-key.
erfenis.afwerking.boek.testament.2:
A homestead is only worth something when someone loves it.

Signed,

Grandpa Nibble
(paw print)
erfenis.afwerking.boek.dagboek.0:
Monday. Made cheese. Ate cheese. Made new cheese.

Hoo-hoo says I eat too much cheese. Hoo-hoo is an owl, what does an owl know about cheese.
erfenis.afwerking.boek.dagboek.1:
Wednesday. A guh in a necktie came by. He wants a parking lot on my flowers.

I gave him a cookie and sent him packing. Nyeg.
erfenis.afwerking.boek.dagboek.2:
Sunday. Wrote my will. The homestead goes to whoever takes good care of it.

I'm hiding the last page under my oldest little tree. Shhh.
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.4.tekst.0: Greetings from Guhcapulco! The beach is
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.4.tekst.1: super chonky. Sand gets everywhere, even
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.4.tekst.2: in my clipboard. Structural report on the
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.5.tekst.0: Hello from the Nibble Alps! I climbed a
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.5.tekst.1: mountain (by ski lift). At the top there
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.5.tekst.2: was cheese fondue. I'm now officially a
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.5.tekst.3: cheese guh. Look after your homestead!
erfenis.vondst.ansichtkaart_5: a postcard from the Nibble Alps
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.6.tekst.0: Bonjour from Paris-sur-Guh! The Eiffel Tower
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.6.tekst.1: is just a tall scaffold, if you ask
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.6.tekst.2: me. I bought a baguette that is
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.7.tekst.0: Ahoy from the cruise! Fourteen decks and
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.7.tekst.1: not a single clump to clear. I miss
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.7.tekst.2: your village a little. Nah, the buffet
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.7.tekst.3: is too yummy. But still, a little.
erfenis.vondst.ansichtkaart_7: a postcard from the Guh Cruise
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.8.tekst.0: Aloha from Guhwaii! I'm wearing a
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.8.tekst.1: flowery shirt and a sombrero now. They
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.8.tekst.2: don't match, says everyone. I'll be back
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.8.tekst.3: soon, with sunscreen. Proud of you!
erfenis.afwerking.cmd.geen_kelder: You don't have Grandpa's cellar yet. Solve case 5 first (or: /guhs erfenis beloning opas_kelder).
vadsrijk.loot.kussenzwaard.flavour.1: "Stuffed with real guh down. Don't tell the guhs."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelknots.flavour.0: "A cuddle with extra powers of persuasion."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelknots.flavour.1: "Moss green and a tiny bit chonky."
vadsrijk.loot.pluishamer.flavour.1: "Forged by a smithguh with a lisp."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelharnas.flavour.1: "Washable at 30 degrees. Not in the dryer."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelharnas.flavour.2: "Knights of the Snuggle Order wear this with pride."
vadsrijk.kern.skill.ult_niet_vol: Your ultimate skill isn't charged yet. More bonking!
vadsrijk.kern.flauw.onder: You wake up at your campfire. Still a little dizzy.
vadsrijk.kern.kampvuur.checkpoint: Campfire lit! This is where you wake up if you faint.
vadsrijk.kern.kampvuur.rust: You warm your pawsies. Chonk and energy are full again.
vadsrijk.kern.baas.klodderreus.onder: The Sticky Scourge of the Camp
vadsrijk.kern.baaskist.niet_jouw: This loot chest belongs to %s. Yours must be here too!
vadsrijk.kern.cmd.kist: %s items returned (%s still in the lost-and-found chest).
vadsrijk.kern.item.ongerold: Not rolled yet (ask for a /guhs vadsrijk loot).
vadsrijk.kern.item.verpluisd_uitleg: Frayed! Have it repaired by the smithguh.
vadsrijk.kern.party.zelf: Invite yourself? Just give yourself a cuddle instead.
vadsrijk.kern.party.vol: Your party is full (5 guh buddies).
vadsrijk.kern.party.uitnodiging: %s invites you to a party! Open the Party tab (H) or type /guhs vadsrijk party accepteer
vadsrijk.kern.party.geen_uitnodiging: Nobody has invited you. Not yet!
vadsrijk.kern.party.erbij: You joined the party. Stronger together, chonkier together!
vadsrijk.kern.tip.welkom: Here you get your own backpack: your normal stuff is safe at home. Left mouse = bonk, R V G = skills, Z = your ultimate smack.
vadsrijk.kern.tip.skill: Skills cost Chonk Energy (blue bar) and have a cooldown. Z charges up by dealing damage.
vadsrijk.kern.tip.loot: The color of the lightbeam is the rarity. Only you can pick up your loot. Check the tooltip for the bonuses.
vadsrijk.kern.tip.levelop: You have two levels. General (everything you do): more Chonk and Defense, new areas and quests. Class (the weapon you hit with): your main stat, skill points and better weapons.
vadsrijk.kern.tip.kampvuur: If you faint, you wake up here. You don't lose anything, you're just a little dizzy for a bit.
vadsrijk.loot.roze_ring.flavour.1: "Shines a little when you say nyeg."
vadsrijk.loot.roze_ring.flavour.2: "Found in a blob. Rinsed off, promise."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelketting.flavour.0: "A cuddle around your neck, all day long."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelketting.flavour.2: "Granny guh knitted it. Out of iron."
vadsrijk.loot.pluisoorbel.flavour.1: "With it you can hear the chonk rustle."
vadsrijk.kern.sieraad.vol: Your backpack is full: the piece stays on.
vadsrijk.kern.sieraad.leeg: %s: empty. Right-click a piece or Shift+click it in your inventory to put it on.
vadsrijk.wezens.set.klodder.2: (2) Slippery: 15%% chance that a hit just slides right off you
vadsrijk.wezens.set.klodder.4: (4) Bounce Power: +12%% damage and your hits sometimes cause Sticky
vadsrijk.wezens.set.zwam.4: (4) Spore Rain: +12%% spell damage and your spells apply Spored
vadsrijk.wezens.kampklodder.aai: The Camp Blob wiggles with joy. Blub!
vadsrijk.wezens.kampklodder.aai2: Blub blub! The Camp Blob gives you a blobby-wet hug.
vadsrijk.wezens.kampklodder.aai3: The Camp Blob makes a happy little bubble.
vadsrijk.wezens.cmd.draak: Wahoognir is flying over! Look up.
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.elite: Golden glow = elite. Stronger, bigger and with a trait (Glowing, Fast, Splitting or Shielding), but better loot too!
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.zwamwachter: From the front it blocks with its cap shield. Walk around it or hit it right after it has swung!
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.kristalklodder: Its crystals sometimes reflect spells. Normal hits always work.
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.glimzwam: The Glowshroom heals the creatures around it. Cheer it up first!
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.mosgeest: A Moss Spirit sometimes swooshes aside. Stick with it, it can't dodge every time.
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.sporenpuffer: Stay out of the green cloud: it applies Spored (damage and less healing).
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.tempelridder: See the red strip? That's its swing. Step aside!
vadsrijk.loot.slijmmutsje.flavour.0: "Fits like a glove. A slimy glove, but still."
vadsrijk.loot.slijmmutsje.flavour.1: "Smells of mint and a little bit of blob."
vadsrijk.loot.bubbelvest.flavour.0: "Every button is a bubble. No poking."
vadsrijk.loot.plakpantoffels.flavour.1: "Sticks to the floor, the stairs and your heart."
vadsrijk.loot.steelbroek.flavour.0: "Made from a shroom stem. It was fine with it."
vadsrijk.loot.steelbroek.flavour.2: "Goes with any hat, especially a toadstool."
vadsrijk.loot.knaagvachtje.flavour.0: "All the gnawing has been washed out. Almost."
vadsrijk.loot.knaagvachtje.flavour.2: "There's still a little crumb in the pocket."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalhelmpje.flavour.1: "Sparkles so hard your own shadow blinks."
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkapje.flavour.0: "Sticks to your little ears. It's supposed to."
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkapje.flavour.1: "Blob chic, now in the color cheerful."
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkapje.flavour.2: "Wahoog! says the cap. Caps don't talk. Right?"
vadsrijk.loot.klodderhesje.flavour.0: "Slippery on the outside, cozy on the inside."
vadsrijk.loot.klodderstuiters.flavour.0: "Boing. Boing. Boing. You get used to it."
vadsrijk.loot.zwamhoed.flavour.0: "Grows a tiny bit when it rains."
vadsrijk.loot.zwamhoed.flavour.1: "Wisdom is in the hat. And some spores."
vadsrijk.loot.sporenmantel.flavour.0: "Coughing is allowed, just not into your sleeve."
vadsrijk.loot.zwambroek.flavour.0: "Sturdy as a stem, soft as a cap."
vadsrijk.loot.mossloffen.flavour.0: "Walks quietly. The moss does the work."
vadsrijk.loot.mossloffen.flavour.2: "Don't leave them outside, they'll take root."
vadsrijk.bazen.opperzwam.onder: He Who Dreams Beneath the Temple
vadsrijk.bazen.kk.splitst: King Blob splats into three Crown Blobs! Cheer up all three quickly, one after another!
vadsrijk.bazen.kk.venster: Quick! %s s left before the other Crown Blobs melt back!
vadsrijk.bazen.kk.gelukt: All three cheered up! The King wobbles back into one big blob.
vadsrijk.bazen.kk.mislukt: Too slow... %s Crown Blob(s) melt back into the King. He heals!
vadsrijk.bazen.kk.hemel: King Blob jumps into the sky! Find a PINK spot!
vadsrijk.bazen.kk.hemel_raak: SPLAT! You were standing in the King's shadow.
vadsrijk.bazen.oz.sporen: Spore clouds fill the hall! Find the pink spot!
vadsrijk.bazen.oz.donker: The Overshroom blows out all the lights... Light the 4 Lightshrooms!
vadsrijk.bazen.oz.licht_klaar: All Lightshrooms are lit! The Overshroom blinks, blinded!
vadsrijk.bazen.oz.kantel: The hall tilts... the Overshroom grows through the ceiling!
vadsrijk.bazen.oz.verslagen: The Overshroom sighs chonkily and dreams peacefully again. The ceiling slowly grows shut.
vadsrijk.bazen.tempel.te_laag: The big temple door stays shut for now (you are level %2$s). Come back at level %3$s: then a right-click on the door always opens it. With the Shroom Temple story quest you can do it from level %1$s.
vadsrijk.bazen.tempel.kamer1: The Glowshroom Chamber: watch closely in which order the shrooms light up...
vadsrijk.bazen.tempel.kamer1_fout: Pfff! Wrong order. The shrooms go dark and show it one more time.
vadsrijk.bazen.tempel.kamer1_goed: Well done! The shroom gate slides open.
vadsrijk.bazen.tempel.kamer2: The Lever Chamber: the shrooms across the room mirror you. Set the levers and step on the pressure plate.
vadsrijk.bazen.tempel.kamer2_fout: Pfff! That's not right. The levers spring back.
vadsrijk.bazen.tempel.kamer2_goed: Click-clack-wahoog! The shroom gate slides open.
vadsrijk.bazen.tempel.ridders: The Knights' Hall: the Temple Shroom Knights block the way! Wave %s of 3.
vadsrijk.bazen.tempel.ridders_klaar: The Knights' Hall is cheered up! The way to the Overshroom is clear.
vadsrijk.bazen.tempel.ridders_weg: Everyone has left the Knights' Hall... the knights stand guard again.
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.praat.0: Nyeg! Er... I mean: nyeg. Totally normal. Want to buy some cheese?
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.praat.1: Chonk! Wahoog! That's how us guhs talk, right? Haha. Ha.
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.praat.2: My mustache? It's real. Completely real. Don't touch.
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.praat.3: I'm just Akim. A-K-I-M. Go on, spell it backwards. No! Don't!
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.praat.4: What a lovely town, Shroomsbury. Who's in charge here? Just asking. For a bit of cheese.
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.au: Ow! Er... nyeg? Behave yourself, I'm just selling cheese.
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.ontmaskerd: NO! My disguise! You'll never catch me, little guhs!
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.kap: The Mika Spy leaps to the next cap! The guhs of Shroomsbury launch you after him with a spore catapult!
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.ballon: He's escaping with a balloon! Shoot or whack that balloon to pieces!
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.ontsnapt: The Mika Spy got away... He'll surely pop up at the market again in disguise.
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.gevangen: Caught in a cuddle net! The Snuggle Order takes him away.
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.cliff: "You think I'm the only one? Nyehehe... Up north there are LOTS more Mikas waiting. The Overlord Mika already knows everything!"
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.cliff_onder: The Mikas are waiting further on in the Chonkdom
"Every hit a blob. Every blob a buddy."
vadsrijk.loot.baas_pluisboog.flavour.0: "The arrows stick to everything. Including you."
vadsrijk.loot.baas_wortelwambuis.flavour: "Grows along with you a little. Water on Sundays."
vadsrijk.loot.baas_lichtzwamhelm.flavour: "Never scared of the dark again. Just a little pink."
vadsrijk.loot.baas_klodderkroontje.flavo: "Heavy is the head that wears the blob. Also very sticky."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.baas_klodderknots: every 5th hit, a mini slime pops out and fights along for 8 s
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.baas_pluisboog: your hits make your target Sticky for 2 s
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.baas_sporenstaf: critical hits leave a little spore cloud behind (Spored around your target)
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.baas_wortelwambuis: when you get hit, roots sometimes grab your attacker (1 s Stunned)
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.baas_lichtzwamhelm: darkness and blindness can't touch you, and neither can the Overshroom's fog
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.baas_rookbomlaarze: drop below 30% Chonk and you poof 6 blocks away with Quickpaws (30 s cooldown)
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.baas_klodderkroont: a sparkly little crown above your head, and every 30 s you and your nearby friends get 5 s of Wahoog
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.baas_neppe_snor: got hit? Sometimes enemies lose sight of you for a moment (poof, Quickpaws)
vadsrijk.bazen.trofee.uitleg: A trophy from a defeated boss. Take it home as decor!
vadsrijk.bazen.kist.eerste: First defeat: a guaranteed Legendary item!
vadsrijk.bazen.tip.koning_klodder: Does he split? Cheer up the three Crown Blobs right after each other, or they melt back. Does he jump into the sky: find a pink circle!
vadsrijk.bazen.tip.opperzwam: Pink circles = roots: get away. Spore cloud? Stand on the pink spot. In the dark: light the 4 Lightshrooms (right-click).
vadsrijk.bazen.tip.mika_spion: Gray circles = unchonking powder: get out! Escaping with a balloon? Shoot or whack that balloon to pieces.
vadsrijk.bazen.tip.lichtzwam: Right-click a Lightshroom to light it.
vadsrijk.klassen.kies.onderkop: You are always all three classes: your class is the weapon in your hand. You can get the other weapons cheaply later.
vadsrijk.klassen.kies.onder.knuffelridde: Up front in the fight, handing out cuddles. Wahoog!
vadsrijk.klassen.kies.onder.vadsmagier: The pink magic flows through your pawsies. Chonk!
vadsrijk.klassen.kies.al: You already have your starter weapon. Other weapons: at the trainers, the shop or the Order temple of Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.klassen.wissel.onder: Level %s · your weapons of this class work again
vadsrijk.klassen.wapen.verkeerd: This weapon is for a %s. Switch class in the Order temple.
vadsrijk.klassen.wapen.te_hoog: This weapon is level %s. Keep growing a little longer!
vadsrijk.klassen.boom.nee.uitgesloten: You already took the other choice.
vadsrijk.klassen.boom.nee.vereist: Learn the node above it first.
vadsrijk.klassen.respec.klaar: Your skill tree is empty and your points are back. Choose again! (Resetting is always free.)
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.klaar: ✦ You're ready for your job advancement to %s! Go to the Order temple in Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.klassen.cmd.info: %s · class Lv %s · general Lv %s · %s skill points free · nodes: %s
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.punten.tip: Click a node to learn it
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.ordetempel: You're always all three classes: attack with a different weapon to switch. Reset (always free) and switch your specialization at the class master in any town.
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.wissel.tip: Every class keeps its own level and skill tree. Weapons belong to a class, armor is shared.
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.respec.tip: All your points in this class back. Always free. Your specialization and advancements stay.
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.adv.tip: Your job advancement: a new title and a new power.
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.adv.dicht: From level %s, through the class quest.
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.welkom: In the little class temple of Camp Snuggle you choose your starter weapon: sword (Snuggle Knight), bow (Fluff Hunter) or staff (Chonk Mage). Your class is always the weapon in your hand.
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.gekozen: Your starter weapon is in your backpack. Fluff Hunters and mages: hold down the left mouse button to shoot.
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.punt: Every class level gives a skill point in that class. Press K for your skill tree (tabs for the other classes). Choose wisely!
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.boom: Click a node twice to learn it. Of the two variants of your R skill, you pick one.
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.balie: Here you can reset a class's skill tree for free (once per hour), do your job advancement and get the starter weapons of the other classes.
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.adv: Your class is ready for a job advancement! Check your quest log to see which class master is waiting for you.
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkling.flavour.0: A sword of hardened slime. Every hit slurps back a little chonk.
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkling.flavour.1: Doesn't stick to your hands. Does stick to your enemies.
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkling.flavour.2: Forged by a blob that didn't need it anymore.
vadsrijk.loot.pluisboog.flavour.0: Arrows with little pink plumes. They tickle, and then they hurt.
vadsrijk.loot.pluisboog.flavour.1: The string is made of stretched snuggle wool. Nyeg!
vadsrijk.loot.pluisboog.flavour.2: Aiming is easy: just think of something sweet.
vadsrijk.loot.druppelboog.flavour.0: It leaks a little. That's how it's supposed to be.
vadsrijk.loot.druppelboog.flavour.1: Every arrow is filled with a splash of pond chonk.
vadsrijk.loot.druppelboog.flavour.2: Found under a waterfall that said 'blub' really loudly.
vadsrijk.loot.snoepkruisboog.flavour.0: Fires candy cane bolts. Red-hot candy cane, mind you.
vadsrijk.loot.snoepkruisboog.flavour.1: Slow to reload, sweet as a sledgehammer.
vadsrijk.loot.snoepkruisboog.flavour.2: Don't lick it. Really don't. Not even a tiny bit.
vadsrijk.loot.eikelkatapult.flavour.0: Acorns from the Sporewood. They pop open in a little puff of shroom.
vadsrijk.loot.eikelkatapult.flavour.1: A squirrel once gave this a very angry look.
vadsrijk.loot.rozenstaf.flavour.0: The orb on top glows pink whenever a dechonked creature is nearby.
vadsrijk.loot.rozenstaf.flavour.1: Smells of cotton candy and a little bit of magic.
vadsrijk.loot.rozenstaf.flavour.2: Made from the branch where the very first guh took a nap.
vadsrijk.loot.vlammenstaf.flavour.0: Warm at the top, cozy at the bottom.
vadsrijk.loot.vlammenstaf.flavour.1: Also used for roasting marshmallows. Mostly for that, really.
vadsrijk.loot.vlammenstaf.flavour.2: Fire is strong against shrooms. The shrooms know it too.
vadsrijk.loot.zwamstokje.flavour.0: A magic wand with a little mushroom on top. It's still growing a bit.
vadsrijk.loot.zwamstokje.flavour.1: Swish, point, spores. In that order.
vadsrijk.loot.slijmboek.flavour.0: All the pages stick together. The spells work anyway.
vadsrijk.loot.slijmboek.flavour.1: Chapter 1: Blub. Chapter 2: Blub blub. Chapter 3: a cliffhanger.
vadsrijk.loot.slijmboek.flavour.2: Read aloud from it and you heal a little. Bite into it and you don't.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.kussenklap: Swing in a cone in front of you (4.5 blocks) for 1.5x weapon damage with hefty knockback. 20 energy, 3 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.stormsprong: Leap to your target (or 8 blocks forward). The landing is a shockwave: 1.3x damage all around. 25 energy, 8 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.kort.stormsprong: Leap to your target with a landing shockwave.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.knuffelschi: For 3 s, hits on you only deal 20 %, half bounces back and all enemies within 10 blocks look at you. 30 energy, 15 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.kort.knuffelschild: 3 s of blocking and reflecting, draws aggro.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.vahoege_plo: ULTIMATE: a giant pillow drops on your target: 3x damage and 3 s stunned within 6 blocks, your group within 8 blocks heals 15 %.
vadsrijk.klassen.kort.vahoege_plof: Giant pillow: stuns everything, heals the group.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.pluizenrege: Rains 3 waves of arrows on the spot you aim at (radius 4): each wave deals 0.6x weapon damage to everything under it. 25 energy, 6 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.kort.pluizenregen: Arrows rain down on an area.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.rolsalto: A backflip away from where you're looking, with a moment of Quickpaws. Your next shot within 5 s is a guaranteed crit. 20 energy, 8 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.kort.rolsalto: Backflip; next shot is a crit.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.knuffelpijl: A heart arrow. If it hits a teammate, they heal 12 % of their Chonk + 0.5x your weapon damage. An enemy takes 2x Pink damage. 25 energy, 7 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.kort.knuffelpijl: Heals a teammate or pokes an enemy.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.sterrenscho: ULTIMATE: charge for 1 s (you walk slower), then a huge 40-block laser arrow straight through everything: 4x weapon damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.kort.sterrenschot: Charge up, then a laser arrow through everything.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.roze_vuurba: A slow ball that explodes (radius 3.5) for 2.8x weapon damage in your weapon's element. Fire burns, Nature spores, Water sticks. 25 energy, 4.5 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.blink: Teleport up to 10 blocks in the direction you're looking (stops neatly before walls). 20 energy, 6 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.kort.blink: Short teleport to where you're looking.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.vadsbron: A healing circle under your feet (radius 4, 6 s): everyone in it heals 4 % of their Chonk + 0.25x your weapon damage every second. 35 energy, 14 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.kort.vadsbron: Healing circle on the ground for everyone.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.meteoorguh: ULTIMATE: a gigantic guh meteor falls where you aim: 5x Pink damage within 6 blocks, then 6 s of pink fire on that spot.
vadsrijk.klassen.kort.meteoorguh: Giant meteor + a zone of pink fire.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_pluisvacht.uitl: More Chonk and Defense. The base of every sturdy cuddle.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_knuffelspier.ui: More Strength and harder crits. Cuddles that really land.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_aanloop.uitleg: Storm Leap recharges 3 s faster and after your leap you get 5 s of Quickpaws.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_vuurkussen.uitl: Pillow Bonk sets enemies on fire for 4 s (25 % of your weapon damage every second). Can't be combined with Slime Pillow.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_slijmkussen.uit: Pillow Bonk pulls enemies toward you instead of away and makes them Sticky for 4 s. Can't be combined with Fire Pillow.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_doornknuffel.ui: Snuggle Shield reflects 100 % instead of 50 %, and raising it heals you 8 % of your Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_schokgolf.uitle: Storm Leap's landing stuns enemies for 1.5 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_taai.uitleg: Below 35 % Chonk you take 30 % less damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_beschermknuffel: Snuggle Shield also gives your group within 8 blocks a Snuggle Shield of 15 % of your max Chonk for 5 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_reuzenkussen.ui: Wahoog Flomp heals 30 % instead of 15 % and gives the group 6 s of Wahoog (+20 % damage).
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_kussenstorm.uit: Pillow Bonk deals 25 % more damage, recharges 1.5 s faster and gives back 8 energy.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_bolwerk.uitleg: While your Snuggle Shield is up, you and your group within 8 blocks take 25 % less damage from enemies.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_scherpoog.uitle: More crit chance and harder critical hits.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_lichtvoetig.uit: Faster walking and some extra Chonk. Always just out of reach.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_snelle_pees.uit: 15 % Attack Speed: you shoot noticeably faster.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_vuurregen.uitle: Fluff Rain sets everything under it on fire for 4 s. Can't be combined with Sticky Rain.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_kleefregen.uitl: Fluff Rain makes enemies Sticky and rains down a 4th wave. Can't be combined with Fire Rain.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_doorboor.uitleg: Your normal shots go through 1 extra enemy (so crossbows go through 2).
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_valkenoog.uitle: Shots at enemies farther than 12 blocks deal 25 % more damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_plakbom.uitleg: Roll Flip leaves a slime bomblet behind: enemies within 3 blocks are stuck for 3 s and take 0.8x damage. Roll Flip recharges 2 s faster.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_hartjespijl.uit: Snuggle Arrow heals 60 % more and gives your teammate 4 s of Quickpaws. 30 % more damage on enemies.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_vallende_ster.u: Star Shot deals 50 % more damage and gives back 25 % of your ultimate charge.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_pluizenmantel.u: After Roll Flip you get a Snuggle Shield of 20 % of your max Chonk for 4 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_jachtroes.uitle: Every 4th normal shot is a guaranteed crit and fires 2 extra arrows in a fan.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_wijs.uitleg: More Wisdom: all your magic gets stronger.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_elementkenner.u: 12 % more Element Damage. Know your triangle: Fire > Shroom > Slime > Fire.
15 % more Heal Power and some extra Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_reuzenbal.uitle: Pink Fireball explodes 50 % bigger and deals 20 % more damage. Can't be combined with Triple Fire.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_drievuur.uitleg: Pink Fireball shoots 3 balls in a fan (65 % each, smaller explosion). Can't be combined with Giant Ball.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_glitterblink.ui: Where you Blink from, a glitter bomb goes off: 1.2x damage within 3 blocks.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_energievonk.uit: Every magic orb that hits gives you back 3 Chonk Energy.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_grote_bron.uitl: Chonk Spring is 50 % bigger and gives everyone in it Wahoog (+15 % damage).
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_bronschild.uitl: Whoever steps into your Chonk Spring for the first time gets a Snuggle Shield of 12 % of your max Chonk for 5 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_kettingbolt.uit: Your magic orbs bounce on to a second enemy within 6 blocks (60 % damage).
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_meteoorregen.ui: After Meteor Guh, 3 small meteors fall all around (1.5x damage each).
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_tijdsprong.uitl: Blink gives back 15 energy and Pink Fireball is ready again right away.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.knuffelridde: Double Smack: Pillow Bonk swings once more after a second (60 % damage). Plus Defense and Strength.
Paladin Aura: you and your group within 10 blocks heal 1.5 % Chonk every 2 s. Plus 120 Chonk and Heal Power.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.pluisjager.1: Flip Volley: in the middle of your Roll Flip you shoot 3 arrows at the nearest enemy. Plus Dexterity and Move Speed.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.pluisjager.2: Falcon Gaze: your arrows curve a little toward enemies. Plus 8 % crit and 15 % crit damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.vadsmagier.1: Element Puddle: Pink Fireball leaves a puddle of its element for 3 s that deals damage. Plus Wisdom and Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.vadsmagier.2: Chonk Overflow: every 3rd skill costs no energy. Plus 10 % Cooldown Reduction and 8 % Element Damage.
item.guhs.vr_item_vadsdrankje.uitleg: Gives you back 300 Chonk. Tastes like strawberries and cuddles.
item.guhs.vr_item_energiedrankje.uitleg: Gives you back 50 energy. A little fizzy, nyeg!
item.guhs.vr_item_vahoegdrankje.uitleg: One minute of Wahoog: you feel super wahoog.
item.guhs.vr_item_verbetersteentje.uitle: The smithguh uses it to tap a little star onto your gear.
item.guhs.vr_item_herrolknabbel.uitleg: Rare! The smithguh uses it to reroll the bonuses on your gear.
item.guhs.vr_item_pluisdraad.uitleg: For sewing frayed gear back together at the smith.
item.guhs.vr_item_rijfluitje.uitleg: Whistles your mount over (once more: it hops home). No longer needed: the mount key does the same.
vadsrijk.economie.winkel.niks_te_verkope: Nothing to sell in your bag.
vadsrijk.economie.winkel.per_post_kort: Sent by post to your home outside the Chonkdom
vadsrijk.economie.winkel.post_uitleg: Cosmetics go home by post (in the post: %s)
vadsrijk.economie.winkel.per_post: %s is sent to your home by post!
vadsrijk.economie.winkel.titel_gekocht: New title! Pick it in your Guhdex.
vadsrijk.economie.munt.uitleg: Chonk Coin (%s). Right-click: into your wallet.
vadsrijk.economie.munt.buiten: Chonk Coins are only worth something in the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.economie.drankje.buiten: This potion only works in the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.economie.drankje.vads.op: Glug glug... your Chonk flows back!
vadsrijk.economie.tas_vol_kist: Bag full: it's waiting for you in /guhs vadsrijk kist
vadsrijk.economie.smid.geen_gear: You have no gear with you.
vadsrijk.economie.smid.kies: Pick something from your bag, nyeg!
vadsrijk.economie.smid.max_uitleg: Ten stars! This piece is positively glowing.
vadsrijk.economie.smid.is_verpluisd: Frayed! (does nothing until you repair it)
vadsrijk.economie.smid.uitkomst.ster_kwi: Oopsie, a little star popped off.
vadsrijk.economie.smid.uitkomst.verpluis: Frayed! Get it repaired at the smith.
vadsrijk.economie.markt.niks_eigen: You have nothing up for sale.
vadsrijk.economie.markt.te_veel: You already have 12 things up for sale.
vadsrijk.economie.markt.geen_fee: Not enough Chonk Coins for the market fee.
vadsrijk.economie.markt.kapot: That thing can't leave the stall right now (it stays there safely).
vadsrijk.economie.markt.niks_op: Nothing is waiting for you yet.
vadsrijk.economie.markt.verkocht_melding: Your %s sold for %s! Collect your coins from the market master.
vadsrijk.economie.markt.wacht: %s is waiting for you at the market master in Shroomsbury!
vadsrijk.economie.handel.alleen_rijk: You can only trade in the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.economie.handel.geen_verzoek: Nobody wants to trade with you right now.
vadsrijk.economie.handel.eerst_klaar: You both have to press Ready first.
vadsrijk.economie.handel.veranderd: Something changed in a bag: take another look and confirm again.
vadsrijk.economie.handel.te_weinig: Someone doesn't have enough coins anymore.
vadsrijk.economie.handel.tas_vol: Someone's bag is too full for the trade.
vadsrijk.economie.handel.weg: The other player left: the trade has stopped.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.nieuw: New mount: %s! Press your mount key (X) to hop on.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.alleen_rijk: Your mount only hops around in the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.geen: No mount yet: you'll get one in the Duskroot.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.geschrokken: Your mount got scared and hopped away!
vadsrijk.economie.stal.gekozen: Your mount key now calls this mount.
vadsrijk.economie.stal.fluitje_nee: You don't have a Riding Whistle!
vadsrijk.economie.post.aangekomen: A parcel arrived from the Chonkdom! (%s things in your bag)
vadsrijk.economie.post.vol: Your bag is full: %s parcel(s) from the Chonkdom are still waiting.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_ridder_van_zwamz: For sale at Home Delivery in the Chonkdom.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_vadsmuntenbaron: Very pricey, at Home Delivery in the Chonkdom.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_sterrensmid: Tap ten stars onto one piece of gear.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_rijdiermeester: Ride a mount to the highest level.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_marktkoopman: Sell ten things at the market of Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.economie.tip.rijdier: Press X (your mount key) and your Cloud Lamb comes running; press X again and it hops home. N shows all your mounts. Riding gives it xp: then it gets faster and jumps higher.
vadsrijk.economie.tip.rijden: Space = a big hop. Your mount simply walks up a ledge or step up to 2 blocks high. If you get hit, your mount gets spooked and hops away. In a boss arena you hop off.
vadsrijk.npc.optie.startwapen.knuffelrid: May I have a Pillow Sword? (the first one is free, then 30 bronze)
vadsrijk.npc.optie.startwapen.pluisjager: May I have a Fluff Bow? (the first one is free, then 30 bronze)
vadsrijk.npc.optie.startwapen.vadsmagier: May I have a Rose Staff? (the first one is free, then 30 bronze)
vadsrijk.npc.rol.nog_niet: %s isn't here yet (that comes with another part of the Chonkdom).
vadsrijk.npc.rol.luchtschip.nog_niet: Finish your training first, recruit! Then I'll fly you anywhere. Well, to Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.rol.luchtschip.vraag: Climbing aboard? The airship is ready. Wind force: chonky, visibility: wahoog!
vadsrijk.npc.rol.luchtschip_kamp.vraag: Back to Camp Snuggle? Say hi to the Camp Blob for me!
vadsrijk.npc.rol.klasse.kies: Which path do you choose? You can always switch later at the great Order temple in Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.rol.questbord.leeg: The quest board is empty! Everyone in Shroomsbury has been helped. Or you need to get a bit stronger first.
vadsrijk.npc.rijdier.later: Hoofy has reserved your Cloud Lamb for you!
vadsrijk.npc.bam.aanval: Something is falling from the sky into the camp pond! The Gray Blob Giant!
vadsrijk.npc.opening.welkom: Welcome to The Chonkdom! Sergeant Fluffball is waiting for you here on the jetty. Top right always shows your next step; J = quest log. Stuck somewhere? Press U and stand still for 3 seconds.
vadsrijk.npc.scene.stad.onder: The city of the Snuggle Order
vadsrijk.npc.scene.einde.onder: Wahoognir circles on. And somewhere, the Mikas are laughing up their paws.
vadsrijk.npc.spion.onder: Akim the Cheese Guh was a Mika!
vadsrijk.npc.spion.later: (The fight on the rooftops of Shroomsbury comes with the bosses of the Chonkdom.)
vadsrijk.npc.adv.onder: A new title from the Snuggle Order!
vadsrijk.npc.aanwijzing.teller: Clues found: %s of %s. Something's not right in Shroomsbury...
vadsrijk.npc.log.leeg: No quests right now. Look out for a ! above a guh.
vadsrijk.npc.log.knuffels.uitleg: They sparkle with hearts when you're close. Little Kiki misses them terribly.
vadsrijk.npc.log.aanwijzingen.uitleg: Nothing found yet. Purple sparkles mean something is lying there...
vadsrijk.npc.log.zone1: Zone 1 is chonky again! The gray scars are getting their color back.
vadsrijk.npc.log.wezens.leeg: You haven't cheered up any critters yet. Every critter you cheer up gets a page here.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.onbekend: The Order knows very little about this creature yet. Cheer up a few more!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.rekruteerder.1: Back straight, ears up, recruit! There. Wahoog.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.rekruteerder.2: A good knight of the Snuggle Order never hits hard. Only very sweetly and very often.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.rekruteerder.3: I once cheered up a hundred blobs in one day. Then I slept for a week. Nyeg.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapitein.1: My balloon ship flies on hot air and good cheer. Mostly good cheer.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapitein.2: Don't lean over the railing, recruit. Last week someone lost their plushie over the sea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapitein.3: Wind force: chonk. Visibility: wahoog. Lovely flying weather!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kok.1: Fluffcakes! Fresh off the griddle! They're a bit black on the bottom, but that's how they're supposed to be.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kok.2: If you want to give chonk, you first have to eat well yourself. That's rule one of the Order. Or rule two. After eating.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kok.3: Smell that? That's the campfire. And a tiny bit my apron.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.priesteres.1: Every path of the Order starts with one small, soft step.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.priesteres.2: The little temple is old, but it still cuddles back when you pet the pillars.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.priesteres.3: Knight, hunter or mage: your heart is what counts. And a bit of your skills.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_ridder.1: Left-click is your normal bonk. R, V and G are your skills. Z is the big whopper!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_ridder.2: A Snuggle Knight stands at the front. With a pillow. Always with a pillow.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_ridder.3: Those training dummies can take a punch. They're made of hay and good spirits.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_jager.1: A Fluff Hunter keeps her distance and aims with her heart. And with her eyes, that helps too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_jager.2: Roll Flip! Out of the blob goo, and your next shot hits extra hard.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_jager.3: I can hit an apple from a hundred paces. Then I eat it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_magier.1: Elements, recruit! Fire beats shroom, shroom beats slime, slime beats fire. Pink is good against everything.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_magier.2: My first fireball was a pink little bubble. It never landed. It's still floating around somewhere.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_magier.3: A Chonk Mage heals too. A circle on the ground, and everyone feels chonky again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.visser_dobber.1: Shhh. The little slimes in the pond don't bite, but they do tickle.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.visser_dobber.2: I've been fishing in this pond for twenty years. I've never seen a fish. Loads of peace and quiet, though.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.visser_dobber.3: My little hat blew away, but I'm sitting just as comfy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.grootmeester.1: Welcome to the temple of the Snuggle Order. Here you switch paths, pick your skills again and grow stronger.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.grootmeester.2: I'm old, but my cuddles are still legendary.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.grootmeester.3: Wahoognir... I knew him when he was still pink. He ate cotton candy out of my paw.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.smid.1: Stars on it? Sure! But sometimes one pops off. That's the exciting part, nyeg.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.smid.2: Frayed? Bring it here and I'll hammer it smooth again. Nothing is ever truly broken.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.smid.3: I forge with love and a veeery soft hammer.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.winkelier.1: Potions, candy, bandages with little hearts on them! Come take a look.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.winkelier.2: My fluff potion helps against everything. Except homesickness. Cuddles help with that.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.winkelier.3: Everything for an honest Chonk Coin. Bronze, silver or gold!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wapenhandelaar.1: Swords, bows, staffs! All with a soft edge. Safety first.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wapenhandelaar.2: That eye patch? Just style. I see everything fine. Almost everything.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wapenhandelaar.3: A good weapon suits your class. A bad weapon suits nobody.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.marktmeester.1: Going once, going twice... CHONK! The auction house is open!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.marktmeester.2: Sell your loot to other adventurers. Not bound items, though: those stay with you.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.marktmeester.3: My little tap-tap gavel is the most important hammer in Shroomsbury. Just ask the smith.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bankier.1: Your Chonk Coins are safer here than in a vault. This IS a vault. Well, soon. The vault door is still being made.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bankier.2: A hundred bronze is one silver. A hundred silver is one gold. A thousand gold is one vacation.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bankier.3: Interest? Of course. We pay in cuddles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.klerk.1: The quest board! It shows who in Shroomsbury needs help. A little stamp on it, done.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.klerk.2: I stamp everything. Letters, bounties, my lunch. That last one was a mistake.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.klerk.3: Bounties for brave adventurers! Just sign here... and here... and here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.stalmeester.1: Mounts! They jump, they run and they grow stronger along with you.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.stalmeester.2: A Cloud Lamb floats a little. It's crazy about Root Shrooms.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.stalmeester.3: A mount? First you pick your very own Plumeguh in the Duskroot. After that I've got more for you here!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.havenmeester.1: Seagulls, wind and the smell of salt. Lovely. Except the seagulls.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.havenmeester.2: The airship? It's at the Harbor, across the bay. Pilotguh Zeppy will fly you wherever you want.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.havenmeester.3: I count the boats every day. There are three. For years now. But you never know.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.oma_truus.1: Knitting is just like cuddling, my little chonk. Stitch by stitch.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.oma_truus.2: When I was young, the blobs were still pink and there was only one moon.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.oma_truus.3: Come here, you've got a bit of fluff on your ear. There.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bakker_bram.1: My shroom pie is famous all the way to the Drip Caves. Not that many folks live there, though.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bakker_bram.2: Kneading dough is good for your pawsies. And for your mood.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bakker_bram.3: Smell that! That's freshly baked chonk.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kleine_kiki.1: Have you seen my plushies? They went on an adventure without me!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kleine_kiki.2: When I grow up I'll be a knight too. Or a princess. Or a knight-princess!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kleine_kiki.3: I can already count to ten. One, two, three, four, chonk, six...
vadsrijk.npc.praat.dichter_daan.1: O Shroomsbury, thou sweetest shroom, where every guh... uh... something with a broom.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.dichter_daan.2: A poet needs inspiration. And coffee. Mostly inspiration.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.dichter_daan.3: Does 'wahoog' rhyme with anything? I've been looking for three years.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.postguh_pim.2: I know every little house on every cap. Except that one. I'm still looking for it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.postguh_pim.3: Rain, wind or Gray Fluff: the mail always gets through. Sometimes a bit sticky.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tuinier_tilly.1: My tulips have turned gray! Gray! They were always pink!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tuinier_tilly.2: You have to sing to your plants. My roses love sappy ballads.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tuinier_tilly.3: A garden is like a guh: it grows from attention.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.muzikant_mo.1: Oom-pah-pah, oom-pah-pah... without a tuba it sounds a bit sad.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.muzikant_mo.2: I play at every party in Shroomsbury. Well, I would play. If I had my tuba.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.muzikant_mo.3: Music makes you chonky. That's science. Just ask the professor.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.professor_pluis.1: Fascinating! Gray Fluff is exactly as soft as normal fluff, but... grumpy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.professor_pluis.2: I have three degrees in Fluffology. And one in Knitting, from Granny Trudy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.professor_pluis.3: Hypothesis: the Chonklessness is contagious. Conclusion: wash your paws!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.ridder_rammel.1: In my day we beat blobs with nothing but a teaspoon! ... Well, cheered them up.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.ridder_rammel.2: My armor rattles a bit. That's how I got my name. Or the other way around.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.ridder_rammel.3: I'm retired. But my thirst for adventure isn't!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapster_fohnie.1: Your little ears could use a little trim, sweetie.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapster_fohnie.2: The secret to pretty curls? Slime Gel. Real, fresh blob slime.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapster_fohnie.3: Blow-dry, comb, fluff. In that order. Always.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.schilder_sien.1: Look at the meadow! All those colors! Well... it used to be.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.schilder_sien.2: I only paint cheerful things. That's why I have so little gray paint.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.schilder_sien.3: My masterpiece is called 'Blob in the Morning Sun'. It got eaten.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.slaapkop_sjors.1: Zzz... huh, what? I wasn't sleeping. I was resting my eyes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.slaapkop_sjors.2: I haven't slept for three nights. Something out there snores really loudly.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.slaapkop_sjors.3: A nap is a cuddle for your head.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.koopman_kees.1: Everything's for sale! Except my little cart. That's gone.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.koopman_kees.2: A good trader can sell anything. Even sand in the Drip Caves.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.weerguh_wolkje.1: Today's weather: sunny, with a chance of cuddles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.weerguh_wolkje.2: Ever since the dragon flew over, the sky's been a bit grayish. I don't like it one bit.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.weerguh_wolkje.3: Little lights in the night, those are the campfires. The more, the chonkier.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tip.1: I'm Tip! My sister is called Tap. She's missing. On purpose.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tip.2: Hide-and-seek is the best game ever. Except when you're the seeker.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tip.3: Tap always hides in places with mushrooms. That doesn't narrow it down much around here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wachter_dikkie.1: I guard Shroomsbury. Mostly Baker Ben's little tarts.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wachter_dikkie.2: King Blob is as big as a house. A big house. With an attic.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wachter_dikkie.3: Halt! Who goes there? Oh, you. Carry on.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.boswachter_mos.1: The Sporewood is pretty, but watch out for the Spore Puffers. They sneeze.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.boswachter_mos.2: The shrooms here are centuries old. Some are older than the Grandmaster.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.boswachter_mos.3: Follow the beams of light and you'll never get lost. Almost never.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tap.1: Hee hee! Don't tell anyone I'm sitting here!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tap.2: I've been sitting here for ages. A mushroom is my little friend.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tap.3: Tip never searches properly. He always looks under his own bed first.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.mijnwerker_mopje.1: Drip, drip, drip. All day long. It's getting me a bit soggy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.mijnwerker_mopje.2: Crystals! Crystals everywhere! And slime. Loads of slime.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.mijnwerker_mopje.3: My little lamp is almost out. Luckily the shrooms glow down here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tempelwachter_steeltj: The Shroom Temple is sacred. And very, very stairy.
The big door only opens for those who help the temple's shrooms.
I've been standing here for a hundred years. My legs have fallen asleep.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kampwacht_weide_1.1: Light the campfire: then you'll wake up here if you faint. Don't worry, you won't lose a thing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kampwacht_weide_1.2: A campfire is a cuddle for your whole body. Sit down for a bit?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kampwacht_weide_1.3: I guard this little fire with my life. Well, with my pillow.
