vadsrijk.npc.quiz.vraag.zwam: Pop quiz! An angry Bobblecap is of the Shroom element. What do you bonk it with hardest?
vadsrijk.npc.quiz.vraag.slijm: Pop quiz! A grumpy Blob is of the Slime element. What do you bonk it with hardest?
vadsrijk.npc.quiz.vraag.vuur: Pop quiz! A creature with a little flame next to its health bar is of the Fire element. What do you bonk it with hardest?
vadsrijk.npc.quiz.fout: Almost! Remember the triangle: FIRE > SHROOM > SLIME > FIRE. Try again!
vadsrijk.npc.gids.driehoek.uitleg: Strong = x1.5 and 'Weak!'. The other way around = x0.7. Pink is strong against everything dechonked.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.tekst: Grandpa Stardust teaches you the element triangle: Fire beats Shroom, Shroom beats Slime, and Slime beats Fire. A strong attack does x1.5 and you see 'Weak!'; the other way around only does x0.7. Pink is strong against everything that's been dechonked. The little letter or icon next to a creature's health bar tells you its element. Answer his question!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.bezig: Fire > Shroom > Slime > Fire. Click on me, and I'll quiz you!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.aanbod.0: Aha, the new one! I'm Grandpa Stardust. Do you know the most important thing about bopping? Not how hard. But with WHAT.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.aanbod.1: Every creature in the Chonkdom has an element. Look at the little icon next to its health bar: a little flame is Fire, a little mushroom is Shroom, a little droplet is Slime, and a little heart is Pink.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.aanbod.2: And then the triangle, remember it well:  FIRE > SHROOM > SLIME > FIRE.  Fire burns the shroom, the shroom slurps up the slime, and the slime puts out the fire. Pfssst!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.aanbod.3: Bop a creature with what beats it, and you'll see 'Weak!' and do one and a half times as much. The other way around you only do a little. And Pink? Pink is extra strong against everything that's been dechonked. Click on me in a bit, and I'll quiz you!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.klaar.0: Well done! You're a clever one. Look in your quest log (J) under Guide, the triangle is drawn there once more.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.klaar.1: Now go back to Cook Crispycrust, by the campfire on the camp square. He wants the fire burning before it gets dark.
vadsrijk.bazen.tempel.verhaal: The big temple door stays shut for now (you are level %2$s). At level %3$s a right-click on the door always opens it. Sooner? Follow the story until Temple Guard Stalky welcomes you here, then you can do it from level %1$s.
vadsrijk.bazen.kk.kroon_af: King Blob's crown flies off! Grab it and throw it back (right-click)!
vadsrijk.bazen.kk.kroon_pak: You've got the crown! Right-click to throw it at King Blob!
vadsrijk.bazen.kk.kroon_raak: %s throws the crown at King Blob! He's dizzy!
vadsrijk.bazen.kk.slijm: The meadow's ponds turn into sticky slime! Watch your step.
vadsrijk.bazen.kk.schild: Shield! Only %s breaks it right away (or %s more hits).
vadsrijk.bazen.oz.last: Spore load on %s! Stand there TOGETHER in the YELLOW to share the hit!
vadsrijk.bazen.oz.spreid: Purple spores on everyone! SPREAD OUT!
vadsrijk.bazen.oz.vloer: The temple floor cracks open: root fields! You'll get stuck in those.
vadsrijk.bazen.oz.toren: A root tower has grown! Climb it: his cap is his weak spot!
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.lok_nep: Pfff! Fake Mika! His mustache didn't sparkle...
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.lok: Four Mikas?! Only the real one has a sparkly mustache!
vadsrijk.bazen.mika.kaas: A cheese wheel avalanche! Do NOT stand in the red lanes!
vadsrijk.kern.baas.te_ver: Too far away! Come into the arena to hit the boss.
guhs.configuration.vadsrijkSchud.tooltip: How hard the screen shakes and the camera moves along with heavy hits and boss moments. 0 = off.
vadsrijk.kern.beleving.fase.vr_baas_mika: Phase 2: Which Mika is the real one?
vadsrijk.npc.schat.hoedenschat: High up on a lonely shroom cap in the Sporewood, at the end of a narrow plank path. Who built this little hut here?
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.kristal.uitleg: The jewelerguh in Sugarbowl sets this in a socket of your gear.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.kristal.ijsglans.ef: %s%% chance that what you hit becomes Frozen
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.kies: Pick something with sockets on the left. Then I'll set a crystal in it!
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.kies_krist: Pick a crystal on the left first.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.uitleg: Setting is free. Removing costs a few coins, and you always get your crystal back.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.gezet: Click! The crystal is in: %s sparkles.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.gehaald: Carefully popped out (%s). Your crystal is back in your bag.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.weg: That's no longer in your bag.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.te_weinig: Removing costs %s. You don't have that yet.
vadsrijk.klassen.boom.nee.level: This row only opens at a higher level.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.adv3.klaar: ✦ Level 30! You're ready for your third job advancement to %s! Go to the Crystal Chapel in Sugarbowl or the order temple in Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.tip.adv3: At level 30 your final ceremony awaits: a new title and a new power. In the Crystal Chapel of Sugarbowl or in the order temple.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.knuffelridde: Crystal Wall: while your Snuggle Shield is up, every enemy that hits you freezes for 3 s. Pillow Bonk deals 40 % more damage to frozen enemies. Plus Strength, Defense and Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.pluisjager.3: Ice Star: every 5th normal shot that hits fires an ice star along with it (1x weapon damage, 2 s Frozen). Star Shot freezes everything it pierces for 4 s. Plus Dexterity and Crit.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.vadsmagier.3: Mirror Echo: Pink Fireball freezes for 1.5 s. If it hits an enemy that was already frozen, the ice shatters in a second explosion (1.2x weapon damage, radius 3). Plus Wisdom and Element Damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_ijsklap.uitleg: Pillow Bonk makes enemies Frozen for 2.5 s: they walk slower and heavy hits deal 30 % more.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_ijspantser.uitl: A lot more Chonk, Defense and Element Resistance. A cuddle like a glacier.
Burning, Spored, Sticky, Stunned and Frozen only last half as long on you.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_galmstoot.uitle: Storm Leap recharges 2 s faster, and the landing deals double damage to frozen enemies.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_kristalhart.uit: More Strength, harder critical hits and extra Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_ijzeren_knuffel: If you drop below 30 % Chonk, you get a Snuggle Shield of 30 % of your max Chonk for 5 s (once a minute).
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_ijspijl.uitleg: Your normal shots have a 15 % chance to freeze an enemy for 2 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_poolvacht.uitle: More Dexterity, Chonk and Move Speed. Warm and fast.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_jachtinstinct.u: 20 % more damage on enemies below 35 % Chonk. Finish them off!
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_splinterregen.u: Fluff Rain recharges 1.5 s faster and deals 60 % more damage on frozen enemies.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_sterrenoog.uitl: A lot more crit chance and harder critical hits.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_windloper.uitle: Every enemy you help defeat makes Roll Flip ready again right away.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_ijsbollen.uitle: Your normal magic orbs have a 20 % chance to freeze an enemy for 2 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_kristalgeest.ui: More Wisdom, Chonk and Element Resistance.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_heldere_bron.ui: When you heal someone, it also washes away Burning, Spored, Sticky and Frozen.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_ijsnova.uitleg: Meteor Guh freezes everything it hits for 4 s and gives you back 30 energy.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_sterrenwijsheid: 15 % more Element Damage and 8 % Cooldown Reduction.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_manastroom.uitl: Every enemy you help defeat gives you 8 Chonk Energy.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_adv3.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 58.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_adv3.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 58.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_adv3.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 58.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_rozekwarts.flavo: Warm pink and a little sticky. Gives you more Chonk.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_zonnesteen.flavo: Catches the last bit of sunshine of the day. Your hits find the weak spot more often.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_galmkristal.flav: Sings softly back when you tap it. You strike faster.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_spiegelkwarts.fl: You see yourself in it, only braver. More Defense.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_vonkkristal.flav: Crackles in your pocket. Your elements get stronger.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_ijsglans.flavour: Always cold, even in hot cocoa. Sometimes freezes what you hit.
vadsrijk.loot.kristalkling.flavour.0: Forged from a crystal needle that wouldn't sing. Now it does.
vadsrijk.loot.kristalkling.flavour.2: Sparkles so hard the Echo Wolf has to sneeze.
vadsrijk.loot.galmhamer.flavour.0: Every hit echoes three valleys further.
vadsrijk.loot.galmhamer.flavour.1: Heavy, slow and very, very convincing.
vadsrijk.loot.galmhamer.flavour.2: The smith of Sugarbowl also uses it to crack nuts.
vadsrijk.loot.ijspeesboog.flavour.0: The string is made of frozen cuddle wool. Don't lick it.
vadsrijk.loot.ijspeesboog.flavour.1: Shoots fast. Your fingers do get cold, though.
vadsrijk.loot.ijspeesboog.flavour.2: A Sky Falcon would be jealous of it.
Built from a Mika Drill Tower. They want it back.
Loads slowly, hits hard, says nothing.
vadsrijk.loot.kristalstaf.flavour.0: A piece of rose quartz from the wall of Sugarbowl. Nobody misses it. Almost nobody.
vadsrijk.loot.kristalstaf.flavour.1: Glows when you think of hot chocolate.
vadsrijk.loot.kristalstaf.flavour.2: Crystal magic: just like regular magic, but shinier.
vadsrijk.loot.poollichtboek.flavour.0: Every page is a piece of the northern lights. Read it at night.
vadsrijk.loot.poollichtboek.flavour.1: Chapter 1: how to stay warm. Chapter 2: fire. Lots of fire.
vadsrijk.loot.poollichtboek.flavour.2: Smells of pine trees and warm socks.
item.guhs.vr_z2_warme_chocomelk.uitleg: Gives you 250 Chonk, thaws you out (Frozen is gone) and keeps you warm for 3 minutes (you can't freeze).
item.guhs.vr_z2_warme_chocomelk.op: Mmm, hot cocoa. Your toes are thawing out.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.set.kristal.2: (2) Crystal Skin: +8 Element Resistance, Frozen lasts half as long and heavy hits then do nothing extra
vadsrijk.z2wezens.set.kristal.4: (4) Splinter Strike: 20%% chance that your hit bursts into shards (25%% damage to everything around it)
vadsrijk.z2wezens.set.mika.4: (4) Drill Power: +15%% damage to petrified creatures, +25%% on your first hit
vadsrijk.z2wezens.mika.weg.2: I'll be back! With more cheese!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.mika.paniek.2: Not the mustache! Uh... I don't have a mustache!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.cmd.spawners: %s zone 2 spawners; max alive per area: %s
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.bevroren: You're Frozen: you move slower and a HEAVY hit hurts extra (and breaks the ice). Dodge the big swings!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.versteend: This creature has turned to gray crystal. Pink (chonk) does x1.5 damage to it!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.splinterling: Every hit on a Splinterling shoots shards back at whoever hit it. Hitting from far away doesn't help!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.galmvleermuis: Gone? Listen! If you hear a high little bell, it's about to pop up behind you.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.sneeuwknabbelaar: They hunt in packs. See one crouch down low? Then it's about to pounce: step aside.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.kristalnaaldkruipe: Crystal needles in the snow? One is lying in wait there. Ground shaking: get out of there!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.ijzelgeest: An ice-blue circle under you = the ground freezes there. Step out before you get Frozen.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.schotsbijter: Ice cracking under you? Run! Something's about to bite up through the floe.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.versteende_wacht: Slow but super heavy. Stay out of the red circle, or you'll be dizzy for a bit.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.ijspuffer: Is it puffing up? Then a freezing cloud is coming. Keep your distance for a bit.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.mika_mijnwerker: Running away? Then he's fetching buddies. Finish him before he's back!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.mika_boorder: The red stripe is where its drill head flies. Step out of the stripe.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.kloofgier: Red circle = it's diving. Get out of the circle, and hit it while it sits exhausted on the ground.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.kristalspin: Her web makes you Sticky. Don't walk through the white sticky spots.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.spiegelwacht: Its mirror shield bounces arrows and spells back. Attack it from the side or from behind!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.scherfgeest: It flashes around you and then throws shards. Hit it right after its flash.
vadsrijk.loot.sneeuwmuts.flavour.0: "Knitted by a guh with cold ears."
vadsrijk.loot.sneeuwmuts.flavour.1: "Keeps your head warm and your thoughts cool."
vadsrijk.loot.sneeuwmuts.flavour.2: "There's still a snowflake in it. It's staying."
vadsrijk.loot.galmpantser.flavour.0: "Rings softly when you knock on it. Don't."
vadsrijk.loot.galmpantser.flavour.1: "Did anyone hear that? That was your armor."
vadsrijk.loot.schotsbroek.flavour.1: "Sturdy as an ice floe, less slippery."
vadsrijk.loot.schotsbroek.flavour.2: "With extra knee patches for out on the lake."
vadsrijk.loot.ijzelslofjes.flavour.0: "Sliding is a choice. These slippers choose yes."
vadsrijk.loot.ijzelslofjes.flavour.1: "Warm on the inside, icy on the outside."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalkroon.flavour.0: "The gray has been polished out. Almost."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalkroon.flavour.2: "A Splinterling wore it as a head. Used to."
"Rings like a little bell when you get a cuddle."
"See-through enough to show your little heart."
vadsrijk.loot.mijnhelm.flavour.0: "Still warm from a Mika head. Yuck."
vadsrijk.loot.mijnhelm.flavour.1: "The lamp still works. The Mika's lights are out."
vadsrijk.loot.mijnhelm.flavour.2: "Smells a bit like cheese and gunpowder."
vadsrijk.loot.buitvest.flavour.0: "Pockets full of stolen stuff. Empty now. Yours now."
vadsrijk.loot.buitvest.flavour.2: "Looted from a Mika, so fair and square."
vadsrijk.loot.boorbroek.flavour.1: "With an extra pocket for spare drill heads."
vadsrijk.loot.kaaslaarzen.flavour.0: "Yes, they're made of cheese. No, don't eat them."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalring.flavour.0: "There's a tiny pink light inside. It winks."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalring.flavour.1: "Fits any guh finger. Guhs don't have fingers."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalring.flavour.2: "Found inside a Crystal Spider. Don't ask."
vadsrijk.loot.spiegelketting.flavour.0: "You can see yourself in it. You look great."
vadsrijk.loot.galmoorbel.flavour.0: "You can hear the mountains singing softly in it."
vadsrijk.loot.galmoorbel.flavour.1: "An echo that never stops. How snug."
vadsrijk.loot.galmoorbel.flavour.2: "Echoes when you nod. So nod a lot."
item.guhs.vr_mom_regenboogdrankje.uitleg: Gives you 700 Chonk and 120 energy, plus 90 s of Wahoog, Quickpaws and a Snuggle Shield.
vadsrijk.momenten.drankje.buiten: This potion only works in the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.momenten.drankje.op: You sparkle in every color of the rainbow!
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.aankomst.have: Caravan in the Harbor! Rare wares, fresh off the airship!
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.aankomst.kust: A little break for Snaily. Anyone else want to buy something?
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.aankomst.zwam: The caravan is on the square in Shroomsbury! Come and have a look!
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.aankomst.spor: Caravan at the edge of the Sporewood! Don't sneeze from the spores, okay?
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.help_eerst: First chase off those rascals, then we'll talk business!
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.aanval.weide: Help! Blobs are attacking the caravan! Snaily is hiding in his shell!
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.aanval.woud: Help! Angry shrooms at the caravan! Save my wares!
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.opgegeven: Phew, they've given up and are bumbling off. Come on Snaily, let's go!
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.dank.0: Thank you, %s! Without you I'd be snail soup by now!
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.dank.1: %s, you're a real caravan hero! Here, for your trouble.
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.dank.2: Hooray! Snaily dares to come out of his shell again. Thank you, %s!
vadsrijk.momenten.karavaan.zeldzaam: Crumbs secretly slips you something rare: %s!
vadsrijk.wereld.deur.dicht.spiegelburcht: The mirror door only reflects your own face. There must be a key...
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.luchtschip.onder_have: Back by guh-balloon line. Nice and warm!
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.luchtschip.nog_niet: The captain shakes his head: first this part of the Chonkdom needs your help. Nyeg.
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.luchtschip.te_laag: The captain looks worried: up there it's freezing and dangerous. Come back at level %s.
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.luchtschip.tip: Sneak and click the bell for the line to Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.opening.onder: Where chonk turns to gray crystal
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.opening.chocomelk: Phew, that was a close call! Welcome to Sugarbowl. First, a mug of hot cocoa.
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.gondel.dicht: The gondola isn't moving yet. The gondolaguh is finishing his hot cocoa first.
vadsrijk.z2npc.luchtschip.te_laag: Brrr. The Splinter Peaks are freezing and dangerous, adventurer. Come back when you're level 20. (now level %s)
vadsrijk.z2npc.juwelier.later: My socket bench is still in the works (it comes with the zone 2 systems). Come back later!
vadsrijk.z2npc.chocomelk: Here you go, a warm mug of hot cocoa. With a marshmallow. Well, two.
vadsrijk.z2npc.chocomelk.al: You just had one! Finish it first, then you get another.
vadsrijk.z2npc.gondel.omhoog: All aboard! The gondola is going up. No wobbling. Okay, a little wobbling.
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.splinter.vraag: A gray crystal splinter is stuck in his wing. He's breathing heavily. He looks at you, but he doesn't move.
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.splinter.optie: Very carefully pull the splinter out
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.splinter.0: On the mountain pass lies something enormous. Gray feathers, fluffy wings, little ears like horns. Wahoognir.
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.splinter.1: He's hurt. A big gray crystal splinter sticks out of his wing. Around him, the snow is gray.
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.splinter.2: He sees you. He doesn't growl. He just sighs. Very deeply.
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.weg: Wahoognir gives you a long look. For a moment you see something pink in his eyes. Then he spreads his wings and flies away.
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.storm: A snowstorm! Ice floes slam against the hull!
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.wolf: On a crystal spire stands a wolf of gray crystal. It howls.
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.naald: The spire cracks! The ship glides into the warm geode just in time.
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.aankomst: Welcome to Sugarbowl! Café Owner Mallow is waiting with hot cocoa in the café on the square.
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.flashback.onder: Wahoognir, the pink guardian dragon of the Chonkdom
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.einde.onder: Far in the east, beyond the clouds, stands a tree as big as a mountain.
vadsrijk.z2npc.zone2.klaar: The first splinter of the heart crystal has been found! The Splinter Peaks sing pure and clear again.
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.teller: Drill tracks found: %s of %s. Inventor Cogwheel will want to know about this!
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.alle: All five drill tracks point to the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, all the way in the west. The drill hall is open!
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z2_knuff: under the ice of the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl (they sparkle with hearts)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z2_aanwi: in the Splinter Gorge, on the Echo Slopes and in Sugarbowl (purple sparkles)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z2_schat: in secret spots in the Splinter Peaks
vadsrijk.npc.plek.z2_luchtschip: by Pilotguh Zeppy, at the airship in the Harbor (south of Shroomsbury)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_kapitein: by the airship at the jetty on the south edge of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kapitein.1: Ice on the hull, snow in my mustache. Lovely! Well. A little bit lovely.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kapitein.2: Back to the Harbor? Pull your scarf tight, it's drafty above the clouds.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kapitein.3: I once caught an ice floe with my hat. It melted. The floe, not the hat.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_cafe: in the hot cocoa cafe on the southwest side of the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_cafe.1: Hot cocoa! With whipped cream! With marshmallows! With even more whipped cream!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_cafe.2: Anyone with cold pawsies gets a mug from me. That's how it works in Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_cafe.3: My secret recipe? A pinch of cinnamon and loads of cuddles in the pan.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_burgemeester: on the north side of the square in Sugarbowl, by the crystal clock tower
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_burgemeester.1: Welcome to Sugarbowl, the warmest spot in the coldest mountains!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_burgemeester.2: Our little town sits inside a giant geode. The pink quartz keeps the warmth in. And the snow out.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_burgemeester.3: I have a chain of office made of rock candy. No licking. I see you looking.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_kwarts: at the quest board on the northeast side of the square of Sugarbowl (the Crystal Guard)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kwarts.1: The Crystal Guard watches over Sugarbowl. Day and night. In warm socks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kwarts.2: Out there, the Chonklessness turns everything into gray crystal. We don't let it in here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kwarts.3: Back straight, adventurer. A guard is like a crystal: hard on the outside, pink on the inside.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_ordemeester: in the Crystal Chapel, high on the top terrace in the northwest of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_ordemeester.1: This is the Snuggle Order's mountain branch. Small, but heated.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_ordemeester.2: Here you can switch classes, just like with the Grandmaster. And at level 30 a new title awaits you here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_ordemeester.3: Crystal remembers everything. Light, warmth, songs. That's why I love listening to it.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_juwelier: in the jewelry shop on the northwest side of the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_juwelier.1: Rough crystals from the mountains? I'll set them in your gear in no time. Click, done.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_juwelier.2: A socket in your sword, a little stone in it, and hop: stronger. You can take it out too, nothing breaks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_juwelier.3: Not everything that glitters is a gem. Sometimes it's just my glasses.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_smid: in the smithy on the northeast side of the square of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_smid.1: It's always warm in here. That's thanks to my oven. And my good mood.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_smid.2: Stars on, frayed off. I'll hammer everything straight again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_smid.3: Forging iron in the snow? Pfff. Sugarbowl has the warmest smithy in the realm.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_winkelier: in the little candy shop on the first terrace on the east side of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winkelier.1: Warm potions, woolly socks and bandages with snowflakes on them!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winkelier.2: A peppermint for the road? They're free. The potions aren't.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winkelier.3: My little shop smells of mint. That keeps the sniffles out.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_wapenhandelaar: in the smithy on the northeast side of the square of Sugarbowl, next to Smith Glowcoal
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wapenhandelaar.1: Swords with a frosty edge, bows with mitten grips. Everything for the mountains!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wapenhandelaar.2: Pointy is good. Too pointy is dangerous. I sell just-right pointy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wapenhandelaar.3: An adventurer without a good weapon is like hot cocoa without whipped cream. Tragic.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_breister: in the mitten shop on the first terrace on the west side of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_breister.1: A sweater for you, a sweater for your guh, a sweater for the sweater.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_breister.2: All the guhs in Sugarbowl wear my sweaters. Except the mayor. He wears two.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_breister.3: Knit, knit, knit. That's my song. It only has one word.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_veilingmeester: in the auction house (the old bank) on the southeast side of the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_veilingmeester.1: Going once, going twice... SOLD to the guh with the warmest hat!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_veilingmeester.2: Even up in the mountains you can trade with other adventurers. Not bound items, though.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_veilingmeester.3: My gavel is made of candyfloss. It makes no sound, but it smells lovely.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_schaatsjuf: at the skating pond in the middle of the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatsjuf.1: A lap to the left, a lap to the right, paws apart and... SWOOSH!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatsjuf.2: Falling is no big deal. Getting up is what matters. Then falling again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatsjuf.3: I've been skating since I was a little guh. Back then the ice was still pink.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_gondelier: at the gondola station on the top terrace in the northeast of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondelier.1: The gondola to the top! View guaranteed, wobbling too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondelier.2: Don't lean out of the window. Not even if you see a Snow Hare.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondelier.3: My cable is a hundred years old. It has never let go. Never ever!
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_opa_sneeuwbal: on the terrace of the hot cocoa cafe, on the southwest side of the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_opa_sneeuwbal.1: In my day we walked through the snow to school every day. Uphill. Both ways.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_opa_sneeuwbal.2: My mittens are gone. My pawsies are ice cubes now.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_opa_sneeuwbal.3: Come here, I'll tell you about the winter of '32. It was cold. The end.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_bakker: at his bakery on the terrace in the southwest of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_bakker.1: Candy cookies! Crunchy on the outside, crystal on the inside!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_bakker.2: My oven is the second warmest spot in Sugarbowl. After the cafe. And the smithy. Third, then.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_bakker.3: Who wants a cookie with a little snowflake on top?
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_vlokje: in the middle of the square in Sugarbowl, by the skating pond
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_vlokje.1: My plushies went skating and now they're stuck under the ice!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_vlokje.2: I'm Flake. I'm six. And three quarters.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_vlokje.3: When I grow up, I'll join the Crystal Guard. With a candy spear!
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_uitvinder: by his workshop in the northwest of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_uitvinder.1: Hear that humming? Deep in the mountains? That's no avalanche. That's a machine!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_uitvinder.2: I invented a snowplow that makes its own snow. It doesn't quite work right.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_uitvinder.3: Cogs, springs, little nuts. That's what makes an inventor happy.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_galmpje: on the northwest side of the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_galmpje.1: La la laaa... and the mountains sing laaa back!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_galmpje.2: The crystal spires on the Echo Slopes sing along if you sing well. Or really loudly.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_galmpje.3: I sing in the Candy Choir. There are two of us. Me and the echo.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_postguh: on the terrace on the east side of Sugarbowl, by the little post office
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_postguh.1: Mail! By sled! Who wants mail?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_postguh.2: Mail in the mountains goes by sled. Downhill, very fast. Uphill... less fast.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_postguh.3: I have a letter for the mountain guide, the fisher and the gorge keeper. I just don't feel like climbing.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_sneeuwpop: by the snow pile on the terrace in the southeast of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwpop.1: I'm building the biggest snowman in the Chonkdom! His name is Jack too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwpop.2: A good snowman has a carrot. A great one has two.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwpop.3: Snowball fights? Always! But never at Grandpa Snowball. He throws back.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_kasguh: by the glass greenhouse on the west edge of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kasguh.1: My greenhouse is warm, my little tomatoes are red, and my little flowers are... gray. Hm.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kasguh.2: Everything grows in the geode. Except patience. You have to bring that yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kasguh.3: Green in the snow! Now that's magic.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_winterslaap: in front of his little house on the terrace on the northwest side of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winterslaap.1: Zzz... is it spring yet? No? Zzz...
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winterslaap.2: I love winter. You get to sleep the whole time. Only it's too cold to sleep.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winterslaap.3: A hot water bottle, a thick blanket, a plushie. That's all you need.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_poollicht: in front of her little house on the terrace on the northeast side of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_poollicht.1: At night the light dances above the peaks. Green and pink. Gorgeous!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_poollicht.2: I draw star maps. The stars here have guh ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_poollicht.3: From the high lookout you can see a giant tree far away. Nobody knows what's there.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_gondel_boven: at the top gondola station, high on the Echo Summit in the northeast of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondel_boven.1: Welcome to the top! Careful, it's a bit windy up here. Hold on to your ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondel_boven.2: Back down? The gondola is ready. It only wobbles a tiny bit.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondel_boven.3: My brother Cable is down below. I'm up top. We talk through the cable. He never hears a thing.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_berggids: at the first campfire on the west edge of the Echo Slopes, east of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_berggids.1: Always follow the little flags. And never the Snow Hares: they don't know the way either.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_berggids.2: When the spires sing, something is coming. Listen closely.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_berggids.3: I've climbed every peak. Twice. The second time to fetch my hat.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_visser: on the little island in the middle of the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_visser.1: A hole in the ice, a rod in the hole, and waiting. Lots and lots of waiting.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_visser.2: Fish swim under the ice. And plushies. They don't bite. Too bad.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_visser.3: My ice hole is the finest ice hole on the lake. Round and everything.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_beeldhouwer: on the north shore of the Frozen Snuggle Lake, by the campfire and his ice sculptures
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_beeldhouwer.1: Tap, tap, tap. There's always a guh inside a block of ice. If you just tap long enough.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_beeldhouwer.2: My statues melt in summer. That's why it's always winter here. Handy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_beeldhouwer.3: I've seen strange things. Little figures with sleds full of crystal. Heading for the gorge.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_touwtje: by the wide rope bridge to the Mirror Keep, in the east of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_touwtje.1: Rope bridges wobble. They're supposed to. I think.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_touwtje.2: I know every bridge in Splinter Gorge. And every rope. They don't call me Ropey for nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_touwtje.3: Something's humming down there. For weeks now. Mika machines, I tell you.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_prisma: at the gate of the Mirror Keep, on the highest peak in the northeast
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_prisma.1: The Mirror Keep was once the brightest palace in the realm. Now it's gray.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_prisma.2: In the keep you have to bounce the light around. Mirror after mirror.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_prisma.3: Lady Mirrorsigh... she was so cheerful once. She admired herself all day long. Now all she sees is gray.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_versteend_zwier: in the middle of the ice of the Frozen Snuggle Lake
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_zwier.1: ...(A guh of dull gray crystal, frozen mid-pirouette. You hear, very softly: 'help...')
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_zwier.2: ...(His little skates still sparkle a bit pink.)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_zwier.3: ...(The crystal is cold, but something warm is beating inside.)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_versteend_snoek: by the ice floes in the south of the Frozen Snuggle Lake
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_snoek.1: ...(A fisher of dull gray crystal, with a fishing rod in his little paws. 'Got... a bite...')
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_snoek.2: ...(A little crystal fish dangles from his rod.)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_versteend_pluk: on the west side of the ice of the Frozen Snuggle Lake
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_pluk.1: ...(A guh of dull gray crystal, with a half-knitted plushie in her little paws.)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_versteend_ijsje: on the little island in the middle of the Frozen Snuggle Lake, next to Ice Fisher Holey
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_ijsje.1: ...(A teeny tiny guh made of dull gray crystal. It's holding a snowball in its little paw.)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_ijsje.2: ...(Its little ears are still standing up in fright.)
vadsrijk.z2npc.vrij.z2_versteend_zwier: I can twirl again! Look: a spin to the left, a spin to the right... oopsie. Thank you, adventurer!
vadsrijk.z2npc.vrij.z2_versteend_snoek: I sat still for three days. Best fishing day ever. Nah, just kidding. Thank you so much!
vadsrijk.z2npc.vrij.z2_versteend_pluk: My pawsies! I can knit again! The plushies under the ice... they're mine. Will you help them?
vadsrijk.z2npc.vrij.z2_versteend_ijsje: Hee hee, it tickled when the crystal broke! I'm going home, to Sugarbowl. Thank you!
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_dok: at the airship dock on the southern edge of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_plein: in the middle of the square of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_schaatsvijver: on the ice of the skating pond, in the middle of the square of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_galmnaald: by the big cracked Echo Spire above the Echo Wolf's den, in the east of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_naald_do: by the low singing spire in the south of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_naald_re: by the middle singing spire, right in the middle of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_naald_mi: by the high singing spire in the north of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_lawinepad: at the foot of the big avalanche path, in the north of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_sneeuwpophellin: on the soft snowy slope all the way in the south of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_warmwaterbron: by the hot spring in the southeast of the Echo Slopes (the steam shows the way)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_gondel_top: by the top gondola station, high in the north of the Echo Slopes (take the gondola on the northeast side of Sugarbowl)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_meer_scheur: by the big crack in the ice, in the north of the Frozen Snuggle Lake
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_brug_1: on the middle rope bridge of the Splinter Gorge, by Gorge Keeper Ropey
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_brug_2: on the western rope bridge of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_brug_3: on the farthest rope bridge, all the way to the west of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_boortoren: by the big Mika Drill Tower in the east of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_boortoren_2: by the Mika Drill Tower in the west of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_drakenravijn: on the mountain pass north of the Frozen Snuggle Lake, at the southwest edge of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_boorhal: in the hidden drill hall at the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, all the way to the west (look for the crack where warm air comes out)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_spiegelpoort: by the gate of the Mirror Keep, on the highest peak in the northeast (behind the Splinter Gorge)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_uitkijk_poollic: on top of the tall crystal spire in the northwest of the Splinter Gorge (the Gorge Lookout)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_kampvuur_galm: by the campfire of Mountain Guide Climbpaw, on the west edge of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_kampvuur_meer: by the campfire on the east shore of the Frozen Snuggle Lake
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_kampvuur_kloof: by the campfire on the southern edge of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq01_splinterpieken.te: Grandmaster Chonkfoot saw Wahoognir circling above the crystal spires in the north. Pilotguh Zeppy in the Harbor has a new airship line: to Sugarbowl, the warm little town in the Splinter Peaks. Fly along and talk to Café Owner Mallow there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq01_splinterpieken.be: Hop in with me, here in the Harbor, and fly to Sugarbowl. Café Owner Mallow is waiting there with hot cocoa.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq01_splinterpieken.do: Fly with Pilotguh Zeppy from the Harbor to Sugarbowl
Talk to Café Owner Mallow in the cocoa café on the southeast side of Sugarbowl's square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq01_splinterpieken.aa: Adventurer! Have you heard? The dragon has been spotted above the crystal spires in the north. The Splinter Peaks.
There's a little town up there, Sugarbowl, inside a giant geode of pink quartz. Warm on the inside, freezing cold outside. I've just started flying there.
A little. There's ice on the route. And snowstorms. And... well. Just hop in, you'll see for yourself. Put your scarf on!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq01_splinterpieken.kl: There you are! Frozen solid! What a flight, huh? I saw the airship glide in with an icicle on its nose.
Here, a mug of hot cocoa. With whipped cream. With marshmallows. Drink it slowly, it's hot.
There was a wolf standing on a crystal spire. It howled, and then the spire cracked...
An Echo Wolf. Brrr. The mayor needs to know about this. Go see the mayor on the north side of the square, and then report to Captain Quartz of the Crystal Guard, by the quest board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.tekst: Sugarbowl lies safe inside its pink geode, but outside, the Chonklessness is growing stronger: creatures are turning into gray crystal. Talk to Mayor Candy on the square and report to Captain Quartz of the Crystal Guard.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.bezig: The mayor on the north side of the square, and then Captain Quartz by the quest board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.doel.0: Talk to Mayor Candy on the north side of Sugarbowl's square, in front of the big snowguh spruce
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.doel.1: Report to Captain Quartz of the Crystal Guard, by the quest board on Sugarbowl's square
Finish your cocoa first. There. And now: off to the mayor. He knows everything about the mountains.
The mayor stands on the north side of the square, in front of the big snowguh spruce. After that, Captain Quartz of the Crystal Guard, by the quest board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.klaar.0: So. You're the Order's adventurer. The mayor sent a note. With little hearts. He always overdoes it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.klaar.1: Listen. Lately the crystal spires on the Echo Slopes have been singing off-key. Creatures are turning gray and hard as stone. Splinterlings, we call them. And yesterday an Echo Wolf howled.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.klaar.2: The Crystal Guard holds the gates. But we can't go outside. You can. Start at the Echo Slopes, in the east.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.praat.z: Welcome, welcome! To Sugarbowl, the warmest spot in the coldest mountains! I'm Mayor Candy.
Our geode keeps the cold out. But not the worries. Guhs have been petrified by the lake. Gray crystal, from head to toe. They're still alive, mind you. They just can't move anymore.
By the Chonklessness, they say. Captain Quartz of the Crystal Guard knows more. He's by the quest board, on the northeast side of the square.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.tek: East of Sugarbowl lie the Echo Slopes: snowfields with crystal spires that sing back when you hit them. Light Mountain Guide Climbpaw's campfire, talk to him and defeat the crystal creatures roaming there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.bez: Out of the geode through the East Gate (the street past the Candy Stall), up the path, to Mountain Guide Climbpaw's campfire.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.doe: Light the campfire by Mountain Guide Climbpaw: through Sugarbowl's East Gate, then up the path to the western edge of the Echo Slopes
Talk to Mountain Guide Climbpaw by that campfire
Defeat 12 creatures on the Echo Slopes, east of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.aan: The Echo Slopes. Leave the geode through the East Gate, at the end of the street past the Candy Stall, and follow the path up. Mountain Guide Climbpaw sits by the first campfire.
Light that fire: that's where you'll wake up if things go wrong. And watch out for the Splinterlings. They shoot shards when you hit them.
No cheer-up poof here, adventurer. These are real monsters. Gray crystal without a heart. When you defeat them, they burst into shards that melt away.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.kla: Twelve! Good work. The slope is already a little quieter. Only the spires are still singing off-key.
You know, those spires are always singing. But lately they sound... angry. I think there's something in the shards.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.pra: An adventurer! Lovely. I'm Climbpaw, mountain guide. I know every stone around here. And every snow hare by name.
See those gray creatures between the spires? Splinterlings and Sleet Spirits. They used to be ordinary little snow critters. Defeat a dozen or so, then we can take a closer look.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.tekst: Mountain Guide Climbpaw wants to know why the crystal spires are singing off-key. Collect Echo Shards from the creatures on the Echo Slopes and climb to the cracked Echo Spire, where the Echo Wolf howled.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.bezig: Six Echo Shards, and a look at the cracked Echo Spire in the east.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.doel.0: Collect 6 Echo Shards from the creatures on the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.doel.1: Climb to the cracked Echo Spire above the Echo Wolf's den, in the east of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.aanbod.0: When you defeat a Splinterling, sometimes a shard is left behind that hums. An Echo Shard. Bring me six.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.aanbod.1: And then climb up to the Echo Spire. The big one, in the east, above the Echo Wolf's den. It cracked when the Echo Wolf howled on it. See what you find there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.klaar.0: Let me see... Hm. Hear that? They're all humming the same little tune. Low. Gray. Like a growl.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.klaar.1: There were pawprints by the spire. Really big ones. And the snow was gray.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.klaar.2: The Echo Wolf. He howls the Chonklessness into the mountains, and the spires sing it back. As long as he howls, everything turns to stone.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.tekst: The Echo Wolf is howling the Chonklessness into the Echo Slopes. Defeat him in his den at the top of the slope. When he howls, crystal waves roll over the snow: hide behind the frozen pillars. But watch out, they break one by one. Then head back to Captain Quartz in Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.bezig: The Echo Wolf's den is in the east of the Echo Slopes. Hide behind the pillars when he howls!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.doel.0: Defeat the Echo Wolf in his den in the east of the Echo Slopes (hide behind the frozen pillars when he howls)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.aanbod.0: There's only one way to make the spires sing clear again. The Echo Wolf has to be silenced.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.aanbod.1: His den is in the east of the slope. When he howls, a crystal wave rolls over the snow. Hide behind a frozen pillar! But those pillars break, one by one. Be quick.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.aanbod.2: Bring friends if you can. I'll wait here with warm tea.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.klaar.0: You defeated the Echo Wolf! I could hear it all the way over here: the whole mountain sighed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.klaar.1: The spires are singing clear again. Well, almost. The Crystal Guard owes you its thanks.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.klaar.2: But there's more. By the Frozen Snuggle Lake, in the west, guhs have been petrified. Real guhs. Will you go take a look?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.tekst: At the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl, four guhs have been petrified into gray crystal. Talk to Ice Fisher Holey by his ice hole and free the four guhs: lay your little paw on the crystal and think of something nice. You never hurt guhs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.bezig: The lake is in the west. First Ice Fisher Holey, then the four petrified guhs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.doel.0: Talk to Ice Fisher Holey on the little island in the middle of the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.doel.1: Free Skater Swirl: click the gray crystal in the middle of the lake's ice
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.doel.2: Free Fisher Pike: click the gray crystal by the ice floes in the south of the lake
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.doel.3: Free Plushmaker Pip: click the gray crystal on the west side of the ice
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.doel.4: Free Little Icy: click the gray crystal on the little island in the middle of the lake, next to Holey
The Frozen Snuggle Lake is in the west. Leave the geode heading west. Ice Fisher Holey sits there, right in the middle of the ice.
Four guhs have been petrified there. They're still alive. They're just stuck in the crystal.
How do I get them out?
Not with your weapon! Never. Ask Holey. He saw it happen.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.klaar.0: All four free! Swirl is swirling again, Pike is fishing again, Pip is knitting again and Icy ran home.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.klaar.1: You know what's strange? When the crystal came, the ice creaked. And under the ice, something moved. Lots of little things. And something big.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.praat.z: Pssst. Quietly. The ice is thin over there. And the creatures are awake.
I saw it happen. A gray wind blew across the lake, and wherever it passed, guhs went still. Gray. Hard. Like crystal.
Crystal remembers what you feel. Lay your little paw on it and think of something nice. Then it cracks. I already tried, but I thought of fish. That didn't work.
You lay your little paw on the gray crystal. It's cold. Then you feel something beating, very softly. You think of something nice: hot cocoa, a hug, a campfire...
KRRRACK! The crystal cracks and falls off him like gray snow. He blinks his eyes.
...Oopsie. Hey! I can move again! Was I... a statue? A handsome statue, I hope?
You knock softly on the crystal and think of something happy. The crystal starts to glow pink, and then... CRACK!
...A bite! A BITE! Oh. No. I'm just awake. How long have I been standing here?
The crystal around Pip is thick and gray. You press your little ears against it and hum a song. The crystal hums back... and pops into pieces.
My plushies... I was knitting plushies for the children of Sugarbowl. They slid under the ice when the crystal came. Thank you, sweetie.
The tiniest statue of them all. You give the gray crystal a hug. A really big one.
Krrrk... krak... FLOMP! The crystal falls off like powdered sugar.
Hee hee! That tickled! Are you a knight? You smell like hot cocoa.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq07_onder_het_ijs.tek: Something is moving under the ice of the Snuggle Lake. Defeat the ice creatures around the lake, and a strong elite, and inspect the big crack in the north of the ice. Ice Sculptor Chisel, on the north shore, saw something.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq07_onder_het_ijs.bez: Defeat the creatures around the lake, inspect the crack in the north and talk to Chisel on the north shore.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq07_onder_het_ijs.doe: Defeat 15 creatures around the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl
Defeat an elite at the Frozen Snuggle Lake (a big creature with a glowing name)
Inspect the big crack in the ice, in the north of the Frozen Snuggle Lake
Talk to Ice Sculptor Chisel by his ice sculptures on the north shore of the lake
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq07_onder_het_ijs.aan: Those big things under the ice... they come up when you hit hard. The ice cracks then. Watch where you stand!
Defeat them, and check the big crack in the north. Ice Sculptor Chisel sits on the north shore. He sees everything, he stares at ice all day long.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq07_onder_het_ijs.kla: Tap. Tap. Oh, hello. You've been to the crack? Then you've seen the drag marks.
I saw them walking at night. Little figures with pointy ears and little helmets. With sleds full of gray crystal. They were pulling them north, toward the Splinter Gorge.
Mikas? The cheese ones? Well, they did meow. And they sang a song about drilling. Very off-key.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.tek: The drag marks lead to the Splinter Gorge, north of Sugarbowl: steep walls, wobbly rope bridges and Mika drill rigs harvesting crystal. Talk to Gorge Keeper Ropey, chase off the Mika Miners and find the big drill tower.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.bez: The Splinter Gorge is in the north. First Gorge Keeper Ropey by the middle rope bridge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.doe: Talk to Gorge Keeper Ropey by the middle rope bridge of the Splinter Gorge, north of Sugarbowl
Defeat 12 creatures or Mika Miners in the Splinter Gorge (defeated Mikas flee home in a puff of smoke)
Take 3 Mika Drill Bits from the Mika Miners in the Splinter Gorge
Find the big Mika Drill Tower in the east of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.aan: The gorge is in the north. Leave the geode heading north and follow the path up. Gorge Keeper Ropey stands by the middle rope bridge.
Bring back a few drill bits as proof. Then they'll believe you in Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.kla: Three drill bits. With little Mika pawprints on them. And you saw the big tower?
They're drilling the gray crystal out of the mountains. Sacks full of it.
So that's the rumbling. For weeks now. But there's something else, adventurer. Something I didn't dare tell anyone.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.pra: Hi! Don't be scared if the bridge wobbles. It always does that. I'm Ropey.
Mikas? Oh yes. Everywhere. With little helmets and drills and lunchboxes. When you defeat them, they vanish in a puff of smoke. Then they run back to their fort, somewhere far away.
Their biggest drill tower is in the east of the gorge. You can hear it from a mile away.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.tekst: Gorge Keeper Ropey saw something big crash onto the mountain pass north of the Frozen Snuggle Lake. Something that breathes. Go carefully and see what it is.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.bezig: The mountain pass in the west, above the lake. Slowly, and look first!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.doel.0: Go to the mountain pass north of the Frozen Snuggle Lake, on the southwest edge of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.doel.1: Help whatever is lying on the mountain pass
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.aanbod.0: Three nights ago something fell onto the mountain pass in the west, above the lake. Something big. It didn't rumble. It... sighed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.aanbod.1: I don't dare look. Do you? Go carefully. And no bonking, please. Look first.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.klaar.0: Was it... was it really the dragon? Wahoognir? And you HELPED him?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.klaar.1: There was a gray crystal splinter stuck in his wing. I pulled it out. He looked at me. For a long, long time. And then he flew away.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.klaar.2: I thought he was the enemy. The source of all the grayness. But he was hurting... Maybe it's all different from what we think.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.klaar.3: That splinter... Lightkeeper Prism at the Mirror Keep knows everything about crystal. Take it there. The keep stands on the highest peak, in the northeast.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.tek: The Mirror Keep stands on the highest peak in the northeast, beyond the Splinter Gorge: a palace of gray crystal full of mirrors. Climb to the gate and talk to Lightkeeper Prism.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.bez: Across the middle rope bridge to the north, and then up the stairs to the Mirror Keep.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.doe: Climb to the gate of the Mirror Keep, on the highest peak in the northeast
Talk to Lightkeeper Prism at the gate of the Mirror Keep
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.aan: Follow the gorge north, across this middle rope bridge, and then up the stairs. Way, way up. You'll see the keep sparkling.
Bring a warm scarf. And your courage.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.kla: A Gray Dragon Splinter... Let me see. Look, when I hold it up to the light, you can see a teeny pink dot. Deep inside.
This is no ordinary crystal. This comes from a heart. From his heart. The pink heart crystal of Wahoognir.
His heart broke into pieces. That's how the Chonklessness began. And a big piece of it... is in there. With Lady Mirrorsigh.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.pra: Halt, traveler. You stand before the Mirror Keep. Once the brightest palace in the realm. Now...
...gray. I'm Prism. I guard the last little bit of light here.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq11_spiegelzucht.teks: In the Hall of Mirrors at the back of the Mirror Keep sits Lady Mirrorsigh, turned gray by the splinter of the heart crystal. Go through the mirror halls to the back: bounce the light from mirror to mirror to open the doors. In the fight she splits into reflections: you can only hit the one without a shadow, and the light shifts each phase.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq11_spiegelzucht.bezi: Through the mirror halls to the back, to the Hall of Mirrors. Only hit the reflection without a shadow!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq11_spiegelzucht.doel: Defeat 10 mirror creatures in the halls of the Mirror Keep
Defeat Lady Mirrorsigh in the Hall of Mirrors at the back of the keep (only hit the reflection without a shadow)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq11_spiegelzucht.aanb: Lady Mirrorsigh used to admire herself all day long. Harmless. Vain, but harmless.
When the heart crystal broke, a splinter fell into her mirrors. Now she sees only gray, and she wants everyone to see gray.
Bounce the light to each door, and you'll get through. And in the fight: watch the shadows! The reflection without a shadow is the real one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq11_spiegelzucht.klaa: You did it. The mirrors are clear again. And look... what's in your little paws.
The splinter of the heart crystal. Pink. Warm. It's beating. Take a good look into it...
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq12_hartsplinter.teks: You've found the first splinter of Wahoognir's pink heart crystal. Bring it to Order Master Crystalline, in the Crystal Chapel on the north side of Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq12_hartsplinter.bezi: To Order Master Crystalline in the Crystal Chapel on the north side of Sugarbowl (behind the big snowguh spruce).
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq12_hartsplinter.doel: Bring the pink heart splinter to Order Master Crystalline in the Crystal Chapel on the north side of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq12_hartsplinter.aanb: Go, adventurer. The Order must know about this.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq12_hartsplinter.klaa: A splinter of the heart crystal... I've only read about them. In the oldest books of the Order.
There was also a picture of a cat with a little crown, and gray mist creeping across the whole page. That page has been torn out. Not by me.
Back when Wahoognir was still pink, he carried a heart of pink crystal. As long as it was whole, he protected the entire realm.
Someone broke it. The Mikas? They're drilling the gray crystal out of the mountains... they're looking for something.
Then we'll look for the other splinters. Before the Mikas find them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.tekst: Little Flake's plushies (knitted by Plushmaker Pip) slid under the ice. They're stuck under the ice of the Frozen Snuggle Lake. They sparkle with little hearts: walk up close, and you'll carefully break them free.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.bezig: They sparkle with little hearts under the ice of the lake in the west!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.doel.0: Free the 10 plushies under the ice (on the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.aanbod.0: My plushies went skating on the lake. Without me! And then... crack. Now they're stuck under the ice.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.aanbod.1: They're all over the lake, under the ice. They sparkle with little hearts. Will you free them? Pleeeease?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.klaar.0: ALL OF THEM! Snowball, Polar Cubby, Captain Quartzy, Mitty... everyone's back!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.klaar.1: Here, I found this in the snow. It's shiny. You can have it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.tekst: Skate Coach Twirly gives every new adventurer a skating lesson. Stand on the ice of the skating pond and come back without falling. Well. Without falling much.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.bezig: On the ice of the pond, in the middle of the square. Paws apart!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.doel.0: Stand on the ice of the skating pond, in the middle of Sugarbowl's square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.aanbod.0: New in Sugarbowl? Then you have to skate! Everyone skates here. Even the mayor. Mostly on his tummy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.aanbod.1: Go on, step onto the ice. Paws apart. Little arms wide. And... WHEEE!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.klaar.0: Beautiful! You only fell three times. That's a record for an adventurer. Here, a diploma. It's a cookie.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.tekst: Chorister Echo wants to sing with the crystal spires again. Visit the three singing spires on the Echo Slopes (do, re, mi): when you stand close, they sing their note.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.bezig: Do, re, mi: three spires on the Echo Slopes, from low to high.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.doel.0: Sing at the low spire (do), in the south of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.doel.1: Sing at the middle spire (re), in the middle of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.doel.2: Sing at the high spire (mi), in the north of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.aanbod.0: Do, re, miiii... Hear that? Nothing. The spires used to sing along. Now they're too shy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.aanbod.1: Will you go visit them? The low one, the middle one and the high one. On the Echo Slopes. Just sing a little. Or hum. Or just go 'laaa'.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.klaar.0: I heard them! All the way over here! Do... re... MIIII! The Candy Choir is complete again. With the echo, there are three of us!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s13_ijsbloemen.tekst: Café Owner Mallow always sprinkles crushed ice flower over the whipped cream. The creatures at the Frozen Snuggle Lake drop them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s13_ijsbloemen.bezig: Five ice flowers from the creatures at the lake in the west.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s13_ijsbloemen.doel.0: Collect 5 ice flowers from the creatures at the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl
My secret ingredient is all gone! Crushed ice flower. It crackles on the whipped cream. Delicious.
Out by the lake, the creatures sometimes have them stuck in their fur. Five, please!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s13_ijsbloemen.klaar.0: Smell that. That's the smell of the best cocoa in the realm. Here, a mug for the road. And another one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.tekst: Gondolaguh Cable thinks everyone should ride the gondola to the top at least once. Take the gondola and say hi to Gondolaguh Pulley up top.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.bezig: Hop in the gondola with me, and say hi to Pulley up top.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.doel.0: Take the gondola at Gondolaguh Cable (northeast side of Sugarbowl) to the top station
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.doel.1: Say hi to Gondolaguh Pulley at the top gondola station, high in the north of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.aanbod.0: Have you been up top yet? No? Then you haven't seen the mountains! Hop in.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.aanbod.1: Say hi to my brother Pulley. He's up at the top. He can never hear me down the cable.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.klaar.0: Pulley says hi back? Through you? Finally, a conversation! Thank you, adventurer.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.praat.z2_go: Greetings from Cable? Tell him: 'Hi Cable! Can you hear me now?' Haha. He never hears a thing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_geheim_boormeester.tek: All over the Splinter Peaks lie traces of an enormous Mika machine. Find all five: then you'll know where it stands, and how to make its three drill heads overheat.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_geheim_boormeester.bez: Five drill tracks, and then the hidden drill hall at the bottom of the gorge, all the way in the west.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_geheim_boormeester.doe: Find the five drill tracks (purple sparkles: in the Splinter Gorge, on the Echo Slopes and in Sugarbowl)
Defeat the Mika Drill Master in the hidden drill hall at the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, all the way in the west
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_geheim_boormeester.kla: The Drill Master! Defeated! Fled home in a puff of smoke, you say? With his little helmet crooked?
So THAT was the rumbling. A drilling machine with three heads, deep in the mountain. They were drilling for the gray crystal. For the splinters of the heart, I think.
You're the smartest sleuth in the mountains. Here, a cogwheel from his machine. I had it gilded. With candy.
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.olievlek: By the big drill tower there's a puddle of black oil. Little paw prints run through it. Four toes and a little pad. And a receipt: 'Drill head 2: do NOT overheat!'
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.titel.olievlek: An Oil Stain with Cat Paws
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.bouwtekening: A drawing of a machine with three drill heads: left, middle, right. Scribbled underneath: 'They get hot in the order they start glowing. Watch the little light!'
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.boorgaten: On the avalanche path there are round holes in the snow, neatly in a row. Something has been test drilling here. They lead north, to the gorge.
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.boorschema: Behind Inventor Cogwheel's workshop lies a cheese sandwich with a note: 'Drill hall west: secret crack. Password: meow. Do NOT tell the guhs.'
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.titel.boorsche: A Drill Plan in the Wastebasket
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.warme_spleet: At the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, all the way in the west, warm air blows out of a crack. You hear humming. And very softly... a cheese tooter. Something is hidden here.
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.ijsgrot: Deep in a cave of blue ice lies a forgotten chest of the Crystal Guard!
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.onder_de_brug: A little treasure chest dangles on a string under the western rope bridge. Don't look down!
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z2_versteend: A petrified guh is made of gray crystal, but still alive. Click it when your quest asks you to: that sets it free. You never hurt guhs.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z2_kristal: These creatures are real monsters. When defeated, they burst into shards. Watch out for Splinterlings: they shoot shards when you hit them.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z2_bevroren: You're frozen: slower, and heavy hits hurt extra. Get out of the cold for a bit, or wait until you thaw.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z2_edelsteen: Set rough crystals into the sockets of your gear at Jewelerguh Glitter in Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_splinterpieken.teks: After zone 1 and from level 20, Pilotguh Zeppy flies you from the Harbor to Sugarbowl, a warm little town inside a giant geode. Around it: the Echo Slopes (east, lv 20-23), the Frozen Snuggle Lake (west, lv 23-26), the Splinter Gorge (north, lv 26-29) and the Mirror Keep (lv 28-30).
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_kristalwezens.tekst: In the mountains you fight real monsters: gray crystal without a heart. When defeated, they burst into shards that melt away. Mikas flee home in a puff of smoke. You never hurt guhs: you free petrified guhs with a click.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_bevroren.tekst: Frozen is a status: you're slower, and heavy hits do extra damage. Stand by a campfire or wait until it thaws. You can freeze creatures too: then give them a good smack!
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_edelstenen.tekst: Some gear has 0, 1 or 2 sockets. Rough crystals from the mountains get set in them by Jewelerguh Glitter in Sugarbowl. Taking them out works too, and a gem never breaks.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_reizen.tekst: Captain Polaris flies you from Sugarbowl back to the Harbor, and Pilotguh Zeppy flies you there again. Gondolaguh Cable takes you by gondola to the top of the Echo Slopes.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z2_titel.tekst: At level 30 a third title from the Snuggle Order awaits you, with Order Master Crystalline in the Crystal Chapel of Sugarbowl: Crystal Champion, Polestar Falcon or Crystal Oracle.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_wacht_plein_wes: on the west side of the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wacht_plein_west.1: Light the campfire: this is where you wake up if you faint. Warm and safe. You lose nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wacht_plein_west.2: The Crystal Guard protects the Splinter Peaks. With spears of rock candy and very warm socks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wacht_plein_west.3: Hear those spires singing? When they sing off-key, something's coming. Stay alert, adventurer.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_wacht_plein_oos: on the east side of the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wacht_plein_oost.1: Light the campfire: this is where you wake up if you faint. Warm and safe. You lose nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wacht_plein_oost.2: The Crystal Guard protects the Splinter Peaks. With spears of rock candy and very warm socks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wacht_plein_oost.3: Hear those spires singing? When they sing off-key, something's coming. Stay alert, adventurer.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_wacht_dok: at the campfire by the airship jetty of Sugarbowl

vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_wacht_kloof_1: at a campfire in the west of the Splinter Gorge
