vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z2_kandijkom: in Sugarbowl, the warm geode of the Splinter Peaks
vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z2_galmhellinge: on the Echo Slopes, east of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z2_knuffelmeer: at the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z2_splinterkloo: in the Splinter Gorge, north of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z2_spiegelburch: in the Mirror Keep, on the highest peak in the northeast
vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z2_kandijkom_do: at the airship jetty of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.plek.kampvuur.z2_kandijkom: at the airship jetty of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.plek.kampvuur.z2_kandijkom_: at the airship jetty of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.plek.kampvuur.z2_galmhellin: on the west edge of the Echo Slopes, by Mountain Guide Climbpaw
vadsrijk.npc.plek.kampvuur.z2_knuffelmee: on the east shore of the Frozen Snuggle Lake
vadsrijk.npc.plek.kampvuur.z2_splinterkl: on the south edge of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.plek.kampvuur.z2_spiegelbur: at the bottom of the stairs to the Mirror Keep
vadsrijk.npc.plek.baas.z2_galmhellingen: in the Echo Wolf's den, in the east of the Echo Slopes (the sign at the entrance tells you if he's awake)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.baas.z2_spiegelburcht: in the Hall of Mirrors at the back of the Mirror Keep: go through the mirror corridors to the back and bounce the light to every door
vadsrijk.npc.plek.baas.z2_splinterkloof: in the hidden drill hall at the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, all the way in the west
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.galmgrot: In a cave full of singing crystals lies a forgotten chest. It's humming a tune.
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.chocokelder: Under the hot cocoa café, in a hollow of pink quartz. This is where Mallow keeps his most secret cocoa.
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.burchtdak: Right on top of the Mirror Keep, between the mirrors. How did you get up here?
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.naam.burchtdak: On the Roof of the Mirror Keep
vadsrijk.z2bazen.galmwolf.onder: Whose howl makes the mountains crack
vadsrijk.z2bazen.boormeester.onder: Drills everything to bits. Even the coziness.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.te_ver: You're outside the fight: you can't hit it from there!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.galm: The Echo Wolf starts a CRYSTAL ECHO! Hide behind a frozen pillar, or interrupt him!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.beschut: The pillar catches the echo... and cracks.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.onderbroken: Interrupted! The Echo Wolf chokes on his own howl.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.roep: The Echo Wolf calls the ice: new pillars shoot up at the purple circles!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.fase2.onder: He calls up new pillars and his cubs
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.fase3.onder: A snowstorm. Listen for the echo!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.verslagen: The Echo Wolf shatters into gray shards that melt away in the snow.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.split: Lady Mirrorsigh splits into reflections! Only she has NO shadow.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.mis: Miss! That was a reflection... it strikes back.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.straal: A crystal eye is charging a mirror beam! Turn the mirrors (right-click) so it hits HER. Out of the purple line!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.verblind: The beam bounces straight into her face! Lady Mirrorsigh is blinded!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.regen: Shard rain on %s! Stand TOGETHER in the yellow circle.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.fase2.onder: Only what stands in the light casts a shadow
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.verslagen: Lady Mirrorsigh breaks into a thousand gray shards. The light in the hall turns warm and pink.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.slot: The drilling machine is locked. There's a red button with a little cheese on it... you don't know yet how to switch it on.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.koud: The armor is ice-cold and sealed. The machine is asleep.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.fout: WRONG ORDER! Steam! All drill heads cool down.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.afgekoeld: The drill heads have cooled down. The panel picks a new order...
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.smelt.onder: His armor is melting: strike now!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.mijnwerkers: Mika Miners are climbing out of the shaft!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.steenregen: Rock rain! Out of the red circles!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.fase3.onder: The machine creaks at every seam
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.cliff: Pfff! This isn't over yet! In the fort the Overdrill is waiting... and it drills through EVERYTHING! Nyeh-heh-heh!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.cliff_onder: The Mika Drill Master drives back to the fort in a cloud of smoke
vadsrijk.z2bazen.burcht.open: The crystal locks glow... the crystal gate dissolves into light!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.burcht.gang: The Splinter Hall! Dodge the red shard lanes and beat all the waves.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.burcht.gang_klaar: The Splinter Hall is quiet. The gate to the great hall opens...
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.galmwolf: Purple across the whole arena = Crystal Echo: stand BEHIND a frozen pillar (or hit him hard enough to interrupt). Each pillar only holds two echoes.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.spiegelzucht: Reflections: only she has NO shadow. Mirror beam: turn the mirrors so the purple beam hits her. Yellow = stand together!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.boormeester: Hit the drill heads until they overheat, in the order shown on the panel. Wrong order = steam!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.boormeester_paneel: Watch and listen: the panel lights up the drill heads one by one. Low = red, middle = yellow, high = blue.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.boormeester_pantser: You can't do much to the machine itself. Make the drill heads overheat in the right order: then its armor melts.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.spiegel: Right-click turns the mirror: / , \ or flat (then the light goes straight through).
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.splinterzaal: Red lanes = shards flying across the corridor. Step out before the lane fills up!
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_galmklauw.flavour.0: "Strike with this and you'll hear the mountains sing back."
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_ijspelsmantel.flavo: "Warm inside, ice-cold to anyone who touches you."
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_spiegelstaf.flavour: "Don't look into the orb too long. It looks back."
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_schaduwloze.flavour: "You never see the first shot coming."
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_boorhamer.flavour.0: "Still warm. Don't put it in your pocket."
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_boorbril.flavour.0: "With these goggles you see exactly where it hurts."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z2baas_galmklauw: every 5th hit echoes: 40 % damage to everything within 3 blocks
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z2baas_ijspelsmant: 15 % chance when you get hit: the attacker freezes for 2 s
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z2baas_spiegelstaf: critical hits bounce on to a second enemy (30 %)
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z2baas_schaduwloze: +25 % damage to a creature that's still full of chonk
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z2baas_spiegelkroo: 10 % chance: a hit bounces half back and you feel nothing (20 s cooldown)
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z2baas_boorhamer: every 3rd hit sets the target on fire for 3 s
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z2baas_stoomlaarze: below 30 % chonk: a burst of steam pushes enemies away + Quickpaws (30 s cooldown)
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z2baas_boorbril: 12 % chance on hit: 4 s Wahoog (20 s cooldown)
vadsrijk.kern.sieraad.hoe: Right-click to wear (or Shift+click in your inventory).
vadsrijk.kern.item.los_stuk: Loose piece: not part of any set.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.knuffelspro: A big leap forward (about 20 blocks). Every class can do it and you always land softly.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilltip.open_boom: Open your skill tree (K) to see what you've already learned.
vadsrijk.kern.wapen.vereist: This weapon requires %s Lv %s (you: Lv %s). You can hold it, but not attack with it yet.
vadsrijk.kern.skill.geen_wapen: No class weapon in your hand: no skills, just a weak little bop.
vadsrijk.kern.levelop.generiek: General level %s: more Chonk and Defense. Wahoog!
vadsrijk.klassen.wapen.te_duur: Not enough Chonk Coins: that costs %s.
vadsrijk.klassen.wapen.gekregen: You got a starter weapon of the %s! Attack with it to become that class.
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.tab.tip: %s (Lv %s): view this skill tree. ⚔ = your active class (the weapon you last attacked with).
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.wapen.tip: A starter weapon of the %s. You become that class as soon as you attack with it (the skills then start on cooldown).
item.guhs.vr_item_klein_vadsdrankje.uitl: Gives you back 120 Chonk. A sip of strawberry for the road.
vadsrijk.economie.drankje.wacht: Drinking takes 2 seconds. After that you have to wait 10 seconds for the next potion.
vadsrijk.npc.kamer.lichtzwamkamer: Glowshroom Chamber: watch which glowshrooms light up one after another and light them in the same order (right-click). Wrong? Then they show you again.
vadsrijk.npc.kamer.hendelkamer: Lever Chamber: the shrooms on the far wall reveal which levers must be ON, but mirrored! Set the levers right and then step on the pressure plate.
vadsrijk.npc.kamer.ridderzaal: Knights' Hall: cheer up all three waves of temple knights. Then the gate to the Overshroom opens.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.kies.kapitein: Where do you want to go? Pick a destination below or look at the travel map. (Ring the ship's bell on the pier and you get the travel map too.)
vadsrijk.npc.reis.kies.luchtschipper: Where do you want to go? Pick a destination below or look at the travel map. (Ring the ship's bell on the pier and you get the travel map too.)
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.zwamzoet: Not yet, recruit! First Camp Snuggle has to be safe. Follow Sergeant Fluffball and the camp's story (your tracker at the top right), then I'll fly you to Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.kandijkom_verhaal: Sugarbowl? I'll only fly there once this land's story is finished. Help Grandmaster Chonkfoot in Shroomsbury first.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.kandijkom_level: Brrr, the Splinter Peaks are ice cold and dangerous. Come back when you're level 20 (now level %s).
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03_poppen.klaar.3: First, go see Grandpa Stardust, right here on the training field. He'll explain the elements to you. You really need to know that before you go on an adventure!
vadsrijk.npc.gids.vastzitten.tekst: Stuck in a pit, between rocks, in the water or somewhere you can't climb out of? Press U (Unstick; also /guhs vadsrijk vast) and stand still for 3 seconds. The snuggle wind then puts you on the nearest safe spot, or at your campfire if there's no spot nearby. You can do it once a minute, but not during a boss fight. You can change the key in Options > Controls > Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.npc.kamer.z2_lichtkamer: Light Chamber: turn the mirrors with right-click (/ , \ or flat) until the light beam hits the crystal lock. Then the crystal gate opens.
vadsrijk.npc.kamer.z2_prismazaal: Prism Hall: two beams, two locks. Turn the mirrors (right-click) until BOTH locks glow at the same time.
vadsrijk.npc.kamer.z2_spiegelgang: Mirror Corridor: survive three waves of crystal critters. Red lanes = flying shards: step out before the lane fills up!
vadsrijk.npc.kamer.z2_opgelost: Solved! The crystal gate is open: go on to the next hall.
vadsrijk.npc.stap.z2_poort: %s. First get out of the Sugarbowl geode: %s.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.z2_poort_oost: through the east gate, at the end of the street past the Candy Stall
vadsrijk.npc.plek.z2_poort_west: through the west gate, at the end of the street past Warm Mittens
vadsrijk.npc.plek.z2_poort_noord: through the north gate, behind the Crystal Chapel
vadsrijk.npc.reis.kies.z2_kapitein: Back to the warm south? Pick where below or look at the travel map. (The ship's bell on the pier opens the travel map too.)
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.zwamzoet.kort: Not discovered yet. The Camp Snuggle story will bring you here.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.kandijkom_verhaal: Not discovered yet. Finish the Shroomsbury story first.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.kandijkom_level.k: Not discovered yet. From level 20 (you: level %s).
vadsrijk.npc.reiskaart.uitleg: Hold the mouse button and drag to move the map. Click a destination to fly there.
vadsrijk.economie.rijfluitje.toets: Mount key: X by default (can be changed).
vadsrijk.economie.pluimei.uitleg: Right-click: the egg hatches and the %s Plumeguh is yours!
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.nieuw_kleur: New mount: %2$s in %1$s! Pick it with N.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.wacht: Hang on, your mount arrives in %s s.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.nog_geschrokke: Your mount is still spooked... (%s s)
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.arena: Your mount is too scared to enter the arena and hops home!
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.arena_niet: Mounts are too scared to enter a boss arena.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.eigen.pluimguh: Runs like the wind with flapping little ears and jumps nice and high.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.eigen.wolkensc: Floats a little: falls very softly and can jump once more in the air!
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.eigen.slakkie: Very slow but very fancy, with its own little seat.
vadsrijk.economie.stal.nog_niet.pluimguh: Pick your first Plumeguh in a quest in the Duskroot.
vadsrijk.economie.stal.nog_niet.wolkensc: Quest from Stable Master Hoofy in Shroomsbury, or for sale at the stable (both only once you have your own Plumeguh).
vadsrijk.economie.stal.nog_niet.slakkie: For sale at the stable (a luxury mount), once you have your own Plumeguh.
vadsrijk.economie.stal.gekocht: Bought! Your new mount is waiting in your stable.
vadsrijk.economie.stal.eerst_starter: First get your own Plumeguh in the Duskroot.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdieren.uitleg: %s = hop on or hop off. You can buy more at the stable.
vadsrijk.economie.starter.vraag: Which Plumeguh will be your buddy? You can buy the other two at the stable later.
vadsrijk.economie.starter.over.roze: Sweet and fast, as pink as a plushie.
vadsrijk.economie.starter.over.mint: Fresh as a mint and always cheerful.
vadsrijk.economie.starter.over.lavendel: Dreamy and soft, smells of lavender.
vadsrijk.economie.tip.starter: Press X to hop on and off again, N for all your mounts and colors. Your Plumeguh can ride in every area of the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.economie.pluimkleur.bron.roze: One of the three starters (quest in the Duskroot), or for sale at the stable.
vadsrijk.economie.pluimkleur.bron.mint: One of the three starters (quest in the Duskroot), or for sale at the stable.
vadsrijk.economie.pluimkleur.bron.lavend: One of the three starters (quest in the Duskroot), or for sale at the stable.
vadsrijk.economie.pluimkleur.bron.honing: For sale at the stable, once you already have a Plumeguh.
vadsrijk.economie.pluimkleur.bron.wolkwi: A reward from a quest in the Duskroot.
vadsrijk.economie.pluimkleur.bron.sterre: A rare egg from a boss in the Duskroot.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.eigen.knuffelh: Soft as a plushie, with dainty little antlers. Jumps really high.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.eigen.guhwolf: A little snow wolf with a scarf. The fastest mount, but it doesn't jump very high.
vadsrijk.economie.stal.nog_niet.knuffelh: Quest: The Snuggle Deer (Sporewood). Light the lanterns and follow the deer...
vadsrijk.economie.stal.nog_niet.guhwolf: Quest: The Lost Guhwolf (Sugarbowl). A little wolf is howling in the Splinter Gorge...
vadsrijk.economie.starter.grapje: No, it's not some choco-thingy from some Fantasy game. Just look at those little ears, nyeg!
vadsrijk.economie.stal.grapje: Stable master: "A choco-what? Never heard of it. This is a Plumeguh. Just look at those little ears, nyeg!"
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_schaatser_1: on the skating pond in the middle of the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatser_1.2: Skating is just sliding really fast with style.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatser_1.3: If you fall, get up and pretend it was a trick.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_schaatser_2: on the skating pond in the middle of the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatser_2.1: A lap to the left, a lap to the right, a lap for hot cocoa.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatser_2.2: I polished the ice just yesterday. With my tummy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatser_2.3: Want to skate with me? There's plenty of room!
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_sneeuwbal_1: by the square in Sugarbowl, close to the big Christmas tree
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_1.1: Watch out! Snowball! ...Missed. On purpose, of course.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_1.2: We've got a snowball fort behind the Christmas tree.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_1.3: Want to be on our team? We always win. Sometimes.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_sneeuwbal_2: by the square in Sugarbowl, close to the big Christmas tree
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_2.1: Got you! Oh no, that was the mayor...
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_2.2: A good snowball is round, soft and a little bit pink.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_2.3: Dumpling always misses. Don't tell him I said that.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_pinguguh_1: by the big Christmas tree on the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_1.1: Waddle waddle. That's how I walk. And how I dance.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_1.2: Penguhs are never cold. Except their little feet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_1.3: That Christmas tree is pretty, but I like the baubles best. To look at.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_pinguguh_2: by the skating pond on the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_2.1: I can't fly, but I can slide really fast.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_2.2: Skating? I've got built-in skates. My tummy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_2.3: A little fish with your hot cocoa? No? Too bad.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_pinguguh_3: at the Christmas market on the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_3.1: I always wear a tuxedo. You never know when there's a party.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_3.2: Those stalls smell like warm cookies. Mmm.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_slee_1: by the stable along the road to the harbor, south of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_1.1: We're about to sled down! Wheeee!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_1.2: Papa pulls, mama brakes, and I shout wheeee.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_1.3: The best slope is behind the stable. Don't tell anyone.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_slee_2: by the stable along the road to the harbor, south of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_2.1: A sled, three guhs and a thermos of hot cocoa. That's a good day.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_2.2: Pulling is hard work, but they laugh so loud.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_2.3: Watch out for the bend by the dock!
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_marktguh_1: at the Christmas market around the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_1.1: Warm candy cookies! Two for the price of a smile!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_1.2: Everything on my stall is homemade. Except the candles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_1.3: The Christmas market isn't really open until the lanterns are lit.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_marktguh_2: at the Christmas market around the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_2.1: Scarves! Mittens! Hats with a pom-pom as big as your head!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_2.2: I knit everything myself. Even in my sleep.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_2.3: Pink looks good on everyone. That's science.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z2_marktguh_3: at the Christmas market around the square in Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_3.1: Crystal ornaments! They sing softly when you touch them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_3.2: I got them from the Echo Slopes myself. Very carefully.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_3.3: One for your tree? Or your little house?
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.0: Halt! Nyeg, don't be scared. I'm Recruiter Pennant, of the Snuggle Order. And you... you have just the right ears.
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.2: To become an adventurer! Beyond this old portal lies the Chonkdom. Creatures there turn gray and grumpy: the Chonklessness. The Order is looking for recruits to cuddle them happy again. With a pillow. Or an arrow. Or a fireball. Very lovingly.
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.3: You get a class, skills, quests, colorful loot, an airship... ...Nyeg. Why are you looking at me like that? Do you also feel like you've seen this before? Something called 'Wynn'-whatsit?
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.4: Nope. This is tooootally different. There are plushies here! And the monsters get happy instead of dead. Totally different. Really.
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.5: One more piece of advice, recruit: set your render distance to 32 chunks, and at least 20 (Options > Video Settings). The Chonkdom is built by hand, without heavy world generation. It can usually go much higher there than here in the Guhmension without stuttering. And the views! Wahoog!
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.7: Then you step through the portal. It's still asleep, but for a recruit of the Order it'll wake up. Your own things stay safe here. Tell Sergeant Fluffball that Pennant sent you!
vadsrijk.npc.werver.weer: There's my recruit again! The portal is ready. And remember your render distance: 32 chunks, at least 20!
vadsrijk.npc.werver.eerst_praten: The portal is still asleep... Talk to Recruiter Pennant first, here by the temple. He's already waving at you!
vadsrijk.npc.rijdierquest.hert.sporen.0: The third lantern glows up warmly. The whole forest goes quiet for a moment...
vadsrijk.npc.rijdierquest.hert.sporen.1: There! Tiny pink hoofprints glitter in the moss, one by one, heading west. Go on, follow them.
vadsrijk.npc.rijdierquest.hert.open_plek: The little hoofprints stop at a clearing full of lightshrooms. It's very quiet here.
Among the shrooms stands a deer, as soft as a plushie. It looks at you with big, wet eyes.
Carefully it comes closer and sniffs your hand. Then it walks along with you. Bring the news to Ranger Moss!
There, behind a block of ice at the bottom of the gorge: a teeny-tiny snow wolf pup, with a snowflake on its nose. It's shivering.
The pup crawls straight into your hood. It's as light as a little pillow and squeaks softly.
Grumpy creatures are sniffing all around you. Cheer them up, and the pup can safely come along to Knitter Woolwinter in Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.werver.1: The Snuggle Order wants you! Yes, you. With those ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.werver.2: I've been recruiting at this temple for a hundred years. You're number three.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.werver.3: The portal snores a bit. Old portals do that.
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_knuffelhert.tekst: Ranger Moss tells of a very soft deer that sometimes comes to look when the old lanterns by the lightbeams of the Sporewood are lit. Light the three lanterns and follow the glowing little hoofprints to the hidden clearing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_knuffelhert.bezig: Three lanterns by the lightbeams in the Sporewood. Then follow the glowing little hoofprints!
Light the lantern by the lightbeam in the southeast of the Sporewood
Light the lantern by the lightbeam in the middle of the Sporewood
Light the lantern by the lightbeam in the northwest of the Sporewood
Follow the glowing little hoofprints to the hidden clearing
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_knuffelhert.aanbo: Hey, you've got a mount! Then maybe you're just the right one for this little story.
By the lightbeams in the Sporewood stand three old lanterns of the Order. When they're lit, a very soft deer sometimes comes to have a look. As soft as a plushie. I call it the Snuggle Deer.
A snuggle deer? Is that really real?
Nobody has ever seen it up close. Light the three lanterns, then follow the glowing little hoofprints. Be quiet, okay? Deer don't like snoring.
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_knuffelhert.klaar: The deer walked along with you?! All the way here? Look, it's standing behind you, sniffing!
It only does that with someone it trusts completely. It wants to come with you, adventurer. Take good care of it, and give it a Root Shroom now and then.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.weergave: The Chonkdom is built by hand, without heavy world generation. Set your render distance to 32 chunks (at least 20): here that usually works without stuttering, and the views are worth it. Options > Video Settings.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.weergave.tekst: Recruiter Pennant recommends it to everyone: play the Chonkdom with a render distance of 32 chunks, and at least 20 (Options > Video Settings > Render Distance). The Chonkdom is built by hand, without heavy world generation, so your render distance can usually go a lot higher here than in the Guhmension without stuttering. Then you can see the town, the giant shrooms and the dragon from far away.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.hert_lantaarn_1: by the beam of light in the southeast of the Sporewood, southwest of Shroomsbury
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.hert_lantaarn_2: by the beam of light in the middle of the Sporewood
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.hert_lantaarn_3: by the beam of light in the northwest of the Sporewood, not far from the waterfall
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.hert_open_plek: in a hidden clearing by the western beam of light of the Sporewood
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z2_wolfje: at the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, at the foot of the second stairway down (west of the middle rope bridge)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_rijdier_guhwolf.tekst: Knitter Woolwinter hears something howling in the Splinter Gorge at night: a little snow wolf, all alone. Find it at the bottom of the gorge, cheer up the grumpy creatures around it and bring it safely to Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_rijdier_guhwolf.bezig: The little wolf is at the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, at the foot of the second staircase. Bring it here safely!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_rijdier_guhwolf.doel.0: Find the howling little wolf at the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, at the foot of the second staircase down
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_rijdier_guhwolf.doel.1: Cheer up 5 grumpy creatures in the Splinter Gorge, so the little wolf can come along safely
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_rijdier_guhwolf.aanbod: Psst. You've got a mount, right? Then you'll understand this. Hear that? At night, something howls in the Splinter Gorge.
A little snow wolf! As small as a cushion, all alone at the bottom of the gorge. I can't climb, I knit.
Lovely! Bring it back here. I'll start knitting a little scarf. A very little scarf. For now.
There he is! Come here, little one. Here, your little scarf. It looks gorgeous on you.
A few days, lots and lots of hot cocoa and three little scarves later...
Look how big he's gotten! He doesn't fit in your hood anymore. But he still wants to come with you. On his back, even!
Here, his scarf saddle. Take good care of each other, you two. And drop by now and then for a new scarf.
vadsrijk.huisdieren.geen_actief: No pet is walking with you right now.
vadsrijk.huisdieren.uitleg: Pets are there to keep you company: they walk with you through the Chonkdom. Defeat a boss for the first time and you get one!
vadsrijk.huisdieren.nieuw.chat: New pet: %s! Press %s to see your pets.
vadsrijk.huisdier.klodderreus.tekst: Once fell into the camp pond with a huge SPLASH. Now he fits in your pocket. Still a little gray, but every cuddle helps.
vadsrijk.huisdier.klodderreus.bron: Defeat the Gray Blob Giant at the camp pond of Camp Snuggle for the first time.
vadsrijk.huisdier.koning_klodder.tekst: His little crown is three sizes too big. Every morning he demands a throne and gets a cushion. He's very happy with it.
vadsrijk.huisdier.koning_klodder.bron: Defeat King Blob for the first time.
vadsrijk.huisdier.galmwolf.tekst: A crystal pup that wants to howl at the moon really loudly, but can only say 'squeak'. Glows a little in the dark.
vadsrijk.huisdier.galmwolf.bron: Defeat the Echo Wolf on the Echo Slopes for the first time.
gui.guhs.vadsrijk.roep.niet_hier: Your guhs stay cozy at home while you're off adventuring in the Chonkdom, nyeg.
vadsrijk.voltooiing.hint.uitkijk: A tall spire in %s. Climb to the top!
vadsrijk.voltooiing.hint.rijdier.knuffel: Got a mount yet? Ranger Moss knows something about the Sporewood.
vadsrijk.voltooiing.hint.rijdier.guhwolf: Got a mount yet? Something howls in Sugarbowl...
vadsrijk.voltooiing.beloning.chat: You've done everything in %s! You get the title %s and %s.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_zwamz: Do everything in The Snuggle Shrooms of the Chonkdom (Exploration Book, B).
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_de_sp: Do everything in The Splinter Peaks of the Chonkdom (Exploration Book, B).
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.al_schaapje: You already had a Cloud Lamb! Hoofy gives you your money back: %s.
vadsrijk.npc.rijdierquest.teaser.rijdier: Oh, your very own Cloud Lamb... that's only possible once you've ridden a mount before. Come back when you have your own Plumeguh, nyeg!
When the lanterns in the Sporewood are lit, a very soft deer sometimes comes to look... But it only trusts someone who has ridden a mount before. Come back when you have your own Plumeguh, nyeg!
vadsrijk.voltooiing.later.tip: You only get mounts further on in the Chonkdom. They don't count toward your percentage.
vadsrijk.voltooiing.hint.rijdier.wolkens: Got a mount yet? Stable Master Hoofy has a little chore for you.
guhs.configuration.stadsmuziek.tooltip: Sweet little tunes in Shroomsbury, Camp Snuggle, The Harbor, Sugarbowl and Honeybough (Music slider). OFF = the normal music there again.
vadsrijk.npc.rijdierquest.teaser.z2_rijd: Hear that? Somewhere in the Splinter Gorge something small is howling... But a little wolf like that only goes with someone who has ridden a mount before. Come back when you have your own Plumeguh, nyeg!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.akim_kaasguh.4: I work for nobody! Well, for my boss. And his boss. And his boss's boss... we'd rather not name that one.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.oma_truus.4: That second moon just showed up one night. It never blinks. Moons shouldn't stare, my little chonk.
item.guhs.vr_npc_mika_speldje.lore: On the back, engraved very small: a little hand with one raised pinkie.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq12_schaduw.klaar.5: Zone one is chonky again, thanks to you. The scars are already getting their color back. But this was only the beginning. Rest up a little, adventurer. The Chonkdom is big.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z08_pluis.klaar.2: And look: all the pawprints go the same way. Away from us. All of them. Scientifically speaking, very suspicious.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z15_lichtjes.klaar.1: Strange, though: I'm also measuring grayishness from a direction the dragon never flies. My meter says 'very far away'. It's probably exaggerating.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_opa_sneeuwbal.4: That winter a guh came over the peaks from very far away. Skinny as a knitting needle. He ate our pancakes for three weeks and never said a word about where he came from.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_poollicht.4: I draw constellations with guh ears. But at the far edge hangs a gray fog bank that no star can shine through. It creeps a little closer every year.
item.guhs.vr_z2_npc_drakensplinter.lore: Gray, hard and a little curved. Just like a nail clipping. From something veeery big. Ew.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq12_hartsplinter.klaa: Look to the east. See that, far, far away, behind the clouds? A tree. As big as a mountain.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.cliff2: That crystal was for the Fingers! The Emperor doesn't like to w... FORGET I SAID THAT!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.set.mika.stempel: Stamped: PROPERTY OF NEVERENOUGH. Do not nibble.
vadsrijk.npc.optie.rol.gondel: Take the gondola to the top
vadsrijk.npc.optie.rol.chocomelk: A mug of hot cocoa, please!
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_splinterling: A crystal golem of gray crystal. With every hit he shoots shards around. When defeated, he bursts apart.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_galmvleermuis: Turns invisible and can only be heard. Listen for the fluttering!
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_ijzelgeest: A floating ice spirit that makes the ground freeze. Loves to steal mittens.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_mika_mijnwerker: A Mika with a little helmet and a drill. When defeated, he flees to his fort in a puff of smoke.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_galmwolf: The Echo Wolf, world boss of the Echo Slopes. Howls crystal waves: take cover behind the frozen pillars.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_spiegelzucht: Lady Mirrorsigh, lady of the Mirror Keep. Only the reflection without a shadow is real.
vadsrijk.npc.wezen.vr_z2_boormeester: The Mika Drill Master and his machine with three drill heads. Make them overheat in the right order.
biome.guhs.vadsrijk_zeppelinwerf: The Chonkdom - The Cheese Zeppelin Yard
biome.guhs.vadsrijk_hart: The Chonkdom - The Heart of the Tree
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.adv4.klaar: ✦ Level 50! You're ready for your fourth job advancement to %s! Go to the Nest Chapel in Honeybough.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.tip.adv4: At level 50 the Nest Chapel awaits: a new title and the Nest Form of your ult (same key, much bigger).
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.veer.erbij: ✦ +%s Golden Feather! You now have %s of %s.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.veer.erbij_al: ✦ +%s Golden Feather! (%s; you already have the Golden Plumeguh, they're just nice and shiny.)
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.veer.te_weinig: You have %s of the %s Golden Feathers you need.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.veer.al_goud: You already have the Golden Plumeguh! (%s feathers, %s needed)
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.vahoeg.te_laag: Wahoog mode only unlocks at level %s.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.vahoeg.geen_zegel: You have no Wahoog Seal. The Hunterguh in Honeybough sells them for Hunt Tokens.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.bord.week: Weekly Goal: %s/%s bounties (then a Bounty Chest)
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.bord.week_klaar: Weekly Goal reached (%s/%s): your Bounty Chest is in!
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.bord.jacht_uitleg: Take a contract and the target waits at its lair. Only for you and your party.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.klaar: ✦ Bounty done: %s! Collect your reward at the Bounty Board.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.te_laag: The Bounty Board opens at level 40.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.te_laag_lv: Come back at level %s: then the Hunterguh will have bounties for you.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.geclaimd: Bounty claimed! Xp, coins and Hunt Tokens.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.al_geruild: You've already swapped today. Again tomorrow!
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.geruild: Swapped! A new bounty on the board.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.weekkist: ✦ Weekly Goal reached! There's a Bounty Chest in your bag.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.te_laag_lv: The Hunterguh only gives you contracts at level %s.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.niet_vanda: That target isn't on the board today.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.verstopt: The target is hiding today. Try again later.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.genomen: Contract taken! The target waits at its lair (check your map).
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.weg: %s ran off. You can take the contract again.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.winkel.te_weinig: You don't have enough Hunt Tokens for that.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.jacht_kruinz: Defeat %s creatures in The Canopy Sea
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.jacht_velden: Defeat %s creatures in The Root Fields
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.elite_kruin: Defeat %s elites in the canopy or on the branches
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.elite_velden: Defeat %s elites in The Root Fields
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.baas_werf: Defeat a boss of the Cheese Zeppelin Yard
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.baas_kruin: Defeat a boss in The Canopy Sea
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.baas_hart: Defeat a boss in the Heart of the Tree
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.rit_kort: Ride %s blocks on your mount through The Duskroot
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.rit_lang: Ride %s blocks on your mount through The Duskroot
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.wind: Get blown up by a wind column %s times
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.ouwe_rotke: An old rot boar that charges twice in a row.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.moeder_wes: Splits her swarm when she's at half health.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.de_harsreu: A resin golem with three rings of shockwaves.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.kapitein_k: Fires three cheeseballs in a fan.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.grootvader: Rolls across the field three times in a row.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.de_stille_: Hears you sneaking. Unleashes three shadows.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.slangenkon: Wherever she surfaces, a puddle of sap is left behind.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.bramzwijn_: A charge three wide, with bramble bushes.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.knuffelridder: New: the Nest Form of Wahoog Flomp!
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.knuffelridde: Nest Form: Wahoog Flomp becomes a pillow with wings. 30 % more damage, and the wind pulls all enemies within 8 blocks to the center (not bosses). Plus Strength, Defense and Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.pluisjager.4: New: the Nest Form of Star Shot!
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.pluisjager.4: Nest Form: Star Shot deals 40 % more damage and pierces shields: a quarter of the damage goes straight through them on top. Plus Dexterity, Crit Damage and Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.vadsmagier.4: New: the Nest Form of Meteor Guh!
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.vadsmagier.4: Nest Form: Meteor Guh leaves a pink fire field for 5 s (radius 3.5): 30 % weapon damage and Burning every second. Plus Wisdom, Element Damage and Heal Power.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_adv4.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at level 50.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_adv4.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at level 50.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_adv4.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at level 50.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_schorshuid.uitl: Below 40 % Chonk you take 15 % less damage. Tough as tree bark.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_afstijgstorm.ui: Storm Leap deals 35 % more damage and is ready 1 s sooner.
While your Snuggle Shield is up, whoever hits you gets a quarter of that hit back.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_drakenkussen.ui: Wahoog Flomp gives you and your party within 10 blocks a Snuggle Shield of 20 % of your max Chonk for 4 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_zweefschot.uitl: A shot from the air (jumping, gliding or on your mount) deals 50 % more damage. Once every 8 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_lichtpijl.uitle: Snuggle Arrow marks its target for 6 s: all damage on that target is 15 % higher, your friends' too.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_sporenzoeker.ui: 20 % more damage on creatures with a status (Burning, Spored, Sticky, Stunned or Frozen).
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_sterrenzwerm.ui: Star Shot leaves 3 afterglows: each deals 40 % weapon damage to your target.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_lantaarnvlam.ui: Pink Fireball sets its target on fire for 3 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_wortelband.uitl: Chonk Spring makes enemies within 5 blocks Sticky for 2 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_blinkspoor.uitl: After Blink, you and your party within 6 blocks heal 8 % of their max Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_meteoorzwerm.ui: Meteor Guh splits: 3 smaller impacts around your target (60 % weapon damage each, radius 2.5).
item.guhs.vr_z3_kristal_amberroze.flavou: Pink resin from the trunk. Sticky and warm. Every hit gives you back a little Chonk.
item.guhs.vr_z3_kristal_honingkristal.fl: Smells like the comb clusters of Honeybough. Your heals get sweeter (stronger).
item.guhs.vr_z3_kristal_wortelkristal.fl: Grown among the old roots. Sturdy as the tree itself: more Defense.
item.guhs.vr_z3_kristal_schemerkristal.f: Catches the light of dusk. Your skills are ready again sooner.
vadsrijk.loot.takkenknots.flavour.0: A branch of the world tree. It still grows a little when nobody's looking.
vadsrijk.loot.takkenknots.flavour.2: The tree dropped it all by itself. Honest.
vadsrijk.loot.schorshamer.flavour.0: As heavy as a piece of bark ten years old.
vadsrijk.loot.schorshamer.flavour.1: Slow. Very slow. But then: BOOM.
vadsrijk.loot.schorshamer.flavour.2: The Tree Folk built their little houses with it.
vadsrijk.loot.liaanboog.flavour.0: The string is a vine that loves to help.
vadsrijk.loot.liaanboog.flavour.1: Shoots as fast as a little squirrel runs.
vadsrijk.loot.liaanboog.flavour.2: Smells like rain in the canopy.
vadsrijk.loot.raatkruisboog.flavour.0: Built by a beekeeper guh with a plan.
vadsrijk.loot.raatkruisboog.flavour.1: The arrows are a little sticky. They're supposed to be.
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemstaf.flavour.0: Something is always blooming on it. Even in winter.
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemstaf.flavour.2: A butterfly lives in the top flower. It doesn't pay rent.
vadsrijk.loot.lantaarnstaf.flavour.0: An old lantern of the Tree Folk, still lit.
vadsrijk.loot.lantaarnstaf.flavour.1: Light in the dark, fire for whoever gets too close.
vadsrijk.loot.lantaarnstaf.flavour.2: Old Knot says he used to read by it.
item.guhs.vr_z3_gouden_veer.uitleg: Right-click: onto your Golden Feathers counter (sneaking: the whole stack). 25 feathers = the Golden Plumeguh from Stable Master Feathers.
item.guhs.vr_z3_vahoegzegel.uitleg: Place it on the Wahoog Altar by a dungeon door: the bosses turn Wahoog (lv 50, stronger, better loot and Golden Feathers).
item.guhs.vr_z3_premiekist.uitleg: Your weekly goal from the Bounty Board! Right-click: an Epic or Legendary weapon, a crystal and a Golden Feather.
item.guhs.vr_z3_reuzen_energiedrank.op: Bzzzzzzt! Your little ears are crackling!
item.guhs.vr_z3_bloesemthee.uitleg: Gives you 400 Chonk and 60 energy, and washes away Sticky and Spored.
item.guhs.vr_z3_bloesemthee.op: A sip of spring. You feel all clean again.
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.luchtschip.nog_niet: The captain peers east: I won't fly that far until the Splinter Peaks are safe again.
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.luchtschip.te_laag: The captain frowns: real monsters live in that tree. Come back at level %s.
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.opening.onder: A Tree as Big as a Mountain
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.opening.stem: He's still alive... but not for much longer.
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.opening.welkom: Welcome to Honeybough! Mmm, it smells of honey and blossom here. Beemother Combsy is waiting on Blossom Square.
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.honinglift.dicht: The Great Honey Lift isn't moving yet. Once you know the way through the trunk, it opens.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.schemerwortel_ver: That giant tree in the east? I'll only fly there once the Splinter Peaks are safe. Help Sugarbowl first.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.schemerwortel_lev: Real monsters live in that tree, recruit. Come back when you're level 30 (now level %s).
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.schemerwortel_ver: Not discovered yet. Finish the Splinter Peaks story first.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.schemerwortel_lev: Not discovered yet. From level 30 (you: level %s).
vadsrijk.z3wezens.mika.weg.0: This is going in my report!
vadsrijk.z3wezens.mika.weg.2: The Count will hear about this!
vadsrijk.z3wezens.mika.weg.3: I'll be back! With more cheese!
vadsrijk.z3wezens.set.bloesem.4: (4) Pollen: your critical hits make the creature Spored
vadsrijk.z3wezens.set.schors.4: (4) Resin Shield: when you drop below 50%% Chonk, you get a resin shield (1x per 30 s)
vadsrijk.z3wezens.set.wortel.4: (4) Rootlight: you give off light yourself in the Rootdark and deal +10%% to rot creatures
vadsrijk.z3wezens.contract.vertrokken: %s has vanished again. Take the contract again at the Hunt Board.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.cmd.spawners: %s zone 3 spawners; max alive per layer: %s
vadsrijk.z3wezens.cmd.alle: %s creatures lined up in a row.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.donker: Outside the light you only see a shadow, and your hits do only half as much. Fight in the light of your Nest Lantern or by the pink veins!
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.bladrover: A red line toward you = his grappling hook. Step out of the line, or he pulls you over to him.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.grauwe_rups: Is it curling up? Step aside! After rolling it's dizzy for a moment: that's when you do extra damage.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.bijtbloesem: Not every flower is sweet. It doesn't walk away: from a distance you're safe. Yellow cone = pollen.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.kaasschutter: The red line is where his cheese ball will go. Run up to him: up close he runs away.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.schorsmarter: They come in pairs and jump on you from above. Red circle = that's where it lands.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.grauwe_wesp: One swarm, one health bar. Hits that strike several creatures at once work best here.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.schorskruiper: That bark moved! Bark Creepers jump out of the wall when you get too close. Watch out for their web.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.lantaarnloze: Does he blow out the light? Click him to light his lantern again: then he stands still for a moment.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.harsgolem: Stay out of the red circle! If a pink crystal breaks out of its back, hit it from behind: x1.5.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.rotzwijn: Is it pawing the ground? Then it charges along the red line. Step aside and let it slam into a wall.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.wortelslang: A dust trail toward you = it's coming up underneath you. Hit it when it's above ground!
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.mika_schimmelboer: His mold fields make you Spored. Defeat him and his fields vanish with him.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.wortelschim: In the dark it sneaks up behind you. Stay in the light, then you see it and hit it properly.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.dove_ziener: He's blind but hears everything. Sneak (shift) up to him: your first hit then does double.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.schimmelbolletje: Small, but it puffs spores. Go for the mold farmer first!
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemkap.flavour.0: "Smells like spring. And a little like caterpillar."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemkap.flavour.1: "There's always a petal blowing off it."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemkap.flavour.2: "A bee thought you were a flower."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemjak.flavour.0: "Light as a leaf, tough as a twig."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemjak.flavour.1: "Picked in The Canopy Sea, ironed by a beeguh."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesembroek.flavour.0: "With pockets full of pollen. No sneezing."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemtrippers.flavour.2: "Soft enough not to wake a caterpillar."
vadsrijk.loot.schorshelm.flavour.0: "A piece of the oldest tree in the world."
vadsrijk.loot.schorshelm.flavour.1: "Someone bonks you on the head? You won't even hear it."
vadsrijk.loot.schorspantser.flavour.2: "The Tree Folk would be proud. We think."
"Sturdy as a root, bendy as a branch."
"There's a drop of resin on it. Not sticky. Usually."
vadsrijk.loot.schorslaarzen.flavour.0: "For those who want to stay put."
vadsrijk.loot.schorslaarzen.flavour.1: "Even a Rot Hog can't push you over. Almost can't."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelkroon.flavour.1: "Braided by something that has been sleeping for a very long time."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelmantel.flavour.0: "Smells of earth and a little bit of egg."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelbroek.flavour.1: "Roots find the way. Now you do too."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelbroek.flavour.2: "With a pocket for a lantern beetle."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelstappers.flavour.0: "Your feet find the ground, even in the dark."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelstappers.flavour.1: "Sneaking comes naturally. Handy near a Deaf Seer."
vadsrijk.loot.honingring.flavour.1: "A drop of honey, caught in gold."
vadsrijk.loot.honingring.flavour.2: "The bees buzz when you wear it."
vadsrijk.loot.harsketting.flavour.0: "There's a tiny pink crystal in the resin."
vadsrijk.loot.harsketting.flavour.2: "Hard as a golem, pretty as a sunset."
vadsrijk.loot.sporenoorbel.flavour.1: "A spore moth lost it. Finders keepers."
vadsrijk.z3npc.honinglift.dicht: The Honey Lift is still stuck. Beemother Combsy has the key to the lock...
vadsrijk.z3npc.honinglift.open: Somewhere below, a chain rattles. The Honey Lift between Honeybough and Mossfoot works again!
vadsrijk.z3npc.honinglift.af: All aboard! The honeycomb cabin slowly sinks down along the trunk, to Mossfoot.
vadsrijk.z3npc.honinglift.op: All aboard! The honeycomb cabin whooshes up along the trunk, to Honeybough.
vadsrijk.z3npc.thee: Here you go, a cup of honey tea. Careful, it's hot. And sweet. Very sweet.
vadsrijk.z3npc.thee.al: You just had one! Drink up first, then you get another.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.opening.onder: A tree as big as a mountain
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.schors: A wall of bark slides past the airship. It doesn't stop. It just keeps going up and up...
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.kruin: The ship breaks through the clouds. The canopy is bathed in gold.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.zwaaien: On a ring deck around the trunk, beekeeper guhs wave their veils. Honeybough!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.gekraak: Deep in the roots, two gray-blue eyes open. Something creaks: "He's still alive... but not for much longer."
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.aankomst: Welcome to Honeybough! Beemother Combsy is waiting on Blossom Square, on the south side of the ring deck.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.bam.onder: A Mika zeppelin above the market!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.bam.verstop: The guhs dart into their hive houses and shut the little hatches. Nobody gets hit!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.bam.pamflet: A flyer flutters down. And Leaf Bandits jump out of the zeppelin!
vadsrijk.z3npc.bam.aanval: Leaf Bandits on Blossom Square! Defeat them!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.nest.leeg: The nest is enormous. Gray feathers, and a few pink ones in between. In the middle: an empty egg hollow.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.nest.vroeger: You picture it: Wahoognir, still pink, landing in his nest...
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.nest.ei: ...and lays a glowing egg. He wraps his wings around it protectively.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.cape: The cape falls to pieces. Count Squeakula stands there in his undershirt: "My cape! Do you know how many winters that took?!"
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.kraak: It's getting cold. Gray mist creeps in through a knothole in the wall of the Fur Hall.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.nee: "No no no, Emperor, I can explain! It was the knight! It was..."
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.floep: Two Mikas step out of the mist. They grab the Count by his undershirt and drag him off into the mist. Poof. Gone.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.afdruk: Silence. A gray, cold frost stain stays behind on the bark. As big as a door.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.piepje: Squeaky crawls out of your bag and nudges something shiny toward you: the pin from the cape.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.ei.onder: Warm, pink, and it has a heartbeat
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.ei.warm: You pick up the egg. It's warm. The little heartbeat speeds up for a moment.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.rit.onder: Out of the Root Tunnel and up the bridle path
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.rit.schudt: The tree is shaking! Branches fall, bark tears. Wahoognir crashes through the canopy!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.rit.zweef: Round and round the trunk, past Honeybough, through the leaf tunnel. The dragon skims along the bark!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.rit.nest: The wind columns blow you upward, canopy after canopy. The old nest! You lay the egg in the egg hollow. Then he lands: enormous, gray, crackling with black fluff.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.splinters: You hold up the last splinter. All five float together into one pink heart crystal, and slide into his chest.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.roze: The black fluff blows off him like dandelion seeds. Fluffy wings, guh ears, pink. He's himself again.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.ei: Wahoognir curls his head around the nest. A dragon egg only hatches when the parent can keep it warm...
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.nies: Crack! Out rolls a teeny tiny pink dragon. It sneezes right away.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.giechel: Wahoognir giggles. A giggling dragon makes the whole canopy shake.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.schouder: The little dragon sees you first, and climbs onto your shoulder. Wahoogie!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.straal: Wahoognir blows a long pink beam of light across the horizon, to the east. Where it ends, a city floats above the clouds.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.weg: He looks at you, bows his head, and flies off after the beam.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.cliff.oosten: Far in the east, where the pink beam ended, a city floats above the clouds. Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f2.onder: Far in the east, something wants more and more.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f2.oosten: Even further east, beyond Highchonk, lies a pink land. A single gray tower rises there, and someone is snuffing out the stars.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f2.zaal: Somewhere far away. A gray hall, thin light. Count Squeakula kneels in his undershirt, shivering.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f2.krabbel_1: A teeny tiny Mika with a way-too-big quill pen reads aloud: "Report from the west."
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f2.tik: From the shadow behind the throne comes impatient tapping on an armrest. Tap. Tap. Tap. Tap. Tap. Against the light: a little crown, much too small.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f2.stem: A slow voice: "Then... I... reach... further."
vadsrijk.z3npc.zone3.klaar: The dragon is pink again and the egg has hatched! The Duskroot blooms again. (Highchonk is coming soon.)
vadsrijk.z3npc.vlek.schoon: Your Plumeguh shakes blossoms out of its plume. The gray patch turns green and pink again!
vadsrijk.z3npc.piepje.0: Between the combs sits a skinny little squeak-squeak mouse. It has lost its winter fur, and it's shivering.
vadsrijk.z3npc.piepje.1: Squeak... the Count... the cold... squeak.
vadsrijk.z3npc.piepje.2: The little mouse crawls into your bag, curls up and falls asleep. It doesn't want to leave.
vadsrijk.z3npc.ring.aan: Ring %s of the Lantern Tower is lit! The little cage springs open and the mice scurry down, squeaking.
vadsrijk.z3npc.nestlantaarn.0: Halfway there, knight. Here, take this. The Nest Lantern of the Tree Folk.
vadsrijk.z3npc.nestlantaarn.1: Under the floor it's pitch dark. In the light of this lantern, nothing can hide. Not even a count.
vadsrijk.z3npc.ketel.uit: You close the mold tap. The kettle hisses, sputters and goes quiet. The valley gets a little of its color back.
vadsrijk.z3npc.duister.klopje: Beneath the beat of the heart you hear something else. A second little beat. Softer. Faster. The egg is still alive!
vadsrijk.z3npc.vahoegnir.zonder: Wahoognir lands by the nest, gray and crackling. You hold up the splinters...
vadsrijk.z3npc.vingerafdruk: A gray frost stain in the bark, as big as a door. Cold, and it smells of nothing. Professor Fluff would want to stare at this for a week.
vadsrijk.z3npc.splinter.nest: It lay among the branches of his old nest, next to his egg.
vadsrijk.z3npc.splinter.werf: In a little box with a bow: 'For the Count, for his collection.'
vadsrijk.z3npc.splinter.cape: The pin from Count Squeakula's cape. The biggest splinter so far.
vadsrijk.z3npc.splinter.wachter: "I kept this warm for him. The little heart of his heart."
vadsrijk.z3npc.kuiken.gevonden: Plume chick found! It squeaks happily. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z3npc.lichtje.gevonden: A Tree Folk light wakes up and blinks at you. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.teller: Beekeeper clues found: %s of %s. Comb Weaver Waxy will surely want to know!
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.alle: All five clues point to the hatch at the bottom of the Comb Clusters. The hatch is ajar!
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.alle: Together, all eight reliefs tell the story of the nest and the egg. The Tree Folk knew everything. And the last relief... that mist, all the way from the east.
vadsrijk.huisdier.vahoegje.tekst: The baby dragon from the egg. Sneezes pink sparkles and thinks you're its mommy.
vadsrijk.huisdier.vahoegje.bron: Cheer up Wahoognir in the old nest
vadsrijk.voltooiing.hint.rijdier.pluimgu: With Stable Master Feathers in the Plume Stable, on the ground at the north side of the tree.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_de_sc: Fully explore The Duskroot (Exploration Book, key B).
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z3_knuff: hidden in The Duskroot: in the crown, on the branches, in the trunk and among the roots (hearts)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z3_aanwi: in Honeybough: by the Blossom Square, on the gangplanks of the branches and in the Comb Clusters (purple sparkles)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z3_schat: in secret spots in The Duskroot
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z3_kuike: on crown 1, by the honey ponds (pink fluff)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z3_licht: along the inner stairs in the trunk, just above Honeybough, at different heights (green glow)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.z3_luchtschip: by Captain Buzzsail, at Honeybough's airship mast
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_kapitein: at the airship mast at the end of Beekeepers' Lane, the gangplank in the northwest of Honeybough, where the airship docks
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kapitein.1: My balloon is striped. Just like my sweater. Just like my socks. I love stripes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kapitein.2: Back to The Harbor or to Sugarbowl? Grab the travel map, I fly everywhere. Except into the tree.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kapitein.3: I once had a bee as my co-pilot. He only wanted to go to flowers. Very snug flights, those were.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_raatje: on the Blossom Square (the Honey Square) on the south side of the ring deck of Honeybough, by the plushie statue of the beekeeper guh
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatje.1: Welcome to Honeybough, sweetie. A little town on a branch, and the branch on a tree as big as a mountain.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatje.2: I'm the mayor, the beekeeper and everyone's grandma here. Mostly grandma.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatje.3: Honey, blossoms and a warm blanket. That's all a guh needs. Well, plushies too.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_wasja: in the Nest Chapel, the big honeycomb cell under the north side of the ring deck of Honeybough (take the chapel lift on the north side down)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wasja.1: This is the Nest Chapel, the Snuggle Order's branch office in the tree. Here you can change class.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wasja.2: Long ago the Order put an egg pedestal here. Empty. Nobody remembers what for.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wasja.3: Bees dance to show the way. I dance to stay warm. Everyone has their reasons.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_veertje: in the Plume Stable on the ground on the north side of the tree, at the start of the riding path (take the lift in the inner courtyard of the trunk to the Barkton floor and go out through the north gate)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_veertje.1: Brushing a Plumeguh is the best job in the world. After feeding Plumeguhs. And cuddling Plumeguhs.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_veertje.2: You ride with your knees, your heart and a bag of Honey Bites.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_veertje.3: Hear that trampling? That's the practice track. Or my tummy. It's almost lunchtime.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_cafe: in cafe The Sweet Comb, the honeycomb cell under the west side of the ring deck of Honeybough (the cafe lift goes down)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_cafe.1: Welcome to The Sweet Comb! Honey tea, honey cake and honey ice cream. And for the daring: honey with honey.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_cafe.2: In the evenings there's dancing here. On the tables. Don't tell my wife.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_cafe.3: A cup of honey tea? That'll warm your little ears.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_jager: in the Hunters' Hut on the northeast side of the ring deck of Honeybough, by the Bounty Board
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_jager.1: New jobs go up on the bounty board every day. Monsters, mold, deliveries. Take whatever you like.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_jager.2: I don't hunt guhs, you know. Only the things that make the tree sick.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_jager.3: A bounty a day keeps the mold away. And the boredom.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_smid: in the smithy on the southwest side of the ring deck of Honeybough, close to the Blossom Square
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_smid.1: My fire burns on beeswax. Smells lovely and glows pink.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_smid.2: Stars on, frays off. Everything gets sturdy again here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_smid.3: The only day I don't forge is Sunday. Then I bake waffles.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_juwelier: in the jewelry shop on the west side of the ring deck of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_juwelier.1: Amber rose, honey crystal, root crystal... the tree is full of pretty stones.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_juwelier.2: A socket in your gear? I'll set a crystal in it in no time. Click, done.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_juwelier.3: Resin is a tree's memory. That's why it sparkles so.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_winkel: in the potion shop on the west side of the ring deck of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_winkel.1: Potions, bandages and honey drops! Everything for the road.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_winkel.2: A potion with a honey rim works twice as well. Says my grandma. My grandma is Combsy.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_wapens: in the gear shop on the northwest side of the ring deck of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wapens.1: Branch clubs, vine bows, blossom staves. All picked from the tree. With permission!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wapens.2: Pointy as a bee's stinger. But nice.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wapens.3: Choose your weapon with your heart. And with your class.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_kleermaker: in the shop on the north side of the ring deck of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kleermaker.1: A beekeeper's hat with a veil? Suits everyone. Even Plumeguhs.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kleermaker.2: I sew everything with silk thread from the caterpillars here. They love to help.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kleermaker.3: Stripes are slimming. That's why the whole town wears stripes. Kidding. It's just cozy.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_markt: at the buzzing market on the Blossom Square, on the south side of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_markt.1: Buy, sell, swap! The buzzing market is always open.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_markt.2: Today's special: nothing. Tomorrow too. Have a look between the stalls yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_markt.3: Here you can swap anything with other adventurers. Fair is fair, says the bee.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_stalguh: in the Plume Stable on the ground on the north side of the tree, by the hayloft
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_stalguh.1: Saddles, colors and feed. See what your Plumeguh likes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_stalguh.2: I tidy the stable. Every day. Plumeguhs lose a lot of feathers. A whole lot.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_stalguh.3: When a Plumeguh sneezes, it leaves a cloud of down behind. I love this job.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_liftguh: at the top station of the Honey Lift, at the end of the Lift Bough in the southeast of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_liftguh.1: The Honey Lift goes all the way down to Mossfoot. Two chains, one honeycomb cabin, lots of courage.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_liftguh.2: Don't look down. Or do. The view is gorgeous.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_liftguh.3: I've been turning this crank for thirty years. My left arm is very strong.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_opa_bast: by the plushie statue on the Blossom Square of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_opa_bast.1: When I was young, I climbed the inner stairs to the nest every day. Now I climb to my chair every day.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_opa_bast.2: Long ago a dragon sang in the canopy. Very softly. You could only hear it if you were quiet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_opa_bast.3: My bees are all called Bea. Makes calling them easy.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_zoemer: on the Blossom Square of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_zoemer.1: I have little wings! They don't do anything, but they ARE very pretty.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_zoemer.2: Buzz buzz! I'm a bee! A big bee! With little ears!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_zoemer.3: Do you know where the queen bee lives? I'm never allowed to go there.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_honingbij: on the Blossom Square of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_honingbij.1: I'm not a bee, you know. I just have little antennae. On my head. Made of fabric.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_honingbij.2: The bees of Honeybough are the sweetest in the whole realm. They never sting. They cuddle.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_honingbij.3: Want to see a bee dance? Look: circle, wiggle, circle. That means: there's cake over there.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_raatwever: by the little houses on the branches of Honeybough, west of the Blossom Square
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatwever.1: I build the combs for the houses. Little hexagons, all day long. I even dream in hexagons.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatwever.2: There's a beekeeper's suit on the clothesline that nobody recognizes. Weird, huh?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatwever.3: A hexagon is the strongest shape. And the coziest.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_bloesem: by the little blossom tree on the Blossom Square of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bloesem.1: The little blossom tree on the square grows right out of the deck. Isn't that lovely?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bloesem.2: When the wind blows, it rains petals here. Then I dance.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bloesem.3: Take a sniff. That's spring. Spring every day.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_druppel: in cafe The Sweet Comb, the honeycomb cell under the west side of the ring deck of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_druppel.1: Tonight we're dancing at The Sweet Comb! Are you coming?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_druppel.2: A honey drop falls very slowly. That's how I dance too. Very slowly. And sticky.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_druppel.3: I once danced with a Plumeguh. He stepped on my toe. Both my toes.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_lampion: by the little houses on the branches of Honeybough, west of the Blossom Square
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lampion.1: Every evening I light all the lanterns. All two hundred and twenty-seven of them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lampion.2: When the glow beetles come, I barely have to do a thing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lampion.3: Light keeps the grayness away. Everybody here knows that.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_imker_1: by the little hive houses on the southeast side of the ring deck of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_1.1: My bees sing in the morning. I sing along. The neighbors find it... special.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_1.2: Harvesting honey takes patience. And a veil. Mostly a veil.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_1.3: Hear that? That's what a happy hive sounds like.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_imker_2: by the little hive houses on the north side of the ring deck of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_2.1: Since the Mika zeppelins started coming, the queen bee doesn't sing anymore. I'm worried.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_2.2: Gray honey! In my hive! Who would do such a thing?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_2.3: A beekeeper without bees is like a tree without leaves. Very bare.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_imker_3: by the little hive houses on the northwest side of the ring deck of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_3.1: I once found a honeycomb as big as a door. Now I live in it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_3.2: Did you know bees can count? Up to four. Then they start over.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_3.3: A good beekeeper always has a sweetie in his pocket. For the bees. And for himself.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_kuikenhoeder: by the practice track of the Plume Stable, on the ground on the north side of the tree
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kuikenhoeder.1: Plume Chicks are sooo cute. And sooo quick to wander off. Where are they now?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kuikenhoeder.2: A Plume Chick follows anything that moves. Especially mounts.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kuikenhoeder.3: When they grow up, you can ride them. Right now they fit in a teacup.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_kind_1: on the Blossom Square of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_1.1: I have the same name as Grandma! But smaller.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_1.2: When I grow up I'll be a Plumeguh rider. Or a dragon. A dragon is fine too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_1.3: Do you have a mount? Can I pet it?
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_kind_2: on the Blossom Square of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_2.1: I'm from Mossfoot! Everything there is made of roots. Here everything is made of honey. I don't know which is tastier.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_2.2: My little wings are made of paper. But shhh.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_2.3: I'm not scared of the Mikas. Only a little bit.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_postguh: on the Blossom Square of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_postguh.1: Delivering mail in a tree is tricky. Everything is above, below or behind.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_postguh.2: I have a letter for someone called 'The Little Finger'. No idea who that is. It's still in my bag.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_bladwachter: at the campfire on the east side of crown 1, the lowest crown floor (the Mika Zeppelin Pier is in the northeast)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bladwachter.1: The Canopy Sea is beautiful, but since the zeppelins came, it's gone gray in places.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bladwachter.2: Light my campfire. This is where you'll wake up if things go wrong.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bladwachter.3: At the very top of the tree, above the three canopies, lies something huge. A nest.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_lusje: in Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village on the Bee Bough, the giant branch in the southeast (ride up the riding path to above Honeybough and ride onto the bough)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lusje.1: Drawing maps of a tree is hard. Everything goes round. And up. And down.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lusje.2: Buzzrest sits on the Bee Bough. High, wobbly and full of bees. You get used to it. After three weeks or so.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lusje.3: My tea's gone cold again. Must be the fright. Or me. I always forget it.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_herbergier: in the inn of Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village, on the Bee Bough in the southeast
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_herbergier.1: Welcome to the inn of Buzzrest! Beds of moss, soup of blossoms.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_herbergier.2: The floor wobbles here. It's supposed to. We live on a branch.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_herbergier.3: I've got potions and bandages too. A beekeepers' village on a branch has to stock everything.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_knoest: in a little house in the wall of the hollow trunk, halfway up the inner stairs of Barkton (the stair door on the Blossom Square)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_knoest.1: ...I am the last little light of the Tree Folk. The others sleep in the wood.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_knoest.2: We built this town inside the trunk. Little houses in the wall, along the stairs, all the way around. Long ago.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_knoest.3: Light is warmth. Warmth is life. It's that simple. It used to be.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_wortelien: in Mossfoot, the hamlet on the ground by the bottom station of the Honey Lift, in the southeast (take the Honey Lift down)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wortelien.1: Welcome to Mossfoot! We live at the bottom of the tree, between the roots. Nice and cozy, and always cool.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wortelien.2: Our waterwheel runs on sap. It smells like maple syrup. Everyone here is always hungry.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wortelien.3: The roots are rotting. We notice it in everything. Even the soup tastes gray.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_molenaar: by the water wheel of Mossfoot, on the ground in the southeast (near the Honey Lift)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_molenaar.1: My waterwheel runs on tree sap. Slowly, but it turns.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_molenaar.2: When the mold comes, it gets stuck. Then I push. Hard.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_molenaar.3: A little spin is good for everyone. Even for a wheel.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_theeguh: in the teahouse of Mossfoot, on the ground in the southeast (near the Honey Lift)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_theeguh.1: Honey tea with marsh flowers. That gives you speedy little paws!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_theeguh.2: I'm a frog guh. I like living near the water. And near the tea.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_gloei: at the campfire in the Heartbeat Hall, the root hall under the trunk (through the Root Gate in the east and down the Root Tunnel)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_gloei.1: It's dark down here. Stay in the light, then the monsters hurt less.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_gloei.2: Hear that? That thumping? That's the heart of the tree.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_gloei.3: My little lamp is my best friend. After my mom.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_nestwachter: by the root basket with the egg, in the middle of the root hall under the trunk (after the Heart of the Tree)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_nestwachter.1: ...I kept the egg warm. For a very long time. I'd almost forgotten why.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_nestwachter.2: The Tree Folk carried the egg down. I stayed. Someone had to stay.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_nestwachter.3: Now I'm pink again. That feels... nice. Thank you.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_wacht_plein_1: on the west side of the Blossom Square of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wacht_plein_1.1: Light the campfire: this is where you wake up if you faint. Warm, safe, and you lose nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wacht_plein_1.2: The Honey Guard protects the routes through the tree. With spears of reed and lots and lots of honey cake.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wacht_plein_1.3: Out there are real monsters, adventurer. Not guhs. Be brave, and come back before dark.
