vadsrijk.npc.plek.baas.z3_hart: in the Heart of the Tree, behind the gate in the west wall of the root hall
vadsrijk.npc.plek.baas.z3_kruintop: at the old nest at the very top of the tree
vadsrijk.npc.plek.baas.z3_kale_kruin: on the Bald Crown, on the west side of crown 1
item.guhs.vr_z3_npc_boomvolkkaart: Tree Folk Map of the Tribe
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.titel: A Tree as Big as a Mountain
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.tekst: Order Master Crystalline saw it in the east: a tree as big as a mountain. Captain Polaris in Sugarbowl flies there now: to Honeybough, a beekeepers' town that hangs like a ring around that tree's trunk. Beemother Combsy is waiting there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.bezig: Board the airship to Honeybough. Beemother Combsy is waiting on Blossom Square.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.doel.0: Fly with Captain Polaris from Sugarbowl to Honeybough (pick Honeybough at the airship pier)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.doel.1: Talk to Beemother Combsy on Blossom Square, on the south side of Honeybough's ring deck (walk from the mast along Beekeepers' Lane and the ring deck around the trunk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.aanbod.0: Adventurer! Crystalline told me. A tree, she says. In the east. As big as a mountain.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.aanbod.1: I've been flying there since this morning. Halfway up the trunk, a little town hangs around it like a ring: Honeybough. Full of beekeepers and bees.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.aanbod.3: Yep. Don't look down. Hop in, it's a long flight. And it goes up. Very, very up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.klaar.0: There you are, sweetie! What a flight, huh? Everyone always looks so amazed the first time they see the tree.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.klaar.1: I'm Combsy. Mayor, beekeeper and everybody's granny around here. Welcome to Honeybough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.klaar.2: In the roots... I saw two eyes. Grayish blue. And I heard something creak.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.klaar.3: Eyes? In the roots? Brrr. Order Master Waxie needs to hear this. She's in the Nest Chapel, the big honeycomb cell under the north side of the ring deck. Take the chapel lift down.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.tekst: Order Master Waxie of the Nest Chapel thinks this tree was once Wahoognir's nest. But then a Mika zeppelin buzzes over the market. Defeat the Leaf Bandits it drops on Blossom Square.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.bezig: The Leaf Bandits on Blossom Square! And then check on Beemother Combsy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.doel.0: Defeat 8 Leaf Bandits dropped by the Mika zeppelin on Honeybough's Blossom Square (chapel lift up, then along the ring deck to the south side)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.doel.1: Check that Beemother Combsy on Blossom Square is all right
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.aanbod.0: An adventurer of the Order! Welcome to the Nest Chapel. See that empty egg pedestal over there? Nobody remembers what it's for.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.aanbod.1: But I have a hunch. This tree... the branches, the feathers in the canopy... I think this was once Wahoognir's nest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.aanbod.3: Shh. Do you hear that? A propeller. That's no bee. That's... a ZEPPELIN! Up, quick, to the square!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.klaar.0: Everyone's safe. The guhs were all in their hive houses with the little shutters closed. Nobody got hurt.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.klaar.1: But look what the zeppelin dropped. A leaflet. 'Operation Ripe Cheese. By order of Baron Bleu, on behalf of His Poshness Count Squeakula.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.klaar.3: A count? Mikas with titles? That's new. And not good news.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.klaar.4: What you need now is a mount. This tree is too big to walk. Stable Master Feathers has her Plume Stable down on the ground, on the north side, where the riding path begins.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.tekst: Stable Master Feathers has three young Plumeguhs. Pick one, give it a name, and take your first ride: Feathers rides ahead of you up the riding path, round and round the trunk, to the top of canopy 1. Jump off the glide platform there: your first Plume Glide.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.bezig: Pick your Plumeguh, follow Feathers up the riding path to the top of canopy 1, and glide down from the glide platform.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.doel.0: Pick your own Plumeguh with Stable Master Feathers in the Plume Stable (on the ground on the north side of the tree)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.doel.1: Call your Plumeguh (key X) and climb on, at the Plume Stable
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.doel.2: Follow Stable Master Feathers up the riding path: around the trunk, past Blossom Square and through the leaf tunnel to the top of canopy 1
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.doel.3: Ride to the glide platform on the south edge of canopy 1, jump off and glide down (hold jump)
A knight without a mount in a tree this size? You'd be walking until next spring.
Look, there in the stall. Three young Plumeguhs. Pink, mint and lavender. Long legs, fluffy little body, a plume tail.
Wait a minute... big yellow birds you ride on... that rings a bell...
No, it is NOT some choco-whatsit from some Fantasy game. This is a Plumeguh. Just look at the little ears, nyeg!
Go ahead and blow the Stable Whistle. All three will come running and show you what they can do. Pick one. Then we'll ride up the riding path together. I lead, you follow.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.klaar.0: Did you see that? You and your Plumeguh, through the air! Your first Plume Glide!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.klaar.1: You can always glide from up high. Only downward, mind you. Going up is for the riding path, the stairs, the lifts and the blossom wind.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.klaar.2: Did you see those gray patches in the canopy? Those are from the zeppelins. Canopy Warden Leaf needs help. He's at his campfire on the east side of canopy 1.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.tekst: Mika zeppelins have sprayed the Canopy Sea gray. Ride past the three gray patches on canopy 1 and canopy 2 and clean them up, defeat the creatures in the canopy and check the Mika Zeppelin Pier to see what they're up to. Canopy Warden Leaf is waiting at his campfire.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.bezig: Three gray patches, twelve creatures, and a peek at the zeppelin pier. Then on to Canopy Warden Leaf.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.doel.0: Clean up the first gray patch, on the southeast side of canopy 1
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.doel.1: Clean up the second gray patch, on canopy 2 on the southwest side (up the wind column)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.doel.2: Clean up the third gray patch, on the north side of canopy 1
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.doel.3: Defeat 12 creatures in the Canopy Sea
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.doel.4: Search the Mika Zeppelin Pier on the northeast edge of canopy 1 for their plans
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.aanbod.0: Canopy Warden Leaf guards the Canopy Sea. He's at his campfire on the east side of canopy 1, not far from the Mika Zeppelin Pier.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.aanbod.1: Clean up the gray patches on the way. You only have to ride past them: your Plumeguh shakes blossoms out of its plume. Really. That's what it was bred for. You get to canopy 2 with the pink wind column.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.klaar.0: You cleaned up the canopy! The leaves are already turning green again. What did you find at the pier?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.klaar.1: An order. 'Find the egg. Let it ripen. Bring it to the Count. The Count brings it to Him.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.klaar.2: Him? With a capital letter? Who's that, then?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.klaar.4: An egg... All the way at the top of the tree, above canopy 3, there's an old nest. Enormous. I never dare go near it. You do, I think.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.tekst: All the way at the top of the tree, above the three canopy levels, lies a gigantic old nest. Go there and see what's left of it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.bezig: To the old nest at the top of the tree. Then back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.doel.0: Go to the old nest at the top of the tree: the pink wind columns blow you from canopy 1 to canopy 2 and 3 (or take the inner stairs all the way up)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.doel.2: Find the glowing pink thing among the branches of the nest
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.aanbod.0: See those pink columns with swirling blossoms? Those are wind columns. Step in and you float up to the next canopy. Three times, and you're at the nest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.aanbod.1: Watch out for the Canopy Raptor. It sits on the Bald Crown, the dead treetop on the west side of canopy 1. Just leave it alone if you don't want a fight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.klaar.0: A heart splinter. Pink, warm... just like the splinter you found in the Splinter Peaks.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.klaar.1: He came back here. Wounded. He left a piece of his heart with his egg.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.klaar.2: And there were drag marks to the edge. And tiny wooden footprints.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.klaar.3: Wooden feet? Then it wasn't the Mikas. Someone carried that egg away long ago. I need to think. And so does Combsy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.tekst: The little wooden footprints in the nest belong to the tree folk, the old residents of the trunk. Ask Beemother Combsy what she knows. And something is squeaking in the Comb Clusters.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.bezig: First Beemother Combsy, and then that squeaking in the Comb Clusters.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.doel.0: Ask Beemother Combsy on Blossom Square about the tree folk
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.doel.1: Find out what's squeaking in the Comb Clusters, the honeycomb cell under the east side of the ring deck (take the Comb Cluster lift down)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.aanbod.0: Combsy is the oldest in town. If anyone knows something about the tree folk, it's her.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.aanbod.1: And do you hear that? Something's been squeaking in the Comb Clusters all morning. Could you take a look?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.klaar.0: A squeaky-squeak mousie! Totally bald! And so cold... come here, little one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.klaar.1: All he said was 'the Count... the cold...'. He comes from somewhere below us. From the dark.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.klaar.2: Below us? The tree folk used to live in the trunk. Their old map is with Mapmaker Loopy, in Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village, on the Bee Bough in the southeast.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.klaar.3: Take the mousie with you. It won't come out of your bag anymore. I think it trusts you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.praat.z3_: Wooden feet? Oh, the tree folk. My granny used to tell me about them. Little wooden critters with lights in their heads.
They built a city in the trunk, she said. With lanterns, along a staircase that went all the way up to the nest. Then it went quiet, and the lanterns went out.
They had a map of the whole trunk. Loopy has it now, in Buzzrest. I think. I hope.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.tekst: Mapmaker Loopy lives in Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village, on the Bee Bough in the southeast. Ride up the riding path and onto the bough, and help the village: Mika Cheese Shooters have built three posts on the giant boughs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.bezig: To Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village on the Bee Bough, help Loopy, and clear out the three Cheese Shooter Posts.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.0: Ride to Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village: up the riding path to just above Honeybough, and onto the Bee Bough on the southeast side
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.1: Talk to Mapmaker Loopy in Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.2: Clear out the first Cheese Shooter Post, on the West Bough
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.3: Clear out the second Cheese Shooter Post, on the North Bough on the east side of the tree
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.4: Clear out the third Cheese Shooter Post, on the Southwest Bough
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.5: Defeat 12 creatures or Mikas on the Branchways
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.aanbod.0: The riding path runs past the foot of every giant bough. Where a bough begins, you can ride right onto it. Buzzrest is on the Bee Bough, in the southeast.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.aanbod.1: Don't be scared on the boughs. Anywhere you can fall, you can glide. And your Plumeguh is very good at not-falling.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.klaar.0: The posts are gone! And my tea is warm again. Well, lukewarm. It's a start.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.klaar.1: The Tree Folk Map... the Mikas took it. To their yard. The Cheese Zeppelin Yard, on the island in the northeast. You get there over the cable bridge, from the northeast edge of Honeybough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.klaar.2: I saw them go. With the map in a cheese crate. Laughing the whole way. Very rude.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.praat.z3: A visitor! Careful, the bough wobbles. I'm Loopy. I draw maps. Of everything. Even of things that spin around.
The Tree Folk Map? Oh dear... The Mikas came by. Nobody got hurt, don't worry. But my tea went cold from the fright.
They built three Cheese Shooter Posts on the boughs. Help the village first, will you? Then I'll tell you everything.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.tekst: The Cheese Zeppelin Yard lies on its own island in the northeast: a Mika Shipyard with three docks, each with a half-built cheese zeppelin. Cross the cable bridge, defeat Rigging Master Taleggio, Bombardier Crumble and Captain Roquefort, and search the captain's cabin for the Tree Folk Map.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.bezig: The Cheese Zeppelin Yard: over the cable bridge, three docks, three bosses, and then the captain's cabin.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.doel.0: Defeat Rigging Master Taleggio at Dock 1, on the ground of the yard (over the cable bridge from Honeybough)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.doel.1: Defeat Bombardier Crumble on Dock 2, on top of the scaffold tower (turn the cannons!)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.doel.2: Defeat Captain Roquefort on Dock 3, on top of the tall mast tower
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.doel.3: Search Captain Roquefort's cabin on Dock 3
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.aanbod.0: The cable bridge starts at the northeast edge of Honeybough. You can already see the cranes from here. And smell the cheese.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.aanbod.1: Go with friends if you can. Three Mika bosses, on three docks, each one higher than the last. Even for a hero with a Plumeguh, that's a lot.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.klaar.0: You've got the map! And what's that... a little box with a bow on it?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.klaar.1: 'For the Count, for his collection.' There was a heart splinter inside. And a letter from Baron Bleu.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.klaar.2: Will you read it out loud?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.klaar.3: 'My mold turns the egg gray. A gray dragon, all our own. He will be pleased, Your Poshness. Finally one thing He finds full.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.klaar.4: ...Full? Who never finds anything full? Brrr. Look, the map. Inside the trunk runs a staircase, from the ground all the way to the nest. The door is on Blossom Square. And halfway down Barkton, someone drew a little light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.tekst: The Tree Folk Map shows the way in: the stair door on Blossom Square. Behind it, the inner stairs spiral down through the hollow trunk, past the tree folk's little houses in the wall: Barkton. Halfway down, the map shows a little light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.bezig: Through the stair door on Blossom Square, down the inner stairs, and then find the little light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.doel.0: Go through the stair door in the trunk wall on Honeybough's Blossom Square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.doel.1: Go down the inner stairs and find the little light in a little house in the trunk wall, halfway down Barkton
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.aanbod.0: See that door in the trunk, on the square? I always thought it was a broom closet. According to the map, it's a staircase.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.aanbod.1: Halfway down there's a little drawing of a light. With a little face. It's winking. Weird, for a map.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.klaar.0: ...You can see me. Nobody has seen me in so long. I'm Knot. The last little light of the tree folk.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.klaar.1: The lanterns have been out ever since the Count moved in under our floor. He likes the dark. And the cold. That makes the little furs fall out faster.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.klaar.3: Look, there. The Lantern Tower, in the middle of the trunk. Seven rings. Once they burn again, he'll have nowhere left to hide.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.tekst: In the middle of Barkton stands the Lantern Tower. Light the seven rings, from bottom to top: on every ring, little mice sit in a cage. Under the floor of Barkton, in the Fur Hall, sits Count Squeakula, the Emperor's Little Finger, in a cape made of mouse furs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.bezig: Seven rings, from bottom to top. And then down the stairs to the Fur Hall.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.doel.0: Light the 7 rings of the Lantern Tower, from bottom to top (stand on the inner stairs next to each ring lantern)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.doel.1: Defeat Count Squeakula in the Fur Hall, under the floor of Barkton (break the cage locks, relight the lanterns)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.doel.2: See what happens in the Fur Hall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.doel.3: Pick up the cape pin, by the throne in the Fur Hall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.aanbod.0: See the tower? It stands in the middle of the trunk, from the floor up to Honeybough's inner courtyard. Seven rings. Seven lanterns.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.aanbod.1: On every ring, the Count has put little mice in a cage. In the cold. Until their little fur falls out. For his cape.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.aanbod.3: Light the ring lanterns from the stairs. Then the little locks will spring open. Halfway, I'll give you something, because under the floor it's pitch dark.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.aanbod.4: And under the floor... that's where he sits. Count Squeakula. The Emperor's Little Finger. The stairs to his Fur Hall start on the floor.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.klaar.0: ...The lanterns. All of them. The whole trunk is glowing again. I haven't seen it like this since... I don't even remember anymore.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.klaar.1: That fog... I know it from old stories. It is his grabby power. It reaches far. Always farther. He takes everything that is warm.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.klaar.2: I'll tell you what happened to the egg. The tree folk carried it down when the dragon turned gray. The heart of the tree would keep it warm until he was himself again.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.klaar.3: We went to sleep in the wood. The egg stayed awake.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.klaar.4: Go to Order Master Waxie. Tell her everything. The lift in the inner courtyard takes you straight up to Honeybough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.tekst: In Mossfoot, the hamlet at the foot of the tree, the roots are rotting away: the Mikas put mold kettles in the Root Fields. Talk to Mayor Rootina and shut off the two kettles. The freed little mice squeak the way.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.bezig: Take the Honey Lift to Mossfoot, see Mayor Rootina, and then shut off the two mold kettles.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.doel.0: Talk to Mayor Rootina in Mossfoot (take the Honey Lift down, in the southeast of Honeybough)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.doel.1: Shut off the first mold kettle of the Mika Mold Farm, in the west of the Root Fields
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.doel.2: Shut off the second mold kettle, also at the Mika Mold Farm
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.aanbod.0: An emperor. The Mikas have an emperor. Then this is bigger than a dragon, knight. Much bigger.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.aanbod.1: But first: the egg. It lies in the heart of the tree, under the trunk. And down there, the roots are rotting.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.aanbod.2: Take the Honey Lift to Mossfoot. Mayor Rootina knows more. And the little mice you freed can smell mold from a mile away.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.klaar.0: The kettles are off! Can you smell that? It smells like sap again. And moss. And a little bit like maple syrup.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.klaar.1: I can already see the field getting its colors back. Green, pink, and the water turquoise again.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.klaar.2: There's one more thing. Under the tree, in the Rootdark, the veins are glowing pink. Brighter and brighter. As if something lives down there. The Root Gate is on the east side, on the ground.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.praat.z3_w: A hero with a Plumeguh! And with... little mice? They're all squeaking at once. They want to go somewhere.
The Mikas put two mold kettles in the Root Fields. Both at their mold farm, on the west side of the tree. That's why everything is rotting.
Just follow the little mice. They stand at every entrance and squeak the way. You don't have to search for anything.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.tekst: Under the tree lies a big root hall: the Rootdark. With your Nest Lantern, follow the pink veins through the Root Tunnel to the Heartbeat Hall, and light the four cave lanterns by the gate of the Heart, on the far side of the hall.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.bezig: Through the Root Gate, follow the pink veins to the Heartbeat Hall, and light the four cave lanterns.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.doel.0: Go to the Root Gate, on the ground on the east side of the tree
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.doel.1: Follow the pink veins down through the Root Tunnel to the Heartbeat Hall, the root hall under the trunk
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.doel.2: Light the 4 cave lanterns around the gate of the Heart, in the west wall of the hall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.aanbod.0: The Root Gate is on the east side of the tree, on the ground. Behind it, a tunnel goes down. After that it's dark. Really dark.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.aanbod.1: Stay in the light of your lantern. In the dark the monsters hurt less, but you can barely see them either.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.aanbod.2: Root Guard Glow is at the campfire in the Heartbeat Hall. He knows how to get into the Heart.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.klaar.0: You lit the lanterns! Look, the gate of the Heart is opening. Do you hear that beat?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.klaar.1: And something else is beating. Softer. Faster. There, in the middle of the hall, in that basket of roots.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.klaar.2: ...I've never heard that before. A second heart. A tiny little heart. But the guardians of the Heart won't let you near it. Go, adventurer. Through the gate, all the way around the ring of halls.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.tekst: Behind the gate in the west wall, the Heart of the Tree runs like a ring of halls around the root hall. Defeat the Root Strangler, cheer up the Old Nest Warden and defeat Baron Bleu and his Mold Colossus. Then you can reach the Dragon Egg, in the middle of the hall.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.bezig: The Heart of the Tree: the Root Strangler, the Old Nest Warden, Baron Bleu. And then the egg, in the middle of the hall.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.doel.0: Defeat the Root Strangler in the Heart of the Tree (cut through the 4 feeding roots)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.doel.1: Cheer up the Old Nest Warden (stand on the pink tree ring)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.doel.2: Defeat Baron Bleu and his Mold Colossus (fight in the light of the lampposts)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.doel.3: Take the Dragon Egg from the root basket, in the middle of the root hall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.aanbod.0: The Heart is a dungeon. Beating walls, mold curtains, and three guardians, all the way around the ring. Go with friends if you can.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.aanbod.1: The Root Strangler is a tangle of gray roots. Cut through its feeding roots when the heart beats.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.aanbod.2: And the Old Nest Warden... he isn't bad. Just gray. Cheer him up, and he'll let you through.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.klaar.0: You've got it. The egg. Look how it glows when you hold it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.klaar.1: I kept this warm for him. The little heart of his heart. You already have that splinter. Now all that's left is HIM.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.klaar.2: The ground starts to shake. Softly at first. Then harder. Somewhere high above you, the whole tree creaks.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.klaar.3: He's coming. He can feel that the egg is awake. Go! Out of the Root Tunnel, up the riding path, back to the old nest! Hurry!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.tekst: Wahoognir is coming for his egg. Escape from the roots and ride up the riding path, up the wind columns, to the old nest at the top of the tree. Put the egg back and cheer up the Chonkless Dragon: at 75, 50 and 25 percent, put a heart splinter back into his chest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.bezig: To the old nest at the top of the tree. Cheer up Wahoognir. And then back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.doel.0: Escape: out of the Root Tunnel, up the riding path around the trunk and up the wind columns, to the old nest
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.doel.1: Cheer up Wahoognir at the old nest at the top of the tree (stand in the pink circle under his chest)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.doel.2: See what happens to the egg
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.klaar.0: You're back! And... what's that on your shoulder? Is that... a little dragon?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.klaar.1: The baby dragon sneezes. A little pink cloud puffs out.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.klaar.2: A pink little dragon. In my chapel. I'm going to sit down. No, I'll stay standing. I don't know anymore.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.klaar.3: Everyone saw it: the pink beam across the whole sky. To the east. Come, knight. Combsy wants to see you too.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.tekst: The dragon is pink again and the egg has hatched. His pink beam pointed east, to Highchonk, the Floating City. Say goodbye to Beemother Combsy and go back to Order Master Waxie.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.bezig: Say goodbye to Combsy, and then back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.doel.0: Say goodbye to Beemother Combsy, on Honeybough's Blossom Square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.aanbod.0: Highchonk. The Floating City of the High Council. They know more about emperors than we do.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.aanbod.1: They want to see you, knight. You and that little one. But first say goodbye to Combsy. She baked cake. Three of them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.klaar.0: Look at you, with Combsy. And Squeaky, with a fluffy new coat of fur. And that little dragon who eats everything that's honey.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.klaar.1: Go to the edge of Blossom Square, knight. Look to the east. Where the beam ended.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.klaar.2: There's a city floating there. Above the clouds.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.klaar.3: Highchonk. Soon an airship will fly there. Until then: get some rest. You've earned it. Dragonfriend.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.praat.z3: There's our hero! With a little dragon! Come here, let me cuddle you both. Careful, he sneezes.
Honeybough will never forget you. There's always a little bed for you here. And cake. Three cakes.
Off you go to Waxie. She's been staring east all day.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.tekst: Chick Keeper Peep has lost six Plume Chicks in the Canopy Sea. They're hiding by the honey ponds on canopy 1, in pink fluff. Find them all.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.bezig: Six Plume Chicks, somewhere by the honey ponds in the canopy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.doel.0: Find 6 lost Plume Chicks by the honey ponds on canopy 1 (pink fluff)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.aanbod.0: Help! My Plume Chicks are gone! They chased after a butterfly. All six of them. Into the Canopy Sea.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.aanbod.1: They're stuck by the honey ponds on canopy 1, around the trunk. You'll know them by their pink fluff. And the peeping.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.klaar.0: They're all here! One, two, three, four, five... six! Thank you! Here, a bag of Honey Bites for your Plumeguh.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.titel: One Last Time to the Top
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.tekst: Grandpa Bark wants to see the old nest at the top of the tree one more time, like in the old days. He can't walk very well anymore. Take him along.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.bezig: Grandpa Bark is walking with you to the old nest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.doel.0: Bring Grandpa Bark to the old nest at the top of the tree (he walks with you; creatures leave him alone)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.aanbod.0: I used to climb the inner stairs up to the nest every day. To hear the dragon sing. Very softly.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.aanbod.1: Will you take me up one more time? I walk slowly, but I walk. And the monsters don't bother an old guh like me.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.klaar.0: Look at that. The nest. Just like old times. Do you hear that? No? Me neither. But I still remember how it sounded.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.klaar.1: Thank you, lad. Or lass. Or guh. My eyes aren't what they used to be. My heart still is.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.tekst: Teaguh Quack in Mossfoot brews honey tea with swamp flowers. It gives you speedy little paws. Pick three swamp flowers in the Root Fields (the creatures in the swamp sometimes drop them).
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.bezig: Three swamp flowers from the Root Fields.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.doel.0: Collect 3 swamp flowers from the creatures in the Root Fields
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.aanbod.0: Quack! Swamp flowers, that's what I need. Three. For the tastiest tea in the tree.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.aanbod.1: The creatures in the Root Fields often walk around with them. On their heads. Just ask them. With your sword.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.klaar.0: Quack quack! Here, have a taste. And look at your little paws. See how eager they are to go?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.tekst: Along the inner stairs, above Honeybough, four little lights of the tree folk are still asleep. Find them at different heights and wake them up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.bezig: Four sleeping little lights along the inner stairs, above Honeybough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.doel.0: Find 4 sleeping tree folk lights along the inner stairs, just above Honeybough (green glow)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.aanbod.0: ...Some of my friends are still asleep in the wood. Four. I can feel them. High and low.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.aanbod.1: Will you wake them up? One little light on its own is just a lamp. Together, we're a city.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.klaar.0: ...They're awake. Can you hear them? They're laughing. I'd forgotten how that sounded. Thank you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.tekst: Mapmaker Loopy wants to put five lookout points on her new map. But somebody has to have actually stood there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.bezig: Five lookout points: The Crown, Bough's End, the riding path, the Root Vault and the mast.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.doel.0: Stand on The Crown lookout, on canopy 2 on the southeast side
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.doel.1: Stand on the Bough's End lookout, at the end of the West Bough
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.doel.2: Stand on the first balcony of the riding path, on the west side of the trunk
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.doel.3: Stand on top of the Root Vault, the big ruin in the north of the Root Fields
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.doel.4: Climb into the crow's nest of Honeybough's airship mast
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.aanbod.0: I draw maps, but I never go anywhere. I don't like heights. Weird, for someone who lives on a bough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.aanbod.1: Five lookout points. Stand on each one and take a good look. Then I'll draw them in.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.klaar.0: All five! Look, my map is finished. With a little drawing of you on it. On a Plumeguh. Very tiny.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.tekst: All over Honeybough there are clues of a strange beekeeper: broken smoke pots, gray honey, a beekeeper suit on the clothesline. Find all five, and you'll know where he's hiding.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.bezig: Five clues, and then the secret hatch in the Comb Clusters.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.doel.0: Find the five clues of the strange beekeeper in Honeybough (purple sparkles)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.doel.1: Defeat the Mika Beekeeper in his secret comb hall, behind the hatch in the Comb Clusters
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.klaar.0: A Mika! In a beekeeper suit! And the queen bee is golden again, you say? Then she'll start singing again!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.klaar.1: So THAT beekeeper suit on the clothesline was his. I knew it. Well, I thought it was weird. That's almost knowing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.klaar.2: Here, a little honeycomb from the queen herself. She sends her thanks. With a buzz.
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.rookpotjes: Next to the quest board lie three broken smoke pots. They smell like old cheese. Beekeepers never use cheese in their smoke.
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.imkerpak: On a gangplank in Honeybough, a beekeeper suit hangs on the clothesline. With holes for ears. Pointy ears. And a tail.
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.grauwe_honing: A jar at the market is full of gray honey. The label says: 'Ripe Cheese Honey. Not for guhs.'
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.koningin: The bee queen doesn't sing anymore. She sits gray and silent in her comb. Something has made her sad.
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.luik: At the bottom of the Comb Clusters there's a hatch with a little cat paw on it. Behind it, something buzzes angrily. And a voice squeaks: 'Meow. Do not disturb.'
vadsrijk.z3npc.schat.onder_de_tak: At the very tip of the Southwest Bough, a chest hangs in a nest. Only the brave make it here!
vadsrijk.z3npc.schat.moeras: On the east edge of the island, by the Honey Swamp, stands a chest. Sticky, but full.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_1: A dragon, pink and big, circles above a teeny tiny tree. The tree grows.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_2: The tree is gigantic. In the canopy, the dragon builds a nest. Little wooden creatures wave.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_3: An egg, pink and glowing, in the nest. The Tree Folk dance around it with lanterns.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_4: A gray cloud comes from the east. The dragon flies at it. He is very angry. Or very scared.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_5: The dragon comes back. Gray. A splinter sticks out of his chest. He growls at his own egg.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_6: The Tree Folk carry the egg down, into the trunk, deep beneath the roots.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_7: The Tree Folk sit in a circle and fall asleep. Their lights grow softer. The egg glows.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_8: A cat with a little crown, far away at the edge of the wall. Gray mist comes from his side, all the way to the nest. His reach is long.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z3_monsters: The creatures in the tree are real monsters. Just defeat them. You never hurt guhs.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z3_lantaarn: Stay in the light. Outside the light, creatures are silhouettes and your hits do half the damage.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z3_zweef: On your Plumeguh you can glide down from high places. Jump off the glide platform or a balcony of the Bridle Path and hold the jump key.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_schemerwortel.tekst: After the Splinter Peaks and from level 30, the airship flies you to Honeybough, a beekeepers' town like a ring around a tree as big as a mountain. The tree has 4 layers: at the top the Canopy Sea (3 canopy floors, lv 30-34) with the nest, then the Branchways with the beekeeper villages (lv 34-38) and Honeybough, in the hollow trunk Barkton (lv 40-43), and under the trunk the Rootdark (lv 46-49). On the ground around the tree lie the Root Fields (lv 43-46). The Cheese Zeppelin Yard is on an island of its own.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_pluimguh.tekst: With Stable Master Feathers in the Plume Stable you choose your first mount: a Plumeguh. Call it with X, open your mount screen with N. From up high you can glide down with your Plumeguh; going up works with stairs, lifts and the blossom wind. When you attack or a boss hits you, you dismount.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_lantaarn.tekst: In the Rootdark and the Heart of the Tree it's pitch black. Creatures outside the light are dark silhouettes and take half damage. Your Nest Lantern, pink veins and lit cave lanterns give light. Together you see more.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_premiebord.tekst: In the Hunters' Hut of Honeybough hangs the bounty board of Hunterguh Turnip: new jobs every day for level 40-50. Hunting, gathering, delivering, clearing mold. No rush, no leaderboard: do whatever you enjoy.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_reizen.tekst: Captain Buzzsail flies you from the mast of Honeybough to the Harbor or Sugarbowl. In the tree: the bridle path winds around the outside of the trunk from the ground via Honeybough up to canopy 1; inside, the inner stairs of Barkton run up to the nest. The Honey Lift goes from the ground (Mossfoot) to Honeybough, the Canopy Lift from Honeybough to canopy 1, and the pink wind columns blow you from the branches to canopy 1, 2 and 3. You glide down with your Plumeguh.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z3_titel.tekst: At class level 50 a fourth title from the Snuggle Order awaits you, with Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel of Honeybough: Nest Warden, Canopy Falcon or Dusk Sage.
vadsrijk.z3npc.bevel: A Mika Command hangs on the jetty: "Find the egg. Let it ripen. Bring it to the Count. The Count brings it to Him."
vadsrijk.z3npc.gezweefd: You're gliding! Your Plumeguh spreads its feathery ears and you drift gently down.
vadsrijk.z3npc.schat.nesttop: Among the branches of the old nest, at the very top of the tree, lies a forgotten chest. Nobody has ever made it this high.
vadsrijk.z3npc.schat.schorsstad: In a little house high in the trunk wall stands a chest of the Tree Folk. There's still light inside.
vadsrijk.z3npc.schat.wortelduister: Behind a root pillar in the root hall, where only the mice ever went, lies a chest.
vadsrijk.npc.optie.rol.honingthee: A cup of honey tea, please!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_knuffelridder.te: Your second title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 35 as a Snuggle Knight and come back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel: then your spec grows stronger.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_knuffelridder.be: Level 35 as a Snuggle Knight, then back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_knuffelridder.do: Reach level 35 as a Snuggle Knight (the Canopy Sea, the yard and the bounties help)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_knuffelridder.aa: You swept the Mikas' yard clean, and your Plumeguh already knows the tree better than I do. I've seen it.
Anyone who gets this far deserves the second title of the Order. Reach level 35 as a Snuggle Knight, and the beekeepers will dance in the Nest Chapel. For you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_knuffelridder.kl: The bees buzz, the blossoms fall, the beekeepers dance. Your spec grows along with the tree!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_pluisjager.tekst: Your second title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 35 as a Fluff Hunter and come back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel: then your spec grows stronger.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_pluisjager.bezig: Level 35 as a Fluff Hunter, then back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel.
Reach level 35 as a Fluff Hunter (the Canopy Sea, the yard and the bounties help)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_pluisjager.aanbo: You swept the Mikas' yard clean, and your Plumeguh already knows the tree better than I do. I've seen it.
Anyone who gets this far deserves the second title of the Order. Reach level 35 as a Fluff Hunter, and the beekeepers will dance in the Nest Chapel. For you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_pluisjager.klaar: The bees buzz, the blossoms fall, the beekeepers dance. Your spec grows along with the tree!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_vadsmagier.tekst: Your second title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 35 as a Chonk Mage and come back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel: then your spec grows stronger.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_vadsmagier.bezig: Level 35 as a Chonk Mage, then back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel.
Reach level 35 as a Chonk Mage (the Canopy Sea, the yard and the bounties help)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_vadsmagier.aanbo: You swept the Mikas' yard clean, and your Plumeguh already knows the tree better than I do. I've seen it.
Anyone who gets this far deserves the second title of the Order. Reach level 35 as a Chonk Mage, and the beekeepers will dance in the Nest Chapel. For you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_vadsmagier.klaar: The bees buzz, the blossoms fall, the beekeepers dance. Your spec grows along with the tree!
vadsrijk.npc.optie.rol.honingkraam: What do you have at The Honey Stall?
vadsrijk.npc.optie.z3_gouden_veren: Trade 25 Golden Feathers for the Golden Plumeguh
vadsrijk.npc.optie.z3_advancement: I'm ready for my second title!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.te_ver: You're outside the fight: you can't hit him from there!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.immuun: He's invulnerable right now: do the task first!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vahoeg.aan.werf: The Wahoog Altar glows: the bosses of the Cheese Zeppelin Yard turn Wahoog (seal: %s). For half an hour, or until Captain Roquefort falls.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vahoeg.aan.hart: The Wahoog Altar glows: the bosses of the Heart of the Tree turn Wahoog (seal: %s). For half an hour, or until Baron Bleu flees.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vahoeg.uitleg: The Wahoog Altar. Place a Wahoog Seal on it (right-click with a seal in your bag, from lv 50): the bosses get stronger, and they drop Golden Feathers. Weekly seal now: %s.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vahoeg.loopt: Wahoog mode is already running (seal: %s), %s min left.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.zegel.taai: Tough (a shield in the first phase)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vast.klauw: The Canopy Raptor grabs you! Click or press shift to wriggle free, or have your team hit it!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vast.wortel: A root has you in a stranglehold! Click or press shift, or have a teammate sneak next to you.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vast.kamer: Locked in the Ripening Room! Click or press shift, or have a teammate sneak next to you.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.grijp: The Canopy Raptor dives at %s! Out of the purple circle!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.mis: Miss! His claws grab at thin air.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.wind: Wing Gust! He blows you toward the edge.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.losgeschoten: Hit! He lets go and tumbles for a moment.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.losgelaten: He drops you... you float gently back into the nest.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.fase2.onder: Whoever he grabs, shoot them free!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.fase3.onder: He's fleeing! Follow the pink trail. Whistle for your Plumeguh: you can ride here!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.achtervolg: The Canopy Raptor flees to another treetop! Call your mount and follow the pink trail of light. Get there fast and you get Wahoog!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.verslagen: The Canopy Raptor falls apart into gray feathers that blow away over the canopy.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.snij: Taleggio cuts the rigging loose! Out of the red, jump to the pink!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.fase2.onder: Shoot him or pull him down with a lever
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.hangt: Taleggio swings high on his ropes! Ranged attacks and magic hit him; pull a lever (pink) when he swings above it.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.gevallen: Crack! Taleggio falls down. Hit him now!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.klimt: Taleggio scrambles back up into the rigging.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.te_ver: He isn't swinging above this lever. Wait until he's above it!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.vlucht: This is going in my report! I'm out of here! (He vanishes in a puff of smoke.)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.br.wielen: Cheese wheel bombs! Out of the red lanes!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.br.plaat: An armor plate flies off! %s left.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.br.laden: The cannon is still loading... %s s
vadsrijk.z3bazen.br.pantser: His armor plates soak up most of it: shoot them off with the deck cannons!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.br.vlucht: Kaboom! ...No wait, that was me. I'm out of here!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.ballonnen: Four balloon segments with purple marks: pop them and he sinks!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.ballonnen_eerst: His zeppelin keeps him up: pop the balloons first!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.kantel: The deck tilts! Loose crates slide down!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.matrozen: All hands on deck! Mika Deckhands!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.zinkt: The zeppelin is sinking! Jump to the wreck (pink circle)!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.vlucht: This isn't over, knight! The Count will hear about this! (He floats away on his umbrella.)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.intro: A knight? In MY Fur Hall? Squeak! Brrr, close the door, there's a draft.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.intro_weer: Still cold in here. That's because of YOU. Look, a new cape. Made of socks. Knitted. By me.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.zwier: Cape Swirl! Out of the red cone!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.schild_op: Squeak squeak! My mice keep me warm. And safe.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.fase2.onder: Break the cage locks: the mice are feeding his shield
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.schild: A chonk shield of mouse sorrow! Free the mice in the little cages!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.kooi_open: A little cage springs open! The mice gnaw a hole in his cape. (%s of 4)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.au: Ow! Don't touch the cape! It's an antique!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.schild_weg.onder: And his cape is full of holes
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.fase3.onder: Light the lanterns again: only in the light can you hit him properly
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.donker: Fffffooo! There. Nice and dark. Nice and cold.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.blaas: He blows at a lantern! Stand in the purple circle to protect the flame!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.grote_kooi: The big cage next to the throne is rattling! Right-click it open!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.nog_niet: The big cage is still locked. The Count needs to be weakened more first.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.nee: No... no no no! Not the big cage! SQUEAK!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.mijn_cape: My cape! Do you know how many winters that took?!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.enrage.onder: He loves the cold. You don't.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f1.uitleggen: No no no, Emperor, I can explain! It was the knight! It was -
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f1.floep: The gray mist swallows them up. Floop. Gone.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f1.stilte: Silence. On the bark a gray, cold frost stain remains, where the mist came in.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f1.onder: A cold, gray mist. It reaches everywhere.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ww.grijp: Gray roots shoot out of the wall! Out of the red strips!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ww.gekapt: A feeding root has been chopped through! (%s of 4)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ww.verslagen: The Root Strangler falls apart into gray fluff. Somewhere in the wall, the heart beats more calmly.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.nw.golf: Tree ring wave! Stand on a PINK ring!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.nw.fase3.onder: Two waves in a row, they alternate
vadsrijk.z3bazen.nw.dank: ...Pink. I'm pink again. The gray is gone. Thank you, little knight.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.nw.splinter: Go on. The egg is waiting. And take this with you: I kept it warm for him. The little heart of his heart.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.intro: The Count is gone. So if I bring the egg myself... then I'll be the new Little Finger!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.spray: The Colossus sprays at a lantern! Relight it afterwards (right-click).
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.zelf: Enough! Then I'll ripen you myself!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.kamer: Ripening Room! Out of the purple circle!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.fase3.onder: Stand TOGETHER in the yellow circle by the egg
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.ei: Colossus! Grab the egg! Grab the EGG!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.grijparm: The grabber arm reaches for the egg! Get together in the yellow circle!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.geblokt: Blocked! The Colossus's grabber arm can't reach the egg.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.gegrepen: The Colossus's grabber arm snatches at the egg! The Baron laughs and perks up.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.vlucht: The Emperor doesn't need to know about this! ...Right? (He escapes in his little zeppelin through a hole in the roots.)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.splinter1.onder: A pink circle under his chest: put the first splinter back
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.splinter_cirkel: Stand in the pink circle under his chest for 3 s: put a heart splinter back!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.splinter_eerst: He waits... put a heart splinter back first (pink circle)!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.te_hoog: He's flying too high. Protect the egg!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.pluis: Black fluff rains down! Cheer up the gray bloblets before they reach the egg!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.klodder_ei: A gray bloblet rolls against the egg. The egg turns a little gray...
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.huil: CRYSTAL HOWL! Hide behind a big nest branch!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.beschut: The nest branch catches the howl... and creaks.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.duik: He dives at the egg! Stand TOGETHER in the yellow circle!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.remt: The egg glows pink! He slows down... and hesitates.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.ei_grauw: He skims past the egg. It turns grayer...
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.enrage.onder: The egg can't hold out much longer
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.hoogvads: Wahoognir blows a long pink beam of light across the horizon. Where it ends, a city floats above the clouds: Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f2.rillen: A gray hall. Thin light. Count Squeakula kneels in his undershirt, shivering.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f2.rapport1: Report from the west. The dragon is... uh... pink.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f2.rapport2: The egg has... uh... hatched. The Little Finger is... picked clean.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f2.tik: From the shadow behind the throne comes impatient tapping on an armrest. Tap. Tap. Tap. Tap. Tap.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f2.onder: Far in the east, something wants more and more.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.werf.net: A rope safety net catches you and flings you back to the entrance of the yard.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.werf.loods_open: BOOM! The cannons blast the gate open!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.hart.bewogen: You moved in the dark! The roots can feel it...
vadsrijk.z3bazen.hart.kwekerij_open: All the mold kettles are off: the mold curtain falls away!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.hart.ringen_open: The pink grain lines up: the tree rings slide open!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.loot.goud: %s has the GOLDEN PLUMEGUH! What a shine!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.veer.nog: Golden Feathers: %s / %s. With 25 you get the Golden Plumeguh.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.veer.al: You already have the Golden Plumeguh. Just keep your feathers for show.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.kruinroofvogel: Red = his dive. Purple = he grabs or blows. Grabbed? Click or shift to break free. During his flight you may call your Plumeguh!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.taleggio: Red = that platform falls, pink = safe rigging. Is he hanging high? Pull a lever when he swings above it.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.brokkel: His armor soaks up a lot. Right-click a deck cannon and look at him: that's how you shoot the plates off.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.roquefort: Red = his boarding attack. Purple = pop the balloons. Is the ship sinking? Jump to the pink wreck!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.piepvel: Free the mice: break the cage locks to break his shield. In the dark: light lanterns and fight in the light.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.wortelwurger: His 4 feeding roots can only be hurt when the heart beats (it goes dark for a moment). Chop them through!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.nestwachter: Tree-ring wave: stand on a PINK ring. Red = shoulder charge, step aside.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.bleu: A burning lamppost burns the mold away: fight in the light. Yellow by the egg = stand in it TOGETHER.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.vahoegnir: You don't defeat him: you cheer him up. Put the heart splinters back in the pink circle. Gray? Cheer up the bloblets. Yellow by the egg = together!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.lantaarnpaal: Right-click lights it. Light helps: in the dark you hit less.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.altaar: With a Wahoog Seal in your bag (from lv 50): right-click. The bosses get stronger and drop Golden Feathers.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.kanon: Right-click fires where you look. Only reloads faster.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.loods: Each lever turns two cannons a quarter turn. Aim all three at the gate!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.aderloop: When the heart beats, it goes dark. Stand still then!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.ketel: Right-click burns it out (three times). Watch out for the purple spore cloud.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.ringen: Each button turns two tree rings a little. Line up the pink grain!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kruinroofvogel.onder: He stole the old nest. And your lunch.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.taleggio.onder: Everything on a string. You too.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.brokkel.onder: Cheese wheels, cannons and a whole lot of racket
vadsrijk.z3bazen.roquefort.onder: Captain of the Cheese Zeppelin Fleet
vadsrijk.z3bazen.wortelwurger.onder: A tangle of gray roots around a rotten core
vadsrijk.z3bazen.nestwachter.onder: He guards the egg. Against everyone.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bleu: BARON BLEU AND THE MOLD COLOSSUS
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bleu.onder: The Count's Knuckle. Ripens everything. Even eggs.
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_touwknots.flavour.0: "One tug and they're all lined up neatly."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_touwknots: every 4th hit pulls the creatures around your target toward you
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_lontstaf: critical hits set the target on fire for 3 s
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_roquefortsabel.flav: "Smells of the sea. And of cheese. Mostly of cheese."
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_paraplu.flavour.0: "A bow that also keeps the rain off."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_paraplu: +15 % damage while you float in the air
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_kooisleutel.flavour: "Whoever opens the cage makes friends for life."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_kooisleutel: every 5th hit opens a little cage: a friendly swarm of mice nibbles along for 3 s
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_sokkencape: 12 % chance when you get hit: 5 % Chonk back (20 s cooldown)
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_roofklauw.flavour.0: "It sees you from farther away than you see it."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_roofklauw: +20 % damage from more than 10 blocks away
"Soft as down, light as a feather."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_kruinveren: below 30 % Chonk: 3 s Quickpaws (30 s cooldown)
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_hartwortel: 3 % of your damage comes back as Chonk
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_lantaarnstaf.flavou: "The light of the Tree Folk never goes out."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_lantaarnsta: critical hits give you a Snuggle Shield for 4 s (20 s cooldown)
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_schimmelbre: +25 % damage to creatures that are Spored or Sticky
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_bleumonocle: 10 % chance on hit: the target gets Spored
"Warm as an egg in a nest."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z3baas_eierwarmer: below 25 % Chonk your team glows pink and gets 15 % Chonk back (60 s cooldown)
vadsrijk.huisdier.kruinroofvogel.tekst: A teeny-tiny raptor with ruffled little feathers. Loves pecking at your shoelaces.
vadsrijk.huisdier.kruinroofvogel.bron: Defeat the Canopy Raptor on the Bald Crown
vadsrijk.huisdier.piepje.tekst: The squeaky-squeak mouse from the tower. His winter coat has grown all the way back.
vadsrijk.huisdier.piepje.bron: Defeat Count Squeakula in the Fur Hall
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.ei.nep: The egg in Baron Bleu's room? Fake! A cheese wheel with pink paint. The real egg was safe here all along.
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.open: At the bottom of the Comb Clusters you hear buzzing... and someone very quietly saying "ow, ow, ow".
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.0: In the comb hall stands a Mika in a way-too-big beekeeper suit, a smoke pot in one hand and a spoon in the other.
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.1: "Nothing going on! Just... tasting honey. For the report. Quality control!"
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.2: "What? Gray honey? Nope, it's just a little... ripe. Like cheese. Mikas like ripe."
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.3: The bees buzz angrily around his head. The smoke pot sputters, coughs out one little cloud and goes out.
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.4: "Okay, okay! I'm going! This is going in my report!"
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.5: He flees through the hatch with a full jar of honey. In his hurry, he leaves the jar behind. The bees are happy again.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.kies.z3_kapitein: Back down? Pick where below or look at the travel map. (The ship's bell by the mast opens the travel map too.)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.volgorde: %s isn't showing up yet. Defeat %s first.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.hart.welkom: The Heart of the Tree (lv 49-50). The root passage behind this gate climbs to the ring. There, past the Vein Run, the Mold Nursery and the Hall of Rings, the Root Strangler, the Old Nest Warden and Baron Bleu are waiting.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.hart.slaapt: The roots are still asleep... Come back when Root Guard Glow sends you to the Heart (main story "The Heart of the Tree"). You can already fight, but your story only counts here once that quest is active.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.bezoek: A happy rumble sounds in the distance... Wahoognir is stopping by to say hi!
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.0: Wahoognir purrs like a really big kitty.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.1: Wahoognir rests his soft head against you for a moment.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.2: A little finch on his back chirps along. Wahoognir giggles.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.3: Wahoognir blinks slowly at you. That means: I think you're sweet.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.4: His ears turn a tiny bit pinker.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.5: Wahoognir rumbles so happily that the ground tickles a little.
vadsrijk.z3npc.gids.start: Stable Master Feathers hops onto her Plumeguh: "Follow me! Up the bridle path, round and round the trunk, all the way to the top of canopy 1!"
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_imker_raatweide: in Combmeadow Beekeepers' Village, on the Southwest Bough (ride up the riding path to above Honeybough and ride onto the bough)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_raatweide.1: Welcome to Combmeadow! We live between the combs here. Literally. My bed is hexagonal.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_raatweide.2: Our bees fly to the canopy every morning and back every evening. I always wave them off.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_raatweide.3: When the wind blows, the whole branch wobbles. The bees think it's a party.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_imker_molenhoek: in Millcorner Beekeepers' Village, on the Mill Bough in the north (ride up the riding path to above Honeybough and ride onto the bough)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_molenhoek.1: In Millcorner the little mills turn in the branch wind. They grind blossom flour for the honey cake.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_molenhoek.2: A mill standing still means the wind is asleep. Then I sleep too. Only fair.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_molenhoek.3: Watch out for the wasps on the branches. They've gone gray. We haven't, luckily.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_reiziger_1: at the campfire on the south side of the Root Fields, on the ground around the tree
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_1.1: I've been walking around this tree for three days. I'm not even halfway yet. I think.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_1.2: The bridle path around the trunk? Gorgeous. But I don't have a Plumeguh. So I walk. Slowly.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_1.3: A campfire, a cup of tea, and a tree as big as a mountain. That's all a traveler wants.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_reiziger_2: at the campfire in the northwest of the Root Fields, on the ground around the tree
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_2.1: I'm mapping where the mold vats are. For Loopy. She doesn't dare herself. Fear of heights, she says. On the ground.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_2.2: Those Mikas over in the west smell like old socks. And cheese. Mostly cheese.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_2.3: My compass always points at the tree. Either the compass is broken, or the tree is very important.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_reiziger_3: at the campfire in the northeast of the Root Fields, on the ground around the tree
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_3.1: See that cable bridge up there? That's where the Mikas go to their yard. I'm staying right here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_3.2: I was on my way to Highchonk. Then I saw this tree. I've been here a month now.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_3.3: Campfire on, shoes off, toes warm. That's how travel should be.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_reiziger_4: at the campfire on the east side of crown 1, the lowest crown floor
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_4.1: I rode the bridle path all the way up here. My Plumeguh is asleep now. Almost me too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_4.2: From canopy 1 you can see the yard on its own island. With a spyglass you can even see the cheese.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_4.3: The wind columns only go up. Going down, you glide. That's the deal in this tree.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_brug_1: on the rope bridge to Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village, on the Bee Bough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_1.1: This bridge wobbles. So do I. We make a good team.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_1.2: Don't look down. I'll do it. It's very far. Okay, now I'm dizzy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_1.3: The bees fly under the bridge. They wave. I think.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_brug_2: on the rope bridge to Combmeadow Beekeepers' Village, on the Southwest Bough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_2.1: I'm counting the planks. A hundred and twelve. Yesterday there were a hundred and eleven. Someone's sneakily adding more.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_2.2: I don't live on the bridge, you know. I just really like standing on it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_2.3: Combmeadow is that way. Follow the lanterns.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_brug_3: on the rope bridge to Millcorner Beekeepers' Village, on the Mill Bough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_3.1: Hear the little mills? Click clack click. It's music to me.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_3.2: Millcorner is further along the branch. Walk slowly, the bridge is ticklish.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_3.3: I'm the bridge keeper. I don't guard anything, but I'm very good at waving.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_brug_4: on the gangplank to the Honey Lift, in the southeast of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_4.1: My name's Combsy too! There are seven Combsies here. It's very confusing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_4.2: This is the gangway to the Honey Lift. Mossfoot is down below.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_4.3: I watch the lift every day. Up and down. Up and down. Very relaxing.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_brug_5: on the gangplank in the northwest of Honeybough, on the way to the airship mast
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_5.1: This gangway goes to the airship. Hold on to your hat!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_5.2: I once dropped a honey cake. It never landed. That's how high it is.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_5.3: Upsy-daisy! I say that with every step. That way you don't fall.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z3_brug_6: in the middle of the rope bridge between Honeybough and the Cheese Zeppelin Yard, in the northeast
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_6.1: This cable bridge goes to the Cheese Zeppelin Yard. I don't go there. I just look.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_6.2: When the Mikas test their cannons, the whole bridge shakes. Then I hold on to my little ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_6.3: A hundred and forty blocks long. I counted every one. Twice.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z3_rijpad_start: at the start of the riding path, on the ground on the north side of the trunk (close to the Plume Stable)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z3_rijpad_eind: at the end of the riding path, on top of canopy 1 (ride four laps up around the trunk, through the leaf tunnel)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z3_honingdeur: by the trapdoor in the trunk wall at the Blossom Square of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z3_schorsstad_vloe: on the floor of Barkton, at the bottom of the inner stairs in the hollow trunk
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z3_pelstrap: by the stairs down to the Fur Hall, on the floor of Barkton
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z3_kabelbrug: at the start of the cable bridge to the Cheese Zeppelin Yard, on the northeast edge of Honeybough
vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z3_stamspiraal: on the riding path, the wide road that winds up around the outside of the trunk
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.klaar.5: Take the lift in the trunk's inner courtyard (through the stair door here on the square) down to the floor of Barkton, and go out through the north gate. And here: the key to the Honey Lift. With it you can always get back up fast.
vadsrijk.dialoog.knop.log: Conversation log (L): what did everyone say again?
vadsrijk.dialoog.hint: Click or space: next  ·  shift+space: to the choices  ·  L: log
vadsrijk.dialoog.cmd.oud: Dialogue: you now get the old talk screen (again = the new one).
vadsrijk.dialoog.cmd.nieuw: Dialogue: you get the new Chonkdom talk screen again.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.0: Welcome to the dialogue demo! I'm the narrator: I get a whole parchment page in italics, without a portrait. Click or press space to see all the text at once, and again to go on.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.1: Hooray, a visitor! See how I hop up and down, with a little heart? That means happy. My name plate has the color of zone 1, and next to it is where I live.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.2: Oh dear, I sag a little and look down. That means sad. My plate is ice blue: the color of the Splinter Peaks.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.3: Oh! A little jump and an exclamation mark: surprised! Guhs from the Duskroot like me have a honey-yellow plate.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.4: Grr! I'm shaking with anger. Mikas get a gray plate and their own sly little voice.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.5: And this is me: my portrait is on the right and my plate is mint green.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.6: I belong to the Snuggle Order, that's why my plate is purple. Press L or the lines button to see the conversation log, and « Back or backspace to page back.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.7: This is a long page, to check that everything fits at GUI scale 2, 3 and 4. The text types itself, with a soft blip per word; how loud that blip is and how fast the text goes, you set under the little gear. Shift+space jumps straight to the choices. Below this text is the quest strip, and the choices each have a little icon: a book for a quest, an emerald for a shop, a map and a feather to travel, a door to leave. The number keys pick right away. And the "What should I do?" button tells you again who, what and where. Yippee!
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.vol: A full screen: lots of text and nine choices. On a small window or GUI scale 4 the choices go in two columns side by side, and when the text no longer fits, you scroll it with the mouse wheel (or space). Nothing falls off the screen. This is some extra text so the balloon really fills up: guhs are always sweet, they love to cuddle, and their favorite cookies have pink icing and sprinkles, preferably three at once, and then a fourth one for later.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.doel.wat: Bring 3 cuddle cookies to Granny Trudy
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.doel.waar: at the bakery in Shroomsbury (just an example)
