vadsrijk.z4boot.fles.uitleg: Right-click: the guh sailboat is yours! Call it with your mount key in the water of the Lantern Coast.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.eigen.zeilboot: Your very own guh sailboat for the Lantern Coast. W = hoist the sail, A/D = steer, Shift at a dock = moor.
vadsrijk.economie.stal.nog_niet.zeilboot: You get it early in the Lantern Coast story.
vadsrijk.z4boot.alleen_water: Your little sailboat only sails on water (and you don't have a land mount yet).
vadsrijk.z4boot.geen_plek: No room for your boat here: find open water (3x3, with air above).
vadsrijk.z4boot.stroming: The Ring Current pushes your boat back toward the islands!
vadsrijk.z4boot.terug_steiger: You logged out at sea. Your boat is safely back in the harbor: you're standing on the dock of %s.
vadsrijk.z4boot.geen_vreemde_boot: Other boats don't float here: in the Chonkdom you sail your own guh sailboat.
vadsrijk.z4boot.nieuw_variant: New for your little sailboat: %s! Pick it in the Little Sailboat screen.
vadsrijk.z4boot.scherm.nog_niet: You get your own little sailboat early in the story of the Lantern Coast.
vadsrijk.z4boot.scherm.uitleg: %s in the water or on a dock = your boat. W = hoist the sail, S = brake, A/D = steer. You go faster with the wind behind you. Shift at a dock = moor.
vadsrijk.z4boot.bron.beloning: A reward somewhere on the Lantern Coast...
vadsrijk.z4boot.tip.boot: Stand in the water or on a dock and press your mount key (X): there's your boat. With N (Sailboat tab) you can dress it up.
vadsrijk.z4boot.tip.varen: W = hoist the sail (you keep speeding up), S = brake, A/D = steer. The wind shifts: you go faster with the wind behind you. At a dock: Shift = moor. At the edge, the Ring Current pushes you back.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.set.stukken: Set: %s (%s/4 worn; the set mittens or cape count too)
vadsrijk.z4wezens.set.lampion.4: (4) Party Light: +10 Heal Power, and you glow in the dark yourself
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.mopperkrab: Holding his claws in front of his face? Then hits from the front only do half. Walk around him!
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.koraalkobold: He throws coral shards from a distance. Run up to him: up close he's a pushover.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.stekelpluis: He does nothing until you do something. Red circle = his spikes: step away for a moment.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.zeurslak: His slime trail makes you Sticky. Crawling into his shell? Wait a moment, he'll come back out.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.lampionkwal: Red circle under the jelly = its tentacles sting. Step out, then strike back.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.mokmeeuw: Red stripe = his dive. Sidestep! Afterwards he sits on the ground for a moment: that's your chance.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.bromvlieger: Purple stripe = a gust of wind that blows you away. When he swoops low, his tail swishes.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.pruilrob: Drumming his flippers? Then he slides on his belly along the red stripe. Step aside!
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.mistmopje: He melts away into the mist and pops up behind you. See the red circle? Get out of it, or things go dark for a bit.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.vliegerknecht: A Mika with a grappling hook. Red stripe = his hook: step aside, or you'll get Sticky.
vadsrijk.z4bazen.tip.zeeslurf: Red = his snoot or a sulk cloud. In phase 2 he dives into his little grotto: dive after him and break the 3 gray polyps. Pink bubble rings give air!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.tip.vliegervanger: Is he hanging under his kite? Right-click the 3 winches on the deck (3x each) to bring him down. Yellow = catch a plushie together!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.zeeslurf: You don't defeat him: you cheer him up. Follow the colors: red = move away, pink = safe, purple = the current, yellow = together.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.vliegervanger.titel: The Wreck of the Kite Catcher
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.vliegervanger: A Mika with a stolen plushie stash. Red = move away, purple = wind and winches, yellow = catch together.
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.immuun: He's deep in his little grotto! Break the gray polyps first.
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.fase2.onder: Dive after him and break the gray polyps!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.fase3.onder: Out of the red ring, or dive under it!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.duik: The Sea Snoot sinks to his little grotto! Dive to the 3 gray polyps (pink rings = air).
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.adem: He surfaces, gasping for air! Hit him now!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.golf: Big wave! Out of the red ring!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.aaien: Pet him together! Everyone stand in the yellow circle!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.giechel: Hee hee hee! He gets the giggles and forgets to swim for a moment!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.blij: The Sea Snoot is pink again! He sings a song for the whole lagoon.
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.immuun: He's hanging too high! Reel in the 3 winches on the deck (right-click).
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.fase2.ond: Reel in the winches to bring his kite down!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.zeg.op: Ha! Catch me if you can, landlubbers! My kite is faster than you!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.zeg.weg: This is going in my report! The Emperor will hear about this!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.lieren: He's hanging from his kite! Right-click the 3 winches (purple flag) 3 times each.
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.neer: CRACK! The kite crashes down! Pinkie is flat on his back for a moment: hit him now!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.knuffel: A plushie falls out of his sack! Catch it TOGETHER in the yellow circle!
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenhelm.flavour.0: "You hear the sea when you put it on."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenhelm.flavour.1: "A hermit crab lived in it first. He was fine with it."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenpantser.flavour.0: "Hard on the outside, mother-of-pearl on the inside."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenpantser.flavour.1: "Every shell is a little gift from the waves."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenbroek.flavour.0: "With a pocket full of sand. That's never coming out."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenlaarzen.flavour.2: "For those who want to stand firm in the surf."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionmuts.flavour.2: "Folded from party paper and good cheer."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionjurk.flavour.0: "Soft as lantern silk, warm as a party night."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionjurk.flavour.1: "Swirls when you twirl. Go on, try it."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionslofjes.flavour.0: "You walk on a little cloud of party."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionslofjes.flavour.1: "They jingle like little bells on the pier."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionslofjes.flavour.2: "Perfect for a little dance by the campfire."
vadsrijk.loot.parelring.flavour.0: "From the deepest shell in the lagoon."
vadsrijk.loot.parelring.flavour.1: "Round, smooth and a little bit magical."
vadsrijk.loot.parelring.flavour.2: "Maybe the Sea Snoot gave it away himself."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenketting.flavour.1: "Picked up by hand on Snuggletide Beach."
vadsrijk.loot.ankerknots.flavour.0: It once held a little fishing boat in place. Now it holds you.
vadsrijk.loot.ankerknots.flavour.2: There's still a bit of seaweed on it. Just leave it.
vadsrijk.loot.golfbreker.flavour.0: It cuts through waves, woes and gray showers.
vadsrijk.loot.golfbreker.flavour.1: Glitters like the sea at five in the afternoon.
vadsrijk.loot.vliegerboog.flavour.0: The string is an old kite string. It sings in the wind.
vadsrijk.loot.vliegerboog.flavour.1: Shoots a little bit with the wind. Handy!
vadsrijk.loot.vliegerboog.flavour.2: There's still a little bow tied to it.
vadsrijk.loot.harpoenkruisboog.flavour.0: "Taken from a Mika Harpooner. Now it does good things."
vadsrijk.loot.harpoenkruisboog.flavour.2: "The rope has been replaced with a ribbon."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionstaf.flavour.0: A little lantern always glows inside. At night too. Especially at night.
vadsrijk.loot.lampionstaf.flavour.1: Slow, warm and very, very pink.
vadsrijk.loot.lampionstaf.flavour.2: The party starts wherever you stand.
vadsrijk.loot.koraalstaf.flavour.1: Your heals smell like the sea.
vadsrijk.loot.koraalstaf.flavour.2: A tiny fish lives inside. He helps out.
item.guhs.vr_z4_kristal_parelkristal.fla: Round, soft and shiny. It makes you a bit sturdier: more Chonk.
item.guhs.vr_z4_kristal_zeeglas.flavour: A little shard of sea, polished round by the waves. More Element Resistance.
vadsrijk.loot.z4baas_slurfstaf.flavour.0: "Pffft! A little salt water comes with the deal."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z4baas_slurfstaf: +15 % damage to creatures in the water
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z4baas_zeekoeienhu: you take 15 % less damage in the water
vadsrijk.loot.z4baas_lagunelampion.flavo: "The little light that made the Sea Snoot sing again."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z4baas_lagunelampi: you glow in the dark yourself
vadsrijk.loot.z4baas_enterhaak.flavour.0: "He grabbed plushies with it. You grab Mikas with it."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z4baas_enterhaak: +15 % damage to creatures that are Sticky
vadsrijk.loot.z4baas_kaasdoek.flavour.0: "It still smells of Pinkie's toe cheese. A lot."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z4baas_kaasdoek: below 30 % Chonk you run faster for 3 s (30 s cooldown)
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.onder: He's been sulking at the bottom of the lagoon for years
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.onder: He steals plushies. With a kite.
vadsrijk.huisdier.zeeslurfje.tekst: A teeny-tiny pink sea cow with a little snoot. Snorts bubbles when he's happy.
vadsrijk.huisdier.zeeslurfje.bron: Cheer up The Gray Sea Snoot in Coral Bay
vadsrijk.huisdier.vliegertje.tekst: Pinkie's war kite, now pink and sweet. Flutters along behind you.
vadsrijk.huisdier.vliegertje.bron: Defeat Pinkie in the Wreck of the Kite Catcher
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenwanten.flavour.0: "Snip-snap, just like a crab. But nice."
vadsrijk.loot.lampioncape.flavour.0: "Flutters like a string of lanterns in the wind."
vadsrijk.loot.koraalwantjes.flavour.1: "Knitted by a coral goblin. He had help."
vadsrijk.loot.vliegercape.flavour.0: "With every gust you feel like a kite for a moment."
vadsrijk.loot.vliegercape.flavour.1: "There's still a bit of kite string on it."
vadsrijk.loot.zeeglasarmband.flavour.0: "Every bit of glass was polished round by the waves."
vadsrijk.ambacht.oogst.niet_hier: That only works in the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.ambacht.oogst.leeg: This spot is empty for now. It'll come back somewhere else soon.
vadsrijk.ambacht.oogst.afk: You've been standing in the same spot for a while: the harvest is halved. Walk around a bit!
vadsrijk.ambacht.korf.vol: You already have enough hives (max %s at this level).
vadsrijk.ambacht.korf.neergezet: Your hive is up! Your bees are off to fetch nectar for %s.
vadsrijk.ambacht.korf.leeg: The combs aren't full yet. Come back later.
vadsrijk.ambacht.korf.boos: Too fast! The bees are a bit grumpy (you're a little sticky).
vadsrijk.ambacht.tip.korf: Your bees fly to the flowers around your hive. The more flowers, the faster the combs fill up.
vadsrijk.ambacht.alleen_rijk: This food only works in the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.ambacht.eten.feest_mee: %s shares a feast with you! So snug!
vadsrijk.ambacht.eten.duur: 30 minutes · one food buff at a time · stays when you faint
vadsrijk.ambacht.eten.feest: For your whole party within 10 blocks + Snug (30 min)
vadsrijk.ambacht.eigenschap.eerste_klap: First hit on a creature +%s%% damage
vadsrijk.ambacht.mw.geen_set: Custom gear never counts for a set bonus.
vadsrijk.ambacht.werk.te_laag: Your level is still too low for this recipe.
vadsrijk.ambacht.werk.geen_massa: Custom gear is made one at a time.
vadsrijk.ambacht.werk.niet_hier: That only works at this workbench.
vadsrijk.ambacht.werk.te_ver: You're too far from the workbench.
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.maak: %s wants you to make something %s times with %s.
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.verzamel: %s wants you to gather %s things with %s.
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.weekkist: Twelve orders this week: a Crafting Chest for you!
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.kist_open: In the chest: Core Splinters, something rare, 5 silver and Craft Tokens!
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.leeg: No orders for you yet. Get a bit better at a profession first!
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.week: This week: %s/%s orders (then a Crafting Chest)
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.week_klaar: This week: %s/%s, you got your weekly chest!
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.waar: Have a look at %s, around x %s, z %s.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.smid.hallo: Welcome to the smithy! Here I forge made-to-measure weapons, helmets and breastplates. You pick the bonuses, I add a little extra sock.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.naai.hallo: Come on into the sewing studio! Pants, little shoes, and hats and decor for your home. All stitched with love.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.kok.hallo: Smell that? In the kitchen we make food with buffs: half an hour stronger, and it stays when you faint!
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.brouw.hallo: Blub blub! In the brewery I make potions, and I cut crystals: three rough ones become one cut one.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.mijn.hallo: Hey, little miner! There are ore spots all over the Chonkdom. Only you can see yours.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.mijn.uitleg: Right-click an ore spot and tap the sparkly bit three times. Tap it well and you get chonky ore! Sneak-click skips the minigame.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.hout.hallo: Hello, little woodcutter! By the trees there are stumps you can chop. Chop to the rhythm and you get chonky wood.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.hout.uitleg: Right-click a stump and tap the pink twice. Every stump comes back after a minute, but somewhere else!
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.pluk.hallo: Hi, little picker! Herbs and fibers grow in the meadows. Pick them gently and they stay whole.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.pluk.uitleg: Right-click a plant, HOLD the mouse button and let go in the green bit. Too long? Then it's squished.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.vis.hallo: Ahoy, fishy friend! Where the water bubbles, there are fish. At night and in the rain, other kinds bite.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.vis.uitleg: Right-click a bubbling spot, wait until you see 'Bite!' and then click right away. Too early? Then the fish gets spooked.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.imker.hallo: Bzzzz! Welcome to the bee stable. Put your own hive by the flowers and your bees will fetch nectar.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.imker.uitleg: Click an empty hive spot to place your hive. Come back later: the more flowers, the faster the combs fill up. Harvesting = giving smoke (hold, let go in the green).
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.bord.hallo: Hello! This is where the town's orders and the players' requests hang. And in the Craft Shop you trade in your tokens.
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z1_pluk_kamp: the meadow by the campfire of Camp Snuggle
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z1_vis_druipmeer: the lake in the Drip Shaft
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z3_vis_honingvijv: the honey ponds in the canopy
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z3_korf_bloesemda: the bee meadow in Toadblossom Dale
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z3_korf_kever: the bee meadow in the Glowbeetle Woods
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.0.0: Do you know what this is? A splinter of the Anvil of the Order. Once, the whole city forged on it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.0.2: The Gray Emperor smashed it to pieces. Find the pieces and become a real smith. Here, a bit of iron to practice with.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.1.0: Your strikes are getting steadier! I heard there's a piece of the anvil in the Drip Caves.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.1.2: Good. And remember: a made-to-measure sword is just as sweet as a made-to-measure cuddle.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.2.0: The second piece was in the Mirror Keep. It reflected my own face... the face of a happy smith.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.2.2: Just a few. Every piece makes the anvil warmer. Go on, feel it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.3.0: With amber copper from The Duskroot the anvil almost sings. Almost!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.3.2: A smith who forges with heart. That's you, I think.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.4.0: The anvil is whole! Hear that? KLIIING. That's the sound of the Order laughing again.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.4.2: Thanks to you, Journeyman. I'll send a little mining helmet to your home, as a keepsake.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.0.0: I'm sewing a giant quilt for Highchonk, with a patch from every zone.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.0.1: A quilt of the whole Chonkdom?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.0.2: Exactly! Start with fluff cotton. Soft, pink and a little stubborn.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.1.0: The Shroomsbury patch is done. There's a tiny little Blob King embroidered on it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.1.2: Now the Splinter Peaks. For that I need crystal flax, it glitters so nicely.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.2.0: The ice patch crackles when you pet it. Highchonk is going to love this.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.2.2: Everyone who's cold. Even the Emperor, if he ever wants to.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.3.0: Dusk silk! Look how purple it shines. The patch from The Duskroot will be the prettiest one.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.3.1: Can I help with the stitches?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.3.2: You're already doing half, sweetie. Your stitches are just as neat as mine.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.4.0: The quilt is finished! Three zones, three patches, and still room for more.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.4.2: First a little present: a Blob Giant Plushie, for your home. Journeyman Sewer, that's you now.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.0.0: Granny Trudy had a recipe book. 'Back when the blobs were still pink', it says. The pages have blown away.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.0.2: All over the Chonkdom! Start with her Blob Pudding. I still know that recipe by heart.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.1.0: I found a page in a fishing net! There's a fish stew on it, with a sauce stain.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.1.1: Does it taste like the olden days?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.1.2: It tastes like Sunday. Keep cooking and we'll find more.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.2.0: This page was frozen in the Splinter Peaks: Candy Soup. Granny wrote next to it: 'for cold paws'.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.2.1: I'll make a whole pot right away!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.3.0: Honey Pancake! With a little drawing of a bee. Granny couldn't draw, look at those legs.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.3.2: It doesn't matter. What matters is that it's yummy.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.4.0: The last page. 'The cookie the Emperor never got.' The rest has been rubbed out...
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.4.1: Maybe we can bake it someday?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.4.2: Someday, Journeyman Cook. Someday. Here, a chef's apron for your home, so you won't forget.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.0.0: Blub! Do you know why the crystals are turning gray? Me neither. But I'm going to find out!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.0.2: Brew a Chonk Potion first. Whoever can brew pink can beat gray.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.1.0: I put a gray crystal in the cauldron. It got... a little less gray!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.1.2: Blob clover and one really big cuddly thought. Science!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.2.0: Cut crystals keep the gray out better. That's why we cut them!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.3.0: With honey from The Duskroot the pink stays even at night! The un-gray potion is getting closer.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.3.2: The Honey Elixir. Sounds fancy, tastes like summer.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.4.0: It works! One drop of Honey Elixir and a gray crystal starts to shine. The Chonk Pipes will be so happy.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.4.2: We sure did, Journeyman Brewer. Here, a Mini King Blob for your shelf.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.0.0: Bonk! Every vein in the Chonkdom is a little bit of chonk sleeping under the ground.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.0.2: Exactly! Here, some fluff iron to start with. Tap the sparkly bit.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.1.0: There's a Mika who sucks veins empty with a cheese gas pump. Have you seen him?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.1.2: I swear it. You can still smell it. Keep your eyes open.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.2.0: Candy silver glitters in the Splinter Gorge. And deep inside an ice cave there's a secret vein...
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.2.2: Go and look. The Exploration Book keeps track of which spots you've found.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.3.0: Amber copper! Warm as a campfire. The roots of the tree protect it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.3.2: That's the tree rumbling. It likes you.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.4.0: You're a real miner. You find glitter veins like the best of them now.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.4.2: Haha, exactly like that! Journeyman Miner. I'll send a little mining helmet to your home.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.0.0: You don't just go chopping wood. First you thank the tree.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.0.2: Well done. Here, some shroom stem to practice with. Chop to the rhythm: nyeg-nyeg.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.1.0: Every stump you chop grows back somewhere else. The forest dances a little.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.1.2: They move house! That's why you have to look around carefully.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.2.0: Crystal pine from the Splinter Peaks. It rings like a little bell when you tap it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.2.2: Tink! Yes. Lovely wood for a bow.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.3.0: Duskwood cries pink resin. Not sad tears, mind you, just happy sap.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.3.2: Happy sap. Smiths use it for their best work.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.4.0: You chop like a real forest guh. The forest whispers your name.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.4.2: 'Thank you.' Journeyman Woodcutter! Here, an Overshroom Statuette for your home.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.0.0: Plants are just like guhs: if you hold them gently, they stay whole.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.0.2: Exactly! Here, some blob clover and fluff cotton to start with.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.1.0: Sometimes a golden clover grows on the Blob Meadow. On glitter spots, if you're lucky.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.1.2: Take your time. Rushing squishes the leaves.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.2.0: Ice flowers never melt. They think it's always winter.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.2.2: Oh no, they love it. Just like snow guhs.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.3.0: Glowbeetle herb gives off light, because the glowbeetles sleep on it at night.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.3.2: Clever! You already know almost as much as I do.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.4.0: My garden hat has gotten too small for all your know-how. Journeyman Picker!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.4.2: Here, your very own garden hat, for your home.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.0.0: Fishing is waiting, and waiting is cuddling with time.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.0.1: How do I know when to click?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.0.2: When you see 'Bite!'. Not before. The fish is just as shy as you are.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.1.0: At night, different fish bite. The moon perch, for example.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.1.2: Then the splash guppy comes up to dance.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.2.0: The mirror trout swims in the Splinter Peaks. If you look closely, your reflection waves back.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.3.0: The lanternfish has her own little lamp. At night you can see her from far away.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.3.2: If you're patient, she'll come to you.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.4.0: You're a real fisher. Do you know what lies beyond The Duskroot? The Lantern Coast. They dive for coral there...
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.4.2: Someday! Journeyman Fisher. Here, a fisher's hat for your home.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.0.0: Bees are guhs with little wings. They share everything, just like us.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.0.1: Can I have a hive too?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.0.2: Of course! Put it near lots of flowers. The more flowers, the faster the honey.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.1.0: Every meadow gives a different honey: blossom honey, dusk honey, root honey.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.1.1: I want to taste them all!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.1.2: Then you'll have to put a hive everywhere. On to the next meadow!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.2.0: Watch out for the Mika Beekeeper. He sucks the combs empty with a cheese pump.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.2.2: Mean, yes. But our bees are smarter. They hide the best honey.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.3.0: Your bees already know your voice. Can you hear them buzzing when you come near?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.3.2: Just like that. Sometimes you'll find royal jelly: the yummiest thing in the hive.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.4.0: You're a real beekeeper. The bees have made you an honorary member.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.4.2: Journeyman Beekeeper! Here, a beekeeper's hat for your home. Bzzzz.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.uit: You already know my whole story. Go on and enjoy your profession!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.wacht: Come back when your %2$s is level %1$s, then I'll tell you more.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.post: A keepsake is on its way home by Post: %s
vadsrijk.ambacht.mini.mijnen: Fluff vein! Tap the sparkly bit!
vadsrijk.ambacht.mini.plukken: Gently! Hold and let go in the green
vadsrijk.ambacht.mini.imkeren: Smoke! Hold and let go in the green
vadsrijk.ambacht.hud.korf_vrij: Free hive spot (%2$s): click to place your hive
vadsrijk.ambacht.hud.uitgerust: Rested: %s min of double profession xp

item.guhs.vr_amb_honingkarper.uitleg: Comes up when it rains. Tastes like honey (T3).

item.guhs.vr_amb_bijenwas.uitleg: For candles, decor and the sewing studio.
item.guhs.vr_amb_koninginnengelei.uitleg: Rare: the yummiest thing in the hive. For the Honey Elixir.

vadsrijk.z5wezens.mika.weg.1: The Ring Finger will hear about this!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.sparren.start: On your marks... get set... spar! (dodge the red strip, don't hit the pink shield)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.sparren.bezet: This knight is already sparring with someone else.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.sparren.eerst_klikken: Right-click the knight first to spar.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.sparren.verloren.klapp: Three pillow bonks: the knight wins this round. Practice a little more!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.sparren.gewonnen: ✦ Well fought! The knight bows. (Trial Tokens: %s)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.buik_in: You climb down through the maintenance hatch... The Belly Tunnels.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.buik_uit: You climb back up to the cellar of the Soup Kitchen.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.nest_in: Behind the loose plank... a secret Mika nest!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.nest_uit: You slip back into the Skyport.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.zuidvin_af: The cloud lift sinks down to the south fin.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.zuidvin_op: The cloud lift takes you back to the city.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.noordvin_af: The cloud lift sinks down to the north fin.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.noordvin_op: The cloud lift takes you back to the city.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.staart_af: The cloud lift sinks down to the tail fin.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.staart_op: The cloud lift takes you back to Tail Park.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.wolkwaldroom_uit: You climb up the ladder, back to the middle blowhole.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.hint.buik_in: A maintenance hatch (right-click): to the Belly Tunnels
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.hint.zuidvin_af: Cloud lift to the south fin (right-click)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.hint.noordvin_af: Cloud lift to the north fin (right-click)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.hint.staart_af: Cloud lift to the tail fin (right-click)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.vangnet: A little cloud catches you! Phew.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.set.6: (6) Cloud Pillow: below 30% Chonk a cloud catches you (Snuggle Shield 20% of your max Chonk, 6 s; 1x per 45 s)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.fase3.onder: Turn at least three back open
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.kleppen_eerst: He's too tough like this: turn the valves open first!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.klep_open: This valve is open. Well done!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.klep_weer_open: Hot air is flowing again! (%s still shut)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.alles_dicht: No hot air, no whale! Everything SHUT!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.weg: My valves... this goes in my report!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.fase2.onder: Which Cloud Watcher is him? Look for the silver glint
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.fase3.onder: Turn the gray gas valves shut
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.welke: Five Cloud Watchers... which one is him? (silver glint by the tail)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.gevonden: Found him! He's off balance for a moment: +50% damage!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.vermom: Find me if you can, knight. I am everyone and no one.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.betrapt: How... how did you see that?!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.ontsnap: Enough! I'm flying off through the blowhole, and the whale goes gray!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.ventielen_eerst: He's holding on tight: turn the gray gas valves shut first!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.weg: The Ring Finger... will... not be pleased...
vadsrijk.z5wezens.db.fase3.onder: He sucks in more often and strikes double lightning
vadsrijk.z5wezens.db.kussen: He's going to suck you in! Jump onto a pink cloud pillow!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.db.slag_mis: Not enough of you in the yellow circle!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.db.blij: Hee hee hee... it tickles... I'm pink again!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.bezeten_oefenpop: That training dummy moved! Gray fluff has crept inside it. Red circle = it spins around: step away. Beat it and the fluff blows right out.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.sparringridder: The knight swings a pillow along the red strip: step out of it. Pink sparkle on his shield = he's blocking, wait a moment. Three pillow bonks and you lose (it doesn't hurt).
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.mika_saboteur: Red circle = that's where he throws a gas wrench. Stay out of the gray cloud, it makes you sticky.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.mika_lontlegger: He keeps his distance and throws cheese bombs (red circle). Run up to him: up close, he runs away.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.grauwe_pluismijt: They nibble at the whale. Small and fast: hits that strike several mites at once work best.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.grauwe_wolkduivel: A red stripe under you = he's diving. Step aside!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.mistslier: Gray circle = mist. Anyone who stays in it can barely see and gets sticky. Walk out of it.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.mika_harpoenier: Red line = his harpoon. If it hits you, he pulls you toward him.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.vermomde_mika: Not every Cloud Watcher is real! A red circle behind you = he appears there. Step away.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.zilverstaart: Five Cloud Watchers? One of them is him: look for the SILVER glint by the tail. Hitting a decoy costs you some Chonk.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.zilverstaart: Is he escaping? Close the three gray gas valves (right-click, 3x).
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.gorgonzola: He shuts the warm-air valves. Right-click a closed valve 3x to turn it open again.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.gorgonzola: Every closed valve makes him tougher and lets the cold in.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.donderbuik: Pink circles = cloud cushions. Stand on one when he starts sucking, or he'll pull you to his belly.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.donderbuik: Yellow circle: stand in it together and you share the thunderclap.
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachthelm.flavour.0: "Polished until you can see your own ears in it."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachthelm.flavour.1: "It comes with a little feather. Always."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachtkuras.flavour.0: "Light as a cloud, sturdy as a cuddle."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachtkuras.flavour.1: "On the chest: an embroidered little whale."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachthandschoenen.flav: "The little Cloudwatch crest is on them."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkring.flavour.0: "A teeny tiny cloud swirls around inside."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkring.flavour.1: "Cool on your finger, warm in your heart."
vadsrijk.loot.walvisketting.flavour.0: "A singing little shell from Mother Cloudwhale."
vadsrijk.loot.walvisketting.flavour.1: "Hold it to your ear and you'll hear her humming."
vadsrijk.loot.regendruppeloorbel.flavour: "Sparkles in every color of the rainbow."
vadsrijk.loot.stormarmband.flavour.0: "Crackles a bit when you put it on."
vadsrijk.loot.stormarmband.flavour.1: "Forged in a thunderstorm. A small thunderstorm."
vadsrijk.loot.stormarmband.flavour.2: "It makes your hair stand on end."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachtzwaard.flavour.0: "The sword of the Cloudwatch: sharp, but polite."
vadsrijk.loot.walvisbotknots.flavour.0: "An old baby bone of Mother Cloudwhale's. She had plenty to spare."
vadsrijk.loot.stormboog.flavour.1: "Arrows as fast as the wind above the clouds."
vadsrijk.loot.stormboog.flavour.2: "Cloud Watchers use it to shoot kites loose."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkenstaf.flavour.0: "On top spins a little cloud that rains on whoever needs it."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkenstaf.flavour.1: "Your heals smell like rain on a summer day."
vadsrijk.loot.bliksemstaf.flavour.0: "A little tube of lightning in a glass orb."
vadsrijk.loot.z5baas_vermommingsmantel.f: "Turn it inside out and you're someone else. Almost."
vadsrijk.loot.z5baas_moersleutel.flavour: "He turned valves shut with it. You turn them open again."
"A piece of Thunderbelly, now pink and cheerful."
"Now it only rains little pink drops. And only on you."
vadsrijk.huisdier.donderbuikje.tekst: A teeny-tiny pink rain cloud that tickles when it rains.
vadsrijk.huisdier.donderbuikje.bron: Defeat Thunderbelly on the Tail Flats.
vadsrijk.huisdier.warmpje.tekst: A little puff of warm air that escaped when you turned the valves open.
vadsrijk.huisdier.warmpje.bron: Defeat Overseer Gorgonzola in the Belly Tunnels.
vadsrijk.huisdier.lokpopje.tekst: One of Silvertail's decoys. It wants to belong to you now.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.eigen.duinhupp: A bouncy beach hare. Jumps the highest of all (almost 6 blocks), but runs a bit slower.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.eigen.wolkwalk: A young cloudwhale on its own little cloud. Floats: falls very softly and can jump once more in the air.
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.eigen.zwamzwij: A sturdy piglet with a mushroom saddle. The first tap doesn't scare it.
vadsrijk.economie.stal.nog_niet.duinhupp: Secret: find 10 hidden plushies in the Chonkdom. Then a dune hopper comes to have a look.
vadsrijk.economie.stal.nog_niet.wolkwalk: Trade in 20 Golden Feathers (from the Wahoog bosses and the weekly chest).

vadsrijk.economie.pluimkleur.bron.krista: Defeat Mirrorsigh in the Mirror Keep (zone 2).

vadsrijk.huisdier.kracht.koninklijk_kuss: Outside of fights you get a bit of Chonk back every second.

vadsrijk.huisdier.kracht.snuffeltje.teks: Picks up your loot lying close by.

vadsrijk.huisdier.snuffel: %s smells something! Follow the golden trail...
vadsrijk.huisdieren.geen_schade: Pets don't fight and never get hit: they help you.

vadsrijk.items.smid.talisman_aan: If it fails, you won't lose a star.

vadsrijk.items.doorgroei.cap: This piece is already at the highest tier.
vadsrijk.items.doorgroei.vertrouwd: Wear it until Trusted 5 first (defeat creatures while you wear it).
vadsrijk.items.doorgroei.geen_pluis: You don't have enough Growth Fluff (from bosses).
vadsrijk.items.overvads.verpluisd: A frayed piece can't do that. Repair it first.
vadsrijk.items.overvads.kies: Pick a bonus from the old piece.
vadsrijk.items.overvads.kies_offer: Pick a different piece to offer up.
vadsrijk.items.overvads.vol: There's no room for another bonus: pick one to replace.
vadsrijk.items.overvads.past_niet: That bonus can't go on this kind of piece.

vadsrijk.items.overvads.lief: A sweet little miss: the bonus came over, but a bit lower.
