vadsrijk.z5wereld.vangnet: A soft little cloud catches you and sets you back on Mother Cloudwhale.
vadsrijk.puzzels.al_opgelost: You've solved this one before. A little puzzling is always allowed!
vadsrijk.puzzels.rust: Solved! The puzzle will reset itself in a moment.
vadsrijk.puzzels.fout: Hmm, that's not right. Everything goes back to the start.
vadsrijk.puzzels.nacht: The star stones are still asleep. Come back when it's dark!
vadsrijk.puzzels.tijd.op: Time's up! Click the lantern to start over.
vadsrijk.puzzels.luister: The stone is listening... whisper your answer in chat.
vadsrijk.puzzels.herstel: Everything is back in its place.
vadsrijk.puzzels.duw.vast: The block can't go that way.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.uitleg: Right-click to read. There are nine.
vadsrijk.puzzels.tip.eerste: A puzzle! The bottom of your screen always shows what to do. Can't get it? After a few tries you'll get a tip.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.1.tekst: Long ago, at the edge of the world, there lived an ordinary little Mika. No stronger than the rest. No smarter. Just... hungrier.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.2.tekst: He stole his first cheese nibble from a guh. When he ate it, for one second he felt something warm in his tummy. Chonk! And then it was gone again.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.3.tekst: So he took another one. And another. What he didn't understand, and what every guh knows: chonk only grows when you share it. What you grab melts in your pawsies.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.4.tekst: He had to grab more and more and reach further and further. First his own land, then his neighbors', century after century. That's why Mikas say: 'The Emperor has long arms.'
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.5.tekst: He emptied his own land completely: gray, skinny and silent. Then he put on a stolen little crown. It was too small. He called himself Emperor anyway.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.6.tekst: He built a castle around one single thing: the Empty Bowl, a bowl as big as a lake. All the chonk in the world has to go into it. It has never been full.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.7.tekst: That's why his castle is called Neverenough. Gray Chonk Pipes run to it like rivers, from every land he already has in his grip.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.8.tekst: The second moon is no moon. It's a gray lantern the Emperor hung above the west, to see where there's still chonk. Mikas call it the Eye.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.9.tekst: Mikas scare each other at night: 'If you share your nibble, the Emperor will come and get you.' But in the margin someone has written: 'Maybe he never got a cookie.'
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_kleurplaten.uitleg: Step on the plates in the right order. First the grass, then a blushing cheek, then the sky, and last of all the sun.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_kleurplaten.hint1: Grass is green, a blushing cheek is pink...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_kleurplaten.hint2: The order is: green, pink, blue, yellow.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_kleurplaten.aanwij: By the first campfire of the Blob Meadow lie four colored plates.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_zwammenlied.uitleg: Click the Demo Stone and listen. Then play the song back on the singing shroom stones.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_zwammenlied.hint1: Watch closely which stone lights up. The song has five notes, and one stone sings twice.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_zwammenlied.hint2: Left, right, middle, right, and then the stone at the front.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_zwammenlied.aanwij: In the Sporewood the stones sing a little song, right by the campfire.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_lichtstraal.uitleg: Turn the mirrors (click them) until the light beam hits the light target.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_lichtstraal.hint1: Follow the beam from the light stone. Where it hits a mirror, it bends.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_lichtstraal.hint2: The beam has to go down twice and right once. You don't need the bottom-left and top-right mirrors.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_lichtstraal.aanwij: Among the light beams of the Sporewood, one has lost its way.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_gebarsten_muur.uit: A little wall with a crack in it. There's something behind it...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_gebarsten_muur.aan: By the lowest campfire of the Drip Caves stands a little wall with a crack.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_fluistersteen.uitl: Click the stone and whisper the answer in chat.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_fluistersteen.hint: Every guh knows it: it only grows when you share it.
The word has five letters and it's a bar on your screen.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_fluistersteen.aanw: At the back of the Blob Meadow, a stone whispers among the flowers.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_fluistersteen.vraa: I don't get less when you give me away, I get MORE. What am I?
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_sterrenveld.uitleg: Only at night! Read the star map and make the right star stones light up. Then press the button.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_sterrenveld.hint1: The constellation is called The Snuggle Star: it's a little heart.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_sterrenveld.hint2: Click the star map again: each star on the map is one stone. Top row: the 2nd and 4th stone.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_sterrenveld.aanwij: On Hat Hopper Meadow lie stones that only wake up at night.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_vuurtorenschuur.ui: A little shed without a door handle...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_vuurtorenschuur.hi: Take a look behind the shed, between the little bushes.
There's a little lever behind the shed.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_vuurtorenschuur.aa: At Camp Snuggle, by the lighthouse, there's a little shed that never opens.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_symboolslot.uitleg: Turn the symbol stones (click) and press the button. The old temple wall said: what you feel, what you see and what you dream.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_symboolslot.hint1: Feeling is done with your heart. Seeing is done in the night sky.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_symboolslot.aanwij: On the way to the Shroom Temple stand three turning stones.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsschuif.uitleg: Push the ice blocks (click them) onto the pink squares. Stuck? Press the reset button.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsschuif.hint1: A block moves away from the side you push it from. You can't pull!
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsschuif.hint2: The left block goes down twice, the right block goes up twice.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsschuif.aanwijzi: By Snuggle Lake lie ice blocks that want to go home.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristallied.uitleg: The Echo Slopes sing back. Listen to the Demo Stone and play the song back.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristallied.hint1: The song has six notes. It starts and ends at the stone in the middle.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristallied.hint2: Middle, bottom left, top left, bottom right, top right, middle.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristallied.aanwij: On the Echo Slopes stand stones that know a song.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristalspiegels.ui: Turn the crystal mirrors until the light beam hits the target at the top right.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristalspiegels.hi: The beam has to go up before it can go right. Not every mirror takes part.
Up at the first mirror, right at the mirror above it, up, and then all the way right.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristalspiegels.aa: In the Splinter Gorge, light breaks in crystals.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_poollicht.uitleg: Only at night! Copy the constellation from the star map with the star stones and press the button.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_poollicht.hint1: The constellation is called The Crystal: a diamond with a dot in the middle.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_poollicht.hint2: Middle row: the 1st, 3rd and 5th stone. The corners stay dark.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_poollicht.aanwijzi: By Snuggle Lake lie star stones that only wake up at night.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_lantaarnsprint.uit: Click the lantern and jump across the crystal pillars to the finish plate. You have 25 seconds!
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_lantaarnsprint.hin: You don't need to run: jumping from pillar to pillar is fastest.
Straight ahead, then up at the corner, and at the top back to the left.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_lantaarnsprint.aan: On the Echo Slopes stands a lantern with a stopwatch.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsgrot.uitleg: A little ice wall with a crack...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsgrot.aanwijzing: Right by the western campfire of the Splinter Gorge there's a crack in the ice.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_raadselsteen.uitle: Click the stone and whisper the answer in chat.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_raadselsteen.hint1: In winter, Snuggle Lake is made of it all over.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_raadselsteen.hint2: Three letters. You can skate on it.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_raadselsteen.aanwi: By the Lakeside Camp, a stone is shivering with cold.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_raadselsteen.vraag: I'm a lake that wants to stand still. I'm slippery and cold, and in the sun I melt away. What am I?
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelplaten.uitle: Step on the plates in the right order. The sun wakes up, the sky turns blue, the blossom blushes and the moss grows too.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelplaten.hint1: The sun is yellow, the blossom is pink.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelplaten.aanwi: Along the Root Road, in the east, lie four colored plates.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_bijenlied.uitleg: The bees of the Honeybough always hummed a little song. Listen to the Demo Stone and hum along.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_bijenlied.hint1: The song has six notes and no stone sings twice.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_bijenlied.hint2: Back row the first two, then front row right and left, then back row the last two.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_bijenlied.aanwijzi: Below the Honeybough, along the Root Road, singing stones are buzzing.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelschuif.uitle: Push the root knots (click them) onto the squares. Stuck? The reset button puts everything back.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelschuif.hint1: First look where you have to STAND to push a knot the right way.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelschuif.hint2: Start with the knot at the bottom right: down once.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelschuif.aanwi: On the west side of the Root Road, knots lie all crooked.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_lantaarnloop.uitle: Click the lantern and run across the honey pillars to the finish plate. You have 30 seconds!
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_lantaarnloop.hint1: Start at the bottom and go counterclockwise. Some pillars are a dead end.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_lantaarnloop.hint2: Bottom row to the right, right side up, top row to the left.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_lantaarnloop.aanwi: Along the Root Road in the southwest, a lantern stands among honey pillars.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_mossymbolen.uitleg: Turn the symbol stones and press the button. The old moss rhyme goes like this: first green, then wet, then warm, and green again.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_mossymbolen.hint1: What's green on a tree? What's wet? What's warm?
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_mossymbolen.aanwij: By the Root Vault stand four mossy turning stones.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_schorsdeur.uitleg: A little bark house without a door handle...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_schorsdeur.hint1: Take a look behind the little house, between the little bushes.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_schorsdeur.hint2: There's a little lever behind the house.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_schorsdeur.aanwijz: Along the Root Road in the southeast stands a little house without a door handle.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_honingfluister.uit: Click the stone and whisper the answer in chat.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_honingfluister.hin: Take a look at the hives on the Honeybough.
Three letters, and it rhymes with 'tree'.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_honingfluister.aan: By the Mossfoot, a stone is buzzing.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_honingfluister.vra: I buzz and I dance, I make something sweet, and I live with a thousand sisters on the Honeybough. What am I?
vadsrijk.npc.reis.kies.z5_havenmeester: Where to? Pick below, or look at the travel map.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.hoogvads: Highchonk is still floating too high. First Mother Cloudwhale has to sink low over the sea (the Lantern Coast story), and you need to be at least level 55. You are level %s now.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.hoogvads.kort: After the Lantern Coast, from level 55
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_knuffelridder.te: Highchonk is saved, Knight. The Cloudwatch wants to give you the highest title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 58 as a Snuggle Knight and come back to Captain Springfeather on the Academy training ground.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_knuffelridder.be: Level 58 as a Snuggle Knight, then to Captain Springfeather on the Academy training ground.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_knuffelridder.do: Reach level 58 as a Snuggle Knight
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_knuffelridder.aa: A Knight of Highchonk with only two titles? That won't do. It's not in the rulebook. I just checked.
Reach level 58 as a Snuggle Knight. Then the whole Cloudwatch will march for you. Left, right, left, cuddle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_knuffelridder.kl: Cloudwatch, atten-shuuun! For the hero of Highchonk: the highest title of the Snuggle Order!
Your specialization is now at its strongest. Call me Feather. No, call me 'Captain'. No, Feather after all.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_pluisjager.tekst: Highchonk is saved, Knight. The Cloudwatch wants to give you the highest title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 58 as a Fluff Hunter and come back to Captain Springfeather on the Academy training ground.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_pluisjager.bezig: Level 58 as a Fluff Hunter, then to Captain Springfeather on the Academy training ground.
Reach level 58 as a Fluff Hunter
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_pluisjager.aanbo: A Knight of Highchonk with only two titles? That won't do. It's not in the rulebook. I just checked.
Reach level 58 as a Fluff Hunter. Then the whole Cloudwatch will march for you. Left, right, left, cuddle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_pluisjager.klaar: Cloudwatch, atten-shuuun! For the hero of Highchonk: the highest title of the Snuggle Order!
Your specialization is now at its strongest. Call me Feather. No, call me 'Captain'. No, Feather after all.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_vadsmagier.tekst: Highchonk is saved, Knight. The Cloudwatch wants to give you the highest title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 58 as a Chonk Mage and come back to Captain Springfeather on the Academy training ground.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_vadsmagier.bezig: Level 58 as a Chonk Mage, then to Captain Springfeather on the Academy training ground.
Reach level 58 as a Chonk Mage
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_vadsmagier.aanbo: A Knight of Highchonk with only two titles? That won't do. It's not in the rulebook. I just checked.
Reach level 58 as a Chonk Mage. Then the whole Cloudwatch will march for you. Left, right, left, cuddle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_vadsmagier.klaar: Cloudwatch, atten-shuuun! For the hero of Highchonk: the highest title of the Snuggle Order!
Your specialization is now at its strongest. Call me Feather. No, call me 'Captain'. No, Feather after all.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.schildridder.kort: Steady combos with your pillow sword. Catch hits on your Snuggle Shield, then strike back hard. Want to tank? The Tank branch sits right next to it in your skill tree.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_spec_schildridd: You chose Shield Knight at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.reuzenkussen.kort: Slow, huge sweeps that also hit everything around your target, and leaps that shake the ground. A club or fluff hammer feels extra good here.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_spec_reuzenkuss: You chose Giant Pillow at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.scherpschutter.kor: Long range and critical hits. Your arrows curve to the target, far shots hit harder, and your Snuggle Arrow becomes a charged shot.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_spec_scherpschu: You chose Sharpshooter at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.strikkenzetter.kor: Quick shots, snares and fluff traps. You hold foes in place, make them sticky and wear them down over time. Strong against groups. Want to help your group? The Support branch sits next to it.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_spec_strikkenze: You chose Snare Setter at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.sterrenwever.kort: Elemental bursts: your Fireball leaves a puddle, every third spell is free, and later the ice shatters and the ground burns.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_spec_sterrenwev: You chose Star Weaver at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.zegenzanger.rol: Songs that hurt foes and help friends
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.zegenzanger.kort: You sing while you fight: your song makes you and your group stronger, and every 2 s a song pulse hits every foe around you. Want to heal? The Heal branch sits next to it.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_spec_zegenzange: You chose Blessing Singer at your first job advancement.
Your shield is your best friend.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.schildridder: Double Smack: Pillow Bonk swings again (60 %). Counter: catch a hit with your Snuggle Shield and your next Pillow Bonk within 4 s does 50 % more.
Crystal Wall: while your Snuggle Shield is up, every foe that hits you freezes for 3 s. Pillow Bonk does 40 % more to frozen foes.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.schildridder.2: Crystal Wall: shield freezes, +40 % vs frozen
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.schildridder: Bulwark Flomp: Wahoog Flomp does 30 % more and stuns everything it hits for 2 s. Pillow Bonk does 15 % more.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.reuzenkussen: Giant Sweep: your basic hits do 30 % more and also hit foes within 3 blocks of your target (50 %). Pillow Bonk does 60 % more but recharges 1 s slower.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.reuzenkussen.1: Giant Sweep: swings that hit everything
The ground shakes when you land.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.reuzenkussen: Pillow Roll: Storm Leap does 60 % more, is ready 2 s sooner and stuns what it hits for 1 s.
Nest Form: Wahoog Flomp does 30 % more and its wind pulls every foe within 8 blocks to the middle. Basic hits 10 % harder on top.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.scherpschutte: One eye closed, one shot home.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.scherpschutt: Falcon Gaze: your arrows curve a little to the target, +8 % crit chance and +15 % crit damage. Far shots: basic shots at foes further than 10 blocks do 30 % more.
Charged Arrow: your Snuggle Arrow does 80 % more damage to foes.
Canopy Falcon: Star Shot does 40 % more plus another quarter as true damage, right through shields. Basic shots 8 % harder.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.strikkenzett: Flip Volley: in the middle of your Roll Flip you fire 3 arrows at the nearest foe. Snare: where you roll away, a trap stays for 6 s: whoever steps in sticks for 3 s and gets Spored (4 s of damage). Quick bow: 8 % attack speed.
Ice Star: every 5th basic shot that hits fires an ice star along (1x weapon damage, freezes 2 s). Star Shot freezes everything it pierces for 4 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.strikkenzette: The whole field is your trap.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.strikkenzett: Snare Rain: where Star Shot lands, a snare field lies for 5 s (radius 4): 40 % damage and Sticky every second. 8 % more attack speed.
The stars dance to your beat.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.sterrenwever: Your Pink Fireball leaves an element puddle for 3 s. Chonk Overflow: every 3rd skill gives its energy back; +10 % cooldown reduction and +8 % element damage.
Ice that sings as it breaks.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.sterrenwever: Mirror Echo: your Fireball freezes for 1.5 s; when it hits a foe that was already frozen, the ice shatters (1.2x damage, radius 3).
Where you cast, the ground glows.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.sterrenwever: Dusk Sage: Meteor Guh leaves a pink fire field for 5 s (30 % damage + Burning every second). 8 % more element damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.sterrenwever.3: Ult: fire field after Meteor Guh
Battle Song: you do 15 % more damage, your group within 10 blocks 8 % more. In a fight a song pulse hits every foe within 6 blocks every 2 s (50 % weapon damage).
Song Circle: your Chonk Spring sings along: for 6 s every foe inside takes 40 % weapon damage each second.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.zegenzanger.2: Song Circle: Chonk Spring hurts foes
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.zegenzanger.3: The final chord of the realm.
Final Chord: Meteor Guh does 30 % more and gives your group 8 s of Wahoog (+20 % damage).
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.geen.1: Job advancement 1, at class level 17, with the Grandmaster in Shroomsbury. What you get depends on your specialization.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_adv1.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 17.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_adv1.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 17.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_adv1.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 17.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.geen.2: Job advancement 2, at class level 35, in the Nest Chapel of Honeybough (zone 3). What you get depends on your specialization.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_adv2.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 35.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_adv2.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 35.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_adv2.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 35.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.geen.3: Job advancement 3, at class level 58, with Captain Springfeather in Highchonk (zone 5). What you get depends on your specialization.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.klaar1: ✦ Your %s is level 17! Go to Grandmaster Chonkfoot in Shroomsbury to choose your specialization.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.klaar2: ✦ Your %s is level 35! In zone 3, Order Master Waxie awaits you in the Nest Chapel (after the Cheese Zeppelin Yard).
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.klaar3: ✦ Your %s is level 58! After Mother Cloudwhale's lullaby, Captain Springfeather awaits you in Highchonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.stam.uitleg: For everyone in this class, whichever specialization you choose.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.zij.knuffelridder.u: Optional: get tougher and protect your group.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.zij.pluisjager.uitl: Optional: help your group with healing arrows, small shields and marks.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.dicht_nog: First choose your specialization (class level 17, with the Grandmaster).
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.dicht_ander: This is the other specialization. You can switch in any town at the class master.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_schildarm.uitle: More Defense and some Strength. Your shield is practically glued on.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_vaste_hand.uitl: More crit chance and faster swings.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_schildmeester.u: Defense, Strength and crit in one.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_schildmuur.uitl: Lots of Defense and harder crits.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_onbreekbaar.uit: Every hit you catch on your Snuggle Shield makes Pillow Bonk ready 1 s sooner.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_reuzenkracht.ui: Lots of Strength and extra Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_reuzenplof.uitl: After Storm Leap your next Pillow Bonk (within 4 s) does 60 % more damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_paladijnsaura.u: Every 2 s you and your group within 10 blocks heal 1.5 % of their Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_sluipschutter.u: More crit chance and much harder crits.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_strikkenweb.uit: Your basic shots do 25 % more damage to Sticky foes.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_zorgzaam.uitleg: More Heal Power and extra Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_sterrenvonk.uit: More Element Damage and some Wisdom.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_koorkracht.uitl: Lots of Wisdom and extra Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_slotlied.uitleg: Your Battle Song gives you 5 % more damage and the song pulse reaches 2 blocks further.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_warme_handen.ui: More Heal Power and some Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.onderkop: %s: two paths. Switch in any town at the class master (once per 10 minutes).
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.onderkop.kies: %s: choose your path! Both deal good damage, even solo.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.word.tip: Your first job advancement: a new title, a new power and your own branch in the skill tree.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.wissel.tip: Free. Your points in the old spec branch come back. Then wait 10 minutes.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.later.tip: You choose your specialization with Grandmaster Chonkfoot in Shroomsbury once your class is level 17.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.knop.tip: Look at both specializations of this class, or switch (once per 10 minutes, not in a fight).
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.gewisseld: ✦ You are now %s! Your points from the old branch are back.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.migratie: ✦ The classes have been renewed! Your skill tree was rearranged: all your points are back (free). Your job advancements were converted to the new system. Take a look with K.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.kies_nog: ✦ Your %s may still choose a specialization! Press K and click 'Choose your specialization'.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.al: You already have a specialization. Switch at the class master.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.nog_niet: You choose your specialization with Grandmaster Chonkfoot, at class level 17.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.balie: You can only switch in a town, at the class master.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.gevecht: Not in the middle of a fight! Wait until things calm down.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.arena: Not in a boss arena or dungeon.
vadsrijk.klassen.vergelijk.leeg: You're not wearing anything as %s yet:
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.ambacht.binnenkort: The workshops of the Crafters' Guild open soon. Come back then!
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.ambacht.gilde: The Crafters' Guild teaches you the Masterworks of nine professions. The doors open soon. Until then: practice in the workshops of your own town.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.vitrine.z5_vadszanger: In the glass display case lies a pink guh flute on a little cushion. The sign says: 'The Guh Flute. Weapon of the Chonk Singer.'
Below it, in fancy letters: 'Coming soon.'
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.vitrine.z5_pluisninja: In the display case lie two teeny-tiny fluff daggers, as soft as a cotton swab. 'The Fluff Daggers. Weapon of the Fluff Ninja.'
Below it, very small, almost invisible: 'Coming soon.'
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bord.zeker: Three clues point the same way: a tail, the Chancellery seal, and a soft spot for ripe cheese.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bord.nog_niet: Not enough evidence yet to point at anyone. Keep sleuthing!
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bord.fout: Inspector Snoop shakes his head. "No, no. Look at the evidence: %s"
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bord.juist.0: You point at Chancellor Softpelt. The Council Hall goes quiet. Very quiet.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bord.juist.1: "Me? Me? But I always hand out cookies!" His tail swishes under his cape. Everyone sees it.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.gevonden: New clue in your Detective's Notebook: %s (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.nog_niet: You have nothing to ask this councilor about yet. Follow Inspector Snoop's trail first.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.soep.kom: You ladle out a bowl of soup. It steams pink. "Thank you..." (%s/4)
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.soep.al: This Unchonked guh already has a bowl. She smiles at you with soup on her snout.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.zachtpels.karton: This is a cardboard Chancellor. The Cloudwatch put it here so the tourists don't get a fright. There's a cookie hanging from it.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.aankomst.zee: The airship rises from the Liftoff Pier. Above you hangs a head as big as a mountain. With eyelashes.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.aankomst.oog: Mother Cloudwhale opens her eye and looks at you. She smiles. When a whale smiles, you feel it in your tummy.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.aankomst.stad: Over the edge of her back: towers, banners, lanterns and a cathedral with a gate reaching up into the clouds. Highchonk!
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.aankomst.welkom: Welcome to Highchonk! Report to Harbormaster Weathervane at the Skyport desk.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontmasker.onder: Pinkie Silvertail, of the Ring Finger
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontmasker.0: Inspector Snoop tugs at the cape. Out comes a zipper. A ZIPPER. In a guh.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontmasker.1: The guh suit slumps to the floor. There stands a skinny, silver-gray Mika with a monocle and a tail as long as a scarf.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontmasker.2: "Pinkie Silvertail, at your service. Of the Ring Finger. My colleague the Kite Catcher got to swipe the lanterns from the coast. I get the biggest little lantern of all: this whale. City and all."
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontmasker.3: "And I'm taking this page with me!" He leaps through the window, over the rooftops, to the blowhole!
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.herinnering.0: Graycourt. Everything is gray. The streets, the sky, the guhs. On every wall a poster: "SHARING IS DUMB".
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.herinnering.1: Mikas walk past with sacks full of gray fluff. Nobody looks up. Looking is dangerous.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.herinnering.2: Minnie ties an old lantern kite to her back. She runs up the Toll Bridge. The wind catches her.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.herinnering.3: Below her: the gray lands, the humming Chonk Pipes, all heading east. Above her: one pink dot. Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.herinnering.4: "I flew for three days. Then I smelled soup."
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.0: You jump into the blowhole. Warm mist, soft as down. You sink down, into the whale, into her dream.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.1: Pinkie Silvertail sings the lullaby backwards. His tail swishes to the beat. The clouds turn gray.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.2: He trips over his own tail. Poof. The Cloudwatch jumps in after you and puts him in a cloud cage.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.3: But the dream stays gray: a big gray whale made of mist swims in circles, crying softly.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.4: You take the page and sing the lullaby. The right way around. Off-key. But with all your heart.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.5: The gray whale stops crying. It turns pink, from its tail to its nose. The dream becomes a lovely dream.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontwaken.0: You sing. The eye beneath the balcony slowly opens. Blue, with eyelashes as long as trees.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontwaken.1: Mother Cloudwhale blows a plume of cloud from all three of her blowholes. All of Highchonk cheers.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.zone5.klaar: Highchonk is saved! Queen Gentleheart names you Knight of Highchonk. Tail Park is blooming, and the Unchonked sing along.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.brief.0: In the drawer of Silvertail's desk lies a gray envelope with a seal: a ring.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.brief.1: "To the Ring Finger, Duchess Ringaling, The Star-Snuffing Tower, the Silklands. Madam. The whale is nearly ripe. The little lantern is yours. Your servant, S."
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.brief.2: On the back, in different handwriting, very small: "Excellent. I want ALL the lanterns. - R."
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.cliff.0: In the east, beyond the Cloud Sea, lies a pink strip of land. Above it, five stars hang low in the sky.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.cliff.1: As you watch, one goes out. Poof. As if someone blew it out. Four are left.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.cliff.2: Next to the snuffed star, something glitters. Ten little rings. On ten toes.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.cliff.3: A voice over the clouds, sweet as syrup: "What pretty stars. I want those. All of them."
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.oog.gemeten: You look through the telescope. The Eye fills the lens: gray, round, and it's looking... back. Twelve inches.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.spuitgat.adem: A soft sigh comes out of the blowhole. Like a pillow being fluffed.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bloesem.water: You water the blossom tree. Pink petals flutter down all over you.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.roosvenster: The light through the rose window falls over you in every color. Even in colors that don't have a name yet.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.flap.gevonden: Behind the statue sits a gray plush bunny with one ear. Flop!
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bol.gevonden: A little ball of pink wool! (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.finale.wacht: Pinkie Silvertail has jumped into the blowhole. Jump in after him, into The Cloudwhale Dream!
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_hoogv: Fully explore Highchonk (Exploration Book, key B).
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_koningin: in the palace throne room, all the way at the back on the palace hill on the east side of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_koningin.1: Come here, knight. A queen may hug whoever she likes. It's the law. I wrote it myself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_koningin.2: My crown is knitted. Gold is cold, wool is warm. A queen has to be warm.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_koningin.3: Mother Cloudwhale has been swimming through the sky for ages. As long as we sing, she stays afloat.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_inspecteur: in the side room of the Council Hall, by the big evidence board, at the top of the grand stairs on the palace hill (east side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inspecteur.1: Elementary, my dear knight. Well, almost. I still have to find out what 'elementary' means.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inspecteur.2: A good detective looks at the little things. Crumbs. Hairs. Tea stains. And sometimes at cookies. For energy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inspecteur.3: My magnifying glass has solved three cases already. And once set a tablecloth on fire by accident.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_havenmeester: at the Skyport counter, the station with the glass roof on the north flank of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_havenmeester.1: Welcome to the Highchonk Skyport! Three piers, a hundred airships a day, and one very strict pigeon.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_havenmeester.2: I know exactly who arrives and who leaves. It's all in my logbook. Well, almost all.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_havenmeester.3: Want to travel? I have the travel map. Pick where you want to go.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_veerkracht: on the training square of the Cloudwatch Academy, the white fortress on the south side of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_veerkracht.1: The Cloudwatch protects Highchonk. With shield, with plume and with very good manners.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_veerkracht.2: We march on the parade ground every morning. Left, right, left, cuddle. That's the last step.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_veerkracht.3: A knight of the Order in my Academy? What an honor. Call me Feather.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_plukje: by the barracks of the Cloudwatch Academy, on the south side of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_plukje.1: I'm the youngest cadet of the Cloudwatch. My helmet is still too big. It keeps sliding over my eyes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_plukje.2: My family still lives in the east. I miss them so much.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_plukje.3: I practice my salute every day. Look. Ow. My helmet.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_professor: in the library rotunda of the university on the north side of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_professor.1: The university of Highchonk is the oldest in the world. The oldest book is so old it sneezes when you open it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_professor.2: I study Mother Cloudwhale. Her breath, her heartbeat, her dreams. Especially her dreams.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_professor.3: Did you know a cloudwhale sleeps with one eye open? So do I. During meetings.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_kok: by the giant kettle in the Great Soup Kitchen, on the south side of the market of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kok.1: Soup! Hot soup! For everyone who comes skinny from the east. A bowl full of chonk, with a bit of parsley.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kok.2: My pot is so big I need a stepladder for it. And a long ladle. Hence my name.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kok.3: Come in skinny, leave full. That's the rule of the Great Soup Kitchen.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_mientje: at the long table in the Great Soup Kitchen, on the south side of the market of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_mientje.1: I'm from the east. Everything is gray there. Here everything is pink. I'm still getting used to all this color.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_mientje.2: This soup is the tastiest thing I've ever eaten. I eat it very slowly. So it lasts longer.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_mientje.3: At night I can't sleep very well. So I watch the stars. And whoever's sneaking around.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_gouddraad: at the bank counter, on the north side of the market of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gouddraad.1: I am the treasurer of the High Council. I count everything. Coins, buttons, stars. Yesterday I counted my toes. Ten!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gouddraad.2: The bank of Highchonk has the thickest vault in the world. It's mostly full of candy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gouddraad.3: I fly off often. But that's private. Very private. Hmph.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_inktvlek: in the university archive, on the north side of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inktvlek.1: I am the archivist. I keep all the old books of the Order. Shhh. Books are sleeping.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inktvlek.2: Tea and books don't mix. Everybody knows that. Me too. Now I do.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inktvlek.3: The oldest books are in the Council Hall. I have the key. And the Chancellery has the spare.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_donsveer: at the top of the tower of the Cloudwatch Academy, on the south side of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_donsveer.1: I am the commander of the Cloudwatch. I have no time for chitchat. I do have time for cookies.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_donsveer.2: Hmph. What do you want? I'm busy. With... orders. Yes. Very important orders.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_donsveer.3: La la laaa... What? Nothing. I wasn't singing. Generals don't sing.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_zachtpels: in the Chancellery, the study next to the throne room in the palace, on the east side of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zachtpels.1: Ah, the brave knight! What an honor. A cookie? I always carry a few. For friends.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zachtpels.2: I'm the Queen's right hand. Her left hand is very nice too, but it has less to do.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zachtpels.3: Highchonk is so... warm. So pink. So... shared. Lovely. Really. Lovely.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_pluisje: in the corner of the Great Soup Kitchen, on the south side of the market of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_pluisje.1: I lost my plushie. His name is Flop. He has one ear. The other ear is lost too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_pluisje.2: At home everything was gray. Here I'm allowed to be pink. Look, my cheeks are turning pink already!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_pluisje.3: Mama says we're safe here. Because the whale swims so high.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_grauwsnor: on a bench in the Great Soup Kitchen, on the south side of the market of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_grauwsnor.1: I crossed the Occupied Lands on foot. With my grandchildren on my back. All at once.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_grauwsnor.2: My mustache used to be pink. It'll turn pink again, they say. With enough soup.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_grauwsnor.3: I write a letter home every day. I don't know if they arrive. But writing helps.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_vluchteling_1: in line for the kettle in the Great Soup Kitchen of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_1.1: Is this really soup? With flavor? I thought soup always tasted like nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_1.2: In the east the posters say sharing is silly. Here they share everything. I don't quite get it yet.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_vluchteling_2: in line for the kettle in the Great Soup Kitchen of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_2.1: We fled over the Toll Bridge. Hanging from a kite. Don't look down, Mama said.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_2.2: My tummy is making a noise. That's not hunger anymore. That's happiness.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_2.3: Can I have another bowl later? For my little brother. He's very small.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_vluchteling_3: in line for the kettle in the Great Soup Kitchen of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_3.1: I used to be a baker. Now I'm mostly tired. But maybe tomorrow I'll be a baker again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_3.2: The Mikas took all our flour. And our songs. How do you take a song?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_3.3: Everything here smells of soup and flowers. I'm crying a little. The good kind.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_vluchteling_4: in line for the kettle in the Great Soup Kitchen of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_4.1: I brought a little stone from home. It's gray. But it's from home.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_4.2: On the whale it's so quiet and soft. Like living on a cloud. Which you are.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_4.3: When I grow up I'm joining the Cloudwatch. Then I'll protect the soup kitchen.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_zuster: at the altar of the First Snuggle, all the way at the back of the Order Cathedral (west side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zuster.1: Welcome to the Order Cathedral. Every evening we sing the song of the First Snuggle here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zuster.2: Look up. The light through the glass falls in every color. Even colors that don't have a name yet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zuster.3: The Great Gate is so tall that clouds sometimes drift right through it. Then we sing louder.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_hofdame: in the palace courtyard, on the east side of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_hofdame.1: I knit the Queen's crown. A new one every winter. This one has an extra pom-pom. To make it cozy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_hofdame.2: A queen with a cold head is a grumpy queen. That's why I knit.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_hofdame.3: There's a loose thread in the crown. Don't tell the Queen.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_stekje: by the pond in Tail Park, all the way at the back of Highchonk on the whale's tail (east side)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stekje.1: Tail Park sits on the tail of Mother Cloudwhale. When she swims, the trees wiggle along a little.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stekje.2: Blossom trees get thirsty. So do I. I share my watering can with them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stekje.3: Watch out for the pond. The ducklings are made of cloud. They quack mist.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_lientje: on the market of Highchonk, around the queen's fountain in the middle of Gentleheart Lane, at the stall with the striped awning
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_lientje.1: Market! Market! You'll find everything here. Except peace and quiet. Peace and quiet is sold out.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_lientje.2: Want to sell something? Or buy? The auction house is right here, with me.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_lientje.3: At the Highchonk market they even sell clouds. In little bags. They do sell out fast.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_bakker: on the market of Highchonk, around the queen's fountain in the middle of Gentleheart Lane, at the bakery stall with the little roof
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_bakker.1: Cloudbuns! So fluffy they float away if you don't watch out!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_bakker.2: Every morning I bake a thousand rolls for the soup kitchen. And one for me. A big one.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_bakker.3: You can buy potions and treats for the road from me.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_kleermaker: on the market of Highchonk, around the queen's fountain in the middle of Gentleheart Lane, at the stall with the fabrics
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kleermaker.1: Clothes make the guh. Or the guh makes the clothes. I haven't figured it out yet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kleermaker.2: Want to look fancy for the Queen? Come try something on.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kleermaker.3: I made a cape for the Chancellor. He wanted it extra long. Down to the floor. Strange.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_smid: on the market of Highchonk, around the queen's fountain in the middle of Gentleheart Lane, at the smithy on the south side
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_smid.1: My hammer sings. Tink, tink, tonk. The tonk is a wrong note. It's supposed to be there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_smid.2: Cloudwatch weapons? I make them all. Soft on the outside, strong on the inside.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_smid.3: Come on in if you'd like something made.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_juwelier: on the market of Highchonk, around the queen's fountain in the middle of Gentleheart Lane, at the glass stall on the north side
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_juwelier.1: Setting gems? Removing them? I do it with tweezers and lots and lots of patience.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_juwelier.2: Sparkling isn't vain. Sparkling is cozy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_juwelier.3: They say the Duchess of the Gray Fleet wears ten rings. On her TOES. What taste.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_stalmeester: at the Skyport on the north flank of Highchonk, the station with the glass roof and the three piers, by the stables next to the station
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stalmeester.1: Your mount can rest here. Cloud hay, warm stables, and a song at bedtime.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stalmeester.2: Plumeguhs love it here. So close to the clouds.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stalmeester.3: Want to go to the stable? Come along.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_kadet_dons: on the west pier of the Skyport, on the north flank of Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kadet_dons.1: I'm lost. Again. Highchonk has so many streets. And they all go uphill.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kadet_dons.2: Do you know where the Academy is? I have to salute at twelve o'clock.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kadet_dons.3: I'm very brave. Just not when I'm lost.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_gildemeester: in the Crafters' Guild, the workshops next to the university on the north side of Highchonk, in the great hall
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gildemeester.1: Welcome to the Crafters' Guild! Highchonk is the capital of all professions. This is where you learn the Masterworks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gildemeester.2: Mining, woodcutting, gathering, fishing, beekeeping, smithing, sewing, cooking and brewing. Nine professions, one guild.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gildemeester.3: The workshops are open! Talk to a mentor and you'll be at the workbench in no time.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_leermeester_kok: in the Crafters' Guild, the workshops next to the university on the north side of Highchonk, in the kitchen
Cooking is love in a pan. With salt. Not too much salt.
The recipes of Highchonk are the tastiest in the world. I'm the one saying it, and I'm honest.
Come along to the kitchen. I'll teach you the Master Recipes there.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_leermeester_bro: in the Crafters' Guild, the workshops next to the university on the north side of Highchonk, in the brewery
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_leermeester_brouwe: Brewing a potion is like singing a song. If it bubbles, you're doing it right.
My cauldron goes 'plop'. That means it's happy.
Come along to the brewery. I'll teach you the Master Potions there.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_leermeester_sme: in the Crafters' Guild, the workshops next to the university on the north side of Highchonk, in the smithy
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_leermeester_smeden: A good sword is soft on guhs and hard on the gray.
Custom work! Handmade gear with your own bonuses. That's what it's all about.
Come along to the forge. I'll teach you Master Smithing there.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_leermeester_naa: in the Crafters' Guild, the workshops next to the university on the north side of Highchonk, in the sewing studio
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_leermeester_naaien: I'm sewing a giant quilt of all the zones. One patch per zone. Highchonk will be the pink patch.
A stitch, a knot, a cuddle. That's how you sew.
Come along to the studio. I'll teach you Master Tailoring there.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_leermeester_imk: in the Crafters' Guild, the workshops next to the university on the north side of Highchonk, by the apiary
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_leermeester_imkere: I'm from Honeybough. The bees of Highchonk make cloud honey. It's so light it drips upward.
A beehive of your own? You bet! Come along to the apiary.
Bees are the hardest workers in the world. After Cook Ladle.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_vadszanger: in front of the steps of the Order Cathedral, by the glass display case with the guh flute (west side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vadszanger.1: La-la-laaa! I'm a Chonk Singer. My songs make guhs stronger and creatures softer.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vadszanger.2: With my guh flute I play a song that hums your wounds shut. Well, almost. I'm still practicing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vadszanger.3: Soon you can become a Chonk Singer too. Take a look in my display case.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_pluisninja: in a dark little corner by the training square of the Cloudwatch Academy, by the display case with the fluff daggers
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_pluisninja.2: You didn't see me. That's good. You only see a Fluff Ninja when it's too late. For a cuddle.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_pluisninja.3: Fast, soft, invisible. Soon you can do it too. Look in my display case. Quietly.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_burger_1: on Gentleheart Lane, by the square in front of the cathedral
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_1.1: Every day is a party in Highchonk. Today we're celebrating Tuesday!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_1.2: I've got confetti in my ears. For three weeks now. It comes with the territory.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_1.3: Have you seen the whale wink yet? She does it once a day. I've been waiting for hours.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_burger_2: on the market of Highchonk, around the queen's fountain in the middle of Gentleheart Lane
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_2.1: Highchonk is so beautiful. I've lived here forty years and I'm still amazed.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_2.2: If you look over the edge, you can see the sea. Very, very far below us.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_2.3: I heard there's a spy in the city. Exciting. Scary. But mostly exciting.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_burger_3: by the square in front of the cathedral
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_3.1: I'm a cloudguh. I was born here, on the whale's back.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_3.2: Sometimes you can feel her breathing. Then the streets go up and down very gently.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_3.3: Mother Cloudwhale has been sleeping so restlessly lately. She rumbles in her sleep.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_burger_4: by the pond in Tail Park
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_4.1: I catch cloud ducklings! They dissolve when you hug them. Then I make new ones.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_4.2: My mom says the whale's tail is a slide. I'm not allowed on it yet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_4.3: Are you a knight? Can I hold your sword? It's a pillow! Fun!
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_burger_5: in the Eye Garden, by the balcony above the whale's eye
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_5.1: From here you can see Mother Cloudwhale's eye. It's as big as a pond. With eyelashes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_5.2: If you wave, she blinks back. Really.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_5.3: In the east there's a gray streak on the horizon. I'd rather not look at it.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_burger_6: at the Skyport on the north flank of Highchonk, the station with the glass roof and the three piers
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_6.1: I'm flying to Sugarbowl today. Or tomorrow. Or the day after. I can't decide.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_6.2: The Skyport has a clock tower. It strikes every hour. Except when the bell ringer is asleep.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_6.3: Did you know you can jump right off the piers into the clouds? Don't. Really, don't.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z5_wacht_1: on the north side of the grand stairs to the palace hill in Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_wacht_1.1: Light the campfire: that's where you wake up if you faint. Even in the safest city in the world.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_wacht_1.2: The Cloudwatch guards Highchonk. With shield, plume and a whistle for when things get exciting.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_wacht_1.3: Highchonk is safe, knight. Nobody fights here. Except over the last cookie.
