vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.tekst: Mother Cloudwhale has sunk low over the sea. From the Lanternhaven Liftoff Pier, the first airship sails up: to Highchonk, the capital of all guhs, on the whale's back. Queen Gentleheart is waiting for you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.bezig: To Queen Gentleheart, in the throne room on Palace Hill.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.doel.0: Fly up to Highchonk on the first airship from the Lanternhaven Liftoff Pier
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.doel.1: Report to Harbormaster Weathervane at the Skyport desk (north side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.doel.2: Walk south from the Skyport to Gentleheart Lane in the middle of the city
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.doel.3: Go to Queen Gentleheart in the throne room: follow the lane east, climb the grand staircase up Palace Hill and enter the palace
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.aanbod.0: Welcome to the Highchonk Skyport! First time? I can tell from your mouth. It's hanging open.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.aanbod.1: The Queen is expecting you. Head south, up Gentleheart Lane, then east to the grand staircase. The palace is at the top.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.klaar.0: There you are. Come here. No, closer. There. A cuddle from a queen, you don't get one of those every day.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.klaar.1: Wahoognir said you would come. He landed on the roof last week. The roof tiles are still pink.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.klaar.2: What a city. I didn't know so many guhs could live together.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.klaar.3: On the back of Mother Cloudwhale. She's been swimming through the sky for ages, and she carries us. Because chonk is light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.klaar.4: But I didn't call you here just for a cuddle. Something terrible has happened. Sit down. On a cushion. There are plenty.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.tekst: The Torn Page has been stolen from the Council Hall: the oldest story of the Order. There's a traitor on the High Council. Inspector Snoop will help you investigate.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.bezig: Inspector Snoop, the lectern in the Council Hall, and then Councilor Inkblot in the archive.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.doel.0: Report to Inspector Snoop in the side room of the Council Hall, next to the palace on Palace Hill
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.doel.1: Examine the lectern with the old books, in the middle of the Council Hall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.doel.2: Question Councilor Inkblot, the archivist, in the university archive (north side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.aanbod.0: Last night the Torn Page was stolen. From the Council Hall. Under lock and key.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.aanbod.1: That page holds the oldest story of the Order. And on the back... something no one may ever sing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.aanbod.3: Only the High Council. Four guhs I've trusted for years. One of them is a traitor.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.aanbod.4: Inspector Snoop is in the side room of the Council Hall. Investigate with him. Quietly. No one may notice.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.klaar.0: Gray hairs on the lectern. A tea stain. And a spare key at the Chancellery. Hmmm.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.klaar.1: You've got your Detective's Notebook already? Good. Write down everything you find. Right-click and you'll see the evidence board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.klaar.2: One more thing: Captain Springfeather of the Academy says there's a mole in the Cloudwatch. That's where we go next.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.praat.z5_: Aha! The knight of the Order. The Queen said you were coming. Inspector Snoop, pleased to meet you. My mustache is real.
Here, a Detective's Notebook. Everything you find goes in it. Start at the lectern, that's where the page was.
And then question Councilor Inkblot. She has the key to the old books. She's in the university archive.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.tekst: Someone left the back door of the Council Hall open. Captain Springfeather thinks there's a mole in the Cloudwatch.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.bezig: Captain Springfeather, the lockers in the barracks, and then Cadet Tuft.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.doel.0: Talk to Captain Springfeather on the training ground of the Cloudwatch Academy (south side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.doel.1: Search the cadets' lockers in the Academy barracks
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.doel.2: Question Cadet Tuft by the Academy barracks
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.aanbod.0: The back door of the Council Hall was open. No signs of a break-in. Someone with a key... or someone from the Cloudwatch.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.aanbod.1: Captain Springfeather is waiting for you on the Academy training ground. Look in the cadets' lockers.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.klaar.0: A command note with a paw stamp. Paws with PADS. And notes under a soup bowl in the Great Soup Kitchen.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.klaar.1: Poor Tuft. He only wanted his family back. Someone used him.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.klaar.2: Off to the Great Soup Kitchen. Cook Ladle knows everything that goes on there. Bring an appetite.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.praat.z5_veer: A knight of the Order! Welcome to my Academy. Call me Feather.
Someone in the Cloudwatch left the back door of the Council Hall open. I'm sure of it: the guard was there, and he left it open.
Look in the cadets' lockers, in the barracks. I hope I'm wrong.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.tekst: The command notes came from under a soup bowl in the Great Soup Kitchen. That's where the Unchonked eat, the skinny refugees from the east. Anyone sneaking around there at night gets noticed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.bezig: Cook Ladle, four bowls of soup, and Skinny Minnie in the Great Soup Kitchen.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.doel.0: Question Cook Ladle by the giant cauldron in the Great Soup Kitchen (south side of the market)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.doel.1: Serve a bowl of soup to the four Unchonked in line at the cauldron (click them)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.doel.2: Question Skinny Minnie at the long table in the Great Soup Kitchen
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.doel.3: Listen to Skinny Minnie's story: how she escaped from the east
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.aanbod.0: The Great Soup Kitchen. Everyone goes there. Cadets, councilors, and the Unchonked from the east.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.aanbod.1: Talk to Cook Ladle. And lend a hand: whoever serves the soup hears the gossip.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.klaar.0: A guh with a TAIL. Who steals cheese. Hmm. Hmmmm. I know only one kind of creature that's that crazy about ripe cheese.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.klaar.1: But who on the Council would hide a tail under their cape?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.klaar.2: Next lead: the Skyport. Harbormaster Weathervane keeps a logbook. Who sneaks off at night?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.tekst: A traitor has to take their secrets somewhere. The Skyport is the only way off the whale.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.bezig: Harbormaster Weathervane, the night logbook, and Councilor Goldthread at the bank.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.doel.0: Talk to Harbormaster Weathervane at the Skyport desk (north side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.doel.1: Read the night logbook on the Skyport desk
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.doel.2: Question Councilor Goldthread, the treasurer, at the bank counter on the market
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.aanbod.0: The Skyport. Harbormaster Weathervane writes down every flight. Even the ones at night.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.aanbod.1: And Councilor Goldthread flies off often. Very often. Question him afterward, at the bank on the market.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.klaar.0: Goldthread visits his mother. What a sweet treasurer. We can cross him off the list.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.klaar.1: But the seal of the Chancellery... on a secret booking to the east. Across the Cloud Sea. Where no one flies.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.klaar.2: Two councilors left: General Downfeather and Chancellor Softpelt. We'll question them both.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.praat.z5_: The night logbook? Of course. It's all in there. Who, when, where to. It's on the desk.
Though there's one booking I never understood. Every Thursday night. To the east, across the Cloud Sea. Nobody wants to go there. See for yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.tekst: Two councilors left. General Downfeather was nowhere to be found at night. Chancellor Softpelt holds the seal of the Chancellery.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.bezig: General Downfeather in the Academy tower, and Chancellor Softpelt in the Chancellery.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.doel.0: Question General Downfeather, at the top of the tower of the Cloudwatch Academy
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.doel.1: Question Chancellor Softpelt in the Chancellery, next to the throne room in the palace (bring the piece of cheese)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.aanbod.0: Two more interrogations. General Downfeather in his tower. And Chancellor Softpelt in the Chancellery.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.aanbod.1: A tip from an old detective: take along that piece of ripe cheese the Queen gave you. A cheese test. You never know.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.klaar.0: A general who sings in secret. A chancellor who refuses soup but snatches cheese. My mustache is twitching. That's a good sign.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.klaar.1: All the clues are in. Time for the evidence board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq07_bewijsbord.tekst: All the clues have been found. Lay them side by side on the evidence board, and point out the traitor. In front of the whole High Council.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq07_bewijsbord.bezig: Point out the traitor on the evidence board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq07_bewijsbord.doel.0: Point out the traitor on the evidence board: with Inspector Snoop in the side room of the Council Hall (or right-click your Detective's Notebook)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq07_bewijsbord.doel.1: Unmask the traitor in the Council Hall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq07_bewijsbord.aanbod: Look at the board. Ten clues. Four suspects. Three clues all point the same way.
Who has a tail, the seal of the Chancellery, and a soft spot for ripe cheese? Point him out. I've already called the Council together.
A Mika. On the High Council. For three years. And nobody noticed, because he handed out such yummy cookies.
Pinkie Silvertail, of the Ring Finger. He's run off with the page. To the blowhole! If he sings the lullaby backwards...
...Mother Cloudwhale will have a gray dream. And a whale with bad dreams sinks. With the whole city on top. After him!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08_wolkwaldroom.teks: Pinkie Silvertail jumped into the middle blowhole with the Torn Page, deep into the whale. There he's singing the lullaby backwards. Mother Cloudwhale is dreaming gray, and she's sinking.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08_wolkwaldroom.bezi: After Silvertail, into the blowhole. And cheer up the gray dream.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08_wolkwaldroom.doel: Chase Silvertail to the middle blowhole, between the cathedral and the Eye Garden (west side)
Defeat Pinkie Silvertail in the Cloudwhale Dream, deep inside the whale
Cheer up Mother Cloudwhale's Gray Dream, in the Cloudwhale Dream
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08_wolkwaldroom.klaa: You're back! And the whale is swimming straight again. The streets don't wobble anymore. Hear that? She's humming.
And you've got the page. May I? Thank you. I'll read it aloud. Everyone may know now.
'Long ago, at the edge of the world, there lived an ordinary little Mika. Only hungrier than the rest.'
'He stole a cheese nibble from a guh, and for one moment felt something warm: chonk. Then it was gone. So he took another. And another.'

'For chonk only grows when you share it. What you grab melts in your paws. His grasp reached ever farther. He put on a stolen little crown and called himself Emperor. He built a keep around a bowl as big as a lake: the Empty Bowl. Never full.'
The Gray Emperor Mika. Keep Neverenough. That's where all the grayness comes from. It was on this page all along.
But first: Mother Cloudwhale has to wake up. All the way. Sing the lullaby, the RIGHT way round, by her eye.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.tekst: The lullaby is on the back of the page. Sing it the right way round, by Mother Cloudwhale's eye, and she'll wake up completely.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.bezig: To the Eye Garden balcony, and sing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.doel.0: Go to the Eye Garden balcony, above Mother Cloudwhale's eye (western tip, south side)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.doel.1: Sing the lullaby to Mother Cloudwhale, on the Eye Garden balcony
Mother Cloudwhale's eye lies beneath the Eye Garden, all the way at the western tip. There's a balcony.
Sing the lullaby the right way round. You may sing off-key. General Downfeather does too.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.klaar.0: She winked at you. She only does that once a century. Or once a day, according to Partyguh Confetti.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.klaar.1: Highchonk is safe. Thanks to you. Kneel for a moment. No, not so low, your cushion will fall out.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.klaar.2: I hereby name you Knight of Highchonk. With a cuddle. That's mandatory.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.tekst: Silvertail worked for the Ring Finger, one of the Emperor's generals. There's still mail in his Chancellery. And in the east, beyond the Cloud Sea, stars are going out.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.bezig: The desk in the Chancellery, the eastern pier, and Harbormaster Weathervane.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.doel.0: Search the desk in the Chancellery, next to the throne room
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.doel.1: Look east from the end of the Skyport's eastern pier
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.doel.2: Take a good look at the stars in the east
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.doel.3: Ask Harbormaster Weathervane about an airship to the east
Silvertail had a desk in the Chancellery. There's bound to be mail from his boss there. Have a look.
And then look east, from the piers of the Skyport. Stars have been going out there for days. One by one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.klaar.0: To the east? Nobody flies there. Too far for an airship. That's where the Great Mainland lies.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.klaar.1: ...Unless Mother Cloudwhale swims there herself. She felt it, the Queen says. Those stars. She wants to help.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.klaar.2: Feel that? The streets are trembling. She's going for a swim. Hold on tight!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.tekst: The cauldron of the Great Soup Kitchen never runs empty, but the cloudberries do. They grow in Tail Park and the Eye Garden.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.bezig: Eight cloudberries from Tail Park and the Eye Garden.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.doel.0: Pick 8 cloudberries in Tail Park (east side) and the Eye Garden (west side): look for the pink sparkles
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.aanbod.0: Cloudberries make the soup pink. And sweet. And a little floaty.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.aanbod.1: They grow in Tail Park and in the Eye Garden. Pick eight, and everyone gets a pink bowl.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.klaar.0: Look how pink! Graysie is laughing. Graysie has never laughed before. Thank you, knight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.tekst: Fluffy has lost her plushie bunny Flop. She was in the cathedral looking at the light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.bezig: Flop is somewhere in the Order Cathedral.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.doel.0: Find plushie bunny Flop behind the statue of the First Snuggle, at the back of the Order Cathedral
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.doel.1: Bring Flop back to Fluffy in the Great Soup Kitchen
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.aanbod.0: Flop is gone. He has one ear. I was in the big church. Looking at the light. He was still there then.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.aanbod.1: Will you look for him? He's very soft. And a little gray. Like I used to be.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.klaar.0: FLOP! You're back! He smells like church. He likes that, I can tell.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.klaar.1: Thank you. Flop says so too. He's just a little shy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.tekst: Grandpa Graywhisker writes letters every day. They need to go to the right guhs in Highchonk, who can send them onward.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.bezig: Harbormaster Weathervane, Sister Softsong and Fluffy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.doel.0: Bring a letter to Harbormaster Weathervane at the Skyport (for the mail to the east)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.doel.1: Bring a letter to Sister Softsong at the altar of the Order Cathedral (for the evening song)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.doel.2: Bring the last little letter to Fluffy in the Great Soup Kitchen (her grandpa wrote it)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.aanbod.0: Three letters. One for the mail to the east, one for the evening song in the cathedral, and one for my granddaughter.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.aanbod.1: She's sitting right nearby, but she'd rather read mail than listen to her grandpa. Kids.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.klaar.0: All three delivered? Then you're the fastest postguh on the whale. My mustache is turning pink. Look. A little.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.praat.z5_h: A letter to the east? It'll go with the next ship. I promise.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.praat.z5_z: A letter for the evening song? We'll sing it tonight. Everyone in the cathedral will think of the east for a moment.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.praat.z5_p: A letter from Grandpa! 'Dear Fluffy, finish your soup and cuddle Flop.' I already do. Both.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.tekst: Professor Specsworth wants to know how big the second moon, the Eye, looks in the sky. You can measure it from the observatory.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.doel.0: Climb up to the observatory on the corner of the university (northeast side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.doel.1: Measure the Eye through the big telescope in the observatory (click when you're there)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.aanbod.0: The second moon. The Eye. Every year it looms bigger in the sky. And grayer. I don't like it one bit.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.aanbod.1: Measure it for me, through the telescope in the observatory. I'm too old for those stairs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.klaar.0: Twelve inches? Last year it was ten. It's coming closer. Or it's getting bigger. Neither is good news.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.klaar.1: I'll write it down. Science is: writing down what's scary, so you can make it less scary later.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.tekst: Mother Cloudwhale breathes through three blowholes. Professor Specsworth wants to know if she's still breathing healthily.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.bezig: Three blowholes, between the cathedral and the Eye Garden.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.doel.0: Listen at the northern blowhole, between the cathedral and the Eye Garden
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.aanbod.0: A whale breathes through her blowholes. Three of them, between the cathedral and the Eye Garden.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.aanbod.1: Stand by each blowhole and listen. A healthy cloudwhale sighs like a pillow being fluffed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.klaar.0: She sighs like a pillow? All of them? Good. Healthy and content. Just like me after a nap.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.tekst: Every Cloudwatch cadet runs the Cloud Course: four posts on the training ground. Captain Springfeather wants to see if you can do it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.bezig: Four posts on the training ground, in order.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.doel.0: Run to the first post, northwest on the Academy training ground
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.doel.1: Run to the second post, northeast on the training ground
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.doel.2: Run to the third post, southeast on the training ground
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.doel.3: Run to the fourth post, southwest on the training ground
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.aanbod.0: The first trial of the Cloudwatch: the Cloud Course. Four posts, in order. Ready? Go!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.klaar.0: Splendid! Faster than Downfeather, and he runs like there's a cookie at the finish line.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.tekst: Cadet Down has wandered off again. He's on a Skyport pier. Bring him back to the Academy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.bezig: Cadet Down, from the Skyport to the Academy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.doel.0: Pick up Cadet Down from the western pier of the Skyport and bring him to the Academy training ground
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.aanbod.0: The second trial: look after your comrades. Cadet Down is lost again. He's probably standing on a Skyport pier, looking at clouds.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.aanbod.1: Bring him back. Slowly. He has short little legs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.klaar.0: Down! There you are. Thank the knight. ...No, don't salute, your helmet... Too late.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.tekst: It's busy on the Highchonk market. Stallguh Lindy has parcels for three other stalls.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.bezig: The baker, the tailor and the jeweler on the market.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.doel.0: Bring a bag of flour to Baker Cloudbun, at the bakery stall on the market
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.doel.1: Bring a roll of cloth to Tailor Hem on the market
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.doel.2: Bring a little box of glimmers to Jeweler Glimmer on the market
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.aanbod.0: Help! Three parcels, three stalls, one Lindy. Flour for the baker, cloth for the tailor, glimmers for the jeweler.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.klaar.0: All delivered? You're a hero. A market hero. That's almost as good as a regular hero.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.praat.z5_bak: Flour! I bake cloudbuns with that. Here, one for you. Eat it quick, before it floats away.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.praat.z5_kle: Velvet-soft cloth! I'll make a new cape out of it. Not as long as the Chancellor's. Nobody wants a cape that long.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.praat.z5_juw: Glimmers! Oooh. They glimmer. That's the whole point.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.tekst: The blossom trees in Tail Park are thirsty. Gardenguh Sprig has one watering can and four trees.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.bezig: Four blossom trees around the pond in Tail Park.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.doel.0: Water the first blossom tree, southwest of the pond in Tail Park
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.doel.1: Water the second blossom tree, southeast of the pond
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.doel.2: Water the third blossom tree, northeast of the pond
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.doel.3: Water the fourth blossom tree, northwest of the pond
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.aanbod.0: Four trees around the pond. They wobble when the whale swims, and then they spill their water. Will you give them a sip?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.klaar.0: Look, they're blooming again! The petals are drifting all the way down to the sea.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s10_wol.tekst: Three balls of pink yarn have rolled out of the Queen's knitted crown. Court Lady Needles wants them back before the Queen notices.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s10_wol.doel.0: Find 3 balls of pink yarn: on the market, in the palace courtyard and in the university (pink fluff)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s10_wol.aanbod.0: Shh. The Queen's crown is fraying. Three balls of yarn have rolled away. One across the market, one across the palace courtyard, and one...
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s10_wol.aanbod.1: ...walked into the university with a professor. Don't ask how.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s10_wol.klaar.0: All three! I'll knit them back in tonight, while she sleeps. She won't notice a thing. She always notices. She just never says anything.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.tekst: In the Order Cathedral they sing the song of the First Snuggle every evening. Sister Softsong wants you to see the light the way the first knights saw it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.bezig: The northern and southern rose windows, and the First Snuggle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.doel.0: Stand beneath the northern rose window, in the transept of the Order Cathedral
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.doel.1: Stand beneath the southern rose window
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.doel.2: Stand by the golden statue of the First Snuggle, at the back of the cathedral
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.aanbod: The first knights of the Order came here, long ago. They stood beneath the two roses and then by the First Snuggle.
Do as they did. You don't have to sing. You may, though.
You saw it, didn't you? The light falls right on the statue. As if the sun itself is hugging someone.
That's how the Order began. With one cuddle. And then another. That's how chonk grows.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.haren: On the lectern in the Council Hall lie long, silver-gray hairs. Not guh fluff: that's shorter and curlier.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.theevlek: Councilor Inkblot spilled tea on page twelve and didn't dare say so. She never touched the torn page. The spare key to the archive is kept at the Chancellery.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.bevelbrief: In Cadet Tuft's locker: 'Leave the back door of the Council Hall open tonight. The High Council.' Below it, a stamp: a round paw with little pads. Guhs don't have pads.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.soepkom: Cadet Tuft got the notes in the Great Soup Kitchen, under his soup bowl. They promised that his family could come over from the east.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.kaasvoorraad: Cook Ladle: every night, cheese disappears from the pantry. Only cheese. No guh eats that much cheese.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.staart: Skinny Minnie saw a posh guh in a long cape sneaking out of the pantry at night. Under the cape swished a long, gray tail.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.logboek: In the Skyport logbook: every Thursday night a quiet little boat leaves for the east, across the Cloud Sea. Booked by 'S.P.'. No name, just letters.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.zegel: Councilor Goldthread flies to his mother in Lanternhaven every week, under his own name. But the S.P. booking bears the seal of the Chancellery. Only one guh uses that seal.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.liedje: General Downfeather wasn't in the barracks at night: he was secretly practicing a birthday song for the Queen. His coat is snow-white, not gray.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.kaastest: Chancellor Softpelt turned down the soup ('too warm, too... shared'), but snatched the piece of ripe cheese right out of your paw. His whiskers quivered and his monocle fogged up.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verdachte.gouddraad: Councilor Goldthread, the treasurer. Often flies off in secret.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verdachte.inktvlek: Councilor Inkblot, the archivist. Has the key to the old books.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verdachte.donsveer: General Downfeather, the commander. The mole is in his Cloudwatch, and at night he's nowhere to be found.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verdachte.zachtpels: Chancellor Softpelt, the Queen's right hand. Always sweet, always cookies.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.inktvlek.intr: Shhh! Whispers only in the archive. The books are sleeping. What brings you here?
The torn page was stolen from the Council Hall. You have the key.
Stolen? Oh no. Oh no, oh no. Ask whatever you like. Quietly.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.inktvlek.antw: The oldest story of the Order. About a cat at the edge of the world who never had enough.
And on the back... Mother Cloudwhale's lullaby. Whoever sings it backwards gives her a gray dream. That's why it was kept under lock and key.
I... okay. Okay! I spilled tea. On page twelve. Of the Great Snuggle Book. A stain as big as a cookie.
I didn't dare say so. But I never touched the torn page. Really, I didn't.
And the key? I have one. The spare key is kept at the Chancellery. Always has been.
Here. Among the books. I sleep in the reading chair. The books like the company.
Cadet Tuft. There was a command note in your locker. 'Leave the back door of the Council Hall open.'
...My helmet's slipping over my eyes again. Then I don't have to look at you.
Nobody's angry. I just want to know what happened.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.plukje.antwoo: I don't know! It said 'The High Council' at the bottom. So I thought it was allowed. The Council is everyone's boss.
My family still lives in the east. In the gray. The first note said they could come over. If I listened well.
I wanted to see them again so badly...
How did you get the notes?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.plukje.antwoo: In the Great Soup Kitchen! I eat soup there every evening. And then there'd be a note under my bowl. I never saw who put it there.
I'm so sorry. I'll report to Captain Springfeather myself later.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.kok.intro.0: A knight in my kitchen! Soup? Of course you want soup. Everyone wants soup.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.kok.intro.1: Yes please. And I have a few questions. About what happens in the soup kitchen at night.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.kok.vraag.0: Who all comes to eat here?
Everyone! Refugees, cadets, councilors. The Chancellor often comes by to watch. Sweet of him. Though he never eats a thing.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.kok.vraag.1: Do you ever find anything missing?
Cheese. Every night. Only cheese! No bread, no soup, no cookies. Only the ripest, stinkiest cheese.
No guh eats that much cheese. The pantry hatch squeaks when someone opens it. Minnie sleeps right next to it.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.kok.vraag.2: How big is that pot, anyway?
So big that a cadet fell in last week. He swam happy little laps in it. After that I put a lid on it.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.mientje.intro: You handed out soup. To Graysie and Dusty and Marl and Pebble. I saw it. You're kind.
Cook Ladle says you sleep next to the pantry at night.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.mientje.vraag: Did you see anyone at night?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.mientje.antwo: Yes. A posh guh in a long cape. He snuck out of the pantry with his arms full of cheese.
And under his cape... a tail was swishing. A long, gray tail. Guhs don't have tails. Right?
I didn't say anything. In the east you learn to be quiet.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.mientje.vraag: How did you escape from the east?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.mientje.antwo: That's a long story. I'll tell you later. If you want to listen. Nobody has asked yet.
Better and better. My cheeks are turning pink. Look. A little.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.gouddraad.int: An interrogation? Of ME? The treasurer of the High Council? Hmpf. Ask away. Quickly. I still have buttons to count.
You often fly off at night. Where to?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.gouddraad.vra: Why do you fly off in secret?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.gouddraad.ant: In secret? I fly to my mother. In Lanternhaven. Every week. She's old and she bakes the yummiest lantern cookies.
I don't tell the Council, because then they'd call me a mama's boy. Which I am. Proudly.
S.P.? I always book under my own name. G-O-L-D-T-H-R-E-A-D. With three D's. Well, two.
Let me see. Hmm. That booking has the Chancellery seal. The little crown with the feather. Only the Chancellor uses that.
But the Chancellor... he's so nice, isn't he? He gives everyone cookies.
Gold, silver and mostly candy. A treasurer needs something tasty to count too.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.donsveer.intr: Hmpf. A knight. In my tower. I'm busy.
General, there's a mole in your Cloudwatch. And you weren't in the barracks last night.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.donsveer.vraa: Did you know about Cadet Tuft?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.donsveer.antw: Tuft? That kid can't even salute without dropping his helmet. A mole? Hmpf. A mouse, at most.
GRAY? My coat is SNOW-WHITE. Look. Here. It's as white as a fresh cloud. Gray. Pff.
I was practicing. A song. For the Queen's birthday. On the roof of the tower, where nobody can hear it.
I sing off-key. Very off-key. But with all my heart. Don't tell anyone. Hmpf.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.zachtpels.int: The brave knight! In my Chancellery! What an honor. A cookie? Have a seat. Not on that chair, my cape is sitting there.
I have a few questions, Chancellor. And I brought something from the Great Soup Kitchen.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.zachtpels.vra: Offer him a bowl of soup and a piece of ripe cheese
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.zachtpels.ant: Soup? No, no, thank you. Too warm. Too... shared.
But is that... ripe cheese? Mmm. May I? Just a taste. To be polite.
(He snatches the cheese out of your paw. His whiskers quiver. His monocle fogs up.)
Ahem. Delicious. I mean: ordinary. Ordinary cheese. Where were we?
Here, of course. Writing letters. To... friends. Distant friends. Very distant friends.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.zachtpels.vra: Who has the spare key to the archive?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.zachtpels.ant: The Chancellery. So, me. But it's safe in my drawer. Look, right here... hm. Strange. It's not there.
Someone must have stolen it! How awful. What treachery. Cookie?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.schat.staartvin: All the way at the back, where Mother Cloudwhale's tail curls up, a chest is tied tight. Nobody dares go that high.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.schat.troonzaal: Behind the Queen's throne stands a chest marked 'DO NOT OPEN'. Inside is a note: 'Except knights.'
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.schat.ooggaarde: Beneath the balcony of the Eye Garden, between the whale's eyelashes, a chest gleams. She doesn't blink. Phew.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z5_veilig: Highchonk is safe: no monsters attack in the city. Campfires still work as rest spots.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z5_verhoor: In an interrogation you choose your questions. One question gives you a clue for your Detective's Notebook. You may ask anything.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z5_bord: Right-click your Detective's Notebook to open the evidence board: all clues and suspects at a glance.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z5_hoogvads.tekst: After the Lantern Coast and from level 55, the first airship sails up from the Liftoff Pier to Highchonk, the capital of all guhs, on the back of Mother Cloudwhale (lv 56-60). It's safe here: no monsters in the city. The Skyport is on the north flank, Gentleheart Lane runs from the cathedral (west) to the palace (east), the university is in the north, the Cloudwatch Academy in the south, Tail Park all the way east and the Eye Garden in the west.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z5_speuren.tekst: In 'Treason in the City' you're a detective. Question suspects (choose your questions well: one question turns up a clue), search for clues at the places the tracker points to, and check the evidence board: with Inspector Snoop in the Council Hall or with your Detective's Notebook (right-click). A wrong accusation costs nothing: the board explains why it doesn't add up.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z5_soepkeuken.tekst: In the Great Soup Kitchen the Unchonked get to eat chonky again: skinny guhs who fled from the east. The further the story goes, the fuller and happier they get. Help Cook Ladle, and listen to their stories.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z5_ambachten.tekst: Highchonk is the capital of all crafts. In the Crafters' Guild next to the university you'll find the mentors of cooking, brewing, smithing, sewing and beekeeping. The Masterworks are coming soon.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z5_reizen.tekst: Harbormaster Weathervane at the Skyport flies you to all the islands of the Island Sea: click on him for the travel map. After the story of Highchonk, line E to the Silklands (zone 6) opens, from Tail Harbor.

vadsrijk.opslag.tip.tas: Materials (pebbles, thread, crystals...) go into your Material Bag all by themselves. No stack limit! The Smith takes them out himself.
vadsrijk.opslag.tip.bank: Your vault is shared by all your knights and waits at the banker in every town.
vadsrijk.kleding.geen_titels: No titles yet. You earn those with big deeds!
vadsrijk.kleding.rug.zweven: Glide: hold space in the air.
vadsrijk.kleding.rug.nogniet: You'll learn to glide later in the story...
vadsrijk.kleding.harnas.uitleg: Every armor you ever had becomes a look. Only in the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.kleding.harnas.thuis: (You're at home: you'll see your armor looks in the Chonkdom.)
vadsrijk.kleding.slot.head: Helmet
vadsrijk.kleding.anderen.tip: Effects of other players (trails, auras, cheer-up effects). Less or Off = more FPS.
vadsrijk.kleding.nieuw: New in your Wardrobe: %s (%s)! Press O.
vadsrijk.kleding.kracht.zweven: Glide: hold space in the air and you sink very slowly.
vadsrijk.kleding.kracht.dubbele_sprong: Double jump: tap space once more in the air.
vadsrijk.kleding.kracht.sneller_zweven: Faster glide: you glide forward more quickly.
vadsrijk.kleding.kracht.langer_zweven: Longer glide: you sink even slower.
vadsrijk.kleding.kracht.luchtdash: Air dash: tap space once more in the air for a little swoosh forward.
vadsrijk.kleding.kracht.zachte_landing: Soft landing: never any fall damage, and a little pink poof when you land.
vadsrijk.kleding.kracht.alleen_rijk: Only works in the Chonkdom (not in boss arenas and dungeons). At home you can still see them!
vadsrijk.kleding.vleugel.onder.eerste: Hold space in the air to glide!
vadsrijk.kleding.vahoeg.chat: Wahoognir shakes his pink feathers... and a few flutter down onto your back. You can GLIDE now! (Wardrobe: O)
vadsrijk.kleding.schemer.melding: %s got the rare Dusk Wings from a Wahoog boss!
vadsrijk.kleding.tip.zweven: Wings! Hold space in the air = glide. You never go up, but you sink down ever so softly. It doesn't work in arenas and dungeons. Your Wardrobe: O.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.vleugel.vahoegveer: A little gift from Wahoognir, once he's pink again (end of The Duskroot).
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.vleugel.kristal.br: Explore The Splinter Peaks to 100% (Exploration Book).
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.vleugel.goudveer.b: Collect 25 Golden Feathers (Wahoog bosses, bounties, hunting contracts).
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.vleugel.schemer.br: Very rarely a little gift from a boss in Wahoog form.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.vleugel.pluis.bron: A little secret... something about gliding very high and very long.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.vleugel.lampion.br: Explore The Lantern Coast to 100% (coming later).
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.kaap.knuffelorde.b: Finish the story of The Snuggle Shrooms.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.kaap.reis.bron: A little secret... the tailors of the Chonkdom all know each other.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.accessoire.oortjes: Your first little step into the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.accessoire.kristal: Finish the story of The Splinter Peaks.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.accessoire.lampion: Explore The Lantern Coast to 25% (coming later).
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.naamkleur.roze.bro: Finish the story of The Snuggle Shrooms.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.naamkleur.ijsblauw: Finish the story of The Splinter Peaks.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.naamkleur.honing.b: Finish the story of The Duskroot.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.naamkleur.goud.bro: Explore every part of the Chonkdom to 100%.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.plof.knuffels.bron: Cheer up your first boss in Wahoog form.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.vleugel.sterrensto: A puzzle reward... something is sparkling somewhere.
A puzzle reward... somewhere in the cold.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.vleugel.lantaarnmo: A puzzle reward... little moths love light.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.kaap.sneeuwvlok.br: A puzzle reward... somewhere in the snow.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.kaap.honingraat.br: A puzzle reward... something with bees.
vadsrijk.kleding.ding.kaap.mos.bron: A puzzle reward... deep in the green.
vadsrijk.luchtschip.bord.onderweg: The ship is on its way here (flight %s)
vadsrijk.luchtschip.pier: Line %s to %s: departing in %s. Click the ship to board.
vadsrijk.luchtschip.aan_boord.vlucht: On the way to %s - landing in %s
vadsrijk.luchtschip.aan_boord.wacht: On board for %s - departing in %s (sneak to get off)
vadsrijk.luchtschip.al_aan_boord: You're already on board! Departing in %s.
vadsrijk.luchtschip.al_aan_boord.vlucht: You're already on board! Landing in %s.
vadsrijk.luchtschip.vliegt_al: This ship has already left. Wait for the next one (check the departure board).
vadsrijk.luchtschip.vol: The ship is full! Take the next one.
vadsrijk.luchtschip.welkom: Welcome aboard! To %s, departing in %s. While we're still at the pier you can get off (sneak).
vadsrijk.luchtschip.vertrek: Off we go! On to %s (flight %s). You can only get off after landing.
vadsrijk.luchtschip.blijf: Nyeg! Stay comfy on board until we've landed.
vadsrijk.luchtschip.alsnog_geland: Your flight was neatly finished for you: you're now in %s.
vadsrijk.luchtschip.slot.kamp: The captain shakes his head: help out in the camp a little longer first!
vadsrijk.luchtschip.slot.z4: This line only flies once the Duskroot is safe again. Finish the Duskroot story first.
vadsrijk.luchtschip.slot.z5: Highchonk is still floating too high. Only after the Snuggletide party does Mother Cloudwhale come down low enough.
vadsrijk.luchtschip.luxe.gratis: Luxury flight! This first one is the captain's treat. (After that a luxury flight costs money; the big airship in the harbor is free.)
vadsrijk.luchtschip.luxe.te_duur: A luxury flight costs %s bronze, and you don't have that much on you. The big airship flies for free: check the departure board in the harbor!
vadsrijk.luchtschip.luxe.betaald: Luxury flight: %s bronze paid. All aboard!
vadsrijk.karakter.modus.normaal.uitleg: The normal adventure. Fainting costs nothing: you wake up at your last campfire.
vadsrijk.karakter.modus.eenvads.uitleg: One life! If you faint outside a town, your knight retires: they get a statue in the Hall of Resting Knights in Shroomsbury and rest there for good (you can't play them anymore). After that you can make a new One-Chonk knight on the right. While they live: a golden heart by your name and 10% more xp.
vadsrijk.karakter.modus.knuffel.uitleg: Play the story at your own pace: monsters only do half their damage to you. You do get 10% less xp. A pink cloud by your name.
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.uitleg: Each knight has their own levels, gear, quests and Chonk Coins. Clothes, mounts, pets and the bank are shared.
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.plek: You can only switch knights in a town or at a campfire.
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.arena: Not in the middle of a boss fight!
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.scene: Wait until the cutscene is over.
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.slot: Can't use that slot (taken or empty).
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.naam: Give your knight a name (letters and digits, max 16).
vadsrijk.karakter.pensioen.onder: Your knight gets a statue in the Hall of Resting Knights
vadsrijk.karakter.pensioen.iedereen: %s (%s) retires as a Resting Knight at level %s. A statue goes up in Shroomsbury!
vadsrijk.karakter.zaal.onder: They fainted once, and now rest with honor.
vadsrijk.karakter.optie: Characters: switch knight or make a new one
vadsrijk.karakter.tip.slots: You can have three knights: Normal on the left, Snuggle Mode in the middle, One-Chonk on the right. Use the ⚔ button next to your inventory!
vadsrijk.npc.optie.rol.z4_vissoep: A bowl of fish soup, please!
vadsrijk.npc.optie.rol.z4_soep: A little bowl of soup, please!
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.lampionkust_verha: The Lantern Coast? First the Duskroot has to bloom again. Help the dragon, knight!
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.lampionkust_level: The Lantern Coast is for adventurers from level 50. You're level %s. A little more practice!
vadsrijk.npc.reis.kies.z4_luchthaven: Back to the Tree or farther away? Pick where below or look at the travel map.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.zeilboot: Your little sailboat is waiting at the dock! (If the boat isn't in this version yet: it's on its way.)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.zeilboot.nog: The little sailboat is still being built. Until then: swim, or cross via the little sandbanks. I'll keep an eye on you.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.vissoep: Here you go, a bowl of fish soup. Careful, it's hot. With a shrimp in it. It's waving.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.limonade: Here you go, a glass of seashell lemonade. With a seagrass straw.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.soep: Here you go, a little bowl of soup. There's always more.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.al: You just had one! Finish it first, then you get another.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.opening.onder: A pink sea full of little islands
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.opening.wolkenv: The airship dives through the Cloudfall. Below the clouds: a pink sea, and lanterns as far as the eye can see.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.opening.eilande: Little islands like beads on a string. Kites. Parasols. A lighthouse with little ears.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.opening.walvis: And above the sea, in the east, a city floats. On the back of a whale.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.opening.knuffel: On a little beach in the southeast, gray specks lie in the surf. Plushies. Gray plushies.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.aankomst: Welcome to Lanternhaven! Harbormaster Anchor is waiting on the quay, by the middle dock.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.knuffel.opgevrolijkt: The plushie turns a little pink. (%s of %s plushies of Snuggletide)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.knuffel.alle: All twelve plushies of Snuggletide are pink again!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.groot.roze: The big plushie sighs, and slowly turns pink. It feels lighter now that its story has been told.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.mist.0: Through the gate you see... nothing. Only mist. And then, very softly, the sound of cartwheels.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.mist.1: A long gray road. Carts full of plushies and lanterns, pulled by Mikas with sacks. They're all heading east.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.mist.2: Along the road hums a gray pipe. It sucks. Wherever it runs, the flowers lose their color.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.mist.3: Far away, on the horizon, stands a castle like a bowl. Above it hangs a moon that isn't a moon. It watches.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.mist.4: The mist closes in again. Your ears are cold. Behind you, a voice: "...Are you a Mika?"
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.wrak.0: Hey! Who dares disturb Pinkie the Kite Catcher in his own wreck? This is a private wreck!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.wrak.1: Those plushies? I... found them. On a clothesline. They were just hanging there. That's practically throwing them away.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.wrak.2: The Ring Finger pays a bonus for every plushie. Two plushies is two bonuses. I'm very good at math.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.wrak.3: Pinkie hoists his gray war kite, but the string is tied to his own tail. He flies one loop, and splashes into the sea.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.wrak.4: "This goes in my report!" He swims off, as fast as a Mika swims. Which is not fast. Down in the hold lie the plushies.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.zeeslurf.0: In the deepest little grotto lies a giant sea cow with a long snoot. He blows gray bubbles. They pop without a sound.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.zeeslurf.1: You swim closer and pet his snoot. He startles. Then... he blinks. One pink bubble. Two. Ten!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.zeeslurf.2: The Sea Snoot sings a low, happy song. The little fish come back and play with his bubbles.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.feest.0: The lanterns light up. Three hundred of them, pink, yellow and mint. And one lilac.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.feest.1: Twelve kites with little ears rise up, and from each kite hangs a plushie, waving down.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.feest.2: Graysie sees a plushie on a kite. "MOUSE!" She runs over. Mouse is pink. So is Graysie, a little.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.feest.3: Everyone dances. Grandpa Slim too. He laughs. At nothing. Just laughing.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.feest.4: Foster Mom Softie taps her lemonade glass: "Whoever washes up here is home. Plushie or guh. Welcome home."
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.wolkwal.0: It goes quiet. An enormous shadow glides across the water.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.wolkwal.1: Mother Cloudwhale sinks down through the clouds. Low. Very low. On her back twinkle the lights of Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.wolkwal.2: She sings. A long, deep whale song you can feel in your tummy. The lanterns sway along.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.wolkwal.3: Her eye is big and kind. And tired. Behind her tail flutters a thin gray wisp.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.cliff.0: The airship casts off from the Liftoff Pier. Slowly it rises, past the head of Mother Cloudwhale.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.cliff.1: Her eye turns to follow. She looks at you. As big as a house, as soft as a blanket.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.cliff.2: Above the clouds: towers with little flags, little bridges, a cathedral of cloudstone. Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.cliff.3: Down on the pier, a guh in a white-and-gold cape watches the ship go. A gray bit of fluff drifts out of his sleeve.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.cliff.vervolg: To be continued... Highchonk, the Floating City.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.zone4.klaar: Snuggletide is over and all the plushies are pink! From now on, the airship to Highchonk departs from the Liftoff Pier.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.zeilboot.klaar: You have your very own little guh sailboat! The sail winks at you.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.serve: Smash tosses the ball up... (%s - %s) Where will he hit it?
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.hint.0: Smash looks to the right... but his left ear is wiggling.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.hint.1: Smash looks straight ahead and whistles a tune. Very innocent.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.hint.2: Smash looks to the left. Very obviously to the left. Too obviously. And his right ear is wiggling.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.uitleg: (Tip: watch Smash's ears. Ears never lie.)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.punt: Got it! You dive into the sand and hit the ball back. Point for you!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.mis: Miss! The ball flomps into the sand. Smash cheers. For himself.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.gewonnen: You win! Three points! Smash falls over backwards in the sand in surprise.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vlieger.start: You launch your guh kite at the contest pole. Up it shoots! Keep it in the wind...
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vlieger.windstoot: A gust of wind! Your kite loops the loop. Wind Master Swoosh claps. (%s seconds)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vlieger.weg: You walked away from the contest pole. The kite sinks. Start over!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vlieger.gewonnen: Half a minute! Your kite dances high above the island. You won the contest!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vlieger.geen: You don't have a guh kite with you. Kitemaker Pennant will help you build one.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.lens.bezig: You polish the big lens. Salt off, shine on...
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.lens.klaar: The lens gleams! The lighthouse's light reaches all the way to the mist again.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.dans.start: The campfire crackles. Your feet start moving all by themselves...
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.dans.klaar: You dance the wave, the crab and the whale! Everyone around the campfire claps.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.flessenpost.weg: You toss the bottle message into the Ring Current. It bobs away, to the east. Off you go, little bottle. To Granny.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vis.gevangen: A pink fish! (%s of %s for Fisher Bobber)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vind.vliegerspul: Found it! Another piece for your kite. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vind.bijtjes: Buzz! A little bee flies back with you. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vind.bloemen: A beautiful flower for the garlands. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vind.lampionhaken: You hang up a lantern. It lights up all by itself! (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vind.mistbrieven: A note from Misty, damp from the mist. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.mistbrief.mistbrief_1: 'Day 1. We walk at night. In the daytime the Mikas stand by the pipes. Mama says: don't look, don't talk, just walk.'
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.mistbrief.mistbrief_2: 'Day 9. We saw a village by a pipe. Everything gray. A guh sat on a doorstep, staring at nothing. He didn't wave back.'
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.mistbrief.mistbrief_3: 'Day 20. The sea! Plushies in the water, all drifting the same way. To the west. We're going with them.'
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.fles.alle: All the bottle messages read. Together, the notes tell of an Emperor who never has enough, far in the east.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_de_la: Fully explore The Lantern Coast (Exploration Book, key B).
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z4_tijkn: along the tideline of Snuggletide Beach (gray fluffs in the surf)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z4_vlieg: on Kite Island (sticks, fabric, string and ribbon blow around everywhere)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z4_parel: under water in the lagoon of Coral Bay (little sparkles)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z4_schel: on the beaches of Beach Party Island
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z4_bijtj: on Flower Island, among the flowers
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z4_bloem: in the flower fields of Flower Island
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z4_lampi: in Lanternhaven: by the jetties, on the quay and on the square (golden sparkles)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z4_mistb: on Mystery Island, in the mist
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z4_knuff: hidden on The Lantern Coast: on the little islands, under water and in the mist (hearts)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.overal.teller:z4_fless: washed up on the beaches of The Lantern Coast (blue sparkles)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.z4_luchtschip: by Skyportguh Weathervane, on the skyport platform of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_havenmeester: on the quay of Lanternhaven, by the middle jetty at the harbor inlet (the east side of the town)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_havenmeester.1: Welcome to Lanternhaven! Houses on stilts, lanterns on every rope, and the sea is pink. Really. Take a look.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_havenmeester.2: See that city above the sea? Highchonk. On the back of a whale. I look at it every morning with my coffee.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_havenmeester.3: A harbor without boats is a bathtub. A harbor without lanterns is... well, also a bathtub. But dark.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_zeilverhuur: at the north jetty of the harbor inlet of Lanternhaven, by the boats
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_zeilverhuur.1: A little sailboat with ears! The sail has a little face. It winks when the wind is right.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_zeilverhuur.2: Go ahead and sail around. Just not too far: at the edge the Ring Current gently turns you back. Like a merry-go-round.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_zeilverhuur.3: I once built a boat out of a teacup. It sank. But very snugly.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_luchthaven: on the airport platform on the west side of Lanternhaven, by the docked airship
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_luchthaven.1: From this platform the airships fly back to the Tree and beyond. Grab the travel map.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_luchthaven.2: The airship to Highchonk? It doesn't leave from here. For that you need the Liftoff Pier, way out east.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_luchthaven.3: Wind from the west: good flying weather. Wind from the east: gray weather. I don't like that.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_lampionmaker: in the lantern workshop on the west side of the Harbor Square of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_lampionmaker.1: Pink, yellow and mint. A lantern doesn't need more colors than that. Well, maybe lilac. For Sundays.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_lampionmaker.2: A lantern is a little sun on a string. You can take it anywhere.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_lampionmaker.3: When Snuggletide comes, we hang up a thousand of them. Then the plushies can find their way home.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_bankier: in the bank on the north side of the Harbor Square of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_bankier.1: Want to keep your things safe? With me, everything goes in a big shell. A really big one. With a lock.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_bankier.2: I pay interest in little shells. Kidding. Or not. Check your vault.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_bankier.3: A smart guh saves. An even smarter guh saves in a vault that can't sink.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_werkplaats: in the workshop behind the lantern workshop, on the west side of the Harbor Square of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_werkplaats.1: Here we tinker, saw and tie knots. Just like on a ship. But on dry land.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_werkplaats.2: Tying nets, stringing kites, varnishing boats. I do it all. Except the dishes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_werkplaats.3: What you make yourself lasts longer. And it smells of sawdust. Lovely.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_winkel: in the shop on the south side of the Harbor Square of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_winkel.1: Potions, bandages and sunscreen for your little ears! Everything for a day at the coast.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_winkel.2: A guh without a beach bag is like a beach without sand. Weird.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_winkel.3: Feel free to look around. Watch out for the crab, he lives in the till.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_smid: in the smithy at the start of the south arm of Lanternhaven, on the quay
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_smid.1: I forge anchors, hooks and swords. Mostly anchors. The sea is big.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_smid.2: Salt water rusts everything. That's why I polish my hammer every evening. It shines like a pearl.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_smid.3: Bring me your gear. Stars on, rust off.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_wapens: in the gear shop on the south side of the Harbor Square of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wapens.1: Harpoons, nets and seashell shields. Everything a coast knight needs.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wapens.2: My harpoons are very nice. They only poke monsters. And sausages.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wapens.3: Choose your weapon with your heart. But also with your class, or it won't fit.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_kleermaker: in the clothing shop on the north side of the Harbor Square of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kleermaker.1: Striped sailor sweaters, sun hats and swim caps! Who doesn't want to hit the sea in style?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kleermaker.2: I sew with sail thread. It never tears. Unless you laugh really hard.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kleermaker.3: A scarf against the sea wind, and you're ready for anything.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_markt: at the coast market in the middle of the Harbor Square of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_markt.1: Buy, sell, swap! The coast market is always open, even when it rains. Then we have parasols.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_markt.2: Today's special: sand. Free. It's everywhere.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_markt.3: Here you can swap with other adventurers. Fair is fair, says the shell.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_kok: in fish restaurant The Happy Halibut, at the end of the north arm of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kok.1: Welcome to The Happy Halibut! Fish soup, shrimp cakes and seaweed ice cream. That last one is better than it sounds.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kok.2: I only cook with fish that wanted to join in. Very honest fish soup.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kok.3: A bowl of soup? That'll warm your little ears after a day at sea.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_visser: at the end of the south jetty of the harbor inlet of Lanternhaven, with his fishing rod
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_visser.1: Fishing is waiting. And waiting is nice too. Especially with a sandwich.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_visser.2: Yesterday I caught a boot. Today a fish in a boot. Tomorrow maybe the other boot.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_visser.3: Cast the line, watch the bobber, don't fall asleep. That last one is the hardest.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_duinwachter: at the campfire on top of the Lantern Dune, the high dune on the north side of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duinwachter.1: From the Lantern Dune you can see everything: the Tree behind you, Highchonk ahead of you, and all the little islands in between.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duinwachter.2: Light the campfire. This is where you wake up if things go wrong. Warm, safe, and you lose nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duinwachter.3: The creatures here are gray and sad. Cheer them up, adventurer. It'll make you happy too.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_oma_zeeschuim: on the Harbor Square of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_oma_zeeschuim.1: When I was little, a plushie washed ashore for me every year. A little duck. It's still on my windowsill.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_oma_zeeschuim.2: The Great Snuggletide comes once a year. When the lanterns light up. I always watch the water then.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_oma_zeeschuim.3: This year they're gray. I've never seen that before. Never.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_kind_lampje: on the Harbor Square of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_lampje.1: I made a lantern! It's crooked. But it's lit!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_lampje.2: Do you know why the sea is pink? I think there's a really big strawberry in it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_lampje.3: When I grow up I'll be a kite champion. Or a whale. A whale is fine too.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_kind_golfje: on the quay of Lanternhaven, by the jetties
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_golfje.1: I can swim already! With water wings. And with Mom right next to me. But all by myself!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_golfje.2: There's a crab under the jetty. His name is Pinchy. I named him myself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_golfje.3: Do you have your own little boat? Can I come along? I'm very light.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_postguh: on the Harbor Square of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_postguh.1: Mail between the little islands goes by message in a bottle. I toss it in the water and the current does the rest. Usually.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_postguh.2: Sometimes a message in a bottle washes up from far, far away. From the east. Those notes are... gray.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_postguh.3: Buzz buzz, mail! Oh no, that was the Tree. Here it's: splish splash, mail!
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_danseres: on the quay of Lanternhaven, under the strings of lanterns
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_danseres.1: In the evenings we dance on the quay, under the lanterns. Are you coming?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_danseres.2: The wave dance goes like this: to, fro, to, and then splash.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_danseres.3: I dance for the plushies coming home. So they feel welcome.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_schipper: on the south arm of Lanternhaven, by the stilt houses
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schipper.1: I've been sailing between the little islands for forty years. I know every wave by name.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schipper.2: Careful near the Gray Fog Bank in the southeast. That's where you lose your compass. And your good mood.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schipper.3: A good boat is like a good friend. It takes you anywhere and never says no.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_opvang: in the rescue center on Snuggletide Beach, the island southeast of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opvang.1: Welcome to the shelter. Everyone is welcome here: guhs, plushies, and sad little critters.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opvang.2: A cup of warm milk, a little blanket and a cuddle. That perks anyone right up.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opvang.3: The guhs from the east are skinny and quiet. But every day they laugh a little more.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_wasguh: by the plushie wash next to the rescue center on Snuggletide Beach
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wasguh.1: In the plushie laundry, gray plushies turn pink again. With soap, warm water and lots and lots of love.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wasguh.2: Then they hang on the clothesline to dry. Look, half of them are pink again already!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wasguh.3: I wash everything. Plushies, socks, and sometimes the cat by accident.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_soepguh: by the soup stand on Snuggletide Beach, next to the rescue center
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_soepguh.1: Soup for everyone! Even if you're not hungry. Then you get a little bowl.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_soepguh.2: The guhs from the east haven't had anything warm for so long. I make a big pot every day.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_soepguh.3: My secret ingredient? A cuddle. Not in the soup, silly. After the soup.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_grijsje: by the rescue center on Snuggletide Beach, on a little blanket in the sand
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_grijsje.1: I'm from the east. Everything there is gray. Here everything is pink. I still have to get used to it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_grijsje.2: My plushie is called Mouse. I lost him while we were fleeing. Maybe he'll wash ashore.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_grijsje.3: Foster Mom Softie gives me warm milk every night. With a straw!
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_opa_dun: on a little bench by the soup stand on Snuggletide Beach
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opa_dun.1: Where I come from, sharing isn't allowed. Sharing is silly, they say there. Here everyone shares everything.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opa_dun.2: I've almost lost all my chonk. But the soup here helps. Every day another spoonful of chonk.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opa_dun.3: Do you know what I missed most? Laughing. Just laughing. About nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_vaaltje: by the clothesline on Snuggletide Beach
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vaaltje.1: We came through the fog in a little boat. It was very cold. And very quiet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vaaltje.2: I've never seen a lantern before. Can I hold one?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vaaltje.3: Here the creatures are gray, but they want to be cheered up. Over there it's different. Over there nothing is allowed to be happy.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_mama_pluis: at the entrance of the rescue center on Snuggletide Beach
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_mama_pluis.1: My fluff is almost back. Look, my little ears are already turning a bit pink.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_mama_pluis.2: I once had a whole cupboard full of plushies. They took them all. For the Bowl, they said.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_mama_pluis.3: Thank you for being here. It feels like home here. A new home.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_limonade: at the seashell lemonade bar on Beach Party Island, the island northeast of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_limonade.1: Seashell Lemonade! Pink, sweet and with a seagrass straw. Have a taste!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_limonade.2: The secret is in the little shells. They give it a hint of sea. A teeeeny hint of sea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_limonade.3: A glass of lemonade and a parasol. That's all a beach needs.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_volleybal: by the volleyball court on the east side of Beach Party Island
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_volleybal.1: Beach volleyball! Ball over the net, not into the sea. I never manage that last part.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_volleybal.2: I've never lost. I've never won either. I always play alone.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_volleybal.3: Come on, one game! I'll give you a head start. Of zero points.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_feestguh: at the campfire in the middle of Beach Party Island
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_feestguh.1: It's always a party here! A little party in the morning, a medium party in the afternoon and a big party in the evening.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_feestguh.2: The campfire never goes out. I make sure of that. With marshmallows.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_feestguh.3: Dancing around the campfire? Your feet will know how all by themselves.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_vliegermaker: in the kite workshop on Kite Island, the windy island in the northeast
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vliegermaker.1: A guh kite has little ears, a little face and a tail with bows. Otherwise it won't fly. Really.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vliegermaker.2: It's always windy on this island. That's why I live here. And because my hat keeps blowing away here, so I can't leave.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vliegermaker.3: Sticks, fabric, string and a ribbon. That's all you need. And patience. Lots of patience.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_windmeester: by the race pole on top of Kite Island
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_windmeester.1: I'm the referee of the great kite contest. I keep an eye on the wind. And on cheaters.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_windmeester.2: Whoever keeps their kite in the wind longest at the contest pole wins. It's that simple.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_windmeester.3: The big contest kite up there? That's mine. His name is Gary.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_duikmeester: on the diving jetty on the north side of the ring of Coral Bay, the atoll in the middle of the sea
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duikmeester.1: Underwater, Coral Bay is even prettier than above. Pink coral, shiny fish and three secret little grottos.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duikmeester.2: Goggles on, breathe in, and splash! Come back up before you turn blue. Or pink.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duikmeester.3: In the deepest grotto lies something big and sad. I don't dare go near it.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_wachter: in the keeper's little house under the big lighthouse on Lighthouse Island, in the east
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wachter.1: I've been keeping the lighthouse for sixty years. Every evening I light the lamp. Even when there are no boats.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wachter.2: A lighthouse says: here is land, here is warmth, come on in. That's all. It doesn't need to say more.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wachter.3: From up top I can see all the currents. The sea tells me everything. If I listen closely.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_imker: by the bee farm on Flower Island, in the middle of the island chain
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_imker.1: My bees make pink honey. From the flowers here. Have a taste, it tastes like summer.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_imker.2: A bee farm on an island is nice. The bees can't run away. They can fly away, though. And they do.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_imker.3: Buzz buzz. That's bee talk for 'good morning'. Or for 'watch out'. Depends.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_madelief: by the flower fields on the south side of Flower Island
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_madelief.1: A flower wreath makes everyone pretty. Even a Mika. Well, almost.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_madelief.2: I'm weaving wreaths for the snuggle festival. One for every plushie that comes home.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_madelief.3: Take a sniff. That's the sea and the flowers together. My favorite smell.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_schelpie: in the little hut on the back of Granny Bobber, the sleeping giant turtle east of Flower Island
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schelpie.1: I live on Granny Bobber. She's been asleep for a hundred years. Her husband, Old Bobber, swims circles around her and comes to rest by the jetty for a bit every lap.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schelpie.2: Every morning I wake up somewhere else. Very adventurous, for a hermit.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schelpie.3: Old Bobber is a hundred years old. Or two hundred. He won't say. He doesn't say much anyway.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_nevel: by the crumbling gray gate on Mystery Island, the misty island in the southeast
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_nevel.1: I came through the fog. From the east. I don't dare go any further yet. Here it's... in between.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_nevel.2: In the fog you hear voices. They say: 'Quiet is quick.' I don't want to be quiet anymore.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_nevel.3: Beyond the fog the gray land begins. I got out. I'm never going back.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_pierwachter: at the start of the Liftoff Pier on the Pierhead, the tip all the way in the east of the island chain
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_pierwachter.1: The Liftoff Pier. This is where the airships take off for Highchonk. Well, soon. When the whale comes down low enough.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_pierwachter.2: I've been waiting years for the first airship. I'm already wearing my best cap.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_pierwachter.3: Look up. That shadow on the water? That's Mother Cloudwhale. She swims through the sky.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_hemelkapitein: at the end of the Liftoff Pier, on the round platform by the mooring mast with little ears
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_hemelkapitein.1: My airship is built to go up. Way, way up. All the way above the clouds.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_hemelkapitein.2: Highchonk is the most beautiful city in the world. I was born there. On the back of a whale. Weird, huh?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_hemelkapitein.3: When the whale comes down low, we take off. Not before. Even I can't fly that high.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z4_wacht_haven: on the Harbor Square of Lanternhaven, by the campfire
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wacht_haven.1: Light the campfire: this is where you wake up if you faint. Warm, safe, and you lose nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wacht_haven.2: The Coast Guard keeps the lanterns burning and the boats in one piece. And we share our cookies.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wacht_haven.3: The creatures on the coast are gray and sad. Cheer them up, adventurer. One pink poof and they're happy again.
