vadsrijk.z6wezens.lampendover.gedoofd: Your little light has been snuffed!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.huisdier.gevonden: ✦ A new pet wants to come along: %s! (press P)
vadsrijk.z6wezens.set.sterrenwacht.6: (6) Starlet: every 20 s your next hit deals +40%% damage
vadsrijk.z6wezens.luik.in: You climb down through the hatch... The Sunken Observatory.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.luik.uit: You climb back up, into Ruin Valley.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.luik.hint.in: An old hatch in the dome (right-click): to The Sunken Observatory
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.fase2.onder: Take cover on the pink spots!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.fase3.onder: Knock the gray salt crust off her back!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.duikt: She dives under! Keep moving, or you'll get a sand fountain!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.onder: She's under the sand! Wait until she comes up.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.schuil: She's gulping sand! Take cover on a pink spot!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.korst: A gray salt crust on her back! Jump at it from a dune, or shoot it off.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.korst_eerst: The salt crust protects her! Knock the crust off first.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.korst_weg: The crust is off! She's dazed for a moment: hit her now!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.blij: Queen Wormelina is pink again... she yawns, and falls asleep in the warm sand.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.zk.fase2.onder: High note = purple ring: step out!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.zk.fase3.onder: Look straight at his heart: double damage!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.zk.kristallen: He throws singing crystals! Listen for the high note.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.zk.gloeit: His heart glows! Look at it while you hit (even better with the Star Lens).
vadsrijk.z6wezens.zk.weg: The Salt Colossus crumbles into glittering salt.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.aw.fase.onder: Stand in the pink gaps when the rings sweep
vadsrijk.z6wezens.aw.nu: The rings are lined up: NOW!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.aw.kaatst: The rings deflect your hit! Wait for the golden light.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.gl.fase2.onder: Two bowls go out, and Lamp Snuffers show up
vadsrijk.z6wezens.gl.aan: The bowl burns again! (%s of the 4 out)
vadsrijk.z6wezens.gl.donker: He hides in the dark! Light the fire bowls.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.gl.weg: Glimmer flees in a puff of smoke. 'My snuffer! The Ring Finger will hear about this!'
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.fase2.onder: A red ring spreading out from him: get close!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.fase3.onder: He scatters more and more star grit
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.hart.onder: All beams on his heart: double damage!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.telescoop_goed: This one's right! (%s of the 4 aimed)
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.schok: Star shock! Stay close to him!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.wanhoop3: The stars... I can't see them anymore...
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.blij: The Sunken Star Guh glows again! 'Thank you, little traveler. Here: the Star Compass.'
vadsrijk.rijdier.tandem.achterop: You're riding on the back. Only the owner steers. (Shift = hop off)
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.zandvlooi: They hide in the sand (just two little feelers poking out). Get close and they jump out!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.fennekguh: He hears you from far away and calls his buddy. Red stripe = his leap: step aside.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.springpiep: Red circle = he kicks sand: get out of there, or you can't see a thing for a moment. Then he bounces away and back again.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.duinkruiper: Red cone in front of him = his tail stings. His venom is sticky. Walk around him!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.dadelaapje: He throws dates (red circle) and sometimes pinches coins. Cheer him up and you get it all back.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.gierguh: He dives at whoever is LOWEST. Red stripe = dive. Afterwards he sits on the ground for a bit: your chance!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.spiegelslang: A mirage: there are three, but only one is real. A copy bursts apart when you hit it.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.zoutkreeft: His salt crust blocks hits from the front. From BEHIND he's soft: walk around him!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.zandgeestje: Only at night. Purple circle = he pulls you toward him. Step out!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.ruinewachter: A silent statue... until you get close. Big red circle = his stomp: keep your distance.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.mika_lampendover: Red cone = his giant snuffer. He makes it dark and snuffs out your Wahoog and Quickpaws.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.mika_ringdrager: Purple circle = he opens a light-catching jar. Walk out of the circle and the beam breaks.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.gedoofd_sterretje: Three little red circles = star grit. Cheer it up: sometimes it wants to come along with you!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.zoutslang: She swims through the rocks and comes for NOISE: running and hitting. Red stripe = that's where she pops out!
vadsrijk.loot.duinwandelaarstulband.flav: "With two little holes for guh ears."
"Keeps the sun out of your eyes and the sand out of your hair."
vadsrijk.loot.duinwandelaarsmantel.flavo: "There's still a bit of pink sand in the folds."
vadsrijk.loot.duinwandelaarslaarzen.flav: "Sand in, sand out. That's how it goes."
vadsrijk.loot.duinwandelaarswanten.flavo: "Warm by day, cool at night. How?"
vadsrijk.loot.duinwandelaarscape.flavour: "Handy as a sunshade at a picnic."
vadsrijk.loot.zijdetulband.flavour.1: "A saffron thread runs right through it."
vadsrijk.loot.zijdegewaad.flavour.0: "Soft as a little cloud, pink as a dune."
vadsrijk.loot.zijdepofbroek.flavour.1: "Nice and roomy for bowing to the sultana."
vadsrijk.loot.zijdeslofjes.flavour.1: "They make no sound in the bazaar."
vadsrijk.loot.zijdehandschoentjes.flavou: "Tiny little stars are embroidered on them."
"The colors of the old caravan guard."
vadsrijk.loot.karavaanwachtlaarzen.flavo: "With a little compass in the heel. Almost."
vadsrijk.loot.sterrenwachtkap.flavour.0: "An old hood of the Star Guhs."
vadsrijk.loot.sterrenkaartmantel.flavour: "Take a look at night: it sparkles along."
vadsrijk.loot.sterrenkaartcape.flavour.0: "The Mother Oasis is on it too. Very small."
vadsrijk.loot.sterrenkaartcape.flavour.1: "A map you never have to fold."
vadsrijk.loot.saffraanring.flavour.1: "Smells just a tiny bit of rice."
vadsrijk.loot.woestijnroosring.flavour.0: "A desert rose of pink sand, hard as stone."
vadsrijk.loot.woestijnroosring.flavour.1: "Fits any finger. Even your second ring finger."
vadsrijk.loot.rozenketting.flavour.1: "A little gift from Gorge Mother Rosie."
vadsrijk.loot.sterrenoorbel.flavour.0: "A little shooting star, caught in silver."
vadsrijk.loot.zoutkristalarmband.flavour: "Every little crystal sings a different note."
vadsrijk.loot.rozenkromzwaard.flavour.0: "Curved like a dune, sharp as a cactus."
vadsrijk.loot.rozenkromzwaard.flavour.1: "For the knight who wears a shield and a smile."
vadsrijk.loot.dadelpalmknots.flavour.1: "Sometimes dates fall out. Yummy after a fight."
vadsrijk.loot.duinvalkboog.flavour.0: "For shots all the way over the next dune."
vadsrijk.loot.duinvalkboog.flavour.1: "A little vultureguh feather on the string."
"Click, click, click: as quick as a caravan bell."
vadsrijk.loot.saffraanstaf.flavour.0: "A little ball of saffron fire on a stick."
vadsrijk.loot.oasefluit.flavour.0: "Play a little tune and everyone feels better."
vadsrijk.loot.oasefluit.flavour.1: "Carved from oasis reed. Sounds like running water."
item.guhs.vr_z6_kristal_rozenkwarts.flav: Pink and warm. Your hits crit more often.
item.guhs.vr_z6_kristal_sterrenzout.flav: Hardened starlight from the Salt Flats. More damage against bosses.
vadsrijk.loot.z6baas_wormelientand.flavo: "She gave it away herself. It was loose."
vadsrijk.loot.z6baas_duinzwemmerslaarzen: "You glide through the sand like a worm. A sweet worm."
vadsrijk.loot.z6baas_wimperwaaier.flavou: "One of Wormelina's eyelashes. She has plenty."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z6baas_wimperwaaie: you take 8%% less damage in the Silklands
"When you swing it, it sings a high note."
vadsrijk.loot.z6baas_zoutsplinterboog.fl: "Carved from a splinter of the Salt Colossus."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z6baas_zoutsplinte: +15%% damage to enemies farther than 10 blocks away
vadsrijk.loot.z6baas_zoutkristalkroon.fl: "A little crown the Salt Colossus never needed."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z6baas_zoutkristal: below 30%% Chonk a salt shield: Snuggle Shield 15%% (45 s cooldown)
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z6baas_astrolabium: every 11 s your next hit does 30%% more
vadsrijk.loot.z6baas_glimmertjes_dover.f: "It doesn't snuff out lights anymore. Only enemies."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z6baas_glimmertjes: your hits sometimes make enemies dizzy (10%%, 1 s)
vadsrijk.loot.z6baas_sterrenkijkerkruisb: "With a little telescope on top. You'll never miss at night again."
vadsrijk.loot.z6baas_sterrenhartamulet.f: "A piece of the heart of the Sunken Star Guh. It glows."
vadsrijk.bazen.effect.z6baas_sterrenhart: at night you glow yourself and your elements do 6%% more
vadsrijk.z6wezens.baas.wormelien.onder: She swims through the sand, gray and hungry
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.baas_wormelien: Keep moving when she dives (standing still = sand fountain). Pink spots = take cover behind a dune. Phase 3: knock the gray salt crust off her back, jump from a dune or shoot it off.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.wormelien: Keep moving when she dives under (standing still = sand fountain). Pink spots = hide behind a dune. Phase 3: knock the gray salt crust off her back, jump from a dune or shoot it off.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.wormelien: Keep moving when she burrows (standing still = sand fountain). Pink spots = take cover behind a dune. Phase 3: knock the gray salt crust off her back, jump from a dune or shoot it off.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.baas_zoutkolos: Red crack lines = salt waves. Hear a high note? Step out of the purple ring around a crystal, or smash it. Phase 3: look straight at his glowing heart for double damage.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.zoutkolos: Red crack lines = salt waves. Hear a high note? Step out of the purple ring around a crystal, or smash it. Phase 3: look straight at his glowing heart for double damage.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.zoutkolos: Red crack lines = salt waves. Hear a high note? Step out of the purple ring around a crystal, or smash it. Phase 3: look straight at his glowing heart for double damage.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.baas_astrolabiumwa: Hit hardest when the rings are lined up (golden light): then your hit gets all the way through. During a ring sweep: stand in a pink gap.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.astrolabiumwachter: Strike mostly when the rings line up (golden light): then your hit lands in full. During a Ring Sweep: stand in a pink gap.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.astrolabiumwachter: Hit him mostly when the rings line up (golden light): then your blow lands in full. During a ring sweep: stand in a pink opening.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.baas_glimmertje: He snuffs out the fire bowls. Right-click a dark bowl 2x to light it again. All four out? Then he hides in the dark.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.glimmertje: He snuffs out the fire bowls. Right-click a dark bowl 2x to light it again. All four out? Then he hides in the dark.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.glimmertje: He snuffs out the fire bowls. Right-click a dark bowl 2x to light it again. All four out? Then he hides in the dark.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.baas.sterrenguh.onder: An old giant of star stone, gone gray
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.baas_sterrenguh: Right-click the four telescopes until they are all aimed at his heart (golden beam). Then he glows: double damage!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.sterrenguh: Right-click the four telescopes until they all point at its heart (golden beam). Then it glows: double damage!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.sterrenguh: Right-click the four telescopes until they all point at his heart (golden beam). Then he glows: double damage!
vadsrijk.huisdier.fennekje.tekst: A little fennecguh with ears bigger than its head. It hears everything.
vadsrijk.huisdier.fennekje.bron: Rare: cheer up a Fennecguh in the Pink Dunes.
vadsrijk.huisdier.springpiepje.tekst: Boing! Boing! He bounces after you everywhere.
vadsrijk.huisdier.springpiepje.bron: Rare: cheer up a Hopsqueak (or a side quest in Rose Gorge).
vadsrijk.huisdier.sterretje.tekst: A cheered-up little star. It glows a little at night.
vadsrijk.huisdier.sterretje.bron: Rare: cheer up a Snuffed Starlet at The Mother Oasis.
vadsrijk.huisdier.dadelaapje.tekst: Doesn't steal coins anymore. Only dates. Sometimes.
vadsrijk.huisdier.dadelaapje.bron: Side quest 'The Date Monkey Gang' (or very rarely from a Date Monkey).
vadsrijk.huisdier.bobbeltje.tekst: Granny Date's baby humpguh. He wants to come with you!
vadsrijk.huisdier.bobbeltje.bron: The end of The Star Caravan (the Mother Oasis).
vadsrijk.huisdier.wormelientje.tekst: A teeny-tiny pink sand worm with eyelashes. Loves to nap in your pocket.
vadsrijk.huisdier.zoutklontje.tekst: A lump of star salt that was left behind when the Salt Colossus fell apart. It squeaks.
vadsrijk.huisdier.sterrenguhtje.tekst: A mini Star Guh. He always points toward the Mother Oasis.
vadsrijk.huisdier.sterrenguhtje.bron: Cheer up The Sunken Star Guh (first time).
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.eigen.bultguh: A camel guh with two soft humps. 30% faster on sand, and someone can ride along on the back!
vadsrijk.economie.stal.nog_niet.bultguh: Help Granny Date's caravan in Rose Gorge (Stable Master Bumpy): then you get to pick your own Humpguh.
vadsrijk.rijdier.bron.api.z6_raid_sterre: Rare drop from the raid The Star-Snuffing Tower.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_het_z: Fully explore The Silklands (Exploration Book, key B).
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_ridder_van_het_z: Play 'The Star Caravan' to the end.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_sjacheraar: Haggle nicely with three merchants in the Grand Bazaar of Saffron Gate.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_vriend_van_ringe: Cheer up Duchess Ringaling, at the top of The Star-Snuffing Tower.
vadsrijk.npc.reis.slot.zijdeland: Line E to the Silklands only opens once Mother Cloudwhale has swum east (after 'Stars in the East' in Highchonk) and you're level 60 (you: level %s).
vadsrijk.luchtschip.slot.z6: Line E only opens once Mother Cloudwhale has swum east (after Highchonk) and you're level 60.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.binnenkort.kwartierme: The Snuggle Quarter opens soon. Then I'll take you there. Promise.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.binnenkort.bondenbord: My board is still empty. The Snuggle Squads are coming soon. Then we'll pin it full of everything.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tapijtwinkel: I sell ordinary carpets. Flying ones are made by Button, in the Grand Bazaar of Saffron Gate. Patterns for your carpet you'll learn later with Sewing. Or you find them. In the strangest places.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.leermeester.binnenkor: My workshop is almost ready. Come back later.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.lens.stand: Star Lens: %s of the 5 beacons are burning.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.lens.alle: All five beacons are burning. The Mother Oasis is visible.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.baken.al: %s is already burning. The stars wink at you.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.baken.nog_niet: It's not this beacon's turn yet. Follow the story first (your tracker shows the way).
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.klus.dadels: You lift the baskets of dates onto the caravan. They smell sweet.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.klus.water: You fill the waterskins at the fountain. Lumpy sneakily drinks one empty.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.klus.tapijten: Carpet Trader Fringe rolls three carpets onto your arms. "Don't drop them. They're a hundred years old."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.bobbeltje: Behind the dune sits Lumpkin, with sand on her hump and a date in her little snout. She hops back with you.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tuin.water: You water the hanging garden. Rose petals flutter down into the gorge.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.noria: You tinker with the water wheel. Krrr... krrr-eeek! It's turning again.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ziedershuisje: You straighten the little walls of the saltmaker's hut. It stands. Crooked, but it stands.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.grot.schat: The First Caravan's chest opens. Inside is a carpet pattern, and a note.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.feest: Lumpkin jumps onto the cake. Everyone cheers. Granny Date sings.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.kompas.fallback: Deep in The Sunken Observatory, past the fire bowls and the rings, you find a big gray guh made of starstone. You give him a hug. He glows, very softly, and places the Star Compass in your paws.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.kerker.binnen: The Sunken Observatory. It smells of old copper and stardust. You can hear stony snoring.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.soep.kom: You hand over a bowl of soup. The Unchonked guh turns a tiny bit pink. (%s/3)
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.soep.al: This guh already has soup. He gives you a grateful nod.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.bron.slaapt: Mother Spring is asleep, gray and dried up. She mumbles: "...stars... not yet... all of them..."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.glans.spiegel: Where Master Gleam stood, there is now a mirror in the shape of a guh. He was never really here.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.toren.dicht: The gate of The Star-Snuffing Tower is shut with a ring lock. That takes at least two.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.zone6.klaar: The story of the Silklands is complete! The caravans can find the Mother Oasis again. At the top of The Star-Snuffing Tower, Duchess Ringaling is still waiting: that's the raid, for 2 to 10 players.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.epiloog.0: The caravans come back to the Mother Oasis, one by one, with little bells and songs. The water of the Saffron River is rising again.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.epiloog.1: Granny Date makes tea. Lumpkin jumps into the oasis. And in Saffron Gate, in the Paradise Garden, a veiled lady with ten bare toes sits gazing at the stars.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.beloning.wacht.bultgu: (Your humpguh is waiting with Bumpy. It will come to you as soon as humpguhs are in the game.)
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.beloning.wacht.tapijt: (Your carpet has been woven. It will come to you as soon as flying carpets are in the game.)
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.beloning.wacht.uiterl: (This carpet pattern will come to you as soon as flying carpets are in the game.)
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.wormelien.zicht: In the distance a dune bursts open. A gigantic pink sandworm with eyelashes rolls through the sand, gray and hungry, and dives back under. Queen Wormelina.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.brief.0: In a gray little tent lies an envelope with a seal: a ring. It says: 'To the Ring Finger.'
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.brief.1: "Madam Duchess. The Empty Lens on the tower works. With every snuffed beacon it drinks more starlight. Your rings are nearly full. The oasis is almost hidden enough to pump dry. Your Knuckle, G."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.brief.2: Below, in elegant handwriting with a little sparkle: "Delightful. Ten toes, ten rings, all the stars. - R."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ringeling.voor.0: The veiled lady looks at her toes. Ten bare toes. "Do I know you? Not yet, darling. Not yet."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ringeling.na.0: "You! My knight! Come here. It's me, Ringaling. The veil? Not everyone knows I'm nice now."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ringeling.na.1: "You know what I found out when you took my rings? That I didn't miss them. I felt something warm. Chonk. Stolen from nobody."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ringeling.na.2: "The Emperor has no use for me anymore. I sent him a note. With a little heart on it. He hates little hearts."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ringeling.na.3: "If you ever go east, to his Fingers: I know where they keep their socks. Do drop by."
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_zandloper: at the Rose Gorge Skyport, the round stone mooring tower on the north edge of the gorge, by the counter under the mast with the banners
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_zandloper.1: Welcome to the Rose Gorge Skyport! From here you can look right into the gorge. Don't lean too far forward.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_zandloper.2: I count the ships with my hourglass. One ship per hourglass. Sometimes it tips over. Then I start counting again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_zandloper.3: Want to travel? Line E flies to Highchonk. And I have the travel map.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_roosje: in the Treasure Room, the big carved facade in the end wall on the east side of Rose Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosje.1: I'm the oldest guh in the gorge. I was here when these rocks were still blushing softly pink. They're still blushing now.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosje.2: The Treasure Room was carved from a single piece of rock. By my great-grandmother. With a teaspoon. It took a while.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosje.3: At night we always used to watch the star beacons. Now they're out. The gorge is so dark without them.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_dadel: on the Rose Square, the bottom of Rose Gorge by the star-shaped fountain, by the caravan with the striped bags
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel.1: I'm Granny Date and this is my caravan. Small but sweet. Just like me. Well, I'm not that small.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel.2: Lumpy, my humpguh, carries everything. Except me. I like to walk. That gives me an excuse for a nap.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel.3: La-la-LAA-la-lo... That's the caravan song. Every caravan sings it. That's how the stars find you again.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_hobbel: on the Rose Square, the bottom of Rose Gorge by the star-shaped fountain, in the humpguh stable with the striped awning
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_hobbel.1: Humpguhs! They have two humps. One is full of water. The other is full of coziness.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_hobbel.2: A humpguh walks over sand like it's a pillow. Faster than any Plumeguh. Don't tell a Plumeguh.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_hobbel.3: A humpguh has two seats. Bring a friend. Or a big bag.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_franje: on the Rose Square, the bottom of Rose Gorge by the star-shaped fountain, in the carpet shop with the rolled-up carpets in front of the door
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_franje.1: Carpets! For sitting on, for lying on and, if you're very sweet, for flying on.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_franje.2: Flying? Only a carpet of starsilk can do that. Button makes those in Saffron Gate. I sell the ordinary ones.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_franje.3: This carpet is a hundred years old. You can tell by the coffee stain. That's a hundred years old too.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_roosmarijn: on the first ledge of Rose Gorge, by the hanging gardens above the western wall stairs
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosmarijn.1: The hanging gardens hang over the edges of the ledges. They like hanging. Sometimes I hang out with them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosmarijn.2: Carrying water up is hard work. But a rose that thanks you makes it worth it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosmarijn.3: Watch out for the wall stairs. They're steep. And they count down out loud when you go down.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_stempel: on the Rose Square, the bottom of Rose Gorge by the star-shaped fountain, by the little post office with the yellow door under the first ledge
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stempel.1: Mail! Mail for the cliff houses! Everyone here lives at a different height. My paws are very strong.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stempel.2: I have a bag full of letters and a head full of stairs.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stempel.3: Sometimes I send a letter to myself. Then I get mail too.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_bankier_kloof: on the Rose Square, the bottom of Rose Gorge by the star-shaped fountain, in the bank, the rock facade with the copper door
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_kloof.1: The bank of Rose Gorge is inside the rock. The safest vault in the Silklands. It's mostly full of sand. And money.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_kloof.2: Your things are just as safe here as in Highchonk. It's the same vault. That's magic. Or bookkeeping.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_kloof.3: Interest? I'll give you one date a year. A big one.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.kk_poort_rozenkloo: on the Rose Square, the bottom of Rose Gorge by the star-shaped fountain, next to the fountain
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_poort_rozenkloof.1: A little house of your own? There's still room in the Snuggle Quarter. I'll take you there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_poort_rozenkloof.2: Cliff dwellings are pretty, but a little garden of your own is prettier.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_poort_rozenkloof.3: Your neighbors in the Snuggle Quarter are very nice. I picked them myself.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.bond_bord_rozenklo: on the Rose Square, the bottom of Rose Gorge by the star-shaped fountain, at the notice board next to the bank
Looking for a Snuggle Squad? Every squad looking for new members is pinned on my board.
Traveling together is cozier. And you really don't do the Star-Snuffing Tower alone.
Go ahead and pin up your own note. I've got plenty of thumbtacks.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_rozijntje: on the throne at the back of the Hall of Mirrors, under the golden dome of the Raisin Palace (north bank of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rozijntje.1: Welcome to my Hall of Mirrors, knight. Don't look in the mirrors too long. You'll start to like yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rozijntje.2: Saffron Gate lives on the water from the Mother Oasis. And on tea. Mostly on tea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rozijntje.3: A sultana has to be strict. I practice every morning. It's not working yet.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_kaneelstok: in the Raisin Palace on the north bank of Saffron Gate (the golden onion dome), by the iwan with the turquoise tiles in front of the Hall of Mirrors
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kaneelstok.1: I am the Grand Vizier. I arrange everything for the Sultana. Even things that don't need arranging.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kaneelstok.2: An audience? That can be done. After tea. And after the tea after that.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kaneelstok.3: Lately two of me have been seen in the palace. That's strange. There's only one of me. Right?
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_glans: in the Hall of Mirrors of the Raisin Palace, by the mirror arch to the left of the runner
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_glans.1: I polish the mirrors in the Hall of Mirrors. All thousand of them. Every day. They shine when you look into them. So do I.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_glans.2: In a mirror you see everything, knight. Even what isn't there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_glans.3: I'm just a simple mirror polisher. Very simple. Nothing special. Move along.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_twinkel: in Twinkle's Observatory, the lavender tower with the copper telescope in the northeast of Saffron Gate, next to the big copper telescope
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_twinkel.1: The stars are maps that switch on at night. Whoever can read them never gets lost.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_twinkel.2: My telescope is made of copper. It's so big I need a little stepladder for it. And a cushion.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_twinkel.3: Five beacons. Five stars. Five times as dark as before. That's too much dark.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_dadel_serai: in the Caravanserai by the West Gate of Saffron Gate (the square courtyard with the arcades), by the fountain in the middle of the courtyard
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel_serai.1: My caravan rests here. The humpguhs drink, the guhs eat, and I take a nap. That's how it goes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel_serai.2: The Caravanserai is the home of all caravans. There's always tea, and always someone with a story.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel_serai.3: La-la-LAA-la-lo. Hum along. Then the stars will find us.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_knoopje: in the Grand Bazaar, the covered street on the south bank of Saffron Gate, in the sewing studio with the carpets on the pillars
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knoopje.1: I weave carpets. Ordinary ones, pretty ones and flying ones. You have to hold on tight to the flying ones.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knoopje.2: You make a flying carpet from starsilk. Silk from the mulberry trees, with a pinch of stardust.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knoopje.3: My tassels keep blowing away. They want to fly too.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_kardemom: in the Grand Bazaar, the covered street on the south bank of Saffron Gate, at the stall with the little spice mountains under the big golden dome
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kardemom.1: Spices! Cardamom, cinnamon, saffron and a secret spice that smells like cuddles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kardemom.2: Haggling is part of the fun. But whoever haggles sweetly gets a bigger discount. That's how it works in the bazaar.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kardemom.3: Come to me for potions and snacks for the road.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_pistache: in the Grand Bazaar, the covered street on the south bank of Saffron Gate, at the stall with the pots and the baskets
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pistache.1: Everything is for sale. Except my mustache. That belonged to my grandpa.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pistache.2: Want to sell something? The Saffron Gate auction house is right here, with me.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pistache.3: The more you laugh, the lower the price. That's a secret. Don't tell anyone.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_lokum: in the Grand Bazaar, the covered street on the south bank of Saffron Gate, at the glass stall by the pillar with the lanterns
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_lokum.1: Setting gems? Taking them out? I do it with tweezers and a little Turkish delight to keep calm.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_lokum.2: Saffron Gold is the prettiest gold in the world. It smells a little like rice.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_lokum.3: They say there's a duchess with ten rings. On her toes. I'd love to take a peek.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_koperkop: in the Grand Bazaar, the covered street on the south bank of Saffron Gate, at the smithy at the west end
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_koperkop.1: Tink, tonk, tink. My hammer sings in the bazaar. My neighbors sing back. A bit less happily.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_koperkop.2: Saffron Gold is soft on the outside and strong on the inside. Just like a guh.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_koperkop.3: Come on in if you'd like something made.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_bankier_poort: at the bank counter, by the Saffron Bridge on the south bank of Saffron Gate
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_poort.1: The bank of Saffron Gate. The vault stands on stilts, in case the river ever gets too excited.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_poort.2: Anything you leave with one banker, you can pick up from any banker. Here too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_poort.3: I count coins in my sleep. Yesterday I got to eleven. Then I woke up.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_knars: on the quay of the Saffron River, by the big noria next to the Saffron Bridge
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knars.1: The norias scoop water up out of the river. They creak and sing. Or they used to sing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knars.2: A noria without a song is a sad wheel. I can feel it in my teeth.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knars.3: Creak. Creak. That's not a name, that's a sound. But it's also my name.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_pluk: in the Canal Quarter, by the little bridge with the flower boxes (southwest of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pluk.1: I have ten rubber ducks! Well, had. They floated off through the Canal Quarter.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pluk.2: If you fly over the water, you can catch them. With a carpet. Or with a really long arm.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pluk.3: My favorite duck is called Quack. The others are called Quack too. That's easy.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_ringeling: in the Paradise Garden behind the Raisin Palace (the four plots with canals, north side of Saffron Gate), by the fountain with the four little canals
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_ringeling.1: Do I know you? Not yet, darling. Not yet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_ringeling.2: What a lovely city. So... shared. I still have to get used to it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_ringeling.3: I have ten toes. That's normal. Ten bare toes. That's new.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.kk_poort_saffraanp: on the palace square of Saffron Gate, by the stone bench under the palm trees
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_poort_saffraanpoor: A house with a little dome? You can have that in the Snuggle Quarter. Almost. I'll take you there.
Saffron Gate is full. But the Snuggle Quarter still has plots.
A garden with a fountain? You'll need a pretty big watering can for that.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.bond_bord_saffraan: in the Caravanserai by the West Gate of Saffron Gate (the square courtyard with the arcades), at the guild caravan board under the arcade
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_bord_saffraanpoo: Squads need members! Just look at my board.
You do the Star-Snuffing Tower with two or more. This is where you find the more.
A Snuggle Squad is a caravan that never splits up.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_leermeester_sme: in the Grand Bazaar, the covered street on the south bank of Saffron Gate, in the smithy next to Smith Copperhead
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_leermeester_smeden: Smithing Saffron Gold is like kneading honey. Warm, slow and a little bit sticky.
With Star Iron you make the prettiest jewelry. It's rare, but you can find it in Ruin Valley.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_leermeester_naa: in the Grand Bazaar, the covered street on the south bank of Saffron Gate, in the sewing studio next to Button
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_leermeester_naaien: Starsilk! Cocoons from the mulberry trees and a pinch of stardust. So soft you sink right into it.
I sew saddle blankets for humpguhs. They're picky. Stripes, please.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_leermeester_kok: in the Caravanserai by the West Gate of Saffron Gate (the square courtyard with the arcades), in the kitchen behind the arcades
Saffron rice with dates. Rosewater Turkish delight. And tea with cardamom. I'll teach you everything.
You make a Caravan Meal for everyone at once. That's the only proper way.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_leermeester_bro: in the brewery under Twinkle's Observatory (northeast of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_leermeester_brouwe: Rosewater, stardust potions, and polishing salt crystals. My brewery smells like everything at once.
A potion with stardust makes you glow softly at night. Handy in the desert.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_leermeester_imk: in the Paradise Garden behind the Raisin Palace (the four plots with canals, north side of Saffron Gate), by the beehives among the orange trees
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_leermeester_imkere: Orange blossom honey. Saffron Honey. The bees in the Paradise Garden are very posh.
A bee in the desert gets thirsty. That's why they live by the fountains.
Come along, and I'll explain everything.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_dadelpit: by the lowest waterfall in the Palm Gorges, the river gorge southwest of Saffron Gate
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadelpit.1: Welcome to the Palm Gorges! The sweetest dates in the world grow here. If the little monkeys don't pinch them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadelpit.2: The waterfalls sing here day and night. I sing along. Nobody hears it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadelpit.3: Up on the plateau stands the Palm Beacon. It's been dark for weeks. It makes my palms sad.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_spetter: at the mouth of the Palm Gorges, where the Saffron River flows into the sea
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_spetter.1: I deliver mail along the waterfalls. Fast and wet. Mostly wet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_spetter.2: With a carpet you're faster. With a carpet and an umbrella you're dry.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_spetter.3: I hold a record. I'm not telling which one. You'll have to try it yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_korrel: on the Salt Flats, by the saltmaker's little house on the south edge (southeast of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_korrel.1: Salt! White salt, pink salt, and at night, sparkly salt. That last one tastes like stars.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_korrel.2: My salt-boiling hut has half caved in. The little salt crayfish threw a party in it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_korrel.3: Under the Salt Flats there's a cave that sings. I hear her through the floor at night.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_rimpel: on the crest of the Pink Dunes, by the tent with the pink pennant (south of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rimpel.1: I live in the Pink Dunes. Every day my little house is in a different spot. The sand shifts.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rimpel.2: Queen Wormelina swims through the dunes. She used to sing. Now she only grumbles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rimpel.3: The Dune Beacon stands on the highest dune. When it burns again, I'll be able to sleep again.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_stof: in the archaeologist camp in Ruin Valley, between the mesas northeast of Saffron Gate
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stof.1: I'm an archaeologist. I dig into old things. And into cookie tins. That's a kind of archaeology too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stof.2: The Star Guhs built temples here for the stars. They counted every single one. One by one.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stof.3: The Sunken Observatory lies in Ruin Valley. Half buried in sand. Don't go in alone.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_bron: on the shore of the Mother Oasis, under the great Mother Palm (the east of the Silklands)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bron.2: I am the spring of all sweet water. I was tired. Very tired. Not anymore.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bron.3: Whoever follows the star path always finds water. I promise.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_mientje: by the refugee tents on the east side of the Mother Oasis, where the East Route begins
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_mientje.1: It's me, Minnie! From the soup kitchen in Highchonk. I came along. And more are coming.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_mientje.2: They come along the East Route. Skinny and gray. Just like I used to be.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_vluchteling_1: by the refugee tents on the east side of the Mother Oasis
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_1.1: We come from far away. From where all the roads go one way.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_1.2: There's water here. Sweet water. I didn't know water could be sweet.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_vluchteling_2: by the refugee tents on the east side of the Mother Oasis
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_2.1: The Mikas said the oasis was empty. It's full! They lied.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_2.2: My little ones are finally asleep. By the water.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_2.3: Can I have another bowl? For later. For the journey.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_vluchteling_3: by the refugee tents on the east side of the Mother Oasis
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_3.1: I walked the whole East Route. My feet are now officially flat.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_3.2: There's a gray tower near here. I don't look at it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_3.3: Tomorrow I'm going to Saffron Gate. They say there's tea.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_burger_1: on the Rose Square, the bottom of Rose Gorge by the star-shaped fountain
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_1.1: I live on the second ledge. Every morning I walk down. Every evening I walk up. My calves are famous.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_1.2: When the sun sinks into the gorge, everything turns pink. Even pinker than it already was.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_1.3: Have you seen the whale? You can see her from the Sea Mouth. Like a little cloud with a tail.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_burger_2: on the first ledge of Rose Gorge, by the cliff dwellings with the little balconies
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_2.1: My balcony looks out on the neighbors' balcony. We wave every day.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_2.2: My flower box has desert roses. They hardly need any water. Just like me. Almost.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_2.3: We used to see the beacons burning at night. Now we only see the neighbors.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_burger_3: in the Grand Bazaar, the covered street on the south bank of Saffron Gate
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_3.1: You can get lost in the bazaar. I've lived here thirty years and I'm still a little lost.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_3.2: Under the domes, beams of light fall inside. Sometimes I dance in them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_3.3: Smell that? Cardamom. And cinnamon. And a bit of humpguh.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_burger_4: on the quay of the Saffron River, by the little feluccas
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_4.1: The river gets a little lower every week. You can tell by the marks on the quay.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_4.2: If the Mother Oasis dries up, everything dries up. Then we'll have to move. But where to?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_4.3: A felucca is a little boat with a triangular sail. I have three. They're called One, Two and Three.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_burger_5: in the Paradise Garden behind the Raisin Palace (the four plots with canals, north side of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_5.1: Everything grows in the Paradise Garden. Pomegranates, oranges, roses and lots and lots of tea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_5.2: The four canals stand for the four directions. Or for four kinds of tea. We don't remember anymore.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_5.3: Sometimes a veiled lady sits here. She doesn't say anything. She just looks at her toes.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_burger_6: in the Caravanserai by the West Gate of Saffron Gate (the square courtyard with the arcades)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_6.1: I'm a caravanguh. I can sleep on a humpguh at full gallop.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_6.2: Without the beacons we don't dare to travel anymore. We've been stuck here for weeks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_6.3: Granny Date is the bravest of us all. She just travels anyway. With a teapot.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_wacht_1: at the campfire on the Rose Square of Rose Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_1.1: Light the campfire: that's where you wake up if you faint. Even in the desert.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_1.2: We guard the road. With a lance, a lantern and a thermos of tea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_1.3: In the daytime the sand is too hot for humpguh paws. That's why caravans travel at night.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.z6_wacht_2: at the campfire under the Rose Gorge Skyport
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_2.1: Light the campfire: that's where you wake up if you faint. Even in the desert.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_2.2: We guard the road. With a lance, a lantern and a thermos of tea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_2.3: In the daytime the sand is too hot for humpguh paws. That's why caravans travel at night.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_3.1: Light the campfire: that's where you wake up if you faint. Even in the desert.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_3.2: We guard the road. With a lance, a lantern and a thermos of tea.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_6.1: Light the campfire: that's where you wake up if you faint. Even in the desert.

vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_staarthaven: at Highchonk Tail Harbor, the pier all the way at the back on Mother Cloudwhale's tail (east side)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_luchthaven: at the Rose Gorge Skyport, the round stone mooring tower on the north edge of the gorge
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_plein: on the Rose Square, the floor of the Rose Gorge by the star-shaped fountain
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_schatkamer: in front of the Treasure Room, the big carved facade in the end wall on the east side of the Rose Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_klus_dadels: on the Rose Square, the floor of the Rose Gorge by the star-shaped fountain, by the baskets of dates next to the caravan
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_klus_water: on the Rose Square, the floor of the Rose Gorge by the star-shaped fountain, at the star-shaped fountain (filling water skins)

vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_moederoase: on the shore of the Mother Oasis, under the big Mother Palm (the east of the Silklands)

vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_examen_2: on the top gallery of the Saffron Bridge
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_examen_3: on the western minaret with guh ears of the Raisin Palace
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_examen_4: on the Sea Mouth Pier in the Rose Gorge

vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_waterval_2: by the middle waterfall of the Palm Gorges, behind the curtain of water
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_waterval_3: by the top waterfall of the Palm Gorges, under the Palm Beacon

vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_dadelpalmen: in the palm grove under the waterfalls of the Palm Gorges

vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_zoutvlakte: on the white Salt Flats, southeast of Saffron Gate
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_moerbeibomen: by the mulberry trees in the Palm Gorges, along the river under the waterfalls
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_uitkijk_zeemond: at the lookout at the end of the Sea Mouth Pier (Rose Gorge, west)

vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_uitkijk_minaret: up in the tallest minaret with guh ears of the Raisin Palace (up the spiral stairs)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.z6_uitkijk_mesa: up on the Table Mesa in the Ruin Valley, with a view all the way to the gray tower

vadsrijk.indeling.barriere.zijdewind: The warm Silk Wind gently blows you back. Without an airship you can't cross the strait.
vadsrijk.indeling.barriere.oostgrens: Further east it turns gray and dangerous. The East Route ends here (for now).
vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z6_rozenkloof: in Rose Gorge, the canyon town in the pink rocks (west coast of the Silklands)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z6_saffraanpoor: in Saffron Gate, the capital on the Saffron River
vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z6_palmenkloven: in the Palm Gorges, the river gorge with waterfalls southwest of Saffron Gate

vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z6_ruinedal: in Ruin Valley, between the mesas northeast of Saffron Gate
vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z6_moederoase: at the Mother Oasis, all the way in the east of the Silklands
