item.guhs.vr_z6_npc_tablet: Stone Tablet of the Star Guhs
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.tekst: Mother Cloudwhale swims east with all of Highchonk, until the pink cliffs of the Great Mainland loom up. That's where the Silklands lie. Line E flies from Highchonk Tail Harbor to Rose Gorge Skyport.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.bezig: To Tail Harbor, take Line E to Rose Gorge, then to Gorge Mother Rosie in the Treasure Room.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.doel.0: Watch Mother Cloudwhale swim east (the cutscene starts by itself; otherwise at Tail Harbor, at the very back on Highchonk's tail)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.doel.1: Take Line E from Highchonk Tail Harbor to Rose Gorge Skyport
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.doel.2: Report to Harbormaster Hourglass at the desk of Rose Gorge Skyport (north rim of the gorge)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.doel.3: Go down the wall stairs to the bottom of the gorge and walk to the Treasure Room in the eastern end wall: Gorge Mother Rosie
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.aanbod.0: Knight! Look east! The Cloud Sea has parted. There, that pink stripe. That's land!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.aanbod.1: Mother Cloudwhale is already swimming toward it. For you. She felt it, the Queen says. Stars are going out over there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.aanbod.2: As soon as she's still, Line E flies from Tail Harbor. At the very back, on her tail. To Rose Gorge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.0: A knight! From the sky! Come in, dear. Mind the threshold, it's three thousand years old and a bit grumpy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.1: I'm Rosie, the gorge mother. I saw the whale this morning. A little cloud with a tail, on the horizon. What a sight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.2: Why are the nights so dark here?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.3: Ah. You've noticed. The Star Beacons are out. All five. Snuffed out one by one, over the past few weeks.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.4: Caravans steer by those beacons to the Mother Oasis, the source of all our water. Without beacons they get lost. And the river sinks.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.5: Granny Date wants to set out anyway. She's the bravest caravanguh I know. She's on Rose Square. Help her.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.tekst: Granny Date is setting off with her little caravan to Saffron Gate, even though the Star Beacons are out. She could use a few extra hands. And you could use a humpguh.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.bezig: Dates, waterskins, carpets, and a humpguh from Stable Master Bumpy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.doel.0: Pack the baskets of dates, next to the caravan on Rose Square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.doel.1: Fill the waterskins at the star-shaped fountain on Rose Square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.doel.2: Get the rolled-up carpets from the carpet shop of Carpet Trader Fringe (Rose Square)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.doel.3: Choose your own humpguh from Stable Master Bumpy in the humpguh stable on Rose Square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.aanbod.0: There you are. Rosie said a knight was coming. You look like you can lift things. Good.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.aanbod.1: My caravan is going to Saffron Gate. Without beacons, yes. I've got a teapot and a good feeling. That's enough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.aanbod.2: Help me pack: dates, water, carpets. And get a humpguh from Bumpy. You weren't planning to walk, were you?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.klaar.0: All packed! And look at you on that humpguh. You two match. Both a little lumpy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.klaar.1: This is Lumpy, my humpguh. And that little dumpling hopping along behind her is Lumpkin. Her little one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.klaar.2: We leave tomorrow. Up through the Siq, and then along the dunes. La-la-LAA-la-lo.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.praat.z6: A knight for a humpguh! Look at them standing there. Sand pink, saffron, cloud white, cinnamon. They're all just as sweet.
A humpguh walks on sand like it's a cushion. And it has two seats. Bring someone along.
This one's choosing you, I see. It's licking your ear. That means: yes.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.tekst: Granny Date's caravan travels up through the Siq and along the Pink Dunes to Saffron Gate. Without beacons. Stay close.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.bezig: Through the Siq, along the dunes, find Lumpkin, and on to the West Gate of Saffron Gate.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.0: Ride with the caravan up through the Siq to the plateau (the narrow canyon in the northeast of Rose Gorge)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.1: Follow the dune road to the caravan's resting spot on the western edge of the Pink Dunes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.2: Lumpkin is lost! Find the baby humpguh behind the tall dune south of the resting spot
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.3: From the dune ridge east of the resting spot, see what's swimming through the sand
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.4: Bring the caravan to the West Gate of Saffron Gate, at the end of the caravan road
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.5: Find Granny Date in the Caravanserai by the West Gate of Saffron Gate
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.aanbod.0: Ready? Then off we go. By day the sand is too hot, so we travel at dusk. Without stars. How exciting.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.aanbod.1: Up through the Siq, and then along the dunes. Stay close. And keep an eye on Lumpkin, she chases everything.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.klaar.0: We made it! Saffron Gate! Can you smell that? Cardamom, roses and river water.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.klaar.1: That thing in the dunes... Queen Wormelina. She used to sing, for the caravans. Now she's gray and hungry.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.klaar.2: Everything's been going wrong since the beacons went out. Go to Sultana Raisin in the palace. She needs to know there's a knight here.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.tekst: Sultana Raisin keeps the old star map of the Silklands. Grand Vizier Cinnamon Stick arranges the audience. And Stargazer Twinkle can teach you how to read the stars.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.bezig: Grand Vizier Cinnamon Stick, the Sultana in the Hall of Mirrors, and Twinkle's telescope.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.doel.0: Ask Grand Vizier Cinnamon Stick for an audience, at the iwan in front of the Hall of Mirrors in the Raisin Palace (north bank)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.doel.1: Go to Sultana Raisin on the throne at the back of the Hall of Mirrors
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.doel.2: Learn to read the stars: connect the constellation The Little Snuggle at the big copper telescope, at the top of Twinkle's Observatory (northeast of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.doel.3: Talk to Stargazer Twinkle next to the big telescope in the Observatory
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.aanbod.0: The Sultana needs to know, knight. Over the bridge at the West Gate, then the palace with the golden dome. You can't miss it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.aanbod.1: Ask for Grand Vizier Cinnamon Stick. He arranges everything. Even things that don't need arranging.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.klaar.0: You got it! The Little Snuggle, from ear to snoot. That's how you read the stars.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.klaar.1: The vision in the water... Mother Spring. The old spirit of the Mother Oasis. I thought she was a fairy tale.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.klaar.2: Take my Star Lens with you. It's empty, but with every beacon you light, it catches a tiny shard of starlight. Then you can see the night sky even by day.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.klaar.3: Start at the Palm Beacon, above the waterfalls of the Palm Gorges. Palmguh Datepit lives there. He knows the way.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.praat.z6_: An audience? Of course. After tea. Well, a knight may skip the line. I'll just put the tea aside.
Go on through the iwan, into the Hall of Mirrors. Don't stare into the mirrors too long. Master Gleam polishes them. Very... thoroughly.
Strange, by the way. Yesterday I saw myself walking down the hall. While I was standing right here. I should drink less tea.
A knight from the sky. On the back of a whale. What a time to be a sultana.
Look. The star map of the Silklands. Five beacons: Palm, Salt, Ruin, Dune and Oasis. Together they point to the Mother Oasis.
They've all been snuffed out. The river drops every week. If the Mother Oasis dries up, Saffron Gate dries up.
Go to Stargazer Twinkle in the Observatory. Whoever wants to light the beacons must first learn to read the stars.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.tekst: The first beacon stands above the waterfalls of the Palm Gorges. At night you have to follow the constellation The Date Palm, or it won't flare up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.bezig: Palmguh Datepit, up the waterfalls, light the Palm Beacon, and back to Twinkle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.doel.0: Talk to Palmguh Datepit at the lowest waterfall of the Palm Gorges (southwest of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.doel.1: Climb up along the waterfalls to the Palm Beacon, on top of the plateau
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.doel.2: Relight The Palm Beacon: follow the stars of the constellation (at the beacon, with your Star Lens)
The Palm Gorges lie southwest of the city, along the river. Follow the water toward the sea until you hear the waterfalls.
Datepit knows the way up. And watch out for the Mikas with the big snuffer hats. Lamp Snuffers. They snuff out the beacons.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.klaar.0: The Palm Beacon is burning! I saw the beam from my telescope. Look, the lens caught a tiny shard.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.klaar.1: And that voice in the light... Mother Spring. So she's real. What did she say? A straw of gray? Brrr.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.klaar.2: Say, you've got stardust on your coat. Carpet Weaver Button in the bazaar can make something lovely with that. Something that flies...
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.praat.z: A knight with a Star Lens! Twinkle sent you, I see. Then you're here for the Palm Beacon.
Follow the water up. Past the three waterfalls. On top of the plateau stands the beacon, among the old palms.
There are Mikas sneaking around with snuffer hats. Lamp Snuffers. If you see them: shoo them away. They don't like light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.tekst: With silk cocoons from the mulberry trees and stardust from the Palm Beacon, Carpet Weaver Button can weave a flying carpet.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.bezig: Five cocoons, to Button in the bazaar, and a test flight to the Saffron Bridge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.doel.0: Pick 5 silk cocoons from the mulberry trees along the river in the Palm Gorges: look for the white sparkles
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.doel.1: Bring the cocoons to Carpet Weaver Button in the sewing workshop of the Grand Bazaar (south bank of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.doel.2: Test flight! Glide on your carpet over the rooftops to the pavilion on the Saffron Bridge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.aanbod.0: Stardust! On your coat! Who told you I adore that? Twinkle. That chatterbox.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.aanbod.1: With stardust and silk I weave a carpet that flies. But I'm out of silk. The cocoons are all gone.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.klaar.0: You're flying! Well, gliding. A carpet can't fly high, it gets dizzy. But over water and sand: lovely.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.klaar.1: Let it slide to a stop when you halt. A carpet doesn't like braking. Just like me on a slippery floor.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.klaar.2: And now: Granny Date is looking for you, in the Caravanserai. The caravan wants to go to the Salt Flats. That's where the second beacon is.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.praat.z6_k: Cocoons! Five! Sit down. Wait a moment. Rustle, click, whoosh...
Done. A carpet of starsilk. With tassels. Tassels are important.
Sit on it. Legs crossed. Now lean forward, very gently... See? It floats! Try flying to the Saffron Bridge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.tekst: Granny Date's caravan is camping on the Salt Flats. That's where the Salt Beacon is, and something big sleeps under the salt.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.bezig: The caravan camp, the Salt Beacon, escaping the Salt Colossus, the Mika camp, and back to Twinkle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.doel.0: Travel to the caravan camp by the campfire on the Salt Flats (southeast of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.doel.1: Relight The Salt Beacon: follow the stars of the constellation (at the beacon, with your Star Lens)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.doel.2: Dodge The Salt Colossus, who wakes up at the Salt Beacon (you don't have to defeat him)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.doel.3: Search the abandoned Mika Camp on the eastern edge of the Salt Flats
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.doel.4: Bring what you found to Stargazer Twinkle in Saffron Gate Observatory
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.aanbod: There you are! With a carpet, I see. Fancy. My caravan leaves for the Salt Flats tonight. The Salt Beacon is there.
We'll camp by the campfire. I hum the caravan song, you light the beacon. Fair split.
A gray letter. 'To the Ring Finger.' Let me see... oh no. Oh no no no.
'Madam Duchess. The Empty Lens on the tower works. With every snuffed beacon it drinks more starlight. Your rings are nearly full. The oasis is almost hidden enough to pump dry. Your Knuckle, G.'
A tower. By the Mother Oasis. Someone is snuffing out the stars to drink the oasis dry. For the Emperor.
There's one more beacon: the Ruin Beacon. But the way there is on a compass of the old Star Guhs. And that's in The Sunken Observatory.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.teks: In Ruin Valley lies The Sunken Observatory of the old Star Guhs. Inside: the Star Compass, which knows the way to the Ruin Beacon and to the oasis.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.bezi: Professor Dust, The Sunken Observatory, the Star Compass, the Ruin Beacon, and back to Twinkle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.doel: Talk to Professor Dust in the archaeologists' camp in Ruin Valley (northeast of Saffron Gate)
Go to the entrance of The Sunken Observatory, the dome half sunk into the sand
Get the Star Compass from The Sunken Observatory (a dungeon: bring friends)
Relight The Ruin Beacon: follow the stars of the constellation (at the beacon, with your Star Lens)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.aanb: Professor Dust has been digging in Ruin Valley for years. He knows everything about the Star Guhs. Especially what lies under the sand.
Go to his camp first. And bring friends to the Observatory. Something in there blows out the fire bowls.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.klaa: The Star Compass! After six hundred years. Professor Dust will be so jealous. May I hold it? Just for a bit?
Look: it doesn't point north. It points to where the stars come together. But for that you need mirrors.
Lots of mirrors. A thousand mirrors... The Sultana's Hall of Mirrors! Take the compass there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.praa: A knight! In my camp! Careful with that jar, there's a little chunk of meteorite in it. Or jam. I don't remember.
The Sunken Observatory is over there, half in the sand. The Star Guhs kept their compass there. But something lives in it now.
A Mika with a giant snuffer. And an old giant guh made of star stone, very gray. Be kind to him. He isn't angry. Just tired.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq09_spiegelzaal.tekst: In the Hall of Mirrors, a thousand mirrors bounce the light of the beacons. With the Star Compass they reveal the hidden path to the Mother Oasis.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq09_spiegelzaal.bezig: The Sultana, the compass in the Hall of Mirrors, and chasing the Mirror Vizier across the rooftops.
Take the compass to the Hall of Mirrors in the Raisin Palace (north bank) and place it in the middle of the runner, under the golden dome. The Sultana is watching
Chase the Mirror Vizier across the rooftops: first to the big golden dome of the bazaar
After him, to the wind tower with the pink dome in the residential quarter
And on to the East Gate, the tower with the guh ears
From the East Gate, see where the Mirror Vizier flees to
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq09_spiegelzaal.aanbo: Take the compass to the Hall of Mirrors. The Sultana knows about it, I sent a pigeon. The mirrors will do the rest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq09_spiegelzaal.klaar: Master Gleam. Twenty years he polished my mirrors. Twenty years he watched, in every mirror.
Master Gleam was the Mirror Vizier. A Mika illusionist, the Knuckle of the Ring Finger. He stole the reflection of the path. But not all of it.
Look. In the corner of the biggest mirror, a little piece got left behind. A path over the dune, to the east.
The Dune Beacon and the Oasis Beacon are the last two. Take the whole caravan with you. Granny Date is already waiting.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.tekst: The great caravan travels by night along the star path to the Mother Oasis. Light the Dune Beacon and the Oasis Beacon, find Mother Spring and look the Ring Finger's tower in the eye.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.bezig: Granny Date, the Dune Beacon, the mirage, the Oasis Beacon, Mother Spring, and the gray tower.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.0: Pick up Granny Date and the great caravan at the Caravanserai by the West Gate
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.1: Relight The Dune Beacon: follow the stars of the constellation (at the beacon, with your Star Lens)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.2: Follow the star path along the East Route through the mirage (between the Salt Flats and the oasis)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.3: Relight The Oasis Beacon: follow the stars of the constellation (at the beacon, with your Star Lens)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.4: Cheer up Mother Spring, the gray water spirit under the Mother Palm on the shore of the oasis
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.5: Walk to the foot of The Star-Snuffing Tower, on the little rock next to the Mother Oasis
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.6: Go back to Mother Spring on the shore of the Mother Oasis
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.aanbod: Two beacons left. The Dune Beacon on the highest dune, and the Oasis Beacon at the oasis itself. Then the path will be fully visible.
Granny Date wants to bring the whole caravan. Every caravan in the city, even. That'll be quite a parade. Off you go. I'll wave.
She fled upstairs. To her Empty Lens. That's where she sits now, with her rings full of my stars.
That door won't open for one knight alone. A ring lock. It takes at least two. More is better.
But look around you. The water flows again. The caravans are singing. The stars are back.
Kneel for a moment. I have no crown, but I have water. That's better.
I hereby dub you Knight of the Silklands. With a splash. That part is mandatory.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.tekst: Lumpkin, Granny Date's baby humpguh, is having a birthday. There has to be a date cake. And a party.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.bezig: Three cake ingredients on Rose Square, and then to the party table.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.doel.0: Collect 3 cake ingredients on Rose Square (dates, honey, flour): look for the golden sparkles
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.doel.1: Bring the date cake to the party table next to the fountain on Rose Square
Lumpkin turns one today! Well, one hump. She counts in humps.
I'm baking a date cake, but I'm missing three things: dates, honey and flour. They're somewhere on the square. I forget everything.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.klaar.0: Look at her munch! She's got cake on her hump. On both of them, actually. She only has one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.klaar.1: Thank you, knight. Lumpkin thinks you're sweet. She ate your shoe. That's a compliment.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.tekst: The hanging gardens of Rose Gorge hang over three ledges. They're thirsty, and the wall stairs are steep.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.bezig: The three hanging gardens on the ledges of Rose Gorge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.doel.0: Water the hanging garden on the first ledge (west wall)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.doel.1: Water the hanging garden on the second ledge (east wall, across the stone arch bridge)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.doel.2: Water the hanging garden on the edge of the plateau (across the rope bridge)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.aanbod.0: Three gardens, three ledges, one watering can. And I'm afraid of heights. What a career choice.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.aanbod.1: Will you climb the wall stairs? First the west wall, then across the arch bridge to the east wall, and then all the way to the top.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.klaar.0: They're blooming! Look, they're bending toward you. That's a rose hug.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.klaar.1: Take these seeds. Desert roses. They grow everywhere. Except where you plant them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.tekst: Postguh Stamp has six letters for cliff houses on different ledges. Her little paws are tired.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.bezig: Six letters for the cliff houses on the ledges.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.doel.0: Deliver 6 letters to the cliff houses on the ledges of Rose Gorge: look for the mailboxes with the yellow sparkle
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.aanbod.0: Six letters. Six doors. Three ledges. Two little paws. That doesn't add up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.aanbod.1: Will you deliver them? The little mailboxes sparkle yellow when you get close.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.klaar.0: All delivered! A letter even came back. For you. 'Thank you, from the neighbors.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.klaar.1: Here, a stamp with a humpguh on it. Very rare. I only have six hundred.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.tekst: Carpet Weaver Button's tassels have blown away all over Saffron Gate: onto rooftops, into the bazaar and along the canal.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.doel.0: Find 5 carpet tassels in Saffron Gate (rooftops, bazaar, canal): look for the rainbow sparkles
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.aanbod.0: My tassels! They blew away. They wanted to fly, just like the carpets.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.aanbod.1: Five of them. On the rooftops, in the bazaar and by the canal. With your carpet you can reach them easily.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.klaar.0: All five! They're a bit dusty, but they're home. I'll make something pretty out of them. For your carpet.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.klaar.1: Rainbow tassels. Look at them flutter. Your carpet is now the prettiest in the city. After mine.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.tekst: In the Grand Bazaar, haggling is part of the deal. But whoever haggles nicely gets the biggest discount. Try it with three traders.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.bezig: Haggle nicely with Cardamom, Pistachio and Delight (talk to them: the tracker points them out).
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.doel.0: Haggle nicely with Trader Cardamom, at the spice stall under the big dome of the bazaar
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.doel.1: Haggle nicely with Trader Pistachio, at the stall with the pots and baskets in the bazaar
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.doel.2: Haggle nicely with Jeweler Delight, at the little glass stall in the bazaar
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.aanbod.0: Ah, a new face! Do you know how to haggle in Saffron Gate? No? Then I'll teach you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.aanbod.1: Haggle grumpy, pay more. Haggle nicely, get a discount and a friend. Give it a try. With me, with Pistachio and with Delight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.klaar.0: Three traders, three friends, and not one grumpy mustache. You're a true Haggler.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.klaar.1: You may wear that title. Everyone in the bazaar knows now: you're someone they can deal with.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.tekst: The three big waterwheels of Saffron Gate don't creak anymore. They've stopped. Millguh Creak can feel it in his teeth.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.bezig: The three norias along the river.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.doel.0: Grease the western noria on the south bank of the Saffron River
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.doel.1: Straighten the gears of the big noria next to the Saffron Bridge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.doel.2: Clear the sand out of the eastern noria on the north bank, past the Paradise Garden
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.aanbod.0: Hear that? Nothing. That's the problem. A noria is supposed to sing. Creeee-aak, creeee-aak.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.aanbod.1: The river is so low that the wheels are full of sand. Will you check them? Three of them. I'm too old for the quay.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.klaar.0: Creeee-aak! Creeee-aak! They're singing again! Hear that? It's the most beautiful song in the city.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.klaar.1: My teeth don't ache anymore. Thank you, knight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.titel: Rubber Ducks in the Canal Quarter
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.tekst: Little Pip's ten rubber ducks have drifted off through the little canals of the Canal Quarter.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.bezig: Ten rubber ducks in the Canal Quarter.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.doel.0: Catch 10 rubber ducks in the little canals of the Canal Quarter (on your carpet, low over the water): look for the yellow splashes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.aanbod.0: Quack! Quack! Quack! They're all called Quack. And they're all gone.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.aanbod.1: They're floating in the little canals. If you fly low over the water on your carpet, you can grab them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.klaar.0: All ten! Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack and... Quack! You're the best.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.klaar.1: You can keep one. His name is Quack.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.tekst: Twinkle wants to know if you're a real stargazer. Four constellations, four high spots.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.bezig: Four constellations at four high spots.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.doel.0: Connect The Little Fluff on the roof of Twinkle's Observatory
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.doel.1: Connect The Great Snuggle on the top gallery of the Saffron Bridge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.doel.2: Connect The Flying Humpguh on the western minaret of the Raisin Palace
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.doel.3: Connect The Little Crown on the Sea Mouth Pier in Rose Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.aanbod.0: A real stargazer knows the constellations by heart. Well, from a little book. That counts too.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.aanbod.1: Four spots, four constellations. The last one is in Rose Gorge. That's where you see the Little Crown best.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.klaar.0: You passed! With an A+. Well, an A. At the Great Snuggle you stepped on my toe for a moment.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.klaar.1: Did you know the Little Fluff, the Great Snuggle and the Flying Humpguh are the oldest constellations? They say they've turned gray in the tower. I can't bear to think about it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.tekst: A gang of date monkeys has pinched Datepit's date harvest and hidden it in the palms.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.bezig: Six baskets of dates in the palm grove.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.doel.0: Find 6 baskets of pinched dates in the palm grove below the waterfalls of the Palm Gorges: look for the brown sparkles
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.aanbod.0: My dates! Gone! The date monkeys pinched them. They throw them at me when I come to look.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.aanbod.1: They hide them in baskets high up in the palms. Six baskets. Get them back. Duck!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.klaar.0: My dates! All of them! And you didn't even get a date to the head. Or did you? You've got a bump.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.klaar.1: One of the little monkeys is following you, I see. He likes you. That's a good sign.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.tekst: Courier Splash delivers the mail along the waterfalls of the Palm Gorges. Can you do it faster?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.doel.0: Start at the lowest waterfall of the Palm Gorges
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.doel.1: On to the middle waterfall, behind the curtain of water
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.doel.2: And all the way up, to the top waterfall below the Palm Beacon
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.aanbod.0: Three waterfalls, from bottom to top. I do it in three minutes. With a wet tail.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.aanbod.1: With a carpet you're faster. Or you take a dunk. One of the two. Ready? Splash away!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.klaar.0: You're here already? And you're almost dry! That's a record. A new record. My record.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.klaar.1: Take this. A splash pennant. For the fastest courier of the gorges.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.tekst: Salt crayfish threw a party in Saltmaker Grainy's hut. The little house is half collapsed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.bezig: Five salt crayfish, and fixing up the saltmaker's hut.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.doel.0: Catch 5 little salt crayfish on the Salt Flats: look for the pink sparkles in the salt
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.doel.1: Repair the saltmaker's hut on the southern edge of the Salt Flats
Salt crayfish! They walk sideways, they snip everything to bits, and they think my little house is a party hall.
Catch five and take them far away. Flip them over and they're super sweet. And then we need to fix up my little house.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.klaar.0: My little house is standing again! Crooked, but it always was. It's a house with character.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.klaar.1: Hear that? Something is singing under the floor. The Salt Cave. Come back tomorrow and I'll tell you about it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.tekst: Under the Salt Flats lies the Singing Salt Cave. Behind a wall of crystal lies the chest of the First Caravan.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.bezig: The Singing Salt Cave, the caravan song on the crystals, and the chest of the First Caravan.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.doel.0: Enter the Singing Salt Cave, through the crack on the southern edge of the Salt Flats
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.doel.1: Play the caravan song on the singing crystals by the glowing little lake
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.doel.2: Open the chest of the First Caravan behind the crystal wall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.aanbod.0: The Salt Cave sings. Each crystal one note. And behind a wall of crystal there's a chest, they say. From the First Caravan.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.aanbod.1: The wall only opens for the right song. The caravan song. Do you know it? Granny Date always hums it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.aanbod.2: And watch out for the Salt Serpent. It swims through the walls. Be gentle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.klaar.0: The chest of the First Caravan! What was inside? A carpet pattern? The pattern of the First Caravan. What an honor.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.klaar.1: And a note: 'Whoever finds this, shares it. That's how it began. That's how it stays.' Lovely, isn't it?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.tekst: Queen Wormelina, the big pink sandworm who used to sing for the caravans, swims gray and hungry through the Pink Dunes.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.bezig: Cheer up Queen Wormelina in the dunes.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.doel.0: Cheer up Queen Wormelina, in the heart of the Pink Dunes (field boss: bring friends)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.aanbod.0: She always used to sing. When a caravan got lost, Wormelina sang the way. Now she only grumbles.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.aanbod.1: There's a gray salt crust on her back. Knock it off. Jump from a dune. She's big. Bring friends.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.klaar.0: She's singing again! Hear that? She's sleeping in the sand and she sings in her sleep.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.klaar.1: Look, she left this for you. A saddle blanket in pink. For your humpguh.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.titel: The Tablets of the Star Guhs
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.tekst: Professor Dust is looking for six stone tablets of the old Star Guhs. They're scattered among the mesas of Ruin Valley.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.doel.0: Find 6 stone tablets in Ruin Valley: look for the blue sparkles among the mesas
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.aanbod.0: Six tablets. Together they tell the story of the Star Guhs. I have zero. That's not many.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.aanbod.1: They sparkle blue when you're close. The stars marked them, I think. Or I did. I don't remember.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.klaar.0: All six! I read: 'We counted the stars. One by one. And when we were done, we handed them out.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.klaar.1: And this one: 'There came a cat with a little crown. He counted too. But he did not share. He only counted what he had. Never enough.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.klaar.2: A cat with a little crown... That sounds like a fairy tale Mikas tell each other. Strange.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.tekst: Along the East Route, Unchonked come from the east to the Mother Oasis. Skinny Minnie from Highchonk takes them in.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.bezig: A bowl of soup for three Unchonked.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.doel.0: Give a bowl of soup to 3 Unchonked at the refugee tents on the east side of the Mother Oasis
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.aanbod.0: Knight! It's me, Minnie! I came along with the whale, and then with a caravan. I wanted to help.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.aanbod.1: They come from the east, along the East Route. Just as skinny as I was back then. Give them soup. Soup always helps.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.klaar.0: Look at them eat. They're already turning a little pink. Just like me back then.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.klaar.1: More are coming. I'm staying here. Someone has to stir the soup. And I'm good at it.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oefen.intro: Twinkle: "You always draw a little guh head like this: first the left ear, then the right ear, and then the little snout."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oefen.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oefen.klaar: The constellation The Little Snuggle shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oefen.0.vraag: Where does The Little Snuggle begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.palm.intro: Mother Spring whispers: "A palm grows from the bottom up. Start at the foot, climb up the trunk to the crown, and then let the leaves hang down: first left, then right."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.palm.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.palm.klaar: The constellation The Date Palm shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.palm.0.vraag: Where does The Date Palm begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.zout.intro: Granny Date hums: "Ears first, left and right. Then the right cheek, the snout in the middle, and the left cheek to close the circle."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.zout.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again at the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.zout.klaar: The constellation The Little Guh Head shines bright in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.zout.0.vraag: Where does The Little Guh Head begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ruine.intro: On the temple wall it's written, half worn away: "The Star Guh begins at his little crown, then his heart, then his left paw and his right paw."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ruine.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ruine.klaar: The constellation The Star Guh shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ruine.0.vraag: Where does The Star Guh begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.duin.intro: Mother Spring, louder now: "You follow a humpguh from back to front. The little tail, the back hump, the front hump, and then his sweet head."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.duin.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.duin.klaar: The constellation The Humpguh shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oase.intro: Mother Spring, clear as water: "I am the spring. Start at the water, follow the roots up to the trunk, open the crown, and end at the star at the top. That's where I wait."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oase.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oase.klaar: The constellation The Mother Palm shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oase.0.vraag: Where does The Mother Palm begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_1.intro: Twinkle: "The Little Fluff is round. Start at the top and go clockwise: top, right, bottom, left."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_1.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_1.klaar: The constellation The Little Fluff shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_1.0.vra: Where does The Little Fluff begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_2.intro: Twinkle: "The Great Snuggle spreads his arms. Left hand, left shoulder, right shoulder, right hand."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_2.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_2.klaar: The constellation The Great Snuggle shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_2.0.vra: Where does The Great Snuggle begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_3.intro: Twinkle: "The Flying Humpguh flies east. Start at his tail in the west, then the wing, and end at his snout in the east."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_3.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_3.klaar: The constellation The Flying Humpguh shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_3.0.vra: Where does The Flying Humpguh begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_4.intro: Professor Dust wrote it down: "A cat with a little crown counted the stars. Start at the left point, then the middle one, then the right. Three points. Never enough, he added."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_4.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_4.klaar: The constellation The Little Crown shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_4.0.vra: Where does The Little Crown begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.lied.intro: The crystals each sing one note. Granny Date hummed the caravan song: "La-la-LAA-la-lo." Low, low, very high, low, and then the very lowest.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.lied.fout: Pliiing! A wrong note. The crystals giggle. Start the song over.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.lied.klaar: The crystals sing along with the caravan song, louder and louder. Then the crystal wall slides aside.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.lied.0.vraag: Which crystal do you tap first? (La)
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.afdingen_karde: Trader Cardamom: "This little bag of saffron costs fifty coins. Fifty! A bargain."
Cardamom pouts. "That's not how we haggle here, sweetie. Try again. Nicer."
Cardamom laughs so hard her little spice heaps puff into clouds. "For you: always a discount. Just say Cardamom sent you."
"That smells wonderful. May I have a sniff?"
Cardamom blushes. "Have a sniff. It comes from the finest crocuses." What now?
"For forty I'll take two, one for you."
"One for ME? Nobody ever gives me anything..." What do you say?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.afdingen_pista: Trader Pistachio: "This pot belonged to my grandpa. It's priceless. A hundred coins."
Pistachio twirls his mustache the wrong way. "Hmpf. Grandpa wouldn't have put it like that." Try again.
Pistachio gives you a wink and a hug. "Just like Grandpa. Always a discount for you."
Pistachio strokes his mustache. "Also from my grandpa." What now?
"Then that pot must have belonged to a very sweet grandpa too."
Pistachio sniffles. "He was so sweet. He always gave a discount." What do you say?
"Then let's do it the way Grandpa did."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.afdingen_lokum: Jeweler Delight: "This little ring of saffron gold costs two hundred coins. It fits around a toe."
Delight slides the Turkish delight away again. "A jeweler doesn't haggle with a penny-pincher." Try again.
Delight laughs with powdered sugar on his snout. "For you: the sweet price. Always."
"What lovely little delights you have there."
Delight offers you one. What now?
"I'll have one, if you have one too."
You chew together. "Mmm. What were we talking about?" What do you say?
"About a little ring for a very sweet price."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ster.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ster.goed: You draw a glowing line to %s.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ster.klaar: The constellation %s shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ster.lens: It's still light out. You hold the Star Lens to your eye: the sky turns deep blue and full of stars.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.0.0: Something trembles in the fountain water. A voice, very soft, like a droplet: "...here... I'm here..."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.0.2: The water is still again. Twinkle stares at you with big eyes.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.1.0: The beacon flares up! A beam of starlight shoots into the sky, and the Star Lens catches a little star shard.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.1.1: In the beam you briefly see a lake, hidden behind shimmering air. A palm. A gray smudge next to it.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.1.2: A voice, still weak: "Thank you... one star... I can feel it... I am Spring. Mother Spring. Come..."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.2.0: The second beacon burns. Two beams cross above the sand.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.2.1: Mother Spring, a little clearer: "I lie sleeping under my palm. Someone is drinking me dry. With a straw made of gray."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.2.2: "She has rings. Ten. They shine with my stars."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.3.0: Three beams! The star path starts to draw itself: a glowing line to the east.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.3.1: Mother Spring, now like a babbling brook: "You're close. The mirage that hides me is wearing thin."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.3.2: "Beware of those who live in mirrors. Mirrors don't show who you are. Only what you look like."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.4.0: The fourth beacon. Four beams, and the night softly sings along.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.4.1: Mother Spring, clear as a fountain: "One more star. My own star. Bring the caravan. Bring everyone."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.4.2: "I'm so tired, knight. But I'm waking up. I can feel it."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.5.0: All five beacons are burning! Five beams meet right above the lake.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.5.1: The mirage tears open like a curtain. There lies the Mother Oasis, so blue it hurts your eyes.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.5.2: And on the shore, under the palm, a big, gray guh of water lies sleeping.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.wolkwaltocht.0: Mother Cloudwhale lets out a deep, happy rumble. All of Highchonk shakes. The Queen waves from her balcony.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.wolkwaltocht.1: She swims. Slowly at first, then faster. Clouds stream past her sides. The Cloud Sea slides by beneath you.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.wolkwaltocht.2: In the east a pink stripe looms. Cliffs, as pink as a cheek. Behind them: dunes, domes, palms.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.wolkwaltocht.3: Mother Cloudwhale puffs a little cloud from her blowhole. It forms two words: "This far."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.wolkwaltocht.4: She settles quietly above the strait. At Tail Harbor the lamps come on: Line E to the Silklands is open!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.aankomst.0: The airship sinks over the pink cliffs. The Silk Wind smells of roses and cinnamon.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.aankomst.1: Below you a gorge opens up, deep and pink. In its walls: doors, little balconies, hanging gardens, lanterns.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.aankomst.2: At the bottom a star-shaped fountain glitters. A caravan of humpguhs is getting ready to go.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.aankomst.3: Welcome to Rose Gorge! Harbormaster Hourglass is already waving his hourglass at you.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.zoutkolos.0: The salt cracks. Fissures shoot like lightning across the flats, toward the beacon.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.zoutkolos.1: A giant of caked-together star salt rises up. Its insides glow gray.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.zoutkolos.2: Granny Date whispers: "Don't fight. Run. He's slow, and we are sweet and quick."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.zoutkolos.3: The Salt Colossus stomps to the beacon, sees it burning and stops, confused. You all slip away.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.0: You set the Star Compass on the runner. A thousand mirrors catch the light of the beacons. A glowing path shoots through the hall.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.1: Master Gleam stands in every mirror. Even in the mirrors he isn't standing in front of.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.2: "What a lovely path. May I borrow it for a moment?" Master Gleam grabs the reflection of the path and rolls it up like a carpet...
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.3: ...and his face slides away like a little window. Underneath: a Mika with a mustache made of mirror shards.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.4: "Master Gleam, the Mirror Vizier. Knuckle of the Ring Finger. Twenty years I polished. Twenty years! My paws are shiny."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.5: He jumps through a mirror and pops out on the roof. After him!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontsnapt.0: From the East Gate you watch him go: the Mirror Vizier, on a carpet of mirror glass, straight to the east.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontsnapt.1: Far away, beyond the dunes, stands something that doesn't belong. A gray tower. Golden rings spin around it.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontsnapt.2: At the top a lens gleams. It sucks the last bit of dusk out of the sky, spiraling inward.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.luchtspiegeling: The air shimmers. Everywhere you see lakes, palms and towers. None of them are really there.
Granny Date sings the caravan song. The whole caravan sings along. La-la-LAA-la-lo.
Four star rays above you point the same way. Follow them. Not the lakes. The stars.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.bron.0: You kneel by the gray guh of water and put your paw on her head. She is cold. And as light as a dry sponge.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.bron.1: Granny Date pours the last waterskin over her. The caravan sings. Lumpkin licks her nose.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.bron.2: Mother Spring ripples. She turns blue. Then pink. Then so clear you can see the fish swimming in her tummy.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.bron.3: "Thank you, knight. What a strange dream. Someone drank me dry with a straw made of gray."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.0: The tower is gray. The grass around its foot is gray. Even the shadow is grayer than a shadow ought to be.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.1: At the top, next to the Empty Lens, stands a lady with a parasol. Ten golden rings gleam on ten toes.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.2: "A knight! How adorable. You lit my stars again. That was very... rude."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.3: She kicks one ring off her toe. It clicks onto the tower gate like a lock.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.4: "That takes at least two, knight. Come back with your little friends. I have tea."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.5: And she dances up the stairs, to the top, to her lens. Her laugh sounds like ten little bells.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ringeling.0: Ringaling sinks to the floor of her tower. Her rings roll across the stones. Ten. Empty.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ringeling.1: "My TOES! They're so... cold. And so light." She wiggles them. She giggles. Her own giggle startles her.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ringeling.2: You give her a hug. She stiffens. Then she turns pink. First her ears, then her cheeks, then her toes.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ringeling.3: "What is this? It's warm. It's stolen from nobody. It's just... given."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ringeling.4: She picks up the last ring, the big one, the Emperor's, and puts it in your paw. "You keep that one. I don't want it anymore."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.0: Somewhere far in the east. A throne room, gray and silent. A long, thin shadow on a throne that is far too big.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.1: Court Scribe Scribble shuffles forward with a note. It has a little heart on it. His quill trembles.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.2: Scribble: "The Ring Finger... uh... isn't coming. She writes: 'Dear Emperor. I quit. I have seen the stars. Toodle-oo, Ringaling.'"
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.3: Scribble: "And uh... 'Your ring is with the knight.' There's a little drawing too. Of a tongue."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.4: A long gray finger taps the armrest. Tap. Tap. Tap. Then: "Then... I'll... see... myself."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.5: Outside, high above the world, the Eye slowly turns. Away from the Silklands. To the west. To Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.schat.schatkamer: Behind the pillars of the Treasure Room is a nook nobody sees. Except you. There's a chest in it, with a bow on top.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.schat.minaret: At the top of the minaret with the guh ears, right between the ears, a little chest is tied fast. Nobody dares go that high. Only knights and pigeons.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.schat.mesa: On the Table Mesa, under a flat stone, lies a chest of the old Star Guhs. There's a note inside: 'For those who look high enough.'
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_1: We, the Star Guhs, counted the stars. One by one. It took a hundred years and three teapots.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_2: When we were done, we handed them out. Every caravan got a star. That way everyone found the way to the water.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_3: We built five beacons to hold on to the stars when it was cloudy. Palm, Salt, Ruin, Dune and Oasis.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_4: Under the Mother Palm lives Spring. She gives water to those who share. She has never once said no.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_5: Then came a cat with a little crown. He counted too. But he did not share. He only counted what he had.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_6: He called it: never enough. We called it: sad. Then we went to sleep under the sand.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.vondst.z6_zoutkreeft: A little salt crayfish flipped over and caught! (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z6_veilig: Rose Gorge and Saffron Gate are safe: no monsters attack in the cities. Campfires work as rest spots.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z6_puzzel: Read the hint carefully: it tells you in which order to connect the stars. Wrong? Then you start over.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.z6_lens: Right-click the Star Lens: you see how many beacons are already burning and where the next one is.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z6_zijdeland.tekst: After Highchonk and from level 60, line E flies from Highchonk Tail Harbor to the Rose Gorge Skyport, on the west coast of the Great Mainland (lv 60-70). The Silklands have two cities: Rose Gorge (the gorge city, arrival) and Saffron Gate (the capital on the river), and five areas: the Pink Dunes (60-62), the Palm Gorges (62-64), the Salt Flats (64-66), Ruin Valley (66-68) and the Mother Oasis (68-70).
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z6_bakens.tekst: Five beacons show the caravans the way to the Mother Oasis. At a beacon you connect the constellation: follow the stars in the order of the hint. A wrong star? No problem: you just start over. During the day the Star Lens shows you the night sky. Right-click the lens to see how many beacons are already lit.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z6_rijdieren.tekst: In the Silklands you get two new mounts. The humpguh (from Stable Master Bumpy, in 'Granny Date's Caravan') is fast on sand and has two seats. The flying carpet (Carpet Weaver Button, 'A Carpet of Starsilk') floats over sand and water and glides on a bit when you stop.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z6_steden.tekst: In both cities you'll find a banker, a Quartermaster (to the Snuggle Quarter), a Squad Board (Snuggle Squads) and campfires. In the Grand Bazaar of Saffron Gate you'll find the merchants and the mentors of smithing and sewing; you learn cooking in the Caravanserai, brewing under the Observatory and beekeeping in the Paradise Garden.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.z6_toren.tekst: At the end of 'The Star Caravan', Duchess Ringaling seals her tower with a ring lock. That finishes the story of the Silklands. The tower itself is a raid for 2 to 10 players: that's where the real final boss awaits.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.doel.3: Tell Stargazer Twinkle in Saffron Gate Observatory that the Palm Beacon is burning
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.doel.3: Fly back to Button in the Grand Bazaar
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.aanbod.2: Mulberry trees grow along the river in the Palm Gorges. They're full of cocoons. Pick five, then I'll weave.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.doel: Bring the Star Compass to Stargazer Twinkle in Saffron Gate Observatory
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq09_spiegelzaal.aanbo: I'd love to come along, but I'm scared of mirrors. They always look back.
There you are! Just look around. Every caravan in Saffron Gate. All of them. They're coming along.
With three beacons lit, they dare again. And with you along, they'd dare anything. Lumpy is wearing her prettiest bells.
First the Dune Beacon, on the highest dune. Then we follow the stars. La-la-LAA-la-lo. Onward!
vadsrijk.npc.plek.gebied.z6_roze_duinen: in the Pink Dunes, the dune land south of Saffron Gate
vadsrijk.npc.plek.kampvuur.z6_roze_duine: at the caravan's resting spot along the dune road
vadsrijk.economie.rijdier.eigen.tapijt: Hovers over ground and water and glides on and on. You can turn it while it still drifts the old way. Space = a little hop.
vadsrijk.economie.stal.nog_niet.tapijt: Carpet Weaver Button weaves it for you in the Silklands (zone 6).
vadsrijk.rijdier.nieuw.patroon_van: New for your %2$s: %1$s! Pick it with %3$s, Dress Up.
vadsrijk.rijdier.nieuw.tuig_van: New for your %2$s: %1$s! Pick it with %3$s, Dress Up.
vadsrijk.rijdier.bron.prestatie.lv10_tap: Achievement: your flying carpet at level 10.
vadsrijk.rijdier.bron.api.z6_kwastjes: Button's reward: find her lost carpet tassels (Saffron Gate).
vadsrijk.rijdier.bron.api.z6_eerste_kara: In the chest of the First Caravan, deep in the Singing Salt Cave.
vadsrijk.tapijt.tip.gekregen: Pick the carpet with N and call it with your mount key (X). Under N, Dress Up you choose the weave, the tassels and the cushion.
vadsrijk.tapijt.tip.rijden: W = speed up, let go = glide (it doesn't stop right away!), S = brake, A/D = sideways. It turns where you look, but drifts the old way for a moment. Space = little hop. It can't fly any higher.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_zwamgrot.uitleg: The Shroom Grotto sings back! Click the Demo Stone, listen to the echo and play the song back on the singing stones.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_zwamgrot.hint1: The song has five notes and starts at the stone in the middle.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_zwamgrot.hint2: Middle, top left, bottom left, top right, bottom right.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_zwamgrot.aanwijz: Deep in the Shroom Grotto stand stones that know an echo.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_kristalgrot.uitl: Turn the ice mirrors until the light beam hits the target at the top left.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_kristalgrot.hint: The beam has to go up before it can go left. Not every mirror takes part.
Up at the first mirror, left at the mirror above it, up, and then all the way left.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_kristalgrot.aanw: In the Crystal Grotto, ice mirrors catch the light.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wortelgrot.uitle: Push the root knots (click them) onto the squares. Stuck? The reset button puts everything back.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wortelgrot.hint1: First look where you have to STAND to push a knot the right way.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wortelgrot.hint2: Start with the knot at the bottom left: down once.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wortelgrot.aanwi: In the Root Grotto, root knots are in the way.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_koraalgrot.uitle: Step on the plates in the right order: first the sea, then the seaweed, then the sun, and last of all the coral.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_koraalgrot.hint1: The sea is blue, seaweed is green...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_koraalgrot.hint2: The order is: blue, green, yellow, pink.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_koraalgrot.aanwi: In the Coral Grotto lie four colored shell plates.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wolkengrot.uitle: Turn the symbol stones (click) and press the button. Written in the cloud: first a cloud cries, then it sleeps, then it dreams.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wolkengrot.hint1: A cloud that cries drops something. Sleeping is done at night.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wolkengrot.aanwi: Deep in the Cloud Caves there's a cloud with a lock.
vadsrijk.grotten.onder.zwamgrot: A glowing mushroom cave under the Sporewood
vadsrijk.grotten.onder.kristalgrot: Crystals and a frozen lake deep inside the Echo Summit
vadsrijk.grotten.onder.wortelgrot: Among the roots of the World Tree
vadsrijk.grotten.onder.koraalgrot: A sea cave under Coral Bay, only reachable by diving
vadsrijk.grotten.onder.wolkengrot: Cloud caves in Mother Cloudwhale's head
vadsrijk.grotten.ontdekt.chat: ✦ You discovered %s! There's an elite, a puzzle and a treasure to find.
vadsrijk.grotten.boek.hint.elite: Deep in %s lives a strong elite.
vadsrijk.grotten.boek.hint.schat: At the back of %s is a treasure chest. Puzzle first!
vadsrijk.grotten.schat.slot: The treasure chest is locked. Solve this cave's puzzle first!
vadsrijk.grotten.schat.al: You already found this treasure. There's nothing left.
vadsrijk.grotten.elite.verslagen: ★ %s defeated! A little cave loot for you.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_mollie.1: A house is only a home with a beanbag in it!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_mollie.2: All handmade, with lots of cuddles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_mollie.3: Pink goes with everything. Really everything.
vadsrijk.huizen.poort.hallo: Hi! I'm the Quartermaster. Behind my little gate lies the Snuggle Quarter: a cozy neighborhood with little streets, a square, a little market and lots and lots of plots. You can buy a house of your very own there and decorate it all by yourself!
vadsrijk.huizen.poort.hallo_eigen: Welcome back, neighbor! Heading home, or popping by someone's place?
vadsrijk.huizen.optie.naar_wijk_kies: To the neighborhood: pick a plot
vadsrijk.huizen.uitleg.1: A district has 24 plots along four little streets. Walk around, pick a free plot and click its 'For sale!' sign. Is the district full? Then we simply build a new one.
vadsrijk.huizen.uitleg.2: You get one house per account: all your characters live together. There are three sizes (cottage, house, villa), each in three colors. Inside and in your garden you can decorate however you like; in the rest of the Chonkdom building stays off-limits.
vadsrijk.huizen.uitleg.3: At the mailbox you sort out everything: collect your mail, lock the door, add friends. Your mount waits in the little stable, your pets play in the garden, and if you log out at home you come back rested (double xp)!
vadsrijk.huizen.bezoek.wie: Who do you want to visit? (your friends and whoever is online now)
vadsrijk.huizen.bezoek.niemand: Nobody with a house is online right now, and you're not anyone's friend yet.

vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.1: A Snuggle Squad is a club of knights who make the Chonkdom happier together. You can join anywhere: at the Squad Board in any town, or with an invitation.
vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.2: You can only found a squad here in Highchonk, at the Squad Clerk. It costs %s and you need zone 4 done, or level %s.
vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.3: Everything members do (creatures, bosses, quests, professions) gives squad xp. Squad levels give handy perks, not big stats.
vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.4: Every squad gets a plot in the Squad Valley with a castle you build up together: from watchtower to Snuggle Castle.

vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.hallo: Good day! I'm Stampy, the Squad Clerk. I'm the one who registers new Snuggle Squads. Stamp it, done!
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.al: You're already in a squad! One squad per knight, that's the rule.
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.te_vroeg: Your own squad? Come back once you've finished zone 4, or when you're level %s. You can already join a squad, though!
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.oprichten: Wonderful! Registering a squad costs %s. Pick a name and a short tag of 2 to 4 characters, and I'll stamp it in.

vadsrijk.gilden.npc.poortwachter.hallo: Beyond this gate lies the Squad Valley: every Snuggle Squad has its own castle there. Want to go?
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.pleinwachter.hallo: Welcome to the Squad Valley! I'll take you back to Highchonk, or to your squad's castle.
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.bord.hallo: Take a look at the Squad Board! All the Snuggle Squads looking for new members are pinned up here.
vadsrijk.gilden.optie.oprichten: I want to found a squad
vadsrijk.gilden.tip.vallei: The Squad Valley: the gate back to Highchonk is on the square. Find your castle via /bond, [To our castle].
vadsrijk.gilden.tip.bank: The squad vault belongs to the whole squad. Recruits can only put things in; members can also take from tab 1; officers from every tab.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_klerk.2: A squad without a tag is like a guh without ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_klerk.3: I've registered more squads than there are clouds in the sky. Almost.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_poortwachter.2: Behind it stand the finest castles of the whole Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_pleinwachter.1: Every plot a castle, every castle a squad.

vadsrijk.ambacht.werk.gilde: Only at the Crafters' Guild of Highchonk.
vadsrijk.ambacht.werk.gilde4: Only at the Crafters' Guild of Highchonk (or in Lanternhaven).
vadsrijk.ambacht.mini.duiken: Diving! Hold and let go in the green
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naar_gilde: My story is done, but yours isn't! Go to the Crafters' Guild in Highchonk, they'll tell you the rest.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.eerst: First finish your mentor's story: %s. They live in the hubs down below. Come back after that!
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.uit: You know the Guild's whole story. When the Chonkdom grows, our story grows along with it!
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.smeden.0.0: Welcome to the Guild's smithy! The Anvil of the Order is whole, but Highchonk has another one: the Cloud Anvil.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.smeden.0.2: It hangs on chains above the city. Forge something pretty from lantern bronze first, then you may use it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.smeden.1.0: Hear that? The Cloud Anvil sings when you strike it. It only does that for masters.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.smeden.1.2: A Master Smith! Here in Highchonk we hang your hammer on the wall. Right next to the one from the old Order.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.naaien.0.0: There you are! The quilt hangs in the Guild Hall now. There's room for one more patch: one from The Lantern Coast.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.naaien.0.2: Of sea yarn, with a little kite embroidered on it. Then the quilt will flutter a bit.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.naaien.1.0: And now the last patch: cloud wool. So soft that the Emperor himself might want to sleep under it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.naaien.1.2: Everybody wants a cuddle, sweetie. Even emperors. You are a Master Sewer now.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.koken.0.0: Look what the divers found: a page from Granny Trudy, in a bottle, in Coral Bay!
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.koken.0.2: 'Fishies from the pink sea, with a pinch of samphire.' Go ahead and make it, then we'll taste it together.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.koken.1.0: The very last page was in the Cathedral: 'The cookie the Emperor never got... starts with cloudberries.'
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.koken.1.2: Cloudberries. The rest we get to make up ourselves. Master Cook, that's you now. Granny would be proud.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.brouwen.0.0: Blub! The sea doesn't turn the crystals here gray, it turns them salty. Salty crystal stays pink longer, did you know?
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.brouwen.0.2: Samphire and a little sponge from the deep. The un-gray potion keeps getting better.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.brouwen.1.0: With sky honey a crystal stays pink even in the fog. The Sky Elixir! My masterpiece... no, OUR masterpiece.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.brouwen.1.2: Blub blub! Master brewer. Let the Chonk Pipes shine.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.imkeren.0.0: Bzzzz, welcome to the Guild's bee stable. Our bees fly all the way to The Lantern Coast and back.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.imkeren.0.2: They want lantern honey! Put a hive on Flower Island, then they won't have to fly so far.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.imkeren.1.0: The bees of Highchonk dance in the clouds. They make sky honey, the sweetest in the whole Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.imkeren.1.1: Can I learn a little dance?
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.imkeren.1.2: You already know it: they dance for you. Master Beekeeper. Bzzzz!
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.mijnen.0.0: Bonk is the mine master of Shroomsbury, I'm the one for Highchonk. He wrote that you tap well.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.mijnen.0.2: Haha, yes, exactly like that. There's lantern bronze on Pierhead. Tap softly, it still glows afterwards.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.mijnen.1.0: Do you know where sky silver comes from? From the fins of Mother Cloudwhale. She doesn't mind, it tickles her.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.mijnen.1.2: She winks back, see? Master Miner, that's you now.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.houthakken.0.0: Kite bamboo grows on Kite Island. Bendy, light, and it whistles in the wind.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.houthakken.0.2: Chop some bamboo first, and ask the sewers. Together you'll make the prettiest kites.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.houthakken.1.0: Cloudwood weighs almost nothing. You could build a house from it that stays floating.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.houthakken.1.2: Someday, maybe. First, you're a Master Woodcutter. The woods of Tail Park whisper your name.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.plukken.0.0: Samphire! Have a taste, it crunches and it tastes like the sea.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.plukken.0.2: Salty and sweet, just like the sea guhs. Pick it gently and it grows back.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.plukken.1.0: The cloudberries in the Eye Garden are ripe. You have to pick them before they float away.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.plukken.1.2: Hee hee, it's true. Being quick and being gentle: that's a Master Picker. And that's you.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.vissen.0.0: Ahoy! I heard you went diving in Coral Bay. Bobby from Shroomsbury already knew it: you'll go far.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.vissen.0.2: And it grows back if you loosen it gently. That's how we take care of the sea.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.vissen.1.0: There are fish swimming in the fountain on Market Lane. Little cloudfish. Nobody knows how they got there.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.vissen.1.2: Maybe it did! Master Fisher, you get to keep that mystery.

vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_knuffelridder.teks: You've become a true Snuggle Knight. Reach level 17 and come back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot: then you'll choose your spec, Shield Knight or Giant Pillow. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_knuffelridder.bezi: Level 17 as a Snuggle Knight, then back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot in the Order temple of Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_knuffelridder.doel: Reach level 17 as a Snuggle Knight (the Drip Caves and the Gorge help)
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_knuffelridder.aanb: I can tell by the way you stand: you've become a true Snuggle Knight. But every Snuggle Knight chooses their own path someday.
There are two: Shield Knight and Giant Pillow. Both strong, both different. Master Pillowcase chose one once, too. He never regretted it.
Reach level 17 and then come back here, to the Order temple. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_knuffelridder.klaa: Kneel, adventurer. Well, sort of sit down a bit. It's time to choose.
Take a good look at both paths. Shield Knight or Giant Pillow. Having doubts later? You can switch with the class master in any town. But for now: choose with your heart.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_pluisjager.tekst: You've become a true Fluff Hunter. Reach level 17 and come back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot: then you'll choose your spec, Sharpshooter or Snare Setter. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_pluisjager.bezig: Level 17 as a Fluff Hunter, then back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot in the Order temple of Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_pluisjager.doel.0: Reach level 17 as a Fluff Hunter (the Drip Caves and the Gorge help)
I can tell by the way you stand: you've become a true Fluff Hunter. But every Fluff Hunter chooses their own path someday.
There are two: Sharpshooter and Snare Setter. Both strong, both different. Miss Dart chose one once, too. She never regretted it.
Reach level 17 and then come back here, to the Order temple. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_pluisjager.klaar.0: Kneel, adventurer. Well, sort of sit down a bit. It's time to choose.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_pluisjager.klaar.1: Take a good look at both paths. Sharpshooter or Snare Setter. Having doubts later? You can switch with the class master in any town. But for now: choose with your heart.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_vadsmagier.tekst: You've become a true Chonk Mage. Reach level 17 and come back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot: then you'll choose your spec, Star Weaver or Blessing Singer. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_vadsmagier.bezig: Level 17 as a Chonk Mage, then back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot in the Order temple of Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_vadsmagier.doel.0: Reach level 17 as a Chonk Mage (the Drip Caves and the Gorge help)
I can tell by the way you stand: you've become a true Chonk Mage. But every Chonk Mage chooses their own path someday.
There are two: Star Weaver and Blessing Singer. Both strong, both different. Grandpa Stardust chose one once, too. He never regretted it.
Reach level 17 and then come back here, to the Order temple. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.

vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.vast: Every slot has a fixed game mode. It belongs to this knight and can never change.
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.rust: Rests in the Hall of Resting Knights in Shroomsbury
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.welkom: Welcome to the Chonkdom! Choose how you want to play. You have three knights, each with a fixed game mode: Normal on the left, Snuggle Mode in the middle, One-Chonk on the right. Your own knight is ready on the left.
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.uitleg_kort: Switch in a town or at a campfire. Clothes, mounts and pets are shared.
vadsrijk.karakter.knop.uitleg: Characters: your knights (switch or make a new one)
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.rust: That knight rests in the Hall of Resting Knights. Make a new One-Chonk knight on the right!
vadsrijk.karakter.na_rust: You play on as %s. Your One-Chonk knight now stands in the Hall of Resting Knights; you can make a new one on the right.
vadsrijk.karakter.welkom.chat: You can always find your knights: the ⚔ button left of your inventory, the Knights tab, shift + right-click on a campfire, or talk to the Grandmaster, the Recruiter or a camp guard.
vadsrijk.karakter.tip.kampvuur: Shift + right-click a campfire to open your knights: switch or make a new one.
vadsrijk.karakter.optie.rekruteerder: Characters: what was that about three knights?
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.8: Oh, one more thing! In the Chonkdom you can have three knights, each with a fixed way to play. On the left Normal, in the middle Snuggle Mode: monsters only hurt you half as much. And on the right One-Chonk: one life, and if you faint, you get a statue!
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.9: A statue? And how do I choose?
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.10: After the welcome scene, the screen opens by itself. Later you'll find your knights with the ⚔ button next to your inventory, with shift + right-click on a campfire, or at a camp guard. You can switch in a town or at a campfire. Wahoog, recruit!
vadsrijk.menu.tab.bond.uitleg: Your squad (guild): members, weekly tasks, perks and your castle
vadsrijk.menu.tab.huis.uitleg: The Snuggle Quarter: your own house in a little neighborhood
vadsrijk.vint.bond.uitleg.1: A Snuggle Squad is a club of players. Together you earn squad xp with everything you already do: monsters, quests, levels and professions.
vadsrijk.vint.bond.uitleg.2: You can join from zone 1: check a Squad Board in any town. Founding your own squad is only possible in Highchonk, at Squad Clerk Stampy.
vadsrijk.vint.bond.uitleg.3: Every squad gets a castle in Squad Valley that you build up together (level 1 to 5), with a vault, trophy hall and workshops.
vadsrijk.vint.bond.voet: Buttons open the squad panel in the chat (also: /bond, /bc to chat)
vadsrijk.vint.huis.titel: My house in the Snuggle Quarter
vadsrijk.vint.huis.intro: The Snuggle Quarter is a neighborhood of its own with little streets, neighbors, a square and a market. You buy a plot with a little house you furnish yourself.
vadsrijk.vint.huis.waar: Getting there: talk to the Quartermaster on the square of any capital (Shroomsbury, Sugarbowl, Honeybough, Lanternhaven, Highchonk).
vadsrijk.web.kaart.verborgen: You're no longer on the live map of guhs.nl. Back on it? /guhs vadsrijk kaart toon
vadsrijk.web.kaart.getoond: You're on the live map of guhs.nl again (never in dungeons, houses or Squad Valley). Hide? /guhs vadsrijk kaart verberg

vadsrijk.questlopen.waarschuwing: This screen changes the progress of your CURRENT character (%s): quests, level, story flags, rewards and mounts really change. Only meant for testing the story quickly. Other characters stay as they are.
vadsrijk.questlopen.lv.klasse: Min. class level %s · expected %s (you: lv %s, class %s)
vadsrijk.questlopen.vecht: Go fight! (Too hard? /guhs vadsrijk vol, or /guhs vadsrijk questlopen verder -> Let it be beaten)
vadsrijk.questlopen.melding.klaar: The whole main line is done!
vadsrijk.questlopen.melding.wacht: Hold on: a scene or dialogue is still playing.
vadsrijk.questlopen.melding.geen_baas: No real boss found: the defeat hook was fired.
vadsrijk.questlopen.melding.immuun: The boss refused to be beaten: the defeat hook was fired.
vadsrijk.questlopen.melding.terug: Set back. Rewards, items and story flags do stay.
vadsrijk.questlopen.melding.gesprongen: Jumped! All earlier steps are done.
vadsrijk.questlopen.melding.geen_scene: No scene played at this step yet.
vadsrijk.questlopen.melding.reset: Quest log of this character wiped (side quests, secrets and story flags too). Level and items stay.
vadsrijk.questlopen.melding.hangt: A scene or dialogue took too long; the screen is back.
vadsrijk.questlopen.melding.vast: This step doesn't count, not even through the hook. Try Jump to on the next step.
vadsrijk.questlopen.fase.wacht: Busy: waiting for the scene to finish...
vadsrijk.questlopen.fase.vecht: You fight it yourself. The screen comes back when the boss is beaten.
vadsrijk.questlopen.tip.overslaan: This step counts right away (via the hook, otherwise the counter), even in the middle of a fight. Then you go to the spot of the next step.
vadsrijk.questlopen.tip.veilig: Stops whatever is running and puts you back on the last quiet spot outside an arena (otherwise at the current step or in Camp Snuggle).
vadsrijk.questlopen.tip.level: Which level Next sets you to: the minimum the step needs, or roughly the level a normal player has here.
vadsrijk.questlopen.tip.adv: Also include your class's advancement quests (lv 17: the spec choice really shows up, lv 35, lv 58).
vadsrijk.questlopen.tip.rijdier: Also include the mount quests and the side quests that reward a pet.
vadsrijk.questlopen.tip.spring: Click a row in the list first. Forward = every earlier step is done silently (with its flags); back = the quests are set back.

vadsrijk.vint.z6raid.halster.ok: The Humpguh in Starnight coat is yours! (N = mounts)
